jobs.title: Director, Engineering - Partnerships
jobs.text:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.
Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.
About the Job
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Global Partnerships engineering organization across Solutions Engineering, Integrations, and API Platform. This leader will combine product engineering judgment, technical depth, customer empathy, and operating discipline to make our partnership ecosystem easier to build on and easier to scale.
You will lead the Solutions Engineering and the engineering teams responsible for partner integrations and API platform capabilities. You will work closely with Product, Partnerships, RSS, Support, Security, Legal, and other engineering leaders to turn partner and business needs into durable platform capabilities.
This role is ideal for a leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: setting direction, simplifying an operating model, making hard prioritization calls, guiding architecture, handling high-severity escalations, and developing managers and senior technical leaders.
Responsibilities
Set the strategy and portfolio for partner integrations, APIs, developer experience and Solutions Engineering making clear trade-offs across business value, partner commitments, reliability, and capacity.
Build a scalable Solutions Engineering model with disciplined intake, prioritization, escalation, SLAs, and communication. Identify opportunities to build a better operating model by collaborating with support, RSS and other cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Lead the technical direction for API Platform and Integrations, and how agentic development can transform the developer experience both internally as well as for external developers using our platform.
Turn recurring partner’s identified problems and gaps into durable improvements in product, process and documentation.
Build trusted relationships across Partnerships, RSS, Product, Support, Security, Legal and Engineering. Make timely decisions when priorities conflict and communicate outcomes, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
Lead and develop managers and senior technical leaders, strengthen delegation and succession, and earn the opportunity to expand the organization’s scope through demonstrated results.
Minimum Qualifications
Significant experience leading engineering organizations that include multiple teams and managers.
Experience with APIs, distributed systems, platform engineering, developer experience, integrations, or another technically complex B2B ecosystem.
Demonstrated success creating prioritization, escalation and operating mechanisms in a high-demand environment.
Strong product judgment, the ability to distinguish a one-off request from a repeatable product or platform opportunity.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to communicate clearly with executives, engineers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of hiring, coaching, and developing managers and senior engineers.
Enough technical depth to review architecture, ask incisive questions, assess risk, and make sound trade-offs without needing to be the primary implementer.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a marketplace, B2B SaaS, platform, developer products, payments, hospitality, commerce, or integration-heavy business.
Experience leading or partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Technical Account Management, or a similar function.
Experience moving a high-touch onboarding or support model toward self-service, automation, AI-assisted support, or risk-based engagement.
Experience driving productivity, innovation, and operational improvements using AI development tooling.
Experience working with external partners, enterprise customers, sales, business development, security, legal, or revenue operations.
Strong background in data-driven decision making, metrics definition, and performance optimization for high-scale enterprise platforms.
Experience with API lifecycle management, OAuth/SSO, developer portals, certification, SDKs, event-driven systems, observability, or partner data access.
Experience operating across globally distributed teams and time zones.
Benefits and Perks
5 weeks paid vacation
Private health & dental insurance
Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to Headspace
Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
Paid parental leave
Time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
Income protection and life assurance
Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
Pension plan contributions
Discounted gym membership
Bike2Work
Season ticket loan
Social events & Thursday happy hours
Free lunch 2 days per week
The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.
Inclusion
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.
If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

jobs.title: Regional Head of Product Proposition (General Insurance)
jobs.text:
ABOUT US:
PolicyStreet is a leading InsurTech group backed by Khazanah, specialising in innovative digital insurance solutions for businesses and consumers in Southeast Asia and Australia. With a network of over 40 providers, we offer a comprehensive range of products, including embedded insurance, customised employee benefits, car insurance renewals, financial advisory, and digital solutions – making insurance straightforward, for everyone. Through our regional group of companies, we serve more than 5 million customers with over US$ 4 billion in sum insured.
THE WORKING CULTURE:
You’ll work closely with our Founders and C-suite, ensuring that decisions are made quickly, feedback is direct, and good work is visible.
We move faster than a traditional insurer, while respecting regulatory requirements and portfolio health.
If you’re solid in the fundamentals, and want the products you develop to actually reach the market – join us in shaping how GI is done in a more digital, partner-led environment.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Develop and execute the regional product strategy and roadmap aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
Structure and own insurance products end-to-end across commercial (All Risk, Cyber) and personal lines (Extended Warranty, Travel, etc.), ensuring coverage relevance, pricing discipline, and scalability for digital distribution.
Partner closely with Partnership Managers to structure and tailor products for digital and embedded solutions, translating partner needs into viable, compliant insurance propositions.
Manage product rates and pricing frameworks, working closely with insurers to balance competitiveness, loss ratios, and underwriting appetite.
Act as the key liaison between insurers and partners, driving alignment on product design, terms, and ongoing enhancements.
Lead and coach regional team in building a culture of accountability, collaboration and strong product thinking.
Build a high-performing team that balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Promote a customer-centric, data-informed and commercially accountable approach to product management.

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations
jobs.text:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.
Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction
Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.
Location
Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Product Operations to build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations function.
In this role, you will define how our Product organization plans, operates, launches, and measures its work. You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.
You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.
This is a player-coach leadership role that requires exceptional operational judgment, strong product instincts, and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced startup environment.
What You’ll Do
Build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations organization, evolving it into a strategic partner embedded across the business.
Hire and develop a team of Product Operations Managers to support stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, and more.
Define PermitFlow’s Product operating system, including planning processes, PRD standards, launch processes, product metrics, customer feedback systems, and cross-functional collaboration models.
Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.
Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.
Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.
Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.
Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.
What We’re Looking For
We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.
8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.
3+ years of experience leading and managing teams, ideally in a high-growth startup or technology company.
Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.
Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.
Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.
Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.
Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and hold your own in strategic and technical conversations.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.
What We Offer
Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
401(k) savings plan
Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
Home office & equipment stipend
Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided
Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)
Closing
If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.
Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting
PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.
We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
Compensation Range: $200K - $250K

jobs.title: Global Programme Director - Finance Technology
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Why we're hiring:
As part of WPPs Elevate28 strategy, we are accelerating a major Finance Technology transformation to simplify, modernise and standardise the platforms, data and processes that underpin Global Finance. This portfolio is critical to statutory reporting, management reporting, forecasting, planning, control, performance management, compliance, and executive decision-making.
The Global Programme Director - Finance Technology will shape, govern and drive WPP’s global Finance Technology transformation portfolio. This senior enterprise leadership role turns a complex, multi-year agenda into a coherent roadmap that simplifies the finance technology estate, strengthens control and resilience, and enables faster, more trusted business insight.
The role spans Finance ERP standardisation, consolidation platform replacement, enterprise performance management, revenue forecasting, analytics, finance data foundations and operating model change. It will work across Group Finance, Enterprise Technology, agencies, markets, regions and delivery partners to align priorities, secure decisions, manage trade-offs and ensure investment delivers measurable enterprise value.
This is a director-level role requiring strategic judgement, executive influence, commercial discipline and the ability to create clarity, momentum and delivery confidence across a high-profile transformation portfolio.
What you'll be doing:
Shape and sequence the global Finance ERP roadmap, moving WPP towards fewer platforms, common templates, harmonised controls and reduced process variation
Lead the transition from legacy consolidation tooling to a resilient enterprise performance management capability across consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting and analytics
Strengthen delivery confidence, investment discipline and benefits realisation across a high-value portfolio with significant executive visibility and business risk
Define the global Finance Technology portfolio vision, investment narrative and multi-year roadmap across Finance ERP, consolidation, enterprise performance management, forecasting, analytics and finance data
Translate finance transformation priorities into a clear, sequenced and deliverable portfolio that balances strategic value, delivery capacity, affordability, risk and business disruption
Establish strong portfolio governance, investment controls, stage gates, assurance and executive reporting to support timely, evidence-based decisions
Lead and orchestrate a portfolio of finance transformation programmes, ensuring clear sponsorship, ownership, outcomes, funding, delivery accountability and benefits realisation
Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, delivery confidence and executive escalations across Finance, Enterprise Technology, data, architecture, security, controls, suppliers, markets and agencies
Build trusted relationships with senior Finance, Enterprise Technology, agency, market and regional leaders to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and maintain enterprise momentum
Shape business cases, funding recommendations and portfolio choices using clear analysis of cost, benefit, risk, sequencing, control impact and business value
Manage system integrators, software vendors and delivery partners against commitments, outcomes, commercial levers and performance expectations
Lead and coach programme directors, delivery leads, PMOs and matrixed teams to raise delivery standards, strengthen transparency and build a culture of accountability.
What you'll need:
Extensive experience leading large-scale finance technology, ERP, enterprise performance management or corporate systems transformation in a global organisation.
Proven track record of leading multi-year transformation portfolios with significant budgets, multiple delivery partners, complex governance and senior executive sponsorship.
Strong understanding of finance operating models and core finance capabilities, including ERP, consolidation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, analytics, controls and finance data.
Director-level leadership presence, with the credibility to influence C-suite leaders, Finance executives, technology leaders, agencies, markets and external partners.
Strong capability in portfolio governance, investment management, business case development, budget ownership, benefits realisation, assurance, RAID and dependency management.

jobs.title: Head of Product Indonesia
jobs.text:
Head of Product
The Opportunity
We are partnering with a fast-growing, technology-driven organisation to identify an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Product to lead its digital product strategy and transformation initiatives.
This is a exciting opportunity for a commercially minded product leader who can drive the development of digital features, platforms, and tools that enhance customer experiences, streamline business operations, and enable scalable growth.
The successful candidate will lead the Product team, taking ownership of the product roadmap, driving cross-functional execution, and translating business needs into innovative, impactful digital solutions.
We are looking for someone who combines strong product leadership, technical understanding, strategic thinking, and hands-on execution, with a proven track record of building and scaling digital products.
What You Will Do
Product Strategy & Digital Transformation
Define and own the overall digital product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning product initiatives with business priorities and long-term growth objectives.
Lead the development and enhancement of digital features, internal platforms, customer-facing tools, and workflow automation solutions.
Identify opportunities to digitalise and optimise existing business processes, improving operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience.
Translate complex business challenges into scalable, technology-driven product solutions.
Digital Product Development & Execution
Oversee the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery, ideation, and requirements gathering through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Drive the development of digital tools and features that improve business workflows, user engagement, and operational effectiveness.
Partner closely with Technology, Design, Data, Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure successful product delivery.
Prioritise product initiatives based on business impact, customer needs, technical feasibility, and available resources.
Establish clear product success metrics, including adoption, engagement, efficiency improvements, and measurable business outcomes.
Ensure digital products are scalable, intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user and business requirements.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for digitalisation initiatives and product enhancements.
Build a high-performing product organisation with clear ownership, accountability, and strong execution capabilities.
Collaborate with senior leadership to shape digital transformation priorities and secure alignment on strategic initiatives.
Act as the key bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring product solutions effectively address operational and commercial needs.
Drive a product-led culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
Product Performance & Continuous Improvement
Establish product performance frameworks to track adoption, usability, operational efficiency, and return on investment.
Leverage user feedback, product analytics, and business insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous optimisation of digital features and tools to enhance user experience and business performance.
Champion automation, system integration, and process standardisation to support organisational scalability.
What Success Looks Like
A clear and executable digital product strategy aligned with business growth and transformation priorities.
Successful delivery and adoption of digital features and tools that improve operational efficiency and user experience.
A high-performing Digitalisation Product team with strong ownership, collaboration, and delivery standards.
Measurable improvements in business productivity, product adoption, process automation, and digital capabilities.
Strong alignment between business objectives, product development, and technology execution.
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to take on a strategic leadership role within a growing technology organisation, where you will have the autonomy to shape the digital product landscape and lead meaningful transformation initiatives.
You will work closely with senior stakeholders, build and lead a capable product team, and play a pivotal role in developing digital solutions that drive business growth and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Technology Director — Global Health (REMOTE ROLE)
jobs.text:
Technology Director — Global Health
ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking a Technology Director to lead technology modernization efforts across various global health and survey programs. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will own delivery of the program's technology work from end to end. You will also serve as one of its technical leads and architects, designing systems yourself as well as directing the team that builds them. You will bridge ICF's applied AI and software engineers with its survey methodologists, statisticians, field operations staff, and country partners. You will be accountable to the funder for results, including the decision to redirect work that isn't performing and move the funding to work that is.
This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional international travel.
It is contingent upon award of program funding.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Modernization Delivery Leadership
Own delivery of the program's AI innovation portfolio. The workstreams cover automated data-to-report production, natural-language data access, multilingual questionnaire design, field data quality, and new measurement approaches.
Run the stage-gate process. Lead go/no-go reviews, and make and defend decisions to stop workstreams, publish what they learned, and reallocate their funding.
Serve as the principal technical counterpart to the funder. Lead progress reporting and learning reviews. Communicate results candidly, including negative ones.
Manage the innovation portfolio, schedule, and risks with the project manager, including inference and cloud operating costs.
Coordinate across global development programs. Share successes, failures, and methods with technology partners to avoid duplicating work.
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Act as technical lead and architect for a cluster of workstreams. Own their system design, write the design documents, and stay hands-on through prototyping and production.
Define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. With survey experts, set the quantitative quality thresholds each tool must meet, and hold the team (and yourself) to them.
Set architecture and standards across the portfolio: model selection and routing, privacy-preserving design, offline and low-connectivity deployment, and security.
Set engineering practice for the team, including specification-driven development with agentic coding tools, evaluation-first delivery, code review, and testing.
Protect data quality and comparability. Work with survey methodologists so that no innovation breaks the comparability of data across countries and over time.
Oversee responsible AI, data governance, and ethics. Make sure the program meets ICF security standards, IRB requirements, and partner-country data sovereignty expectations.
Team Leadership & Collaboration
Lead and mentor the program's technology team, including applied AI, software, ML, and platform engineers.
Bridge technology and survey expertise. Make sure survey methodologists, statisticians, and field teams shape what gets built, and that engineers understand how surveys work.
Work with national statistical offices and ministries of health, together with ICF's country engagement leads, to design tools that countries want and can run on their own.
Share the program's results openly through public documentation, publications, and presentations at technical and global health conferences.
Contribute to business growth efforts including proactive engagement with potential clients, preparation of white papers, and proposal development.
Minimum Required Experience
Bachelors degree in IT, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
Minimum 10 years of professional experience designing and delivering technology solutions, including hands-on architecture of multiple complex systems taken into production
Minimum 5 years leading and mentoring software or data engineering teams to build products or deploy systems
Additional Required Skills and Experience
A track record of architecting and delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered systems in production, and the ability to explain how their quality was measured and where they failed
Experience leading a multi-workstream technology program for a foundation, donor, or government client, with accountability for budget and results
Deep knowledge of system architecture, data pipelines, software development methods, and at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
Hands-on familiarity with agentic coding tools and specification-driven development, and experience setting how a team uses them
U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract
Preferred Skills
Working proficiency in French or Portuguese
Background in survey operations or data collection, such as work on or with the Demographic & Health Surveys (DHS) Program, Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS), Living Standards Measurement Study (LSMS), a national census, or other population-based household surveys

blocks.text: Technology Director — Global Health

ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking a Technology Director to lead technology modernization efforts across various global health and survey programs. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will own delivery of the program's technology work from end to end. You will also serve as one of its technical leads and architects, designing systems yourself as well as directing the team that builds them. You will bridge ICF's applied AI and software engineers with its survey methodologists, statisticians, field operations staff, and country partners. You will be accountable to the funder for results, including the decision to redirect work that isn't performing and move the funding to work that is.
This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional international travel.
It is contingent upon award of program funding.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Modernization Delivery Leadership

items: Own delivery of the program's AI innovation portfolio. The workstreams cover automated data-to-report production, natural-language data access, multilingual questionnaire design, field data quality, and new measurement approaches.
Run the stage-gate process. Lead go/no-go reviews, and make and defend decisions to stop workstreams, publish what they learned, and reallocate their funding.
Serve as the principal technical counterpart to the funder. Lead progress reporting and learning reviews. Communicate results candidly, including negative ones.
Manage the innovation portfolio, schedule, and risks with the project manager, including inference and cloud operating costs.
Coordinate across global development programs. Share successes, failures, and methods with technology partners to avoid duplicating work.

blocks.text: Technical Leadership & Architecture

items: Act as technical lead and architect for a cluster of workstreams. Own their system design, write the design documents, and stay hands-on through prototyping and production.
Define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. With survey experts, set the quantitative quality thresholds each tool must meet, and hold the team (and yourself) to them.
Set architecture and standards across the portfolio: model selection and routing, privacy-preserving design, offline and low-connectivity deployment, and security.
Set engineering practice for the team, including specification-driven development with agentic coding tools, evaluation-first delivery, code review, and testing.
Protect data quality and comparability. Work with survey methodologists so that no innovation breaks the comparability of data across countries and over time.
Oversee responsible AI, data governance, and ethics. Make sure the program meets ICF security standards, IRB requirements, and partner-country data sovereignty expectations.

blocks.text: Team Leadership & Collaboration

items: Lead and mentor the program's technology team, including applied AI, software, ML, and platform engineers.
Bridge technology and survey expertise. Make sure survey methodologists, statisticians, and field teams shape what gets built, and that engineers understand how surveys work.
Work with national statistical offices and ministries of health, together with ICF's country engagement leads, to design tools that countries want and can run on their own.
Share the program's results openly through public documentation, publications, and presentations at technical and global health conferences.
Contribute to business growth efforts including proactive engagement with potential clients, preparation of white papers, and proposal development.

blocks.text: Minimum Required Experience

items: Bachelors degree in IT, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
Minimum 10 years of professional experience designing and delivering technology solutions, including hands-on architecture of multiple complex systems taken into production
Minimum 5 years leading and mentoring software or data engineering teams to build products or deploy systems

blocks.text: Additional Required Skills and Experience

items: A track record of architecting and delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered systems in production, and the ability to explain how their quality was measured and where they failed
Experience leading a multi-workstream technology program for a foundation, donor, or government client, with accountability for budget and results
Deep knowledge of system architecture, data pipelines, software development methods, and at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)

U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract

jobs.title: VP Product
jobs.text:
About Current AI
Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.
If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.
Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.
Role Overview
Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.
As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.
What you will be working on
AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:
Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.
Your first six months
Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha
How we will measure success
Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.
What you’ll do
The VP Product will be responsible for the following:
Product Strategy & Vision
Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed
Internal & External Alignment
Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.
Team & Organizational Leadership
Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.
Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives
Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.
Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment
Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.
What we’re looking for
Essential Qualifications
12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)
Nice-to-haves
Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
French proficiency is a strong plus
Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.
Character traits
We’re looking for people who:
Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.
How to apply
Please submit your resume through the button on the top right and answer the prompted questions in no more than [500] words in total:
Equal opportunity commitment
Current AI is committed to ensuring equal access to employment and preventing all forms of discrimination. All applications will be reviewed fairly, without regard to origin, sex, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religious beliefs, views held, or any other criteria unrelated to professional qualifications. Selection will be based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.
Current AI does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have a signed agreement. Current AI will not be liable for any fees or commissions in the event that a candidate submitted in this manner is subsequently hired.
Salary: Paris: 140,000 € - 180,000 € depending on experience. Our offers are adjusted based on location.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Field Engineering
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FIELD ENGINEERING
We're hiring a Regional Director, Field Engineering to build and lead a high impact pre-sales Field Engineering team supporting our fastest growing enterprise accounts. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for ensuring our technical pre-sales motion scales with quality, speed, and credibility. As the Regional Director, Field Engineering, you'll manage and develop Field Engineers who partner closely with AEs to run technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept. You'll also stay close to customers and deals yourself, coaching in real time, unblocking complex evaluations, and ensuring SpaceXSI is positioned as the best AI-native development platform on the market.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead, coach, and scale a team of Field Engineers supporting enterprise opportunities; partner closely with Sales leadership and AEs to drive high quality technical discovery, demos, and POCs
Establish best practices for evaluations, proof-of-concept execution, and technical deal strategy
Serve as an escalation point for complex customer evaluations and high-stakes enterprise deals
Hire, onboard, and develop top-tier Field Engineering talent; set clear expectations and career paths
Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insights back to Product and Engineering
Ensure tight handoffs with post-sales teams to support successful customer onboarding and adoption; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's product, roadmap, and competitive landscape
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
3+ years experience leading Field Engineers, Solutions Architects, or Pre-Sales teams in enterprise software
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Pre-sales leadership for AI/ML platforms, LLM APIs, developer tools, or cloud products sold to engineering, IT and business line leaders
Familiarity with software development lifecycles and enterprise AI: AI coding tools, AI agents, and LLM APIs
Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales while maintaining technical integrity and customer trust
Comfortable operating in customer-facing, high-pressure deal environments and guiding teams through complexity
Strong communication skills and executive presence, and able to engage developers, architects, and CTOs
A builder mindset: you thrive in fast-moving, startup environments and enjoy creating structure where little exists
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
The expected annual base salary range for this role is $245,000 - $280,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
About Leena AI
Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Colleagues don't just answer employee questions — they run the work behind them: case handling, approvals and transactions across systems like Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow.
We compete — and win — against ServiceNow + Moveworks, Workday Illuminate and vertical point solutions. We do it with vendor-agnostic, cross-functional orchestration, the broadest connector coverage in the category, and deployments measured in weeks, not quarters.
The business is working: ARR has passed $20M and tripled in the last 12 months. Gartner has named us a Leader in agentic AI three times running, and hundreds of enterprises — including Nestlé and Coca-Cola — run on Leena AI. We're headquartered in New York, with our product and engineering hub in Gurugram.
The role
We're hiring a VP of Product to own what Leena AI builds, why, and how we know it worked. You'll report to Adit Jain, our co-founder and CEO, and lead the product org across our pods — knowledge management, AI Colleague Studio, integrations, and the HR, IT and Finance agents.
We've built the platform. The next stage is harder: turning a strong agentic platform into the system of record for back-office work, while competing against incumbents who own the underlying systems. That takes a product leader who can set a sharp strategy, decompose it into metrics, and carry senior rooms — internally and with Fortune 500 CIOs and CHROs.
This is not a roadmap-routing role. We want someone who decides, holds a line under pressure, and builds a product org that does the same.
What you own
Product strategy and vision. Define where Leena AI wins over the next 24 months — which back-office workflows we go deep on across HR, IT, Finance and Legal, and where we stay horizontal. Turn that into a multi-quarter roadmap the company can bet on.
The metric tree. Own a clear north star (e.g., autonomous resolution rate, or work completed end-to-end without a human) and the decomposed tree of input metrics beneath it, with owners and quarterly movement targets for every pod. If a pod's plan is a list of features rather than a model of its metric, send it back.
The agentic platform. Set direction for AI Colleague Studio, our agent orchestration layer, voice, and the knowledge layer — so customers' builders can design, test, govern and deploy agents themselves without raising a ticket with us.
Integrations as a moat. Keep our connector breadth and depth ahead of the market — Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Oracle, ADP, Salesforce and Microsoft 365 — and make sure agents land transactions correctly across them.
Enterprise trust. Make data residency, audit trails, explainability, permissions and agent guardrails first-class product features, not RFP afterthoughts.
Field to product loop. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions and our HR domain leads so what we learn in each implementation ships to the next customer by default. Cut time-to-value release over release.
Go-to-market alignment. Work with Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Gen on positioning, packaging and pricing. Be in the room for strategic deals, QBRs, customer advisory boards and analyst briefings.
Team. Lead and grow a team of product managers and designers across New York and Gurugram. Raise the bar on PRDs, metric thinking and customer presence. Hire well and fast as we scale.
Operating cadence. Run planning, roadmap reviews and launch readiness with Engineering, Design, CS and Sales on a single prioritized backlog.

jobs.title: Director Engineering, Retail Media& Marketplace
jobs.text:
About your tasks:
Shape Retail Media & Marketplace: Set the engineering direction across both domains, deciding where the platforms should converge to create the most value for brands, sellers and Redcare.
Lead and grow the organisation: Develop your Engineering Managers and their teams, shaping the organisation as the domains evolve while creating an environment with clear ownership and autonomy.
Drive engineering excellence: Own delivery, reliability, architecture and technical debt, continuously raising engineering maturity and enabling teams to move quickly without compromising quality.
Turn technology into commercial impact: Co-own roadmaps with Product and Commercial, connecting engineering priorities to outcomes such as take rate, advertiser ROAS, seller economics and contribution margin.
Own strategic partnerships: Lead engineering relationships with external platforms, integrators and agencies, including build/buy/partner decisions, integrations, SLAs and vendor performance.
About you:
You have 3+ years of experience leading multiple engineering teams through managers or leads and have successfully led organisations through significant change, such as merging domains, introducing new scope or replacing a platform.
You have led development of commercial B2B platforms such as a marketplace, retail media, ad tech, payments or a seller/partner platform, with experience across high-traffic and transactional systems.
You combine strong technical judgement with commercial thinking, connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes and confidently partnering with senior Product and Commercial stakeholders.
You care deeply about engineering excellence, can demonstrate measurable improvements you have driven, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, external partners and competing priorities. Strong English communication skills are essential.
About your benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:
Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us).
Corporate pension plan: We offer a company pension scheme and have a dedicated external consultant to offer you the best guidance and advice.
About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Retail Media and Marketplace are two of Redcare Pharmacy’s fastest-growing and most strategically important domains — and this is your opportunity to shape how they evolve together. Leading an engineering organisation of around 40 engineers across 5–7 teams, you will decide where these two distinct platforms should converge to create a seamless experience for brands and sellers, and where they should remain separate to perform at their best.
This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly influence our customer experience and commercial growth. Reporting to our Executive Director of Engineering / VP of Engineering, you will lead through two Engineering Managers and partner closely with Product and Commercial leadership to turn engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes.

jobs.text:
Proactive Technology Management is partnering with Michigan Planners, an established employee benefits and retirement services organization, to identify an experienced and forward-thinking Director of Business Technology & AI.
MI Planners is seeking a technology leader who can bring a fresh perspective to their organization, identify opportunities for improvement, and help transform the way they operate through AI, Salesforce optimization, and strategic technology initiatives.

We are looking for someone to work full time in or around either Washington, MI or Traverse City, MI. You'd be expected to be on-site at least 2-3 days out of the week.

We are seeking an innovative, hands-on technology leader who enjoys solving problems, challenging existing processes, and identifying opportunities to make businesses more efficient.

jobs.title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
jobs.text:
Brief info about Vinted
Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:
Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.
Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.
Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
Information about the position
At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.
We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.
This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.
You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.
In this position, you’ll
Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key results
Own the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadership
Partner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in place
Manage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation
Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right time
Own build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutions
Get ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to it
Build, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product Managers
Implement best in class product development and managerial practices
About you
7+ years of experience in product management, with a substantial part of it in AML, financial crime, compliance, risk or fraud, ideally at a regulated financial institution, e-money institution, PSP, bank or fintech
4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product Managers
Deep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)
Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positives
A proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)
Comfortable operating in a regulated environment: you have worked alongside compliance officers, internal and external auditors and supervisors, and you know how to move quickly without creating regulatory exposure
Able to deliver from 0 to 1, and not afraid to build your own tools to achieve your goals
Exceptional leadership skills and substantial experience building high-performing teams of 10+, ideally not only in product (and we’d expect your former teams to still be singing your praises!)
Strong business judgement, analytical skills and long-term planning skill
Both quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisation
Well organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownership
An excellent communicator, including in written and spoken English
Work perks
The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
Frequent team-building events

blocks.text: Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
Information about the position

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.
In this position, you’ll

items: Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key results

Own the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadership
Partner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in place
Manage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation
Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right time
Own build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutions
Get ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to it
Build, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product Managers
Implement best in class product development and managerial practices

blocks.text: About you

4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product Managers

Deep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)

Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positives
A proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)

Strong business judgement, analytical skills and long-term planning skill

Both quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisation
Well organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownership

jobs.title: Head of Product Management - Artist Products
jobs.text:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
The Music team shapes how artists and their music show up on Spotify. Our work spans Spotify for Artists, content upload, artist identity and visual expression, promotion and discovery, and insights that help artists and their teams understand and grow their audiences.
As Head of Artist & Label Product, you’ll lead the product organization responsible for these experiences, bringing together our artist and label products into a clear, connected strategy. You’ll lead PM managers and senior PMs, set direction across multiple product areas, and turn that strategy into meaningful outcomes for artists, labels, listeners, and Spotify. You’ll report to the VP of Product, Design and Insights for the Music Vertical and be a key member of the extended Music leadership team.
What You'll Do
Set the strategy and direction for Spotify’s artist and label products, connecting artist tools, promotion, discovery, expression, and insights into a coherent product experience.
Own business and product outcomes across the portfolio, translating long-term strategy into clear priorities and near-term goals.
Lead, coach, and develop PM managers and senior PMs, creating an environment where people can do their best work and continue strengthening their product craft.
Advance how the product organization uses AI to improve the way we build, learn, make decisions, and deliver value.
Make thoughtful prioritization and resource decisions across product areas, navigating trade-offs and keeping teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
Partner closely with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, Content, and Business leaders to build high-quality products at Spotify’s scale.
Represent the needs of artists and labels in key product and business decisions, helping teams balance creator, listener, and Spotify priorities.
Navigate a complex music ecosystem, including relationships with labels and distributors, legal and licensing considerations, and dependencies across Spotify.
Who You Are
You bring 12+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading product managers and product management leaders.
You have led complex product portfolios and can turn broad opportunities into clear strategies, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
You have experience building products for multi-sided platforms and understand how to create value for different groups with distinct needs.
You understand the commercial side of product development and are comfortable working across revenue, engagement, and user-experience goals.
You have experience creating new products and scaling established products to serve large audiences.
You can move comfortably between long-term strategy and detailed product decisions, communicating effectively with senior leaders while staying close to teams and customers.
You build trusted cross-functional relationships and have delivered complex products across teams, disciplines, and organizational boundaries.
You communicate complex ideas clearly and create frameworks that help teams make informed decisions and move forward.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Compensation
Additional Information
The United States base range for this position is $229,874–$328,392 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
