jobs.title: AI & Data Senior Vice President - APAC
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters, creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve.
By understanding, respecting and supporting the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners fosters an inclusive environment where authenticity, growth and collaboration thrive. We believe diversity strengthens our perspectives, improves our decisions and ultimately delivers better outcomes for our clients.
What you’ll do
As a Senior Vice President in our APAC AI Transformation team, you will lead complex AI workstreams and engagements, guide multidisciplinary teams and help senior clients move from AI ambition to scaled implementation and measurable value.
Your responsibilities will include:
AI Strategy & Transformation
Shape enterprise AI strategies, investment priorities and implementation roadmaps.
Identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities across functions, industries and APAC markets.
Design AI-enabled operating models, governance structures and transformation programmes.
Advise senior executives on AI investment, risk, governance, adoption and value realization.
Lead organisational change and implementation planning for enterprise AI transformation.
Build & Prototype
Lead teams building Proofs of Concept and Minimum Viable Products using APIs from leading Large Language Models.
Guide the development and deployment of AI agents in enterprise environments, including system integration, orchestration, monitoring and controls.
Oversee Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge solutions using vector databases and secure enterprise data.
Set design principles for intelligent workflows, automation, responsible AI and security.
Translate complex business challenges into scalable AI solutions and delivery programmes.
Deliver Business Impact
Lead AI solution delivery alongside client executives, business owners and technical teams.
Drive enterprise adoption, change management and capability transfer.
Define and track business outcomes, value realization and solution performance.
Resolve trade-offs between business priorities, technical feasibility, risk and time to value.
Ensure solutions are responsible, secure, scalable and aligned with enterprise objectives.
Build the Practice
As our APAC AI Transformation capabilities grow, you will also contribute to:
developing differentiated client offerings and sector-specific AI propositions;
creating reusable methodologies, accelerators and intellectual property;
leading proposal development and supporting business development;
managing and mentoring teams of consultants and technical specialists;
strengthening AlixPartners' market leadership in AI Transformation across APAC.
This description is not intended to provide an exhaustive list of responsibilities.
What you’ll need
Your Profile
We are looking for an experienced AI transformation leader who combines consulting judgement, hands-on technical credibility and strong delivery leadership.
The successful candidate will be comfortable leading engagements, managing senior stakeholders and coaching teams across multiple APAC markets.
Relevant backgrounds may include leading IT consulting firms, commercial AI solution teams within technology companies, specialised AI firms, or senior corporate technology, digital, product and AI teams.
Successful candidates will typically demonstrate:
about 10-14 years of working experience with outstanding structured problem-solving, programme leadership and commercial judgement;
hands-on professional experience building Generative AI solutions using LLM APIs; hands-on professional experience and deep credibility in Generative AI solutions, Machine Learning, Data Modelling/analysis
experience leading the development and deployment of enterprise AI agents;
a strong record of moving AI solutions from prototype to production and adoption;
excellent executive communication, stakeholder management and team leadership skills;
the ability to bridge strategy, operations, data and technology;
an entrepreneurial mindset, ownership and the ability to lead through ambiguity.
Technical Experience
The following capabilities are essential:
Hands-on experience building enterprise GenAI solutions using LLM APIs, MLOps, cloud architectures etc. training or self-learning alone is not sufficient.
Experience leading the development and deployment of AI agents in enterprise environments, including integration, orchestration, monitoring and controls.
Demonstrated experience leading AI solutions from prototype or proof of concept into production at scale.
Experience developing or commercializing AI products, AI-enabled devices or robotics is advantageous.
Experience with RAG, vector databases, AI governance, responsible AI and security is advantageous.
Technical credibility must be based on real professional delivery and deployment, not solely training, certification or personal experimentation.
Consulting experience is a plus, but is not required where the candidate has strong enterprise AI leadership, commercialization and stakeholder experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.

jobs.title: AI & Data Vice President - APAC
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters, creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve.
By understanding, respecting and supporting the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners fosters an inclusive environment where authenticity, growth and collaboration thrive. We believe diversity strengthens our perspectives, improves our decisions and ultimately delivers better outcomes for our clients.
What you’ll do
AI Transformation
Artificial Intelligence is creating one of the largest business transformations of our generation. While many organizations are experimenting with AI, relatively few have succeeded in turning it into measurable business value.
At AlixPartners, we help clients move beyond experimentation.
We combine strategy, transformation and execution to help organization's identify high-impact AI opportunities, redesign operating models, prototype solutions, deploy AI at scale and create sustainable business outcomes.
Our AI Transformation team brings together experienced consultants, AI specialists and industry experts to help organizations rethink how they operate, make decisions and create value. Working with colleagues across our global network, we support clients across APAC in functions including operations, finance, procurement, supply chain, commercial excellence and corporate strategy.
Our ambition is to build a team of consultants who combine outstanding business judgement with modern AI capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape our AI Transformation capabilities across APAC and influence how AI consulting evolves within AlixPartners.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on and pragmatic—at AlixPartners, your career is driven by performance, initiative and the value you create.
Working in small, highly experienced teams, you will collaborate directly with CEOs, executive committees, Boards and private equity investors on some of their most strategic and time-critical challenges.
Our consultants do more than develop recommendations. They work alongside clients to design solutions, prototype rapidly, deploy at scale and measure the impact created.
One week you may be helping a CEO define an enterprise AI strategy. The next, you may be building an AI-enabled solution to automate a critical business process, improve decision-making or transform the way an organization operates.
This unique combination of strategy, execution and technology is what differentiates AlixPartners.
Through our One-Firm approach, you will collaborate with experts across industries, functions and geographies, gaining exposure to diverse APAC markets and global client challenges.
Your Role - Vice President
As a Vice President in our APAC AI Transformation team, you will combine hands-on AI delivery with consulting problem solving to help organizations turn AI opportunities into practical, production-ready solutions.
Your responsibilities will include:
AI Strategy & Transformation
Translate AI strategies into structured workplans, use cases and implementation roadmaps.
Identify and assess high-value AI opportunities across business functions and APAC markets.
Design practical AI-enabled processes, operating models and solution architectures.
Support stakeholder workshops and communicate recommendations to senior client teams.
Support change, adoption and responsible implementation of AI solutions.
Build & Prototype
Build Proofs of Concept and Minimum Viable Products using APIs from leading Large Language Models.
Develop and deploy AI agents in enterprise environments, integrating business systems, tools and data sources.
Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions using enterprise search, vector databases and secure knowledge sources.
Create intelligent workflows, orchestration and automation with appropriate monitoring and guardrails.
Translate business challenges into testable AI solutions and measurable outcomes.
Deliver Business Impact
Deploy AI solutions alongside client and technical teams.
Support adoption, training and transition into business operations.
Track solution performance, business outcomes and value creation.
Bridge business priorities with technical implementation and delivery constraints.
Ensure solutions are secure, responsible, scalable and focused on measurable client impact.
Build the Practice
As our APAC AI Transformation capabilities grow, you will also contribute to:
developing client offerings and industry use cases;
creating reusable methodologies, accelerators and intellectual property;
supporting proposals and business development activities;
coaching analysts and consultants;
strengthening AlixPartners' market presence in AI Transformation across APAC.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
Your Profile
We are looking for an experienced consultant or AI practitioner who combines business acumen, hands-on technical capability and an execution mindset.
The successful candidate will be comfortable owning workstreams, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and engaging senior stakeholders.
Relevant backgrounds may include IT consulting, AI solution teams within technology companies, specialized AI firms, or corporate technology, digital, product and AI teams.
Successful candidates will typically demonstrate:
7-10 years of experience with strong structured problem-solving and analytical skills;
hands-on professional experience and deep credibility in Generative AI solutions, Machine Learning, Data Modelling/analysis
experience developing and deploying AI agents for enterprise use;
a track record of taking AI solutions beyond experimentation into production;
excellent communication, teamwork and stakeholder management skills;
the ability to bridge business priorities, data and technology;
intellectual curiosity, ownership and a passion for continuous learning.
Technical Experience
The following capabilities are essential:
Hands-on experience building enterprise GenAI solutions using LLM APIs, MLOps, cloud architectures etc. Training or self-learning alone is not sufficient.
Experience developing and deploying AI agents in enterprise environments, including integration, orchestration, monitoring and controls.
Demonstrated experience moving AI solutions from prototype or proof of concept into production.
Experience with AI products, AI-enabled devices or robotics is advantageous.
Experience with RAG, vector databases, AI governance, responsible AI and security is advantageous.
Hands-on experience must come from real professional delivery and deployment, not solely training, certification or personal experimentation.
Consulting experience is a plus, but is not required where the candidate has strong enterprise AI delivery experience and stakeholder skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritize their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business audiences.
A proactive, client-oriented mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a successful track record of working with diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
About the Role
H&R Block is looking for a Vice President, Enterprise Data & Analytics to turn data into an advantage for our customers and our business. Reporting to the Chief Strategy & Operations Officer, this leader will shape and execute an enterprise data strategy that sharpens customer understanding, speeds decision-making, and unlocks responsible AI and personalization. The mandate is clear: build trusted data capabilities and translate them into measurable growth, better experiences, and stronger performance.
This role brings enterprise data leadership together with hands-on accountability for reporting, forecasting, experimentation, data science, measurement, and decision support. You will set the long-term direction while delivering near-term wins, with clear milestones, measurable outcomes, and visible progress from the start. You will create shared definitions, clarify ownership, and build adoption across functions. In partnership with Product, Technology, Marketing, Retail, Operations, Finance, Information Security, and business leaders, you will move quickly from strategy to execution and business value.
You will create an operating model that pairs enterprise standards with clear business ownership and fast, cross-functional delivery. Business teams will continue to own how data is defined and used, while delivery partners remain accountable for execution. You will clarify decisions, priorities, and responsibilities so teams can move faster with trusted, shared foundations.
What You’ll Lead
Enterprise Data Strategy & Business Value
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy, aligned to H&R Block’s growth priorities and the customer outcomes that matter most, with a sequenced roadmap that delivers meaningful progress each quarter.
Partner with executive leaders to prioritize high-impact opportunities, guide investment decisions, and define measurable outcomes for data and analytics initiatives.
Make data easier to understand and act on, helping leaders turn complex questions into clear decisions and measurable action.
Data Foundations & Governance
Establish practical governance, including data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, decision rights, and escalation paths.
Create shared business definitions and a trusted metrics foundation, working with leaders to resolve competing definitions and ownership questions.
Partner with Technology and Information Security to enable appropriate access, permissions, and responsible reuse.
Enterprise Data Capabilities & Products
Lead the strategy and cross-functional delivery of shared data capabilities, beginning with customer identity and expanding to customer intelligence and reusable data products.
Partner with Product and Technology to build scalable data products that power smarter personalization, responsible AI, and connected digital experiences.
Measure success through adoption, reuse, speed, and business value, while reducing duplicated work across teams.
Analytics & Decision Science
Lead and grow a high-performing team of data scientists, machine learning experts, and analysts focused on the company’s most important business questions, from forecasting and experimentation to measurement and decision support.
Connect analytics priorities to the data roadmap and help business leaders convert insight into action that improves customer experience and performance.
Organizational & Cross-Functional Leadership
Build and develop an exceptional, multidisciplinary data and analytics organization with clear priorities, strong accountability, and room for people to do their best work.
Lead enterprise change with clarity and momentum, building executive alignment, navigating tradeoffs, and bringing business and technical teams together around common outcomes.
Required Qualifications
A track record of leading enterprise data and analytics across complex organizations and turning investment into adoption, measurable outcomes, and lasting business value.
Experience establishing governance that works in practice, including ownership, stewardship, quality standards, decision rights, shared definitions, and trusted enterprise metrics.
Experience building shared data capabilities or products, such as customer identity, customer intelligence, or reusable enterprise data assets.
Leadership depth in analytics and decision science, including reporting, forecasting, experimentation, data science, and measurement.
Strong business and technical fluency, with the ability to connect customer and business needs to governance, architecture, and engineering execution.
Executive presence, influence, and sound judgment, with a record of resolving difficult tradeoffs, leading change, and building teams that deliver.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a customer-centered, multichannel business where customer identity, personalization, governance, and enterprise analytics are important to business performance.
Experience establishing trusted data foundations for AI, personalization, or connected digital experiences.
A background in enterprise data leadership or product leadership for shared data, customer identity, intelligence, personalization, or enterprise platform capabilities.
What Success Looks Like
A clear enterprise data roadmap that balances long-term direction with near-term milestones, accountable owners, smart investment choices, and measurable outcomes.
A more complete and consistent understanding of customers across products, channels, and experiences.
Trusted data and shared definitions that reduce debate, speed decisions, and increase confidence.
Practical governance that resolves issues quickly and helps teams move with confidence.
Reusable data products that accelerate analytics, personalization, and responsible AI without rebuilding the foundation for every use case.
A high-performing analytics organization known for turning insight into action and measurable business value.
Why work for us
At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.
That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.
Pay Range Information
The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.
Pay Range
$248,000.00 - $372,000.00/Yr.

This role brings enterprise data leadership together with hands-on accountability for reporting, forecasting, experimentation, data science, measurement, and decision support. You will set the long-term direction while delivering near-term wins, with clear milestones, measurable outcomes, and visible progress from the start. You will create shared definitions, clarify ownership, and build adoption across functions. In partnership with Product, Technology, Marketing, Retail, Operations, Finance, Information Security, and business leaders, you will move quickly from strategy to execution and business value.

You will create an operating model that pairs enterprise standards with clear business ownership and fast, cross-functional delivery. Business teams will continue to own how data is defined and used, while delivery partners remain accountable for execution. You will clarify decisions, priorities, and responsibilities so teams can move faster with trusted, shared foundations.
What You’ll Lead
Enterprise Data Strategy & Business Value

items: Own and execute the enterprise data strategy, aligned to H&R Block’s growth priorities and the customer outcomes that matter most, with a sequenced roadmap that delivers meaningful progress each quarter.
Partner with executive leaders to prioritize high-impact opportunities, guide investment decisions, and define measurable outcomes for data and analytics initiatives.
Make data easier to understand and act on, helping leaders turn complex questions into clear decisions and measurable action.

blocks.text: Data Foundations & Governance

items: Establish practical governance, including data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, decision rights, and escalation paths.
Create shared business definitions and a trusted metrics foundation, working with leaders to resolve competing definitions and ownership questions.
Partner with Technology and Information Security to enable appropriate access, permissions, and responsible reuse.

blocks.text: Enterprise Data Capabilities & Products

items: Lead the strategy and cross-functional delivery of shared data capabilities, beginning with customer identity and expanding to customer intelligence and reusable data products.
Partner with Product and Technology to build scalable data products that power smarter personalization, responsible AI, and connected digital experiences.
Measure success through adoption, reuse, speed, and business value, while reducing duplicated work across teams.

blocks.text: Analytics & Decision Science

items: Lead and grow a high-performing team of data scientists, machine learning experts, and analysts focused on the company’s most important business questions, from forecasting and experimentation to measurement and decision support.
Connect analytics priorities to the data roadmap and help business leaders convert insight into action that improves customer experience and performance.

blocks.text: Organizational & Cross-Functional Leadership

items: Build and develop an exceptional, multidisciplinary data and analytics organization with clear priorities, strong accountability, and room for people to do their best work.
Lead enterprise change with clarity and momentum, building executive alignment, navigating tradeoffs, and bringing business and technical teams together around common outcomes.

blocks.text: Required Qualifications

items: A track record of leading enterprise data and analytics across complex organizations and turning investment into adoption, measurable outcomes, and lasting business value.
Experience establishing governance that works in practice, including ownership, stewardship, quality standards, decision rights, shared definitions, and trusted enterprise metrics.
Experience building shared data capabilities or products, such as customer identity, customer intelligence, or reusable enterprise data assets.
Leadership depth in analytics and decision science, including reporting, forecasting, experimentation, data science, and measurement.
Strong business and technical fluency, with the ability to connect customer and business needs to governance, architecture, and engineering execution.
Executive presence, influence, and sound judgment, with a record of resolving difficult tradeoffs, leading change, and building teams that deliver.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience in a customer-centered, multichannel business where customer identity, personalization, governance, and enterprise analytics are important to business performance.
Experience establishing trusted data foundations for AI, personalization, or connected digital experiences.
A background in enterprise data leadership or product leadership for shared data, customer identity, intelligence, personalization, or enterprise platform capabilities.

blocks.text: What Success Looks Like

items: A clear enterprise data roadmap that balances long-term direction with near-term milestones, accountable owners, smart investment choices, and measurable outcomes.
A more complete and consistent understanding of customers across products, channels, and experiences.
Trusted data and shared definitions that reduce debate, speed decisions, and increase confidence.
Practical governance that resolves issues quickly and helps teams move with confidence.
Reusable data products that accelerate analytics, personalization, and responsible AI without rebuilding the foundation for every use case.
A high-performing analytics organization known for turning insight into action and measurable business value.

blocks.text: Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.text:
The Vice President of Technology leads WorldVia's technology organization including software engineering, travel technology, IT and network infrastructure, information security, and AI workflow automation. Reporting to the CEO, this role turns WorldVia's technology direction and product roadmap into working systems, and owns how the technology team is built, how work is delivered, and how systems run day to day. The VP manages the software engineering team directly while building out the organization and is accountable for the systems that independent travel advisors and WorldVia staff rely on, including WorldVia's One platform, worldvia.com, advisor booking tools, travel-system integrations, and various third-party systems.
Requirements
Technology Leadership
Lead the technology organization, including software engineering, travel technology, IT infrastructure, information security, project delivery, and AI workflow automation.
Plan the technology organization's growth, including organizational structure, leadership needs, and hiring strategy across engineering, infrastructure, and technology operations.
Build and report on a technology scorecard covering delivery performance, system reliability, security, and cost management.
Develop and maintain a technology strategy that aligns technology investments with company growth objectives, operational scalability, and revenue goals.
Software Engineering & Product Delivery
Manage the software engineering team directly - setting priorities, reviewing architecture and code, and holding the team accountable for delivery commitments - until additional engineering leadership is added.
Partner with the CEO and Product Management to translate the product roadmap into delivery plans, estimates, release schedules, and measurable outcomes.
Own technical architecture and key technology decisions, including platform strategy and build-versus-buy evaluations for advisor-facing tools, WorldVia.com, and internal systems.
AI Strategy
Lead WorldVia's adoption of AI across the company, advancing an AI-native development lifecycle in which AI agents support planning, coding, testing, code review, and deployment under engineer oversight.
Partner with department leaders to redesign workflows using AI, measuring improvements in efficiency, cost, quality, and scalability.
Oversee the company's AI workflow and automation program, identifying opportunities for process automation and driving implementation, adoption, and results tracking across departments.
Travel Technology Systems
Oversee travel technology platforms and integrations, including GDS systems, supplier connections, booking tools, advisor technology, and mid-office systems.
Ensure technology platforms effectively support advisor and employee experiences while enabling business growth and operational efficiency.
Infrastructure & Security
Own IT operations, network infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, access management, and overall technology operations.
Lead the company's information security program, including policies, risk management, incident response, vendor security reviews, and security best practices.
Ensure systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business continuity objectives.
Business Management
Manage the technology budget, vendor relationships, contracts, and technology investments.
Evaluate and prioritize technology spending to maximize business value, operational effectiveness, and long-term scalability.
*This is a remote position. Must be able to travel up to 20%. Travel may include attendance at company meetings, team collaboration, training, conferences, industry events, and other business-related activities.
Qualifications
12+ years in software engineering or technology leadership.
5+ years leading teams of 10 or more people with managers among your direct reports.
Experience leading technology at a company of roughly 50 to 500 employees, covering both product engineering and IT/infrastructure.
A record of hiring and developing engineers and technical managers and growing a team while keeping delivery on schedule.
Experience managing technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and investment prioritization decisions.
Hands-on experience running an engineering team on an agentic development lifecycle (AI coding agents used across planning, coding, review, and testing, with human review and approval steps), and leading AI-driven workflow redesign in business operations with measured results.
Experience putting AI or automation tools into use in business operations.
Hands-on technical depth: able to review architecture and code, judge engineering tradeoffs, and step into delivery when needed.
Experience building and running B2B platforms that depend on many third-party integrations. Marketplace or membership-based software experience is a plus.
Working knowledge of information security and data protection practices.
Proven success partnering with executive teams and influencing company strategy through technology planning and execution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical leaders, staff, and partners.
Preferred
Travel-industry technology experience is strongly preferred, such as GDS systems (Sabre, Travelport, etc.), supplier APIs, booking engines, or host agency or OTA platforms.
Benefits
What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
Employer-Sponsored Medical and Dental Insurance with Employee Contribution
Fully-Funded Life Insurance (1x salary) & LTD (Long-Term Disability Insurance)
Optional Employee-Paid Vision Insurance and STD (Short-Term Disability Insurance)
401k with up to 4% Company Match
Paid Time Off + Company Holidays
Additional Time Off for Your Birthday and Work Anniversary
Travel industry perks and discounts
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Equal Opportunity & E-Verify Statement
WorldVia is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
WorldVia participates in E-Verify. We will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: IS Area Director - Technology Partner API Enablement
jobs.text:
An IS Area Director is a senior technology leader accountable for the strategy, people, delivery, operational health, investment, risk, and business alignment of a significant technology portfolio. They lead through managers, senior technical leaders and Agile Release Train (ART) business partnerships to establish direction and priorities and ensure technology investments support prioritized business outcomes.
WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:
Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
Info Services Director: $190,000 - $215,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Technology strategy & business alignment: Ensure we have the right technology strategy, leadership, architecture, investment, capacity and controls to achieve the business outcomes. Working with ART Product Managers and Architects to help translate business priorities into technology strategy, roadmaps, modernization priorities, and investment decisions.
Portfolio and delivery leadership: Maintain executive-level visibility across initiatives, priorities, dependencies, and delivery outcomes rather than managing day-to-day engineering activities.
People leadership: Lead managers and senior technology professionals while owning talent development, workforce strategy, succession planning, and organizational capability.
Operational stability & risk: Provide leadership around production health, incidents, resiliency, security, quality, observability, and technology lifecycle risk.
Financial & resource stewardship: Make decisions involving investment, budget, capacity, contractors, vendors, sourcing, and business cases.
Architecture & modernization: Establish direction and accountability for architecture and modernization while partnering with architects and engineering leaders who provide deeper technical leadership.
Cross-functional leadership: Align Business, Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Operations, Data, Infrastructure, and external partners around common outcomes.
Governance and decision authority: Area Directors participate in formal approval processes. For example, deployment approvals and the promotion process for engineers and architects where Area Director is a required reviewer/approver.
This IS Area Directoris responsible for the API Enablement with WS Benefit Administrators, Technology Partners, and other integrations:
They serve as the technology owner alongside the Product Manager, RTE, System Architect, Info Service Managers and Business Owners. They collaborate on strategy and roadmap, delivery outcomes, budget/capacity, external resources, stakeholder alignment, and leadership/development of ISMs and technical professionals.
Partnering with business and technology leaders to accelerate API Integrations with Benefit Administrators and other Technology Partners, as well as other integrations while reducing point-to-point solutions and duplicative effort.
Adherence to building reusable APIs and integration services, patterns, standards, schema governance, documentation, observability, and self-service capabilities.
Enablement of reliable information exchange across APIs, events, files, EDI and core business applications.
Identification, incubation, proof of concept and scaling of AI and automation opportunities that improve Technology Partner and customer experience, associate productivity, decision quality, and operational efficiency, with clear pathways for successful proofs of concept to become supported production capabilities.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.
Technology experience: 7+ years of progressive information technology experience, including significant work in enterprise integration, API and observability platforms, or large-scale application delivery.
Leadership scope: 5+ years of people leadership, including leading managers and senior technical professionals across multiple teams, with accountability for budget, capacity, vendors, and contracted resources.
Integration & API background: Strong understanding of API design and management, event-driven architecture, data exchange patterns (APIs, events, files, EDI), integration standards, and schema governance.
Operational excellence: Proven experience leading production support, incident management, resiliency, security, and vulnerability remediation in a regulated environment.
AI & innovation: Demonstrated ability to evaluate, pilot, and scale AI and automation capabilities responsibly, with appropriate governance and measurable business value.
Executive communication & influence: Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business implications, build trust with senior leaders and external partners, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries.
Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.
PREFERRED:
Industry experience: Experience in insurance, employee benefits, financial services, including enrollment, member data, and/or Benefit Administrator integrations.
Partnership experience: Track record of building strategic partnerships with technology vendors, consultants, and internal and external partners.
Agile at scale: Experience leading in a SAFe or similar scaled Agile model, partnering closely with Product Management, RTEs, Architecture, and Business Owners.
This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.
We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!
If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at . Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

jobs.title: Director of Performance Media, Solutions - Design and Development, UK
jobs.text:
About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
Director, Solutions Development – Performance Development
About WPP Media
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:
Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
Role Summary and Impact
As one of our Directors in the Solutions Development team you will be focused specifically on leading the design and development for enhanced digital performance within WPP Media Solutions in ways that have client appeal and are revenue returning.
With either extensive performance marketing, or in-platform performance experience in social and programmatic, you will canvas the broad responsibility of leading strategically on designing the destination and mapping the requirements, with tactical development planning to ensure we build, test, and launch with robust processes.
Strategically, you will act as a forward-looking leader and innovation agent, shaping the future of performance within WPP Media Solutions and directly influencing our own path to delivering Guaranteed Outcomes to clients.
Tactically, you will both lead cross-functional working groups to build, test and launch while also collaborating with marketing science, directly feeding into the rest of the portfolio – defining, evolving and championing lower funnel performance delivery for clients in line with our gold standard measurement and effectiveness framework.
The role promises to offer you a platform for individual growth, matrix management of cross-functional teams across Data & Tech, Solutions Integrations, Marketing Science, Planning, and Activation with a platform for true client and business impact.
Overall Purpose:
To lead, shape, and directly influence our lower funnel performance offer to clients – grounded in social and OR programmatic, with influence into the wider portfolio.
Responsibility set
Performance planning & Solution design:Define and lead the development of best-in-market performance capabilities for Social (P1) and ideally Programmatic Display (P2), ensuring solutions are synced to client needs and cross-channel use cases.
Strategic & Thought leader:Be the go-to expert for innovation and developments in Performance delivery for clients with a lens on Social and Programmatic Display, understanding competitive landscapes, and collaboratively shaping solution differentiation. Lead channel innovation leveraging our Desirability, Feasibility, Viability framework.
Cross-Functional leadership:Lead cross-functional working groups, bringing together diverse teams (media, tech, marketing science, planning, activation) to deliver prioritized developments and planned benefits. This involves being a project manager for complex initiatives.
Senior stakeholder engagement:Engage confidently with senior leaders and stakeholders to drive ideas, influence strategy, and articulate the value of proposed solutions.
Channel ecosystem understanding:Network with agency practitioners and EMEA colleagues to ensure a finely tuned understanding of how channels are planned, activated, and measured, driving solution consistency and identifying opportunities for share and reapply.
Commercial & compliance oversight:Ensure the compliant design and development of owned channel solutions, continuously reviewing pricing, margin setting, and market fit. Maintain a deep understanding of the supply chain and cost model.

jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced and visionary professional to join as Head of Product Management (Risk, Finance & Compliance), taking strategic responsibility for a newly established Product Management division within a leading Swiss banking environment.
In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and management of the product portfolio across Risk, Finance and Compliance. You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.
The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management, with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
Workload: 80–100%
Your Responsibilities
Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas
Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments
Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train
Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus
Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders
Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions
Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels
Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance
Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery
Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements
Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders
Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio
Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape

Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry
Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment
Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation
Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector
Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures
Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures
Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT

Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach

Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset

Very good written and spoken German and English

A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division
The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape
A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility
Close collaboration with Senior Management, business functions and IT
A modern, agile and customer-oriented working environment
A flexible hybrid working model with home-office options
Attractive opportunities for professional development and career progression into leadership roles
A stable and future-oriented environment within an established Swiss financial institution

jobs.title: Director, Global Total Rewards, People Operations & HR Technology
jobs.text:
Clinigen is seeking an experienced global People leader to lead Total Rewards and the operational infrastructure behind an effective employee experience.
In this role, you will shape global compensation, benefits and incentive programs while also leading People Operations, HR systems, payroll governance, workforce data and reporting. You will help create a simpler, more scalable model that equips leaders with reliable insights and enables employees and managers to navigate core People processes effectively.
This is a visible, hands-on leadership role for someone who can connect strategy, systems, data and disciplined execution.
What You Will Do
Develop and execute Clinigen’s global Total Rewards strategy.
Lead global compensation, benefits, recognition, mobility and annual reward processes.
Support executive compensation, incentive design and Remuneration Committee activity.
Lead People Operations and improve core employee lifecycle processes and service delivery.
Own the People systems roadmap, including HRIS implementation, integration, optimization, controls and adoption.
Expand employee and manager self-service and automate high-volume processes.
Establish workforce data standards and improve data quality across systems and processes.
Create executive dashboards and recurring reporting that turn workforce data into clear business insights.
Partner with Finance on headcount, organizational and people-cost reporting.
Provide governance and oversight for global payroll controls, providers, issue resolution and compliance.
Lead and develop a team spanning Rewards and People Operations.
Partner across HR, Finance, IT, Legal and the business to deliver practical, scalable solutions.
Requirements
What You Will Bring
Progressive leadership experience in global Total Rewards, including compensation, benefits and incentive programs.
Meaningful experience in People Operations, HRIS or HR technology transformation.
Experience building workforce reporting, dashboards and data-governance practices.
Working knowledge of multi-country payroll governance and vendor oversight.
Strong executive presence, business judgment and financial acumen.
A track record of simplifying processes, strengthening controls and improving user experience.
The ability to move from strategy to detailed execution in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management and team-leadership skills.
Preferred Experience
Life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or healthcare-services experience.
Private equity-backed, public-company or transformation experience.
Experience supporting global growth, M&A or integration.
Experience implementing or optimizing a modern global HR platform and its connected reporting ecosystem.
Why Join Clinigen?
You will have the opportunity to shape a broad, high-impact global capability rather than manage a narrow functional remit. The role connects how employees are rewarded, how People services are delivered, how systems enable work and how workforce information informs business decisions.
For a leader who enjoys building, simplifying and creating visible enterprise value, this is an opportunity to help define the next chapter of Clinigen’s People function.
About Clinigen
Clinigen is a global pharmaceutical services business focused on helping improve access to medicines. Our teams work across markets and functions to support customers, healthcare professionals and patients around the world.
Equal Opportunity
Clinigen is committed to building an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on role requirements, individual qualifications and business needs. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable law.
Benefits
While at Clinigen, you’ll enjoy:
The culture. Thanks to our diverse opportunities for engagement and involvement, every colleague’s Clinigen experience can be a bit different, and we’re proud of that. We work hard to ensure our company culture is inclusive to people from all backgrounds and social styles.
The benefits. We take pride in having a broad range of activities, systems, and programs that provide a competitive benefit offering and build a culture of celebrating success.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote (US)
About the Role
Turno is growing from a turnover tool into a multi-product platform for hosts, property managers and the service providers who keep their rentals running. As Head of Product, you'll decide what that platform should look like and lead the team that builds it. You'll make the calls on what we build and connect each one to a business metric. It's a hands-on role: you'll write specs, review work and talk to hosts and service providers yourself.
What You'll Do
Set product direction
Own the product vision. Define what Turno's platform should look like over the next 12–24 months for hosts, property managers and service providers, and get the leadership team behind it.
Bring ideas. Spot what we're missing and tell us what we need before we ask.
Decide what not to build. Turn the vision into one prioritized roadmap, and decide what we stop or don't start.
Own business outcomes
Be measured on results. Own the product metrics that drive Turno's business, like retention, marketplace growth and revenue, and set the KPIs that connect product work to them.
Explain tradeoffs. Walk anyone at Turno through the tradeoff between a long-term product investment and this quarter's number.
Balance the marketplace. Make tradeoffs that keep both sides healthy. A win for hosts that hurts service provider retention (or the reverse) is not a win.
Grow with partners. Shape how we build with platform partners and integrations, and how hosts and service providers come onto Turno.
Lead and grow the product team
Lead the product team. Lead product management and design. You set the direction and the standard; PMs own their product areas within it.
Coach and give feedback. Set goals for each PM, review their work, run product critiques, and set clear expectations and growth paths.
Hire well. Attract strong product talent and shape how the team grows.
Work across the company
Partner on launches and growth. Work with Marketing and Customer Experience on launches, adoption and how we explain new features to customers.
Partner closely with Engineering. Work through architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers, and explain them to the leadership team in plain terms.
Set the operating rhythm. Set up planning and review cadences, and make sure everyone knows why the roadmap is what it is.
Stay hands-on
Write, prototype and join customer calls. Use AI in your own work, and lead how we build AI into the product, including agents that handle operational work for hosts and service providers.
What You'll Bring
You make the call. You form a view of where the product should go, then use data and research to test it. When the evidence says you're wrong, you change course.
You start from the customer. Your strategy comes from time spent with customers on both sides of a marketplace.
You're commercial. You think in business outcomes and are comfortable being measured by them. You've owned a business metric such as revenue or retention.
You've led product in marketplaces or B2B SaaS. You have 10+ years in product, including 3+ years leading PM teams.
You grow people. You’ve developed PMs into stronger leaders and built talent-dense teams.
You're hands-on and technical. You still write, prototype and dig into data, and you have the technical depth to earn engineers' trust. You use AI to get more done with a lean team.
You explain things simply. You can walk engineers or the founders through a complex tradeoff in a few minutes.
Nice to have
Experience in short-term rentals, proptech, home services or gig-workforce platforms
Built for multi-sided or partner ecosystems, including bringing businesses or service providers onto a platform
Scheduling, payments or large platform partnerships
Led a product from a single product to a multi-product platform
Led globally distributed teams, including in Latin America

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Head of Engineering
System Crew Group
United Kingdom, Florida, North Carolina or South Carolina. Full-time, remote with regular travel.
About System Crew
System Crew is a managed IT services group operating from eight countries across North, Central and South America, the Caribbean and Europe: the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland and Poland. Its own engineers work alongside a network of specialist contractors, associates and delivery partners, and the group holds partner status with around 40 technology vendors. System Crew designs, builds and runs IT infrastructure for organisations with demanding requirements and supports client operations in more than 70 locations worldwide. Clients include international organisations, government bodies, global logistics and supply chain companies and regulated financial services firms, with work delivered across the Americas and Europe. Recent work includes complete IT separations of business units from their former parent companies, new-site build-outs and long-term managed service contracts. The group is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001.
The Role
The Group Head of Engineering leads the group’s engineering function: in-house engineers and specialist contractors who deliver projects, run client environments and staff the service desk, spread across seven hours of time difference from Central Europe to Central America. The role carries full responsibility for how engineering work is planned, delegated, delivered and documented, and for raising the technical standard of the team.
The group is growing, and the role is expected to build an engineering organisation that scales with it: one that delivers on time, runs on clear ownership, and uses AI and automation as a normal part of daily work. The role reports to the Group Managing Director and works closely with sales and pre-sales on solution design and bids. The role suits someone who genuinely enjoys infrastructure engineering, keeps up with technology out of interest, is still comfortable opening a console to understand a problem, and takes pride in environments that run quietly and well.
Responsibilities
Leadership and management
Lead, organise and develop the engineering team across all locations, with clear ownership, delegation and accountability for every project and client environment.
Plan resourcing and workload so that projects and client commitments are delivered on time, and report progress, risks and slippage early and honestly.
Run a working rhythm suited to a distributed team: clean handovers across time zones, written documentation as the default, regular one-to-ones and team reviews.
Hire, onboard and develop engineers in several countries, manage performance, and build a layer of team leads who can run work without constant escalation.
Travel to team locations and client sites as needed, including the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany and Switzerland.
Engineering and service delivery

blocks.text: Head of Engineering
System Crew Group
United Kingdom, Florida, North Carolina or South Carolina. Full-time, remote with regular travel.
About System Crew

System Crew is a managed IT services group operating from eight countries across North, Central and South America, the Caribbean and Europe: the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland and Poland. Its own engineers work alongside a network of specialist contractors, associates and delivery partners, and the group holds partner status with around 40 technology vendors. System Crew designs, builds and runs IT infrastructure for organisations with demanding requirements and supports client operations in more than 70 locations worldwide. Clients include international organisations, government bodies, global logistics and supply chain companies and regulated financial services firms, with work delivered across the Americas and Europe. Recent work includes complete IT separations of business units from their former parent companies, new-site build-outs and long-term managed service contracts. The group is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001.
The Role

The Group Head of Engineering leads the group’s engineering function: in-house engineers and specialist contractors who deliver projects, run client environments and staff the service desk, spread across seven hours of time difference from Central Europe to Central America. The role carries full responsibility for how engineering work is planned, delegated, delivered and documented, and for raising the technical standard of the team.

The group is growing, and the role is expected to build an engineering organisation that scales with it: one that delivers on time, runs on clear ownership, and uses AI and automation as a normal part of daily work. The role reports to the Group Managing Director and works closely with sales and pre-sales on solution design and bids. The role suits someone who genuinely enjoys infrastructure engineering, keeps up with technology out of interest, is still comfortable opening a console to understand a problem, and takes pride in environments that run quietly and well.

items: Lead, organise and develop the engineering team across all locations, with clear ownership, delegation and accountability for every project and client environment.
Plan resourcing and workload so that projects and client commitments are delivered on time, and report progress, risks and slippage early and honestly.
Run a working rhythm suited to a distributed team: clean handovers across time zones, written documentation as the default, regular one-to-ones and team reviews.
Hire, onboard and develop engineers in several countries, manage performance, and build a layer of team leads who can run work without constant escalation.
Travel to team locations and client sites as needed, including the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany and Switzerland.

jobs.title: Sr Director - Technology and Delivery
jobs.text:
Overview
US Anesthesia Partners is the highest-quality single-specialty anesthesia practice in the United States, with over 6,000 employees distributed across 10 states. Our clinical and non-clinical staff support each other as they work toward a common vision: Forging a better future by empowering people to advance exceptional care.
POSITION SUMMARY: The Sr Director – Technology and Delivery is the senior technical delivery leader for IT clinical business solutions and serves as the VP’s principal leader for the execution and operation of application development, automation, platform development, and application support. This role converts business priorities and solution roadmaps into reliable, scalable, secure, and measurable technology outcomes. The Sr Director – Technology and Delivery is accountable for delivery performance, engineering and support practices, resource management, vendor execution, operational stability, and the development of high-performing technical teams.
The Sr Director – Technology and Delivery does not own enterprise architecture; rather, this role partners with enterprise architecture and the solution architect assigned to clinical business solutions to ensure designs align with enterprise standards, security requirements, integration patterns, and future-state roadmaps. This position also partners closely with solution management to establish clear accountability between business and product priorities and technology execution.
Job Highlights
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)
Serves as the VP’s technology delivery lieutenant, owning day-to-day execution, operational performance, delivery governance, and escalation management across the technical portfolio.
Leads application development, automation, platform development, integration delivery, release management, and application support for clinical business solutions.
Partners with solution management to translate business strategies, product roadmaps, requirements, and priorities into executable delivery plans, estimates, staffing models, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
Partners with enterprise architecture and the assigned solution architect to ensure solutions conform to approved architecture, security, data, integration, resiliency, and technology standards.
Establishes and operates consistent software development lifecycle, using Agile, DevOps, testing, change control, release, documentation, and quality assurance practices.
Owns delivery commitments and portfolio execution, including scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, financial performance, and stakeholder communication.
Leads automation strategy execution and delivery, including workflow automation, process optimization, reusable capabilities, controls, monitoring, and sustainable support models.
Provides interim direct leadership for the platform development team until a dedicated manager is hired; recruits, onboards, and develops the future manager and transitions responsibilities effectively.
Leads application support and service operations, including incident, problem, request, change, release, root cause analysis, service-level performance, availability, and continuous improvement.
Establishes dashboards and operating reviews for delivery predictability, throughput, quality, defects, technical debt, application health, service levels, incidents, customer satisfaction, capacity, and financial performance.
Balances new development, enhancements, production support, regulatory needs, technical debt, platform lifecycle, and modernization priorities with solution management and business stakeholders.
Builds and maintains effective capacity, workforce, succession, and sourcing plans across employees, contractors, managed services, and vendor partners.
Leads and develops managers, technical leads, engineers, developers, automation specialists, analysts, and support professionals; creates a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning, and operational excellence.
Manages technology vendors and delivery partners, including performance, statements of work, deliverables, service levels, financials, risks, and corrective actions.
Ensures solutions and support processes comply with organizational security, privacy, HIPAA, audit, data governance, business continuity, and regulatory requirements.
Provides concise executive-level reporting, recommendations, decision support, and escalation of material risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and delivery constraints.
Drives continuous improvement, standardization, automation, and reuse to increase delivery speed, quality, reliability, transparency, and business value.
Qualifications
KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, healthcare administration, or a related field. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of education.
Master’s degree and relevant certifications in technology, delivery, Agile, project/program management, IT service management, or cloud disciplines are preferred.
12+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, software engineering, application development, automation, platform operations, or application support.
7+ years of experience leading managers and multidisciplinary technical teams in an enterprise environment.
Demonstrated accountability for a significant application or technology portfolio, including delivery, operations, budgets, vendors, workforce planning, and executive stakeholder relationships.
Healthcare technology experience, including clinical, charge capture, coding, revenue cycle, or other regulated platforms is strongly preferred.
Experience with enterprise transformation, platform modernization, vendor implementations, operating model development, SAFe Agile leadership, and organizational change is preferred.
Seasoned technical and people leader with demonstrated success owning enterprise application delivery and operations in a complex, highly regulated environment.
Deep knowledge of application development, automation, integrations, APIs, cloud and hosted platforms, DevOps, testing, release management, observability, and production support.
Ability to translate strategy and business priorities into practical delivery plans and to hold teams accountable for measurable commitments and outcomes.
Strong command of portfolio, program, project, financial, resource, vendor, risk, and service management disciplines.
Ability to operate effectively across solution management, enterprise project management, enterprise architecture, engineering, operations, security, data, and business teams without duplicating ownership.
Executive presence and excellent verbal, written, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, organizational change, competing priorities, production incidents, and high-visibility delivery challenges.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to prioritization, capacity, performance, quality, and continuous improvement.
Ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams and develop managers and technical leaders.
Working knowledge of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, clinical, and revenue cycle operations is strongly preferred.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
· Occasional Standing
· Occasional Walking
· Frequent Sitting
· Frequent hand, finger movement
Use office equipment (in office or remote)
· Communicate verbally and in writing

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)
Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Head of Product to define where Socket goes next and build the product function to support our next stage of growth. We’ve built a platform with strong product-market pull, a rapidly growing customer base, and a lot of room to grow. You’ll set the product strategy, bring our growing portfolio together into a cohesive platform, and help define what software supply chain security looks like as AI changes how software gets built.
You’ll work directly with Feross and the leadership team, and have real influence over what we build, where we invest, and how we grow. Partnering closely with Engineering, Sales, Customer Engineering, and Threat Intelligence, you’ll turn customer needs and market opportunities into clear product direction and products that ship. You’ll stay close to customers, understand where the biggest problems are, and help us focus on the opportunities that will have the greatest impact. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll shape both the big picture and the decisions that bring it to life.
You’ll also build the product function itself: establishing how we prioritize across our portfolio, make tradeoffs, measure success, and communicate our roadmap. You’ll create the practices and team that allow us to move quickly without losing focus, bringing clarity to what we’re building, why it matters, and how each product fits into the bigger picture.
What You'll Do
Set product strategy across Socket’s portfolio. Connect customer needs, market opportunities, and our technical strengths to a focused set of priorities.
Get close to customer problems. Join customer calls, learn from support and sales conversations, and understand what’s behind a feature request before deciding how to solve it.
Partner with Engineering to turn complex security challenges into intuitive, technically sound products. Define clear requirements and success metrics, help navigate technical trade-offs, and give engineers the ownership to determine how we build.
Make prioritization decisions explicit. Balance customer commitments, support escalations, reliability, and new opportunities against engineering capacity. Be clear about product boundaries and what a new priority displaces.
Own outcomes, not just launches. Define the customer impact we’re aiming for, the assumptions we need to validate, and how we’ll measure success. Use adoption data and customer feedback to inform what we do next.
Partner with Sales on positioning, demos, and launches that clearly communicate what we’re building, who it’s for, and why it matters.
Build a practical way to plan and communicate product work. Keep priorities, decisions, and roadmaps clear, and help customer-facing teams distinguish commitments from ideas we’re still exploring.
Grow the product function over time. Help shape how we hire, collaborate, and develop the team while staying close to the work.
What You'll Bring
Senior product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from strategy through launch and learning from the results.
Experience building for developers, security teams, or other technical users, ideally in security, infrastructure, or B2B software.
Technical fluency. You can work through architecture and implementation trade-offs, ask good questions, and earn the trust of engineers.
Strong product judgment. You can separate important problems from competing requests, set boundaries, and make decisions with incomplete information.
An understanding of how customer value translates into business results. You know how technical products are evaluated, adopted, and expanded within an organization.
Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex problems simply, document the reasoning behind a decision, and help teams understand what we’re doing and why.
A hands-on approach. You’re comfortable building where there’s no established playbook, creating structure where it helps, and moving quickly without losing sight of the details.
Preferred
Experience with software supply chain security, application security, vulnerability management, or developer tooling.
Experience building a product function at an early-stage company while continuing to ship.
Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.
Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:
Market competitive salary bands
Meaningful equity program
Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)
Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge
Paid parental leave
Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites
At Socket, we
Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.
Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.
Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.
Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.
Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.
Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.
