jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
Lead and scale the engineering organization at a high-growth AI risk management company. You will shape the team, operating model, and technical culture across AI engineering and deployment engineering, partnering closely with company leadership.
What You'll Do
Scale the engineering organization through significant growth while maintaining execution quality and pace.
Develop engineering leaders and establish management layers and cross-functional coordination for a globally distributed team.
Set operating rhythms for planning, prioritization, hiring, onboarding, and performance across engineering groups.
Represent the engineering organization in technical discussions with customers, partners, and the broader community.
Partner with company leadership on organizational strategy, headcount planning, product development, and go-to-market decisions.
What We're Looking For
At least five years in engineering leadership, building and scaling engineering organizations.
Direct experience scaling an engineering organization from roughly 25 people to more than 100, with accountability for hiring, leadership development, and operating cadence.
Technical depth across AI engineering and deployment or production infrastructure.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and developing engineering leaders.
Background at a high-growth company in a post-Series B scaling phase, with experience managing engineering teams of 40 or more.
Experience communicating technical capabilities to customers, partners, or the wider technical community.
Degree from a highly regarded university or equivalent strong academic and technical foundation.
Based in or willing to relocate to London for a regular in-office schedule.
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary is $325,000 to $365,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.
Location
Hybrid in London, United Kingdom, with four days per week in the office and one remote day, Tuesday or Friday.

jobs.title: Account CTO
jobs.text:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.
If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.
Engineering at Lambda is responsible for building and scaling our cloud offering. Our scope includes the Lambda website, cloud APIs and systems as well as internal tooling for system deployment, management and maintenance.
What You’ll Do
Strategic Technology Leadership for Key Accounts
Serve as the primary technical liaison for Lambda's strategic Superintelligence accounts
Cultivate and sustain executive level technical relationships, establishing Lambda as a trusted technology partner and strategic advisor
Drive multi-year technology roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives and Lambda's product portfolio
Influence customer technology strategy and adoption at the executive level
Represent Lambda at executive briefings, board meetings, and strategic planning sessions
Own Technical Strategy and Business Outcomes
Partner with Global Account teams to drive strategic account growth and expansion
Lead architectural reviews and technology assessments at the enterprise level
Define and articulate business value propositions, ROI models, and TCO analyses for executive stakeholders
Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Product Management
Own technical escalations and serve as the Executive Technical Sponsor for critical customer initiatives
Drive adoption of Lambda's strategic initiatives within key accounts
Technology Vision and Thought Leadership
Establish yourself as a trusted advisor on AI/ML transformation and cloud strategy
Guide customers through digital transformation journeys and emerging technology adoption
Publish thought leadership content, speak at industry events, and represent Lambda in executive forums
Influence Lambda's product strategy based on strategic customer needs and market trends
Mentor and develop technical talent across the organization
You
Have 15+ years of experience designing, deploying and scaling cloud infrastructure
Have 6+ years of experience working directly with C-suite executives and senior leadership teams in advisory or consultative capacities
Have 5+ years driving cloud transformation initiatives at enterprise scale
Have proven track record of influencing C-suite executives and board-level stakeholders
Have deep expertise in AI/ML technologies and their business applications
Have experience with NVIDIA DGX/HGX/MGX systems, InfiniBand &RoCE networking, and large-scale GPU cluster deployments
Have experience with storage architectures including distributed file systems, object storage, high-performance parallel file systems, and NVMe-based solutions
Have hands-on experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, and inference at scale
Have experience with enterprise architecture frameworks and governance models
Have experience managing or influencing deals worth $1B+ annually
Have strong business acumen with ability to translate technology into business outcomes
Have experience navigating complex organizational dynamics and driving consensus
Have track record of building strategic partnerships and alliances
Excel at executive communication, presentation, and storytelling
Demonstrate thought leadership through publications, speaking engagements, or industry recognition
Nice to Have
MBA or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
Experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, Chief Architect, or Technical Fellow at a technology company with $100M+ revenue
Track record working with AI labs, research institutions, or frontier model companies
Board advisory experience for technology companies
Published peer-reviewed research, whitepapers, or patents specifically in distributed computing, GPU acceleration, or large-scale ML training infrastructure
Salary Range Information
The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.
About Lambda
Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
We offer generous cash & equity compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use
Equal Opportunity Employer
Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Senior Director Data Platform & Strategy
jobs.text:
The Mission:EndeavorB2B is a rapidly growing US-based B2B media and events company founded in 2017. Endeavor’s mission is to deliver the highest-quality content in the B2B markets we serve and to do so in the various, multi-channel formats that today’s industry professionals demand. From informative e-newsletters to in-depth monthly magazines to curated in-person events, EndeavorB2B is committed to providing the best opportunities for professionals to stay knowledgeable and connect with marketplace colleagues that drive their industry forward.
The Team: EndeavorB2B places a high importance on its data-driven core values of accountability, continuous improvement and being passionate about value creation in an environment that maintains minimal politics, directional clarity, high productivity and low turnover among good people. These values are adopted at all levels of the company across every sphere and give the company its operational advantage. Our departments and operating businesses have autonomy and place a high value on meritocracy, with a commitment to providing individuals with opportunities for growth and development.
Job Summary:This role will own the strategy, architecture, implementation, and commercialization of EB2B's enterprise data platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing a multi-year data architecture roadmap and presenting it to executive leadership, building pipelines and data models, and standing up governance frameworks. As the platform matures and the team grows, this role's mandate will expand to encompass broader strategic and commercial leadership.
This role comes with a defined implementation roadmap and clear first-year priorities that will be shared with candidates during the interview process.This leader will partner closely with Digital, Product, Technology, Audience Development, Finance, Sales, Editorial, and commercial teams to transform EB2B's audience data into a strategic business asset.
Key Responsibilities:
Data Platform Build-Out & Architecture
Lead the implementation and optimization of EB2B's centralized cloud data platform, driving the consolidation and modernization of our enterprise data assets.
Design and build modern data architecture, data models, and data standards that scale across EB2B's multi-brand, multi-market environment.
Design and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, orchestration, and data quality processes.
Establish DataOps practices, monitoring, observability, documentation, and engineering standards.
Evaluate and implement technologies that support data scalability, automation, and operational efficiency.
Enterprise Data Strategy & Governance
Define and execute EB2B's enterprise data strategy and roadmap.
Develop a scalable data foundation that supports analytics, audience intelligence, personalization, reporting, and AI initiatives.
Create a roadmap for integrating audience, behavioral, registration, engagement, campaign, CRM, and revenue data into a unified ecosystem.
Establish governance frameworks, data-access controls, retention standards, and documentation processes that improve data quality, trust, privacy compliance, and adoption across the organization.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Information Security teams to ensure responsible data practices and compliance with applicable privacy requirements including GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA.
Audience Intelligence & Data Monetization
Build audience intelligence capabilities that support lead generation, ABM, intent data, segmentation, personalization, and audience activation.
Develop strategies to transform first-party audience data into new commercial products and services.
Partner with commercial leadership to identify and execute new revenue opportunities through privacy-safe data collaboration and commercial data product development.
Build scalable reporting, benchmarking, and intelligence products for internal and external stakeholders.
Support the development of data products that enable privacy-safe audience activation, including consent and preference management frameworks.
AI & Advanced Analytics
Prepare EB2B's data ecosystem to support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and agent-based applications.
Ensure enterprise data is structured, governed, and accessible for current and future AI initiatives.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to support AI-powered audience intelligence, content, and sales enablement solutions.
Identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics across the organization.
Execution & Stakeholder Management
Lead cross-functional data initiatives in phases, partnering with Technology, Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Editorial, Audience Development, and Operations.
Build and manage relationships with strategic technology partners and vendors.
Develop project plans, timelines, resource requirements, and success metrics.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
Serve as an internal evangelist for data-driven decision making and best practices.
Qualifications:
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics, or enterprise data strategy, including at least five years leading complex enterprise data initiatives from strategy through execution.
Proven, hands-on experience implementing and managing enterprise cloud data platforms, including platforms such as Snowflake, with deep expertise in data modeling, ELT/ETL design, and pipeline development.
Experience building and scaling enterprise data warehouses and audience intelligence platforms.
Strong understanding of data governance, master data management, data-access controls, and retention standards.
Experience working with privacy and compliance frameworks including GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA, including familiarity with consent and preference management practices and demonstrated ability to partner with Legal, Privacy, and Information Security teams on responsible data practices.
Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, audience, advertising, and analytics data.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to operate independently and drive initiatives to completion.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical strategy clearly to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
Technical Expertise
Cloud data platforms and modern data warehousing architectures (e.g., Snowflake)
SQL and modern data engineering practices
Data integration and pipeline technologies
Data governance and master data management
Business intelligence and reporting platforms
Audience data, customer data platforms (CDPs), and marketing technologies
Privacy-safe data collaboration and audience activation frameworks
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with AI-enabled data platforms and cloud ecosystems, including modern AI capabilities and LLM integrations.
Exposure to agent-based applications and generative AI use cases within enterprise data environments.
Experience supporting or developing commercial data products, including data marketplace listings or external data-sharing programs.
We are excited to share the salary for this position is $150,000. If you are hired for this position at EndeavorB2B, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as hiring location, skillset, prior years’ experience, relevant education, certain degrees and certifications, training, and market considerations. In addition to those factors – we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider any internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. We also offer a generous benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).We offer competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision
24/7 access to Telehealth services
FSA and HSA pretax savings accounts
Company paid life and disability insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave
A generous FTO policy
12 paid holidays!
Tuition assistance
Professional growth opportunities through continuing education
Mentorship program
Company Core Value Rewards
Employee Retail & Travel discountsTo all current EndeavorB2B employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the internal career center.
EndeavorB2B is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in recruiting, hiring, training, promotions, compensation, and other aspects of employment for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Engineering Operations
jobs.text:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀
Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.
At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.
We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.
The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!
[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]
The role ⚡
📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits
As our Head of Product & Engineering Operations, you will design, install, and run the engine across product, engineering, and design. You will help us find a better way by transforming our work into one unified, high-performing build process.
This role owns the ‘how’ we build. You install the operating model across product, engineering and design, and drive product, design and engineering leaders to run it. You have real influence with the CTO down.
You’ll work closely with product, engineering and design teams, and make the operating model work in practice. You’ll be the executive operator on the AI-native lifecycle programme already in motion, turning it from an initiative into the default way our teams build.
You know what great looks like because you’ve done it. You could build the product, but would prefer to build the team who build the product.
As our Head of Product & Engineering Operations, you'll:
Establish and run core builders leadership rituals, cross-line product reviews, calibration sessions, and go/no-go release gates.
Partner directly with stakeholders across all three disciplines, such as our VP Product, VP Engineering, and Design Leadership, to raise the bar on what and how we build.
Take small steps fast through hands-on piloting of new frameworks, running early iterations personally before handing them off to squad leads and ensuring they become permanent habits.
Embed AI-driven build tools and automated workflows across all three functions to modernise our Product development lifecycle and processes.
Convene the Product, Design and Engineering leadership team to ensure continuous improvement of how we build great products at Funding Circle.
Integrate regulatory and compliance checks seamlessly into the core delivery path without slowing down shipment cycles.
What we’re looking for 🌱
A builder and innovator with proven experience scaling Product Development Lifecycles inside complex product organisations, operating as an embedded leader rather than an external consultant.
Strong experience in Product Management, Engineering, and Design, with the credibility to challenge leadership and bring teams together across all three disciplines.
The ability to take ownership of redesigning departmental workflows, and being up to date on how to use AI to build great products. You’ve built with Claude Code, Codex, or similar, and you’re excited about helping a whole organisation to build that way.
Confidence and credibility to hold MDs, VPs, and senior directors accountable to continuous improvements in how we build.
An understanding and of working within regulated environment and the complexities involved. It’s a bonus if you’ve worked alongside Risk and Compliance.
Skills we'd love to see:
Familiarity with fintech, lending, or financial services compliance requirements.
Evidence of having installed an operating model at a comparable inflection point.

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
Our Mission:
Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Product Director to lead product across a major surface area of the Omnea platform. In this role, you’ll set strategy, grow and manage a team of PMs, and ensure we’re building the right things - with speed, clarity, and customer obsession.
This is a leadership role that blends product vision, organizational scaling, and hands-on execution. You’ll report into the VP of Product and work closely with design, engineering, and go-to-market leaders to scale Omnea at pace.
What You’ll Do
Own product strategy and execution across one or more core product areas.
Hire, coach, and grow a team of high-performing product managers.
Drive product planning, decision-making, and communication across functions and leadership.
Ensure we are learning fast and shipping thoughtfully - balancing speed with rigour.
Partner with go-to-market to support onboarding, growth, and customer feedback loops.
Help define and evolve Omnea’s product development culture as we scale - including rituals, values, and operating principles.
About You
9+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years managing PMs.
Strong product strategy chops - you can define vision, sequence bets, and zoom into detail.
Track record of building and scaling product teams in high-growth or startup environments.
You lead with context, not control - and you coach PMs to think independently and execute well.
Excellent communicator with the ability to align stakeholders and drive clear decisions.
You care deeply about product quality and have a nose for what great looks like.
Why Join Omnea
Omnea is tackling one of the most painful and underserved areas of the enterprise stack — and doing it with taste and urgency. As Product Director, you’ll shape not just what we build, but how we build it. You’ll work with a world-class team that moves fast, sweats the details, and values ownership at every level.
At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.
A few things to note:
We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.
We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here
We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!
We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).
We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Platform (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
About the role:
We are looking for a full-time Head of Engineering to help us build a securities Platform for financial institutions, the first API of that kind in Europe.
You will lead the Platform Tribe, which comprises three teams. These teams are responsible for critical domains such as Infrastructure, Reliability and Development Tooling and shared libraries, all of which are essential for Upvest’s Investment API.
The Platform Tribe exists to give every engineer at Upvest the fastest, safest path from idea to production. We own the foundations that make great engineering possible: the infrastructure teams build on, the tools they build with, the shared libraries that let them move fast without reinventing the wheel, and the observability and reliability practices that keep our systems trustworthy at scale. We measure our success not by what we ship, but by how much faster and more confidently every other engineering team can ship — because when the platform is invisible, it's working.
What you’ll do:
Own and shape the tribe's roadmap with real autonomy over what we build and why.
Partner closely with product tribes to understand their needs and translate them into platform priorities.
Work with modern tools and technologies, with real influence over our technical direction and stack.
Directly influence the reliability, velocity, and quality of every product we ship.
What you bring:
Ability to bridge strategic "why" with engineering solutions, actively discussing tradeoffs and proactively suggesting ideas, demonstrating a strong product engineering mindset.
Strong interest in Upvest's product domains and a proactive desire to understand the business use cases Upvest enables for clients.
Experience in leading and growing larger engineering teams in a technical leadership capacity.
Prior experience within the Fintech domain.
Strong technical expertise and hands-on experience in developing highly scalable, distributed, asynchronous, and resilient platforms.
Strong work ethic and principles such as pragmatism.
A security-focused mindset and a high sense of taking ownership.
It's great if you have:
Experience with API-first and SaaS applications.
Experience building and running microservice-based event driven distributed applications.
How we Upvest in you:
Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.
Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.
Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.
Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.
Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.
Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.
Our Values:
Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions
Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.
Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
About the role:
We are looking for a full-time Head of Engineering to help us build a securities Platform for financial institutions, the first API of that kind in Europe.

You will lead the Platform Tribe, which comprises three teams. These teams are responsible for critical domains such as Infrastructure, Reliability and Development Tooling and shared libraries, all of which are essential for Upvest’s Investment API.

The Platform Tribe exists to give every engineer at Upvest the fastest, safest path from idea to production. We own the foundations that make great engineering possible: the infrastructure teams build on, the tools they build with, the shared libraries that let them move fast without reinventing the wheel, and the observability and reliability practices that keep our systems trustworthy at scale. We measure our success not by what we ship, but by how much faster and more confidently every other engineering team can ship — because when the platform is invisible, it's working.
What you’ll do:
Own and shape the tribe's roadmap with real autonomy over what we build and why.
Partner closely with product tribes to understand their needs and translate them into platform priorities.
Work with modern tools and technologies, with real influence over our technical direction and stack.
Directly influence the reliability, velocity, and quality of every product we ship.
What you bring:
Ability to bridge strategic "why" with engineering solutions, actively discussing tradeoffs and proactively suggesting ideas, demonstrating a strong product engineering mindset.
Strong interest in Upvest's product domains and a proactive desire to understand the business use cases Upvest enables for clients.
Experience in leading and growing larger engineering teams in a technical leadership capacity.
Prior experience within the Fintech domain.
Strong technical expertise and hands-on experience in developing highly scalable, distributed, asynchronous, and resilient platforms.
Strong work ethic and principles such as pragmatism.
A security-focused mindset and a high sense of taking ownership.
It's great if you have:
Experience with API-first and SaaS applications.
Experience building and running microservice-based event driven distributed applications.
How we Upvest in you:
Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.
Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.
Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.
Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions
Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Science
jobs.text:
Shape the future of AI in Intellectual Property. As Vice President, Data Science, you will set the vision for our Data Science & AI organization and turn advances in machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI into scalable products, smarter operations, and measurable business value.
This is an opportunity to pair technical ambition with executive leadership—guiding a global, multidisciplinary organization from AI strategy to production-grade solutions. If you have led enterprise-scale AI teams and brought AI solutions into production, we invite you to help define what comes next for our IP business.
About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
15+ years of progressive experience in Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related fields, including 8+ years leading enterprise-scale global teams.
Experience managing Data Scientists, Applied Scientists, AI Researchers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and MLOps professionals.
At least 7 years of experience defining AI strategy and leading the delivery of production-grade AI/ML systems and data products at enterprise scale.
At least 7 years of experience in AI and machine learning, with experience spanning deep learning, NLP, RAG, LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps, and responsible AI practices.
At least 7 years of experience presenting AI or machine learning technical strategy to executive stakeholders and partnering with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Customer Success teams.
At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI/ML solutions involving predictive modeling, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, forecasting, computer vision, graph methods, or experimentation.
At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI solutions, including experience with Generative AI, LLMs, SLMs, RAG, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation, AI safety, and hallucination mitigation.
At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI/ML model development, including experience with pretraining, fine-tuning, PEFT/LoRA, quantization, distillation, explainability, benchmarking, and A/B testing.
At least 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or production deployment, including experience with deployment pipelines, monitoring, feature stores, vector databases, drift detection, observability, data quality, cloud-native platforms, and Kubernetes.
At least 7 years of experience managing AI/ML costs and measuring business value, including experience with LLM cost management, model routing, GPU and inference optimization, hybrid model strategies, FinOps, and AI ROI measurement.
At least 7 years of experience presenting AI strategy and outcomes to executives, customers, boards, investors, or industry forums.
It would be great if you also have . . .
PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience in Intellectual Property, Legal Technology, Information Services, Scientific Research, SaaS, or Knowledge Management industries.
Recognized AI/ML contributions through patents, publications, conference talks, or AI Centers of Excellence leadership.
What will you be doing in this role?
Define and execute the enterprise data science and AI vision, aligning investment and delivery with business strategy, product innovation, and long-term growth.
Differentiate our products, operations, and customer experiences through AI.
Create a multi-year roadmap for machine learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced analytics adoption.
Lead the strategy, architecture, and implementation of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across the business.
Build scalable AI agents, copilots, assistants, reasoning systems, and workflow automation capabilities.
Set standards for prompt engineering, context management, retrieval, orchestration, and agent evaluation.
Lead predictive modeling, recommendation systems, forecasting, analytics platforms, and reusable AI capabilities.
Translate business opportunities into scalable AI solutions that improve decisions, customer outcomes, and operational performance.
Define the strategy for foundation model selection, fine-tuning, deployment, benchmarking, governance, lifecycle management, and cost optimization.
Evaluate responsible uses of proprietary enterprise data and open-source and commercial model ecosystems.
Establish enterprise standards for responsible AI, governance, transparency, security, compliance, explainability, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
Build, lead, and develop a global Data Science & AI organization with technical excellence, talent depth, a culture of innovation, and accountability for business impact.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to align AI capabilities with business priorities and communicate technical strategy.
Establish KPIs for AI adoption, model performance, ROI, productivity, customer impact, cost efficiency, and delivery of high-value initiatives.
About the Team
Our Data Science & AI organization drives innovation and competitive advantage across the IP business through advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. The team brings together Data Scientists, Applied Scientists, ML Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and specialists focused on customer insight, workflow automation, product intelligence, and strategic decision-making. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Customer Success to turn AI capabilities into business and customer outcomes.
Hours of Work
You will primarily work full-time business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to support global business needs.
Compensation – US only
The expected base salary for this position is $240,000–$300,000 USD per year. This role is eligible for bonus earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors.
In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more.
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Company Overview:
Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.
We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.
We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.
As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.
What You'll Do
As Head of Engineering, you will lead Radiant's engineering organisation and be accountable for its execution, technical quality, reliability, and scalability.
You'll lead software engineering, platform security engineering, and architecture: an organisation of 30-35 engineers today, growing to 150 to 200+ as Radiant expands internationally. You'll partner closely with Product, the Customer team, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, the PMO, and the wider technology leadership team.
This is a senior leadership role focused on building a high-performing engineering organisation capable of delivering and operating complex AI infrastructure at scale. You'll stay close to the work through design review.
Key Responsibilities
Hire and scale the engineering organisation, building a strong leadership layer across Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical leaders.
Own engineering hiring, performance, leadership development, succession planning, and organisational health.
Design and evolve the engineering organisation as the company scales across teams, sites, and regions.
Own the engineering strategy, operating model, and execution in alignment with company and product objectives.
Translate business priorities into clear technical plans, sequencing, investment decisions, and delivery commitments.
Establish clear ownership, decision-making, and accountability across engineering teams.
Drive predictable, high-quality delivery, identifying risk early and intervening where execution drifts.
Ensure systems are designed and delivered to be production-ready, reliable, observable, maintainable, and supportable.
Strengthen collaboration with infrastructure, SRE, and operations, including effective handover and incident learning.
Set and uphold standards across architecture, engineering quality, security, scalability, and operational maturity.
Own the roadmap jointly with Product: Product owns what is built, and you own how and when.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical technical, architectural, and delivery decisions, brokering decisions between peers and escalating to the CTO when needed.
Improve engineering maturity and processes while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy or loss of delivery momentum.
Represent engineering in executive and partner discussions, and join customer escalation reviews with the Customer team.
Your Profile
Significant experience leading and scaling engineering organisations of 20+ engineers through multiple stages of growth.
Experience managing managers, with a strong track record of hiring and developing Engineering Managers, senior engineers, and technical leaders.
Proven experience evolving a smaller engineering group into multiple teams with clear ownership, leadership, and consistent delivery.
Experience designing organisational structures, team boundaries, and operating models for increasing scale and complexity.
Demonstrated success improving delivery predictability, engineering quality, throughput, and organisational effectiveness.
Strong technical background across modern software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure-heavy products.
Experience owning production systems where reliability, observability, scalability, and operational readiness are critical.
Comfortable working closely with Product, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, and Commercial teams.
Experience operating across multiple teams, locations, or time zones.
Able to communicate technical risk, trade-offs, and opportunity clearly at executive level.
Experience with cloud or infrastructure platforms, scaled SaaS, AI/ML platforms, or infrastructure-heavy technology businesses is strongly preferred.
How You Work
You move fast and correct course quickly.
You challenge openly, then commit.
You address underperformance within weeks, with clear coaching and firm deadlines.
You keep process light and standards high.
What You Bring
Engineering leadership: You build strong teams, strong leaders, and clear accountability.
Execution: You create predictability and drive complex programmes through to completion.
Technical judgement: You can guide architecture and challenge senior engineers without becoming a bottleneck.
Systems thinking: You understand organisations, platforms, and operating models as interconnected systems.
Operational mindset: You expect engineering output to be reliable, supportable, and production-ready.
Organisational design: You know when structures, processes, or ownership models need to evolve.
Calm leadership: You remain decisive under pressure and make clear trade-offs when required.
Ownership: You take responsibility for engineering outcomes, organisational health, and long-term capability.
Qualities we look for:
Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up
Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change
You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.
Why should you join us?
What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.
Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:
25 days of annual leave
A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.
Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.
Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.
Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.
Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.
Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps
Participation in the company shares program
Enhanced parental pay & leave
Our process: a conversation with our Talent team, then interviews with our CTO and leadership team.

jobs.title: Head of Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
jobs.text:
Hi 👋🏾, I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and CTO. Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.
We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!
The Role
In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:
Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure.
Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).
Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!
Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.
Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.
You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.
If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!
A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues!
The Qualifications
We’re entrusting you with a company priority, so we want you to know how to scale products and build the great teams that do that. This means:
You played an important role leading a company through a high-growth period (either as an IC Lead or Engineering Leader). You had to make high-quality decisions under pressure. That often meant striking a balance between short-term fixes to keep the product from falling over and long-term investments to ensure it didn’t happen again.
You have experience hiring and building hiring processes, and enjoy it! You’ve designed interviews, interview loops, and led hiring strategy.
You have a track record of excellent collaboration with other departments. You were a key contributor to company-level initiatives that involved Product Engineering, Product, Sales, or Support. Those departments felt heard and supported, yet positively challenged by you.
You are knowledgeable about platform and infrastructure technologies, networking, and hardware. You know how Kubernetes goes beyond a Container Orchestration Platform, how traffic flows between Load Balancers and Pods, and how the intricacies of the underlying hardware can cause Cloud abstractions to break, etc.
You are a great communicator, particularly in writing. You’ll need to be able to go deep with Infrastructure Engineers in conversations while also communicating those concepts to folks like myself who have much less experience.
You should be comfortable managing a team spanning from the Americas West Coast to Europe. You’ll be able to hire managers to focus on specific time zones, but I expect you to have skips with some engineers (and you should want to, too!). To ensure a reasonable work schedule, we’re only hiring candidates who live in the PST-GMT time zone.
What We’re Building
As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. You went into management because it was the only growth path available. We want folks who could have been Principal engineers (or were one!).

Putting effort into building a diverse team

Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).

We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.

Great developer tooling. For example, our CI/CD takes ~10m, we deploy at least 15x a day, and our debugger works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Introduction call with me (30m, live)
A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
An interview to explore your past experience as a leader (1h, live)
Interview with Colin, our Head of EMEA Engineering (45m)
Final round where you meet various folks on the team and explore leadership and technical topics (3h)
I’ll have a strong read on whether we’re trending toward an offer by Round 3. Near the end of the process, we’ll do reference checks with a former manager, two direct reports, and a peer in Engineering. Depending on my bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.

Your first three months at Ashby will be spent learning about Ashby Engineering and easing into leadership. While most of your onboarding will be driven by a 6-month plan you put together (and refine over time), you’ll also ship some product changes, features, and infra changes. What better way to learn how ICs work than to be one! Don’t worry if you’re not familiar with our technologies. The team is really helpful, and our dev environment is pretty awesome: it sets up in a single script, and you’ll be able to push your first product change on day one.
You and I will do 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and 6-month reviews to calibrate on our unique culture and how you, I, and the team will work together.

Competitive salary and equity.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO.
A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.

If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

jobs.text:
What do we do?
Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.
We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.
The role:
We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production.
The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics.
We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start.
This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance.
What you'll do:
Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly.
Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build.
Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

jobs.title: Head of ML & MLOps Engineering - Fintech Engineering (f/m/n)
jobs.text:
The mission
Build a state-of-the-art ML platform and the discipline around it.
Models with a price tag. Every model has a business case and a measurable monetary outcome.
Credit and decisioning models built with rigorous validation, champion/challenger testing and explainability.
A production ML platform. Serving, monitoring, reproducibility and retraining are engineered, not improvised.
Responsible AI, built in. Model risk, bias and explainability checks, with an independent sign-off gate before anything reaches production.
Agent-first systems. Agents are production components with orchestration, guardrails, evals and observability.
◆ Models on governed data. You build on a point-in-time-correct feature store, not around it.
This is a business function. Every model carries monetary value, and you will run the function that way: compute budget, headcount and return on investment.
What you'll own
The agentic standard for ML. You run agentic model iteration and agentic model monitoring and observability, bound to the feature store. You own the reliability, cost and latency of agent loops and graphs in production, and you hire against the bar.
The ML & MLOps team, from your first hire onward.
Model-development standards and the validation methodology that stands up to model-risk and regulatory scrutiny.
The ML platform behind decisioning services.
A clear ownership line between feature production (data engineering) and model consumption, set together with the Head of Data Engineering and the Director.
You are
A leader who loves data and loves building systems around it.
Hands-on when needed, especially with AI on board. You understand the model, the pipeline and the serving layer.
Experienced across the full ML lifecycle: development, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
Experienced in architecting agentic systems for ML: orchestration, guardrails, evals in CI, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, agent observability.
Experienced in building and leading ML teams in regulated settings.
Experienced in credit-scoring or underwriting modelling, or comparable high-stakes ML.
Skilled in model-risk management and responsible-AI governance.
Experienced in building and leading a team from zero.
Fluent in English (B2+).
Bonus
CCD2 and consumer-credit regulation · DORA/ICT risk · IFRS 9 implications for model outputs · fraud-detection ML · Databricks/Spark.
What you will work with
The ML platform (serving, monitoring, and retraining), the feature store, the agent evaluation and observability layer, and cross-functional partners in Data Engineering and Credit Risk.
Why this one
Seat at the table on a core leadership team.
Build it right the first time. No legacy ML estate.
Models that matter. Your work decides real money, not a dashboard.
Real pace. A lean, AI-native organisation.
Build ML that makes money and stands up to a regulator.
We are building a scale-up inside InPost, and AI will flow through it. You would join the core Data & AI leadership team and build the ML and MLOps function from zero, with the InPost executive team backing it. Our word is extreme ownership: you own a model from first idea to its profit and loss impact.

jobs.title: Head of UX/UI (H/F/X)
jobs.text:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.
📄 JOB DESCRIPTION
Veepee is looking for a Head of UX/UI for its Growth Marketing team. Attached to the Growth Director, the person in this position will lead the team of UX/UI designers, and will be in charge of defining the UX vision for the Veepee front experience, and assuring the optimization of the customer journey on all the Veepee sites, by following and analyzing the performance of each step of the customer journey.
🎯 TASKS
Management of the UX/UI team
Management of the UX/UI designers team (5 people), ensuring the best support, mentoring and development for the team members.
To define and to animate a performing organization for the UX/UI team (rituals, capacity management, planification…)
To ensure the quality of the deliveries of the team, and to put in place the actions needed to keep the team updated with the most actual UX/UI trends and innovations.
UX/UI vision and strategy
To define and deliver the UX/UI front vision of all the Veepee sites & apps in collaboration with the marketing business and Tech teams
To ensure a flawless and coherent user experience across all devices, being a strong contributor on the improvement of the performance of the Veepee platforms, relying on the defined KPIs and monitoring added business value
To be a source of best practices and innovative solutions to address the new e-commerce challenges, and more particularly the flash sales model.
To ensure the development and maintenance of the group Design System.
To be the UX/UI referent for Veepee Group, ensuring a clear and affordable sharing of UX/UI topics all along the Group, from Top Management to Operational teams
Collaboration Business - Tech
To closely work with Business teams and Product Tech teams to propose UX/UI solutions aligned with business expectations and Tech complexity.
To ensure the quality of the business requests and the Tech deliveries in order to propose high performing evolutions.
To be part of the core animation team for the Front topics, playing a key role on the definition of the Tech Roadmaps, prioritization of the projects and validation of deliveries.
👉 MUST HAVE skills
At least 5 years of experience as Head of UX/UI, with a main focus on e-commerce environments.
Leader, you dare to challenge and manage to influence others, positively managing the change
Proactive, organized and autonomous, you are able to move things forward
A strong understanding of the e-commerce universe, specially with high volumes of daily traffic.
Results oriented and a strong capacity to identify the weaknesses of the processes and improve them.
Feeling comfortable working with a wide range of different teams, from IT teams to Data science, legal, finance, logistics, commercial or operational.
Fluent level of English is a must
An international experience is a plus
❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ?
The Marketing Growth team is dedicated to acquiring new customers, retaining existing customers and improving the user experience on all channels
You will join a team of 1 Head of SEO; 2 BPOs (definition of the business needs); 1 Product analyst and 5 front UX/UI designers
We are the owner of the Front roadmaps and SEO strategy at a group level, coordinating and consolidating inputs from a wide range of different teams, from IT teams to Data science, legal, finance, logistics, commercial or operational; and leading several initiatives from the Group Strategic Plan.
✅ BENEFITS
👉 Variable bonus
👉 Profit sharing & incentive schemes
👉 Remote working possible up to 2 days/week
👉 Online language learning platform
👉 CSE benefits
👉 CESU vouchers and vacation vouchers
👉 Access to company catering and connected fridges (Foodles, Kumo, Bolk)
👉 Access to the gym
❓ WHO WE ARE
Veepeeᵀᵉᶜʰ is a tech community of 500 collaborators who play a key role in Veepee’s innovative strategy.
From Warsaw to Sevilla, through Brussels, Amsterdam, Paris, Lyon, Nantes, Nice, Barcelona, Madrid and Lausanne all our projects are developed in an agile environment with a wide skills variety where you’ll be sure to find your place, no matter the technology you work with.
If you love to try things why don’t you jump on this new adventure?
Need more info > https://careers.veepee.com/en/

jobs.text:
About TACTILIA
At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.
This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.
You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?
The Role
As a Chief Technology Officer, you will own TACTILIA's technology strategy, product architecture, and engineering execution. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization across project management, systems engineering, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product management, applications and testing. Your responsibility is to turn a highly capable robotic hand into a reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and scalable industrial product.
This is a leadership role with substantial technical depth. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every discipline, but you must have first-hand experience with both hardware and software development and the judgment to make sound system-level decisions across both.
What you will do:
Set the technology direction. Define TACTILIA’s technology strategy and product roadmap from the current platform to a scalable industrial product.
Lead the whole stack. Lead the teams across project management, systems, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product, applications and testing.
Make the architecture work. Own the system architecture and the interfaces between hardware, software, AI and applications.
Turn R&D into product. Drive the transition from advanced prototypes to reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and customer-ready products.
Make the right trade-offs. Balance performance, reliability, cost, safety, manufacturability and speed of execution.
Build the organization. Recruit, develop and lead the engineering and product organization across Zurich and Munich.
Create clarity and accountability. Establish effective priorities, processes, decision-making structures and technical standards across the teams.
Own resources and execution. Manage engineering budgets, headcount and priorities in line with the company’s product and business goals.
Stay close to customers. Translate customer requirements and field experience into product decisions and future technology direction.
Represent TACTILIA externally. Act as the technical face of the company with customers, partners, SCHUNK, investors and the robotics community.
Stay close to the hard problems. Remain sufficiently hands-on to challenge important technical decisions and unblock the team when necessary.
What you bring:
You can lead across hardware and software. You have deep practical understanding of both disciplines and the credibility to guide experts across mechanics, electronics, sensors, embedded systems, controls, AI and applications.
You have led complex engineering organizations. You have successfully led multidisciplinary teams, ideally with responsibility for 20 or more people, multiple functions and a significant budget.
You have shipped physical products. You have taken complex robotics, mechatronics, medical or industrial hardware from development or prototype stage into customer use, production or product maturity.
You understand human-like robotic systems. Ideally, you have experience in humanoid or biomedical robotics, particularly with anthropomorphic mechanisms, sensor and actuator systems, robotic hands or tendon-driven devices.
You think in systems. You can connect mechanics, electronics, sensing, control, software, AI and customer applications into a coherent product architecture.
You build teams that execute. You have a track record of recruiting strong people, developing leaders and creating a culture of ownership and high standards.
You know how to scale engineering. You bring experience from a startup, scale-up or industrial technology company and understand how to combine speed with disciplined execution.
You make sound decisions under uncertainty. You are pragmatic, commercially aware and able to distinguish between the perfect solution and the right solution.
You communicate with every audience. You can engage credibly with engineers, customers, executives, investors and industrial partners.
You have a strong technical foundation. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred.
You are ready to build internationally. You are fluent in English and comfortable working across the Zurich and Munich locations. German is an advantage.
Bonus:
Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands
Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation
The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.
At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.
The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.
Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.
If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Product Director, Studio
jobs.text:
About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
The Role
Studio has been developed to help enterprises build, evaluate, and operate AI systems reliably, safely, and at scale, turning prototypes into production-ready solutions. It provides the infrastructure enterprises need to scale their use cases, including comprehensive monitoring, reliable automation, and centralized tracking of AI assets.
We are seeking a strong product leader to own the strategy and shape the future of Studio redefining the AI builder experience in enterprises.
You will determine how enterprises observe AI behavior, run complex workflows, version and track assets, and deploy safely across hybrid and self-hosted environments.
What You Will do
Strategy & Vision - Define and evangelize the product vision, strategy and annual goals for Studio. You will be accountable for its business impact.
Team leadership - Build the Studio PM organization: hire PMs and stream leads, set the operating cadence (quarterly product reviews, roadmap reviews…), and develop PMs through clear growth paths.
Delivery & Execution - Partner with engineering leadership on the roadmap to scope, sequence, and deliver value by balancing quick wins for our customers while advancing the long-term platform bets.
Drive strategic customer discovery with the PMs under your responsibility.
Go-to-market - Collaborate with Marketing and Go-to-market teams on positioning, pricing and packaging, launch plans, and adoption strategies.
Partner cross-functionally and with other product leaders to ensure we have a unified customer journey.
What We're Looking For
10+ years in product management, with deep experience building technical platform, infrastructure or developer products for enterprise customers and AI/ML fluency
Proven people leadership: you've hired and grown senior PMs, organized teams around clear stream ownership, and built durable operating cadences
Experience launching and scaling products
Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Ownership and pragmatism: low ego, high EQ, bias for action; equally comfortable crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, UX details, or a customer escalation
Strong communication skills for executives, teams, and users.
Ability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift.
Self-directed, taking initiative to navigate unknowns and own outcomes.
What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
Privacy Policy
Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
