jobs.title: VP, Global Developer Relations
jobs.text:
About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
The Role
As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors.
You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral.
What You Will Do
Build a Global Developer Movement
Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists.
Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools.
Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations.
Engage and Inspire the Technical Community
Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including:
Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models.
Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts.
Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities.
Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers.
Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption
Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models.
Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs.
Scale a World-Class DevRel Team
Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco
Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy).
Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities
Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth
Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models.
Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation.
Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact.
What We're Looking For
Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source.
Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture).
Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons).
Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions.
Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach.
Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals.
Bonus Points If You Have
Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs).
Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities.
Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets.
Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools.
What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Director of Attendee Excellence & Event Technology - US
jobs.text:
About Nteractive
AtNteractive, we design and deliver world-class experiential, event, and conference solutions that connect brands with people in powerful, meaningful ways.
We partner with some of the world’s most influential organizations to create large-scale, high-impact global programs — from flagship conferences and destination events to complex, multi-market activations. Our work blends strategy, creativity, technology, and flawless delivery to produce experiences that truly move audiences.
Our success is built on our people. We are a collaborative, ambitious, and values-driven agency that invests in talent, encourages innovation, and empowers our teams to take ownership and make a real difference. We believe in long-term partnerships, exceptional client service, and continuously raising the bar in everything we do.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an established Event Technology leader with deep RainFocus expertise to join Nteractive as Director, Attendee Excellence & Event Technology.
Reporting to the Global Head of Attendee Excellence & Event Technology, you’ll lead Event Technology strategy across a portfolio of Nteractive’s most significant global client programmes, acting as a trusted consultant, subject matter expert and strategic advisor to both clients and internal teams.
This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, commercial acumen and executive presence.
You’ll help clients maximise the value of their event technology ecosystem, create exceptional attendee experiences and establish best practice across complex global programmes. Your expertise will help shape technology strategy, solution design, programme scalability and digital transformation across some of the world’s largest events and conferences.
What you’ll be doing
Strategic Client Leadership
Act as the senior Event Technology consultant across a portfolio of global enterprise accounts.
Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a go-to advisor for Event Technology strategy.
Lead strategic conversations around digital transformation, attendee experience and technology roadmaps.
Influence client decision-making through expert consultation, solution design and industry insight.
Present confidently to executive audiences and facilitate strategic discussions with senior stakeholders.
Translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
RainFocus & Event Technology Leadership
Serve as a senior subject matter expert in event software, with strong RainFocus experience across strategy, solution design and programme delivery.
Advise clients and internal teams on platform architecture, implementation strategies and optimisation opportunities.
Provide strategic oversight across registration, event websites, attendee communications, reporting, integrations, housing and digital engagement experiences.
Drive innovation across event technology ecosystems and attendee journeys.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation and emerging technologies.
Establish best practices, governance frameworks and scalable delivery models across Event Technology programmes.
Stay ahead of industry trends and help shape Nteractive’s Event Technology capabilities, methodologies and offerings.
Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor and develop Event Technology Managers, Consultants and Specialists across your portfolio.
Champion excellence, consistency and continuous improvement across the Event Technology function.
Support the development of methodologies, standards and operational best practices.
Provide leadership and guidance across complex and high-profile client programmes.
Partner closely with Client Services, Project Leadership, Creative Studio and Production to deliver integrated client solutions.
Growth & Commercial Impact
Support new business opportunities, solutioning and client growth initiatives.
Contribute to proposals, pitches and strategic client discussions.
Identify opportunities to expand Event Technology services across existing accounts.
Partner with senior leaders to strengthen Nteractive’s Event Technology proposition and market position.
Bring a commercial mindset to technology strategy, identifying opportunities that create additional client value and business growth.
What you will bring
We’re looking for a strategic thinker, trusted consultant and recognised Event Technology expert.
You’ll ideally bring:
Significant experience leading Event Technology programmes for global enterprise clients.
Advanced expertise in event software and RainFocus, including strategic consulting, solution design and programme delivery.
Proven experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams.
Strong understanding of event technology ecosystems, attendee management, registration, websites, communications and data strategy.
Experience delivering large-scale global conferences, events and attendee programmes.
Strong knowledge of platform integrations, data flows and digital engagement solutions.
Experience leading and developing high-performing specialist teams.
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to identify growth opportunities and demonstrate client value.
Outstanding presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of AI, automation and emerging technologies within events and digital experiences.
A passion for innovation, attendee experience and operational excellence.
The kind of leader you are
You’re a recognised Event Technology professional who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise and commercial thinking.
You’re equally comfortable advising senior client stakeholders, leading strategic workshops, presenting recommendations to executive audiences or coaching technical teams through complex solutions.
You bring credibility and confidence into every room. People trust your expertise, value your perspective and look to you for guidance. You know when to challenge, when to influence and how to build consensus around the right solution.
Most importantly, you’re passionate about using technology to create exceptional attendee experiences and measurable business outcomes.
Why you’ll love working at Nteractive
This is a rare opportunity to play a leading role in shaping Event Technology strategy across some of the world’s most exciting and complex global programmes.
You’ll work alongside talented colleagues and industry-leading clients, helping define how event technology, attendee data, digital engagement and innovation come together to create world-class experiences.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence the future direction of our Event Technology offering while working on programmes where technology genuinely shapes the attendee and client experience.
Benefits
PTO – 20 days plus public holidays
Summer Hours
Birthday Day Off
401k – access to fund for employee contributions
Health Care – employee cover and dependent cover offered
Dental & Vision
Life Insurance
Health Advocacy Program
Wellbeing & Inclusion Initiatives including access to an EAP
Family Leave & Adoption Assistance
Rewards & Recognition incentives
Volunteering Day
Cell & Wi-Fi allowance
Generous Talent Referral Scheme
Time Off in Lieu
Other Requirements
Based in the USA
Ability to travel to aid team collaboration and meet client needs
Ability to work across multiple time zones as required
Quiet home working environment with reliable broadband (minimum 25MB download / 2MB upload)
Due to client and business requirements, you may be required to complete a criminal background check. Any checks will be carried out in compliance with applicable local legislation and data privacy requirements.

jobs.title: Vice President - Technology- Transformation
jobs.text:
Job Purpose
Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.
Key Result Areas: --
A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning
Partner with assigned Groups to translate strategic priorities and change demand into an integrated technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap.
Lead/support annual and in-year budget formulation for CAPEX and OPEX projects, challenging scope, estimates, sequencing, dependencies, resource needs, benefits and delivery readiness.
Coordinate initiation, planning, estimations, benefits articulation and business-case / Executive Summary preparation; review submissions for completeness, quality and decision readiness and provide required Transformation Office sign-off.
Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.
B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting
Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.
Track projects against approved scope, schedule, cost, milestones, resourcing, risks, dependencies and benefits baselines; identify variance and require credible recovery actions.
Produce concise, evidence-based Group portfolio reporting highlighting performance, exceptions, decisions required and forward outlook.
Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.
Forecast portfolio performance, delivery milestones, financial utilization, emerging risks and likely year-end outcomes; identify potential slippage, under-utilization or value leakage early.
C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods
Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.
Escalate material non-compliance, delivery risk and control weakness, and track agreed remediation to closure.
Assure that onboarded Project Managers understand and apply Mashreq Methods; provide coaching, training and targeted knowledge transfer.
Where specifically required, act directly as Project Manager / recovery lead for selected critical or complex initiatives without diluting independent assurance across the wider portfolio.
Contribute lessons learned and practical enhancements to Mashreq delivery Methods and Transformation Office standards.
D. Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory
Work with Group Heads, project sponsors, business/technology owners and Project Managers to remove delivery blockers and resolve cross-project or cross-functional issues.
Serve as trusted advisor on change demand, portfolio composition, prioritization, execution choices, dependencies, delivery risk and value creation.
Create fact-based escalation paths for issues requiring senior leadership intervention, with clear options, impact and recommended action.
Build effective working relationships across Technology, Business, Functions, Finance, Procurement, Technology GRC, ISG, ORM, Internal Audit, Compliance and other relevant functions.
E. Benefits & Value Realization
Work with accountable business owners to define measurable financial and non-financial benefits, establish baselines, ownership and realization timelines.
Ensure approved benefits are recorded, tracked and periodically validated through the delivery lifecycle and after go-live where applicable.
Challenge gaps between investment cases, delivered capabilities, adoption and realized outcomes; escalate material benefit shortfalls and agree corrective actions.
F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability
Provide functional leadership to Project Managers supporting assigned portfolios, setting expectations for delivery discipline, transparency and escalation.
Assess PM onboarding/readiness, coach performance and reinforce consistent application of Mashreq Methods and reporting standards.
Support assignment of appropriately skilled Project Managers to initiatives based on complexity, risk and criticality, and identify capability or capacity gaps
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
15+ years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in banking / financial services technology transformation, portfolio, program and project delivery.
Demonstrated ownership/governance of large, complex portfolios comprising 100+ projects and aggregate investment of AED 100m+ (or equivalent).
Strong command of CAPEX/OPEX portfolio planning, budgeting, financial forecasting, investment prioritization and delivery-performance management.
Deep practical experience in portfolio/program/project governance, baseline management, RAID and dependency management, executive reporting, quality assurance and recovery of challenged initiatives.
Strong understanding of benefits management and value realization, including definition of measurable outcomes, ownership, baselining and tracking.
Proven ability to advise and influence Group Heads / C-level stakeholders, constructively challenge senior leaders and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
Experience leading, coaching and assuring Project Managers and building consistent adherence to enterprise delivery methods.
Strong analytical skills and ability to convert complex portfolio data into forward-looking executive insight and actionable recommendations.
Master’s degree preferred (Bachelor’s degree required) in technology, business, engineering, finance or a related discipline.
Recognized project/program/portfolio management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent) preferred; equivalent demonstrable experience may be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Design
jobs.text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
As the Senior Director of Design, Governance & Compliance at Vanta, you'll lead design for our largest product pillar. You'll set the direction for how compliance work moves from manual workflows to agents that do the work alongside our customers.
Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. Those companies range from founders getting their first SOC2 to global enterprises managing hundreds of controls. As we move upmarket, the team's job is to make that complexity feel simple for every customer, at every size.
You’ll lead a team of senior, staff, and principal designers, with senior managers and directors reporting to you. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner as a peer with product and engineering leadership for the pillar. We're not starting from scratch. Vanta Agent works across the product, customers build and deploy their own custom agents, and our designers prototype and ship to production with our own AI design harness. Your job is to make that the way the whole pillar works.
What you’ll do as a Senior Director of Design at Vanta:
Lead the agentic direction for Governance & Compliance. Build on the agents we've already shipped, define what comes next, and shape how people and agents work together across the pillar
Own design quality across the pillar. Set the bar, drive consistency from concept to ship, and get into the details yourself when it matters
Design for platform and enterprise complexity. Lead the team through cross-cutting decisions on scoping, segmentation, org units, permissions, and multi-entity audits so the system holds together across surfaces
Bring AI into how the team works. Build on our design harness, help every designer prototype and ship faster, and keep craft high as speed goes up
Lead and grow leaders. Develop your design leaders and senior ICs, build a high-trust team, and hire well as the pillar grows
Partner as a peer with product and engineering. Co-own outcomes and quality with your counterparts, not just the design work
How to be successful in this role:
You've shipped agentic or AI-forward products and have a point of view on how design changes when outputs are non-deterministic
You use AI hands-on in your own process, from prototyping to building in a harness or in code, and you bring your team along
You have deep enterprise B2B SaaS experience. You understand custom configurations, multi-org workflows, and large deployments, and you've made complex products feel simple
You think in systems, designing object models and patterns that hold up across many surfaces, not just individual flows
You're comfortable going deep with engineers in a technical, domain-heavy space like GRC
You've led teams of 12 or more, including design directors, design managers, and staff ICs, and you move easily between strategy and the details
You have a portfolio showing how you've simplified complex products and shipped AI-forward experiences (required for interview)
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship
Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results
Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

blocks.text: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As the Senior Director of Design, Governance & Compliance at Vanta, you'll lead design for our largest product pillar. You'll set the direction for how compliance work moves from manual workflows to agents that do the work alongside our customers.

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. Those companies range from founders getting their first SOC2 to global enterprises managing hundreds of controls. As we move upmarket, the team's job is to make that complexity feel simple for every customer, at every size.

You’ll lead a team of senior, staff, and principal designers, with senior managers and directors reporting to you. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner as a peer with product and engineering leadership for the pillar. We're not starting from scratch. Vanta Agent works across the product, customers build and deploy their own custom agents, and our designers prototype and ship to production with our own AI design harness. Your job is to make that the way the whole pillar works.
What you’ll do as a Senior Director of Design at Vanta:
Lead the agentic direction for Governance & Compliance. Build on the agents we've already shipped, define what comes next, and shape how people and agents work together across the pillar
Own design quality across the pillar. Set the bar, drive consistency from concept to ship, and get into the details yourself when it matters

Design for platform and enterprise complexity. Lead the team through cross-cutting decisions on scoping, segmentation, org units, permissions, and multi-entity audits so the system holds together across surfaces
Bring AI into how the team works. Build on our design harness, help every designer prototype and ship faster, and keep craft high as speed goes up
Lead and grow leaders. Develop your design leaders and senior ICs, build a high-trust team, and hire well as the pillar grows
Partner as a peer with product and engineering. Co-own outcomes and quality with your counterparts, not just the design work
How to be successful in this role:
You've shipped agentic or AI-forward products and have a point of view on how design changes when outputs are non-deterministic
You use AI hands-on in your own process, from prototyping to building in a harness or in code, and you bring your team along
You have deep enterprise B2B SaaS experience. You understand custom configurations, multi-org workflows, and large deployments, and you've made complex products feel simple
You think in systems, designing object models and patterns that hold up across many surfaces, not just individual flows
You're comfortable going deep with engineers in a technical, domain-heavy space like GRC
You've led teams of 12 or more, including design directors, design managers, and staff ICs, and you move easily between strategy and the details
You have a portfolio showing how you've simplified complex products and shipped AI-forward experiences (required for interview)
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship
Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results

jobs.title: Director, Emerging Technology
jobs.text:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly strategic and execution-focused Director of Emerging Technology to lead the development, deployment, and adoption of the firm's internal AI capabilities. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Data and Application Engineering, this leader will translate business and technology priorities into practical, scalable AI solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance service delivery, and create measurable business value.
As a 1,000-person Managed Services Provider (MSP) serving financial services and healthcare clients, we operate in highly regulated environments that require secure, compliant, reliable, and responsible use of technology. The Director of Emerging Technology will play a key role in establishing and scaling the firm's AI engineering capabilities while ensuring solutions align with security, privacy, regulatory, and operational requirements.
This role combines AI engineering leadership, business partnership, solution delivery, and team development. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving from strategy to hands-on execution—identifying high-value opportunities, designing solutions, leading implementation, measuring outcomes, and building the capabilities required to scale AI across the organization.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Direct Reports: 2–3 AI engineers initially, with the team expected to scale as AI adoption expands
Primary Scope: Internal AI strategy execution, AI engineering, automation, enablement, governance, and operational transformation
Partner with senior business leaders to execute the firm's AI strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives.
Identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities across departments including Service Desk, Finance, Operations, Customer Experience Management (CXM), and other corporate functions.
Develop and maintain a phased roadmap for AI solution development, deployment, and organizational adoption.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and frameworks and determine where they can provide meaningful business value.
Establish practical standards for evaluating AI opportunities based on business impact, technical feasibility, risk, security, and expected ROI.
Serve as a senior internal advisor on AI engineering, implementation approaches, and emerging AI capabilities.
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI agents, automation, and AI-powered applications.
Drive use cases such as ticket triage, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, financial processes, and operational insights.
Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant.
Oversee integration of AI solutions with existing enterprise systems and workflows.
Build, mentor, and lead the AI engineering team.
Establish development standards, architecture patterns, and best practices.
Partner with infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to deliver AI solutions.
Establish responsible AI practices and appropriate governance.
Partner with Security, Compliance, Legal, and Privacy teams on AI-related requirements.
Ensure appropriate controls for sensitive data, model usage, access, and monitoring.
Support compliance requirements applicable to financial services and healthcare environments.
Experience & Qualifications
8+ years of experience in technology or automation.
7-10 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML, or a related field
5-7 years Technical leadership or people management experience
5-7 Proven years of experience deploying AI/ML or generative AI solutions into production.
5-7 years of strong knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, automation, APIs, and data pipelines
5-7 of experience translating business requirements into technical solutions
5-7 years of experience working in regulated or security-sensitive environments
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience in an MSP, professional services, financial services, or healthcare environment.
Benefits of Working for Abacus:
Exposure to diverse array of technologies
Part of a team of experienced engineers who aim to deliver exceptional service
Competitive compensation
Performance bonus
Robust benefits package: medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401k, and PTO
Opportunities to further technical education through online courses
Positive, friendly, supportive work environment
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: VP of HubSpot & Technology Services
jobs.text:
Hybrid (Cheshire, CT area preferred). Occasional travel 1–2 times per quarter.
New role: one of four leadership positions we’re adding to support IMPACT’s next phase of growth. Open to internal and external candidates.
We're looking for a leader to build and run IMPACT's HubSpot and Technology practice for the next several years, so clients' sales and marketing teams adopt their platforms and use them to grow. You'll own IMPACT's HubSpot partnership day to day and help decide which platforms we train on next.
You'll be building on a strong foundation. Our HubSpot partnership matters a lot to the business, and today much of our work comes through referrals from our Endless Customers coaching clients. Now we need you to grow the practice on its own strength. That means building new sources of demand by making the most of the HubSpot partnership and expanding into other technologies.
We’re looking for someone who can take the goals for this practice, build a plan they believe in, and lead the team through it. You’ll set the priorities and make the day-to-day calls. If results are off pace or an offering isn’t delivering for clients, you’ll spot it early, decide what needs to change, and follow through without waiting for direction.
The job is to deliver the 2027 results and build a practice that you and your team can keep growing profitably into 2028 and beyond.
About IMPACT
IMPACT helps businesses become the most recommended, trusted, and chosen company in their market with the Endless Customers System (formerly They Ask, You Answer). We coach companies to earn buyer trust through content, video, sales alignment, their website, and visibility in AI search, and we're also a HubSpot Diamond Partner. We offer additional services such as website redesign, and paid media management.
We typically work with businesses in the range of $5-100m in revenue, often in home services, manufacturing, retail, and professional services. Most of the time, the business owner decides whether to engage with us, and sometimes it's the head of marketing or sales.
Room to shape the practice
You'll have room to shape the practice around your vision for what buyers will need in 2027 and beyond. Within certain parameters, you'll decide which services to develop, what to charge, and how your team delivers them profitably. We're counting on you to build a team that works well together and produces results clients can point to when they tell the story of what IMPACT did for their business.
Make the tools work for the people
Platforms keep getting more powerful, and AI is changing what they can do every month. Most teams can't keep up. You'll help clients own and run their own systems. You'll never lock them in or add complexity they don't need, and you'll keep our training current as HubSpot and other tools change.
What you'll do
Grow a profitable practice
Own the practice's revenue and profitability
Follow up quickly on opportunities from Marketing & Sales and our coaches, and scope and close custom and expanded engagements.
Keep forecasts current
Spot at-risk clients early and lead documented recovery plans.
Recommend renewals and expansions only when there's a clear next outcome for the client.
Deliver consistently at scale
Certify trainers on the platforms they teach, and review training quality regularly.
Keep materials current as HubSpot and other tools release new features.
Coordinate training scope and sequencing with our Web, Paid Media and coaching teams, so shared client processes aren't redesigned in isolation.
Own the HubSpot partnership
Track partner-tier requirements, with a dated plan to close any gaps and reach Elite status.
Keep deal registration and team certifications current.
Turn HubSpot referrals, co-marketing and partner-program opportunities into pipeline.
Grow our tier through work that fits the client and is profitable, never by selling unnecessary licenses.
Evolve the products
Shape our training lineup around market demand, client feedback and what the team enjoys delivering.
Evaluate new platforms, such as other CRMs and Notion
Fix or retire offers that don't sell or don't deliver, and recommend new offers and pricing changes
Work as One IMPACT
Coordinate cross-practice handoffs through each client's Relationship Owner.
Contribute expert time to marketing and sales (content, events and sales conversations) and to the Endless Customers Academy.
Test AI and process improvements, and share what works with the other practices.
Lead the team
Lead, develop and hold the team accountable, with clear expectations, measurables and regular feedback.
Make sure the team has the skills, tools, certifications and documentation it needs.
Who you'll work with
You'll report to our Integrator and work closely with our Visionary, who owns the executive-level HubSpot relationship. You'll also partner with the VPs of EC Coaching & Training, Web Services and Paid Media Services on shared clients, and with Marketing & Sales on new business.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Remote-based in the US
Overview
GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.
Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.
GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.
Job Summary
GoodPower is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own our end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.
Key Responsibilities
Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance
Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for GoodPower’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture
Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.
Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries
Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.
Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight
Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Team Leadership & Operational Culture
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to GoodPower's mission and growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.
Qualifications
12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.
This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks
Annual salary range: $220,000-$230,000, commensurate with experience
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
2 weeks of US office closure
10 days of paid sick leave annually.
403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
8 weeks of paid parental leave
GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.
Job Summary

GoodPower is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own our end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.
Key Responsibilities
Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance

items: Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for GoodPower’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.

blocks.text: Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture

items: Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.

blocks.text: Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance

items: Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.

blocks.text: Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries

items: Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.

blocks.text: Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight

items: Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.

blocks.text: Team Leadership & Operational Culture

items: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to GoodPower's mission and growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.

blocks.text: Qualifications

items: 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power every marketing, product and commercial decision across the business. We're looking for a Data Science leader who believes machine learning only creates value when it changes business decisions.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.
You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.
Responsibilties:
Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.
Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.
Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.
Innovation & Industry Leadership: Represent Forbes in strategic conversations with technology partners including Google and Meta while staying connected to advances in AI, machine learning and marketing science. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.
Qualifications:
Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.
Nice to Have
Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.
Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Head of Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
Hi 👋🏾, I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and CTO. Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.
We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!
The Role
In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:
Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure.
Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).
Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!
Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.
Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.
You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.
If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!
A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues!
The Qualifications
We’re entrusting you with a company priority, so we want you to know how to scale products and build the great teams that do that. This means:
You played an important role leading a company through a high-growth period (either as an IC Lead or Engineering Leader). You had to make high-quality decisions under pressure. That often meant striking a balance between short-term fixes to keep the product from falling over and long-term investments to ensure it didn’t happen again.
You have experience hiring and building hiring processes, and enjoy it! You’ve designed interviews, interview loops, and led hiring strategy.
You have a track record of excellent collaboration with other departments. You were a key contributor to company-level initiatives that involved Product Engineering, Product, Sales, or Support. Those departments felt heard and supported, yet positively challenged by you.
You have a background in writing production software (far beyond scripts). Our Platform & Infrastructure team is exclusively made up of strong software engineers, not just folks who scale the systems software runs on. They can jump into any part of our app, understand the code, and modify the underlying logic. We expect you to have similar experience to grow and upskill the team.
You are knowledgeable about platform and infrastructure technologies, networking, and hardware. You know how Kubernetes goes beyond a Container Orchestration Platform, how traffic flows between Load Balancers and Pods, and how the intricacies of the underlying hardware can cause Cloud abstractions to break, etc.
You are a great communicator, particularly in writing. You’ll need to be able to go deep with Infrastructure Engineers in conversations while also communicating those concepts to folks like myself who have much less experience.
You should be comfortable managing a team spanning from the Americas West Coast to Europe. You’ll be able to hire managers to focus on specific time zones, but I expect you to have skips with some engineers (and you should want to, too!). To ensure a reasonable work schedule, we’re only hiring candidates who live in the PST-GMT time zone.
What We’re Building
As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.
As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!
Why You Shouldn’t Apply
You’ve always been a line manager or never led a department within Engineering. You haven’t led the definition and evolution of culture and processes.
You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology. We believe great leaders are folks who were great engineers themselves. That starts with loving the craft and never giving it up.
You went into management because it was the only growth path available. We want folks who could have been Principal engineers (or were one!).
You're happy with a team of engineers who are predominantly early-career or mid-career or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. You believe that with enough guardrails, the team can get things done.
To you, a Staff or Principal Engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or conducting architecture reviews. You don’t believe staff and principal engineers could lead by the example they set or the leverage they create through their work.
You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently from the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers or consistency.
Engineering Culture
Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:
Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage, including LLM-driven dev tooling.
Putting effort into building a diverse team
Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership
The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They often discovered problems, prioritized the right ones, and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.
Traditional development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”
At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive.
Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate
Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).
To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over 4 years. ~34 hours of focus time, 2.5h of interviews, and 3.5 hours of meetings:
We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.
Increase Leverage, not Team Size
We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:
Great developer tooling. For example, our CI/CD takes ~10m, we deploy at least 15x a day, and our debugger works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.
Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:
And a demo of one of these building blocks:
Put Effort into Diversity
Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.
Today, 30% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We actively maintain and improve these numbers by sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, banning leetcode interviews, providing guidance and coaching to candidates, and more.
Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint
The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.
Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives engineers (and to a similar degree, you) a lot of flexibility in how they structure their days and weeks. In practice, that means they keep their own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching their feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and they actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.
This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and me. I block off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with my daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”
Interview Process
This is an important role that will lead our Platform & Infrastructure teams now and for the foreseeable future. The interview process reflects that in both challenge and length (5 rounds, ~6.5h):
Introduction call with me (30m, live)
A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
An interview to explore your past experience as a leader (1h, live)
Interview with Colin, our Head of EMEA Engineering (45m)
Final round where you meet various folks on the team and explore leadership and technical topics (3h)
I’ll have a strong read on whether we’re trending toward an offer by Round 3. Near the end of the process, we’ll do reference checks with a former manager, two direct reports, and a peer in Engineering. Depending on my bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.
This is also an important decision for you, so once you start interviewing, I’m always happy to have coffee chats in person or over Zoom to get to know each other.
Your First Six Months at Ashby
Your first three months at Ashby will be spent learning about Ashby Engineering and easing into leadership. While most of your onboarding will be driven by a 6-month plan you put together (and refine over time), you’ll also ship some product changes, features, and infra changes. What better way to learn how ICs work than to be one! Don’t worry if you’re not familiar with our technologies. The team is really helpful, and our dev environment is pretty awesome: it sets up in a single script, and you’ll be able to push your first product change on day one.
You and I will do 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and 6-month reviews to calibrate on our unique culture and how you, I, and the team will work together.
Benefits
Competitive salary and equity.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO.
A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.
Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
