jobs.title: Vice President, People Technology and Operations
jobs.text:
Department:
102100 People Success
Location:
San Diego, USA- Remote
Be a part of a global team that is inspired to make a difference in the lives of people living with rare disease.
At Travere Therapeutics, we recognize that our exceptional employees are vital to our success. We are a dedicated team focused on meeting the unique needs of rare patients. Our work is rewarding – both professionally and personally – because we are making a difference. We are passionate about what we do.
We are seeking talented individuals who will thrive in our collaborative, diverse, fast-paced environment and share in our mission – to identify, develop and deliver life-changing therapies to people living with rare disease. We stick by our values centered on patients, courage, community, and collaboration to pursue our vision of becoming a leading biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the delivery of innovation and hope to patients in the global rare disease community.
At Travere Therapeutics, we are in rare for life. We continue to courageously forge new paths as we move toward a common goal of elevating science and service for rare patients.
Position Summary
The Vice President, People Technology & Operations leads Travere’s global People technology, digital transformation, and People Operations capabilities. A key objective is to transform how People Success delivers services through AI, automation, integrated systems, and simpler processes. This leader is accountable for reliable technology, including Workday, trusted workforce data, and scalable services that improve the experience of employees, managers, and the People Success team.
Reporting to the Chief People Officer (CPO), the Vice President translates People Success strategy and business priorities into an integrated technology and service delivery roadmap. The role advises the CPO on enabling capabilities and leads execution within its scope. In partnership with IT and functional leaders, the Vice President prioritizes investments, drives adoption, and communicates complex technical concepts in clear, practical terms that help stakeholders make decisions and use solutions effectively.
Responsibilities
People Technology Strategy and Leadership
Own the People technology strategy and roadmap, aligning Workday and the broader technology ecosystem with business priorities, employee needs, and People Success goals.
Lead Workday and related HR systems design, optimization, and ongoing support through internal experts and external partners, with accountability for platform effectiveness and user experience.
Establish technology governance, demand prioritization, release planning, testing, and change control in partnership with IT and functional owners.
Oversee integrations, reporting, and data governance; establish clear accountability for data quality, access, and information flow across systems.
Manage technology investments and vendor relationships, with accountability for cost, service quality, adoption, and business value.
Digital Transformation and Adoption
Lead digital transformation across People Success, redesigning processes and applying AI, automation, and digital tools to improve service, reduce manual effort, and enable scale.
Identify and prioritize use cases, such as employee and manager self-service, knowledge access, workflow automation, reporting, and onboarding, based on business value and employee experience.
Partner with IT, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to evaluate tools and establish appropriate safeguards for privacy, security, accuracy, and human oversight.
Lead change management, communications, and training that translate technical changes into clear benefits and practical actions for employees, managers, and People Success partners. Measure adoption and results.
People Operations Strategy and Leadership
Translate the CPO’s People Success strategy into operational priorities and service delivery capabilities. Advise on capacity, technology, and process implications as Travere grows and evolves.
Centralize and simplify People Operations processes where appropriate, establishing clear ownership, consistent standards, and effective service delivery across the employee lifecycle.
Lead a team that can execute day-to-day operations while advancing strategic improvements. Set clear priorities, develop talent, and build capacity for future needs.
Advise People Success leaders on the operational implications of new programs, organizational changes, and business growth.
Define how employees, managers, and People Success partners access support, including self-service, case management, escalation paths, and service expectations.
Operational Excellence Data and Controls
Ensure People Success processes and systems deliver accurate data, global consistency, effective controls, and a reliable employee and manager experience.
Partner with Payroll, Finance, IT, Stock Administration, and other functions to improve the flow of information and clarify accountability across shared processes.
Establish service and platform performance measures, including resolution time, data accuracy, user adoption, and employee satisfaction. Use results to prioritize improvements and demonstrate value.
Advance People analytics and reporting so leaders have timely, reliable information to support workforce and business decisions.
Lead process mapping and continuous improvement efforts, balancing standardization with the needs of different business groups and geographies.
Oversee HR systems security, documentation, internal controls, audits, and adherence to applicable SOX requirements.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Technology, or a related field required. An equivalent combination of education and applicable experience may be considered.
At least 15 years of progressive experience in People technology, HR systems, People Operations, or HR transformation, including significant leadership experience and at least eight years managing teams.
Demonstrated success designing and scaling People Operations in a growing, complex organization with global operations.
Experience leading enterprise HR technology strategy, including Workday implementation or optimization, with demonstrated success translating business needs into effective solutions and sustained adoption.
Experience leading HR technology governance, integrations, data quality, release management, and vendor partnerships in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience applying AI to business processes is required, including identifying use cases, leading implementation and adoption, and measuring results. Sound judgment regarding data privacy, accuracy, risk, and human oversight is essential.
Experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology strongly preferred.
Additional Skills and Qualifications
A strategic partner who can advise the CPO and senior leaders while remaining accountable for execution.
Strong understanding of Workday and the broader HR technology ecosystem; able to evaluate solution designs, lead technical experts, and make sound platform and investment decisions.
Proven ability to redesign processes, clarify ownership, and build scalable service models across functions.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn operational data into clear recommendations and measurable improvements.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving technology, process, people, and change management.
Sound judgment in handling sensitive employee information, confidential matters, and competing business priorities.
Exceptional written and verbal communicator who translates highly technical information into clear, concise, audience-appropriate explanations. Able to articulate a point of view, explain trade-offs and business implications, and give employees and managers practical guidance they can understand and use.
Collaborative leader who influences senior stakeholders, builds trust across functions, and develops high-performing teams.
Ability to manage budgets, vendors, project plans, and competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
Commitment to Travere’s values and patient-inspired mission.
Ability to travel approximately 10% domestically and internationally
Ability to perform face-to-face work with colleagues and work
Total Rewards Offerings:
Travere provides comprehensive total rewards offerings that demonstrate our commitment as a diverse, equitable, people-centric, and pay-for-performance organization.
Benefits: Our benefits include premium health, financial, work-life and well-being offerings for eligible employees and dependents, wellness and employee support programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with employer match and generous paid time off.
Compensation: Our competitive compensation package includes a combination of both cash compensation (base pay and short-term incentive) and long-term incentive compensation (company stock), designed to recognize, retain, and reward employees.
Target Base Pay Range:
$285,000.00 - $385,000.00
*This information is current as of the date of this posting and may be modified in the future. Actual pay offered to a candidate will depend on a variety of factors including the candidate’s experience, education, skills, and location.
Travere will accept applications on an ongoing basis until a candidate is selected for the position.
Travere Therapeutics, Inc. is an EEO/AA/Veteran/Disability Employer.
If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact us by sending an email to . Please note that this email address is to be used exclusively to request an accommodation with the online application, interview or hiring process only. Travere HR will not reply to emails sent to this address for any other reason.

jobs.title: Director of Technology, Ad Tech
jobs.text:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.
Director of Technology, Ad Tech
Location: Argentina
Reports to: Chief Technology & Product Officer
About Adprime
Adprime Media is a vertically integrated advertising technology company headquartered in New York. Our platform spans a demand-side platform, a programmatic ad exchange, audience, data, and ad products, and campaign intelligence. We work with agencies, brands, and publishers across performance and healthcare verticals, and we are building an AI-first engineering and operations culture.
The Role
Adprime is hiring a Director of Technology to lead engineering execution across our platform. The Director of Technology will work directly with the CTPO to shape technical strategy, then own turning that strategy into delivered software through our distributed engineering team.
This is not a process management role. The ideal candidate will need the technical depth to evaluate architecture proposals on their merits, reject weak designs with a better alternative in hand, and produce solution designs yourself when the situation calls for it. Their leverage comes from judgment: the team produces options, you make sure the right one ships.
What The Director of Technology Will Do:
Partner with the CTPO on technology strategy and translate strategic direction into concrete architecture proposals and implementation plans
Review solution designs and architecture proposals from the engineering team; approve, reject with a clear alternative, or refine
Own delivery end to end: sprint planning, ticket definition, scope control, and accountability for committed timelines
Manage a distributed engineering team of nine engineers across backend, full stack, data, QA, and ML through an on-the-ground engineering lead
Establish measurable progress reporting so leadership always knows what is shipping, what is at risk, and why
Raise the engineering bar: solution design quality, code review discipline, documentation, and testing standards
Work with product management to turn requirements into scoped, sequenced engineering work
Champion AI-assisted development practices across the team
Requirements:
8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering teams
Hands-on experience building or operating advertising technology systems: bidders, exchanges or SSPs, ad servers, or real-time auction infrastructure
Working knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem: OpenRTB, supply chain standards (ads.txt, sellers.json, schain), identity, and measurement
Strong data engineering fluency: high-volume pipelines, data warehousing, and analytics infrastructure; AWS experience
A track record of managing distributed or offshore teams and getting reliable output across timezones
The ability to switch between strategic discussion with executive leadership and detailed technical review with engineers
Excellent written and spoken English
What Success Looks Like
Within six months, the CTPO is out of the day-to-day engineering loop. Architecture decisions are made quickly and well, sprints ship what they commit to, and delivery timelines are trusted by the rest of the company.
Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - REMOTE (Plano, TX, US)
jobs.text:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a Managing Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - REMOTE to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).
Position Summary
NTT DATA is building a new Forward Deployed Engineering capability to accelerate AI Service-as-Software, one of the company's key strategic growth bets. We are seeking an Executive, Head of Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead this function globally.
This leader will create the field execution engine that brings AI products into strategic client environments. The role will deploy high-caliber technical teams to shape, prototype, validate, and scale AI solutions, while converting client learning into reusable product and platform patterns.
This is not a traditional delivery, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales role. It is an executive technical leadership role focused on connecting client demand, AI product strategy, and product engineering to help NTT DATA move from bespoke AI services toward repeatable, platform-led AI Native growth.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead a high-impact Forward Deployed Engineering team of up to 20 engineers, combining AI engineering, solution architecture, industry/domain expertise, and client-facing technical credibility.
Define the Forward Deployed Engineering operating model, including engagement rules, delivery standards, escalation paths, handoff models, and interfaces with product, engineering, sales, industry, and delivery teams.
Deploy FDE teams into priority client and industry opportunities to shape AI solution hypotheses, prototypes, MVPs, pilots, and production deployments.
Partner closely with the Executive, AI Solutions Product Leader to translate field learning into product roadmap recommendations, reusable platform capabilities, and productization opportunities.
Work with Product Engineering to move validated field solutions into scalable, secure, enterprise-ready product capabilities.
Support strategic pursuits and executive client conversations by providing technical credibility, solution clarity, demos, prototypes, and deployment plans.
Establish reusable deployment patterns, reference architectures, templates, integration assets, and solution playbooks to reduce bespoke delivery and improve speed to value.
Promote a 70% standardized / 30% configurable model for AI Service-as-Software offerings to improve repeatability, scalability, and margin potential.
Recommend FDE deployment priorities based on client demand, strategic value, product learning potential, technical feasibility, and commercial relevance.
Track field impact through metrics such as deployment quality, time to prototype, time to client value, reusable patterns created, productization candidates identified, client feedback, deployment repeatability, and team health.
Required Qualifications
15+ years of experience in engineering, field engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, AI/data products, product engineering, or technical delivery leadership.
Experience leading technical teams at scale, ideally 15-30 engineers or equivalent.
Strong technical fluency across AI, GenAI, agentic workflows, data platforms, cloud architecture, APIs, integrations, enterprise applications, and software delivery.
Proven ability to work directly with senior client, business, and technology stakeholders in complex enterprise environments.
Experience translating ambiguous business problems into practical, deployable technical solutions.
Strong understanding of how field-built solutions can become scalable product capabilities.
Experience working across product, engineering, sales, delivery, architecture, security, and client teams.
Ability to build new operating models, delivery standards, team structures, and execution rhythms in a scaling environment.
Executive presence and ability to influence across a global, matrixed organization.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, field engineering, solutions engineering, platform engineering, technical product leadership, or enterprise AI delivery.
Experience in a global systems integration, consulting, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, or AI platform environment.
Experience with Service-as-Software, productized services, or platform-led delivery models.
Experience building repeatable deployment patterns from client-specific implementations.
Experience partnering with product and engineering leaders to convert field learning into roadmap priorities and scalable product capabilities.
Success Measures
Establishment of a high-performing Forward Deployed Engineering function.
Quality and speed of AI deployments in strategic client environments.
Strength of the feedback loop from field deployments into product and platform roadmaps.
Number and quality of reusable patterns, accelerators, and productization candidates generated.
Improved deployment repeatability and reduced bespoke implementation effort.
Effectiveness of partnership with AI Solutions Product, Product Engineering, AI Vista, AI Market Makers, industry, sales, and delivery teams.
Contribution to strategic pursuits, client confidence, and commercialization readiness.
Technical quality, reliability, and enterprise readiness of field-deployed solutions.
Health, retention, and development of the FDE team.
Why Join Us
This is an opportunity to build a new executive-level technical field capability at the center of NTT DATA's AI strategy.
You will lead the team that makes AI Service-as-Software real in client environments, proves value quickly, and turns field learning into scalable product advantage. You will work alongside product and engineering executives to help the company move from bespoke AI delivery toward repeatable, platform-led AI Native growth.
You will not simply lead implementation. You will build the field engineering system that connects client demand, AI product strategy, and scalable product engineering.
About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, .
NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this role is $150,000 - $350,000 per year. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance.
This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.
NTT DATA endeavors to make accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at . This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. jobs.title: Data Governance Director
jobs.text:
At EMC, we’re all about working together to make an impact. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, contribute, and gain experience that matters. We strive to be caring leaders, close partners, and responsive experts—always supporting each other to do our best work. Join us, and let’s improve lives together.
**This position is eligible to work from home anywhere in the United States with preference given to those living in the Des Moines, Iowa metro area. This role would also need to work hours based on Central Time Zone**
This role leads EMC’s enterprise Data Governance program and is accountable for the strategy, operating model, capabilities, technical direction, and organizational adoption required to improve the value, quality, protection, accessibility, and responsible use of enterprise data. Partners with senior business, technology, analytics, risk, compliance, and Digital Product Management leaders to integrate governance into enterprise priorities, strengthen data ownership and accountability, and deliver measurable business and risk-management outcomes.
Essential Functions:
Defines the enterprise Data Governance strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with business and technology strategies, ensuring governance supports EMC’s business model, enterprise priorities, and evolving data needs.
Establishes strategic direction and capability expectations for data stewardship, business metadata management, data quality management, master and reference data management, governance operations, and governance technology platforms.
Aligns investment and capability priorities based on business objectives, regulatory and risk-management needs, and enterprise data and technology strategies.
Directs execution of the Data Governance strategy through portfolio planning, prioritization, resource alignment, and management of internal and external delivery resources.
Oversees governance programs, initiatives, consulting partners, contractors, and third-party service providers to ensure delivery aligns with approved objectives, commitments, and enterprise priorities.
Establishes outcome, adoption, quality, and capability-maturity measures; monitors performance; manages enterprise-level risks, issues, and dependencies; and initiates corrective action when delivery does not meet established expectations.
Bridges business and technology priorities by building consensus across competing interests and aligning senior leaders around governance objectives, operating model changes, and accountability expectations.
Partners with business, technology, and product management leaders to clarify decision rights, establish shared ownership, and integrate governance requirements into enterprise initiatives.
Exercises decision authority for Data Governance-led initiatives and facilitates resolution or escalation of material conflicts, exceptions, and decisions that require broader enterprise alignment or authority.
Leads the development, enterprise approval, implementation, and continuous improvement of data governance policies, standards, controls, and frameworks in partnership with business and functional leaders.
Champions data ownership and accountability, and leads organizational change to address systemic barriers, strengthen program maturity, and sustain adoption across the enterprise.
Leads and develops the Data Governance team through workforce planning, clear performance expectations, coaching, succession planning, and talent development.
Establishes team objectives and ways of working aligned with strategic priorities, promotes accountability and continuous improvement, and builds the skills and capacity needed to deliver and sustain the enterprise Data Governance program.
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's degree in business, information management, computer science, analytics, finance, insurance, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Ten years of progressively responsible experience in data governance, information management, business analytics, data management, or related disciplines
Five or more years of leadership experience managing teams, enterprise programs, or cross-functional initiatives
Property and casualty insurance industry experience preferred
Experience working within Agile product delivery environments and partnering with Digital Product Management organizations preferred
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Expert knowledge of data governance frameworks, operating models, policies, and standards
Advanced knowledge of data management practices, including metadata, data quality, stewardship, and master and reference data management
Strong knowledge of property and casualty insurance operations, business processes, products, and data domains
Knowledge of data-related regulatory requirements, privacy principles, information protection, and emerging industry trends
Strong knowledge of data governance technologies and their application to enterprise data management
Advanced strategic planning, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Strong ability to translate enterprise strategy into actionable governance roadmaps and operating models
Advanced ability to lead organizational change and drive adoption of governance practices
Excellent ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional stakeholders, and resolve competing priorities
Superior verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex governance and technical concepts to diverse audiences
Our employment practices are in accordance with the laws that prohibit discrimination due to race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, active military status, citizenship status, marital status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.
All of our locations are tobacco free including in company vehicles.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About The Role
Samsara’s mission is to improve industrial efficiency, safety, and quality at a massive scale, through the use of sensors and software. Our suite of IoT products and software platform brings the benefits of sensor data to traditional industries like transportation, food and beverage distribution, construction, state and local government, and K-12 education. We help our customers transport food, medicine, and other goods safely across the country, monitor deliveries for unsafe conditions, and help fleet managers improve the efficiency of their operations.
Samsara’s Product Design team is responsible for crafting user-friendly features, workflows, and interfaces that our customers use every day to run their operations. This involves talking to customers, working with engineers and product managers to understand problems, rapidly designing and iterating on mocks and user flows, and communicating ideas effectively to stakeholders. We also build design systems that underpin all our products to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.
We’re looking for an experienced product design director who will build out an already high-caliber group of designers and help shape the product experience for all our customers.
This is a remote position based in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
In this role, you will:
Lead, grow, coach and mentor a team of design managers
Engage with customers to deeply understand their operations and people
Ship high-quality designs based on these customer needs
Collaborate with partners to define opportunities and deliver a best-in-class experiences
Define and drive the product design strategy across product areas
Create and refine tools, systems and processes that improve team health and output
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Minimum requirements for the role:
4-6 years (or more) of product design management experience
Strong portfolio that showcases ability to lead teams that ship elegant solutions to complex problems
An ideal candidate also has:
Track record of shipping step-changes to the UX that drive customer and business impact
A history of hiring, growing and retaining great talent
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to ship high quality experiences
Experience identifying and instituting changes that improve employee experiences
Expertise in providing feedback that accelerates career growth and improves product quality
A desire to improve yourself, the team, and product experiences
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary
$235,600—$294,500 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: VP, Technology and Strategy (Job 1513)
jobs.text:
About Us
DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.
Overview
DLH is seeking a Vice President, Technology and Strategy, to help shape the company's technology vision, strategy, and innovation agenda across our Health and Defense & Security markets. As a member of the senior leadership team, the VP will set the enterprise technology direction, guide where DLH invests and/or partners, and ensure emerging capabilities translate into differentiated solutions and measurable growth.
This role will combine deep technology expertise with market insight and executive presence – someone who can shape strategy, lead technical teams, drive the execution of solutions, and represent DLH’s technology brand to customers, partners, and industry.
Responsibilities
Own the enterprise technology adoption and deployment strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned to DLH’s corporate growth objectives.
Direct the company’s innovation and adoption agenda, including emerging-technology pilots, rapid prototyping, and independent research and development (IR&D) efforts.
Govern technical solution architectures on strategic pursuits, partnering with Growth to embed differentiated technology into bids, RFIs, white papers, demonstrations, and proposals.
Lead DLH’s technology strategy, including solution architects and external emerging and established technology subject-matter experts – whether as direct reports or a matrixed community of practice and partners.
Establish and manage strategic partnerships and alliances with technology companies that strengthen DLH’s capabilities and competitive posture. Evaluate emerging technologies and translate into business strategy.
Monitor competitor technology investments, partnerships, and market positioning to identify opportunities for differentiation.
Monitor competitor technology investments and market positioning to identify opportunities for differentiation.
Champion responsible AI adoption across the company and DLH delivery environments coordinating with business-unit technology initiatives.
Serve as DLH’s technology voice in relevant customer, partner, and industry forums, providing thought leadership and guidance on emerging trends and mission impact.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of relevant experience in federal technology leadership, technology strategy, digital transformation, solution development, or related areas, including enterprise-wide scope
Demonstrated record of translating technology strategy into growth - differentiated contract wins, new offerings, or strategic partnerships.
Experience supporting Growth, Capture, solutioning, or major proposal efforts.
Deep knowledge of Health and Defense customer missions, the acquisition environment, and the competitive landscape.
Strong executive communication skills, with credibility across customers, partners, and senior leadership; able to translate complex technology into clear business and mission implications.
Experience supporting federal Health, Defense, or National Security customers preferred.
Active Secret Clearance walking through the door
What Success Looks Like
A funded, multi-year enterprise technology roadmap tied directly to DLH’s corporate growth plan.
Measurable improved win rates on technology-differentiated pursuits.
A pipeline of emerging-technology pilots and partnerships converting into offerings, partnerships, or contract wins.
DLH recognized by customers and industry as a technology leader in its Health and Defense markets.
Basic Compensation: $230,000 - $285,000 yearly salary
The salary range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The final offer may vary based on skills, experience, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. Additional compensation may include performance incentives and program-specific awards. We do not use salary history to determine compensation, in line with applicable law.
Benefits
DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.
EEO
DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.
DLH is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic interview process
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Position Summary...
What you'll do...
Role summary:
The Senior Director, Product Management, leads the strategic direction and operations for multiple complex product families within Walmart - with a focus on Governance and Corporate Affairs. This role defines long-term product vision, aligns cross-functional teams, and drives innovation by leveraging data and emerging technologies. The position is accountable for enterprise-wide resource allocation, financial planning, and organizational capability development. It requires influencing senior leadership, managing product roadmaps, and ensuring compliance with governance standards. The role fosters a high-performing culture focused on operational excellence, ethical practices, and continuous improvement to deliver impactful business outcomes and maintain Walmart’s competitive positioning.
About the team:
The Corporate Functions Product team develops and scales innovative products, platforms, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance Walmart’s corporate operations. Collaborating with Finance, Corporate Affairs, Legal and Governance, and People teams, the group streamlines workflows, modernizes processes, and improves access to reliable data and insights. The team focuses on reusable capabilities that address enterprise-wide challenges while delivering measurable business outcomes. Members apply strong stakeholder management, program development, and technical expertise to drive impactful solutions supporting strategic goals and operational excellence across the organization.
What you'll do:
Define and lead long-term product strategy and vision for multiple complex product families aligned with business objectives and market trends.
Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and deliver financial plans, resource allocation, and investment recommendations.
Oversee product roadmap prioritization, risk management, and execution to drive growth and innovation.
Foster cross-functional alignment by partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Business teams to ensure strategic priorities are met.
Guide organizational capability development through talent recruitment, mentorship, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Leverage data analytics and emerging technologies to inform product decisions and enhance competitive positioning.
What you'll bring:
Extensive experience leading product strategy and operations for complex product portfolios.
Proven ability to define long-term vision and align product roadmaps with business objectives.
Strong expertise in cross-functional leadership, collaborating with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Business teams.
Demonstrated success in data-driven decision making and leveraging AI and emerging technologies.
Skilled in managing resource allocation, risk, and dependencies to deliver financial targets.
Ability to influence senior leadership with fact-based narratives and market insights.
Commitment to developing high-performing teams and fostering continuous learning and innovation.
At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see . Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.
The annual salary range for this position is $160,000.00 - $320,000.00 Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance bonuses. Additional compensation for certain positions may also include :
- Stock

jobs.title: Head of Technology & Data Partnerships
jobs.text:
Our Mission:
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
Our People:
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
The Opportunity
This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for defining and leading the company’s technology, data, and AI partnership strategy.
The role will serve as the executive owner of the broader technology and data partnership ecosystem.
This is not a traditional channel or alliances sales role. The focus is on partnerships that shape the product, strengthen the company’s data advantage, and extend the reach of the platform.
The leader will help determine where the company should build, buy, partner, or potentially acquire capabilities.
What the Leader Will Own
Set the company-wide strategy for technology, data, platform, integration, and AI partnerships.
Identify a focused portfolio of high-impact partnership opportunities that can improve product differentiation, innovation, distribution, and growth.
Build trusted C-suite relationships with priority technology platforms, data providers, cloud companies, and emerging AI ecosystems.
Originate and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements covering product scope, data rights, intellectual property, economics, investment, exclusivity, and governance.
Shape the external data strategy, including data coverage, quality, identity, signals, licensing, and differentiated data products.
Influence product and platform strategy by bringing an external ecosystem and market perspective into company investment decisions.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strategic agreements translate into funded roadmaps, clear ownership, successful launches, and measurable customer adoption.
Establish portfolio governance, performance measures, and an operating model that allows the partnership capability to scale.
Build and develop a senior, globally effective organization over time.
Why the Role Matters
The company’s advantage depends on connecting high-quality data, identity, and signals with the platforms, data environments, and AI ecosystems where customers already work.
These partnerships are viewed as a company-level lever for product innovation, differentiation, distribution, and growth, rather than simply a source of partner-sourced revenue.
The successful leader will have significant influence over product direction, ecosystem positioning, investment choices, and how the company creates long-term strategic advantage.
What Success Looks Like
In the first 60 days
Assess the existing portfolio, market landscape, strategic gaps, team capabilities, active commitments, and role boundaries.
By 90 days
Develop an executive-ready technology, data, and AI ecosystem strategy with a concentrated set of priority bets, investment choices, executive sponsors, and Product and R&D commitments.
Within six months
Demonstrate visible progress on consequential partnerships, including signed or late-stage agreements with funded productization paths and clear measures of impact.
Within 12 months
Establish a focused portfolio producing measurable adoption, distribution, differentiation, and commercial impact, supported by trusted C-suite relationships and a scalable team and operating model.
The Profile That Will Be Successful
An executive who has built or materially scaled a technology, platform, product, or data partnership capability.
Someone who combines ecosystem strategy with enough technical fluency to engage credibly on architecture, APIs, data rights, identity, security, privacy, and AI.
A sophisticated negotiator who understands partnership structures, economics, data licensing, commercialization, and joint product delivery.
A strong cross-functional leader who can align senior Product, Engineering, commercial, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders around difficult investment and roadmap choices.
Someone with a practical understanding of how AI, agents, and MCP are changing enterprise software ecosystems.
A builder who can create the strategy, operating model, governance, metrics, and leadership team required for the capability to scale.
Base Salary Range: $195,000.00 - $270,000.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).
Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy.
Our Benefits:
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to .

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Director, Data & Business Systems
jobs.text:
About Graza
Graza makes always fresh, never blended, extra virgin olive oil in fun-to-use squeeze bottles. In the past two years, we’ve gone from a fast-growing brand to a national business, with products on the shelves of Whole Foods, Target, Walmart, Kroger, Safeway/Albertsons, and many others.
We’ve also expanded beyond olive oil into mayo and chips, with more innovation ahead. We operate across retail, club, DTC, and international markets, and the complexity of the business is growing quickly.
That creates an exciting problem: we need to build the systems, data infrastructure, and processes that allow Graza to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.
The Role
We’re looking for our first dedicated Director of Data & Business Systems
This is not a traditional data engineering role. And it’s not a traditional IT or business systems role. You’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, and how the business actually works.
You’ll help us understand how information flows through Graza—from customer orders and inventory, through purchasing, production, logistics, finance, and ultimately into the reporting the leadership team uses to run the company.
You’ll identify where we rely on spreadsheets, manual work, duplicate data entry, disconnected systems, or inconsistent definitions. You’ll determine whether the answer is a process change, better use of an existing system, an integration, automation, or something new.
At the same time, you’ll own the evolution of our Snowflake data environment and turn it into a reliable foundation for reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
You’ll report to the VP of Finance and work directly with the leadership team. This is a highly visible role with broad ownership and significant room to shape the function.
What You’ll Do
Build the data foundation.
Own the architecture and roadmap for our Snowflake environment. Design the underlying data model, ingestion and transformation pipelines, and reliable datasets that become the foundation for company reporting. Build the tools and outputs that allow the business to answer questions without recreating analysis in spreadsheets every week.
Understand how the business works.
Map critical business processes and data flows across Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and other functions. Understand where data originates, where it changes, which system owns it, and where things break down. Establish clear systems of record for customers, products, orders, inventory, revenue, COGS, and other critical business domains.
Make Graza's systems work together.
Evaluate our existing technology landscape and determine where we should integrate, configure, replace, consolidate, or build. Own the architecture behind key integrations between accounting, ERP, e-commerce, inventory, supply chain, logistics, retail, and other platforms.
Eliminate unnecessary manual work.
Find the processes that consume people's time because "that's how we've always done it." Quantify the problem, redesign the process, and automate where it makes sense. We want fewer spreadsheets that require someone to remember to update them and more durable systems that work correctly by design.
Build trusted business intelligence.
Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to turn business questions into useful data products. Build reporting around revenue, margin, customers, channels, SKUs, pricing, velocity, inventory, purchasing, production, logistics, and forecasting. Start with the decision the business needs to make and work backward to the data required to support it.
Create confidence in the numbers.
Establish definitions, ownership, testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and documentation for critical metrics. When Finance, the leadership team, the board, or investors ask a question, we should be able to explain where the number came from and why we trust it.
Build the function.
Manage and develop our existing data analyst and determine what the team should look like as Graza grows. Establish practical engineering and data standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Decide what we should build ourselves, what we should buy, and where outside expertise makes sense.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, you will have:
Created a clear map of Graza's major systems, processes, and data flows.
Established a target architecture for our data and business systems.
Turned Snowflake into a well-modeled, trusted foundation for company reporting.
Defined systems of record and eliminated ambiguity around critical business data.
Replaced a meaningful number of manual, spreadsheet-dependent processes with scalable workflows.
Built reliable reporting for Finance, Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain.
Established clear definitions and controls around our most important metrics.
Identified and prioritized the next wave of integrations, automation, and systems investments.
Built a roadmap for the people, technology, and capabilities Graza will need as we scale.
Why This Role
This is an opportunity to build something foundational at Graza.
You won't inherit a mature data organization or spend your time maintaining someone else's architecture. You'll have the opportunity to define how data and systems work across a rapidly growing consumer business—and to directly influence how the company operates.
If you like solving messy problems, building things that matter, and making companies work better, we'd like to talk.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management
jobs.text:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.
Magna Legal Services is seeking a Vice President of Product Management to build and lead consistent product management practices across the company. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, this leader will lead Magna’s product management team and work with Business Unit leadership in a matrixed environment to bring structure, process, and discipline to how Magna evaluates, develops, launches, and improves its products and services.
The VP will contribute to product strategy by bringing client, market, and operational insights to planning and prioritization. Working closely with leaders across Commercial (including Sales, Marketing, and Client Success), Technology, Operations, and Magna’s Business Units, including court reporting, records retrieval, jury consulting, investigations, trial technology, and language services, the VP will help turn strategic priorities into well-defined roadmaps and coordinated execution. Product sits at the center of these groups: the VP serves as the bridge between the Business Units, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Client Success, and owns enterprise-wide products that do not fall neatly within a single Business Unit, such as the client portal.
Magna’s product managers will report directly to the VP of Product Management, with a dotted line to their respective Business Unit leaders. The dotted-line relationship reflects that the Business Units own their product and offering strategy; product managers will work closely with their Business Unit leaders to ensure product development is directed by and consistent with Business Unit priorities.
The VP will also work through Magna’s Product Council, chaired by the Chief Strategy Officer, which brings together executive, commercial, and technology leadership, including the CTO, to align product priorities across the company. The VP will partner closely with the CTO and Engineering leadership, who will be actively involved in shaping product priorities, roadmaps, and feasibility decisions, so that product direction and technology strategy move forward together.
Primary Responsibilities
Lead, develop, and manage Magna’s product managers, who report directly to the VP with a dotted line to their Business Unit leaders.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of enterprise-wide products that serve multiple Business Units, such as the client portal.
Establish product management processes, standards, and governance that support consistent decision-making across Magna.
Introduce best practices for product discovery, opportunity assessment, prioritization, requirements development, launch planning, and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to product strategy by sharing client feedback, market insights, portfolio assessments, and product performance data.
Translate company and service-line priorities into clear product roadmaps, business requirements, and execution plans.
Facilitate cross-functional planning and decision-making among Business Unit, Technology, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and Operations leaders, including through Magna’s Product Council.
Guide product initiatives from initial concept through development, launch, adoption, and refinement.
Develop practical tools and frameworks to evaluate opportunities, build business cases, assess feasibility, and measure expected impact.
Partner with CTO/Engineering team to ensure engineering produces development timelines with enough specificity around milestones and sequencing to enable the PM to monitor and report out on progress.
Define and monitor measures of product performance, such as adoption, client outcomes, revenue contribution, and operational effectiveness.
Identify opportunities to improve existing products and services, and coordinate the work needed to advance them.
Build organizational understanding of product management roles, processes, and decision rights.
Desired Background
Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Significant experience in product management, product operations, or product development, ideally in professional services, legal services, technology-enabled services, or a related environment.
Demonstrated success establishing or improving product management processes and cross-functional ways of working.
Experience coordinating products or services through discovery, development, launch, and ongoing improvement.
Strong ability to translate client and business needs into requirements, roadmaps, and actionable plans.
Experience with prioritization, business cases, product performance measures, or go-to-market planning.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to build alignment among senior stakeholders.
Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the judgment to introduce process that supports effective execution.
Comfortable working in a dynamic organization and building structure where processes are still developing.
Success in This Role
Success will mean that Magna has clear, repeatable product management practices; teams have a shared process for assessing and advancing product opportunities; and product decisions are supported by client insight, business priorities, and measurable outcomes.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

The VP will also work through Magna’s Product Council, chaired by the Chief Strategy Officer, which brings together executive, commercial, and technology leadership, including the CTO, to align product priorities across the company. The VP will partner closely with the CTO and Engineering leadership, who will be actively involved in shaping product priorities, roadmaps, and feasibility decisions, so that product direction and technology strategy move forward together.
Primary Responsibilities

items: Lead, develop, and manage Magna’s product managers, who report directly to the VP with a dotted line to their Business Unit leaders.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of enterprise-wide products that serve multiple Business Units, such as the client portal.
Establish product management processes, standards, and governance that support consistent decision-making across Magna.
Introduce best practices for product discovery, opportunity assessment, prioritization, requirements development, launch planning, and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to product strategy by sharing client feedback, market insights, portfolio assessments, and product performance data.
Translate company and service-line priorities into clear product roadmaps, business requirements, and execution plans.
Facilitate cross-functional planning and decision-making among Business Unit, Technology, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and Operations leaders, including through Magna’s Product Council.
Guide product initiatives from initial concept through development, launch, adoption, and refinement.
Develop practical tools and frameworks to evaluate opportunities, build business cases, assess feasibility, and measure expected impact.
Partner with CTO/Engineering team to ensure engineering produces development timelines with enough specificity around milestones and sequencing to enable the PM to monitor and report out on progress.
Define and monitor measures of product performance, such as adoption, client outcomes, revenue contribution, and operational effectiveness.
Identify opportunities to improve existing products and services, and coordinate the work needed to advance them.
Build organizational understanding of product management roles, processes, and decision rights.

blocks.text: Desired Background

items: Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Significant experience in product management, product operations, or product development, ideally in professional services, legal services, technology-enabled services, or a related environment.
Demonstrated success establishing or improving product management processes and cross-functional ways of working.
Experience coordinating products or services through discovery, development, launch, and ongoing improvement.
Strong ability to translate client and business needs into requirements, roadmaps, and actionable plans.
Experience with prioritization, business cases, product performance measures, or go-to-market planning.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to build alignment among senior stakeholders.
Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the judgment to introduce process that supports effective execution.
Comfortable working in a dynamic organization and building structure where processes are still developing.

blocks.text: Success in This Role

Success will mean that Magna has clear, repeatable product management practices; teams have a shared process for assessing and advancing product opportunities; and product decisions are supported by client insight, business priorities, and measurable outcomes.

jobs.title: VP, Product and Growth, Go.Compare
jobs.text:
Who we are
We create trusted, expert content that helps millions of people discover more about the things they love, need and care about. From technology, gaming and entertainment to fashion, lifestyle, sport, finance and beyond, our specialist brands connect people with their passions every day.
Across websites, magazines, newsletters, social channels and events, we bring expert content to audiences around the world. We combine our deep specialist knowledge with innovative technology and data to create engaging experiences, build valuable communities and help people make better-informed decisions.
Behind it all are our people - passionate experts, creators, innovators and problem-solvers who are shaping the future of media.
The Team You’ll Join
As a proud part of Future's brand portfolio, Go.Compare is a passionate price comparison site finding customers savvy insurance deals. Based in our Cardiff office, we pride ourselves on being a fun and fair place to work. You'll join a team of experts partnering with trusted organisations and the Welsh Rugby Union. It's an exciting opportunity to help millions make informed financial choices.
Description
As the VP, Product and Growth, you will direct our product vision, user acquisition, and growth strategy. Operating from our Cardiff office, you'll lead cross-functional teams spanning Product Management, UX Design, and Conversion Rate Optimisation. You'll partner with executive peers across Technology, Commercial Trading, and Brand Marketing to deliver scalable digital experiences. By combining customer insights, experimentation, and data analytics, you'll optimize conversion funnels and accelerate sustainable business growth.
What you'll do
You will report to the SVP of Go.Compare
Direct the overall product vision, growth strategy, and digital customer journeys across all Go.Compare verticals.
Oversee product management, UX design, conversion optimisation, and digital acquisition teams.
Partner with technology and commercial leaders to deliver high-performing comparison tools and seamless user experiences.
Establish data-driven experimentation frameworks to test, iterate, and optimize funnel conversion rates.
Leverage customer research, analytics, and market trends to identify new product features and growth opportunities.
Guide cross-functional teams to align product releases with commercial trading and strategic revenue goals.
What you’ll bring
Executive product leadership experience in price comparison, digital marketplaces, fintech, or high-volume e-commerce.
Proven track record scaling digital products, driving customer acquisition, and optimising conversion funnels.
Strong expertise in data analytics, user research, A/B testing, and growth experimentation frameworks.
Strategic mindset with the ability to turn complex customer data into clear product roadmaps.
Experience guiding, inspiring, and developing cross-functional product, design, and marketing teams.
Excellent communication skills to align executive stakeholders, engineering teams, and commercial partners
Minimum Requirements
Executive background directing digital product strategy, conversion growth, or product management in a digital environment.
Ability to operate from our Cardiff office under a hybrid model.
What we offer
Uncapped leave
Enhanced parental leave
Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care
When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
Refer a friend scheme - with payment following the successful hire.
Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes
Opportunity to purchase shares in Future, with our Share Incentive Plan
Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match
Free drinks and snacks in our offices
The expected range for this role is £120,000 - £140,000
This is a hybrid role, working 2 to 3 days per week from our Cardiff Office.
Internal job family level Professional 2
Inclusion and Diversity at Future
At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educating our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive.
Find out more about Our Future, Our Responsibility on our website.
If you need any reasonable adjustments, please let us know, and we'll be happy to support you.
