jobs.title: VP, Data Integration
jobs.text:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.
All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.
As VP Data Integration (PhareOS), you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of PhareOS integrations with customer electronic medical record (EMR) systems. This role is both highly strategic and operational, with accountability for evolving integration approaches, assessing new technologies and vendors, and advancing the team’s operating model.
You will also own the end-to-end delivery of high-quality, timely, and efficient customer integrations. The ideal candidate will be equally energized by working through ambiguity and pioneering new approaches as by leading a team through disciplined, high-performing execution. Strong client management and program management skills are essential.
Essential Responsibilities
Deliver timely, high-quality EMR integrations: Oversee the successful execution of all required inbound and outbound integrations with PhareOS customers. Own end-to-end data delivery, from communicating requirements through ingestion, mapping, validation, and go-live. Implement rigorous quality-control and error-handling processes, and establish, measure, and improve key data-delivery metrics.
Develop repeatable integration processes: Implement processes across discovery, development, and testing that improve data coverage and quality. Build repeatable approaches for integrating PhareOS product outputs into customer workflows. Continually reduce integration cycle time through tools, documentation, and process refinement, while fostering knowledge sharing and best-practice development across the team.
Innovate the integration approach: Assess the landscape of integration methods and provide thought leadership on potential new approaches. Scope and execute pilots, manage the portfolio of integration tools and vendors, and continuously improve that portfolio. Partner with Engineering and Product to scope enhancements to the data platform and adapt team processes to meet product integration requirements.
Build the right team: Organize the data integration team to support the volume, complexity, and diversity of PhareOS products and data. Recruit and mentor team members, elevate emerging leaders, and provide growth opportunities at all levels.
Plan and resource: Collaborate with the implementation team to anticipate demand, plan resources, and ensure coverage of all work. Manage integration vendors and their scopes of work.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex healthcare data integrations.
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing people managers and scaling teams.
5+ years managing senior client stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with HL7 and FHIR.
Expertise in one or more mainstream interface engines.
· Strong SQL skills.
Strong client management, communication, and program management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with EDI data types.
Prior experience at an EMR or interoperability company.
· Prior experience in revenue cycle.
· Experience with Databricks.
For this US-based position, the base pay range is $179,593.00 - $350,044.45 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 30.00%
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.
Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.
R1 RCM Inc. (“the Company”) is dedicated to the fundamentals of equal employment opportunity. The Company’s employment practices , including those regarding recruitment, hiring, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination shall not be based on any person’s age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Furthermore, the Company is dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment based on any of the foregoing protected categories.
If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the job application process, please contact us at 312-496-7709 for assistance.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering- Integrated Sensor Team
jobs.text:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.
Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As Director of Engineering for GenLogs’ Integrated Sensor team, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling the hardware and software systems at the heart of our sensing network.
This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and cloud/software platforms. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.
You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.
WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and software engineering.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.
Set Technical Direction
Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the Integrated Sensor product line across hardware, edge, and cloud systems.
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.
Drive Product Delivery
Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.
Build Reliable, Scalable Systems
Ensure the Integrated Sensor platform is designed for reliability in demanding, real-world field environments.
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.
Collaborate Across the Company
Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for the Integrated Sensor product line.
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
High effectiveness and communication working in a remote and distributed team.
English proficiency is required.
IDEAL CANDIDATE
You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy developing people and organizations while remaining technically engaged enough to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.
You think across the entire system. You can connect hardware, embedded software, edge systems, cloud infrastructure, and data into a cohesive product architecture.
You prioritize impact. You understand that engineering exists to solve meaningful customer and business problems, and you focus teams on delivering measurable outcomes.
You operate with urgency and ownership. You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, removing obstacles, and driving issues to resolution.
You raise the bar. You establish clear standards for engineering quality, reliability, execution, and accountability—and consistently hold yourself and your team to them.
You develop people. You invest in coaching, feedback, career development, and creating opportunities for engineers to take on greater responsibility.
You balance speed with durability. You know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational work, and how to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs without accumulating unnecessary complexity.
You thrive in complexity. You are energized by systems that operate in the real world and understand that building reliable technology often requires solving problems across organizational and technical boundaries.
You communicate clearly. You can translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs for engineers, product leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You value transparency and collaboration. You actively seek input, give direct feedback, and build trust through clear communication and accountability.
You are curious and adaptable. You continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and look for better ways to build both technology and teams.
You are comfortable in a remote environment. You create clarity, alignment, and accountability across distributed teams without relying on proximity.
WHY GENLOGS
At GenLogs, you have the opportunity to build technology that operates at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our Integrated Sensor platform is foundational to our vision of creating ubiquitous visibility into the movement of commercial vehicles across the United States.
You will have a direct impact on the technology, people, and systems required to scale that network—and the opportunity to build an engineering organization capable of supporting one of the most ambitious sensing and intelligence platforms in freight.

Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.

blocks.text: Set Technical Direction

items: Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the Integrated Sensor product line across hardware, edge, and cloud systems.
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.

blocks.text: Drive Product Delivery

items: Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.

blocks.text: Build Reliable, Scalable Systems

items: Ensure the Integrated Sensor platform is designed for reliability in demanding, real-world field environments.
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.

blocks.text: Collaborate Across the Company

items: Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for the Integrated Sensor product line.
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.

blocks.text: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

items: 10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
High effectiveness and communication working in a remote and distributed team.
English proficiency is required.

blocks.text: IDEAL CANDIDATE

items: You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy developing people and organizations while remaining technically engaged enough to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.
You think across the entire system. You can connect hardware, embedded software, edge systems, cloud infrastructure, and data into a cohesive product architecture.
You prioritize impact. You understand that engineering exists to solve meaningful customer and business problems, and you focus teams on delivering measurable outcomes.
You operate with urgency and ownership. You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, removing obstacles, and driving issues to resolution.
You raise the bar. You establish clear standards for engineering quality, reliability, execution, and accountability—and consistently hold yourself and your team to them.
You develop people. You invest in coaching, feedback, career development, and creating opportunities for engineers to take on greater responsibility.
You balance speed with durability. You know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational work, and how to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs without accumulating unnecessary complexity.

You thrive in complexity. You are energized by systems that operate in the real world and understand that building reliable technology often requires solving problems across organizational and technical boundaries.
You communicate clearly. You can translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs for engineers, product leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You value transparency and collaboration. You actively seek input, give direct feedback, and build trust through clear communication and accountability.
You are curious and adaptable. You continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and look for better ways to build both technology and teams.
You are comfortable in a remote environment. You create clarity, alignment, and accountability across distributed teams without relying on proximity.

blocks.text: WHY GENLOGS

At GenLogs, you have the opportunity to build technology that operates at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our Integrated Sensor platform is foundational to our vision of creating ubiquitous visibility into the movement of commercial vehicles across the United States.

You will have a direct impact on the technology, people, and systems required to scale that network—and the opportunity to build an engineering organization capable of supporting one of the most ambitious sensing and intelligence platforms in freight.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering & Continuous Improvement
jobs.text:
🌱 Join Birdman and Help Build the Future of Manufacturing! 🌱
At Birdman, we develop plant-based foods and supplements that are better for people and the planet. We believe conscious nutrition can transform the way we live, consume, and shape the future. 💚
🏢 About Birdman
Over the past few years, Birdman has experienced rapid and sustained growth, becoming one of Latin America's leading plant-based food and supplement companies.
Our mission is to make healthy, sustainable, and cruelty-free nutrition accessible through innovative, science-backed, and high-quality products.
As we continue scaling our operations, we're looking for exceptional leaders who are passionate about operational excellence, innovation, and building world-class manufacturing capabilities.
🎯 The Role
We're looking for a Head of Engineering & Continuous Improvement to build and lead Birdman's Process Engineering and Project Engineering function.
This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving productivity, automation, manufacturing capacity, Lean transformation, and CAPEX projects across our operations. You'll partner closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, R&D, and Finance to ensure our facilities are ready to support Birdman's ambitious growth.
If you're excited about building systems, leading transformational projects, and creating lasting operational impact, we'd love to meet you.
⚙️ Responsibilities
Engineering & Continuous Improvement
Lead Process Engineering and Project Engineering teams.
Drive productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction initiatives across manufacturing.
Implement Lean Manufacturing methodologies including Kaizen, SMED, TPM, 5S, Standard Work, and Value Stream Mapping.
Improve OEE/OLE, reduce waste, changeover times, and manufacturing costs.
Develop operational KPIs and performance dashboards.
Capital Projects & Automation
Lead CAPEX projects from concept through commissioning.
Develop manufacturing capacity plans to support business growth.
Identify and implement automation opportunities.
Evaluate equipment investments and infrastructure improvements.
Manage project scope, budgets, timelines, risks, and startup activities.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, R&D, and Finance.
Prioritize engineering initiatives aligned with business strategy.
Build a culture of execution, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Develop and coach engineering teams while ensuring successful project delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About Mission Underwriting Services
At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.
What We Offer:
Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
Medical, Dental, Vision
401K, 401K Match
Life and Disability Benefits
Unaccrued Paid Time Off
11 Paid Holidays
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program
Educational Assistance Program
Employee Referral Program
Paid Parental Leave
Purpose:
We are a commercial insurance Program Administrator focused on building and scaling specialty Insurance Programs. As part of our next stage of growth, we are transitioning from reliance on third-party software and SaaS vendors toward developing and owning more of the technology that powers our business.
We are building a technology organization that combines deep insurance expertise with modern software development, data, automation, and artificial intelligence. Our goal is to create differentiated platforms and tools that improve underwriting, distribution, operations, program launch speed, portfolio management, and the overall experience of our brokers, carriers, and internal teams.
We are seeking an entrepreneurial and highly experienced Head of Product to lead the creation of our product organization and technology product strategy.
This person will be responsible for identifying the highest-value opportunities for technology, AI, data, and automation across the enterprise, translating those opportunities into a prioritized product roadmap, and building the teams and operating model required to execute it.
The Head of Product will work closely with the CEO, executive leadership, underwriting, claims, actuarial, operations, distribution, finance, legal, compliance, and engineering. The role will initially be both strategic and hands-on, requiring someone who can establish the product vision while also driving early product decisions, hiring, prioritization, and delivery.
The ideal candidate has experience in AI-enabled software development, enterprise or B2B product management, and building high-performing product teams. Experience in property and casualty insurance is strongly preferred.
This is an opportunity to build a product and technology organization at the foundation of a growing insurance company. The person in this role will have meaningful influence over the company’s future operating model, technology architecture, AI capabilities, customer experience, and competitive position.
The Head of Product will not simply manage an existing product portfolio. This individual will help define what the company becomes: a modern insurance Program Administrator with the technology, data, and AI capabilities to build and scale Programs more effectively than traditional market participants.
Essential Duties/Functions:
Product Strategy and Vision
Develop and lead the company’s overall internally built product strategy, as well as AI software strategy.
Establish a clear product vision aligned with the company’s business strategy and long-term competitive objectives.
Identify opportunities to replace, improve, or integrate third-party systems through internally developed technology.
Create a multi year product roadmap designed to implement agentic AI across all MGA's in the portfolio, through a combination of in house technology and vendors
Define the principles, governance, and decision-making processes that will guide product development.
Help determine which capabilities should be built internally, purchased, integrated, or developed through strategic partnerships and oversee operation of those related to AI.
Insurance and Business-Process Transformation
Develop a deep understanding of how our Programs are originated, designed, launched, underwritten, distributed, administered, and managed.
Partner with business leaders to identify the most important technology opportunities across the insurance lifecycle.
Develop tools and platforms that support underwriting workflows, submission management, appetite and eligibility decisions, pricing, portfolio oversight, broker engagement, reporting, and program administration.
Identify ways AI can improve decision-making, productivity, knowledge management, risk selection, service, and operational efficiency.
Artificial Intelligence and Data
Establish a practical and commercially focused AI product strategy.
Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for generative AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and decision-support tools.
Develop appropriate standards for data quality, model governance, security, privacy, explainability, and human oversight.
Work with engineering, data, underwriting, actuarial, legal, compliance, and risk leaders to move AI initiatives from experimentation into production.
Product Organization and Team Building
Build and lead a high-performing product organization, initially hiring key product leaders and individual contributors.
Define the appropriate product organization structure, including product management, product design, user research, data product management, and product operations.
Identify talented employees in existing departments who may be well suited for product roles and create effective pathways for their transition.
Executive and External Leadership
Serve as the senior executive voice for product strategy and technology-enabled business transformation.
Regularly communicate product priorities, progress, risks, and tradeoffs to the CEO, executive team, and Board as appropriate.
Help shape the company’s broader technology strategy in partnership with the Chief Technology Officer
During the first year, the Head of Product is expected to:
Assess the company’s existing systems, vendor relationships, data capabilities, workflows, and technology gaps.
Develop and secure alignment around a company-wide product and AI strategy.
Establish a prioritized product roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes.
Define the future product organization and begin hiring key team members.
Identify and launch a limited number of high-impact technology or AI initiatives.
Create the product management operating model and core development processes.
Establish clear criteria for build-versus-buy decisions.
Build strong working relationships with business leaders and transferred employees.
Demonstrate measurable progress in speed, efficiency, underwriting capability, distribution effectiveness, user experience, or program-launch capacity.
Required Qualifications:
Significant experience leading product management for software, technology, AI, data, or digital platforms.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling product organizations and teams.
Experience taking products from concept through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
Experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, analytics, or intelligent automation.
Experience translating complex business problems into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
Experience operating in a complex, regulated, or highly data-driven industry.
Strong executive communication, influencing, decision-making, and organizational leadership skills.
Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to operate strategically and tactically.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in property and casualty insurance, including underwriting, program administration, distribution, claims, actuarial, or insurance operations.
Experience with MGAs, Program Administrators, carriers, reinsurers, or insurance platforms.
Experience building products for commercial insurance or other complex B2B markets.
Experience building products subject to regulatory, privacy, security, model-risk, or compliance requirements.
Experience managing product teams during a period of rapid growth or organizational transformation.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
The successful candidate will be:
A builder who enjoys creating teams, processes, and products from an early stage.
Commercially minded and able to connect technology investments to business results.
Comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve and not every answer is known in advance.
Credible with both technical professionals and insurance executives.
Curious about how insurance works and motivated by the opportunity to improve it.
Decisive, analytical, collaborative, and highly accountable.
Capable of balancing long-term platform development with near-term business needs.
Focused on practical AI adoption, not simply experimentation or industry hype.
An excellent communicator who can create alignment across departments.
Energized by the opportunity to help shape the future of the company.
The Head of Product will report to the Chief Executive Officer and will work closely with the executive leadership team and leaders across underwriting, distribution, operations, actuarial, claims, finance, legal, compliance, engineering, and data.
Working Conditions:
Requires a quiet work environment with regular sitting at a computer for extended periods of time.
Occasional walking and standing, and lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Regular use of hands and fingers.
Frequent talking or hearing.
Vision requirements: Close, distance, color, peripheral, focus and depth perception.
Additional Information
This is a remote position. Planned, in-office activities may be required on occasion (typically 2-4x per year).
You must live in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States without requirement of employmentsponsorship/visa.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An Overview of this Role
As Director, Data Science, you'll lead GitLab's Product, Sales, and Finance Data Science teams and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You have two mandates:
Make Data Science a driver of growth. Connect the team's work to GitLab's biggest priorities: supporting product innovation, making sure what we launch is improved and scaled with data, improving product adoption through our GTM motions, and growing the consumption business. Make sure the work changes decisions at the executive level.
Set the bar for great data science. Define what makes a great Data Scientist at GitLab, from business partnership to technical rigor, and develop managers who build teams where everyone shows up to that standard.
You lead through your managers with an overall team size of 12 including data scientists and analysts, ensuring direction with the team across the data organization, and staying close enough to the work to pressure-test the analyses and models that matter most.
What you’ll do
Build trusted relationships with executives across Product, Finance, and GTM, and act as their thought partner, shaping the questions the business should be asking, not just answering them
Own investment and prioritization across teams: decide where Data Science spends its time, and make trade-offs visible to senior leaders
Lead high-impact, cross-functional programs, such as driving new product adoption and growing our consumption business, from strategy through measurable business impact
Coach and mentor managers and senior ICs to grow as leaders, building succession and a bench of future leaders
Hold a high talent bar, and make sure every teammate grows into a trusted thought partner in their area
Set org-wide standards for metric definition, causal inference, and predictive modeling, and the role of AI in each
Build a high-trust culture of urgency, accountability, and open communication, and act on engagement and feedback across teams
Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and other data teams across the company to solve data opportunities together, aligned on a shared data and AI roadmap
What you’ll bring
12+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, including 6+ years leading teams and 3+ years managing managers in B2B SaaS or tech
Track record of building and scaling a data science or analytics organization that executives treat as a strategic partner
Strong business acumen across product and go-to-market, with experience connecting data work to revenue and growth outcomes
Executive presence: communicates complex findings and trade-offs clearly to the C-suite, and coaches managers to do the same
Deep expertise in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, with enough technical depth in SQL, Python, and ML to guide and pressure-test the team's work
Clear point of view on how AI is reshaping data science and analytics, and experience leading teams through that shift
Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model and coach GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values
Nice to Have
Experience with developer tools, DevSecOps, or product-led growth products
Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models
Experience merging or restructuring data science and analytics teams
Thought leadership in data science or analytics, internally and externally
Advanced degree in a quantitative field
About the Team
Data Science at GitLab brings Data Science and Analytics together into one function. jobs.title: VP, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 100 million monthly active users across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.
Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
Our Infrastructure Operating Group owns the platforms, systems, and tooling that Life360’s engineering, product, and design teams build on every day, from build/deploy pipelines and internal tools to the reliability behind an app that tens of millions of families trust with their safety. We treat infrastructure as a competitive advantage, not a cost center: our real product is the velocity at which we can build a great experience for our members, so we obsess over developer experience and the systems that they build on, including the move to AI-native ways of working.
We hold ourselves to a high standard of craft and have direct, honest conversations about quality, scope, and trade-offs because we care about building things that last. Life360 is scaling fast, and this team will be at the center of that growth, unlocking what the rest of the company can build, including the next wave of AI-powered features.
About the Job
We’re looking for an experienced VP of Infrastructure Engineering to lead the platform, systems, and infrastructure organization behind Life360’s products. You’ll shape our technical strategy to scale reliably toward our 2028 goals of 150M monthly active users and $1B+ in revenue, and help the engineering organization adopt AI-native ways of working.
What You'll Do
While this is a leadership role and we expect you to be well-rounded across all areas, the specific areas of emphasis will be on the following pillars:
Strategic Leadership – Define, communicate, and execute an infrastructure vision in partnership with your functional counterparts that complements Life360's broader goals. Align infrastructure investment with business objectives in close collaboration with the executive team.
Developer Productivity & Enablement – Build the build/deploy pipelines, internal tooling, and self-service platforms that let engineering, product, and design teams ship faster — including AI-powered capabilities — without compromising security, privacy, or cost discipline. Bring firsthand experience helping an organization move toward AI-native ways of working, whether you drove that shift or were a meaningful part of it.
Reliability & Scalability – Keep infrastructure scaling securely and cost-effectively as user growth and workload complexity increase. Uptime, latency, observability, and disaster recovery are non-negotiables for systems serving tens of millions of families.
Team Leadership & Culture – Recruit, mentor, and grow a world-class infrastructure and platform engineering team. Act as a strong voice for engineering craft and culture, and foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional Alignment – Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science/ML, Security, and Product leaders to plan and execute strategic infrastructure initiatives, including the compute and platform needs that support AI-powered features.
What We're Looking For
A degree in Computer Science or a related field.
A seasoned infrastructure/platform engineering leader with a track record of building stellar teams.
Many years of experience leading large-scale infrastructure or platform engineering organizations, including leading through managers or directors.
Deep technical fluency in distributed systems and cloud architecture.
A track record of scaling infrastructure for consumer products at massive scale — from iterative reliability improvements to big-bet platform investments.
Direct experience with, or meaningful involvement in, an organization's shift toward AI-native ways of working. Leading it isn't required, but you've seen it from the inside.
A bias for speed — constantly pushing to try new things, and learning quickly from what doesn't work to find what does.
Strong instincts for data — comfortable digging into cost, performance, and reliability metrics to spot what's working and what isn't, and using KPIs on reliability and cost efficiency to guide decisions.
A background at companies known for engineering excellence and resilient, high-performing platforms.
Strategic thinking paired with strong storytelling — the ability to motivate and inspire a team around a shared technical vision.
A genuine conviction that robust, well-designed infrastructure is a competitive differentiator — the invisible foundation that makes great user experiences possible.
A hands-on approach — comfortable delegating, but ultimately owns everything the team ships.
A reputation for having tough, direct conversations while staying kind and respectful.
Comfort with risk-taking and big swings, and making decisions with incomplete information.
Alignment with our values: Be a Good Person; Be Direct, with Respect; Members Before Metrics; High Intensity, High Impact.
Nice to Have
Exposure to the infrastructure demands of AI-powered products (for example, supporting inference or ML workloads) and comfort operating in the fast-moving AI landscape.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
Paid parental leave
401(k) plan with company matching program
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers
Life360 Values
Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Belonging
Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.title: Director, Data Science & Engineering, Finance
jobs.text:
Role Description
This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of data science, data engineering, finance, and AI. As Director, Data Science & Data Engineering for Finance, you will lead a small, high-impact team that enables Finance to make better decisions through trusted data, robust analytical systems, applied modeling, and increasingly AI-powered capabilities.
You will manage two direct reports: a data scientist and a data engineer. Together, the team supports the financial organization across recurring business operations, driver-model maintenance, knowledge coordination, analytical insights, and the development and operationalization of AI and machine-learning use cases. The role requires enough technical depth to guide both disciplines, while maintaining a clear focus on business outcomes, reliability, and team growth.
You will partner closely with Finance leadership, Engineering, Data, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish priorities, improve the quality and accessibility of financial data, and shape a forward-looking roadmap. You will be expected to move the team beyond request-driven execution: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, clarifying the problems worth solving, and creating the operating mechanisms needed to deliver durable impact.
This is an opportunity to shape how Finance uses data and AI at a time when the underlying technologies, operating models, and expectations are changing quickly. The successful candidate will bring a growth mindset, a strong background in either data science or data engineering, and the ability to lead effectively across both disciplines.
Responsibilities
Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team: Lead, coach, and develop a data scientist and a data engineer, creating clear expectations, meaningful development plans, effective delegation, and a strong culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Set the team’s strategy and priorities: Translate Finance and company goals into a focused portfolio of work. Prioritize ruthlessly across strategic initiatives, recurring operational responsibilities, model maintenance, knowledge coordination, and technical debt.
Provide technical leadership across data science and data engineering: Guide problem framing, analytical and modeling approaches, data architecture, pipeline quality, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. You do not need to be the deepest expert in both disciplines, but you must be able to ask the right questions, recognize trade-offs, and raise the technical bar.
Advance AI and modeling capabilities: Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to Finance workflows. Establish appropriate standards for experimentation, evaluation, interpretability, human oversight, privacy, and ongoing monitoring.
Build trusted data foundations: Partner with data engineering and Finance stakeholders to improve source-of-truth datasets, data quality, lineage, observability, documentation, and reliability. Ensure that recurring reporting, driver models, and downstream analyses are based on accurate and well-governed data.
Own analytical and modeling outcomes: Ensure the team develops, maintains, evaluates, and improves models and analyses that support financial planning, forecasting, business-driver understanding, and decision-making. Connect technical work to measurable business outcomes rather than treating model delivery as the finish line.
Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend.
Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Present implications, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables timely decisions.
Partner across functions: Work effectively with Finance leaders, analysts, data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, product partners, and executives. Seek diverse perspectives, lead productive debate, and align stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.
Improve the team’s scope and effectiveness: Look continuously for ways to eliminate low-value work, automate recurring tasks, improve service levels, and increase the team’s strategic contribution. When the current operating model is insufficient, make the case for change and lead the team through it
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Significant experience applying data science, machine learning, analytics, data engineering, or a combination of these disciplines to business problems.
Experience directly managing and developing technical professionals, ideally including both data scientists and data engineers or closely adjacent roles.
A strong professional foundation in either data science or data engineering, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across the other discipline.
Experience leading a portfolio of projects from problem definition through delivery, adoption, measurement, and ongoing operation.
Experience with data quality, data pipelines, analytical datasets, model development or maintenance, experimentation or evaluation, and production or operational support.
Demonstrated ability to use data and technology to influence business decisions and deliver measurable impact.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, uncertainty, and trade-offs to Finance and executive audiences.
Demonstrated growth mindset: actively seeks feedback, learns new technologies and domains, adapts to changing conditions, and creates an environment where the team does the same.
Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting Finance, financial planning and analysis, forecasting, corporate strategy, accounting, or other business functions with high standards for accuracy and control.
Experience building or scaling AI/ML capabilities, including generative AI, predictive modeling, model evaluation, workflow automation, or AI-assisted decision support.
Experience managing a hybrid or multidisciplinary team spanning data science, analytics, data engineering, or software engineering.
Experience building 0-to-1 capabilities, establishing new operating models, or transforming a team from reactive execution to proactive partnership.
Experience with data governance, observability, model risk management, responsible AI, or other practices that support reliable and auditable business decisions.
Experience working in a technology company or other complex, data-rich environment.
Durable Skills
AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:
Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
Compensation
US Zone 1
This role is not available in Zone 1
US Zone 2
$228,400—$309,000 USD
US Zone 3
$203,000—$274,600 USD

Own analytical and modeling outcomes: Ensure the team develops, maintains, evaluates, and improves models and analyses that support financial planning, forecasting, business-driver understanding, and decision-making. Connect technical work to measurable business outcomes rather than treating model delivery as the finish line.

Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend.

Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Present implications, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables timely decisions.

Partner across functions: Work effectively with Finance leaders, analysts, data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, product partners, and executives. Seek diverse perspectives, lead productive debate, and align stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.

Improve the team’s scope and effectiveness: Look continuously for ways to eliminate low-value work, automate recurring tasks, improve service levels, and increase the team’s strategic contribution. When the current operating model is insufficient, make the case for change and lead the team through it

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Platforms
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An Overview of This Role
As Director of Product, SaaS Platforms, you'll own the product direction and business outcomes for GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) environments: GitLab.com, our multi-tenant platform, and GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant offering. You'll connect reliability, scalability, and operability with the commercial decisions that make these platforms sustainable businesses.
Your scope spans both platforms, not a single feature roadmap. On GitLab.com, you'll guide growth through better customer isolation and additional cells, alongside rate limits, usage limits, and monetization. On GitLab Dedicated, you'll help scale it to hundreds of customers through automation, customer self-service, and closer alignment with GitLab's latest releases. You'll balance customer needs with operating costs and gross margin.
This director-level role starts as an individual contributor. It's remote and open to candidates based in the United States or Canada, with no specific time zone preference.
What You'll Do
Set the product strategy and roadmap across GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, connecting platform capabilities to customer and business outcomes.
Drive improvements in platform reliability, scalability, and operability, including better separation between customers and expansion of GitLab.com's cell-based architecture.
Define GitLab.com's rate limits, usage limits, and related monetization approach.
Scale GitLab Dedicated through maintenance-window automation and other operational improvements, while controlling costs and improving gross margin.
Expand customer self-service through Switchboard, giving customers tools to monitor, observe, and operate their Dedicated tenants.
Guide capabilities such as customer-initiated disaster recovery and geographic redundancy, and enable earlier access to beta features on GitLab Dedicated.
Reduce the delay between GitLab releases and their availability on Dedicated.
Own the business side of the portfolio as well as the technical product direction, developing profit and loss (P&L) ownership for both platforms and helping establish GitLab.com as a P&L business.
What You'll Bring
Experience leading a product portfolio at director level or with comparable scope, setting direction across multiple related products rather than a single roadmap.
Technical product experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure, or SaaS environments, including the tradeoffs involved in reliability, scalability, and operations.
The ability to connect product decisions to commercial outcomes, including monetization, operating costs, and gross margin.
Experience translating complex platform challenges into product priorities and working across teams to deliver them.
The ability to lead through product direction and influence in a director-level individual contributor role.
Direct ownership of a product P&L is particularly valuable. Experience in an organization actively adopting artificial intelligence (AI) would also be helpful.
About the Team
The SaaS platform portfolio brings together GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated. The work spans shared-platform growth, single-tenant operations, and the tools customers use to manage their environments. The challenge is to improve the customer experience and platform capabilities while building a scalable, financially sustainable operating model for each offering.
At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings together development, security, and operations, helping teams collaborate throughout software delivery.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$203,200—$345,600 USD

jobs.title: Engineering Director- AI Products
jobs.text:
Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. We are a fast growing, dynamic business with a global customer base of more than 30,000 and a team of over 300 in the USA, Australia, UK, Canada, New Zealand and LATAM.
The Actionstep Engineering team contributes to developing, maintaining, and running Actionstep through the delivery of industry leading technology, operations, and analysis. Actionstep Engineering consists of squads of cross-discipline software engineers, analysts and product experts who work collaboratively to enhance Actionstep software for our customers.
How we build
Every team at Actionstep builds with AI as part of the development lifecycle. Engineers and product managers decide what gets built, write the specs, and review and own what ships, while AI agents do much of the building and testing. We treat the harness, i.e. the tooling, context and review checkpoints our teams build with, as a product in its own right. We measure delivery on one scoreboard that reads throughput beside quality, so speed never gets counted without quality next to it.
Our platform runs on TypeScript services, React micro-frontends and a shared design system, on AWS across multiple regions.
Our Product Development teams work across North America, the UK and Asia-Pacific. Each team works within one time-zone band, so its members share a working day. This role leads teams in both North America and Asia-Pacific.
Engineering Director – AI Products
AI Products owns the AI features built into our products along with the AI, data and workflow capabilities that the power our platform, such as agents, open APIs and MCP, search, analytics and workflow automation.
You lead several teams through their engineering managers, and work alongside a product lead and product managers for each area.
Location -- Denver, Colorado (hybrid).
In this role, you will:
Lead through managers -- you set direction, standards and priorities for a group of teams, and grow the managers who run them.
Ship AI to production -- you work with product to turn the AI roadmap into features firms use every day, with permissions, privacy and audit built in.
Build shared platform capabilities -- you make sure agents, APIs, search, data and workflow work reliably for every Actionstep product.
Run AI responsibly and efficiently -- you build evaluation, observability and cost discipline into how AI features are designed and run.
Raise the bar on how we build -- you bring every team in the group onto our AI development lifecycle and make delivery predictable.
Lead across time zones -- you run a group split between North America and Asia-Pacific, which means some early or late calls.
Other Responsibilities:
Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required

jobs.title: Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product​
jobs.text:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
Why this role matters:
BSS Engineering and Product is a critical enabler of Vonage's commercial platform, ensuring our business support systems are scalable, reliable, commercially aligned, and able to support growth across products, regions, and customer segments. As Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product, you will lead the global BSS function across engineering ownership, product direction, platform strategy, and delivery for billing, rating, provisioning, ordering, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations.
Your key responsibilities:
BSS Engineering Leadership
Lead the global BSS engineering organization, owning architecture, delivery, quality, resilience, technical standards, and platform performance across core BSS systems
Define engineering practices across solution design, integration, release management, test automation, observability, and technical debt management
Ensure BSS platforms support scale, availability, security, compliance, and the needs of a multi-product, multi-region commercial model.
BSS Product Ownership & Roadmap
Own the BSS product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing capabilities against commercial, customer, operational, regulatory, and finance needs
Translate business requirements into a clear product backlog across billing, rating, mediation, ordering, CPQ, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations
Establish governance, prioritization forums, success measures, and communication rhythms, including the use of AI-enabled insight and automation to improve delivery, decision-making, and platform optimisation.
Team Leadership & Operating Cadence
Lead and develop a global BSS Engineering and Product team, including engineering managers, product owners, platform leads, architects, and delivery specialists
Run an effective operating cadence across roadmap planning, delivery governance, platform health, stakeholder prioritisation, risk management, and product delivery progress
Build organisational capability through hiring, succession planning, team structure design, globally distributed delivery, and practical AI enablement across engineering and product ways of working.
What you'll bring:
Required:
Senior BSS engineering and product leadership experience in global telecommunications, CPaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise SaaS
Deep BSS domain expertise, including platforms such as Amdocs, Oracle Communications, CSGi, NetCracker, Zuora, Optiva, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent
Experience leading BSS platform delivery, including migrations, integrations, data improvement, release planning, and API-led or cloud-native architectures where appropriate
Strong product ownership capability, with experience translating commercial, finance, regulatory, operational, and customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes
Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, product, architecture, and delivery teams in a matrixed environment, with a track record of using AI, automation, or data-driven tooling to improve productivity, quality, and platform outcomes.
Experience we consider a plus:
Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or Tier 1/Tier 2 telecommunications
Experience with API monetisation, partner billing, usage-based charging, subscription management, or digital self-service.
How you'll benefit
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
401(k)
Ericsson Care Line
Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)
Volunteer Time (VTO)
Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.
US Pay Transparency
$240,000—$318,000 USD
There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.
To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.
Who we are:
Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.
Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

jobs.title: Director of Geotechnical Engineering
jobs.text:
Description
Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.
We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.
Job description
Location: United States | Remote/Hybrid | Approximately 40% domestic travel
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role
Exodigo is seeking a Director of Geotechnical Engineering to lead U.S. geotechnical engineering standards, quality, and technical credibility. This senior role combines engineering leadership with customer engagement, helping infrastructure owners, contractors, and engineering consultants understand and trust Exodigo’s subsurface intelligence technology.
The ideal candidate is an experienced geotechnical engineer with strong industry relationships and expertise in complex civil infrastructure, particularly tunnels, bridges, and transportation projects. You will partner with Sales as a technical advisor while working across Product, R&D, Operations, and Project Management to translate engineering needs into product requirements and ensure reliable, defensible deliverables.
Key Responsibilities
Build industry trust: Represent Exodigo’s geotechnical expertise with infrastructure owners, DOTs, contractors, and engineering consultants; communicate the technology’s value, accuracy, and limitations.
Support customers and Sales: Lead technical discussions, presentations, and proposals, addressing engineering challenges and demonstrating real-world applications.
Own technical standards and quality: Translate customer requirements and industry standards into engineering specifications, acceptance criteria, QA processes, and consistent delivery practices.
Provide engineering oversight: Review geotechnical deliverables and serve as the responsible engineering sign-off authority.
Connect engineering and product: Partner with Product and R&D to align customer needs with product capabilities and development priorities.
Improve project delivery: Work with U.S. Project Management, Operations, and CAD/BIM teams to standardize workflows and maintain consistent quality nationwide.
Requirements
• B.S. in Civil Engineering with a geotechnical specialization; M.S. strongly preferred.
• 10–15 years of progressive geotechnical engineering experience in U.S. civil infrastructure and/or construction.
• Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to obtain additional licensure as needed.
• Demonstrated track record authoring formal engineering requirement documents (PRDs, design basis documents, technical specifications) and translating market needs into user stories / acceptance criteria.
• Deep working knowledge of DOT (AASHTO, FHWA, state DOT) and ASCE standards; strong familiarity with ASTM and USACE geotechnical practice.
• Solid understanding of engineering and geotechnical formats, including common solutions, methodologies, and industry work practices
• Basic technological understanding of current tools and approaches used in engineering and geotechnical fields
• Ability to read, interpret, and analyze geological, geotechnical, and civil engineering reports
• Substantial client-facing experience: scoping, presenting, negotiating technical approaches with owners, DOTs, and contractors; acting as voice of the customer internally.
• Experience leading delivery organizations that include field operators, OPS, QA, and CAD/BIM/infrastructure engineers.
• Hands-on experience running agile/structured delivery using tools such as Monday, Jira, Slack, and Gantt-based planning.
• Advanced proficiency in drafting documents, proposals, and strategic plans, with meticulous attention to detail to ensure clarity, accuracy, and effective coordination of all requirements and applications
• Proven collaboration with business functions on strategy, pricing, and marketing in a technical B2B context.
• U.S. work authorization; willingness to travel domestically to project sites (estimated 25–40%).
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience leading delivery for productized geotechnical solutions (instrumentation, monitoring, sensing, specialty foundations, ground improvement, etc.).
• Prior role as a technical/delivery lead on major DOT or large-scale infrastructure projects.
• Active participation in ASCE Geo-Institute, TRB committees, or DFI technical committees.
• Experience working in a growth-stage company environment with cross-functional business exposure.
Salary: $160,000 - $260,000 depending on experience and geographic location.
Location: Remote (NYC / LA preferred)
Exodigo encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants without regard to characteristics protected under applicable federal, state, or local law, including race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.
Learn more
Why Join Us
Opportunity to shape sales strategy and make a direct impact on company growt
Exposure to cutting-edge solutions transforming digital infrastructure and data center development
Collaborative, no-ego team environment focused on customer impact
Remote-first culture with flexibility and autonomy
Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.
You can learn more about us on our website or check out this short video.
Apply on our careers page, via Linkedin or send your resume to
