jobs.title: VP of Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
jobs.text:
About Mozn
MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.
We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.
If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.
About the role
We are looking for a VP of Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead the team that takes MOZN's AI into production inside our clients' organizations. Our forward-deployed engineers and data scientists work embedded with government and enterprise clients across Saudi Arabia, from the first problem definition to a system that people use every day. Not a handoff. Not a slide deck.
You will lead a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and data scientists, own delivery outcomes across our most important engagements, and turn what we learn in the field into repeatable playbooks and platform improvements. The role suits a leader who has run customer-facing solutions, delivery or engineering teams, stays close to the technical work, and is comfortable in the room with senior client stakeholders.
What you'll do
Leadership & Organization
Build, lead and scale a multidisciplinary forward-deployed organization spanning software engineering, data science and AI.
Hire, develop and retain exceptional engineers, data scientists and technical leaders; set clear expectations, career paths and a high bar for quality.
Define the operating model: how teams are staffed on engagements, how work is prioritized, and how delivery is measured.
Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and accountability for client outcomes.
Delivery & Client Outcomes
Own the end-to-end delivery of AI solutions across government and enterprise engagements, from problem framing and solution design through production deployment and adoption.
Ensure solutions reach production and are used: define success metrics with clients and hold the team to them.
Lead escalations, unblock delivery risks and make sound trade-offs between scope, quality and timelines.
Partner with Sales and Presales to shape engagements, scope solutions realistically and ensure a smooth transition from presales to delivery.
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating business and mission priorities into practical AI solutions.
Navigate client procurement, security, data-governance and approval processes on the path to production.
Represent MOZN's delivery capability in executive discussions, workshops and steering committees.
Technical Direction & Standards
Set technical standards for architecture, integration, security and quality across deployments, including on-premise, private cloud and restricted environments.
Stay close to the technical work: review architectures and solution designs, and step in on the hardest problems.
Ensure deployed AI systems are secure, reliable, monitored and maintainable after go-live.
Playbooks & Product Feedback
Turn field experience into repeatable deployment playbooks, reusable components and accelerators.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to feed client needs back into the MOZN AI Platform and roadmap.
Track delivery performance and report regularly to senior leadership on outcomes, risks and capacity.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; a Master's degree is a plus.
8-12+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, professional services, technical delivery or software engineering, with significant experience in a leadership role.
Proven track record of building and leading technical delivery teams of engineers and/or data scientists that delivered solutions into client organizations.
Demonstrated ownership of complex technology deployments from solution design through production go-live and adoption, ideally including AI, machine learning or data platforms.
Strong technical foundation across software architecture, systems integration, data and AI/ML, with the credibility to review designs and guide engineers on hard problems.
Experience delivering for government, public sector, defense or other highly regulated clients, including working through procurement, security and compliance requirements.
Experience deploying solutions in on-premise, private cloud or restricted environments.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior client leaders.
Professional fluency in Arabic and English.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Deployment Strategist, Applied AI or similar customer-embedded engineering role.
Experience building a team, practice or function from scratch, or founding or scaling a technology company.
Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLM-based solutions in production, including RAG, agents and evaluation.
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering to turn field delivery into reusable platform capabilities.
Familiarity with Saudi data, cybersecurity and AI governance requirements.
Benefits
You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.
You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI.
We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Cloud & Reliability
jobs.text:
Who is Boulevard?
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.
Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.
We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations.
You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth.
Domains of Ownership
Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code
DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery
Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools
Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services
Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices
Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles
Key Projects & Initiatives
EKS Migration & Containerization: Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture
Multi-Region DR Implementation: Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures
CI/CD Pipeline Transformation: Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments
Advanced Observability: Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution
Security Framework: Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements
Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution: Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities
Database Scaling: Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture
What you'll do here:
Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows
Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives
Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices
Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance
Compliance Management: Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls
What you'll need to thrive:
10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers
Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform
Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures
Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation
Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery
Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies
Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives

Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

jobs.title: SVP, Data Science & AI Product Enablement
jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About Monks
Monks is a global digital marketing and data company within the S4 Capital Group, helping the world's most ambitious brands grow through the integration of data, content, media, and technology. We combine the strategic depth of a top-tier analytical consultancy with the speed of a digitally native operating organization, serving diverse clients across the rapidly growing S4 Capital network, every sector, market, and channel.
About Data Science and AI Product Enablement
Data Science and AI Product Enablement brings together Monks' advanced analytics and AI product capabilities in North America. The function pairs market-leading data science — predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality testing, and optimization — with the engineering, product, and solution consulting needed to turn that intelligence into AI-powered products, automation, and agentic workflows.
It is a core engine of Monks' full-service product roadmap and its AI transformation agenda for brands.
The Role
The SVP, Data Science and AI Product Enablement will lead the strategy, growth, and delivery of Monks' data science and AI product practice across North America.
This leader will own the vision for how advanced analytics and AI become scalable products and client solutions — from discovery and solution design through build, deployment, and adoption — and will be accountable for the commercial performance, talent, and market reputation of the practice.
As a senior executive, the SVP will partner with Media, Creative, Strategy, Growth, and Technology Services leadership to embed data science and AI across the full-service offering, shape the integrated product roadmap, and position Monks as the agency partner of choice for AI transformation in marketing.
Location: New York preferred; candidates based in Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Denver will also be considered.
Salary Range: $225,000–$275,000 USD annually
Key Responsibilities
Practice Leadership & P&L Ownership
Own the P&L for the Data Science and AI Product Enablement practice, including revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, and investment decisions.
Establish the operating rhythm, business plan, and resourcing model needed to scale the practice profitably.
Growth & New Business
Drive revenue growth across existing clients and new business opportunities.
Lead and support senior-level pitches, shape AI and data science propositions, and partner with Growth teams to convert market demand into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
Client Leadership & Executive Sponsorship
Serve as the senior executive sponsor for strategic clients, including CMOs, CDOs, and CIOs.
Lead critical client engagements, including AI transformation roadmaps, quarterly business reviews, escalations, and renewal decisions.
Build strong, referenceable, multi-capability client relationships.
Delivery Economics & Commercial Models
Set standards for scoping, pricing, and delivery quality across the practice.
Develop value-based, product-led, and subscription commercial models, leveraging AI-accelerated delivery to improve margins and cost-to-serve.
Partner with Finance and Resource Management on capacity planning and investment decisions.
Organizational Leadership
Lead, scale, and develop a multidisciplinary organization of data scientists, AI and full-stack engineers, solution consultants, and product leaders.
Build a strong leadership bench, design effective team structures, and foster an inclusive, high-performance culture.
Data Science & AI Strategy
Define the vision and roadmap for data science and AI across the North America practice, aligned with Monks' global Data and Media strategy.
Lead the evolution of the advanced analytics portfolio, including predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality, optimization, and causal inference, and its integration with generative and agentic AI.
Establish methodological standards and quality controls to ensure models and AI systems are rigorous, explainable, and trusted by clients.
Champion responsible AI practices, including governance, evaluation, data privacy, and compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
AI Product Development & Enablement
Own the AI product roadmap for the practice and its integration into Monks' broader full-service product roadmap.
Lead the development of reusable AI and data science products, accelerators, and platforms that deliver measurable business value.
Build a forward-deployed delivery model that takes solutions from client discovery and prototyping through production deployment and adoption.
Define product requirements, prioritization, and success metrics in partnership with Engineering, Technology Services, and client teams.
Drive adoption of AI products across client engagements and internal workflows, with clear measures of business impact.
Cross-Functional Integration
Partner with Media, Creative, Content, Strategy, and Growth leadership to embed data science and AI into integrated client offerings.
Shape how analytics and AI products support media planning, creative optimization, content performance, and measurement.
Serve as a senior leader in agency-wide AI transformation initiatives and internal capability building.
Partnerships & Ecosystem
Lead senior relationships with platform and technology partners such as Google, Meta, Amazon, Adobe, Microsoft, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
Develop co-innovation, co-development, and go-to-market initiatives that strengthen Monks' offerings.
Evaluate build, buy, and partner decisions for AI tooling, models, and data infrastructure.
Thought Leadership & Innovation
Represent Monks externally as a recognized voice in marketing science, AI products, and AI transformation through conferences, publications, and industry engagements.
Stay ahead of emerging developments in AI, machine learning, agentic systems, and marketing technology, translating innovation into practice strategy.
Foster a culture of experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous innovation, with a clear path from pilot to scalable product.
Required Qualifications
15+ years of experience in data science, marketing analytics, AI, or data product leadership within an agency, consultancy, holding company, marketing technology company, or large-scale in-house organization.
Proven P&L ownership of a data, analytics, or AI practice, with a track record of profitable growth.
Experience leading the development and commercialization of data science or AI products, from strategy through launch and adoption.
Demonstrated success building and leading large, multidisciplinary teams spanning data science, engineering, product, and consulting.
Executive-level client leadership experience, including C-suite sponsorship and growth of strategic accounts into multi-capability engagements.
Deep understanding of advanced analytics methodologies, including predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality, and causal inference.
Strong technical understanding of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and production deployment.
Commercial fluency in statements of work (SOWs), value-based pricing, product and subscription models, and procurement negotiations.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to executive, technical, and creative audiences.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a credible leader with internal executive leadership and global stakeholders.
Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
Quantifiable track record of scaling practices or portfolios, with demonstrated revenue growth and margin improvement.
Experience launching AI or data products at enterprise or industry scale, with measurable client adoption and business impact.
Experience building forward-deployed engineering or solution consulting functions.
Senior-level partnerships with major technology platforms and AI model providers, including co-development or joint go-to-market initiatives.
Experience leading enterprise AI transformation programs for major brands.
Industry expertise

The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.

Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network

Salary Range:
$225,000—$275,000 USD
About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms, you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients.
Requirements
Responsibilities
Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals.
Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs.
Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting.
Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization.
Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
Proven experience in designing and implementing dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or similar.
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and modern data stacks.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and SQL proficiency.
Ability to design scalable data architectures and optimize performance across systems.
Demonstrated ability to set up data tracking and analytics for digital transformation use cases.
Soft Skills:
Excellent spoken and written English; able to work closely with international clients.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business goals and turn them into data solutions.
Comfortable leading discovery sessions, presenting insights, and defining success metrics with clients.
Clear, structured communicator who can explain data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Organized and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
Highlights
Lead the data strategy behind impactful digital transformation projects, translating business goals into measurable outcomes through smart KPIs, clear dashboards, and scalable data architecture.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
We are evolving from a widely-used screen recorder into an AI-first learning and collaboration platform, and we’re looking for a hands-on VP of Engineering to join our leadership team and help shape what’s next. As we expand into new markets and invest in product-led growth, you'll lead a small high-performing engineering team, set technical direction, drive AI initiatives, and partner closely with Product to deliver our vision. This is an opportunity for an experienced SaaS engineering leader who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment, combines strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, and knows how to leverage a lean team and AI to drive business growth.
What you'll do:
Lead a small high-performing Engineering team across multiple product areas and platforms.
Set technical direction and partner closely with Product leadership to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and deliver on business goals.
Champion AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Shape our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Drive engineering excellence through scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Partnerships - Tech, Finance, Auto
jobs.text:
Who We Are
The Vox Media Group consists of New York Magazine, the Vox Media Podcast Network, and Vox.com. Reaching a monthly audience of tens of millions across audio, video, digital, print and social platforms, our media brands and talent spark conversations and shape culture, covering everything from politics, technology, and business to food, travel, fashion, sports, entertainment, and more.
As a Senior Director, Partnerships, you will be a senior revenue contributor responsible for expanding high-value relationships and driving new business growth across New York Magazine, the Vox Media Podcast Network, and Vox.com. You will serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior brand marketers and agencies, delivering innovative editorial, podcast and talent solutions that connect brands with highly engaged, intellectually curious communities at scale.
Leveraging Vox Media Group's premium properties to build partnerships that drive measurable business outcomes, this role demands a consultative mindset, strong relationship-building skills, the ability to influence at senior levels of marketing organizations, and a relentless drive to grow revenue in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.
What You'll Do
Lead Strategic Growth: Develop and execute a long-term revenue strategy to expand business with existing and new clients across the Vox Media Group, with an emphasis on New York Magazine portfolio of digital brands.
Cultivate Executive-Level Relationships: Build and deepen relationships with senior decision-makers at major companies and their agencies — CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Heads of Demand Generation and Brand — positioning Vox Media as a go-to strategic partner for investment spanning audio, video, digital, social, talent and experiential.
Proactive Market Engagement: Identify industry trends, evolving buyer behaviors, and client challenges within the categories including (but not limited to) B2B and Consumer Technology, Financial Services and Automotive, proactively delivering cross-platform editorial, podcast and talent solutions before RFPs are issued.
Consultative Sales Leadership: Translate client objectives into high-impact campaigns using our podcasts, editorial brands, host talent, video, social and live event capabilities.
Revenue Accountability: Own forecasting, pipeline development, and quarterly and annual sales targets, with full accountability for results and strategic account planning.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with editorial, marketing, creative, production and operations teams to deliver custom, culturally resonant proposals that reflect how B2B and Consumer Technology, Financial Services and Automotive brands communicate with their audiences.
Brand Advocacy: Represent Vox Media Group at key industry events, conferences, and client forums to expand our presence and thought leadership.
Who You Are
Proven Media Seller: 10+ years of digital media sales experience with a demonstrated track record of success in the B2B and/or Consumer Technology, Financial Services, and/or Automotive categories. This is a NYC based role.
Strategic Dealmaker: Skilled in complex, consultative sales to senior marketing executives and agency leadership, with experience securing large-scale, integrated partnerships.
Advocate for Premium Content: Deep understanding of the power of editorially-driven, culturally impactful media brands (like New York Magazine) and influential talent (Vox Media Podcast Network), and of how to leverage that power to benefit advertising partners.
Visionary & Entrepreneurial: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and client needs before they surface.
Influential Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade at the highest levels of a client organization. Ability to think critically, connect advertiser needs to the right solution and communicate the value proposition with clarity and confidence.
Data-Informed Strategist: Comfortable leveraging performance data, audience insights, and category trends to craft compelling, measurable solutions that justify and grow media investment.
In this role, you are not just selling media — you are shaping how brands connect with audiences through premium content, trusted voices, and unique scale. As a Senior Director, Partnerships, your ability to see around corners, anticipate client needs, and deliver category-defining ideas will directly influence New York Magazine and Vox Media Group’s position as a leading force in the premium content landscape.
Where You’ll Work
This job is located in New York City and requires in-office presence with additional in-person expectations for client and agency meetings in and outside of NYC.
Total Compensation
In addition to the base salary listed, this role is bonus eligible.
PAY TRANSPARENCY
The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.
Pay Range
$130,000—$160,000 USD
OUR DEI COMMITMENT
Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.
Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com).
WHAT COMES NEXT
Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @voxmedia.com email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.

jobs.title: Head of Data Platform and Governance
jobs.text:
e are looking for a strategic and hands-on Head of Data Platform and Governance to lead the organizations data management, governance, and reporting initiatives. This role is pivotal in establishing a robust data foundation that enables accurate insights, informed decision-making, and a strong data-driven culture across the company.
The ideal candidate will oversee the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise-wide data systemsensuring data quality, consistency, and compliancewhile leading a team of data professionals focused on building one trusted source of truth.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development, testing, and optimization of data pipelines, database schemas, and common data models.
Manage issue resolution and escalations related to data quality, access, and reporting.
Define and implement a comprehensive Data Governance framework, including policies, processes, and data standards.
Oversee the architecture, integrity, and performance of data platforms to support business analytics and reporting.
Drive the execution of data programs and initiatives, ensuring delivery against roadmap timelines and KPIs.
Champion a data-driven culture, promoting ownership and literacy across the organization.
Ensure compliance with data protection and security standards.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to align data capabilities with business goals.
Support business units with timely and accurate data extraction and reporting needs.
Key Performance Indicators
Data accuracy and quality
SLA adherence for data and reporting requests
Data platform security and compliance
Timely delivery of data-related initiatives (vs. planned timelines and budgets)
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
At least 10 years of experience in IT, data analysis, or data management, with 5+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience leading data governance, data management, or analytics teams.
Strong technical background in data modeling, database design, and data warehouse platforms.
Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and project management skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive performance outcomes.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Digital Shelf (Walmart Retail Analytics & Platform Solutions)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
About the role
The Director, Digital Shelf (Walmart Retail Analytics & Platform Solutions) is a client-facing leader who uncovers why client items are winning or losing on Walmart's digital shelf and turns those findings into clear, prioritized action plans. Using both data and practical judgment, this leader identifies opportunities and gaps across a client's catalog and recommends the actions needed to improve discoverability, conversion, availability, and sales across Walmart's omnichannel ecosystem.
This role is VML's go-to expert on Walmart Supplier One, with Walmart Scintilla (formerly Walmart Luminate) and Retail Link as key supporting tools. It is both strategic and tactical: the Director explains why performance changed, connecting item setup, content quality, catalog and inventory health, and shopper data to pinpoint root causes, and then makes the item-level changes needed to fix them. They partner with internal and client teams to make sure every insight leads to a clear owner and a measurable result.
This role also supports Walmart merchant readiness for client teams, shaping the insights behind joint business plans, line reviews, and business reviews, and helps build the playbooks and frameworks that make Digital Shelf analysis repeatable across VML's Commerce Connections practice.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Supplier One, Walmart Systems & Root Cause Analysis
Serve as VML's lead expert in Walmart Supplier One, making hands-on, item-level changes (item setup, content, attributes, and catalog fixes) and monitoring content quality scores, in-stock rates, OTIF, inventory health, and buy-box performance to resolve issues affecting items at shelf.
Use Walmart Scintilla (Channel Performance, Shopper Behavior, and Customer Perception) and Retail Link (DSS) to add sales and shopper context to Supplier One findings.
Lead Digital Shelf root cause analysis for client catalogs and items, combining data (sales, traffic, conversion, in-stock, search rank, and content scores) with qualitative review (content and imagery, ratings and reviews, and competitive positioning) to explain why items are over- or under-performing.
Analyze omnichannel sales, fulfillment (Pickup, Delivery, Shipping), shopper trends, and pricing or promotional impact to identify what is driving share gains or losses and size the opportunity.
Use AI-enabled tools, including Marty for Scintilla and WPP Open, to spot issues such as out-of-stock risk earlier and act before they impact sales.
Client Leadership & Walmart Retailer Strategy
Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, clearly communicating catalog- and item-level opportunities, gaps, and recommended actions.
Build scorecards and insight-driven narratives for Walmart joint business planning (JBP), line reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that help clients strengthen merchant relationships.
Turn complex retail data and platform changes into clear action plans with defined owners, expected impact, and success measures, and carry out item-level changes directly where needed.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Discoverability & Connections, Analytics, Strategy, Product, Technology, and Delivery teams so insights turn into coordinated execution.
Convert Supplier One and Scintilla findings into clear briefs for content optimization, catalog health, and supply chain improvements, and track the resulting impact.
Share Walmart insights and platform changes across Commerce Connections so teams can anticipate and respond to shifts.
Platform Enablement & Team Development
Develop and maintain Supplier One and Scintilla best practices, standard operating procedures, and root cause frameworks that standardize how VML resolves issues at shelf.
Lead internal training and platform guides that build team fluency in Walmart data and Digital Shelf operations.
Identify new Walmart platform and data opportunities that expand VML's commerce offering.
Improve analytical efficiency, accuracy, and workflows across client engagements.
Mentor team members in Supplier One, Scintilla, root cause analysis, and insight storytelling.
Model and foster a collaborative team culture grounded in Curiosity, Candor, and Connection.
Who you are
Walmart Supplier One Expert: Brings deep, hands-on Supplier One expertise, supported by strong working knowledge of Walmart Scintilla and Retail Link, and is the go-to resource for clients and internal teams.
Hands-On Executor: Comfortable rolling up their sleeves to make item-level changes in Supplier One and see each fix through to results at shelf.
Root Cause Diagnostician: Moves beyond what happened to why, identifying the true drivers of item performance across content, availability, pricing, and search.
Insight-to-Action Leader: Turns insights into clear, prioritized recommendations, communicates them with confidence, and follows through to measurable results.
Collaborative Partner: Works with Digital Shelf, Strategy, Content, Operations, Technology, Analytics, and Client teams around shared priorities.
Capability Builder: Creates playbooks, frameworks, and platform knowledge that strengthen Commerce Connections and improve client outcomes.
Continuous Learner: Stays current on Supplier One enhancements, Scintilla releases, and AI tools such as Marty for Scintilla and WPP Open.
What you bring
Experience
8+ years of experience in retail analytics, Digital Shelf management, Walmart platform operations, CPG category management, eCommerce, or agency commerce roles, including experience leading client engagements.
Deep, hands-on expertise in Walmart Supplier One, including making item-level changes (item setup, content, and catalog updates), with working knowledge of Walmart Scintilla (formerly Walmart Luminate) and Retail Link (DSS).
Proven track record of root cause analysis across sales, inventory, shopper, and content data, turning findings into recommendations that drove measurable results.
Experience supporting Walmart retailer engagements, including Line Reviews, Joint Business Planning (JBP), and Digital Shelf optimization, with exposure to client and merchant stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams, and to mentor team members.
Strong communication skills, with experience presenting insights and recommendations to client leadership in a clear, action-oriented way.
Skills
Walmart Supplier One, including item setup, content updates, and catalog maintenance
Walmart Scintilla (formerly Luminate) and Retail Link (DSS)
Root cause analysis for catalog and item performance
Walmart merchant storytelling (JBP and Line Reviews)
Client communication and presentation skills
Cross-functional collaboration, mentorship, and project execution
AI productivity and analytics tools
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$75,000—$180,000 USD

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. jobs.title: VP of Learning Design
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
Read our blog to learn more.
About the role...
Learning is at the heart of Duolingo’s product, and AI is opening new ways to create, personalize, and evaluate learning experiences. We’re looking for a VP of Learning Design to lead our 40+ person Learning Experience (LX) organization day to day and help make every lesson more effective, motivating, and memorable for hundreds of millions of learners.
Reporting to the VP of Learning Experience, you’ll help shape how Duolingo teaches, with your primary focus on building a strong organization and developing its people. You’ll lead through directors and other senior leaders, strengthen the team’s learning design and product capabilities, and ensure LX delivers strong results in partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data across language, math, music, and chess.
This role is based in our New York or Pittsburgh office.
🧠 You will...
Help millions of people learn more effectively, identifying opportunities to improve how Duolingo teaches and guiding LX leaders to turn those opportunities into better learning experiences.
Build a high-performing LX organization and leadership team, owning organizational design, hiring, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, and team health.
Ensure LX delivers on its commitments, allocating resources to the highest-impact work, holding leaders accountable for results, and helping them resolve obstacles.
Strengthen product capabilities across LX, helping leaders coach their teams to make sound product decisions, write clear specs and roadmaps, present effectively at Product Review, and use AI to ship small experiments independently.
Represent LX in key cross-functional forums, build strong partnerships, and help its leaders influence product decisions and resolve cross-team challenges.
✅ You have...
Experience leading a multidisciplinary organization through directors and other senior leaders in a fast-moving, product-led environment.
A passion for people leadership, with a track record of developing strong leaders, empowering teams to take ownership, and delivering results through others.
Meaningful grounding in learning design, learning science, or a related discipline, with the judgment to coach experts and connect learning principles to product decisions.
Experience shaping consumer products through the teams you lead, including using AI to accelerate product development or content generation.
Excellent executive communication and judgment, with the ability to make difficult tradeoffs, influence senior leaders across functions, and lead through ambiguity and change.
Ability to work from or relocate to New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...
Experience building AI-powered learning experiences or systems for generating and evaluating learning content at scale.
Experience at a founder-led or rapidly scaling consumer technology company.
Significant experience using Duolingo, and opinions about how to make it better.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$330,000—$550,000 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Executive Director - ICT Operations (Technology Lead) Sports BU SPA2
jobs.text:
The Executive Director – Technology Lead is a foundational executive role responsible for defining, governing, and delivering end-to-end sports technology strategy across all Sports Business Unit assets, from early planning and concept design through construction, commissioning, and structured transition into operations under the Asset Management organization.
In line with the current SBU TOM, the role does not assume responsibility for day-to-day asset operations once venues are handed over to the Asset Management team. Instead, it ensures that sports venues are designed, delivered, and documented with full lifecycle integrity, and that the technology intent, architectural decisions, and integration logic are effectively transferred, supported, and retained as organizational knowledge.
The role establishes SBU as the custodian of technology design intent and institutional memory, enabling Asset Management and operators to run assets efficiently, evolve them safely, and avoid long-term technical debt. This continuity reflects global best practice, recognizing that technology-led assets require ongoing involvement of the original design authority to support optimization, upgrades, servicing strategies, and future-proofing—without blurring operational accountability.
Through this approach, the role ensures Qiddiya’s sports assets remain globally competitive, future-ready, and fully integrated with the wider Qiddiya city technology ecosystem across their entire lifecycle.
1. Sports Technology Strategy & Governance
Define together with Qiddiya Tech and Asset Management the SBU Technology Strategy aligned with the Sports BU Target Operating Model and the Qiddiya Technology Mandate & Operating Model (QTMOM).
Represent SBU at executive level within the Qiddiya-wide Technology Board ( as per QTMOM )and related governance forums.
Establish clear decision rights, standards, and lifecycle ownership for technologies across all assets.
2. Planning, Design & Delivery Leadership
Act as executive technology authority across Stage Gates for all sports assets (stadiums, arenas, academies, training centers, public sport facilities).
Ensure technology requirements are embedded early in master planning, concept design, and detailed design, avoiding retrofits and value leakage.
Oversee complex technology scopes including digital infrastructure, smart venues, broadcast, fan experience, performance tech, data platforms, and cyber security.
3. Complex Sports Asset Enablement
Lead technology delivery for multi-asset sports ecosystems, not standalone venues — including integrated sports districts, mixed-use developments, and city-scale environments.
Ensure seamless integration with mobility, smart city platforms, digital identity, payments, and city operations.
4. Industry-Leading Technology Partnerships & Commercial Value
Co-create and lead an industry-leading Sports Technology Partnership Program in close collaboration with Qiddiya Strategy and Commercial teams.
Structure long-term partnerships (OEMs, integrators, telcos, cloud, media, data, performance tech) generating hundreds of millions to potentially billions SAR in:
Direct revenues (sponsorships, naming rights, data & media monetization)
Capex savings
Opex efficiencies

jobs.title: Head of Product - Asian Timezones
jobs.text:
Company Overview
hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
Job Overview
We are a discretionary crypto trading firm where traders and researchers make high-conviction decisions using proprietary data, tools, and workflows. Our edge depends not only on the quality of our people, but also on the internal systems that help them investigate markets, test ideas, understand risk, and act quickly with confidence.
This is a founding Head of Product role. Today, product work is handled across trading, research, and engineering. Your mandate is to build the product function from the ground up: discovery, prioritization, requirements, roadmap ownership, product quality, adoption, and eventually the team.
At our firm, “product” means internal, proprietary systems built for our own traders, researchers, and engineering teams. We do not build retail products, and we do not serve external customers. Your users are expert practitioners inside the firm. Your job is to understand their workflows deeply, identify the highest-leverage problems, and ensure engineering builds the right systems to solve them.
You will start hands-on. You will sit with traders and researchers, understand real decisions and investigations, write the early requirements yourself, and establish the standards for how product work should be done. As the scope grows, you will hire and lead a small product team while staying close enough to the trading and research to retain a first-hand understanding of the problems we are solving.
Responsibilities
1. Product Function and Operating Model
Build the product discipline for the firm. Define how we discover problems, capture requirements, write specifications, review trade-offs, measure adoption, and close the feedback loop with users.
2. Internal Product Roadmap
Own the roadmap for internal trading and research systems in partnership with the CIO, engineering, trading, and research leadership. Balance immediate practitioner pain points with longer-term platform foundations, including data quality, provenance, tooling reliability, and system scalability.
3. Practitioner Discovery
Work directly with traders and researchers to understand real workflows: how they investigate opportunities, evaluate data, form hypotheses, monitor positions, assess risk, and make decisions. Your job is to understand the underlying decision process and identify what system capability would create the most leverage.
4. Requirements and Product Quality
Translate ambiguous practitioner needs into clear, evidence-backed requirements that engineering can build from. Requirements should capture the business context, user workflow, data assumptions, expected behavior, edge cases, success measures, and relevant trade-offs.
The goal is not simply to reduce questions from engineering. The goal is to reduce avoidable ambiguity, surface trade-offs early, and ensure the team is building the right thing for the right reason.
5. Trust, Explainability, and Source Transparency
Ensure our internal systems are built for trust. Traders and researchers should be able to understand where a number came from, what assumptions sit behind a calculation, why a signal changed, and when human judgment is required.
Data lineage, source transparency, explainable calculations, and human-in-the-loop decision-making should be default product principles.
6. Stakeholder Alignment
Act as the connective tissue between trading, research, engineering, and management. You will surface trade-offs clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and help the firm make better prioritization decisions.
7. Team Building
Start as the sole product leader, then build the team as the work scales. Hire and develop product managers, set the bar for discovery and specification quality, and create a product culture suited to a high-performance trading environment.
What you'll do
Spend significant time with traders and researchers to understand real decisions, workflows, investigations, datasets, and pain points.
Distinguish stated feature requests from underlying practitioner needs.
Translate trading and research workflows into product opportunities, clear requirements, and buildable product decisions.
Write clear product requirements for internal systems, workflows, data products, analytics, and decision-support tools.
Partner closely with engineering to shape feasible, scalable solutions and surface technical trade-offs early.
Prioritize product work based on expected trading, research, operational, or risk impact.
Define success measures for product work, including faster research cycles, better data quality, reduced manual work, improved decision confidence, risk reduction, stronger adoption, or, where measurable, PnL contribution.
Defend foundational work — such as data quality, lineage, reliability, and platform architecture — when it is more important than a visible front-end feature.
Evaluate external data providers and tooling vendors where relevant, including API quality, coverage, latency, reliability, cost, and integration complexity.
Establish product rituals, documentation standards, and feedback loops.
Advise the CIO on product priorities, practitioner needs, product-engineering trade-offs, and sequencing.
Hire and lead a small product team once the scope requires it.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture is responsible for designing and industrializing the enterprise’s data and digital product solutions — turning bespoke, one-off work into reusable, production-ready assets built on a centralized, enterprise-agnostic Silver model.
This role leads Data Architecture as part of its umbrella, owning the enterprise solution architecture that binds data and digital product capabilities together and weaving AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress the modeling cycle that has historically slowed the path to production. The Senior Director directs the design of the scalable, enterprise-agnostic data model and partners closely with Data Engineering, Data Analysis & Products, Digital Product, and Analytics teams to architect reusable solutions and refactor raw work onto governed, shared sources.
This role is a critical counterpart to the Data Engineering pillar of the DataOps team. The role provides hands-on leadership across data architecture, solution design, AI-accelerated modeling, product integration, and automation so that architectural intent and engineering investment result in reusable, adopted, and scalable data and digital product assets.
Key Responsibilities
Data Architecture Leadership
Lead the Data Architecture function, owning the design of the scalable, flexible, enterprise-agnostic data model that underpins the enterprise medallion architecture.
Set architectural direction, standards, and reference models that Data Engineering and Analysis teams build against.
Direct the ingestion, structuring, and layering strategy in partnership with IT and Data Engineering to ensure a durable, reusable foundation.
Solution Architecture & Design
Own the end-to-end solution architecture that connects data and digital product capabilities to the centralized, enterprise-agnostic medallion architecture models.
Design reusable, scalable solution blueprints and reference patterns aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture rather than siloed, point builds.
Translate architectural intent into buildable, production-ready solution designs that engineering and product teams can execute against.
AI-Accelerated Modeling & Solution Industrialization
Weave AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress modeling time — the historic inhibitor to reaching production.
Refactor raw, bespoke solutions onto the centralized, agnostic Silver layer so value is captured once and reused many times.
Establish repeatable patterns and accelerators that turn learning-stage work into durable, production-ready assets.
Data & Digital Product Integration
Integrate data and digital product solutions onto shared, reusable sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise medallion model rather than siloed builds.
Partner with Digital Product and Analytics teams to embed automation and AI into product workflows where combined capabilities produce stronger outcomes.
Ensure integrated solutions are designed for reuse across multiple use cases, not bespoke consumption.
Reusability, Standards & Enablement
Centralize AI-assisted modeling patterns, templates, and reusable components so every asset compounds the value of the next.
Establish standards for how data architecture, solution design, AI, and automation are applied across engineering and solutioning to ensure consistency and scale.
Enable Data Engineering and Analysis teams to adopt architectural patterns and automation accelerators effectively within their workflows.
Required Experience & Capabilities
Senior leadership experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data modeling, data/analytics solution delivery, automation, or applied AI within an enterprise data environment.
Demonstrated experience leading a data architecture function and designing scalable, enterprise-agnostic data models.
Demonstrated experience designing and industrializing bespoke or prototype solutions into reusable, production-ready assets.
Strong knowledge of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), reusable modeling, and enterprise-agnostic data design.
Hands-on understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion to production.
Proven ability to apply AI and automation to accelerate modeling, integration, and solutioning while preserving quality and governance.
Strong communication, influencing, and change leadership skills; experience in complex, regulated enterprises preferred.
Measures of Success
The enterprise data model and architecture are scalable, reusable, and consistently adopted across use cases.
Solution designs are consistently reusable, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture.
Modeling and solution cycle time is measurably reduced through AI and automation.
Bespoke and raw solutions are consistently refactored onto reusable, agnostic Silver sources.
Data and digital product assets reach production faster through governed, automated pipelines.
Acceleration is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus and long term incentive plan.

jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?
Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.
The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope
You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.
The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?
Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.
Requirements
What do you bring to the table?
Must have
12+ years in software engineering, including several years leading multi-team organizations through managers.
Distributed-systems and platform architecture ownership at scale — multi-tenant isolation, service decomposition, and the judgment to reduce complexity.

blocks.text: Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?

Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.

The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope

You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.

The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?

items: Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.

Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.

jobs.title: Vice President of Information Technology and Security
jobs.text:
The Vice President of IT & Information Security will serve as the executive leader responsible for corporate information technology, enterprise information and data security operations, IT service delivery and. Reporting directly to the CHRO, this executive will establish a cohesive technology and security strategy designed to support and scale a high-growth, $100M+ ARR B2B software organization expanding toward $250M+ ARR in a rapidly transforming AI-enabled workplace.
Operating in a modern, cloud-native ecosystem centered around Google Workspace and JumpCloud’s identity, access, and device management platform, the VP will align technology operations with business velocity. This leader will drive unified identity and access management, operationalize and technically enforce data classification and retention policies established by Data Privacy & Compliance, and establish clear federated IT and cybersecurity governance across peer technical functions, including DevOps,RevOps, Product (including Business Intelligence), Data Privacy & Compliance, and AI Enablement. This leader will also provide oversight for cybersecurity, IT infrastructure resilience, and technical security controls supporting enterprise compliance strategies. The ideal candidate balances risk mitigation with business agility, building a scalable foundation for innovation in the age of agentic AI.
Leadership Scope & Strategic Mandate:
Unified Technology Strategy & Executive Governance: Own the multi-year, internal technology, cybersecurity, and technical data protection infrastructure roadmaps. Align investments, compliance strategies, and operational metrics with corporate growth and board-level risk tolerances.
Balance Risk & Velocity: Ensure security controls and compliance mandates serve as business enablers (SOC 2, ISO 27001) without creating friction for employee productivity or engineering velocity.
Facilitate Federated Operating Model: Build structured operational boundaries, coordinated work practices, and identity governance frameworks across specialized teams with system administrative access (DevOps, RevOps, AI Enablement).
Role Specific Job Duties:
1. Enterprise IT Architecture, Cloud Operations (Google Workspace & JumpCloud) and AI Infrastructure
Provide senior leadership oversight of the core cloud productivity stack (Google Workspace), identity provider, and mobile device management (JumpCloud).
Lead IT team that manages provisioning, system administration and IT service and support, including outsourced IT support partner in the UK
Drive zero-touch, automated provisioning and de-provisioning workflows for cross-platform hardware fleets (macOS, Windows, mobile) and enterprise SaaS licenses.
Maintain 99.9%+ availability, disaster recovery resilience, and business continuity across corporate technology systems.
Operationalize, secure, maintain and continuously improve corporate AI infrastructure, model pipelines, and internal AI platforms. Build the systems needed to support and enforce data privacy, governance, and secure API controls for LLM usage.
2. Cybersecurity, Data Governance & Risk Management
Manage team of Information Security experts, who lead the company’s comprehensive information security program, encompassing threat intelligence, incident response, vulnerability management, zero-trust network access, and endpoint protection.
Partner with the Senior Director of Data Privacy & Compliance to operationalize and technically automate enterprise data classification standards, least-privilege access controls, and automated data retention/privacy policies across all SaaS and cloud repositories.
Oversee continuous compliance readiness for security, confidentiality, and availability frameworks (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001) and partner with Data Privacy & Compliance on technical security safeguards mandated by GDPR and CCPA. Own technical and infrastructure security responses for customer security questionnaires, serving as the executive escalation point alongside the Senior Director of Data Privacy and Compliance on third-party risk assessments.
3. Strategic Cross-Functional Partnerships
DevOps & Engineering: Establish clear demarcations between corporate IT/Security and production engineering infrastructure. Collaborate on cloud security posture management (CSPM), developer tool governance, and secure CI/CD pipelines.
RevOps & Commercial Systems: Build federated identity and access standards for commercial tools (e.g., Salesforce/HubSpot). Ensure commercial system admins adhere to central security, audit logging, and SSO policies without bottlenecking go-to-market speed.
4. Financial & Vendor Management
Manage the consolidated IT and Information Security budget (CapEx/OpEx), optimizing software licensing spend, hardware procurement, and security tooling.
Partner with Purchasing in leading strategic enterprise negotiations with software vendors, managed security service providers (MSSPs), and external auditors.
5. Organization Building & Talent Development
Lead and develop the IT and Security teams, structuring distinct functional domains for maximum impact (e.g.,Service Desk, Cloud Architecture, InfoSec/Compliance, Systems Engineering and Administration).
Transform both functions into AI-forward operations leveraging agentic AI and tooling automation to support scalable, lean operations.
Required Skills / Experience:
Dual IT and Information Security Domain Expertise: Proven track record leading both enterprise IT operations and corporate cybersecurity/compliance programs.
Critical Thinking & Structured Problem-Solving: Proven ability to think critically, identify, gather and organize data, identify problem statements, lead collaborative problem solving, ask insightful questions and question the status quo along the way.
Risk Management & Governance: Strong experience establishing governance models alongside DevOps (production vs. corporate IT) and RevOps (commercial tool federation).
Data and Security Operations Management: Confident stewardship of a company’s technical infrastructure and data security posture. Able to provide a single pane of glass view of a company’s cloud data repositories and the technical security controls (encryption, access controls, DLP) protecting enterprise data assets.
Collaboration Skills: Demonstrated skill at working across multiple stakeholder groups to get things done. Experience taking engineering hand-offs from AI Enablement or specialized platform engineering teams to maintain secure, enterprise-grade AI infrastructure.
AI-Enabled Business Transformation: Demonstrated proficiency at leading technology-enabled business / workflow transformations. Demonstrated experience with the transformation of internal operations leveraging AI tools and solutions, acting as an informed security advisor in the process.
Presentation and Influence Skills: Able to take complex topics and turn them into compelling narratives that engage stakeholders. Ability to influence others leveraging data and insights. Comfortable presenting to audiences at all levels.
People Management: At least 7 years of experience directly managing people and teams, including hiring, developing, performance managing, building trust and driving employee engagement.
Education / Experience / Certifications (Preferred)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
Master’s degree, MBA, or advanced technical degree preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in IT and/or Information Security, with 5+ years in senior leadership (Director, Senior Director, VP) within $50M–$150M+ ARR) B2B software/SaaS organization.
Preferred: proficiency with Claude, Gemini, Crowdstrike and/or other AI and AI-related tool suites.
Preferred: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), CISM, or CRISC.
Preferred: Google Workspace Professional Administrator Certification.
Preferred: ITIL v4 or PMP

Provide screening questions via email
