Request any personal information (such as Social Security numbers, banking details, etc.) through email or messaging platforms

jobs.title: Director - Engineering, Forward-Deployed Engineering and Customer Outcomes
jobs.text:
Customer Success at Innovaccer
Our mission is to turn our customers into tech-savvy superheroes, ensuring they achieve success using our platform to meet their organization’s business goals. If you're passionate about helping customers realize the value they seek with technology, then our customer success team is the right place for you.
About the Role
As the Director of Engineering, FDE and Customer Outcomes, you will lead an elite organization of multiple cross-functional engineering teams, each dedicated to a portfolio of tier-one healthcare customers. You are ultimately accountable for the technical delivery, enterprise configuration, and operational success of our AI-driven platform within complex healthcare ecosystems.
Each team under your leadership operates with high autonomy, directly owning their customer delivery plans, data quality standards, and clinical/business outcomes. You will mentor engineering managers and technical leads across a global footprint to architect robust data ingestion pipelines, configure complex enterprise software, and deploy production-grade, compliant AI agents into live healthcare environments.
A Day in the Life
Global Team Leadership & Delivery Ownership
● Scale and Govern Multiple Teams: Hire, mentor, and scale multiple customer-facing engineering teams across regions, optimizing global resource allocation across health systems, payers, and life sciences clients.
● Delivery Plan Accountability: Empower autonomous teams to own, track, and execute comprehensive implementation delivery plans, navigating critical paths from discovery to live production.
● Customer Outcome Management: Focus engineering execution on direct business and clinical metrics (reducing administrative burden, improving workflow efficiency) to drive customer retention and high NPS/CSAT.
● Quality Assurance & Standards: Establish baseline organizational standards for data integrity, product quality, architectural reviews, and formal customer sign-off criteria.
Data Ingestion & Data Quality
● Clinical Data Ingestion: Guide teams in building high-throughput pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured datasets (EHR notes, lab results, imaging metadata, claims) via HL7, FHIR, and DICOM.
● Data Quality & Normalization: Standardize validation frameworks to sanitize, deduplicate, and normalize raw, heterogeneous healthcare data for downstream AI/ML consumption.
● Deterministic Guardrails: Implement automated data-quality testing and schema enforcement protocols to intercept data corruption or format mismatches pre-ingestion, ensuring absolute clinical data integrity.
Product Configuration & Enterprise Implementation
● Enterprise Customization: Oversee platform configuration, tailoring core software capabilities to match specific clinical workflows and varied healthcare operational taxonomies.
● Seamless Integration: Lead native platform deployments into complex enterprise ecosystems, integrating directly with production EHR systems and native provider workflows.
● Solution Architecture: Design scalable pre-sales and post-sales technical solution architectures that align customer requirements with platform capabilities.
Build & Deploy AI Agents
● AI Agent Engineering: Oversee the forward-deployed development, local integration, optimization, and fine-tuning of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents utilizing advanced LLM orchestration frameworks.
● Clinical Safety & Benchmarking: Enforce a high rollout bar which includes deployment-level guardrails, and real-time monitoring and ensure safe outputs.

jobs.title: Director of Operations (Product, Engineering & Technical Solutions)
jobs.text:
Job Description
Alloy is where you belong!
Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.
Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong.
See how we've been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.
Check out our investors and read more about us here.
About the team
Product, Engineering, and Technical Solutions (PETS) make up two-thirds of Alloy and own the products and capabilities that drive outcomes for our clients. As Alloy grows, we keep rethinking how we operate: delivering first-of-their-kind client solutions, building scale and consistency in our core, and leveling up our platform. PETS Operations sits at the center of that work. The team keeps every group focused on high-impact problems, cuts toil out of how we work, and runs the rituals that keep PETS aligned. Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. Directors and above attend the office four times a week.
What you'll do
Own how two-thirds of Alloy operates. You'll set the operations strategy for PETS, sit on Alloy's senior leadership team, report to our Chief Product & Operating Officer, and lead a team of Operations Managers and an Applied AI Engineer.
Set the operations strategy for Product, Engineering, and Technical Solutions. Choose the priorities, say what we will not do, and hold the organization accountable for delivering.
Build the measurement that shows where effort goes across PETS, starting with cost to serve by client segment, and turn it into decisions and points of view for the executive team and board.
Cut the overhead of running PETS so Alloy grows without scaling headcount linearly. Set automation goals and make the build-vs-buy calls on the tooling that gets us there.
Redesign core processes, from triage and feature requests to delivery, launches, and product feedback loops, to raise client satisfaction and remove internal overhead.
Run PETS operating cadences, including quarterly roadmap planning, annual planning, and All Hands, and decide which ones to keep, change, or cut.
Own the systems PETS runs on, including contracting, budget, and setup in partnership with IT.
Lead, coach, and grow a small team of Operations Managers and an Applied AI Engineer into a group that gets more done together than apart.
What we're looking for
Must-haves:
Experience leading operations for Product, Engineering, and/or Technical Solutions teams at a high-growth startup.
A track record of setting strategy and priorities for an operations function and driving change through teams you don't manage, all the way to adoption. You are comfortable pushing on senior leaders, including the executive team.
Measurement built from no baseline, such as cost to serve, capacity or effort models, or unit economics for solutions and engineering teams, and used to change real decisions.
Fluency in how engineering teams work. You engage credibly with Engineering leaders on SDLC, triage, and process. You do not need to be a former engineer.
Experience leading and developing a high-performing team, with real investment in each person's career growth.
Based in New York and able to work from our Union Square HQ four days a week.
Nice-to-haves:
Led build-vs-buy decisions on automation or internal tooling, and partnered on the build when that was the right call.
Redesigned an operating cadence, including cutting one that was not creating value.
Prepared points of view and materials for executives and a board.
Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!
This position has a salary range of $200,000 – $240,000.
Benefits and Perks
Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy
Employee stock options
Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options
401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation
Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave
Home office stipend for new employees
Annual learning & development stipend
Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health
Hybrid work environment: our employees local to NYC are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday, most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office.
How to Apply
Apply right here! You've found the application!
Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We're committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.
All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you're ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
jobs.text:
About FoodLabs
FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch.
About The General Data Corporation
General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.
Why this is a unique opportunity
AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity.
General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani, you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up.
About the role
Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives.
Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API.
ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data.
Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure.
Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become.
What you need to succeed
Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more.
Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks.
Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus.
Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows.
Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths.
Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems.
Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus.
Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us!
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
We are looking for a highly skilled Director, Product Management to lead our supplemental Math & Literacy product portfolio, spanning DreamBox Math, DreamBox Reading Park, Reading Plus, and Doodle. As a senior product leader, you will define and drive the long-term strategy for products that deliver measurable learning outcomes for students while supporting sustainable growth for Discovery Education. This highly visible role partners closely with Curriculum, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and senior leadership to establish portfolio priorities, guide investment decisions, and advance product innovation. You will build, lead, and develop a team of product managers and curriculum designers responsible for the ongoing maintenance, enhancement, performance, and growth of the portfolio.
In This Role You Will:
Strategic Product Leadership
Define and drive the multi-year product vision, strategy, and investment priorities for the Math & Literacy portfolio Align the portfolio with Discovery Education’s business objectives, customer needs, market opportunities, and learning efficacy goals Evaluate emerging technologies, AI capabilities, competitive trends, and market insights to inform strategic decisions
Portfolio Management
Own the roadmap and product lifecycle across DreamBox Math, DreamBox Reading Park, Reading Plus, and Doodle Balance maintenance, modernization, enhancement, and new feature investment across the portfolio Prioritize portfolio investments based on customer value, product performance, organizational capacity, and expected business outcomes
Business Planning
Develop business cases and portfolio plans that balance product investment and expected return Partner with cross-functional leaders to align product plans with sustainable growth, retention, and business performance goals
Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and curriculum designers Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, curricular rigor, innovation, and product excellence Build organizational capability through talent development, effective resource allocation, and succession planning
Executive and Stakeholder Engagement
Communicate product strategy, portfolio performance, investment recommendations, and roadmap priorities to stakeholders and senior leadership, including the SVP of Product Build consensus and align organizational leaders around portfolio priorities, trade-offs, and desired outcomes
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with Engineering, Design, Curriculum, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to align priorities and support seamless product delivery Guide cross-functional decisions related to scope, staffing, risk, technical considerations, and user experience
Growth and Customer Outcomes
Identify opportunities to increase product usage, adoption, renewal, and customer satisfaction across the portfolio Apply customer, market, and competitive insights to improve learning outcomes and inform investment decisions Champion the needs of educators, students, and administrators throughout the product development lifecycle
Performance and Execution
Establish and own portfolio-level OKRs, KPIs, product performance measures, and efficacy goals Use data, experimentation, and customer insights to guide product decisions and measure results Lead cross-functional execution by managing priorities, dependencies, risks, staffing projections, and trade-offs
Core Competencies for Success:
Strategic Mindset: Anticipates future trends and translates customer, market, competitive, and organizational insights into a clear, long-term portfolio strategy Business Insight: Applies commercial, financial, customer, and market knowledge to evaluate opportunities and make sound product investment decisions Drives Results: Establishes clear priorities and accountability while mobilizing teams to deliver measurable customer, learning, and business outcomes Develops Talent: Builds organizational capability by providing meaningful coaching, feedback, development opportunities, and support to current and future leaders Collaborates: Builds effective partnerships across functions and levels, integrating diverse perspectives to create alignment and advance shared outcomes
Credentials and Experience:
10+ years of progressive product management experience, including responsibility for complex products, product lines, or multi-product portfolios 5+ years of experience leading and developing product managers, curriculum professionals, or multidisciplinary product teams Demonstrated experience developing and executing portfolio strategies that support customer adoption, retention, growth, and business performance Demonstrated experience leading roadmap prioritization, business planning, product investment recommendations, and resource allocation across multiple products Experience presenting product strategy, portfolio performance, and business recommendations to senior and executive leadership Experience partnering with engineering teams on technically complex products and applying AI or emerging technologies to improve product development efficiency or customer value Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, education, product management, or a related field, with an MBA or advanced degree preferred; familiarity with mathematics or literacy curriculum, instructional design, or educational technology strongly preferred Legal right to work in the United Kingdom
This role is designed to be remote or hybrid in Bath, UK. We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. Our office is in a listed building and unfortunately does not have a lift. If this presents an accessibility issue, or you require any other reasonable adjustment for your interview, please let us know and we will be happy to discuss alternative arrangements. #li-remote The hiring range for this position is between £88,000 - £99,050 annually, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Additionally, this position is eligible for an Annual Bonus.

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and curriculum designers Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, curricular rigor, innovation, and product excellence Build organizational capability through talent development, effective resource allocation, and succession planning
Executive and Stakeholder Engagement

Communicate product strategy, portfolio performance, investment recommendations, and roadmap priorities to stakeholders and senior leadership, including the SVP of Product Build consensus and align organizational leaders around portfolio priorities, trade-offs, and desired outcomes
Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Engineering, Design, Curriculum, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to align priorities and support seamless product delivery Guide cross-functional decisions related to scope, staffing, risk, technical considerations, and user experience
Growth and Customer Outcomes

Identify opportunities to increase product usage, adoption, renewal, and customer satisfaction across the portfolio Apply customer, market, and competitive insights to improve learning outcomes and inform investment decisions Champion the needs of educators, students, and administrators throughout the product development lifecycle
Performance and Execution

Establish and own portfolio-level OKRs, KPIs, product performance measures, and efficacy goals Use data, experimentation, and customer insights to guide product decisions and measure results Lead cross-functional execution by managing priorities, dependencies, risks, staffing projections, and trade-offs

Credentials and Experience:

10+ years of progressive product management experience, including responsibility for complex products, product lines, or multi-product portfolios 5+ years of experience leading and developing product managers, curriculum professionals, or multidisciplinary product teams Demonstrated experience developing and executing portfolio strategies that support customer adoption, retention, growth, and business performance Demonstrated experience leading roadmap prioritization, business planning, product investment recommendations, and resource allocation across multiple products Experience presenting product strategy, portfolio performance, and business recommendations to senior and executive leadership Experience partnering with engineering teams on technically complex products and applying AI or emerging technologies to improve product development efficiency or customer value Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, education, product management, or a related field, with an MBA or advanced degree preferred; familiarity with mathematics or literacy curriculum, instructional design, or educational technology strongly preferred Legal right to work in the United Kingdom

jobs.title: Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance
jobs.text:
About the team
Strategic Finance Data Science helps OpenAI make consequential financial and operating decisions as the business grows. We connect customer behavior, product economics and business performance to the choices leaders make about goals, customer acquisition and investment.
The team works closely with Strategic Finance and partners across Data Science, Product, GTM and Data Engineering. Its work combines forecasting, analytical decision support and tools that make financial planning more effective.
About the role
We are seeking a data science leader who can turn complex, uncertain business questions into clear recommendations. You will lead an established team, strengthen its technical and leadership capabilities, and help shape where it can have the greatest impact.
You will partner with Finance and business leaders on forecasts, customer lifetime value, acquisition economics and resource allocation. This role calls for someone who can challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs and follow the analysis through to a decision. You should be motivated by the opportunity to build a durable function during a period of rapid growth.
The role is based in San Francisco with three in-office days each week. Relocation assistance is available.
In this role, you will
Build forecasting approaches that help leaders understand business trajectories, compare scenarios and make choices under uncertainty.
Develop customer lifetime value and acquisition-economics models that inform marketing investment and balance near-term performance with long-term value.
Partner with Strategic Finance on annual goals, budget decisions and resource allocation, including the economics of compute investment.
Translate model outputs into clear operating recommendations, making assumptions, uncertainty and implications understandable to executive stakeholders.
Strengthen the tools, metrics and recurring analyses that allow Finance partners to make decisions effectively and at scale.
Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing team; establish priorities and accountability across ongoing work and urgent business questions.
Work across consumer and business products, applying expertise in one business model while learning the dynamics of the other.
You might thrive in this role if you
Have partnered closely with a CFO, Finance leadership or a COO whose remit includes major financial and operating decisions. Your work has informed meaningful business choices, regardless of whether your title included Finance.
Have led data science work in a large technology business or a rapidly scaling company, with experience adapting methods and priorities as the business changes.
Bring deep forecasting judgment and can connect technical choices to business consequences, communicate limitations and respond constructively when a forecast misses.
Have built strong teams, developed talent and attracted excellent colleagues. You can set direction while staying close enough to the work to challenge its quality.
Communicate clearly with technical and business audiences and build trust through sound judgment, evidence and follow-through.
Are excited by OpenAI’s mission and this specific opportunity to improve financial decisions in an evolving environment.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Product Director, Consumer Channels
jobs.text:
Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview
Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.
We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards
Education Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required
Experience Qualifications
7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required
Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required
Experience owning digital products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Required
Skills and Abilities
REQUIRED
Demonstrated success improving high-intent consumer journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service.
Strong analytical fluency and hands-on experience using digital analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Heap, Amplitude, FullStory, Mixpanel, or similar.
Demonstrated fluency using AI across product strategy, discovery, research synthesis, analysis, prototyping, experimentation, and optimization.
Experience using AI-native tools to investigate customer behavior, product performance, and emerging opportunities.
Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and evidence-based product decision making.
Ability to connect customer needs, behavioral signals, business strategy, and technology capabilities into clear product direction and investment priorities.
Experience working in continuous discovery and delivery environments where learning actively shapes the roadmap.
Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous product environments.
TARGET EXPERIENCE
We are looking for a product leader who has led consumer digital experiences where customer behavior and business performance are tightly connected.
You have owned high-intent journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service and can show how product decisions changed conversion, revenue, satisfaction, or customer effort.
You have worked in environments where pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial decisions are part of the product experience, not separate from it.
You also know what strong product practice looks like. You have worked with dedicated cross-functional teams, continuous discovery, instrumented products, experimentation, and outcome-based goals, and you have helped raise the maturity of the product organization around you.
Relevant experience may come from marketplaces, on-demand services, travel and hospitality, omnichannel retail, home services, financial services, modern automotive experiences, or other businesses where digital demand connects to real-world service delivery.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience shipping AI-enabled, conversational, agentic, predictive, or personalized product capabilities.
Experience leading products that span both customer-facing and employee-facing digital experiences.
Experience with behavioral analytics, voice of customer, journey analysis, service design, and customer research methods.
Familiarity with APIs, data products, design systems, experimentation platforms, and the technical foundations of modern digital products.
Experience with products where digital conversion connects directly to operational capacity or service fulfillment.
CORE CAPABILITIES
Product Strategy. Turns customer, business, and technology signals into clear product choices, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Consumer Journey Leadership. Understands the end-to-end journey and identifies where product can materially improve customer behavior, confidence, and outcomes.
Growth and Business Acumen. Connects product decisions to conversion, revenue, margin, satisfaction, and operational performance.
Opportunity Identification. Uses customer behavior, evidence, and business context to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities.
People Leadership. Builds strong product managers and raises the quality of judgment, execution, and product practice across the team.
AI-Enabled Product Leadership. Uses AI directly to improve how the team learns and to identify where intelligent capabilities can create customer and business value.
Experimentation and Learning. Uses analytics, testing, research, and feedback loops to improve decisions and product performance continuously.
Cross-Functional Leadership. Aligns Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Pricing, Operations, and other partners around shared outcomes.
Execution Discipline. Turns strategy into sustained product progress while managing priorities, dependencies, risk, and performance.
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by an employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned to ensure workload coverage. This job description does NOT constitute an employment agreement between the employer and employee and is subject to change by the employer as the organizational needs and requirements of the job change.
This position description is not all inclusive for every aspect of this role. Reasonable accommodations will be made for individuals covered by ADA, ADEA, FMLA and other laws and regulations in accordance with their requirements. Physical and mental demands are not, and should not be construed to be job qualification standards, but are illustrated to help the employer, employee and/or applicant identify tasks where reasonable accommodations may need to be made when an otherwise qualified person is unable to perform the job’s essential duties because of an ADA disability.
Other qualifications may be required to ensure employment eligibility in accordance with local laws, regulations and with Safelite Group, Inc. policies and practices.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Director of Data Engineering to lead our enterprise data engineering strategy, platform modernization, and operational excellence initiatives. This role will drive the design, governance, reliability, and scalability of our data ecosystem while enabling analytics, AI, and business intelligence capabilities across the organization. The Director will partner with technology and business leaders to deliver secure, trusted, and business-ready data solutions that support organizational growth and innovation.
Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Lead and develop high-performing teams of managers, architects, and data engineers.
Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise data platforms, including data warehouses, lakes, lakehouses, and analytical data products.
Establish standards for data architecture, integration, governance, quality, security, observability, and DataOps.
Drive modernization initiatives that improve scalability, reduce technical debt, and enhance operational efficiency.
Enable AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and self-service reporting through trusted data foundations.
Partner with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to align data initiatives with business objectives.
Manage technology investments, vendor relationships, budgets, and resource planning.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, architecture, analytics engineering, or enterprise data platform leadership.
7+ years leading technical teams in complex enterprise environments.
Experience developing enterprise data strategies, governance programs, and modernization roadmaps.
Strong expertise with cloud data platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data integration, and production operations.
Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational and analytical databases.
Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or hybrid cloud environments.
Experience with Informatica or similar enterprise integration platforms.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in a related discipline.
Experience with Informatica IDMC, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Power BI, and related technologies.
Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics initiatives.
Experience leading large-scale data modernization programs in regulated or data-driven industries.
Technical Skills
Enterprise data integration and data management platforms
Cloud-based data architecture and engineering
Data warehousing, lakehouse, and analytical platforms
DataOps, observability, and operational excellence
Data governance, metadata management, and lineage
Modern orchestration and transformation frameworks
Business intelligence and analytics technologies, including Power BI
Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and source control platforms such as GitHub and GitLab
Project collaboration tools including Jira and Confluence
What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance bonus program
Fully remote work environment
Comprehensive benefits package including 401k match
19 days of PTO per year; 10 holidays per year
Opportunity to work in a mission-driven organization where your work directly shapes clarity, confidence, and better outcomes across healthcare
Travel
Up to 10% travel, based on business needs. While our roles are 100% remote, we do get together a few times a year for up to one week. Employees are given ample notice and attendance is expected.
Work Environment
This position operates primarily in a remote work environment and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing work at a desk or workstation. The employee must be able to operate standard office equipment, including a computer, keyboard, mouse, webcam, and telephone.
The role also requires the ability to occasionally move throughout a workspace to access files, office equipment, and work-related materials. Effective communication, both written and verbal, is essential for interacting with employees, clients, and stakeholders.

Staritas is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.
As a federal contractor, Staritas complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding nondiscrimination and affirmative action. We are committed to creating a workplace that is fair, inclusive, and grounded in merit-based decision-making.
Accommodation Statement
If you need reasonable accommodation to apply for this position, please contact the recruiter.
Pay Transparency Statement
Staritas posts compensation ranges and benefits for all open roles. The base compensation range for this position is $165,000 - $175,000annually, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Compensation offered will depend on factors including experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. Staritas does not retaliate against employees or applicants for discussing compensation.
Benefits Statement
Staritas offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plans with company contributions; paid time off and company holidays; paid parental and family leave; and access to employee assistance and wellness resources. Additional benefits include life and disability insurance, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements.
Learn more about us by visiting .

jobs.title: Vice President, Revenue Cycle Technology Operations
jobs.text:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Vice President, Revenue Cycle Technology Operations leads the enterprise functions responsible for translating EnableComp's technology strategy into scalable, reliable, and measurable operational performance across revenue cycle service lines. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Operations, this role owns the Technology Operations vision, investment portfolio, governance, and value-realization framework while setting the strategic direction, operating expectations, and performance framework for work delivered through EnableComp's global vendor partners. Serving as an executive bridge among Operations, Technology, Product, Data, Implementation, and external delivery partners, the VP aligns technology enablement, workflow design, capacity strategy, and partner performance with business growth and client commitments. The VP leads through internal leaders and designated vendor leadership, establishes decision rights and accountability, allocates resources, resolves cross-functional tradeoffs, and remains accountable for productivity, quality, cost, scalability, risk, employee experience, and client outcomes across the combined portfolio.
THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE
Define and lead the enterprise vision, multi-year roadmap, and operating model for technology operations in alignment with EnableComp's growth strategy, client commitments, and Operations priorities.
Own the portfolio of Operations technology, automation, workflow-transformation, and global-operations initiatives, including business-case development, prioritization, sequencing, funding recommendations, and executive governance.
Establish decision rights, accountability, and ways of working across Operations, Technology, Product, Data, Implementation, Finance, Information Security, Compliance, and global vendor partners.
Translate business strategy and service-line needs into enterprise capability, capacity, and delivery requirements, ensuring technology and global-operations plans address the highest-value opportunities and risks.
Sponsor workflow redesign and standardization across onshore and global operations teams before and alongside technology deployment, ensuring processes are scalable, controlled, and consistently executed.
Set portfolio-level goals and KPIs for productivity, quality, cost-to-serve, cycle time, utilization, vendor performance, client outcomes, and return on investment; report results and recommendations to executive leadership.
Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Technology Operations leadership teams, including the Senior Directors, Revenue Cycle Technology Adoption..
Set strategic direction while delegating day-to-day technology adoption, global production, inventory coordination, vendor-team support, and performance-management execution to the respective Senior Directors.
Partner with Technology, Product, and Data leaders to align operational and global-delivery requirements with platform architecture, product roadmaps, integration capacity, data availability, and delivery constraints.
Maintain executive oversight of governance, operational continuity, regulatory and contractual controls, information security, data protection, third-party performance, and change risk; use performance data, partner feedback, and client insight to drive continuous improvement.
Sponsor pilots and phased rollouts, establish readiness and scale criteria, and make data-informed decisions to expand, revise, pause, or retire solutions.
Build a continuous-improvement culture that uses performance data, frontline feedback, client insight, and market developments to identify and deliver the next generation of operational capabilities.
Other duties as required.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree (MBA or similar) preferred.
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, healthcare operations, technology-enabled services, or a related environment, including 5+ years leading at the senior director or vice president level.
Demonstrated success building and leading an enterprise technology-operations, digital-transformation, automation, or operational-excellence portfolio with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success leading operational change in a services or operations heavy business, including at least one transformation carried through technology-led workflow redesign from pilot through multi-team rollout to a measured result, with task-level planning, dependency and gate management, and delivery at or under budget on a program with executive visibility.
Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations, including complex claims, denials, reimbursement, revenue recovery, or adjacent workflows.
Experience governing cross-functional portfolios and partnering with Technology, Product, Data, Information Security, Finance, and Operations leaders in a matrixed organization.
Demonstrated financial and analytical acumen, including business-case development, investment prioritization, KPI design, benefits realization, and executive-level reporting.
Experience directing outsourced or global delivery partnerships, including vendor governance, service-level performance, capacity planning, commercial oversight, and risk management preferred.
Timely and regular attendance.
Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES
Practices and adheres to EnableComp's Core Values, Vision and Mission.
Enterprise mindset with the ability to balance growth, client, operational, financial, risk, and technology considerations when setting priorities.
Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational and technical topics into clear decisions, tradeoffs, and actions.
Proven ability to lead through other leaders, build high-performing teams, and distinguish strategic accountability from delegated program execution.
Financially disciplined and data-driven, with the ability to connect technology investments to measurable operational and client value.
Skilled at influencing senior stakeholders, resolving competing priorities, and making timely decisions with incomplete information.
Strong understanding of change leadership and technology adoption, with the judgment to set direction and hold accountable the leader responsible for day-to-day adoption execution.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead effectively in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.
EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.
Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying:
“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.” – Revenue Specialist
“I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented and flexible, along with understanding the balance of work, life, and fun.” – Supervisor, Operations

jobs.title: SVP of Software Development & Technology
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage is one of the nation’s leading direct mortgage lenders, driven by innovation, data, and a relentless focus on customer experience. For more than two decades, we have redefined how consumers access mortgage financing by combining digital technology with a high-performance sales organization. As AmeriSave continues expanding across mortgage, home equity, and consumer lending products, technology remains a core competitive advantage.
Position Summary
AmeriSave is seeking a Senior Vice President of Software Development & Technology to lead and scale our engineering organization across Marketing Technology, Sales Technology, Operations Technology, Automation, AI, and Enterprise Platforms.
This executive leader will oversee multiple engineering teams and engineering leaders while driving technology strategy, architecture, innovation, and execution across the company. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with exceptional leadership capabilities and maintains hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices.
What You'll Do
Lead software engineering functions across AmeriSave technology teams
Develop and execute technology strategy aligned with business objectives
Oversee engineering leaders responsible for Marketing, Operations, Sales, and Enterprise Technology
Drive large-scale platform modernization and architectural initiatives
Establish engineering standards, governance, and development best practices
Lead AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
Partner closely with Executive Leadership to identify strategic technology opportunities
Ensure scalability, security, compliance, and reliability across all platforms
Build and mentor high-performing engineering management teams
Drive delivery excellence, innovation, and operational efficiency throughout the organization
Evaluate emerging technologies and make strategic investment recommendations
Own engineering budget planning, resource allocation, and organizational growth
What You Bring
Required Qualifications
15+ years of progressive software engineering experience
8+ years leading large engineering organizations
Proven success leading Directors, VPs, and Engineering Managers
Deep hands-on experience with modern software architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices
Strong technical background with Java, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and enterprise application development
Experience leading AI and automation initiatives
Track record building highly scalable customer-facing and operational platforms
Demonstrated success aligning technology investments with measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
Preferred Qualifications
Mortgage, fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction experience
Experience leading remote and distributed engineering organizations
MBA and/or advanced technical degree
Experience with digital customer acquisition and marketing technology
Tech Stack
Languages:Java, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL
Architecture:API-driven architecture, microservices, cloud-based systems
Focus Areas:Marketing technology, operations technology, sales platforms, enterprise applications, AI, automation, analytics, and conversion optimization
High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet. Minimum speeds: 70/30 Mbps (basic), 200-300/35-70 Mbps (shared), 500-1,000/100+ Mbps (heavy use).

jobs.title: Director, Global Total Rewards, People Operations & HR Technology
jobs.text:
Clinigen is seeking an experienced global People leader to lead Total Rewards and the operational infrastructure behind an effective employee experience.
In this role, you will shape global compensation, benefits and incentive programs while also leading People Operations, HR systems, payroll governance, workforce data and reporting. You will help create a simpler, more scalable model that equips leaders with reliable insights and enables employees and managers to navigate core People processes effectively.
This is a visible, hands-on leadership role for someone who can connect strategy, systems, data and disciplined execution.
What You Will Do
Develop and execute Clinigen’s global Total Rewards strategy.
Lead global compensation, benefits, recognition, mobility and annual reward processes.
Support executive compensation, incentive design and Remuneration Committee activity.
Lead People Operations and improve core employee lifecycle processes and service delivery.
Own the People systems roadmap, including HRIS implementation, integration, optimization, controls and adoption.
Expand employee and manager self-service and automate high-volume processes.
Establish workforce data standards and improve data quality across systems and processes.
Create executive dashboards and recurring reporting that turn workforce data into clear business insights.
Partner with Finance on headcount, organizational and people-cost reporting.
Provide governance and oversight for global payroll controls, providers, issue resolution and compliance.
Lead and develop a team spanning Rewards and People Operations.
Partner across HR, Finance, IT, Legal and the business to deliver practical, scalable solutions.

jobs.title: Head of IT Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
Asana is hiring a Head of IT Systems Engineering to lead the team that powers how every Asana employee works. Reporting to the Head of IT, this San Francisco-based leader owns the strategy, architecture, and operations behind our SaaS productivity applications, corporate endpoints, identity, and user lifecycle, setting the standards and roadmap that keep every employee secure and productive. You will also influence the way Asana evaluates, adopts, and governs the tools and platforms our employees rely on. You will be responsible for the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, who deliver this work. This role has one manager level report.
You ask good questions, are confident in not knowing everything, and would rather build with others than go it alone. You are crisp and detail oriented, but comfortable working outside the boundaries when the situation calls for it. You bring a proven record of success, a passion for technology, and, like us, you value hard work and fun in equal measure.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Develop the multi-year vision, roadmap, and architecture for Systems Engineering, aligned with Asana’s business priorities and Asana’s broader AI strategy
Accelerate an Agentified Asana, helping teams across Asana embrace our tools and reduce the friction of manual work.
Partner with leaders across Asana to build and maintain an efficient and effective portfolio of SaaS tools to enable all Asanas to do their best work.
Lead, develop, and grow the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, including hiring, performance management, succession planning, and career development
Own the strategy and operation of corporate endpoint management, SaaS application management, identity, and the full user lifecycle
Drive IT’s AI strategy, from evaluating and governing platforms such as Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI to building AI agents and automation for onboarding, access requests, support, and compliance workflows
Partner with Security, Legal, and Privacy to set AI usage policies, data access controls, and vendor risk standards, including identity-based access and data loss prevention for AI tools and integrations
Set client platform standards and drive excellence in system performance, patching, and configuration compliance
Partner with IT Support, IT Infrastructure, and Security leadership to resolve issues, reduce risk, and improve the employee experience
Represent Systems Engineering to senior stakeholders, communicating priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly
About you
10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years directly leading teams of systems engineers and software engineers in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment
Proven ownership of purchasing, inventory management, and budgeting at scale
Strong, hands-on knowledge of current IAM practices and cloud-based identity, SSO, SAML, and SCIM
Experience with hosted cloud applications, including Okta, Google Workspace, Asana, Figma, and Slack
Experience establishing governance for emerging technology, including AI usage policy, data protection, and vendor risk review
Track record of setting strategy and roadmaps, then delegating effectively while staying close enough to the details to coach and unblockExperience with configuration management and automation tools such as JAMF, Intune, Puppet, and Munki
Working knowledge of scripting and API integration (REST, OAuth, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent)
Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, and OpenAI, including deployment, administration, and integration through APIs, connectors, and MCP servers
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
How you work
A strong mix of problem solving and a positive, service-oriented attitude
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
Curiosity and a bias toward experimenting with AI in your own work, and the ability to lead a team through rapid change
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $252,000 - $296,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

jobs.title: Director, Product Sourcing
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Position Summary
The Director, Product Sourcing is responsible for developing and executing global sourcing strategies that support new product introduction (NPI), product lifecycle management, supplier development, and supply continuity across a complex semiconductor equipment portfolio. This leader partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, and Business Unit teams to drive innovation, mitigate risk, improve supplier performance, and enable scalable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute global product sourcing and category strategies aligned with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and operational priorities.
Lead sourcing activities across the product lifecycle, from concept and NPI through production ramp and end-of-life management.
Drive supplier selection, qualification, development, and performance management to optimize quality, delivery, cost, innovation, and risk.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with strategic suppliers and lead complex commercial negotiations and long-term agreements.
Partner with Engineering to support design-for-supply-chain initiatives, supplier technology alignment, component standardization, and value engineering opportunities.
Lead cross-functional efforts to ensure material readiness, supply continuity, and successful execution of NPI and engineering change initiatives.
Develop strategies that strengthen supply chain resilience, mitigate risk, and address capacity, quality, and availability challenges.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global sourcing organization while fostering collaboration across key business functions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational performance, supplier effectiveness, and total cost of ownership.
Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering Management, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering strongly preferred.
12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, operations, or engineering leadership within semiconductor, semiconductor capital equipment, or other advanced technology manufacturing environments.
5+ years of experience leading sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or engineering teams.
Proven experience supporting complex NPI programs, product lifecycle management, and global supplier networks.
Strong background in category management, supplier strategy, contract negotiations, and cross-functional leadership.
Demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders and driving business results in a global environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Semiconductor capital equipment industry experience.
Product or equipment engineering background.
Experience leading global sourcing organizations.
Advanced knowledge of supplier quality, commodity management, and supply chain risk mitigation.
Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP systems.
APICS/ASCM, CPSM, Lean Six Sigma, or related certifications.
Leadership Profile
The ideal candidate is a strategic, results-oriented leader with strong business acumen, technical credibility, and executive presence. They excel at building supplier partnerships, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and developing sourcing strategies that enable growth, innovation, and operational excellence.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader with strong experience in adtech, martech, media technology, or commercially relevant customer data environments. This person will guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. The role combines data-platform and solution architecture, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership—bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will lead the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure. Snowflake is central to the environment, but the role requires working knowledge of the broader modern data ecosystem, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, cloud infrastructure, analytics, governance, and activation tools.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable adtech and data solutions, support pre-sales technical strategy, and determine when a client need should be addressed through a custom solution, a repeatable capability, or a scalable data product.
This is a working leadership role for a strong data-platform technologist with commercial instincts. The person will set direction and manage the function while remaining close enough to the technology and client work to evaluate architecture, troubleshoot complex issues, shape solutions, and translate technical concepts into clear, natural language for clients and internal stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
• Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
• Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
• Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, data quality, documentation, and data-product performance
• Drive the continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and the surrounding data ecosystem, making sound decisions across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, cloud, analytics, and activation tools
• Own and evolve the data-platform and data-product roadmap, balancing infrastructure reliability, client needs, commercial opportunities, technical debt, and longer-term platform investments
• Provide clear recommendations to company leadership on platform investments, staffing needs, delivery risks, technical priorities, and opportunities to expand or productize Statara’s capabilities
Solution Architecture & Strategy
• Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through architecture, high-level design, validation, and delivery planning
• Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
• Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases, including when to convert custom work into repeatable capabilities or data products
Client & Pre-Sales Support
• Partner with Business Development to qualify and shape opportunities, clarify technical requirements, assess feasibility, and support proposals, demonstrations, and solution walkthroughs
• Participate in client and executive conversations as a technical resource, translating complex adtech and data concepts into clear business language, practical recommendations, and measurable value
• Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
• Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
• Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
• Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
• Establish practical standards for data governance, security, documentation, observability, and quality that are appropriate to Statara’s size and client commitments
Cross-Functional Alignment
• Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Business Development to align solution designs with platform capabilities, client expectations, commercial potential, and delivery realities
• Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
• Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams, ensuring that proposed solutions are both technically credible and commercially useful
What Success Looks Like
• The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear priorities, strong execution, practical management, and alignment to company objectives
• Snowflake and the surrounding data ecosystem are reliable, well-maintained, and evolving through sound platform and tooling decisions
• Adtech and data opportunities are qualified and scoped accurately, with strong technical grounding, commercial relevance, and clear client-facing explanations
• Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
• Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
• Company leadership receives clear, practical recommendations on platform investment, staffing, risk, and productization opportunities
• Custom solutions increasingly become repeatable capabilities or scalable data products where the market opportunity and delivery model support it
