jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Job Title: Head of Engineering
Location: Cumbernauld
Contract and working pattern: On site, permanent
Are you ready to Be Your Best Barr None?
Lets Grow!!!
We are all about Being Your Best Barr None and having a career with real Moments that Matter!
Employing around 950 people across the UK, we are proud to be a responsible business that takes care of our people, values diversity, gives something back to our communities and works to minimise our environmental impact.
For 150 years AG Barr has been building great brands and is home to some of the nations favourite flavours.
At our core is IRN-BRU, launched in 1901 and still going strong today, the vibrant RUBICON fruit based brand, Boost making every moment better with a caffeine kick, hydration hit or tasty treat, and FUNKIN where real fruit means authentic taste.
We also have a number of exciting owned brands within our portfolio including MOMA, which crafts quality oats into great tasting oat drinks and porridges.
There's never been a better time to join us!
What we’re looking for…
As a Head of Engineering, you will champion world-class manufacturing performance at our flagship site, combining strategic vision with a visible, sleeves-rolled-up approach on the factory floor!
Reporting directly to the Site Director and sitting on the Site Leadership Team, you will set the engineering agenda, drive multi-million-pound capital projects, and pioneer continuous improvement across high-speed packaging lines. Just as importantly, you are a grounded leader who stays close to the action—ready to step down onto the line shoulder-to-shoulder with your technicians during critical overhauls or complex faults. If you are an empowering, technically astute leader who can command the boardroom while earning genuine respect on the shop floor, we want to hear from you.
Your responsibilities will include…
Strategic Leadership & Budget Ownership: Partner with the Site Director to set engineering strategy and execute the site budget, balancing cost control with high-availability manufacturing goals.
Asset Reliability & Proactive Maintenance: Drive plant uptime, MTBF, and OEE by evolving PPM routines, overhaul planning, and modernising engineering stores and inventory control.
Hands-On Floor Support & Technical Mentorship: Maintain an active presence on the line, stepping in alongside shift teams to resolve complex breakdowns, guide line-side troubleshooting, and model operational excellence.
Capital Project Delivery: Lead end-to-end Capex programmes from business case justification and equipment procurement through to on-site installation and successful commissioning.
Cross-Functional CI & Efficiency: Collaborate daily with Production Managers to embed TPM and Lean methodologies, reduce changeover times, and eliminate recurring operational bottlenecks.
Culture, Coaching & Matrix Leadership: Inspire and develop both core site engineers and shift-based teams, fostering an inclusive, high-accountability environment focused on technical growth.
Safety, Quality & Regulatory Compliance: Act as site champion for Quality, Safety, and Environment (QSE), managing statutory compliance, contractor safe systems of work, and site utility resilience.
What you’ll bring...
The successful candidate will have;
Extensive engineering management experience leading teams within a high-speed FMCG or Food & Beverage manufacturing environment.
Proven ability to balance strategic management with a hands-on, line-side presence when technical escalations and critical overhauls require direct support.
Deep technical expertise in high-speed packaging equipment, automated bottling/canning lines, and modern asset reliability/PPM systems.
Track record of scoping, managing, and delivering multi-million-pound capital projects safely, on budget, and on schedule.
Proven leadership capability to mentor shift technicians, influence cross-functional operations, and drive a culture of continuous improvement.
NEBOSH qualification (Certificate or Diploma) with comprehensive knowledge of machinery safety and contractor management regulations.
And it would also be great if you can demonstrate:
A degree in an engineering discipline alongside hands-on proficiency with CMMS platforms (e.g., Mainsaver) and AutoCad.
Formal accreditation or practical mastery in Lean/TPM methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, SMED, 5S, root-cause 8D analysis).
Prior experience managing site infrastructure, facilities, and utilities (effluent, steam, compressed air, refrigeration) within an ISO-accredited plant (9001, 14001).
What we offer…
We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive culture where your voice can be heard. Our skilled, loyal and committed people are critical to the future success of AG Barr which is why we are continually investing in our employees to develop their talent.
We look after our employees by offering a competitive salary and benefits package which includes;
Competitive salary, benchmarked to market
Annual bonus linked to business and individual performance
Defined contribution Pension with employer contribution
Up to 34 days holiday (depending on shift pattern)
Flexible holiday trading
Flexible cash pot to spend on benefits
Healthcare Cash Plan
Flexible benefits e.g. discounts & cashbacks, gym memberships, technology purchases etc
Life assurance
Save as you earn scheme
Staff sales discount
Free AG Barr products throughout your working day and staff sales
Ongoing professional development and access to Learning and Development programmes and content
And much more!
To find out more about what it is like to work for AG Barr, please visit our careers platform here.
We are an equal opportunities employer and happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments that may be needed for successful candidates with a disability, health or mental health condition.
While we have highlighted our ideal requirements for this role, we are realistic that the successful candidate probably won't meet every single requirement in this advert, but we are big advocates of people growing in role. So even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to submit an application - you may be just what we are looking for! Apply now!
Speculative CVs from agencies will not be accepted.
Please note, we may close vacancies early where we receive significant numbers of applications, so apply now!

jobs.title: Director, Global Digital & Technology Systems
jobs.text:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
General Description:
BeOne Medicines Global Research and Development Technology Solutions (GRDTS) team is seeking a motivated, enthusiastic, and experienced Digital & Technology Systems Director to join our Development Technology team. The director, Global Digital & Technology Systems will own the end-to-end system management life cycle of the portfolio of external systems and solutions used by the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) function at BeOne.
The ideal candidate should bring deep knowledge of the clinical space and experience working in Cloud/SaaS environments with the ability to manage multiple projects across different functions in a global, geographically diverse environment. The candidate should also be experienced at running technology projects from a strategy, technology, security, process, finance, and people management standpoint. As a system owner, the individual must demonstrate a strong understanding of system lifecycle management and be able to provide technical expertise while guiding system administration activities. Additionally, they should be adept at fostering collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the system aligns with organizational goals and meets regulatory requirements.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Accountable for the entire lifecycle management of all external Global Clinical Operations (GCO) applications and platforms.
Responsible for end-to-end system management and oversight of all GCO external systems:
Implementation and delivery of systems/applications and projects that meet GCO business needs, including key initiatives to support GCO goals and objectives.
Provide data, digital, and technology systems expertise to GCO stakeholders for their domain related needs.
Coordinate and drive system maintenance such as security patching, version upgrades, enhancements and configuration changes focused on improving business processes, addressing gaps, and enabling automation and organizational growth.
Collaborate with GCO and GRDTS leadership to develop long-term strategies for external systems enhancements and technology investments.
Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop business cases that justify and prioritize system initiatives, ensuring alignment with the overall business plan.
Develop and manage budget around external systems ensuring alignment with organization objectives and cost-efficiency.
Ensure data integrity, security, and proper governance of information processed through external systems.
Coordinate and manage incident response for external system issues, ensuring timely resolution and communication with stakeholders.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to system architecture, functionality, and operational procedures.
Provide guidance and support to end-users, facilitating training programs to enhance system utilization and productivity.
Identify potential risks related to GCO external systems, establish mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Engage and collaborate with third-party vendors, service providers, and stakeholders to manage contracts, performance and service level agreements (SLAs).
Foster collaboration across functions to ensure seamless integration of clinical systems with corporate enterprise systems, thereby enhancing overall operational effectiveness.
Collaboration within GRDTS:
Collaborate with other GRDTS capabilities & teams, including Technology & Systems Engineering, GRDTS Operations to deliver solutions for the GCO function within allocated budgets.
Ensure all GCO-related systems and data platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal functional & Enterprise policies including security policies.
Liaise with computer system vendors, IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities.
Work within a framework and operating model that supports the current and future technology needs for GCO, that comprises requirements management, solutioning, build, implementation, and administration (run) of global Development platforms, master data, and system interfaces
GRDTS GCO Systems Management Team Leadership:
Team Leadership & Talent Development:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GCO Systems Management team focused on end-to-end system lifecycle management for all external GCO systems and platforms.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and drive professional development.
Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:
Ensure all systems and platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal security policies.
Liaise with vendors, Enterprise IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities
Ensure the team is trained in and embeds CSV, compliance, and health authority requirements into operational activities.
Collaboration & Partnership:
Collaborate with R&D functions and teams on standards and best practices to attain business goals
Engage with peers to define, sponsor, and execute continuous improvements.
Qualifications:
10+ years of experience working on validated applications in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment, primarily clinical applications and/or systems management in a pharmaceutical or medical device industry especially in CTMS, eTMF, IRT, EDC, SSU management.
8+ years of experience working in a GxP or regulated environment with a strong understanding of SLC methodology, 21CFR Part 11 and GAMP principles.
5+ years of proven leadership at a senior level managing a team of direct reports and associate staff
Proven experience in overseeing the direction, planning, installation, implementation, and maintenance of software solutions especially in the SaaS/Hybrid cloud environment.
Good working knowledge of O365, active directory technology and schema, and SaaS to SaaS application integration framework.
Working knowledge of IaaS (Amazon Web Services, Azure) PaaS and SaaS architectures and technology options a plus.
Extensive experience in business and technical analysis, including developing requirements and translating them into data-driven and technical solutions
Strong expertise in data management practices, including data integrity, accuracy, and reliability
Significant experience delivering technical projects and managing multiple initiatives across diverse functions in a global environment
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to several technology areas, demonstrating a proactive approach to industry trends and innovations
Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Manage team members (employees and contingent workers) at global sites, including coaching and mentoring of staff with training and professional development.
· Must be an effective leader and communicator and considered to be a developer of people comfortable working with a broad cross-section of people in direct and matrixed relationships.
Key Capabilities
Strategic System Roadmap: Translating long-term clinical objectives into a multi-year system capability roadmap for external GCO systems.
Clinical & Technical Translation: Fluency in "clinical domain speak" related to GCO to accurately translate complex clinical workflows into structural, technical system and data requirements.
Stakeholder Orchestration & Influence: Navigating a matrixed environment to align with various clinical functions, internal IT groups, and external vendors around external systems standards.
Solution Lifecycle Oversight: Managing the end-to-end delivery of digital & technology systems & solutions—from initial scoping and vendor selection through deployment and value realization.
Key Competencies
Pharma Industry R&D Domain Literacy: Understanding of the pharmaceutical research and development value chain, mainly for the Clinical Operations function.
AI & Data Literacy: Comprehensive understanding of how AI solutions integrate within external systems and platforms, including knowledge of machine learning lifecycles, foundational models, and the requirements for "AI-ready data" to ensure effective clinical systems implementations and management.
Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate the business value proposition of external systems and platforms to clinical leadership, helping them understand the strategic roadmap and how the platform aligns with organizational goals and objectives
Key Deliverables
GCO function Data, Digital, & Technology Roadmap for external systems: Short-term and long-term strategic blueprint mapping technology solutions directly to clinical capability milestones.
Business Capability Maps: Visual matrices mapping out current-state vs. future-state technical capabilities across GCO, and relationships to other functions.
Product Requirements Documents (PRDs): Detailed, prioritized functional and technical requirement backlogs that can be used by the Systems Engineering team to integrate or enhance platforms.
Conceptual design & specification documents for existing GCO platforms & systems and its interactions with other systems.
Vendor Selection & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Briefs: Formal evaluations, technical scores, and business cases for onboarding specialized vendor platforms or niche scientific AI tools.
Platform Operating Models: Governance structures co-authored with the Systems Engineering capability & GTS to ensure GCO platforms remain stable, highly available, and optimized during production runs.
Delivery & launch of AOP projects based on approved requirements, specifications, development activities & implementation plans.
Other Qualifications:
Strong process improvement skills and orientation.
Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language.
Must have proven business and technology skills, with success providing customer-oriented technology solutions environment.
Travel:
Education Required:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology

The candidate should also be experienced at running technology projects from a strategy, technology, security, process, finance, and people management standpoint. As a system owner, the individual must demonstrate a strong understanding of system lifecycle management and be able to provide technical expertise while guiding system administration activities. Additionally, they should be adept at fostering collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the system aligns with organizational goals and meets regulatory requirements.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Accountable for the entire lifecycle management of all external Global Clinical Operations (GCO) applications and platforms.
Responsible for end-to-end system management and oversight of all GCO external systems:
Implementation and delivery of systems/applications and projects that meet GCO business needs, including key initiatives to support GCO goals and objectives.
Provide data, digital, and technology systems expertise to GCO stakeholders for their domain related needs.

Coordinate and drive system maintenance such as security patching, version upgrades, enhancements and configuration changes focused on improving business processes, addressing gaps, and enabling automation and organizational growth.
Collaborate with GCO and GRDTS leadership to develop long-term strategies for external systems enhancements and technology investments.
Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop business cases that justify and prioritize system initiatives, ensuring alignment with the overall business plan.
Develop and manage budget around external systems ensuring alignment with organization objectives and cost-efficiency.
Ensure data integrity, security, and proper governance of information processed through external systems.
Coordinate and manage incident response for external system issues, ensuring timely resolution and communication with stakeholders.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to system architecture, functionality, and operational procedures.
Provide guidance and support to end-users, facilitating training programs to enhance system utilization and productivity.
Identify potential risks related to GCO external systems, establish mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Engage and collaborate with third-party vendors, service providers, and stakeholders to manage contracts, performance and service level agreements (SLAs).
Foster collaboration across functions to ensure seamless integration of clinical systems with corporate enterprise systems, thereby enhancing overall operational effectiveness.
Collaboration within GRDTS:
Collaborate with other GRDTS capabilities & teams, including Technology & Systems Engineering, GRDTS Operations to deliver solutions for the GCO function within allocated budgets.
Ensure all GCO-related systems and data platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal functional & Enterprise policies including security policies.
Liaise with computer system vendors, IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities.

Work within a framework and operating model that supports the current and future technology needs for GCO, that comprises requirements management, solutioning, build, implementation, and administration (run) of global Development platforms, master data, and system interfaces
GRDTS GCO Systems Management Team Leadership:
Team Leadership & Talent Development:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GCO Systems Management team focused on end-to-end system lifecycle management for all external GCO systems and platforms.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and drive professional development.
Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:
Ensure all systems and platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal security policies.
Liaise with vendors, Enterprise IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities
Ensure the team is trained in and embeds CSV, compliance, and health authority requirements into operational activities.
Collaboration & Partnership:
Collaborate with R&D functions and teams on standards and best practices to attain business goals
Engage with peers to define, sponsor, and execute continuous improvements.
Qualifications:

10+ years of experience working on validated applications in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment, primarily clinical applications and/or systems management in a pharmaceutical or medical device industry especially in CTMS, eTMF, IRT, EDC, SSU management.
8+ years of experience working in a GxP or regulated environment with a strong understanding of SLC methodology, 21CFR Part 11 and GAMP principles.
5+ years of proven leadership at a senior level managing a team of direct reports and associate staff
Proven experience in overseeing the direction, planning, installation, implementation, and maintenance of software solutions especially in the SaaS/Hybrid cloud environment.
Good working knowledge of O365, active directory technology and schema, and SaaS to SaaS application integration framework.
Working knowledge of IaaS (Amazon Web Services, Azure) PaaS and SaaS architectures and technology options a plus.
Extensive experience in business and technical analysis, including developing requirements and translating them into data-driven and technical solutions
Strong expertise in data management practices, including data integrity, accuracy, and reliability
Significant experience delivering technical projects and managing multiple initiatives across diverse functions in a global environment
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to several technology areas, demonstrating a proactive approach to industry trends and innovations
Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Manage team members (employees and contingent workers) at global sites, including coaching and mentoring of staff with training and professional development.
· Must be an effective leader and communicator and considered to be a developer of people comfortable working with a broad cross-section of people in direct and matrixed relationships.
Key Capabilities
Strategic System Roadmap: Translating long-term clinical objectives into a multi-year system capability roadmap for external GCO systems.
Clinical & Technical Translation: Fluency in "clinical domain speak" related to GCO to accurately translate complex clinical workflows into structural, technical system and data requirements.
Stakeholder Orchestration & Influence: Navigating a matrixed environment to align with various clinical functions, internal IT groups, and external vendors around external systems standards.
Solution Lifecycle Oversight: Managing the end-to-end delivery of digital & technology systems & solutions—from initial scoping and vendor selection through deployment and value realization.
Key Competencies
Pharma Industry R&D Domain Literacy: Understanding of the pharmaceutical research and development value chain, mainly for the Clinical Operations function.

AI & Data Literacy: Comprehensive understanding of how AI solutions integrate within external systems and platforms, including knowledge of machine learning lifecycles, foundational models, and the requirements for "AI-ready data" to ensure effective clinical systems implementations and management.

Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate the business value proposition of external systems and platforms to clinical leadership, helping them understand the strategic roadmap and how the platform aligns with organizational goals and objectives
Key Deliverables
GCO function Data, Digital, & Technology Roadmap for external systems: Short-term and long-term strategic blueprint mapping technology solutions directly to clinical capability milestones.
Business Capability Maps: Visual matrices mapping out current-state vs. future-state technical capabilities across GCO, and relationships to other functions.
Product Requirements Documents (PRDs): Detailed, prioritized functional and technical requirement backlogs that can be used by the Systems Engineering team to integrate or enhance platforms.
Conceptual design & specification documents for existing GCO platforms & systems and its interactions with other systems.
Vendor Selection & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Briefs: Formal evaluations, technical scores, and business cases for onboarding specialized vendor platforms or niche scientific AI tools.

Platform Operating Models: Governance structures co-authored with the Systems Engineering capability & GTS to ensure GCO platforms remain stable, highly available, and optimized during production runs.
Delivery & launch of AOP projects based on approved requirements, specifications, development activities & implementation plans.
Other Qualifications:
Strong process improvement skills and orientation.
Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language.
Must have proven business and technology skills, with success providing customer-oriented technology solutions environment.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology

jobs.title: Head of Product, UX & Design (Product Owners, Experience & Creative)
jobs.text:
Company Description
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
Job Description
Role Overview
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO’s vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn’t good enough.
Reporting & Team
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
Leads:
Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology’s engineering teams.
Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Leadership & Roadmap
Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client’s three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience.
Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts.
Turn the CAIO’s vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality.
Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager.
2. The Super App & Customer Journey
Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:
Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations.
Onboarding: the resident “interviews” their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members).
Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness.
Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere.
Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don’t want to “talk to AI”.
3. UX, Interaction & Design Systems
Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays.
Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it.
Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre.
Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish.
4. Creative Direction & Brand Expression
Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets.
Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, “Nike meets Apple”, glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product.
Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners.
5. Wellness, Data & Trust
Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy.
Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design.

jobs.title: Head of Technology (Engineering, Platform & Living Systems)
jobs.text:
Company Description
Our Client is a real estate developer building AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces from the ground up, not retrofitted with gadgets. Their spaces use an intelligent agent that perceives the environment, learns its occupants, and adjusts light, air, water, sleep and surroundings toward wellness and longevity. Our Client runs a lab and experience centre, works with best-in-class technology partners, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation where technology, design and construction teams work closely together.
Job Description
Role Overview
We are seeking a hands-on, systems-minded Head of Technology to own everything that makes our client’s spaces actually work. The client is building AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces: buildings where an intelligent agent perceives the space, learns its occupants, and continuously adjusts light, air, water, sleep and environment toward wellness and longevity.
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will be the CPU of the technology organisation. You will own the engineering teams, the platform architecture, the hardware integration layer and the reliability of every system deployed, from the experimental lab to fully occupied residential towers. The CAIO sets the vision; the Head of Product, UX & Design defines what is built; you ensure it is built well, runs reliably, and scales.
This is not a slideware role. You will be expected to read code, review architecture, and stand in a half-wired lab at 10pm and know why the lights aren’t responding.
Reporting & Team
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
Key partners: Head of Product, UX & Design (product owners and roadmap); Technical Program Manager (delivery cadence); Development & Construction teams (building integration)
Leads:
Agentic Intelligence Engineering: Senior AI Systems Engineer, Backend AI Engineers, AI Systems Engineers, AI Data Analyst
App & Platform Engineering: Mobile Engineers, Frontend Engineers, Backend & Dashboards Engineers
Hardware & IoT: Smart Home & Automation Engineers, Smart Home Hardware & Operations, IoT & Wearables Engineer, Experience Centre Manager
Delivery Reliability: Quality Engineer, Deployment Engineer / Network Admin, IT Manager
Research & Development: Wellness & Longevity Specialist, Robotics Engineers, R&D AI Systems Engineer
Key Responsibilities
1. Platform Architecture & Technical Direction
Own the end-to-end architecture of the platform: device integration (Home Assistant over KNX, Zigbee, Matter/Thread and vendor ecosystems), the MQTT event bus, the data lake, the Perception backend server, and the agentic layer.
Make the architecture reusable by design: the same core must power the Work product (offices, meeting rooms, desk pods) and the Home product (apartment-by-apartment deployments), and later hospitality.
Define the local-first vs. cloud model: fast, deterministic local control for everyday actions, with frontier models (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) reserved for heavier reasoning, while respecting PII and UAE data regulations.
Lead build-vs-buy decisions. We integrate best-in-class partners (sleep tech, wearables, lighting) rather than reinventing them, and build only where it creates a durable advantage.
2. Engineering Leadership & Delivery
Build, hire and lead the engineering teams across AI, app/platform, hardware and reliability, with a bias for senior, high-ownership engineers who want to work at the frontier.
Partner with the product owners (who report to the Head of Product, UX & Design) so that every product line has a clear owner for what and a clear engineering lead for how.
Set engineering standards: code review, CI/CD, environments, documentation, and a predictable sprint cadence alongside the Technical Program Manager.
Translate the CAIO’s vision and product roadmaps into realistic technical plans, timelines and staffing.
3. Living Systems, Hardware & the Lab
Own the physical technology layer: lighting, sensors, switches, smart mirrors, speakers, cameras, wearables integration, and future robotics.
Stand up and run the lab and Experience Centre spaces. Get real switches, lights, pressure sensors and beds wired so that software teams can build against real hardware.
Drive hardware RFPs and vendor selection (e.g. Signify and other lighting/controls partners) together with procurement, and secure the technical side of exclusive partnerships.
Build digital twin simulators so that software can be developed and tested before physical spaces (e.g. a gym, spa or full apartment) exist.
4. Reliability, Security & Privacy
Own uptime and quality for every deployed space. A building of hundreds of units needs automated monitoring, telemetry, alerting and self-healing, not people on call at 2am.
Establish QA practices for hardware/software integration: functional, regression, stress and chaos testing.
Lead the privacy-first technical design for biometric and occupant data, including the early privacy impact assessment, consent and per-person data separation within a household.
Guarantee graceful degradation: every space must keep working manually (physical switches, safe defaults, emergency override) during Wi-Fi, cloud or AI outages.
Define and maintain the AI safety guardrails and kill-switch design.
5. Research & Development
Oversee R&D into wellness and longevity technology, robotics and new sensing modalities, turning promising experiments into production-ready capabilities.
Maintain a technology radar so the client stays ahead of what Apple Home, Alexa, Samsung and other developers are shipping.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About First Bus:
Are you ready to advance your career with one of the UK's leading bus operators? Join a forward-thinking company that embraces cutting-edge bus technology, from innovative mobile apps to environmentally friendly vehicles. We are passionate about delivering passenger journeys that are sustainable, comfortable, and efficient. We are at the forefront of innovation in the industry, connecting communities and shaping the future of public transport.
Position: Head of Engineering
Location: Home based with travel to our UK based portfolio of Coaching entities.
The Head of Engineering will provide senior engineering leadership across all coach operations, ensuring the consistent application of engineering standards, regulatory compliance and best practice. The role will work closely with the Managing Director Coach, Coaching Directors, General Managers, Operations teams and depot engineering leaders to drive performance, reliability and continuous improvement while supporting the business's commercial, operational and sustainability objectives.
Key Details:
Salary up to £95,000 - £100,000 DOE
Monday-Friday
The Head of Engineering is accountable for establishing and maintaining a robust engineering framework across all coach operations.
Operating as a key member of the Coach Leadership Team, the role holder will provide visible leadership across multiple businesses and locations, ensuring engineering activities support the delivery of safe, reliable and customer-focused transport services.
The role will develop and embed engineering standards, governance and continuous improvement practices while acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, compliance and fleet performance issues.
Through strong stakeholder engagement and coaching of local engineering leaders, the Head of Engineering will build engineering capability, drive operational performance and support the successful delivery of the Coach strategy.
What We're Looking For:
Significant senior engineering leadership experience within a transport, fleet, automotive, commercial vehicle, coach, bus, logistics or related engineering environment.
Extensive knowledge of vehicle engineering, maintenance management and regulatory compliance requirements.
Proven ability to lead engineering performance improvement across multiple sites or business units.
Strong understanding of engineering governance, risk management and assurance processes.
Demonstrable success in coaching and developing engineering leaders.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong commercial and financial acumen.
Experience leading transformation, change and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ability to analyse complex operational and technical data to drive performance improvements.
A strategic thinker who is equally comfortable operating at both operational and executive levels.
Professional engineering qualification or equivalent technical experience preferred.
Applicants are advised that background checks will be conducted as a standard part of our recruitment process and to comply with UK employment requirements, we ask all applicants to confirm their right to work in the UK.
Rewards:
• Your health is important to us which is why we offer Simply Health & Smart Health for you and your dependents at no cost to you! This offering includes cash-back benefits across optical & dental as well as virtual GP appointments, mental health support and nutrition and fitness advise. Our EAP provision offers 24hr, 365 days a year mental health support
• We are also committed to your financial wellbeing, and we offer a platform with many discounts on high street brands and supermarkets etc
• Working at First you also receive discounted train travel for you and your family after 6 months service as well as a free bus pass
• Free onsite parking + cycle to work scheme
• Up to 5 weeks holiday + bank holidays
• Pension scheme and chance to buy discounted FirstGroup shares

jobs.title: SVP, Engineering
jobs.text:
What We Are Looking For
We are seeking a visionary, inspirational Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale our global engineering function. They will be responsible for defining our multi-year technical strategy, leading the organization at an executive level, and ensuring the quality, performance, and resilience of our Java open-source based in-memory Real-Time Data Platform.
This role requires an executive leader who is a strategic business partner to the C-suite, a champion of engineering excellence, and a driver of enterprise-wide innovation who can balance long-term technical vision with predictable, world-class execution.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
I. Executive Technical Strategy & Product Delivery
Executive Technical Vision: Define and champion a multi-year technology strategy and architectural vision that anticipates market trends and directly aligns with the company’s long-term business objectives and revenue growth.
Product Strategy & Roadmap Co-Ownership: Collaborate at the executive level with Product Management to define, prioritize, and drive the technical direction of the product roadmap, ensuring engineering input enhances technical execution, architectural quality, commercial value, differentiated packaging, and timely delivery.
Strategic Execution & Delivery: Drive, own, and manage end-to-end engineering delivery against the product roadmap, utilizing agile methodologies to ensure rapid, predictable, and high-quality releases at an enterprise scale.
Quality & Resilience: Maintain and continuously elevate world-class standards for system quality, performance, security, and resilience across the entire platform, ensuring enterprise-grade reliability for our largest customers.
Innovation & Future-Proofing: Provide executive oversight for core technical domains (distributed systems, high-performance Java, concurrency, streaming, data structures) while aggressively evaluating and integrating emerging technologies to maintain a competitive market edge.
Resource & Investment Optimisation: Manage the engineering budget, drive ROI on technology investments, and optimize resource allocation to ensure maximum business impact and operational efficiency.
II. Open Source Software Leadership
Open Source Stewardship: Steward Hazelcast’s open-source core with a strong commitment to transparency, stability, and long-term compatibility, ensuring community trust while advancing enterprise capabilities.
Open Source/Commercial Balance: Balance the needs of commercial customers with the expectations of a global, user-led open-source community, making principled, strategic decisions about feature placement, deprecations, and roadmap visibility.
Industry Thought Leadership: Serve as a prominent voice and advocate for the company within the broader open-source and real-time data ecosystems, influencing industry standards and building strategic technological partnerships.
Community Feedback: Convert high-volume user feedback from diverse production environments into clear engineering priorities, ensuring the OSS platform remains robust, predictable, and widely adoptable.
Ecosystem: Maintain disciplined reliability across Hazelcast’s multi-language client ecosystem and seamless upgrades for all users.
Superior Developer and Operator Experience: Champion exceptional developer and operator experience, driving documentation quality, release clarity, and community engagement to strengthen Hazelcast’s ecosystem.
III. Organisational Development & Leadership
Global Executive Leadership: Lead, motivate, and manage a highly distributed, global engineering team, fostering a people-centric managerial approach and an aggressive, collaborative engineering culture. The majority of our Engineers are based in the UK with smaller teams across EMEA.
Culture & Ethos: Instill a strong product-led, innovation-led ethos within the department, guiding engineering teams to build and develop the product as a customer acquisition and value-delivery tool
Organizational Design & Scaling: Evolve and optimize the organisational structure for maximum performance, resilience, scalability, and ownership to support the company's next phase of growth.
Talent Acquisition & Leadership Development: Lead global headcount planning to ensure a right-sized, highly skilled, and diverse engineering organisation. Build a robust leadership bench and succession plan for critical technical and managerial roles.
Managerial Development: Identify, coach, mentor, and develop engineering directors and managers within the organisation, creating clear career paths for both technical and managerial career tracks.
Performance Management: Ensure teams are empowered and aligned with company goals, providing frequent, actionable, and constructive feedback to support personal development and measure team outcomes.
IV. Go-To-Market and External Partnership
Executive Collaboration: Partner closely with the CEO, and other C-level executives to report on engineering performance, technological risks, and strategic opportunities.
Executive Client Sponsorship: Serve as an executive sponsor for key enterprise accounts. Partner with Sales to engage in high-stakes C-level prospect meetings, acting as the ultimate technical authority for the company.
Developer Relations: Inspire and engage advanced developers globally, encouraging contributions to our open-source projects and fostering a vibrant technical community.
WHAT YOU HAVE
Executive Leadership: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in software engineering, with at least 7+ years operating at the VP, SVP, or CTO level, preferably in a B2B enterprise software or platform company. Demonstrated experience fostering a product-led culture and driving commercial results through engineering excellence.
Business & Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to manage large departmental budgets, optimize engineering spend, and translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for executive-level stakeholders.
Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of complex architectures, concurrent, distributed systems, high-performance compute, and real-time data architectures.
Open Source Software Expertise: Excel at balancing open-source community expectations with enterprise requirements, maintaining rigorous public API discipline, documentation standards, and governance practices. Experience nurturing a global developer and operator community—across polyglot clients, cloud-native deployments, and hybrid environments.
Global Team Management: Proven track record of successfully scaling and leading a geographically distributed, international engineering organisation of significant size.
Technical Depth: A strong foundation in the core technologies relevant to the Hazelcast platform including Java, concurrency, networking, data streaming, SQL, distributed data stores, data grids. Ability to engage deeply with Principal Engineers and Architects on complex technical designs.
Agile and Delivery: Expertise in modern agile methodologies and continuous delivery pipelines, focused on delivering product capabilities rapidly, reliably, and at scale.
Customer-Centric/Team Aligner: Comfortable working backward from the customer and working in an “open-kitchen,” GTM aligned environment.
Desired Characteristics
Strategic Visionary & Entrepreneurial Spirit: The ability to look ahead to anticipate technological shifts, while approaching the engineering function with the agility of a startup to constantly innovate and improve.
Executive Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, capable of communicating complex technical strategy to both internal teams (engineering, product) and external stakeholders (C-level customers, analysts, board).
Influence: Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries, driving alignment between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at the highest levels.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master’s or equivalent advanced degree preferred).
BENEFITS
25 days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays + Quarterly Wellbeing Days
Group Company Pension Plan
Private Medical Insurance
Private Dental Insurance
Life Insurance
EAP (Employee Assistance Program)

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology Officers Practice - Retained Search
jobs.text:
About Modern Executive Solutions
Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow.
The Opportunity
Modern Executive Solutions is seeking a high-impact Managing Director to lead the execution of retained executive search engagements with rigor, judgment, and credibility. This role is central to the success of each search, owning the day-to-day execution of the engagement and helping clients navigate to the right leadership decision through a thoughtful, consultative approach.
Working under the guidance of a Senior Partner, the Managing Director is accountable for running a successful search process from kickoff through close. This person will shape the search strategy, lead and motivate the research team, build trust with the client’s hiring stakeholders, and ensure the engagement remains on track even when conditions become complex or challenging.
The right person brings strong executive search execution skills, commercial judgment, and the emotional intelligence to know when to support, when to challenge, and when to elevate issues in a client’s process that may be limiting the outcome.
Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end execution of executive search engagements under the supervision of a Senior Partner.
Translate client needs into a clear, practical, and differentiated search strategy.
Lead the research team to develop target company lists, market maps, candidate pipelines, and search hypotheses.
Drive momentum throughout the engagement, keeping workstreams moving with pace, discipline, and accountability.
Build trusted relationships with the client hiring team through consistent communication, sound judgment, and credible counsel.
Act as a consultative advisor to clients, helping them refine role specifications, assess talent, and navigate key decision points.
Identify weaknesses, gaps, or inefficiencies in the client’s hiring process and challenge constructively when those issues may compromise the search outcome.
Motivate and direct the research team through difficult stretches of a search, especially when progress is slow or market feedback is challenging.
Synthesize market intelligence and candidate feedback into actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Ensure a high-quality candidate experience and a professional, well-managed process from first outreach through completion.
Partner closely with the Senior Partner, escalating client management challenges when appropriate while maintaining primary ownership of search execution.
Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, discretion, and follow-through across every stage of the engagement.
What Success Looks Like
Deliver search engagements with consistency, quality, and strong outcomes.
Earn the confidence of clients by combining responsiveness with honest, well-grounded counsel.
Build effective search strategies that are informed by market realities and aligned to the client’s business context.
Lead research teams with resilience, focus, and urgency, particularly when searches become difficult.
Recognize when client assumptions or process issues need to be challenged and do so with tact and credibility.
Create alignment among internal and external stakeholders to keep the search moving toward the right hire.
Ideal Profile
Significant experience in retained executive search or a closely related advisory environment.
Proven ability to run complex executive search engagements with substantial client exposure and ownership.
Strong search strategy skills, including role shaping, target identification, market mapping, and candidate assessment.
High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal judgment.
Confidence to challenge clients constructively when needed, without damaging trust or momentum.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and direct research teams through ambiguity and adversity.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information clearly and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong project management discipline, attention to detail, and commitment to execution.
Sound judgment in knowing when to handle an issue directly and when to involve a Senior Partner.
A consultative mindset with a strong bias toward accountability and outcomes.
The Team
The Managing Director will join the Chief Technology Officers Practice, an ultra high-performing team where excellence and extreme ownership are the baseline expectations. This is a fun, collaborative, and supportive environment in which colleagues are always willing to pitch in, share ideas, and help solve problems together, particularly when a search becomes challenging. At the same time, team members are expected to take full accountability for their responsibilities, maintain consistently high standards, and deliver with rigor and reliability. It is a strong fit for someone who thrives around other high performers and is energized by a culture where collaboration is valued, but ownership and excellence are non-negotiable.
Personal Characteristics
·Credible
·Calm under pressure
·Direct but tactful
·Commercially astute
·Highly accountable
·Resilient and persistent
·Collaborative
Client-oriented without being client-led
·Motivating leader
·Strong listener with good instincts
Reporting Structure
This role reports to a Senior Partner, who provides support, guidance, and intervention on more complex client management situations. While the Senior Partner remains closely involved, the Managing Director is expected to own the execution and day-to-day leadership of the search.
Why This Role Matters
The Managing Director plays a critical role in ensuring that every search is not just well run, but genuinely consultative. This is the person who brings structure to ambiguity, insight to the client conversation, energy to the internal team, and discipline to the overall process. They help clients make better leadership decisions by combining search execution excellence with sound judgment and trusted advice.
Why Modern?
Purpose-Driven Work: Join a team that is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and gives back to the community by donating 10% of annual profits to support underserved youth and educational opportunities.
Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful projects that positively impact clients’ organizations, communities, and the development of diverse leaders.
Professional Growth: Gain exposure to various aspects of the business, with opportunities for mentorship, leadership development, and career advancement.
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with a 401(k) match.
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from a flexible remote work environment, paid parental leave, and an office setup stipend to support your work-from-home needs.
Our Values
Be Bold: Think strategically, seeing implications and creative paths. Innovates commercially – seeks to understand client perspective to drive impact. Innovates internally - seeks to improve processes, procedures, and technology used within and across their teams.
Be Excellent: Deliver client ready work, with attention to detail, raising the bar of expectations within team and with data integrity to include the use of all company tools and systems. Motivated by excellence to the benefit of clients and our firm.
Be United: Be an inclusive ‘team player,’ willing to support, develop and ‘go the extra mile’ to deliver impact with others. Proactively develops trusting relationships both within and outside our firm.
Be Authentic: Demonstrate awareness, coachability and a desire to grow with continuous improvement. Motivated by a personal purpose aligned with our firm’s mission and values. Is accountable for delivery of client ready work.
Modern Executive Solutions is dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, veteran or military status or care-giver status. Please contact us at if you need assistance completing this application.

The right person brings strong executive search execution skills, commercial judgment, and the emotional intelligence to know when to support, when to challenge, and when to elevate issues in a client’s process that may be limiting the outcome.
Key Responsibilities

items: Own the end-to-end execution of executive search engagements under the supervision of a Senior Partner.
Translate client needs into a clear, practical, and differentiated search strategy.
Lead the research team to develop target company lists, market maps, candidate pipelines, and search hypotheses.
Drive momentum throughout the engagement, keeping workstreams moving with pace, discipline, and accountability.
Build trusted relationships with the client hiring team through consistent communication, sound judgment, and credible counsel.
Act as a consultative advisor to clients, helping them refine role specifications, assess talent, and navigate key decision points.
Identify weaknesses, gaps, or inefficiencies in the client’s hiring process and challenge constructively when those issues may compromise the search outcome.
Motivate and direct the research team through difficult stretches of a search, especially when progress is slow or market feedback is challenging.
Synthesize market intelligence and candidate feedback into actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Ensure a high-quality candidate experience and a professional, well-managed process from first outreach through completion.
Partner closely with the Senior Partner, escalating client management challenges when appropriate while maintaining primary ownership of search execution.
Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, discretion, and follow-through across every stage of the engagement.

blocks.text: What Success Looks Like

items: Deliver search engagements with consistency, quality, and strong outcomes.
Earn the confidence of clients by combining responsiveness with honest, well-grounded counsel.
Build effective search strategies that are informed by market realities and aligned to the client’s business context.
Lead research teams with resilience, focus, and urgency, particularly when searches become difficult.
Recognize when client assumptions or process issues need to be challenged and do so with tact and credibility.
Create alignment among internal and external stakeholders to keep the search moving toward the right hire.

blocks.text: Ideal Profile

items: Significant experience in retained executive search or a closely related advisory environment.
Proven ability to run complex executive search engagements with substantial client exposure and ownership.
Strong search strategy skills, including role shaping, target identification, market mapping, and candidate assessment.
High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal judgment.
Confidence to challenge clients constructively when needed, without damaging trust or momentum.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and direct research teams through ambiguity and adversity.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information clearly and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong project management discipline, attention to detail, and commitment to execution.
Sound judgment in knowing when to handle an issue directly and when to involve a Senior Partner.
A consultative mindset with a strong bias toward accountability and outcomes.

blocks.text: The Team

The Managing Director will join the Chief Technology Officers Practice, an ultra high-performing team where excellence and extreme ownership are the baseline expectations. This is a fun, collaborative, and supportive environment in which colleagues are always willing to pitch in, share ideas, and help solve problems together, particularly when a search becomes challenging. At the same time, team members are expected to take full accountability for their responsibilities, maintain consistently high standards, and deliver with rigor and reliability. It is a strong fit for someone who thrives around other high performers and is energized by a culture where collaboration is valued, but ownership and excellence are non-negotiable.
Personal Characteristics
·Credible
·Calm under pressure
·Direct but tactful
·Commercially astute
·Highly accountable
·Resilient and persistent
·Collaborative

items: Client-oriented without being client-led

blocks.text: ·Motivating leader
·Strong listener with good instincts
Reporting Structure

This role reports to a Senior Partner, who provides support, guidance, and intervention on more complex client management situations. While the Senior Partner remains closely involved, the Managing Director is expected to own the execution and day-to-day leadership of the search.
Why This Role Matters

The Managing Director plays a critical role in ensuring that every search is not just well run, but genuinely consultative. This is the person who brings structure to ambiguity, insight to the client conversation, energy to the internal team, and discipline to the overall process. They help clients make better leadership decisions by combining search execution excellence with sound judgment and trusted advice.
Why Modern?

Purpose-Driven Work: Join a team that is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and gives back to the community by donating 10% of annual profits to support underserved youth and educational opportunities.
Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful projects that positively impact clients’ organizations, communities, and the development of diverse leaders.
Professional Growth: Gain exposure to various aspects of the business, with opportunities for mentorship, leadership development, and career advancement.
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with a 401(k) match.
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from a flexible remote work environment, paid parental leave, and an office setup stipend to support your work-from-home needs.
Our Values

Be Bold: Think strategically, seeing implications and creative paths. Innovates commercially – seeks to understand client perspective to drive impact. Innovates internally - seeks to improve processes, procedures, and technology used within and across their teams.

Be Excellent: Deliver client ready work, with attention to detail, raising the bar of expectations within team and with data integrity to include the use of all company tools and systems. Motivated by excellence to the benefit of clients and our firm.

Be United: Be an inclusive ‘team player,’ willing to support, develop and ‘go the extra mile’ to deliver impact with others. Proactively develops trusting relationships both within and outside our firm.

Be Authentic: Demonstrate awareness, coachability and a desire to grow with continuous improvement. Motivated by a personal purpose aligned with our firm’s mission and values. Is accountable for delivery of client ready work.

Modern Executive Solutions is dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, veteran or military status or care-giver status. jobs.title: VP, Product Design
jobs.text:
About Us
Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs.
About the Role
The Athletic is redefining what a sports app is. We need a design leader who is hands-on, opinionated, and genuinely obsessed with sports, with a clear vision for what the "essential sports app" becomes over the next several years.
This role is reporting into our Chief Product Officer.
This role is 100% remote for candidates based in the United States or Canada.
Responsibilities
Product vision and prototyping the future. We want working prototypes and opinionated concepts that demonstrate what the next-generation sports app looks like, and where the biggest opportunity is for us to lead. You own the process and the design output behind ongoing strategic visioning with cross-functional leadership, driving toward decisions the exec team rallies behind.
A strategic voice in product direction, with real weight in the business. You bring informed, data-backed points of view to planning, and help design shape where the product goes. You partner directly with the VP Eng, the VP Data, and the CPO on the business priorities and metrics that matter, and you make sure design has a seat at the table.
Day-to-day craft leadership. You stay in the work: reviewing flows, jumping into Figma, and prototyping directly alongside your team.
AI-native transformation of the design practice. You set the direction for how design works in an AI-native world, covering tools, workflows, and team structure, so that velocity and craft rise together.
Org leadership and performance. You build, coach, and manage a design org (~10) that can operate at this level, with clear accountability for what each team and person delivers.
Collaboration. You are part of the leadership team of The Athletic. As such, your role goes beyond “design” and you work hand in hand with the other leads (engineering, product, data, marketing, commercial etc.).
Requirements
Someone who is a sports fan first, who uses the product, has opinions about it, and lets that passion show up in the work.
A design leader with a track record of hands-on craft at senior levels. We want to see recent, personal work.
Experience leading a design org through a step-change in how it works, ideally involving AI tooling and workflow, at a company shipping consumer product at scale.
Strong, well-argued opinions about what makes a sports product, or a comparable habit-forming consumer product, great, along with the conviction to defend them in a room of product and engineering leaders.
Comfort operating in ambiguity.
Nice to have: experience starting or running your own company or side project.
This is a remote-based role requiring some regular travel.
The annual base salary range for this role is $270,000.00 - $295,000.00 USD. The total compensation offered for this position may vary based on factors such as education, experience, skills, and location. It may also include non-cash rewards and benefits. The base salary range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.
For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process. If you are a candidate for a technical role, we will let you know what specific tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

The Athletic will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
