jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.
You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.
This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.
Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.
Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
AI and agentic product
Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Portfolio and operating model
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.
Team and accountability
Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.
In the first week, expect to:
Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.
In the first three months, expect to:
Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.
In the first year, expect to:
Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.
You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.
You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.
This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering
Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Team, resourcing, and accountability
Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.
Platform and execution
Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.
In the first week, expect to:
Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.
In the first three months, expect to:
Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Head of AI Solutions & Engineering  - Technology & Innovation
jobs.text:
Position Summary
To advance Teach For All’s 25-year vision, we are seeking a strategic AI leader developer to join our Technology & Innovation team and work globally to identify and implement transformative technology solutions to accelerate the impact of our global network.
This role will work across the network with partners or groups of partners in order to identify and deliver transformative AI-forward technology products to accelerate network impact, as well as internally across the global organization to increase efficiency and effectiveness of our work. The successful candidate will also be responsible for helping build and cultivate a community of technology enthusiasts across the network made up of network staff members, fellows and alumni who will contribute to these projects.
About the Team
The Technology & Innovation Team provides thought-leadership and solutions as well as foundational support in the use of technology to unlock potential and accelerate impact across the organization and the global network. The team leverages a deep understanding of the work and needs of the global organization, its teams and partners, our own expertise and global best practice to provide targeted solutions and technologies to accelerate our global impact. You will play a key role in this work.
Outcomes
Identifying and delivering key AI-forward technologies for network partners to support their work. These may include tools for common needs across the network – classroom data collection, professional development of fellows, scheduling and management of Assessment Centers (where teaching fellows are selected) or new platforms (connectivity tools, online learning) - which are identified and scoped in partnership with our network partners. Many if not all of these technologies will include AI components.
Similarly, identifying and delivering technology solutions to increase the impact of the global organization. This could include improvements to ourlearning portals for network staff, fellows and alumni, an online platform enabling teachers and teacher coaches across and beyond our network to engage in our global professional development learning community, or a new global “constituent voice” system that enables all our network partners to surface feedback from key constituents in ways that strengthen global learning loops.
Taking an AI-forward approach to increase organizational effectiveness, increase our impact in supporting network partners in their work, and evolve our systems and ways of working to incorporate new tools and technologies.
Successful management of two solutions engineers and a UI/UX specialist to deliver your ambitious strategy and goals.
Key Responsibilities :
Strategy Development
Working across network partners and internal stakeholders including our AI and Ed Tech Initiative team to build context and identify key potential technology solutions to accelerate impact
Developing a responsive and evolving strategy to prioritize and develop these key technologies, working closely with the Technology & Innovation team and key senior stakeholders to invest them in the strategy
Providing regular updates internally and externally regarding progress, and regularly revisiting and modifying the solutions strategy as needs change
Requirements Gathering, Analysis and Execution
Gathering requirements for prioritized projects through stakeholder interviews and discussion, ensuring that all projects are accessible, inclusive of the various needs of the network and sustainable for all network partners
Synthesizing requirements and developing holistic solutions to meet the needs of your stakeholders, ensuring that key needs and requirements are met within project and budgetary constraints
Working both individually and collaboratively across the Technology & Innovation team and any external vendors or collaborators needed to develop and deliver prioritized solutions
Ensuring that end users are trained and supported along with the Technology & Innovation Operations team
Identifying key metrics and measures of success, and reporting on those throughout the phases of each project
Identifying and managing key improvements through user and stakeholder interviews
Team Management
Lead a team of 2 within the broader Technology & Innovation team to deliver on your solutions strategy for the organization and broader network
Community Building and Management
Supplementing the work of the AI and Ed Tech Initiative team, helping develop a community of technology enthusiasts across the network, and working across key stakeholders internally and throughout the network to share best practice and amplify the impact of community members
Where possible, involving the community members in the development of the technology solutions identified as part of the three year strategy
Encouraging and supporting community-developed solutions
Qualifications
Computer Science or related degree and/or equivalent years of formal training and experience, with a clear track record of delivering AI-forward solutions in a broad range of contexts
7+ years of relevant working experience, including designing and delivering AI-powered solutions, with a proven portfolio showcasing high-impact, scalable implementations across diverse contexts
Strong experience with AI libraries and frameworks, as well as associated Typescript and Python skills
REST-based API integration experience, preferably including experience with popular Generative AI APIs and libraries
Proficiency in Git and other version control systems is essential, with a proven ability to effectively manage code repositories, track changes, and collaborate with team members using branching, merging, and pull request workflows.
Ability to design easy to use and compelling user interfaces and experiences
Experience with Cloud Technologies, including Google Cloud
Comfort and experience in engaging with new technologies
Participation in open-source development projects and communities
An understanding of working with technology in bandwidth-constrained environments
Passion about Education, AI and Ed Tech
History of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
Strong business analyst skills, communications skills and ability to manage multiple diverse stakeholders
Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
Deeply committed to the mission, vision and values of Teach For All
Additional desirable skills/experiences
Comfort and curiosity in engaging with new and emerging technologies
Participation in open-source development projects and communities
Experience working in bandwidth-constrained environments
Passion for Education, AI and EdTech
Proven track record of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
Strong alignment with and commitment to the mission, vision, and values of Teach For All
What Teach For All Offers:
Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
All roles are 100% remote; in some locations we offer the option for in-office collaborations
Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
And much more!
Compensation
This role is a three-year fixed term contract. Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.
Work Authorization
This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.
Travel and Hours
Travel up to 20% is possible when it is safe to do so and in accordance with local travel guidelines. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role. This role will communicate and work globally regardless of location.
Apply now
If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all
About Teach For All
Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

These may include tools for common needs across the network – classroom data collection, professional development of fellows, scheduling and management of Assessment Centers (where teaching fellows are selected) or new platforms (connectivity tools, online learning) - which are identified and scoped in partnership with our network partners. Many if not all of these technologies will include AI components.

Similarly, identifying and delivering technology solutions to increase the impact of the global organization. This could include improvements to ourlearning portals for network staff, fellows and alumni, an online platform enabling teachers and teacher coaches across and beyond our network to engage in our global professional development learning community, or a new global “constituent voice” system that enables all our network partners to surface feedback from key constituents in ways that strengthen global learning loops.

Taking an AI-forward approach to increase organizational effectiveness, increase our impact in supporting network partners in their work, and evolve our systems and ways of working to incorporate new tools and technologies.
Successful management of two solutions engineers and a UI/UX specialist to deliver your ambitious strategy and goals.

jobs.text:
Job Title: Senior Director, Data Management - South Africa - Remote
Job Location: Cape Town, South Africa
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Who we are
We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.
We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.
Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.
Why Worldwide
We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!
SUMMARY: To provide strategic leadership and technical expertise to the Data Management department. To establish the optimal operational framework for the department ensuring data management deliverables are completed to a high quality and within agreed timelines** leveraging and anticipating regulatory and industry changes.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
Provide global innovative and creative leadership of the department, across several sites and countries, including setting strategic direction and leading change.
Plan and develop overall strategies for the future of the Data Management and Database Programming department including system and resource needs.
Assume overall responsibility for the efficiency of the Data Management department, utilizing metrics on quality and efficiency and feedback from internal and external customers.
Monitor departmental budgets and have oversight of project PPR’s, ensuring DM staff are adhering to trial budgets and timelines
To be responsible for staff allocation within the Department, ensuring sufficient expertise and delegating responsibility appropriately.
Supervise, coach and mentor Data Management staff, undertaking performance appraisals and development reviews as appropriate.
Identify the Department’s training requirements and to provide or source training as and when required.
Provide expert advice on Data Management issues for either general processes or project specific details.
Design solutions to enable Data Management, and to ensure related clinical trial management and clinical data requirements are met
Ensure self and team liaise with technology and other scientific/medical colleagues
Point of contact and escalation for Sponsor personnel.
Ensure that Data Management departmental SOPs and other non-project-specific procedures/ working guidelines are written and updated as required.
Ensure the Data Management team performs in accordance with Good Clinical Practice guidelines, departmental SOPs, and guidelines, and to the agreed requirements of the Sponsor.
Ensure support is provided to all Business Development activities including input and review of bids and proposals and representing Data Management at Bid Defence meetings.
Provide technical advice and support on Data Management topics to other departments.
Represent Data Management within Worldwide, ensuring that the department’s capabilities and expertise are well represented.
To fully co-operate with the auditors of the Sponsor company and any other staff from the regulatory authorities both during and after the project to ensure that any recommendations are discussed with senior management as appropriate and that any recommendations are incorporated
Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.
*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:*
A good standard of written and spoken English
Excellent time management skills with ability to work to and direct project plans
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects simultaneously; flexible and able to use sound independent judgment and take initiative to assess information
Proven leadership and management skills
Excellent working knowledge of Data Management Systems and principles
*REQUIREMENTS:*
Educated to degree level or equivalent
12 relevant Data Management experience.
Clinical drug development experience including experience in software or application development and deployment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong attention to detail are essential.
Proven ability to design and/or develop Data Management solutions deployed in clinical trials.
Good knowledge of guidelines and regulations relevant to the deployment of technologies and programming in clinical development programs.
Excellent Time Management skills with ability to develop, follow and direct project plans.
Excellent knowledge of budgets, revenue recognition, and invoicing.
Organizational skills that define strategies in a way that align and contribute to the organization’s strategic plan.
Proven ability to prioritise and handle multiple projects simultaneously, a flexible and creative approach, the ability to use sound independent judgement and take initiative to assess information
Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.
We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.
To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law.

jobs.text:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Fractional CTO to join our team. This role is ideal for a hands-on technology leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and can take a product from concept to launch. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical direction of our next-generation SaaS platform, built with AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) at its core.
Key Responsibilities
Design and architect the product’s technical foundation.
Build and deliver the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
Lead the integration and experimentation with AI/LLM technologies.
Drive rapid prototyping to move from idea, working product quickly.
Ensure scalability and robustness of the product architecture.
Collaborate with founders and stakeholders to align technical execution with business goals.
Qualifications & Skills
5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior leadership role (CTO, Lead Engineer, or equivalent).
Strong hands-on coding ability (preferably full-stack).
Deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and LLM integration.
Expertise in SaaS architecture and cloud infrastructure.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in a lean, agile startup environment.
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Interested candidates should submit their CV and a short cover letter here or send an email to [] with the subject line: Fractional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Application – [Your Name]

Nucleus Ventures is a leading entity in corporate innovation, venture building, and advisory services, with a track record of successful ventures, operational advisory missions, and startup incubators. Based in Beirut, Nucleus Ventures also operates in France, the UK, and Cyprus, serving the EMEA region. The company collaborates closely with clients, leveraging subject matter experts, startups, and entrepreneurs to drive growth and innovation through tailored strategies.

jobs.title: Head of Data Practitioner
jobs.text:
(This role can be based from anywhere in Europe on a fully remote basis)
Head of Data Practitioner
What we believe
Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.
Our role
We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.
Our approach
The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
What we value
Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.
If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.
About the role
Crosslake is looking for a Head of Data to lead data engagements. In this role, you will work with private equity investors and portfolio company leadership teams to turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
You will own senior client relationships on complex data engagements, building credibility with CDOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders while leading the work from strategic diagnosis through to practical delivery.
The ideal candidate combines the breadth of a strong consulting leader with deep expertise in data strategy, data transformation and modern data platforms.
You will be expected to shape the problem, develop the data strategy, lead complex transformations, manage senior stakeholders, drive the storyline and own delivery, while credibly challenging clients and specialists on the substance of the work.
This is a role for someone who can move confidently between business, technology and data conversations, connecting strategic ambition to the data capabilities, operating-model changes, investment choices and delivery roadmap required to realise value.
Role responsibilities
Own client relationships on data engagements, establishing trusted partnerships with senior business and technology leaders and acting as a credible advisor to CDOs, CTOs and executive teams.
Lead the development of data strategies that align business priorities, value-creation opportunities, target data capabilities, technology choices, operating model and delivery roadmap.
Lead complex data transformations from diagnosis through to implementation planning, including data platform modernisation, data governance, data quality, data product and analytics initiatives.
Bring structure to ambiguous data challenges, defining the key questions, building the workplan, managing workstreams and keeping the team focused on the issues that matter most to the client.
Develop compelling executive-level narratives that synthesise analysis, client input and specialist perspectives into practical recommendations and clear decisions.
Translate effectively between commercial and technical audiences, ensuring recommendations reflect business priorities, data realities, architecture implications, delivery feasibility and execution risk.
Link data initiatives to value creation economics, including opportunity sizing, business cases, investment requirements, benefits, trade-offs and dependencies.
Challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations and identify where deeper expertise is needed across data engineering, architecture, governance, analytics, AI or transformation.
Drive engagements beyond analysis towards prioritised actions, accountable delivery plans and a pragmatic path from recommendation to execution.
What we’re looking for
Experience operating at a level comparable to a high-performing consulting Director, Associate Director or Senior Consultant, with a track record of leading complex data engagements and senior client relationships.
A strong consulting toolkit, ideally developed in a leading strategy, digital, data or transformation consultancy, or through comparable experience in high-stakes advisory or transformation environments.
Deep expertise in data strategy and data transformation, with practical experience across areas such as modern data platforms, data architecture, governance, quality, data products, analytics or AI enablement.
Proven ability to take ambiguous business and data problems, impose structure, develop hypotheses, lead rigorous analysis, manage teams and translate findings into a clear executive storyline.
Credibility with senior executives and functional leaders, including CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, CEOs and leaders across data, technology, product and transformation.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to size opportunities, build business cases, quantify benefits, understand investment needs and evaluate strategic trade-offs.
Experience leading complex data programmes or transformations, with sufficient technical depth to challenge decisions on data architecture, platforms, governance, operating models and delivery approaches.
A hands-on leadership style: senior enough to build confidence with executives, while close enough to the work to guide analysis, challenge team thinking and personally shape the strategy and storyline.
A practical, action-oriented mindset aligned with Crosslake’s values of service, curiosity, credibility, commitment and creativity.

jobs.title: VP, Global Technology Services
jobs.text:
About SH/FT
Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.
The Role
SH/FT is seeking a VP of Global Technology Services to lead and scale our technology delivery practice across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.
This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. You'll have real latitude to shape how this practice is structured, staffed, and grown.
What You’ll Lead
Client Delivery and Technical Strategy
Own technology services delivery across active engagements, ensuring technical quality, on-time delivery, and alignment to scope
Serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor to clients, translating complex architecture, engineering, and platform capabilities into clear business outcomes
Step in directly on client work where needed to protect delivery integrity - particularly on the most complex or highest-stakes engagements
Provide thought leadership in RFP and RFI responses, ensuring technical feasibility, clarity, and alignment with best practices
Establish and enforce architectural standards, delivery governance, and quality frameworks across the practice
Practice and Team Leadership
Lead, develop, and retain a team of Directors, senior architects, and engineers across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning
Set standards and best practices for system integrations and email engineering, including responsive design, rendering compatibility, templating architecture, and deployment workflows
Identify opportunities for practice innovation, including accelerators, reusable frameworks, and AI and ML enablement
Partner with Sales and leadership on pipeline development, partnership co-selling, and capability positioning
Cross-Functional Process and Growth
Drive process and operating rhythm across a matrixed, cross-functional team where formal structure is still being built
Partner closely with Sales, Alliances, Business Operations, and Delivery Management to ensure seamless handoffs from pre-sale through execution
Build scalable delivery frameworks, scoping standards, and technical governance models that reduce variability and protect margin across platform and email work
Identify and close operational gaps before they become client or financial issues
What You Bring
Leadership and Delivery
10 or more years in marketing technology, solution architecture, software engineering, or digital consulting, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (Director or equivalent)
Proven track record leading delivery across multiple complex engagements simultaneously in a consulting or agency environment
Highly comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where process must be built alongside execution
Strong cross-functional influencer who drives alignment without relying on formal authority
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead client conversations at the VP and C-Suite level
Technical Expertise
Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the Adobe ecosystem (AEP, AEM, CDP, Marketo, AJO, CJA) or the Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Account Engage, Agentforce, Sales Cloud), with working fluency across the other-
Strong background in email development, including HTML/CSS email engineering, responsive design, rendering across clients and devices, ESP integrations, and templating frameworks
Broad understanding of enterprise data architecture, identity resolution, and customer 360 strategy
Experience integrating martech platforms with data warehouses, CRMs, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience with AI and ML enablement across marketing and data platforms
About SH/FT
SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients' businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. We have built strong relationships with the world's most influential martech platforms and are key partners to them and their clients.
Why SH/FT
SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. As VP of Technology Services, you will shape how our clients connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable delivery, and data-driven strategy - and you'll have significant influence over how the practice's structure, standards, and team are shaped and scaled. You will lead a team doing some of the most complex and interesting work in martech today, with a direct line to executive leadership and real influence over where the practice goes next.
We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
Candidates must have current U.S. or Canada work authorization. For U.S. candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be located in North America.
As required by law, SH/FT provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in California, Colorado, Hawaii, New York, New Jersey, or Washington. The salary range for these residents is $185,000.00 to $210,000.00 + annual performance based bonus. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to scope of responsibilities, skillset, relevant experience, certifications, and more. In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.
No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.
All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at
safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.text:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.
If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.
At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
The Senior Director, Enterprise Data leads Vetsource's enterprise data organization and is accountable for making data a trusted, high-value business asset to drive product innovation and business performance. This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.
Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.
This is a full-time, remote position.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Data Engineering Platforms and Integration
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Analytics and Data Products
Lead analytics and business intelligence teams that develop trusted metrics, analytical models, dashboards, and decision-support products for internal stakeholders and external customers.
Adopt a data product approach for priority business domains, with defined customers, accountable business and technology owners, quality expectations, service levels, documentation, and adoption measures.
Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.
AI Enablement and Adoption
Develop the data and platform foundations required for AI-powered products, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and generative AI use cases.
Partner with product, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and business leaders to evaluate and deliver AI use cases with appropriate controls for data access, quality, privacy, safety, traceability, and monitoring.
Enable associates and customers to access approved data and insights through governed conversational interfaces and AI assistants, while preserving metric consistency, permissions, and source traceability.
Establish practical standards for model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and MLOps or LLMOps where applicable.
Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.
Data Governance Trust and Risk
Create a federated governance model that assigns business and technology ownership for critical data and establishes clear decision rights and stewardship responsibilities.
Oversee the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, lineage, quality rules, access policies, retention practices, and issue-management processes.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and legal teams to ensure data and AI capabilities meet contractual, regulatory, ethical, and company requirements.
Build trust by making data quality and ownership transparent and by ensuring material data issues are prioritized, communicated, and resolved.
Business Partnership and Delivery
Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the company, helping them frame business questions, understand data limitations, and use evidence to make better decisions.
Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.
Manage divisional objectives, service metrics, budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity plans; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
Promote strong product management and engineering practices that improve delivery speed, quality, accountability, and customer experience.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Lead a multidisciplinary organization that may include managers and individual contributors across data engineering, integration, analytics, business intelligence, AI engineering, MLOps, and data product development.
Set clear goals and decision rights, manage performance, and hold leaders accountable for business outcomes, platform reliability, and delivery commitments.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing teams; build succession plans and strengthen technical, product, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
Create an inclusive culture of ownership, curiosity, constructive challenge, continuous learning, and responsible innovation.
Delegate effectively, remove organizational blockers, and help teams make sound decisions close to the work.
WHAT YOU BRING
12+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, analytics, and data platforms
8+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and leaders.
Proven track record in delivering production AI/ML capabilities, including assessing data readiness, enforcing AI governance (access controls, audit trails), and managing MLOps/LLMOps.
Demonstrated experience defining and executing an enterprise data strategy or broad data transformation with measurable business outcomes.
Strong and prior hands on data engineering background, including experience with modern cloud data platforms, data modeling, batch and near real time streaming platforms like Kafka, schema registries, APIs and integration patterns, testing, observability, and production operations.
Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.
Experience establishing data governance, catalog, lineage, quality, access, ownership, and stewardship practices in partnership with business leaders.
Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, vendors, investment tradeoffs, and capacity planning.
Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to executive, business, customer, and technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, build alignment across functions, and convert ambiguous opportunities into focused plans and delivered results.
Preferred Experience and Qualifications:
Experience with cloud data and AI services, modern data warehouses or lakehouses, transformation and orchestration tools, event platforms, BI tools, and data catalogs.
Experience building data products or commercial data services for external customers and partners.
Experience in veterinary health, animal health, pharmacy, healthcare, ecommerce, or another regulated, data-intensive industry.
Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, information management, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
WORKING CONDITIONS
Remote work environment with reliable internet access.
Extended periods working at a computer, with the ability to alternate between sitting and standing.
Travel up to 30 percent, including occasional international travel, based on business needs.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM VETSOURCE
In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:
Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!
For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*
OUR VALUES
Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.
Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.
Pay Range (US based applicants): $190,265 - $240,000 USD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Pay Range (CAN based applicants): $185,000 - $240,000 CAD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, certifications, relevant education and training, while also considering internal equity.
The statements in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed for this role, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Our pre-employment process includes a background check as a part of the hiring process, and will include a drug screen for pharmacy related roles. The background check will only be initiated after a conditional offer of employment has been made and will be subject to an individualized assessment, as required by law. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please email , or if you have general questions relating to this process. No agencies please. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Vetsource is an E-verify employer.

jobs.title: VP of Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
A Crypto wallet security infrastructure provider are looking for a VP of Solutions Engineering
They develop the most secure wallet-as-a-service infrastructure in Web3 : an API-first wallet management system, ideal for applications and organizations seeking to provide secure access to all blockchains through a single integration). APIs and SDKs were designed for wallet programmability and efficient implementations, enabling fast deployments, smart automation flows, as well as granular sets of permissions and policies via secure authentication credentials. They are on the way to become the leading wallet infrastructure for the multi-trillion-dollar digital asset industry.
The company is SOC-2 certified, employs 30 people across 6 countries and has raised over $20M since creation with prestigious investors. Their solution is used and trusted by major international corporations.
As the VP of Solutions Engineering you will help financial institutions and enterprises adopt the company's platform with confidence and ease.
This high-impact role is both strategic and hands-on:
You’ll design integrations for complex legacy systems, guide clients through deployment, and offer end-to-end technical support.
You’ll pair deep technical expertise with strong client-facing skills, serving as an advisor to CTOs, architects, and engineering teams at banks, fintechs, and enterprises.
You’ll design tailored solutions, deliver technical proposals, and drive adoption via troubleshooting, clear docs, and tight collaboration with engineering, security, and product.
You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, equally comfortable whiteboarding ideas, writing code examples, and jumping on late calls to help a customer.
MISSIONS
Guide financial institutions through safe and seamless onboarding to the company's platform.
Architect secure, scalable deployment pathways that fit into legacy and modern systems.
Provide hands-on support: troubleshoot, fix, and build solutions alongside client teams.
Collaborate with sales to design technical proposals, demos, and RFP responses.
Maintain and improve technical docs and developer guides to industry standards.
Gather client feedback, analyze competitors, and turn insights into product tweaks.
Represent the company at conferences, workshops, and meetings as a technical thought leader.
Profil
10+ years in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise integration, with leadership experience.
Proven track record helping financial institutions deploy mission-critical systems.
Proficient in TypeScript (or similar languages) with strong API experience (REST).
Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems (AWS essential; GCP/IBM/Thales a plus), microservices, and serverless architectures.
Skilled in troubleshooting technical issues and delivering under pressure.
Strong understanding of enterprise security compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS)
Excellent communicator, able to bridge technical and business threads with clients.
Excellent doc and demo skills; able to clarify matters for tech and non-tech teams.
Knowledge of blockchain, digital assets, and financial workflows strongly preferred.
Certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) a plus; multilingual fluency also valued.
Informations contractuelles
Contract : Permanent role (Hybrid remote) in Nigeria or South Africa. remote first, office optional
Salary: 160,000–240,000 USD.
Equity: 100-200 stock options (0.1-0.4%) vested over 4 years with a one-year cliff.
Work essentials: MacBook Pro, iPhone, AirPods, screens, headsets, AirPods.
Training and coursework in Crypto, Blockchain, Security, code, Coding languages and other topics are paid for on-demand to encourage personal and professional growth.
Benefits: healthcare and life insurance, retirement plan, sponsored transportation, gym, lunch card, home office equipment, and other perks.
Recruitment process :
Video call with COO/CTO (30mn).
Cognitive and personality tests (45mn).
Coding test in a language of your choice
Focus interview (30mn x 3) : Code Review - Architecture review -Pre-sales fundamentals - Culture check fit
Final interview with Management (30mn)
