jobs.title: Head of Data and AI
jobs.text:
Job Title: Head of Data and AI
Location: Thailand
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing technology company specializing in AI-driven enterprise solutions that deliver measurable business impact. The organization is expanding its capabilities across advanced analytics, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation to support large-scale enterprise clients.
Role Overview
We are seeking a Head of Data and AI to lead the companys data and AI vision, strategy, and execution. This role combines technical leadership, AI research direction, data strategy, and enterprise solution delivery. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Data Science, proven experience with LLM implementation, and the leadership capability to build and scale high-performing Data and AI teams.
You will serve as the organizations data and AI authority, shaping the roadmap, guiding innovation, and ensuring successful deployment of scalable AI and data solutions at enterprise scale.
Key Responsibilities
Data & AI Strategy
Define and drive the company-wide Data and AI strategy and roadmap
Act as the internal and external Data & AI subject-matter expert
Identify new opportunities where data and AI can create business value
Team Leadership
Lead and mentor cross-functional teams across Data Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, and AI Research
Build a strong culture focused on innovation, experimentation, and delivery excellence
Oversee hiring, capability development, and team scaling initiatives
Solution Delivery
Guide end-to-end delivery of enterprise data and AI solutions, from concept to deployment
Ensure scalable, secure, and production-ready architectures
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Engineers, and Business Teams to translate data and AI into measurable business outcomes
AI Research & Innovation
Drive research initiatives in LLMs, Generative AI, and advanced ML techniques
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and integrate relevant advancements into company solutions

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed withI mean or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
Our Services engineering teams, part of our Quality and Scale Pillar, build and run the systems every Life360 member relies on but never sees. We carry location data between members’ phones and our servers, deliver the push and SMS notifications that families depend on, verify who members are and what they can access, build and scale our business critical services and give partners a safe way to build on Life360. When we do our jobs well, product teams ship faster and families trust the app in the moments that matter most.
We are a group of backend, cloud, and mobile engineers who care about reliability, security, and scale, and who treat member trust as the foundation of everything we build.
About the Job
As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams building and operating Life360’s critical platforms, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure and identity, and partner ecosystems. These systems are the foundation of the experiences millions of families rely on every day. You are a player coach who will set technical direction, develop strong engineering managers and technical leaders, and ensure our platforms are reliable, secure, and built to scale as Life360 grows to hundreds of millions of members worldwide.
This is a leadership role that combines deep technical judgment with business impact. You will anticipate scaling challenges before they become problems, modernize critical systems, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and speed. You will partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and engineering leaders to connect technology investments to business outcomes, accelerate product innovation, and build an engineering organization that can deliver at scale.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 251,000 to 295,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.
Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You’ll Do
Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.
See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.
Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.
Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Create an engineering organization where teams proactively identify problems, take responsibility for outcomes, and drive solutions without waiting for direction. Empower leaders to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence across organizational boundaries.
Make the invisible visible. Establish meaningful engineering metrics across reliability, performance, cost, security, and developer productivity. Use data to identify risks, prioritize investments, and communicate platform health and business impact to senior leadership.
Grow leaders who grow teams. Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders. Build a high-performing organization with clear accountability, strong technical judgment, and leaders who can make decisions and deliver outcomes independently.
Accelerate the entire engineering organization. Build reusable services, APIs, and platforms that reduce duplication and enable product teams to ship faster. Expand our partner ecosystem through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier to build on Life360.
Turn engineering investments into business outcomes. Connect technical strategy to member experience, product velocity, and business performance. Make deliberate tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, cost, and speed, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate impact and inform investment decisions.
Lead through influence. Partner across Product, Security, Data, and Engineering to align priorities, resolve ambiguity, and drive cross-functional decisions. Translate company strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps while bringing technical risks and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Stay close to the technology and embrace what’s next. Engage in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and empower teams to make pragmatic tradeoffs. Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed.
What We’re Looking For
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers.
Track record of leading backend or platform engineering at high scale, with distributed systems serving millions of users. B2B or B2C platform experience is welcome.
Demonstrated success developing and coaching managers, including former individual contributors who grew into leadership.
Experience translating company strategy into technical plans, and representing your teams’ needs back to senior leaders.
Experience modernizing legacy systems with respect for the history behind them, and the judgment to change what needs changing rather than everything.
Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with a record of resolving ownership and priority conflicts directly.
Hands-on technical credibility in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems (AWS experience preferred).
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave.
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
Learning & Development programs.
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.title: VP of Technology
jobs.text:
VP of Technical Delivery
Strong CRM
Location: Remote (US/Canada), with a distributed LATAM delivery team
Reports to: Founder/CEO
Team: ~45 delivery professionals across Salesforce clouds
About Strong CRM
Strong CRM is a bootstrapped, profitable Salesforce systems integrator that has grown from under $300K to roughly $5M in revenue in five years. We specialize in the high-complexity end of the ecosystem — Field Service Lightning, Revenue Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff — delivered by a talented, certification-heavy nearshore team. We serve roughly 80 active clients with a strong existing-client expansion engine and a reputation for doing the hard work that generalist shops can't.
We're at an inflection point. The founder currently carries both senior architecture and delivery leadership personally, and we're hiring a technical leader to own delivery end to end — so the practice can scale beyond any single person.
The Role
You will own the delivery organization: its quality, its margin, its people, and its technical standards. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a figurehead one. You'll be close enough to the work to make the hard architectural calls on complex engagements, and senior enough to build the systems, standards, and leaders that let delivery run without the founder in the loop. Success means that within 12 months, the founder is no longer the bottleneck or the senior technical escalation point for delivery — you are.
What You'll Own
Delivery leadership & client outcomes
Own end-to-end technical executiondelivery across all active and prospect engagements, including — scoping, staffing, sequencing, timelines, and client satisfaction
Serve as the senior delivery escalation point for at-risk projects, stepping in to recover timelines, scope, or client relationships when needed
Establish and run a delivery governance cadence — project health reviews, risk flagging, and status reporting — so problems surface early rather than at the deadline
Partner with clients as a trusted senior technical voice, especially on the largest and most complex accounts
Own delivery-driven client expansion — ensuring quality and proactive guidance turn engagements into repeat and expansion work
Margin, utilization & delivery economics
Own delivery gross margin and protect the margin profile that makes the business work
Manage team utilization, bench, and staffing efficiency across concurrent engagements
Improve estimation accuracy and scoping discipline so projects are priced and staffed to land profitably
Identify and reduce margin leakage — scope creep, over-servicing, rework, and mis-staffing
Provide the founder with clear, regular visibility into delivery metrics, capacity, and forecast
Technical authority & standards
Set architecture patterns, standards, and best practices across FSL, Revenue Cloud, FSC, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff
Serve as the final technical decision-maker and escalation point on hard architectural problems
Establish and enforce code and configuration review practices, quality gates, and delivery standards
Drive reusable-asset and accelerator development so the team stops rebuilding the same solutions from scratch
Stay current on the Salesforce platform roadmap and guide how new capabilities are adopted into delivery
Team leadership & organizational scaling
Lead, mentor, and develop a ~45-person nearshore delivery team
Build the management layer beneath you — team leads, senior architects, and practice owners — so delivery scales beyond any single person
Own hiring, onboarding, and ramp for delivery roles, including workforce planning against pipeline
Set and drive the certification strategy across the specialized clouds
Own performance management — clear expectations, feedback, development paths, and accountability
Build and protect a culture of quality, ownership, and accountability across a distributed, cross-border team
Delivery operations & repeatability
Turn hard-won project patterns into documented, repeatable methodologies and delivery playbooks
Develop productized and accelerator-based delivery approaches that improve margin and shorten sales cycles
Own the delivery tooling and systems that support quality, visibility, and efficiency
Partner with sales on scoping, solutioning, and technical pre-sales for complex opportunities
Systematically reduce founder- and hero-dependency by building process where there is currently tribal knowledge
What We're Looking For
Senior technical consulting leadership in the Salesforce ecosystem — someone clients trust in the room, who can hold executive-level conversations, shape solutions, and be the credible senior voice on complex, high-stakes engagements
A track record of leading and scaling a sizable delivery organization — you've run delivery at meaningful scale and know how to bring structure, standards, and leadership to a growing team
The ability to provide technical leadership across our specialized clouds without being the hands-on builder — setting direction, making the hard architectural calls, and elevating the team's technical bar
A systems-builder who designs how an entire delivery org operates — methodologies, standards, quality, and repeatability — rather than solving problems one project at a time
Proven success leading distributed and/or nearshore teams, ideally LATAM — building quality, culture, and accountability across a remote, cross-border organization
The presence and judgment to operate as a true peer to the founder, and the credibility to own delivery and client relationships end to end
Nice to Have
Salesforce certifications across our specialized clouds
Experience climbing the Salesforce partner tier and working with Salesforce AEs and co-sell motions
Roofing, field-service, or other vertical experience
Experience in a bootstrapped or founder-led environment
Spanish or Portuguese
Why This Role
You'll take a profitable, respected, technically excellent practice and make it scalable — with real ownership over how delivery is built, and a founder who genuinely wants to hand you the keys rather than look over your shoulder. This is a rare chance to shape the technical and delivery backbone of a growing company at exactly the moment it's ready to scale.
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary range: $250,000–$300,000 per year. Actual base offered will depend on experience, depth of Salesforce delivery leadership, and demonstrated ability to lead at scale.
In addition to base salary, this role includes:
Performance-based incentive compensation tied to delivery margin, utilization, client outcomes, and organizational milestones (target and structure discussed during the process)
Health benefits (medical, dental, and vision)
Retirement plan with 4% company matchcontribution
Paid time off and company holidays
Additional benefits and perquisites discussed during the interview process

jobs.text:
Vice President, Technology
Location: Remote-friendly — preferred locations are Singapore, Greater Shanghai, Seoul and vicinity, or Malaysia. This role works with R&D teams distributed across Singapore, Seoul, and Shanghai, and location flexibility reflects that operating reality.
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Curiox Biosystems is a pioneering life science technology company transforming sample preparation for cell analysis. Listed on the Korea Stock Exchange, Curiox operates globally with R&D and commercial teams across Singapore, Seoul, Shanghai, and Boston. Our breakthrough C-FREE™ Pluto automation platforms eliminate manual centrifugation, enabling faster, more reproducible, and scalable workflows for flow cytometry and single-cell applications. As Curiox scales globally across biopharma, CRO/CDMO, and platform partnerships, we are seeking a Vice President of Technology to institutionalize system-level architecture and lead Curiox's evolution from a product-led innovator to a software-enabled platform company.
Why This Role?
This is a senior leadership role with direct exposure to the CEO and broad influence across Curiox's technical strategy and product direction. You will own system-level architecture across hardware, software, workflow automation, and AI layers — ensuring that Curiox's platform scales coherently, not as a collection of disconnected products.
This role is accountable for architectural discipline, platform coherence, and the technical foundations that will carry Curiox to global scale.
What You'll Do
System-Level Architecture
Own and enforce architecture discipline across all product initiatives — hardware, firmware, software, cloud, and AI layers.
Define system boundaries and interface contracts before development begins.
Formalize the definition of "architecturally complete" across all product lines including Pluto Workstations, Pluto Code, Workflow Wizard, and Antibody Cocktailing Wizard.
Institutionalize failure-mode anticipation as a standard practice before implementation.
Implement AI-assisted requirement expansion and stress testing of system logic.
Eliminate patch-based development culture and replace it with architecture-first discipline.
Ensure no major initiative launches without an architecture review artifact.
AI-Driven Product Leadership
Lead the architecture and delivery of Curiox's next-generation software platform, integrating AI capabilities into unified, workflow-level user experiences.
Define execution models and interface standards that enable scalable, intelligent automation across Curiox's product portfolio.
Work with internal teams and external development partners to translate AI capability into coherent, productized outcomes.
Ensure software product direction is system-driven, not feature-accumulated.
Software-Driven Platform Expansion
Define modular API architecture for third-party robot integration, data pipelines, and partner connectivity.
Define and govern the development of reusable software components across the product portfolio, executed through internal teams and external development partners.
Integrate hardware, consumables, and software logic into a coherent platform.
Enable OEM-friendly architecture to support Curiox's partner-led growth model.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Work closely with R&D (including Engineering and BioApplications), Product, and Commercial teams to align architecture decisions with biological constraints and commercial priorities.
Contribute to leadership discussions on platform strategy, technical roadmap, and long-term scalability.
Operate effectively across globally distributed teams in Asia, the US, and Europe.
Who You Are
Must-Haves
Senior technical leader with 10+ years in systems architecture, platform engineering, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience designing and owning complex multi-layer systems — hardware, software, workflow, or equivalent.
Proven ability to define architecture under ambiguity — before all requirements are finalized.
AI-native operator: experienced using AI as a modeling and requirement-expansion tool, not just an execution aid.
Platform thinker with experience transitioning a product company toward scalable, modular platform architecture.
English proficiency at professional working level — able to lead technical discussions, produce architecture documents, and communicate with global stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-functional technical teams in complex, multi-disciplinary environments.
Background (one or more of the following)
Robotics, automation, or precision instrumentation systems
SaaS platforms with hardware dependencies
Semiconductor, MedTech, or industrial automation systems
Life science instrumentation (advantageous but not required)
Success Profile
Structured thinker who produces clear system models before others have finished defining the problem.
Low ego, high discipline — earns authority through clarity of output, not seniority.
Comfortable challenging the CEO and senior stakeholders constructively, with data and structured reasoning.
Raises architectural standards without destabilizing the existing team.
Documents by default — architecture artifacts, interface contracts, and decision logs are standard outputs, not follow-ups.
Adaptable to a globally distributed, multi-time-zone environment.
Why Join Curiox?
You'll join a team challenging legacy workflows and redefining how modern cell analysis is performed. Curiox values clarity of thinking, learning agility, and impact over hierarchy.
For the right person, this role offers something rare:
Architectural authority from day one. You are not inheriting a finished system. You are defining how a platform that is already in production at leading biopharma accounts gets built for global scale. Your decisions will be visible in the product for years.
Direct access to the CEO and Board. Curiox is a listed company at an inflection point. This role reports directly to the CEO and carries real strategic weight — not a layer removed from where decisions are made.
A physics-based moat worth protecting. C-FREE™ is not a software feature. It is a validated, patent-protected approach to cell handling that no competitor has replicated in 60 years of trying. You are architecting on top of a genuine scientific differentiator.
A platform that is not yet built. The convergence of hardware, software, AI, and cloud orchestration is defined in direction but open in execution. This is an architect's opportunity, not a maintenance role.
A globally distributed, high-caliber team. R&D spans Singapore, Seoul, and Shanghai. Commercial presence extends to the US and Europe. The team is lean, technically deep, and operating at a pace that rewards clarity over politics.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Central Europe
jobs.text:
Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Head of Product, Central Europe to join our ever evolving SMB Product team within Global Payments and help shape the future of global commerce.
This senior leadership role is accountable for defining and delivering the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships. You will work through influence across a complex partner ecosystem, aligning Global Payments, JV partners, EU market leadership, and global product and technology teams around clear priorities, funded roadmaps, and sustainable commercial outcomes.
What you’ll own
Define and lead the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships, translating customer needs, market insights, competitive trends, and platform opportunities into a clear 3 to 5-year product vision that supports sustainable growth across the region.
Establish and drive strong governance frameworks across Global Payments and JV partners, ensuring alignment on product priorities, investment decisions, roadmap execution, funding models, and expected business outcomes.
Own the product roadmap and prioritisation process, balancing strategic objectives, commercial impact, customer value, technology capacity, and partner-specific requirements to maximise overall portfolio performance.
Build alignment across product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders, proactively managing dependencies, resolving competing priorities, and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Ensure product initiatives deliver measurable business impact by connecting delivery outcomes to revenue growth, market expansion, customer success, operational efficiency, and long-term value creation for both Global Payments and JV partners.
What you’ll bring
15+ years of product leadership experience delivering end-to-end product strategy, development, and lifecycle management within payments, fintech, banking, software platforms, commerce technology, or similarly complex industries, with a strong track record of translating market opportunities into scalable product solutions.
Proven ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multi-entity environments, aligning product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders around shared objectives and driving outcomes without direct authority.
Extensive experience in product governance, roadmap prioritisation, and portfolio management, including balancing strategic objectives, managing cross-functional dependencies, navigating investment trade-offs, and ensuring successful execution across multiple businesses, markets, or partners.
Strong commercial acumen and partnership leadership, with experience developing business cases, connecting product investments to revenue outcomes, managing portfolio performance, and successfully collaborating with Joint Ventures, strategic partners, or other complex stakeholder ecosystems.
Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with a people-first, high-accountability mindset, enabling the development of trusted relationships, effective decision-making, and successful collaboration across countries, cultures, and organisational boundaries.
It’s a bonus if you have
Experience working within Joint Ventures, strategic partnerships, or other multi-entity environments, with an understanding of complex governance structures, funding models, and stakeholder management requirements.
Strong knowledge of payment ecosystems, fintech, banking, commerce technology, or SMB-focused solutions, with the ability to connect market opportunities to product strategy and execution.
Experience operating across multiple countries and markets, balancing local customer and partner requirements with broader regional or global product objectives.
Familiarity with API-first platforms, target architecture models, platform modernisation initiatives, and scalable product delivery approaches that support long-term business growth.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align diverse executive stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and drive outcomes without direct authority.
About the team
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
What makes a Globalpayer?
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

jobs.title: Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations
jobs.text:
McDermott Laboratories Limited
Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.
We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.
Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference, and here’s how the Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations role will make an impact:
Provide strategic leadership for engineering, facilities, utilities, projects and capacity expansion across the Steriles (Injectables and respiratory) network. Ensure compliant, reliable and cost-effective operations while supporting growth, operational excellence, audit readiness, and people development. A balanced combination between mastering capital management, and manufacturing operations reliability transformations is a key requirement.
Key responsibilities for this role include:
Lead engineering, facilities, utilities and capital project activities across all sterile manufacturing locations.
Top 1 prioritity will be Quality and Safety assurance across all the engineering related activities, for internal and for external collaborators
Drive Lean/Operational Excellence and Digital transformation agenda across the engineering function with a clear goal to optimize performance of our assets (e.g.: OEE) and optimize expenses
Ensure compliance with GMP, statutory, regulatory, safety and environmental requirements.
Drive standardization of engineering practices, utilities and technical standards across sites.
Manage CAPEX and engineering OPEX budgets and optimize resource utilization.
Lead capacity expansion, plant upgrades, automation and operational improvement initiatives.
Maintain audit readiness and support regulatory inspections.
Partner with Quality, Manufacturing and Projects teams to improve plant performance.
Mentor and develop engineering teams through coaching, training and succession planning. Developing a strong network of Engineering leaders across the site through active career development and rotation across sites.
The minimum qualifications for this role are:
Deep knowledge of sterile pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, engineering systems and project management.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management and strategic planning capabilities.
Knowledge of current sterile pharmaceutical technologies, including isolator filling lines, device assembly lines and plant management best practices
Bachelor of Science and Engineering with specialization in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or related field.
Experience in people and process management within the pharmaceutical industry.
Significant experience in injectables manufacturing environments is required.
At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.
At Viatris, we offercompetitivesalaries, benefitsandan inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is not an abstract mission. It is real, urgent, and growing. Our ICAP product is a proven, high-impact solution that is trusted by customers who depend on us to secure their most critical systems. We are now ready to take ICAP to the next level.
This Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICAP, including the evolution toward a next-generation Proxy, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. If you are energized by building success, driving innovation, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.
What You Will Be Doing
As Director of AI Product Management, you will be the end-to-end owner of ICAP’s product strategy and growth trajectory.
You will:
Set and own the ICAP product vision and roadmap, including the strategic evolution into a Proxy-focused solution.
Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, and customer adoption.
Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with a close partnership with our Vietnam-based teams.
Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring ICAP continues to deliver reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
Represent ICAP with confidence to customers, partners, and internal leadership.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:
A clear, compelling ICAP roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
Progress toward a Proxy-focused architecture that positions ICAP for long-term growth.
A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
Who You Are
You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You bring:
Proven experience leading enterprise or security products at scale.
Deep hands on experience building with AI.
Strong understanding of proxy technologies, ICAP, networking, or adjacent security domains.
A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Vietnam.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to influence across functions.
A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.
Why OPSWAT?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow.
In this role, you will:
Own a successful, revenue-generating product with a meaningful runway.
Shape the future of ICAP and Proxy innovation.
Work with smart, committed teams across the globe.
Have direct visibility and influence within Product leadership.
If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology (US, Remote)
jobs.text:
Reports to: CTO
Department: Technology
Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.
FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt
Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $190,000 - $220,000
Tier 2 (National Markets): $180,000 - $210,000
Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $170,000 - $200,000
About the Company
Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.
Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.
We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!
About the Opportunity
The technology behind Paleovalley and Wild Pastures is central to how customers shop, subscribe, and get help - and how our teams fulfill orders and run the business. Much of it was built in-house by our co-founder and CTO. As both brands grow, we need a technology organization that can keep these platforms strong, connect them with our business systems, and support the next stage of growth.
The Vice President of Technology will be the CTO’s trusted right hand and lead the full technology function across software engineering, business systems, and IT. This leader will set priorities and investment plans with the CTO, make consequential day-to-day decisions with substantial autonomy, and own the team, budget, delivery, and health of our technology. The role gives the CTO room to focus on company-wide direction and the technical work where he can add the most value.
Success here requires executive judgment, real technical depth, and a practical approach to AI and automation. You’ll work through architecture, code, and difficult incidents while building shared knowledge and ownership across the team. You’ll also guide AI adoption that improves how we build software and run the business, partnering with E-Commerce on reliable solutions for the shopping experience and commercial priorities.
What You’ll Do
Technology Strategy and Leadership
Set the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap with the CTO, turning business priorities into clear investments, sequencing, and delivery across both brands.
Lead engineering, business systems, and IT as one function, developing leaders, clarifying decision rights, and building the capacity needed for growth.
Own the technology budget, staffing, and vendor strategy; make sound build-versus-buy decisions and raise enterprise-level risks and architectural choices with the CTO.
Establish and oversee a centralized technology request intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, defining project scope, assessing business impact, allocating resources, and communicating realistic timelines to stakeholders across departments.
Develop scalable engineering workflows and project management practices that improve accountability, delivery predictability, and cross-functional communication without introducing unnecessary administrative complexity.
Custom Platforms and Engineering
Own the architecture and engineering delivery of our custom commerce, subscription, customer service, and internal platforms, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintainability.
Stay close to the technical work through design and code reviews, hands-on troubleshooting, and selective coding when a critical problem calls for it.
Set practical standards for testing, releases, monitoring, and incident response so teams can move quickly while protecting the customer and employee experience.
Reduce dependence on any one person by documenting critical systems, sharing ownership, cross-training the team, and testing recovery procedures.
AI and Automation
Lead AI and automation strategy with the CTO, turning emerging capabilities into practical agents, workflows, and tools that improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity.
Evaluate where AI, conventional automation, and human expertise are best applied, measuring business value before scaling adoption across engineering and business functions.
Business Systems, IT and Security
Lead the strategy for business applications, integrations, and data flows that connect commerce with customer service, fulfillment, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance.
Oversee IT services, infrastructure, access, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor risk, including practical standards for AI reliability, data protection, and appropriate human oversight.
Maintain continuity and disaster recovery plans for revenue-critical and operational systems, and prioritize technical debt based on security, scalability, cost, and business impact.
Delivery and Cross Functional Partnership
Partner with E-Commerce and web experience teams to translate storefront and testing priorities into technical solutions; E-Commerce owns commercial outcomes while Technology owns platform delivery.
Partner with business leaders to evaluate processes, automation opportunities, and capacity needs before recommending additional systems, vendors, or headcount.
Set realistic commitments, manage competing requests, and give the CTO and executive team a clear view of progress, service health, and emerging risks.
Serve as a responsive and solutions-oriented technology partner to department leaders, ensuring incoming requests are properly evaluated, stakeholders receive clear updates, and technical priorities remain aligned with business impact and available capacity.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and technology leadership, including 4+ years leading technical teams and developing managers or other senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical leadership will be considered in lieu of a degree.
Strong command of software architecture, production code, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and engineering practices.
Hands-on experience applying AI tools and automation in software development or business workflows, with sound judgment about their limitations, reliability, and data risks.
Experience leading customer-facing commerce or subscription platforms alongside enterprise applications and IT services.
A track record of making custom or founder-built systems maintainable, documented, and independently operable.
Practical judgment in security, privacy, access, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Business acumen to manage budgets, vendors, technical investments, and competing priorities across functions.
Ability to earn a technical founder’s trust while leading independently and building a stronger technology organization.
Bonus Points
Experience working in a startup, founder-led business, or high-growth e-commerce environment.
Experience with custom-built e-commerce platforms, legacy application modernization, or migrations involving PHP/Laravel-based systems.
Familiarity with platforms such as Shopify and the technical considerations involved in building or integrating e-commerce functionality.
Experience with RESTful APIs, MySQL or comparable relational databases, AWS or similar cloud infrastructure, and modern web development practices.
Experience with ERP, warehouse management, fulfillment, or customer service platforms, including systems such as Acumatica, Logiwa, Klaviyo, or Gladly.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or other structured project management practices; relevant certifications are a plus.
Interest in food, wellness, and regenerative agriculture.
Our Commitment to You
Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
Paid sick time for when you need it
Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
$300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for employees
Compliance & Employment Practices
Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .
All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.
To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.
This role is open until filled.

jobs.title: AVP - CRM & Cognitive Technology
jobs.text:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the strategy, architecture, implementation, and continuous enhancement of CRM and Cognitive Technology solutions.
The role will focus on leveraging enterprise CRM platforms, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation, and intelligent technologies to enhance customer engagement, streamline business processes, and improve overall customer experience.
The ideal candidate should have a strong background in enterprise technology, CRM transformation, solution architecture, and emerging cognitive technologies, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable and innovative technology solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. CRM Strategy & Transformation
Lead the development and implementation of enterprise CRM strategies aligned with business objectives.
Drive CRM transformation initiatives to improve customer relationship management, engagement, and service delivery.
Oversee CRM platform implementation, customization, integration, and optimization.
Ensure CRM solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
2. Cognitive Technology & AI
Drive the adoption of Cognitive Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI across CRM platforms.
Identify opportunities to implement AI-powered customer engagement, intelligent automation, chatbots, virtual assistants, and predictive analytics.
Explore emerging technologies to improve customer insights, personalization, and operational efficiency.
Lead the integration of AI-driven solutions into existing enterprise applications and CRM ecosystems.
3. Enterprise Architecture & Technology Integration
Define and oversee CRM solution architecture, system integration, and technology roadmaps.
Ensure seamless integration between CRM platforms, core banking systems, APIs, enterprise applications, and data platforms.
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, and application development teams.
Ensure technology solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, and regulatory requirements.
4. Project & Stakeholder Management
Lead large-scale CRM and digital transformation projects from planning through implementation.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, senior management, and technology teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, and project timelines.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to cross-functional teams.
5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Evaluate emerging CRM and Cognitive Technology solutions.
Establish technology standards, best practices, and governance frameworks.
Monitor technology performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Drive innovation initiatives that enhance customer experience and business value.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in IT, enterprise technology, CRM, solution architecture, or digital transformation.
Strong experience in enterprise CRM strategy, implementation, customization, and integration.
Hands-on exposure to Cognitive Technologies, AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, APIs, system integration, and cloud technologies.
Experience leading large-scale technology transformation projects.
Strong stakeholder management and leadership capabilities.
Experience within banking, financial services, or other regulated industries is an advantage.
Technical Skills
Enterprise CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or equivalent.
Cognitive Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning.
Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
Cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
API management, application integration, and enterprise systems.
Data analytics, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions.
Technology governance, security, and compliance.
Preferred Certifications
TOGAF or other Enterprise Architecture certifications.
Microsoft Azure AI or relevant AI certifications.
CRM platform certifications (Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Salesforce).
Relevant certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or Cloud Architecture.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.text:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.
The Opportunity
Allara is hiring its first Director of Data to build the backbone of how the company collects, models, governs, and uses data. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this is a hands-on leadership role: in your first months you will be in the pipelines yourself, cleaning up our ETL, consolidating duplicated logic, and closing gaps in our source data. Over time you will define and drive the company's longer-term data strategy, set the standards the rest of the organization builds on, and grow the data function as Allara scales. This is a player-coach role, senior enough to own strategy and still happy to get the pipelines right yourself, and the hands-on work comes first.
Location: Hybrid (NYC). We value in-person collaboration and aim for at least three days per week in our NYC office, with flexibility as needed.
Your Impact
Make Allara's data trustworthy, so every team can make decisions on numbers they believe.
Turn a fragmented, duplicated data setup into one reliable source of truth with traceable lineage.
Define the data strategy that lets Allara scale its use of data, from AI-assisted analysis across departments and leveraging health data to drive better outcomes.
Build and lead the data engineering function over time.
Partner with Product, Growth, Finance, Strategy, and Clinical as the owner of the shared data platform and standards.
Responsibilities
First 6 to 12 months (hands-on)
Clean up the pipelines. Audit our existing ETL across Fivetran and Mozart into Snowflake, stabilize reliability and freshness, and fix the brittle parts the business has learned to work around.
Consolidate duplication. Collapse duplicated models, metrics, and transformation logic into a single, well-documented modeling layer, so there is one definition of each number rather than several that disagree.
Close source-data gaps. Map what we collect against what the business needs and close the gaps across our systems.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Fenix24 is a global leader in breach recovery and pre-breach operational recoverability, redefining cyber resilience with the world's first Recovery Dependency Modeling and Recoverability Intelligence Platform, Argos99. Fenix24's
breach recovery team is the largest in the world and has led more than 500 ransomware recoveries in 96 countries, including 30 of the Fortune 500. Pre-breach operational recoverability is founded on that real-world experience and is powered by Argos99 and our Resiliency Operations Center.
Our recoverability platform is purpose-built by frontline recovery experts and is deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premise environments; delivering measurable improvements in recovery readiness and faster, more confident restoration when ransomware strikes.
About This Position
We are searching for a Vice President of Product to join our Fenix24 team. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in the future of our company, providing the overall vision for the Argos99 product roadmap and leading the product management function. You'll define the product, help shape the broader portfolio, and have a strong voice in pricing, go-to-market, and commercial strategy. This role will be critical in shaping not only our products, but our entire organization.
This is an incredible opportunity to build the product from the ground up. You'll do real work from day one alongside engineering, architecture, and UX, and build out the product function as Argos99 grows. You'll guide products from conceptualization through planning and development, bringing the leadership, organizational, and execution skills to carry the product lifecycle from strategy through delivery, in support of the business's long-term plans.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead the product function from the ground up: establish the team, processes, and the metrics and performance framework that govern how product work is tracked, using a data-driven mindset to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement.
Develop and implement strategic product plans, collaborating with customers, prospects, external partners, and internal teams to grow our business.
Own, create, and maintain all product roadmaps and business cases, along with feature backlogs, timelines, business/functional/user requirements, and design artifacts (use cases, user stories, journey maps, etc.).
Lead evidence-based product definition, User Experience (UX) design, and market, user, and competitive research.
Own pricing strategy and market launch, and coordinate with the sales, support, and services teams.
Lead cross-functionally, bringing engineering, architecture, UX, sales, support, and services together around shared goals, and tell the product story clearly, both internally and externally.
Represent and advocate for the customer and end user through every stage of the product experience: development, delivery, deployment, and adoption.
Other duties as required.
Qualifications, Requirements & Preferred Skills
10+ years in product management, including time as the senior product decision-maker for an early-stage B2B SaaS product.
5+ years of experience in the cybersecurity/infrastructure/resiliency industry, with deep fluency in how enterprise infrastructure is built, run, attacked, and recovered. That fluency could come from cybersecurity, backup and data protection, IT operations, incident response, or hands-on practitioner work.
3+ years of experience with MSP/MSSPs.
5+ years managing and mentoring teams.
Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, use sound judgment to assess risk, and communicate a clear, compelling, data-informed narrative to stakeholders, in writing and in person.
Strategic thinker with entrepreneurial drive, passion, and the ability to quickly assess product goals and objectives.
Proven ability to build constructive, collaborative relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and across all levels of the company, while modeling Fenix24's Culture and Values.
Excellent analytical and organizational skills.
Proven track record building or leading products in resilience, backup/DR, security operations, exposure management, or asset management.
What Success Looks Like in Year One
A product strategy and Argos99 roadmap that leadership has agreed on and the whole company can explain.
Pricing and packaging validated with MSP/MSSP and enterprise customers.
A product operating rhythm and metrics framework in place, with the first product hires planned.
Salary: $250,000 - $350,000
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
About Feanix Bio
Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.
We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions.
That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning.
We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork — just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before.
If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you.
About The Role
Feanix is expanding its product offerings based on our farmers' needs and moving into other species, and engineering has to scale with these business goals. Today we're a small, tight engineering team behind one core product: Autopilot and sire mating, the decision engine farmers act on every day. We're shifting from individuals carrying whole systems to teams that share them, and we're growing in close partnership with our product organization. Over the next 12–18 months we plan to grow engineering to around 30 people. The technology organization includes software, hardware, and product, and this role leads software development.
You'll be our first Director of Engineering, reporting to the CTO. You'll lead a team of engineering managers: two have already joined, and you'll hire more to support the organization's growth. Our staff and principal engineers, who lead architecture, also report directly to you rather than to the EMs. You run the engineering org and its delivery, and you set technical direction together with them.
You'll report to a repeat CTO who wants thought partners: people who lay out the options, show their reasoning, and ask what we'd do if the current options disappeared. You'll also be one of a small group of technical leaders setting direction for the company. We're growing fast and working with biological systems, so designing with an experimental mindset is crucial.. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and making good calls with incomplete information.
The impact of this role is through your people. Your output is a team that ships: clear roles, managers who can build and run teams of 6–8 engineers, and cohesive system and team design. We expect you to be technically credible and fluent in how software is now built, but you won't be writing production code or doing line-by-line review.
Your Partnership With Product and Hardware
You'll join the growing director team in our technology organization, alongside our Director of Product and Director of Hardware. Together you'll deliver products with one goal: making farms as profitable and efficient as possible. We do that through the best possible breeding decisions for cattle, sensors that collect phenotypic data, and analysis built on the genomic data we collect and process.
As a team, you're accountable for keeping our existing products stable and growing their value, while prototyping, testing, and rolling out new ones.
What You'll Do
Lead and support the engineering managers. Our EMs are experienced managers, and your job is to make them more effective. Give them the context, support, and clear expectations they need to build high-functioning teams with real accountability for outcomes. Unblock them across teams, back their hard calls, and hold them to a consistent bar. Hire the managers we'll need as we grow.
Design the org as it grows. In partnership with the CTO and your fellow directors, grow the engineering organization. Gather signals and input from engineers, EMs, and the teams closest to farmers, and use them to turn high-level plans into a concrete org and roadmap that meet customer needs. Decide when and how teams split, and draw boundaries around the architecture rather than around labels. Our working areas are platform and decision engine, farm delivery (data on and off farm computers, automation, QC), modeling and genomics, and new planned product lines.
Build how we hire and onboard. With the CTO and our recruiting team, create and refine an engineering hiring process that attracts high-quality talent and keeps the bar high as we grow. Make sure new engineers onboard quickly, and that people are in the right seats as teams form and change.
Make delivery predictable. With the Director of Product, turn strategy into committed outcomes for each team. Surface tradeoffs early, and report progress in terms of what reached farms, not activity.
Protect platform investment. Make sure the infrastructure that unlocks future products is designed, staffed, and built alongside customer work. Make platform and architecture calls together with the CTO and your architecture leaders.
Lead an AI-native engineering org. Our engineers work spec-first and direct coding agents. Set the standards (specs, evals, testing, CI, and security) that let people and agents ship safely without heavy process. Decide where agents should carry the load, such as support and bug fixing, and where people need to. When agent output goes wrong, fix the spec or harness, not just the symptom, and keep evolving these practices as the tools change.
Build the operating system. Put in place the lightweight rhythm a fast team actually uses: escalation paths, incident response, release discipline, and knowing who's responsible for what.
Shape how we plan and grow people. With the CTO and your fellow directors, help build the leveling framework for technical roles, our planning cycles, and our performance review system, so expectations are clear and growth paths are fair for both managers and ICs.
Partner across Feanix. Work with Farm Success, Farm Ops, and our science teams so what we ship holds up on real farms. Join farm visits and stay close to the customer.
What Success Looks Like
First 30 days: You understand your peers across the organization and how engineering works with each of them. You've started setting expectations with your direct reports. You've reviewed our technical hiring process and made improvements where it needs them. You've spent time on a farm and know the system and the customer.
First 90 days: Technical hiring is operationalized: you've built on the process we already have, not redesigned it, and it runs reliably with the EMs and recruiting. You and the Director of Product have aligned on the roadmap, and you're confident it's achievable with the team we have and the team we're hiring; where it isn't, the tradeoffs are on the table. You've established a working partnership with the Director of Hardware and agreed on how hardware and software teams will plan and hand off work. Your EMs know what you expect of them, and each team has clear goals and a delivery cadence you can report on.
First 6 months: At least one new product has launched to farms, our hardware pilots have the software they need, and the core product has stayed stable as we've grown.
First 12 months: Engineering has supported the company's sales and impact goals for the year: farms are onboarded as fast as we sign them, new products reach farms on schedule, and the organization is ready to take on what comes next.
What You Bring
10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing engineers and at least 2 years managing managers. You reached a senior engineering level as an IC first.
A track record of scaling an engineering org at a startup through a growth phase, ideally from around 10 to 30+ engineers, including splitting teams and adding a management layer as you went.
Managers you can point to: people you hired or promoted into management and developed into strong leaders.
Experience building engineering hiring processes that attract strong talent, including calibrating interviewers and closing senior candidates.
Experience leading delivery across several products or teams at once, and balancing customer-facing roadmap work against platform and infrastructure investment.
Deep fluency with AI-native engineering. You've moved teams to spec-first, agentic development, and you have real opinions on specs, evals, verification, and quality in that world. You use AI daily in your own leadership work.
A strong partnership record with product leaders: you've worked as an equal partner to a head of product, not as an order-taker or a gatekeeper.
Experience partnering with hardware or science leaders to deliver products that span physical devices, data, and software.
Clear written communication and the judgment to report status, risk, and tradeoffs at the right level for the CTO, CEO, and board.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading teams that ship ML, data-intensive, or decision-support products
Experience with platform re-architecture while the business kept shipping: data models, pipelines, or event-driven systems
Experience with products that combine software with hardware, sensors, or edge compute
Experience in a remote-first engineering org
Interest in agriculture, biology, genomics, or working close to a physical industry
Ultimately, we care far more about demonstrated ability, curiosity, and problem-solving than pedigree or conventional career paths.
Logistics
Remote (US), ideally able to work west coast hours
Travel about 20% of the time: recruiting, time with teams and at our headquarters, and customer farm visits
Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us
The People - we have an amazing group of talented, smart and fun people on our team!
The Company - we are building something novel that has not been done before which is making a huge impact on the dairy industry!
The Experience - you get to come in and be a part of ground breaking work that will have a huge impact on generations to come!
Compensation and Benefits
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or transfers at this time.
Actual starting pay for this role is determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to qualifications, experience, relevant skills, education, and geographic location. Employees are offered a variety of benefits to empower them with the resources and flexibility they need to enjoy success on the job and to live a healthy life.
We offer a flexible, remote-friendly work environment for most roles, along with a growing benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401k, pet insurance, flexible paid time off; and paid parental leave, including up to twelve weeks of paid leave and/or supplemental pay coordination with applicable state benefits.
Pay Transparency
$200,000—$230,000 USD
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or transfers at this time.
Compensation is based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Benefits include equity options, medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k); flexible PTO; paid parental leave; and pet insurance.
Feanix Biotechnologies is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process.
By applying, you consent to Feanix Biotechnologies processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws.
