You'll be our first Director of Engineering, reporting to the CTO. You'll lead a team of engineering managers: two have already joined, and you'll hire more to support the organization's growth. Our staff and principal engineers, who lead architecture, also report directly to you rather than to the EMs. You run the engineering org and its delivery, and you set technical direction together with them.

You'll report to a repeat CTO who wants thought partners: people who lay out the options, show their reasoning, and ask what we'd do if the current options disappeared. You'll also be one of a small group of technical leaders setting direction for the company. We're growing fast and working with biological systems, so designing with an experimental mindset is crucial.. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and making good calls with incomplete information.

The impact of this role is through your people. Your output is a team that ships: clear roles, managers who can build and run teams of 6–8 engineers, and cohesive system and team design. We expect you to be technically credible and fluent in how software is now built, but you won't be writing production code or doing line-by-line review.
Your Partnership With Product and Hardware

You'll join the growing director team in our technology organization, alongside our Director of Product and Director of Hardware. Together you'll deliver products with one goal: making farms as profitable and efficient as possible. We do that through the best possible breeding decisions for cattle, sensors that collect phenotypic data, and analysis built on the genomic data we collect and process.
As a team, you're accountable for keeping our existing products stable and growing their value, while prototyping, testing, and rolling out new ones.
What You'll Do

items: Lead and support the engineering managers. Our EMs are experienced managers, and your job is to make them more effective. Give them the context, support, and clear expectations they need to build high-functioning teams with real accountability for outcomes. Unblock them across teams, back their hard calls, and hold them to a consistent bar. Hire the managers we'll need as we grow.

Design the org as it grows. In partnership with the CTO and your fellow directors, grow the engineering organization. Gather signals and input from engineers, EMs, and the teams closest to farmers, and use them to turn high-level plans into a concrete org and roadmap that meet customer needs. Decide when and how teams split, and draw boundaries around the architecture rather than around labels. Our working areas are platform and decision engine, farm delivery (data on and off farm computers, automation, QC), modeling and genomics, and new planned product lines.

Build how we hire and onboard. With the CTO and our recruiting team, create and refine an engineering hiring process that attracts high-quality talent and keeps the bar high as we grow. Make sure new engineers onboard quickly, and that people are in the right seats as teams form and change.

Make delivery predictable. With the Director of Product, turn strategy into committed outcomes for each team. Surface tradeoffs early, and report progress in terms of what reached farms, not activity.

Protect platform investment. Make sure the infrastructure that unlocks future products is designed, staffed, and built alongside customer work. Make platform and architecture calls together with the CTO and your architecture leaders.

Lead an AI-native engineering org. Our engineers work spec-first and direct coding agents. Set the standards (specs, evals, testing, CI, and security) that let people and agents ship safely without heavy process. Decide where agents should carry the load, such as support and bug fixing, and where people need to. When agent output goes wrong, fix the spec or harness, not just the symptom, and keep evolving these practices as the tools change.
Build the operating system. Put in place the lightweight rhythm a fast team actually uses: escalation paths, incident response, release discipline, and knowing who's responsible for what.

Shape how we plan and grow people. With the CTO and your fellow directors, help build the leveling framework for technical roles, our planning cycles, and our performance review system, so expectations are clear and growth paths are fair for both managers and ICs.
Partner across Feanix. Work with Farm Success, Farm Ops, and our science teams so what we ship holds up on real farms. Join farm visits and stay close to the customer.

blocks.text: What Success Looks Like

items: First 30 days: You understand your peers across the organization and how engineering works with each of them. You've started setting expectations with your direct reports. You've reviewed our technical hiring process and made improvements where it needs them. You've spent time on a farm and know the system and the customer.

First 90 days: Technical hiring is operationalized: you've built on the process we already have, not redesigned it, and it runs reliably with the EMs and recruiting. You and the Director of Product have aligned on the roadmap, and you're confident it's achievable with the team we have and the team we're hiring; where it isn't, the tradeoffs are on the table. You've established a working partnership with the Director of Hardware and agreed on how hardware and software teams will plan and hand off work. Your EMs know what you expect of them, and each team has clear goals and a delivery cadence you can report on.
First 6 months: At least one new product has launched to farms, our hardware pilots have the software they need, and the core product has stayed stable as we've grown.

First 12 months: Engineering has supported the company's sales and impact goals for the year: farms are onboarded as fast as we sign them, new products reach farms on schedule, and the organization is ready to take on what comes next.

blocks.text: What You Bring

items: 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing engineers and at least 2 years managing managers. You reached a senior engineering level as an IC first.
A track record of scaling an engineering org at a startup through a growth phase, ideally from around 10 to 30+ engineers, including splitting teams and adding a management layer as you went.
Managers you can point to: people you hired or promoted into management and developed into strong leaders.
Experience building engineering hiring processes that attract strong talent, including calibrating interviewers and closing senior candidates.
Experience leading delivery across several products or teams at once, and balancing customer-facing roadmap work against platform and infrastructure investment.

Deep fluency with AI-native engineering. You've moved teams to spec-first, agentic development, and you have real opinions on specs, evals, verification, and quality in that world. You use AI daily in your own leadership work.
A strong partnership record with product leaders: you've worked as an equal partner to a head of product, not as an order-taker or a gatekeeper.
Experience partnering with hardware or science leaders to deliver products that span physical devices, data, and software.
Clear written communication and the judgment to report status, risk, and tradeoffs at the right level for the CTO, CEO, and board.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience leading teams that ship ML, data-intensive, or decision-support products
Experience with platform re-architecture while the business kept shipping: data models, pipelines, or event-driven systems
Experience with products that combine software with hardware, sensors, or edge compute
Experience in a remote-first engineering org
Interest in agriculture, biology, genomics, or working close to a physical industry

blocks.text: Ultimately, we care far more about demonstrated ability, curiosity, and problem-solving than pedigree or conventional career paths.
Logistics

items: Remote (US), ideally able to work west coast hours
Travel about 20% of the time: recruiting, time with teams and at our headquarters, and customer farm visits

blocks.text: Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us

items: The People - we have an amazing group of talented, smart and fun people on our team!
The Company - we are building something novel that has not been done before which is making a huge impact on the dairy industry!
The Experience - you get to come in and be a part of ground breaking work that will have a huge impact on generations to come!

jobs.title: Director, AI and Emerging Technology
jobs.text:
SUMMARY
Responsible for translating AF Group’s business strategy into AI and emerging technology execution that delivers measurable business value. Partners with business leaders to define opportunities, build business cases, prioritize use cases, and develop an execution roadmap from evaluation through production adoption. Leads cross-functional delivery in close partnership with Information Security, Platform, Application, and Data teams and the Center of Excellence (CoE). Engages heavily with the CoE and governance partners to apply established capabilities, standards, and responsible AI requirements; does not own governance functions, but does lead and facilitate CoE operations. Provides strategic leadership, manages delivery resources and budgets, and develops leaders and team members to advance adoption, execution excellence, and value realization.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Translate business strategy and operational needs into AI and emerging technology opportunities, business cases, and measurable outcomes in partnership with business leaders.
Evaluate AI and emerging technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation, for business fit, maturity, scalability, cost, and risk. Lead focused proofs of value and recommend whether to scale, refine, or discontinue initiatives.
Lead cross-functional execution with Information Security, Platform, Application, and Data teams, engaging partners early to align security requirements, architecture, infrastructure, application integration, and data needs.
Coordinate delivery from discovery and experimentation through production deployment with technical teams. Establish release readiness, support handoffs, and ongoing performance monitoring with delivery and operational owners.
Identify and prioritize use cases based on strategic alignment, expected value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and delivery capacity. Establish success measures and an execution roadmap with clear milestones, dependencies, and accountable partners.
Partner with business owners and Learning and Development to redesign workflows, support training and change management, and drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions. Track adoption and business results against agreed success measures.
Facilitates and leads cross-functional AI CoE and partners with governance and business partners to leverage reusable capabilities, implementation patterns, and approved standards. Incorporate required reviews and responsible AI controls into delivery without assuming ownership of governance functions or CoE operations.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research or related field is required. Master's degree or PhD in related field is preferred.
Minimum nine (9) years of related work experience is required, including experience translating business priorities into technology execution, leading cross-functional delivery, and implementing AI or related emerging technology solutions.
Previous experience working in the P&C Insurance industry is preferred.
QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Advanced communication skills, including the ability to explain AI opportunities, limitations, delivery trade-offs, and business outcomes to executive, business, and technical audiences.
Advanced relationship-building skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Information Security, Platform, Application, and Data teams, the CoE, and governance stakeholders.
Advanced influence and negotiation skills to align stakeholders on priorities, decisions, resources, and shared delivery commitments.
Advanced change management skills to support workflow transformation, workforce readiness, production adoption, and sustained use of AI-enabled solutions.
Advanced strategy development skills, including business case development, use-case prioritization, execution roadmaps, and value measurement.
Expert execution skills, including leading cross-functional initiatives from experimentation through production and coordinating operational readiness and support.
Expert problem-solving skills and sound judgment in evaluating AI and emerging technologies, assessing risks and trade-offs, and selecting practical solutions.
Working knowledge of generative AI and machine learning solution lifecycles, evaluation methods, data quality, application integration, and production monitoring. Familiarity with Python, SQL, relational databases, ETL, and DevOps/MLOps practices is preferred.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms, AI services, and scalable solution architectures, with the ability to apply established security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements in partnership with designated owners.
Advanced project and portfolio management skills, including roadmap planning, dependency management, budgeting, delivery risk management, and benefits realization.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
Directly supervises a varied number of employees in the designated department(s). Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. This job description does not constitute a contract for employment.
PAY RANGE:
“Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $187,660 and $314,325.”
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment in any form. Candidates for the position stated above are hired on an "at will" basis. Nothing herein is intended to create a contract.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Engineering – Remote
jobs.text:
Symetra is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Symetra's Digital Experience engineering organization, driving the technology behind customer, partner, and employee experiences.
About the role
This role is responsible for defining technology strategy, building and developing high-performing engineering teams, and delivering secure, scalable digital products that create measurable business value.
As a strategic technology leader, you will partner across Product, Architecture, UX, and business teams to modernize capabilities, accelerate delivery, and shape the future of Symetra's digital ecosystem. You will play a key role in fostering an engineering culture centered on innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
What you will do
Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization, creating an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Define and execute technology strategies aligned with business priorities, customer needs, and long-term organizational goals.
Partner closely with Product, Architecture, UX, and business leaders to deliver modern digital experiences and enterprise capabilities.
Drive large-scale modernization, cloud transformation, and digital product initiatives from concept through production delivery.
Champion engineering best practices including Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, security, quality, and reliability.
Oversee the design, development, and operation of secure, scalable, cloud-native solutions leveraging AWS and modern engineering frameworks.
Build, coach, and retain exceptional engineering talent, including leaders, architects, and individual contributors.
Establish strong partnerships with vendors and technology partners to support product delivery, platform evolution, and operational excellence.
Balance innovation, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational stability across the technology portfolio.
Provide executive-level leadership, strategic guidance, and investment recommendations related to technology priorities and engineering resources.
Why Work at Symetra
“I truly believe there’s something for everyone at Symetra. No matter what your passion is, if you enjoy being part of something bigger than yourself and want to make a meaningful difference, this is the place for you. We’re more than just an insurance company—we’re a community with purpose.” - Joanne S., AVP Compliance
"Symetra will spoil you. There aren't many companies that will put as much effort into you being a success as Symetra. The culture will challenge you but simultaneously put you at ease. Failure is seen as integral to the learning process so there is less reason to be fearful of it." - Kerry S., Sr. Systems Analyst
What we offer you
We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.
Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview
Compensation
Salary Range: $171,300 - $285,600 plus eligibility for the company annual bonus program.
Who You Are
12+ years of progressive experience leading software engineering teams and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including experience leading managers and senior technical talent.
Proven success leading engineering organizations responsible for customer-facing digital products, platforms, or experiences.
Strong track record of translating business strategy into technology roadmaps and successfully delivering complex, large-scale initiatives.
Experience building and scaling cloud-native applications and platforms in AWS, including modern architecture and serverless technologies.
Deep expertise in Agile development, DevSecOps, CI/CD, software delivery, platform reliability, and engineering operations.
Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain high-performing teams while fostering an inclusive and growth-oriented culture.
Skilled at influencing and partnering with executives, business stakeholders, product leaders, and technical teams to drive alignment and results.
Experience balancing innovation, operational excellence, risk management, and technology modernization efforts.
Demonstrated experience enhancing engineering practices and transforming SDLC with AI.
Strong business and financial acumen, including prioritization, resource planning, budgeting, and investment decision-making.
Exceptional communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to inspire teams and drive organizational change.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and a high school diploma.
Relevant cloud or technology certifications are a plus.
Ability to travel as needed to support the business.
Travel:
Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.
Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.
Identity Verification
Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
Disqualification from the recruitment process
Withdrawal of a job offer
Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

Demonstrated experience enhancing engineering practices and transforming SDLC with AI.
Strong business and financial acumen, including prioritization, resource planning, budgeting, and investment decision-making.
Exceptional communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to inspire teams and drive organizational change.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and a high school diploma.
Relevant cloud or technology certifications are a plus.
Ability to travel as needed to support the business.

Required Training & Professional Development

All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.
Reasonable Accommodations

Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.

Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
​​​​​Role Summary
The Director of Product leads Greenshades' product organization — owning roadmap strategy, delivery execution, and product experience quality across our payroll, HR, and tax compliance solutions. This role carries a specific mandate to reorient product strategy for the AI era: identifying where AI can reshape workflows, unlock new efficiencies, and differentiate the platform. This role manages a team of Product Managers and a Product Experience/UX designer, and partners closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, and Product Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects real market and customer signal. As part of an integrated Product and Marketing organization, this role is central to tightening the loop between what customers need and what gets built.
Responsibilities
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and the Product Experience/UX function; set clear priorities, coach on craft, and manage performance and growth.
Own and maintain a groomed, prioritized product roadmap that reflects the highest-value initiatives across Greenshades' product lines, grounded in customer and market signal.
Drive Greenshades' product strategy into the AI era — evaluating where AI/ML can create step-change efficiency and experience improvements across the product line, and ensuring roadmap prioritization reflects that lens going forward rather than treating AI as a bolt-on feature.
Own Product Experience: ensure usability, design consistency, and overall product quality are considered alongside feature delivery, not treated as an afterthought.
Drive day-to-day product delivery in close partnership with Engineering, ensuring features ship on time, within scope, and aligned with roadmap priorities.
Partner with Customer Experience to strengthen how customer and market signal flows into intake, triage, and prioritization — bringing structure and clarity to how requests become roadmap decisions.
Serve as a key product escalation point for significant customer and internal issues, working with Support, TPE, and Engineering to resolve or route issues appropriately.
Partner with Product Marketing to ensure roadmap priorities, positioning, and launch timing are aligned and well-sequenced.
Build and maintain deep working knowledge of payroll, HR, and tax business processes, including how AI is reshaping those domains, through customer research, competitive analysis, and ongoing industry engagement.
Partner with the CMO on Product team budget, resourcing, and prioritization tradeoffs; report on progress against roadmap and team capacity.
Other duties as assigned.
Requirements
5-7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, including 5+ years leading a team of Product Managers or equivalent ICs.
Experience managing a complex domain (payroll, HR, tax, compliance, or similar), or a track record of quickly mastering a new business domain, with a specific example you can describe.
Have shipped AI or ML-enabled capabilities in a B2B product, or led a roadmap shift toward AI.
Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product talent, including managing performance and supporting career growth.
Experience balancing roadmap strategy with hands-on delivery, including keeping features on schedule and in scope alongside Engineering.
Experience working day to day with Engineering, Customer Success/CX, and Marketing to align product decisions with business priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining product strategy and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience presenting product strategy, roadmap progress, and resourcing tradeoffs to executive leadership, with the judgment to tailor depth and framing for an ELT audience.
Travel Required: Up to 15%
Location: This is a remote position.

jobs.text:
Company
Lumicera
About Us
Lumicera - Lumicera Health Services Powered by Navitus - Innovative Specialty Pharmacy Solutions- Lumicera Health Services is defining the “new norm” in specialty pharmacy to optimize patient well-being through our core principles of transparency and stewardship. Here at Lumicera, our team members work in an environment that celebrates creativity and fosters diversity. .. Current associates must use SSO login option at to be considered for internal opportunities. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees and comply with all applicable nondiscrimination regulations, including those related to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or handicap.
Pay Range
USD $152,177.00 - USD $190,096.00 /Yr.
STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)
17.50 - Director, GM of GP, PIC
Work Schedule Description (e.g. M-F 8am to 5pm)
M-F: 8:00 am - 5:00 pm
Remote Work Notification
ATTENTION: Lumicera is only able to offer remote work to residents of Arizona, Alabama, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
Overview
Lumicera Health Services is adding a new position, a Director, Analytics and Data, to join our remote team! This is a leadership position with frequent communication and facetime with executive leadership. In addition, this role will understand and plan the technical work for their team of analytics professionals. This is a nimble, ideas-driven role that will quickly put imagination into action.
The Director, Analytics and Data leads Lumicera’s enterprise data and analytics function and is accountable for the strategy, delivery, governance, and adoption of trusted data products, reporting, and analytical capabilities. The role leads data and analytics associates and partners, and works closely with business leaders, technology teams, finance, clinical operations, pharmacy operations, compliance, privacy, security, and enterprise data stakeholders.
The Director, Analytics and Data advances Lumicera’s ability to use data as a business asset by establishing clear priorities, reliable delivery practices, effective governance, and accessible insights. The Director connects the Data Lakehouse, shared data models, business intelligence, and advanced analytics to measurable business outcomes, operational decision-making, patient and client needs, and the organization’s broader transformation and artificial intelligence strategies.
Is this you? Find out more below!
Responsibilities
How do I make an impact on my team?
Define and execute the data and analytics strategy, operating model, roadmap, and investment priorities in alignment with Lumicera business objectives and enterprise standards.
Lead and develop the data and analytics team, establishes clear accountability, manages capacity and performance, and builds the capabilities required to meet current and future business needs.
Own the delivery and ongoing improvement of enterprise data products, reporting, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support reliable business decisions.
Advance the Data Lakehouse and related data platforms by prioritizing source integration, data hydration, shared data models, consumption capabilities, scalability, reliability, and cost effectiveness.
Establish data governance practices for ownership, definitions, quality, lineage, metadata, access, retention, privacy, and appropriate use in partnership with business and control functions.
Create an intake and prioritization process that connects analytics demand to strategic value, regulatory needs, delivery capacity, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes.
Improve reporting effectiveness by rationalizing redundant assets, promoting governed self-service, maintaining a trusted catalog, and increasing the use of consistent enterprise metrics.
Partner with business leaders to translate strategic and operational questions into data products, insights, forecasts, and performance measures that support action and accountability.
Enable advanced analytics and artificial intelligence by improving data readiness, governed access, feature and model inputs, analytical methods, and monitoring of data-dependent outcomes.
Manage data and analytics vendors, contracts, budgets, delivery commitments, and platform decisions to maximize value and reduce unnecessary complexity or duplication.
Other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
What our team expects from you?
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
10+ years of progressive experience in Data, Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Platform capabilities within a complex enterprise environment experience required.
5+ years of progressive leadership experience including leading technical or analytical teams, which may include leading individual contributors or teams, required.
Experience developing and executing data and analytics strategies, roadmaps, operating models, and demand prioritization processes required.
Experience delivering enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, data models, reporting, dashboards, and governed self-service analytics required.
Experience establishing data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, access, and privacy practices required.
Experience translating business priorities into measurable analytical outcomes and communicating tradeoffs to executive, operational, clinical, and technical audiences required.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, delivery partners, and cross-functional programs with multiple dependencies required.
Knowledge of cloud data platforms, modern data architecture, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and data foundations for artificial intelligence required.
Knowledge of healthcare data, regulated environments, HIPAA, and specialty pharmacy operations required.
Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.
What can you expect from Lumicera?
Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
20 days paid time off
4 weeks paid parental leave
9 paid holidays
401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
Adoption Assistance Program
Flexible Spending Account
Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

jobs.title: Vice President, Product
jobs.text:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**
About SafelyYou
SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.
Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.
SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.
Your Role at SafelyYou
Our product works; how we build hasn't kept up. Our product and technology teams own customer outcomes, built on shared platforms. As VP of Product, you lead the product management team and own the portfolio: one committed roadmap, where investment goes, and which bets get funded, changed, or stopped. The CPTO sets overall direction and the VP of Engineering owns delivery; you own product execution You'll inherit a capable team ready for a stronger operating model, and part of the job is deciding what to keep, rebuild, and stop. Operators are choosing their technology partners for the next decade, and you'll have a seat at the leadership table as we earn that choice. Every improvement you ship reaches residents, families, and caregivers. You'll work daily with the CPTO and VP of Engineering, and closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, our clinical team, Operations, and Strategy.
Key Responsibilities:
The Numbers You'll Own
Customer NOI. Own SafelyYou's impact on operator NOI per resident, proven with outcome data in each care setting.
Wellness AI and staffing intelligence. Build both into scaled product lines alongside Safety AI.
Throughput. Double the rate of committed features launched to customers within the next year, measured by release to market and adoption, not tickets closed.
What You'll Own
One roadmap. A single customer-facing roadmap tied to company objectives. Sales sells what's committed.
The portfolio. Allocate investment across customer-facing teams, shared platforms (AI, data and integrations, devices, hardware), and longer-horizon bets, and make stage-gate calls on evidence.
The operating model.With the VP of Engineering, run annual strategy, quarterly planning, and published decision rights. Build the operations support PMs need to focus on outcomes.
The ecosystem. Drive partner adoption so SafelyYou insights reach caregivers inside the EHR and eCall systems they already use.
Trusted AI. Clear accuracy and false-alarm standards, privacy by design, and evidence before anything reaches the field.
The market. Be in the room with our largest operators, shape pricing and packaging with Sales and Marketing, and represent product at industry events and with investors.
The team. Coach, level, and hire product managers, and build a bench of future leaders.
The Ideal Candidate:
The hard requirement:you've led product managers through an operating-model change, such as functional teams to outcome and platform teams, on products that combine hardware, AI/ML, and cloud software.
10+ years in product, including 5+ years leading PMs across multiple product areas.
AI/ML, hardware, and platform or partner-ecosystem products shipped to market, including stage-gated development, certification, and field reliability.
Enterprise B2B credibility. You've carried a product number, not just supported one.
A decisive player-coach and clear writer who earns engineering's respect.
Strongly preferred, and learnable:healthcare or senior living experience, and regulated products (HIPAA, life-safety).
Salary Range:$260,000 - $280,000 USD commensurate with experience
Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!
SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:
A mission-driven company culture
Fully remote
Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision
401k Program
Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends
Non-accrual PTO
Growth Potential
Company Retreats
Medical & Family/Parental Leave
At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Our Story
At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software empowers sales associates to have more personal, effective conversations with customers through AI-powered tools that drive measurable revenue.
Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, most platforms overlook the in-store experience. We’re changing that. We’re helping brands like Reformation, Gorjana, Glossier, Frame, and Mizzen+Main turn real customer relationships into growth powered by intuitive software and thoughtful design.
With rapid growth ahead, we’re scaling our Product organization and need a steady, capable leader to help us get there.
Position Overview
Endear is hiring a VP of Product to take day-to-day ownership of the product organization during a pivotal phase of growth. Partnering closely with leadership on long-term vision, you will translate company goals into clear product priorities and lead execution against the agreed mission.
This role is central to making Endear’s product team AI-native. You will improve how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, make decisions, and accelerate shipping—not just shape Endear’s AI product direction. You will bring a zero-to-one mindset, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and build the operating model needed for product, design, and engineering to move faster together.
This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will lead and develop the product team, partner deeply with Design and Engineering, assess team structure and resourcing, and hire additional product talent as needed. We are looking for someone who has shipped products in lean environments, can go deep when needed, and knows how to build scalable processes without adding unnecessary overhead
What You’ll Accomplish
In your first 6 months, you’ll…
Take clear day-to-day ownership of product, turning company priorities into an actionable roadmap and measurable outcomes.
Align leadership, Product, Design, and Engineering around a cohesive product vision and a clear path to execution.
Assess the current team, operating model, and resourcing; identify what needs to change to improve speed, ownership, and accountability.
Establish stronger product rituals and decision-making systems that help the team ship with more focus and less friction.
Build practical customer-feedback loops into roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Make the product organization more AI-native by improving how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, prioritize, and ship.
In your first year, you’ll…
Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, strong psychological safety, and the right team structure for the next stage.
Hire and develop product talent, including an additional PM, while evaluating the capabilities and resourcing the team needs.
Deliver high-impact roadmap work that improves product adoption and business outcomes.
Establish scalable planning, execution, and communication systems that keep teams aligned as Endear grows.
Help shape and execute Endear’s AI product direction while ensuring the team can move quickly from idea to shipped product.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If…
You Have Experience With
Leading product at a lean B2B SaaS company, with both strategic ownership and hands-on execution.
Turning company goals into clear product priorities, success metrics, and decisions.
Building and communicating product vision, then translating it into focused execution.
Partnering deeply with Design and Engineering, including going technical when needed.
Leading, mentoring, and growing Product Managers while maintaining a high bar for delivery.
Building product processes that add clarity and speed without creating unnecessary overhead.
Using AI tools in day-to-day product work—from research and problem framing to prototyping, prioritization, and execution.
Transforming how product teams work in an AI-native environment.
Using customer feedback, usage data, and market insight to guide roadmap decisions.
Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving growth-stage environments.
Align With What We Value
At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:
Customer First: Prioritize real customer problems over internal assumptions. Use research, feedback, and product data to ensure the roadmap delivers meaningful value to merchants and sales associates.
Take Ownership: Own outcomes, not just outputs. Take responsibility for product direction, team performance, and the impact product decisions have on the business.
Enable Autonomy: Build clear product strategy, priorities, and processes so product, design, and engineering teams can execute with confidence and independence.
Under Promise, Over Deliver: Set realistic expectations for product initiatives and deliver consistent, measurable improvements that build trust with customers and the team.
Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Balance thoughtful strategy with a bias toward action. Test ideas, iterate quickly, and ship improvements that create real business impact.
About the Team
You’ll partner most closely with:
Executive Team: Align product strategy with company goals, provide visibility into roadmap priorities and performance, and partner on key decisions around growth and product direction.
Head of Product Design: strategy, feedback, and design system development
Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, and merchant needs
Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration
We’re a small team with big ambitions—collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Screen
Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder
Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members
Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO
Offer 🎉
Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary: $190+240k
Equity Eligible
Fully remote team
Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Co-working or home office stipend
Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation
Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry
Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. We care about skills, motivation, and how you think more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Analytics Architecture Director
jobs.text:
Overview
The Data Governance & Analytics Architecture Director is a leader within the Health Enablement Analytics organization responsible for ensuring all data, analytics, and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, standardized, and governed foundation. This role serves as a subject matter expert for data governance, analytics architecture, and AI/ML best practices across Health Enablement. This role provides advisory leadership, technical guidance, and architecture standards to ensure analytics and innovation efforts are aligned to enterprise data strategy and built in a scalable, sustainable manner.
This position operates as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Analytics, and Reporting teams helping shape how solutions are designed and delivered; enabling Health Enablement Analytics to operate as a reliable, high-impact capability, driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Standards
Contribute to the development of data governance standards, and best practices across analytics and reporting.
Provide guidance on data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of enterprise data assets.
Support the standardization of data models, business metrics, and reusable data assets to improve consistency and efficiency.
Implement governance frameworks, ensuring policies are embedded into day-to-day data and analytics workflows.
Establish clear data stewardship accountability across business and analytics teams.
Oversee data quality processes, metadata management, and governance monitoring to ensure sustained data integrity.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Information Governance, data risk, and compliance alignment.
Data Architecture & Platform Alignment
Drive standardization of data assets to reduce fragmentation and enable consistent cross-domain insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on analytics architecture across BI, reporting, and advanced analytics.
Partner with teams to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise data platforms and long‑term strategy.
Recommend architectural approaches that support scalability, interoperability, and reuse.
Technical Enablement & Scalable Delivery
Serve as a technical SME contributing to AI/ML standards and best practices.
Provide guidance to ensure analytic and AI solutions are designed for scalability and sustainability.
Advise on approaches to monitor performance, manage technical debt, and identify architectural risk.
Assess technical feasibility of innovation and analytics initiatives and provide input on viable solution approaches.
Consult on solution design to support production readiness and scalability.
Identify constraints in data or architecture and propose practical workarounds to enable business outcomes.
Define guardrails that enable faster decision-making and reduce execution friction.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Serve as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Data Science, Reporting, and broader enterprise teams.
Translate business and analytics requirements into technical solutions and executable designs.
Provide input on feasibility, architecture, and standards to support solution development.
Collaborate across teams to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise direction while meeting business needs.
Contribute technical expertise to vendor evaluations and platform decisions as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field required.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, data engineering, and analytics roles.
5+ years of leadership experience driving data governance, data architecture, and analytics platform initiatives at enterprise scale.
Proven ability to define and implement data governance frameworks, standards, and data quality processes.
Strong expertise in: data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse architectures, cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
Experience enabling analytics and AI/ML solutions to scale from prototype to production deployment.
Strong understanding of BI platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data lifecycle management.
Experience working across analytics, product, engineering, and innovation teams in complex environments.
Ability to translate business and analytics priorities into scalable technical architecture and design.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making capabilities.
Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment as part of a distributed team with effective communication and collaboration skills.
Proven ability to handle stressful situations, multiple tasks, and deadline Enterprise project management methods and process management experience preferred.
Shares information with all appropriate stakeholders and escalates to director in a timely, effective.
Strong written and oral communication The ability to communicate effectively (clear, concise, and professionally) at all levels within Cotiviti.
Demonstrated teamwork, leadership, and project management discipline.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive business outcomes.
Cognitive/Mental Requirements:
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected
Base compensation ranges from $150,000 to $200,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
Date of posting: 08/27/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 09/27/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.text:
Description
We're seeking an exceptional, hands-on Data Scientist with deep expertise in data science, MLOps, and building GenAI solutions to join our Enterprise Data & Data Science team. In this role, you'll identify, evaluate, and develop solutions at the intersection of data science, generative AI, and enterprise data strategy—including GenAI evaluation frameworks and semantic data layers. You'll also serve as a community champion, driving the adoption of best practices across a large, collaborative data science organization.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and evaluate generative AI solutions and agentic systems
Develop and maintain data semantic layers and knowledge graphs for enterprise-scale data accessibility
Build evaluation frameworks and tools to assess GenAI systems' performance, reliability, and safety
Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business partners
Champion best practices and tooling across a broad data science community
Lead cross-functional working groups and contribute to innovation in AI/ML methods
Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
Please note this is an individual contributor role
Qualifications
Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Preferred Experience:
Strong foundation in data science and machine learning
Proven MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle
Experience building GenAI solutions and agentic systems
Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies
Experience with data semantic layers and/or knowledge graphs
Track record of cross-functional collaboration in a large enterprise environment
Ability to work ET hours

jobs.title: Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
jobs.text:
The role
As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.
This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.
What you’ll do
M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.
Portfolio Optimization: Lead the strategic analysis and recommendations for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
Corporate Strategy: Contribute to the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, owning the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.
Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
What you’ll bring
Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.
Process and deal leadership: You have led complex, multi-stakeholder processes to a deadline, coordinating internal functions and external advisors and managing senior counterparties such as target or client management teams. This can come from running M&A transactions (in-house corporate development or advisory) or from leading strategy projects with transaction exposure, such as due diligence, carve-outs, partnerships or market entries. Direct M&A process experience is a strong plus; the ability to learn it quickly is essential.
Leadership and Influence: You have guided and developed more junior colleagues and influenced senior stakeholders, including through negotiation and building rapport with counterparties.
Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You structure ambiguous problems and set direction for others, not just solve them yourself. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
Financial Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended complex models used for high-stakes investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentations and memos for an executive audience.
How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.
What you will get in return:
70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
Company pension scheme
Gym membership
Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
Nursery support scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Group Life Assurance
Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London
Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.
Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.
To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.
You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
The Mission: Club Arran delivers complex digital services across UK Central Government. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together Product, Delivery, UCD, Architecture and Engineering to solve problems and deliver sustainable outcomes.
We are now building on that foundation to become an AI integration consultancy for government: helping clients take AI and emerging technologies beyond experimentation and into real services, safely and sustainably.
We are looking for a Head of Product to champion user-centred design and product strategy, ensuring that as we integrate advanced technologies, we never lose sight of the user's needs.
Reporting to the Club Executive and sitting on the Club Leadership Team, you will be accountable for product and UCD excellence across Arran's portfolio and act as the Head of Profession for our Product and UCD capabilities.

jobs.title: VP & GM: Product Platform
jobs.text:
Why Entersekt
Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.
Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded product leader who combines strong platform thinking with a relentless focus on adoption and business value. You’re comfortable operating across product, technology and commercial considerations, turning complex and sometimes competing needs into clear priorities and scalable platform solutions.
You build credibility quickly and influence effectively across teams, including where you don’t have direct authority. You’re equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders, making tough roadmap and investment trade-offs, and developing a high-performing product team.
The Role
Owns the end-to-end success of the Platform components, as a horizontal capability that other portfolio solutions build on and consume. Accountable not just for the health of the platform components individually, but for the penetration and value they deliver when embedded across the broader portfolio. Success is measured as much by cross-portfolio adoption as by each component’s standalone quality.
Responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and business performance for the Entersekt Platform including Portal, Administration, Reporting, Detection & Decisioning capabilities.
Set the product vision for how these & future components serve as reusable building blocks rather than siloed products
Partner with your Pier GMs to drive an explicit adoption strategy and targets for each component across all portfolio solutions (e.g., % of solutions integrated, active usage within each solution, time-to-integrate) and identify evolving needs that should be served via reusable platform components
Remove adoption blockers - technical debt, integration friction, packaging/pricing barriers, or lack of awareness - that slow uptake
Build the internal "go-to-market" motion for the platform itself: enablement, documentation, migration support, and success stories that make adoption easy for other product teams
Balance platform roadmap decisions against the sometimes-competing needs of multiple consuming product lines - arbitrating trade-offs transparently
Own cost, investment, and value-capture model for the platform
Define and track health metrics per component (usage, reliability, performance, satisfaction)
Build and lead product management (and potentially design/eng-partnership) for the three components
Represent Platform in executive/portfolio planning forums
Skills and Experience
Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience essential.
Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA, Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent executive/business education advantageous.
10+ years’ experience in Product Management, Product Leadership or a related technology product discipline, including significant experience in a senior product leadership role.
Proven experience owning product strategy, roadmaps and business performance for complex B2B technology, SaaS or platform products.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling platform products/shared capabilities consumed by multiple products, solutions or product teams.
Strong track record of driving platform adoption and measurable usage, including identifying and removing technical, integration, commercial and organisational barriers to adoption.
Experience balancing the competing requirements of multiple product lines and making transparent roadmap, investment and prioritisation trade-offs.
Experience developing business cases, investment models and value-capture approaches, with strong commercial and financial judgement.
Experience defining and managing product health and performance measures covering areas such as adoption, usage, reliability, performance and stakeholder/customer satisfaction.
Proven experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical leadership on architecture, integration, technical debt and platform scalability decisions.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders across functions, including achieving alignment without direct authority.
Proven people leadership experience, including building, developing and leading product teams and holding teams accountable for outcomes.
Personality Attributes
Strategic and systems-minded, able to connect customer, product, technology and business considerations.
Influential and collaborative, building alignment across diverse stakeholders and conflicting perspectives.
Commercially pragmatic, balancing long-term platform strategy with business and portfolio needs.
Decisive in ambiguity, comfortable navigating complexity and making clear trade-offs.
Low ego, high conviction, open to challenge and feedback while confident in making difficult decisions.
Clear and candid, able to simplify complex topics and communicate decisions with impact.
Outcome-focused, measuring success through adoption, value and results rather than output alone.
Accountable and dependable, taking ownership, following through and setting a strong standard for others.
We place a lot of value on how we treat prospective employees and appreciate the time and effort that goes into job hunting. That is why we aim to keep the hiring process as quick and seamless as possible while ensuring the best possible fit for both you and the company.
Working at Entersekt is truly a dream. You get exposed to cutting-edge technology, colleagues who are leaders in their fields, and an awesome working environment that includes flexible hours, remote work, and plenty of growth opportunities.
Apply for this position by following the "apply now" tab and or viewing our other roles at Entersekt Careers page.
Entersekt is an Equal Opportunity Employer:
We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. For all South Africa-based roles, preference will be given to candidates from historically disadvantaged groups, in accordance with local Employment Equity objectives.
