Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US, US
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
USA
Summary

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
Job description summary

The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening oncology-focused data partnerships that sup-port the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across oncology brands, customer engagement, patient access, and field execution.

This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic oncology data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and oncology data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant oncology data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:

items: Implement the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial oncology brands, functions, and priority use cases.
Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic oncology data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external oncology data assets.
Apply deep understanding of oncology data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.

Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external oncology data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.

Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, and cross-functional oncology teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
Implement oversight mechanisms for external oncology data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.

Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that oncology data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.

Track oncology data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand oncology business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.

Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.

blocks.text: Experience:

Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing oncology data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and oncology data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate oncology business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, and compliance, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.
Essential Requirements:

items: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 6+ years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on oncology, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of oncology data assets, including data sourcing, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of oncology data.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills in a complex organizational environment.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess vendor data quality, identify data gaps, manage risks associated with external data partnerships, and ensure the integrity, security, and quality of shared data.
Experience working with IQVIA, Komodo, MMIT, Symphony, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva, Flatiron, or similar healthcare and oncology data sources is highly desirable.
Ability to translate oncology business needs into data solutions and guide teams in selecting and leveraging the right data sets to support decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.
You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.
Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.
About the Job
This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.
You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.
You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.
What We're Looking For
Required Experience & Qualifications
10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Nice to Have
Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.
Core Expectations
You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.text:
Position Summary...
What you'll do...
Walmart is building the future Commerce. We are seeking a Director of Strategic Partnerships & Business Development to build and drive ecosystem partnerships across AI, Commerce and Growth platforms and tech. From big tech to hyper-scalers and foundation model providers, you will identify and negotiate the foundational deals that integrate cutting-edge technology into the lives of millions. Operating at the high-stakes intersection of product, engineering, and commercial strategy, you will be the bridge between 'what’s next' and 'what’s possible at scale' - sourcing opportunities, structuring complex deals, and driving execution across the enterprise.
About the team: Our team leads strategic partnerships and business development at Walmart, collaborating closely with Business, Product, and Technology groups. We focus on shaping strategy, accelerating innovation, and delivering measurable value to customers and associates. By leveraging expertise in program and financial management, stakeholder engagement, and business operations, we drive impactful initiatives and foster strong partner relationships. The team is committed to aligning technology and business goals to support sustainable growth and operational excellence across the organization.
What you'll do:
Partnerships Strategy and Business Development:
Define, lead Walmart's top tech partnerships roadmap aligned to product and enterprise strategy.
Launch and scale new tech partnerships that enable AI and other experiences.
Develop exec-ready ready recommendations. Influence senior leadership on strategic direction.
Build, manage strategic partners portfolio that accelerates Walmart's top priorities.
Deal Structuring and Negotiation:
Lead end-to-end deal execution from exploratory discussions through term sheets and full contract negotiation and execution.
Structure complex agreements involving IP, data rights, co-development, platform integrations and commercialization models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Lead highly matrixed teams across Engineering, Product, Advertising, Payments, Marketing, Business.
Remove execution barriers and drive accountability across internal and external partners.
What you'll bring:
12+ years of experience in business development, partnerships.
8+ years of experience negotiating and managing the implementation and execution of term sheets and signed agreements with partners.
Proven track record sourcing, structuring, and scaling enterprise level partnerships that drive measurable business impact.
Experience influencing and presenting to executive leadership, including VP, SVP, Csuite, and external executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross functional teams, manage complex partner relationships, and drive adoption of new products and features
Benefits:
Benefits: Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include 401(k) match, stock purchase plan, paid maternity and parental leave, PTO, multiple health plans, and much more.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers, and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The full Job Description can be made available as part of the hiring process. At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see . Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

jobs.title: Games Creative/Design Director
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As Creative/Design Director, you will be responsible for guiding Incubator creators toward the successful development of novel games (Read about novel games, the Incubator program and its charter at https://create.roblox.com/build). This design & creative leader will be instrumental in helping Incubator participants find the right rich game dynamics for their games, whether these creators come from the Roblox creator community or the off-platform traditional game community. The ideal candidate has a history of creative leadership (including design) across a variety of games, along with a broad knowledge of design elements and their application in successful games across the industry. You will report to the Senior Lead, Incubator.
You will:
Own design feedback to all (external) Incubator creators
Oversee group feedback on specific builds and milestones
Ideate on alchemy of Roblox and traditional success to help creators find innovation and value in their games
Foster creator-to-creator community interactions, both individually and by creating sustainable processes and partnerships
Build and execute effective design related workflows between internal disciplines and Roblox creators
Collaborate cross-functionally (production, product, analytics, engineering, marketing, partnerships and more) to facilitate design related deliverables and deadlines
Work with marketing and creative teams to devise and execute on GTM strategies
Support analytics to set up goals, measure impact, and increase growth KPIs
Help the novel games initiative across non-Incubator projects as needed
You have:
15+ years of creative or game design experience with proven track record of conceptualizing, creating, guiding and refining game designs
Ability to adapt and learn new game and platform dynamics, in order to demonstrate expertise in both traditional and Roblox game design
Superb written and verbal communication skills that guide and convince
Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including production, product, analytics, engineering, marketing, partnerships and more
Domain experience with UGC, social and gaming; ability to understand and design for player behavior, expectations and trends
Understanding of game design, principles and mechanics
Experience working with 3rd party creators and developers
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile and iterative development environment
Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and ambiguity
Excellent organization skills
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$287,590—$336,450 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: Director, Brand Design
jobs.text:
About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings, and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors, as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We're headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
About the Role
Betterment is entering its next phase of growth, and we’re looking for a Director of Brand Design to raise the ambition and craft of our brand everywhere it shows up.
This role is for someone who obsesses over the kerning in a web nav as much as over the motion piece that moves people. You have exceptional taste, a sense of curiosity to learn new things, and a strong point of view. You’ll be the brand’s primary design voice and the final word on our brand design system, knowing when to hold the line and when to evolve. You will make the brand feel like one brand across advertising, web, motion and sales collateral, for both our Retail and B2B businesses.
You’ll stay hands-on. You’ll lead concepting and art direction on our biggest initiatives and shape them from the first idea. You’ll polish the work that matters most and jump in wherever the craft needs you. You’ll also lead and develop a small team of designers, setting the bar for their work and trusting them to own execution in their areas. Stakeholders will come to you for creative direction, not just review.
Reporting to the VP, Brand Creative, you’ll partner closely with our Director of Copy and our Director of Brand Operations.
This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.
New York City: $175,000-$205,000
This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.
A Day in the Life
Act as the arbiter of our brand design system and standards; challenge the system when it starts to feel stagnant and keep a constant eye on how our visual identity needs to evolve.
Review and shape creative briefs before work begins, ensuring projects start with clear direction and objectives.
Hold the overall craft bar across advertising, web, motion, and collateral. Lead concepting and art direction on key initiatives, personally refining work at critical moments, and catching any execution misses or inconsistencies.
Manage and develop a team of senior designers: set clear goals, deliver regular and constructive feedback, and push design execution from good to great.
Build and pitch proposals for new design initiatives.
Work closely with marketing and sales stakeholders on assignments to understand goals and what success looks like.
Create a team culture where designers feel empowered to take creative risks, raise dissenting opinions, and learn from projects that don't land perfectly the first time.
Represent your team's work and point of view to senior leadership, translating creative decisions into business context.
Participate in hiring: lead portfolio review interviews, evaluate candidates, and help scale the team as it grows.
Source and direct vendors and agencies to supplement our work.
What We're Looking For
10+ years of brand/design experience, including experience leading or managing designers.
A strong, well-defined point of view on brand design systems, with experience evolving an identity system over time rather than just applying one.
Proven ability to translate business strategy, objectives, and growth goals into a clear creative point of view and compelling work, while shaping creative briefs and providing direction before execution begins
Experience managing and developing designers at varying levels of seniority, including supporting both craft-focused and people-leadership growth paths.
A strong track record of partnering cross-functionally with copy and brand voice, marketing, operations, and external agencies to keep creative work on-brand and on schedule.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to represent your team’s work and decisions to senior and executive stakeholders.
A portfolio that demonstrates range and craft across advertising, web, motion, and sales materials.
Bonus points if you have experience:
Working in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry, given the compliance and disclosure requirements that shape our creative work.
Join a team built on these core values
We change lives
Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.
We set audacious goals
We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
We value all perspectives
When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
We simplify financial services
We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:
We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
What happens next
We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.
We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.
Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Come join us!
We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Product
jobs.text:
Goodwall
Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.
Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.
As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.
Your Role
You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.
Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.
What you will do
Scale a product members love returning to. Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
Accelerate member acquisition. Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
Bring Product and Growth together. Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
Set the standard for every detail. Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
Experiment with purpose. Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.
Hire and lead a strong team. Choose priorities, develop your people and direct budget toward lasting growth. Move quickly, remove obstacles and take responsibility for results.
What we offer
Competitivecompensation and equity: an ownership stake in a scale up raising its Series B.
Real authority across Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with the founders.
The opportunity to hire and lead yourownteam.
An establishedglobalcommunity and the chance to shape the experience of millions more members.
And most importantly, a mission to be proudof - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures
Requirements

Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.

Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.

jobs.title: AVP, Data Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.
The Assistant Vice President, Data Solutions Engineering will be responsible for building operational data pipelines and delivering fully documented datasets that account for data integrations. This role is engaged and aligned with our business partners to understand their needs and build data engineering solutions to address these needs. The role will report to the VP, Data Solutions Engineering.
This role will be based remotely.
What You Will Do:
Deliver well-architected data solutions in partnership with data platform engineers, data governance, data science, and data analytics/visualization peers.
Partner with business teams to design data solutions with the ability to mentor early career data engineers.
Lead build-out and deployment of data pipelines.
Ensure reliability, scalability and governance of data pipelines.
What You Will Have:
Bachelor's degree in Math, Computer Science or Engineering.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, Cloud, data operations.
Domain knowledge of Actuarial, Investment and Finance within Insurance/Reinsurance industry is a plus.
Minimum experience of seven years in a growing data engineering role, with at least five years in programming (Python) and SQL.
Robust knowledge of data lakes, data governance and modern data quality techniques.
Excellent analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills.
Strong verbal and written skills.
The base salary range for this role is listed below and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.
Base Salary Range
$160,000—$180,000 USD
At Fortitude Re, our strength has always come from our people. Our success is deeply rooted in our ability to embrace the unique attributes, perspectives and experiences of every individual within our company. Fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone—regardless of background, race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity—feels valued and respected is a foundation of our culture.
We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, diversity of thought and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
To all recruitment agencies: Unless you have been requested to work on this position, or other positions with Fortitude Re, please do not forward any resumes to Fortitude Re employees. Fortitude Re is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Check us out on YouTube: About Fortitude Re (youtube.com)
By submitting your application, you agree that Fortitude Re may collect your personal data for recruiting purposes. For more on how we handle your personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice. Concerned about recruitment fraud? Learn how to verify Fortitude Re's recruitment process: Recruitment Fraud Notice

jobs.title: Director of Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director of Data Governance sits within Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance and leads the evolution of DeepHealth's data ecosystem into a unified, high-quality enterprise asset. The role owns strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Data Governance Framework so data is accurate, secure, and ready for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Define and execute a Data Governance roadmap aligned with the Enterprise Information and Governance vision.
Review, maintain, and enforce the Data Management Policy and Data Governance Charter against current regulatory and business needs.
Facilitate decision-making on data standards and help resolve cross-functional data conflicts.
Implement Data Quality Management procedures and establish KPIs for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Define enterprise-wide data standards, including metadata management, data lineage, and master data management protocols.
Partner with IT and Security so data pipelines support AI applications while maintaining security boundaries.
Work with Security to define data classification levels and manage high-risk data access policies.
Ensure data practices adhere to applicable global privacy regulations and internal Enterprise Information and Governance mandates.
Align data governance priorities with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
Mentor and develop team members as the data governance capability grows.
Requirements
Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).
7 to 10 years of progressive experience in Data Management, Data Governance, or Information Architecture in healthcare, medical technology, or another highly regulated industry (required).
Strong experience with DAMA-DMBOK frameworks and data quality lifecycle management (required).
Deep understanding of data profiling tools, metadata management, and modern data stack concepts (required).
Experience with AI systems in production or product development contexts (required).
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including explaining complex concepts to diverse audiences (required).
High level of integrity and confidentiality (required).
Preferred: Master's degree or advanced relevant certifications.
Quality Standards
Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.
Travel
This position requires travel up to approximately 10%.
Working Environment
European Union. Remote-friendly or office-based role.
Physical Demands
The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Salary:
115,000.00-130,00.00 EURO
100,000.00-110,000.00 in France

jobs.title: VP, Systems Engineering NAR (Virtual, Texas, United States, 78701)
jobs.text:
In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
At Ruckus, our mission is to deliver purpose-driven networks across vertical markets, that drive human experiences where we learn, live, work, and play. With core values focused on innovation and customer success, RUCKUS has an unbeaten track record of redefining what’s possible in connectivity and network performance with our portfolio of AI-powered access points, multigigabit switching, and Cloud and Edge services.
We’re looking for a dynamic, customer-focused technology leader to drive innovation and impact as our VP of Systems Engineering NAR (North America Region) at RUCKUS. In this role, you’ll lead a team of SE professionals, shaping strategy, fostering trust, and ensuring every customer interaction delivers real business value.
“How You'll help us to connect the world:”
As the VP of Systems Engineering, NAR you will lead a geographically distributed team of Systems Engineers and Managers supporting customers and channel partners across the region.
This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for driving technical sales success through partner enablement, customer engagement, and team development in a diverse and high-growth market. You will work closely with regional sales leadership, distributors, and partners to expand RUCKUS adoption and ensure strong technical alignment across countries.You will attract, recruit, and develop talented SEs and support the team’s efforts to successfully position, influence and grow the RUCKUS product portfolio to net new and existing installed base customers and channel partners
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of Systems Engineers across the NAR region
Develop and execute a strategic SE business plan to drive growth.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing SE team.
Partner with regional sales leadership to achieve revenue targets, pipeline growth, and market expansion
Guide pre-sales activities including solution design, demos, POCs, and RFx responses
Review and strengthen technical account plans and regional go-to-market strategies
Act as a technical escalation point for complex, multi-country deployments and customer situations
Build executive-level relationships with partners, distributors, and customers as a trusted advisor
Align cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing) to enhance customer experience.
Influence product roadmaps with field insights and market demands.
Optimize operational budgets and scale global SE initiatives.
Core Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
15+ years of pre-sales or systems engineering experience in at least one area of networking (Wi-Fi, switching, routing)
7+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams
Hands-on experience with enterprise networking solutions, including wireless and switching
Proven ability to operate across complex and matrixed organizations
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Proven ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive revenue growth.
Strong leadership in talent development, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Candidates can be located in any state across the U.S.
Requirements: “You will excite us if you have:”
3+ years of experience in a second-level technical management capacity, including oversight of escalations, team leadership, and operational support
A proficient understanding of pre-sales engineering including new customer acquisition strategies, technical influencing, objecting handling, how to develop technical and business skillsets of your team, program and case management, hardware and software networking solutions in IT infrastructures, channel partner engagements for growth, and critical account management
Strong understanding and experience with mid to large enterprise business models and technical requirements for verticals that include MDU, K-12, SLED, higher education, hospitality, manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, large public venues and others
Advanced understanding of customer business drivers and how to map these to customer requirements and network environments, migrations, and network refresh decision making strategies including identification of improvement areas in network design
Multi-tasker with strong ability to manage under pressure to address deadlines, program manage development of deliverables, and logistical champion when supporting multiple projects and events
Working knowledge or understanding of networking technical skills; specifically, 802.11 Wi-Fi technology evolution releases (Wi-Fi 5, 6, 7), best practices design and assessment, wireless troubleshooting, RF tools used for pre and post site surveys, wireless network optimization, IP routing and switching WAN/LAN design, setup and configuration, Layer 4-7 application services, security authentication methods and products, SASE, SD-WAN, RADIUS, AD, Virtualization environments/deployments, VM installations, (any of VM Ware, KVM, Hyper-V, GCE, Azure, AWS), secure device/user onboarding solutions, etc.
General knowledge of the following areas of specialization: Cloud services (SaaS); VLAN; network segmentation, personal identity networking, security (SASE); SD-WAN; wireless controller architectures; indoor and outdoor wireless deployments; general routing and switching
Strong program management experience, technical relationship building, verbal and written communications skills, presenting and thought leadership, and commanding a room of executive level decision makers
Our salary ranges consider a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to benchmarking by independent third-party consultants, skill sets, years of experience, training, education, geography, and other business needs. Depending on experience, the range can be higher for candidates with exceptional experience and a demonstrated history of successful performance. Expected Total Target Compensation for this role is $250,000 - $370,000. The candidate will be rewarded with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and accidental death insurance, a 401(k) plan, and participation in the Company’s Incentive Plan. Candidates starting with the Company will be eligible for eleven paid holidays in a full calendar year, two weeks of paid vacation (prorated based on start date), as well as other leave options.
What Happens After You Apply:
Learn how to prepare yourself for the next steps in our hiring process by visiting
Why Join Us?
Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.
RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.
If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.
Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Global Product Owner / Global Head of Entity Management
jobs.text:
At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Entity Management (EMT) owns the EMT product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of EMT worldwide.
This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for EMT in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.
You lead the EMT function globally through the Global Process Manager (GPM), the Regional Product Owners (RPOs), and the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver EMT every day.
Roles & Responsibilities
Commercial Leadership & Growth
• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for EMT: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.
• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.
• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so EMT can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.
• Own the reputation of the EMT product in the market.
Product Strategy & Standards
• Own the global scope, service definitions, and standards for EMT — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.
• Set global execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.
• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.
Market Insight & Service Design
• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.
• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.
• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.
Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
• Set the global EMT operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.
• Direct the Global Process Manager (GPM) on process design, standardisation, controls, and scalability — turning product intent into repeatable, executable delivery.
• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within EMT to enable scale and quality.
Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability
• Own product-level cost-to-serve for EMT, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.
• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.
• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.
Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership
• Lead all Regional Product Owners (RPOs) for EMT as their global head, holding them and the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.
• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.
• Lead, mentor, and develop the GPM, RPOs, and OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global EMT team.
Scope & Commercial Governance
• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.
• Support enabling functions on scope-to-catalogue mapping, SKU registration, and pricing alignment.
• Validate post-implementation effectiveness of scope and commercial changes through defined metrics, and refine where needed.
Compliance, Audit & Risk
• Set the global compliance posture for EMT across company law, corporate-governance codes, and statutory filing and corporate-secretarial requirements.
• Ensure EMT delivery maintains internal controls and regulatory adherence in every jurisdiction the product serves.
• Engage with internal and external audit on EMT product-level matters.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with the Chief Delivery Officer, peer Global Product Owners, Revenue, Technology, and the enabling functions across Delivery.
• Represent the EMT product in cross-functional and executive forums.
Key Performance Indicators
• Revenue growth and win rate for the product.
• Retention and net revenue retention (NRR).
• Margin and cost-to-serve.
• Delivery SLA attainment and quality.
• Client satisfaction (NPS).

jobs.title: SVP of Software Engineering & Transformation
jobs.text:
At Emprise Bank, everything we do is focused on empowering people to thrive. We proudly work to provide an extraordinary customer experience to help our customers achieve their goals.
The Senior Vice President of Software Engineering & Transformation provides strategic leadership for the Bank’s enterprise technology transformation agenda, advancement and adoption of artificial intelligence, application development, and emerging technology capabilities. This executive is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and delivering transformational opportunities that leverage AI, automation, modern engineering practices, and strategic technology partnerships to improve client experience, operational efficiency, resiliency, and business outcomes.
A successful candidate will have:
Exemplary customer service experience
Critical and analytical thinking skills
Confident and articulate written and verbal communications skills
Initiative and strong work ethic
Technical problem resolution skills
Strong attention to detail
The ability to treat highly confidential information with utmost urgency
An understanding of and commitment to our values
Attitude and aptitude to engage in continuous development
Essential functions of the role:
Software Engineering Enablement
Develop and drive adoption of modern software engineering practices such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, automation, AI-assisted development, and cloud-native development capabilities.
Partner with business and technology leaders through Software Engineering Center of Excellence to establish shared standards, practices, and capabilities that accelerate responsible software delivery.
Collaborate with engineering teams to improve delivery velocity, quality, scalability, and developer experience through modern engineering and AI-enabled capabilities.
Enable teams to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI, while maintaining appropriate security, governance, and architectural alignment.
Collaborate with enterprise and solution architects to establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technology standards and modern development capabilities.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for customer facing digital products and software capabilities that enhance experience, improve efficiency, and support business growth.
Enterprise AI & Innovation Strategy
Lead the identification, prioritization, and delivery of AI and agentic AI solutions that improve employee productivity, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and revenue growth.
Identify, prioritize, and implement agentic AI solutions that create measurable business value, enhance customer experiences, and improve employee productivity.
Partner with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions align with established governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI standards.
Build organizational understanding and adoption of AI through education, enablement, and change management.
Transformation Leadership & Execution
Lead enterprise technology transformation initiatives from strategy through execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
Partner with executive leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and modernization.
Partner with external business partners and internal teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities for custom software development, platform extensions, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish transformation methodologies, prioritization frameworks, and reporting mechanisms to drive accountability and transparency.
Partner with technology leaders, engineers, and architects to drive modernization initiatives aligned with enterprise architecture standards and the strategic technology roadmap, enhancing scalability, resiliency, security, operational efficiency, and business agility.
Remove organizational barriers and enable cross-functional collaboration across Technology and business teams.
Identify opportunities to simplify technology environments, modernize legacy platforms, and reduce technical complexity.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and customer-focused problem solving.
Executive Leadership & Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to the CTO, executive leadership team, and business leaders on emerging technology opportunities and transformation strategies.
Build strong partnerships across business lines, ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful business value.
Recruit, develop and lead high-performing teams through coaching, talent development, and organizational growth.
Represent the Bank externally with technology partners, industry groups, and innovation communities.
Other duties as assigned within the scope and responsibility of the job
Requirements
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience spanning enterprise transformation, software engineering, digital strategy, AI adoption, and emerging technologies.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Experience delivering AI-enabled products and capabilities, cloud technologies, modern software engineering practices, automation, and enterprise technology platforms.
Proven success in developing and executing technology strategies and leading large-scale modernization and organizational change within complex, regulated environments, with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to drive delivery at pace through clear prioritization, decisive leadership, rapid decision-making, barrier removal, and accountability.
Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and effectively leveraging strategic technology partners, platforms, and ecosystem capabilities.
Strong executive presence, strategic thinking, communication, change leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across business and technology organizations.
Relevant professional certifications preferred, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, TOGAF, SAFe, PMP, ITIL, or recognized AI/ML certifications.
Benefits
In addition to a competitive salary and benefits, Emprise offers professional growth, a rewarding and challenging environment, opportunities to be involved in our communities, and a culture of integrity, passion, and success.
At Emprise Bank, empowering people to thrive means having an all-inclusive culture that honors our commitment to all dimensions of diversity in our workforce and embraces inclusion of all people. People of color, women, LGBTQIA+, veterans, and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
To learn more, please visit our website at.
Emprise Bank is an EEO/AA/ADA/Veteran Employer/Member FDIC/Drug Free Workplace.
Emprise Bank participates in E-Verify and will provide your Form-I 9 to the federal government to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Position Title: Vice President, Product
Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer
Location: United States
POSITION DESCRIPTION
apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.
apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.
We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.
The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.
Trusted Advisor
Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.
Roles and Requirements
Product discovery
Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.
Investment coordination
Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.
Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.
Product strategy and leadership
Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.
Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.
Customer and market
Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.
Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.
First-Year Priorities
Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.
Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.
Required Skills
15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product organizations through product leaders and managers in B2B enterprise SaaS.
Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.
A proven record of leading a transformation from a project- or feature-driven model to empowered, outcome-funded product teams, including winning over executives and stakeholders outside product.
Hands-on experience leading product discovery at scale, including addressing value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing engineering investment.
Experience owning portfolio-level investment decisions across multiple teams: setting capacity allocation, saying no with evidence, and making trade-offs transparent to executives and Go-to-Market leaders.
A track record of hiring, coaching and developing strong product managers and product leaders.
Strong analytical skills, with experience using product analytics, experimentation and qualitative research to make decisions.
Experience working in close partnership with design and engineering as a trio, and with distributed teams across US and India time zones.
Experience with AI-native or data products, and sound judgment about where AI and agents create real customer value.
Strong executive presence, able to represent product strategy credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.
Preferred Skills

Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer
Location: United States
POSITION DESCRIPTION

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.
Trusted Advisor

items: Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

blocks.text: Roles and Requirements
Product discovery

items: Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.

Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

blocks.text: Investment coordination

items: Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.

Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.

Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.

blocks.text: Product strategy and leadership

items: Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.

Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.
