jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.company: Accelerated Digital Media - an OuterBox company
jobs.text:
Description
The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.
Job Responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Set the Product Vision: Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
Build Products for Our Delivery Teams: Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
Lead Direct-to-Market Products: Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
Lead the Product Management Team: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
Turn Development Talent into Great Products: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
Drive Effective Execution: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
Measure & Report Product Effectiveness: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
Evaluate Emerging Technology: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
Additional duties, as assigned.
Requirements
6+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.
Working knowledge of how digital marketing agencies deliver services
Fluency in product process, including PRDs and acceptance criteria, prioritization, and pilot and rollout programs, with credible participation in architecture and build decisions alongside technology leadership.
Hands-on experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent).
Strong product design and user-experience judgment, grounded in user research, feedback programs, and adoption measurement (interviews, NPS, surveys).
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, AI-accelerated environment, with working familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) and cloud-native platforms (Google Cloud Platform).
Benefits
Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.
Boxer Benefits
Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.
Health Insurance
401(k) & Retirement Savings
Generous Paid Time Off
Flexible Scheduling
Remote-First Culture
Professional Development
Employee Referral Program
And more!
Salary Description: $140,000 - $160,000
Our Company Values
Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.
At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.
Growth At OuterBox
We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.
Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.
Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.
Physical Demands
Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.
Requires a high level of mental focus and the ability to work under pressure.
Good manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and the ability to use a computer for extended periods are required.
Utilizes required organization-provided tools, such as project management systems, artificial intelligence (AI) applications, reporting and analytics programs, and other business software, as directed by management in the regular course of business. Use of such tools ensures accuracy, accountability, and continuity across projects, supports collaboration among team members, and allows the organization to maintain visibility into work product and progress.
Work Authorization/Requirements
Must be located in the USA.
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
Affirmative Action/EEO Statement
Our company is an equal-opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.
OuterBox may use AI-assisted tools to support the hiring process. Human review is involved in all employment decisions.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Product and Privacy
jobs.text:
At Podium, we build an AI Workforce that helps local businesses turn every conversation into revenue. More than 60,000 businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics trust Podium to drive growth 24/7, from capturing new leads to re-engaging past customers.
Two and a half years ago, we made a deliberate shift from building software for local businesses to building AI Employees that work for them. Every local business struggles to answer every call, lead, and follow-up. Our AI Operating System and AI Workforce fill that gap. We’ve crossed $150M in AI ARR, deployed more than 20,000 AI Employees, and helped customers generate over $13B in revenue.
Inc. Magazine named Podium the Best AI Implementation, OpenAI highlighted us for building AI Agents that drive revenue, and G2 ranked us the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations.
Podium is AI-native in every sense. We build AI for our customers, we build AI tools for ourselves, and we use AI in every role across the company.
We hire exceptional people, hold them to high standards, and give them room to make an impact. We look for people who are all-in on AI and eager to stay on the cutting edge, both in what we build for customers and in how they operate day to day. If you’re hungry for growth, aligned with our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won’t find a better place to accelerate your career.
Podium builds AI products that help local businesses engage customers, convert leads, book appointments, and manage customer relationships across Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services. We are looking for an experienced product and privacy lawyer at the Director level to help shape how we build and deploy AI across our core verticals. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work directly with the teams building our products, own practical privacy and AI governance programs, and be a critical member of a small legal team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, significant ownership, and direct influence on product decisions.
What you will be doing:
Regularly meet with internal teams (e.g. Product, Engineering and AI teams) to understand strategies, roadmaps, and initiatives, and advise throughout the product lifecycle, from early design and development through launch, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
Provide legal advice and counsel on a variety of product compliance matters, including AI, privacy, data rights, intellectual property, and consumer protection, and structure, negotiate, and advise on transactions with AI providers, data partners, and integration partners, including product terms, data processing agreements, and business associate agreements.
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Security, and the rest of the Legal team to ensure our products and services comply with applicable regulations in existing markets and industries and also help guide our expansion, with particular focus on AI products in Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services.
Provide legal and regulatory guidance on the design and modification of products, proactively identify associated risks and recommend mitigation strategies, review product user experiences to ensure legal compliance and proper disclosures, and help translate guidance into product requirements that the Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Legal teams can implement.
Advise legal and business/product organizations on privacy issues and practical privacy considerations, and own the development and implementation of scalable product, privacy, and AI review process, including impact assessments, launch criteria, playbooks, and escalation paths.
Identify applicable regulatory or legal privacy and AI risks associated with existing and new laws, conduct gap assessments, and advise on appropriate controls, risk mitigation options, and compliance strategies. Translate evolving requirements into prioritized product and operational changes.
Manage cross-functional privacy-related projects, including but not limited to data mapping, permitted data uses, retention and deletion, and tracking technologies.
Partner with Security on incident response and privacy aspects of compliance and diligence reviews.
Build and operationalize AI governance for customer-facing agents and internal AI use. Advise on data sourcing and rights for model fine tuning, evaluation, and improvement; third-party model terms; output ownership; and safeguards against inaccurate outputs.
Counsel on AI agents, including permissions, customer configurations, AI disclosures, human oversight and escalation, auditability, and the allocation of responsibility among Podium, model providers, integration partners, and customers.
Guide healthcare product development, including HIPAA privacy and security, BAA obligations, sensitive health data, and EMR integrations. Advise on access controls, and patient communications.
Advise on automotive and home services workflows, including, as applicable, Field Services Management or CRM and dealer management integrations, lead sourcing and re-engagement, appointment booking, service scheduling, and representations about pricing, financing, and services. Assess GLBA, FCRA, payments and other sector requirements where relevant to the feature and data involved.
Advise on voice, messaging, and marketing compliance, including TCPA, telemarketing and do-not-call rules, consent and opt-out design, call recording and transcription, and AI-generated voice. Review product claims and customer guidance so they accurately describe capabilities, limitations, and customer responsibilities.
Provide fintech and payments counseling on Podium Payments, including consumer disclosures, fraud and chargebacks, applicable financial services and payment network requirements. Partner with Product and Finance to allocate compliance responsibilities among Podium, customers, and financial partners.
What you should have:
J.D. with strong academic credentials and demonstrated record of success as a lawyer and member of local State Bar or eligible to register as Registered In-House Counsel.
8+ years of experience, including at least 5+ years of in-house experience, preferably at a high-growth technology company.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulatory frameworks applicable to the U.S. and global telecommunications.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulations in other industries and markets, such as Healthcare, Automotive, or Home Services, is also highly desirable.
Experience advising clients on risk mitigation across technology product platforms, particularly with respect to AI, payments and messaging/telecommunications technologies.
Required privacy certification, such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT.
Specific experience working with, and knowledge of, privacy laws applicable to businesses, such as CCPA, CPRA, GDPR, TCPA, as well as other U.S. state and federal privacy and data security and global data protection laws.
Capacity to think strategically to identify issues and develop long-term solutions.
Ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously and manage major projects to successful completion.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong customer-focused orientation.
Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and facilitation skills, as well as the ability to navigate within a corporate environment and work with a variety of stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools thoughtfully in legal work, verify their outputs, protect confidential information, and improve the speed and quality of legal counseling.
BENEFITS
Open and transparent culture
Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
Paid parental leave
Fertility benefits
Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends
Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits
401k Plan
Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel
A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered
Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Tide Credit Services
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM
Tide Credit Services (TCS) puts credit in SMEs’ hands when they need it. We build Tide’s on demand lending products—including Credit Flex, Instant Loan, and Credit Score Insights—so members get fast, flexible funding inside the account they already run their business from.
We are scaling our flagship products globally across the UK, Europe, and India. This is high-velocity, high-impact work: you’ll architect and drive a fully automated, lightning-fast lending engine designed to deliver capital on demand, securely and seamlessly. Partnering with a brilliant and growing cross-functional team of 28 across engineering, product, design, data, and operations, you'll build a robust, scalable platform powering the future of SME credit.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering for Tide Credit Services (TCS, transactional credit), you’ll own the technology behind how Tide lends to SMEs. That covers Credit Flex, Instant Loan and the platform underneath them.
It’s a senior, hands-on leadership role with real say over architecture, engineering strategy and delivery. You’ll lead Engineering Managers and senior engineers, and set the bar for technical excellence.
As Head of Engineering you will:
Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.
Own integrations with third-party providers, including credit data, payments and funding partners, and make them seamless.
Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
Shape Tide’s wider technical strategy as we scale Tide Credit Services globally.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a highly technical, strategic engineering leader. Background in the credit domain (lending, credit decisioning, loan servicing or repayments) is preferable, and wider fintech experience is also valued. Neither is a prerequisite if you bring strong engineering leadership, breadth of technical knowledge and the ability to get up to speed fast.
10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.
OUR TECH STACK
Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €91,600 to €114,500 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
Remote first
25 days of paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Private Health Insurance
Mental Health Support Platform
FitPass
Family and friendly leave (according to statutory)
Personal L&D budget
Share Options
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Over $300 million raised in funding

We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM
Tide Credit Services (TCS) puts credit in SMEs’ hands when they need it. We build Tide’s on demand lending products—including Credit Flex, Instant Loan, and Credit Score Insights—so members get fast, flexible funding inside the account they already run their business from.
We are scaling our flagship products globally across the UK, Europe, and India. This is high-velocity, high-impact work: you’ll architect and drive a fully automated, lightning-fast lending engine designed to deliver capital on demand, securely and seamlessly. Partnering with a brilliant and growing cross-functional team of 28 across engineering, product, design, data, and operations, you'll build a robust, scalable platform powering the future of SME credit.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering for Tide Credit Services (TCS, transactional credit), you’ll own the technology behind how Tide lends to SMEs. That covers Credit Flex, Instant Loan and the platform underneath them.
It’s a senior, hands-on leadership role with real say over architecture, engineering strategy and delivery. You’ll lead Engineering Managers and senior engineers, and set the bar for technical excellence.
As Head of Engineering you will:
Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.
Own integrations with third-party providers, including credit data, payments and funding partners, and make them seamless.
Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
Shape Tide’s wider technical strategy as we scale Tide Credit Services globally.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a highly technical, strategic engineering leader. Background in the credit domain (lending, credit decisioning, loan servicing or repayments) is preferable, and wider fintech experience is also valued. Neither is a prerequisite if you bring strong engineering leadership, breadth of technical knowledge and the ability to get up to speed fast.
10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.
OUR TECH STACK
Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €92,000 to €115,000 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
25 days paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
Additional health & dental insurance
Mental wellbeing platform
Fully covered Multisports card
Food vouchers
Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
WFH equipment allowance
Flexible working from home
Sabbatical Leave
Share options

jobs.text:
Performance & Technology | Technology - Enterprise Architecture | Senior Vice President | London
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput, and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
As the Director of Site Reliability Engineering you will oversee the SRE organization focused on various emerging products like Workflows, PAM/ASA and Inbox.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-caliber SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet.
Partner with global engineering, product, and infrastructure leaders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure services.
Define and execute the SRE strategy in alignment with global reliability goals.
Lead post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure long-term corrective actions. Participate in incident management, on-call rotations, and blameless RCAs.
Implement automation and observability to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of modern infrastructure practices: infrastructure as code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and AI within the SRE org.
Hire, mentor, and develop top SRE talent; build a strong engineering culture centered on reliability and innovation.
Foster collaboration across global teams.
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.
Maintain a deep knowledge of industry best practices, evolving trends, and technologies.
Manage service and business expectations and prioritize resource allocation.
Accelerate the velocity of SRE and product engineering by developing robust platforms, powerful tooling, and intuitive self-service capabilities.
Improve SDLC processes for Cloud infrastructure as a code, including the maturity of CI/CD pipelines, change and release management.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
15+ years of experience in site reliability, infrastructure, or production engineering roles.
8+ years of experience in technical leadership & people management including managing managers. Strong expertise in automation, observability, performance optimization, and incident response.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-cultural collaboration skills—particularly in a global matrixed setup.
Experience building and scaling offshore SRE teams that partner with global counterparts.
4+ years of experience running the SRE org supporting a SaaS/Cloud service in a public Cloud, preferably AWS. Experience supporting a multi-Cloud environment will be a plus.
Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, containerization (Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage large-scale programs
Effective verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills
Education and Training:
Computer Science Degree or related degree or equivalent experience
Additional requirements:
There is no citizenship requirement. The Okta employee must be on US Soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101
Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We enable a flexible approach to work, meaning for roles where it makes sense, you can work from the office, or from home, regardless of where you live. jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
Join the Revolution in Car Finance 🚗💥
At Carmoola, we’re changing the way people get on the road – making it faster, fairer, and entirely built around the customer. We’ve started with car finance, reimagining it from the ground up with a seamless, digital experience that puts drivers in control.
Since launch, we’ve raised over £540m from top-tier investors (including QED), helped over 31,000 customers get behind the wheel – and we’re scaling fast.
To take things to the next level, we're looking for a technical, AI-native Head of Data Science to build and deploy the models that let us lend faster, safely, at scale.
Your Mission
You'll take the reins on building and owning Carmoola's data science strategy – from designing and deploying the AI to assess risk across our application flow, to using Open Banking to provide frictionless, accurate affordability assessments. You'll have a huge amount of autonomy and responsibility from day one, and the opportunity to define what AI-native risk and affordability at Carmoola really means.
This is a high-impact role for someone who is as comfortable writing and shipping production code as presenting to leadership, thinks commercially about the cost of friction, and knows how to build something from scratch. You won't hand requirements to another team – you'll set the strategy, build the models and agents yourself, deploy them into live decisioning and prove their impact on real losses.
What You'll Be Doing
Own our risk prediction strategy - Set the direction across data science methods, data sources and platforms. Decide what we build versus buy, and balance loss prevention against friction for customers and dealers.
Lead delivery across the business - Own the data science roadmap. Shape requirements with Product and Engineering, work with Credit, Ops and Collections to make models fit how the business really runs, and keep delivery moving from idea to live impact.
Develop the models underneath - Build Gradient Boosting Machines to predict risk, Open Banking categorisation models, plus look for other uses of data science techniques to meet our goals.
Ship it to production - Own deployment end to end, from tested, version-controlled code and CI/CD to safe releases and live monitoring for drift and performance, with clear governance and human oversight wherever customers are affected.
Turn data into decisions - Deliver analytics and MI that show how your models are winning, and report against risk appetite to senior leadership and the board.

jobs.title: Director of Instructional Media and Technology
jobs.text:
Overview
The Associate Director of Instructional Media and Technology leads strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem, ensuring that the tools and digital experiences supporting hybrid and online learning are modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs. This role oversees an EdTech team and collaborates closely with LDT leadership, Learning Designers, and Academic and University Partner (UP) stakeholders to deliver solutions that enhance curriculum development efficiency and quality, elevate the user experience, and expand EIM’s innovation capacity.
Operating within the LDT division, this role evaluates instructional technologies, guides the development and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions, develops instructional media standards and templates, and ensures educational technology platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality. Through cross-functional leadership, technology stewardship, and continuous improvement, it strengthens EIM’s digital learning infrastructure and advances its mission to deliver high-quality hybrid healthcare education at scale.
Responsibilities
Strategy & Continuous Improvement
Lead the strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem and roadmap, keeping tools modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs.
Based on ongoing analysis of internal LDT needs and the innovation roadmap, set the EdTech vision and establish metrics that evaluate effectiveness and guide investment, development, or deprecation decisions.
Team Leadership
Build LDT team capability with respect to instructional media and technology.
Develop the EdTech team, fostering an innovative and solutions-oriented culture.
Work in a cross-matrixed environment to identify and serve the needs of the Learning Designers, University Partners, and other stakeholders.
Technology Evaluation & Management
Partner with Learning Designers and LDT leadership to identify instructional and operational needs and determine technology solutions that enable effective learning experiences and improve curriculum-development quality, efficiency, and scale.
Apply product-management principles to the EdTech portfolio, including discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, implementation, adoption, measurement, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement
Champion policies (such as AI and accessibility), supporting their translation into the edtech stack and training.
Oversee the administration of EdTech systems.
Course Templates, Media & Digital Experience
Lead the development and maintenance of master course templates, reusable instructional media, and design objects that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across UP and EIM programs. Balance standardization-for-scale and customize-for-partner dynamics.
Establish instructional media and design standards—including video, interactive, and multimedia components—and guide implementation in partnership with the LDT team.
Direct the development, adoption, and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions.
Ensure platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality, refining them based on analytics and stakeholder feedback.
Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Expand EIM’s innovation capacity by exploring emerging technologies—including AI and automation—and recommending ROI-driven applications to implement.
Partner with EIM Business Enablement to ensure the LDT EdTech ecosystem aligns with enterprise technology architecture.
Develop adoption and change strategies for new technologies, tools, standards, and workflows, partnering with LDT leaders and managers to build awareness, capability, utilization, and sustained adoption.
Partner with Learning Designers and Academic/UP stakeholders to identify technology needs and systemic issues affecting course development, delivery, and user experience, driving cross-functional resolution and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience), with 6–8 years of relevant experience (Associate Director) or 8-12 years (Director)
Minimum 5 years experience supporting online courses in an LMS (Canvas, Brightspace, Blackboard, or equivalent).
Knowledge of product development lifecycles and solution implementation in educational environments.
Strong analytical skills for evaluating technologies against organizational goals.
Demonstrated experience in two or more of the following: web development (HTML, CSS/SCSS); EdTech system administration; UI/UX design for educational platforms; multimedia development.
Proven strategic thinking with experience in road-mapping and implementation, plus strong project management across competing priorities.
Demonstrated experience evaluating and applying AI and emerging technologies in educational or content-development environments.
Exceptional communication skills including presentation to external partners (e.g., university partners).
Familiarity with learning theories, instructional theories, and instructional design best practices.
Ability to thrive in a diversified environment with varying levels of ambiguity.
About
Confluent Health, LLC and its affiliates are equal opportunity employers committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. This role oversees an EdTech team and collaborates closely with LDT leadership, Learning Designers, and Academic and University Partner (UP) stakeholders to deliver solutions that enhance curriculum development efficiency and quality, elevate the user experience, and expand EIM’s innovation capacity.

Operating within the LDT division, this role evaluates instructional technologies, guides the development and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions, develops instructional media standards and templates, and ensures educational technology platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality. Through cross-functional leadership, technology stewardship, and continuous improvement, it strengthens EIM’s digital learning infrastructure and advances its mission to deliver high-quality hybrid healthcare education at scale.
Responsibilities
Strategy & Continuous Improvement

items: Lead the strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem and roadmap, keeping tools modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs.

Based on ongoing analysis of internal LDT needs and the innovation roadmap, set the EdTech vision and establish metrics that evaluate effectiveness and guide investment, development, or deprecation decisions.

blocks.text: Team Leadership

items: Build LDT team capability with respect to instructional media and technology.
Develop the EdTech team, fostering an innovative and solutions-oriented culture.
Work in a cross-matrixed environment to identify and serve the needs of the Learning Designers, University Partners, and other stakeholders.

blocks.text: Technology Evaluation & Management

items: Partner with Learning Designers and LDT leadership to identify instructional and operational needs and determine technology solutions that enable effective learning experiences and improve curriculum-development quality, efficiency, and scale.

Apply product-management principles to the EdTech portfolio, including discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, implementation, adoption, measurement, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement
Champion policies (such as AI and accessibility), supporting their translation into the edtech stack and training.
Oversee the administration of EdTech systems.

blocks.text: Course Templates, Media & Digital Experience

items: Lead the development and maintenance of master course templates, reusable instructional media, and design objects that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across UP and EIM programs. Balance standardization-for-scale and customize-for-partner dynamics.
Establish instructional media and design standards—including video, interactive, and multimedia components—and guide implementation in partnership with the LDT team.
Direct the development, adoption, and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions.
Ensure platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality, refining them based on analytics and stakeholder feedback.

blocks.text: Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration

items: Expand EIM’s innovation capacity by exploring emerging technologies—including AI and automation—and recommending ROI-driven applications to implement.
Partner with EIM Business Enablement to ensure the LDT EdTech ecosystem aligns with enterprise technology architecture.

Develop adoption and change strategies for new technologies, tools, standards, and workflows, partnering with LDT leaders and managers to build awareness, capability, utilization, and sustained adoption.

Partner with Learning Designers and Academic/UP stakeholders to identify technology needs and systemic issues affecting course development, delivery, and user experience, driving cross-functional resolution and continuous improvement.

blocks.text: Qualifications

items: Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience), with 6–8 years of relevant experience (Associate Director) or 8-12 years (Director)
Minimum 5 years experience supporting online courses in an LMS (Canvas, Brightspace, Blackboard, or equivalent).
Knowledge of product development lifecycles and solution implementation in educational environments.
Strong analytical skills for evaluating technologies against organizational goals.
Demonstrated experience in two or more of the following: web development (HTML, CSS/SCSS); EdTech system administration; UI/UX design for educational platforms; multimedia development.
Proven strategic thinking with experience in road-mapping and implementation, plus strong project management across competing priorities.
Demonstrated experience evaluating and applying AI and emerging technologies in educational or content-development environments.
Exceptional communication skills including presentation to external partners (e.g., university partners).
Familiarity with learning theories, instructional theories, and instructional design best practices.
Ability to thrive in a diversified environment with varying levels of ambiguity.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
We are building a Digital Concierge Platform for 2–4 star hotels that transforms every hotel room into a digital sales channel for local services. Guests discover and book experiences, wellness, dining, and more via a simple QR code—while hotels unlock new revenue streams without additional operational effort.
The founding team consists of two experienced and successful entrepreneurs with a strong track record in building and scaling companies.
Our next step: build the MVP → launch pilot hotels and partners → raise seed funding.
Your Role
As CTO, you are a technical co-founder responsible for building the entire platform—from architecture to launch.
You will work directly with the founders and have full ownership of the product and tech vision.
Tasks
Your Mission (0–6 months)
Phase 1: MVP (0–3 months)
Define and build the technical architecture
Develop a mobile-first web or app MVP
Implement core features:
QR-based entry experience
Location-based content delivery
Booking and payment flows (via APIs)
Rapid iteration with real pilot customers
Phase 2: Validation & Fundraising
Stabilize and scale the platform
Integrate initial partners (via APIs or manual onboarding)
Support technical due diligence with investors
Requirements
Strong full-stack engineering background (e.g., React / Next.js / Node / Python or
similar)
Proven experience building MVPs and scalable platforms
Product mindset—you think in solutions, not just features
Ideally experience with:
Marketplace models
Booking and payment integrations
Location-based services
Hands-on builder mentality with the ability to scale into a leadership role
Startup mindset: speed over perfection
Benefits
What We Offer
Equity-based co-founder role
Opportunity to build a globally scalable product from scratch
Close collaboration with experienced serial entrepreneurs
Clear vision with a strong, revenue-driven business model
Compensation
No salary for the first 3–4 months
Focus: build MVP & secure funding
Salary and team expansion after successful fundraising
Why This Is Exciting
Large, clearly defined global market (hotels worldwide)
Immediate monetization potential (commission-based model)
Not a “nice-to-have,” but a revenue engine for hotels
Strong go-to-market strategy (QR + co-branding + local partnerships)

jobs.title: Vice President Data and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.text:
Overview
At SCA Health, we believe healthcare is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.
As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.
What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:
Clinical quality
Integrity
Service excellence
Teamwork
Accountability
Continuous improvement
Inclusion
Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.
At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Click here to learn more about our benefits.
Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.
Responsibilities
SCA Health is building the data and AI foundation that will define its competitive position as the leading ambulatory surgery company in the United States. This is a greenfield executive leadership role — a chance to shape strategy, build a team, and establish the governance and technology platforms that will serve SCA's 300+ facilities and 12,000+ associates for the next decade. The VP, Data & AI reports directly to the CIO and is one of eight direct reports on the CIO's leadership team. You will own the enterprise data strategy, platform, and governance function, and will lead SCA's AI and machine learning capability — from foundational MLOps infrastructure through clinical decision support and operational AI at scale. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare's two most consequential technology shifts: the transition to data-driven clinical and operational decision-making, and the responsible deployment of AI in care delivery. You will work in direct partnership with SCA's CMO, CFO, COO, CGO, and clinical leaders — not just the technology organization.
Core Accountabilities:
Enterprise Data Strategy & Platform.Define and execute SCA Health's multi-year data platform roadmap — cloud data architecture, EHR/PAS data integration (HST, Athena, eCW, etc.), real-time pipelines, and the infrastructure that makes trusted data available to every decision-maker across the enterprise.
AI & Machine Learning Strategy.Lead SCA's AI roadmap — from MLOps infrastructure and model development through production deployment and monitoring. Prioritize use cases with rigorous business case analysis and establish clinical validation protocols.
Responsible AI & Ethics Framework.Establish SCA's responsible AI standards — model documentation, bias monitoring, explainability requirements, and the AI Review Board that ensures every clinical AI deployment meets the highest standards of safety and transparency. Track FDA SaMD guidance.
Cross-Functional Enterprise Partnership.Operate as the data and AI thought leader for the enterprise — partnering with VP Product on data-informed product decisions, with CISO on data security and AI risk, with Head of Architecture on platform design, and with clinical and operational leaders on use case identification and adoption.
Team Building & Talent Development.Build and lead a high-performing team of 12–15 data and AI professionals across six functional areas. Establish a culture of rigor, curiosity, and clinical partnership that attracts top talent in a competitive market.
Investment & Vendor Management.Own the Data & AI technology budget, vendor evaluation, and contract strategy. Make disciplined build/buy/partner decisions and defend investment priorities with rigorous ROI analysis to executive and board-level audiences.
Shared Accountabilities:
Data Governance & Quality.Support evolving SCA’s enterprise data governance framework — ownership model, data dictionary, quality standards, master data management, and compliance posture across HIPAA, TEFCA/HTI-1, and emerging interoperability mandates. Function currently reports to Sr. VP of Innovation.
What the role does not own:
Analytics & BI: Remains with the Payer Analytics team, not IT. VP Data & AI is an enabler of analytics capability — providing clean data, governed pipelines, and platform access — but does not own the Analytics & BI roadmap or outcomes.
Qualifications
Required Experience:
10+ years in data, analytics, or AI leadership roles, with 4+ years at VP or equivalent level
Demonstrated experience building enterprise data platforms at scale (cloud-native, modern data stack: dbt, Spark, Databricks or Snowflake)
Healthcare data experience required — EHR integration (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA compliance, clinical data structures and terminology
Hands-on experience leading AI/ML initiatives from business case through production deployment and ongoing monitoring
Proven track record building and leading high-performing technical teams of 10+ people in complex organizations
Experience establishing data governance frameworks in multi-site or distributed healthcare organizations
Preferred Experience:
Ambulatory surgery, surgical specialty, or multi-site healthcare network experience
Familiarity with FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) regulatory framework for clinical AI
Experience deploying generative AI in enterprise or clinical settings (RAG pipelines, LLM evaluation, guardrails)
Track record of data product thinking — not just infrastructure, but data as a product consumed by business users
Graduate degree in computer science, data science, statistics, biomedical informatics, or related field
Experience operating in a PE-backed or high-growth acquisition-driven environment
Technical Depth Expected:
Cloud data platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, or Azure Synapse — architectural fluency required (not just familiarity)
Healthcare interoperability: HL7 v2, FHIR R4, SMART on FHIR — integration pattern experience
ML frameworks and MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Vertex AI
Data governance tooling: Collibra, Alation, or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms
BI and analytics: Tableau, Power BI, or Looker — platform strategy and semantic modeling
GenAI patterns: RAG architecture, LLM evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering at enterprise scale
Leadership Profile:
Equally fluent in the executive boardroom and the data architecture whiteboard — not one or the other
Build trust with clinicians and operational leaders; demonstrates clinical context, not just technical empathy
Makes decisions with data, not just instinct — models the culture they are trying to build
Comfortable with greenfield environments and ambiguity — a builder, not just an operator
Demonstrates genuine commitment to responsible AI — not just checkbox compliance orientation
Attracts and develops exceptional talent; creates careers, not just roles
Strong executive communication skills — comfortable presenting to boards, CMOs, and CFOs with and without technical audiences
USD $225,000.00/Yr. USD $275,000.00/Yr.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Senior Engineering Director
College Board– Technology
Location:This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have theoptionof being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employeesare required tooccasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Type: This is a full-time position
AboutTechnologyat College Board
We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year,operatingatsignificantscale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways:blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery,operatingas an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.
About the Team
TheCore Assessment Platformis a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time.What makes this group special is its focus oncontinuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.
About the Opportunity
As the Senior Engineering Director, you will provide senior organizational and technical leadership within the Core Assessment Platforms group, with responsibility for multiple teams led by experienced engineering managers. This roleoperatesat the platform level, shaping multi-team roadmaps and aligning execution across highly interconnected systems. Working closely with peer directors, principal and staff engineers, and cross-functional partners, the Senior Engineering Director ensures teams deliver meaningful progress while keeping long-term platform goals front and center. The role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to guide complex decisions across teams with competing needs.You’llhelpidentifyand prioritize near-term improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while ensuring those wins reinforce longer-term architectural and strategicobjectives. Success is measured by the coherence of the platform over time, the strength of collaboration across teams, and the durability of both the technical foundations and the leadership bench you help build.
In this role, you will:
Provide Technical Leadership to the Team(45%)
Provide senior technical leadership for a defined area of the Core Assessment Platforms, ensuring alignment across multiple highly interconnected systems.
GuideEngineeringManagers, Principal and Staff Engineers in evaluating solution options, making architectural tradeoffs, and managing technical risk and debt across teams.
Identifyand prioritize near-term technical improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while reinforcing longer-term platform strategy and architectural coherence.
Establish and uphold shared engineering standards for system design, reliability, security, and operational excellence within your platform area.
Serve as an escalation point for complex, cross-team technicaldecisionsand platform-level risks, applying strong technical judgment.
Stay informed on relevant technologies and platform practices, using that insight to guide platform evolution.
Build ahighly engaged,and high-performing team(30%)
Lead multiple engineering teams through experienced Engineering Managers, building consistent leadership practices and strong collaboration across teams.
Partner with Engineering Managers to ensure teams are appropriately staffed, aligned, and able to deliver sustainably.
Foster a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement across interdependent teams.
Actively support diversity, equity, and inclusion through hiring, talent development, and inclusive leadership practices.
Mentor Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, helping build a durable leadership bench and clear growth paths.
Interface with business partners and technology colleagues(25%)
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, and peer Technology leaders to shape and align multi-team roadmaps.
Develop a strong understanding ofassessmentbusiness needs and platform consumers to inform technical priorities and sequencing.
Balance competing demands across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating tradeoffs whilemaintainingplatform cohesion.
Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations effectively to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
Ensure delivery progress across teams is coordinated, visible, and aligned with both near-term outcomes and long-term platform health.
Collaborate with peer Engineering Directors to ensure consistency and alignment across the broader Core Assessment Platforms group.
About you, youhave:
10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, includingsignificant experienceleading leaders (Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, or equivalent).
Proven experience setting technical direction and overseeing the delivery of large-scale, cloud-based applications and platforms, preferably using AWS and modern web technologies.
A strong background in software architecture and system design, with the ability to guide teams toward scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions without being prescriptive.
Demonstrated success building, mentoring, andretainingdiverse, high-performing engineering teams at scale.
Experienceoperatingat the intersection of technology and business, with the ability to align engineering investments to organizational goals and customer impact.
Exceptional communication skills, witha track recordof influencing senior executives, product leaders, and cross-functional partners.
Strong operational mindset, including experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, delivery risk, and long-term technical health.
A leadership style grounded in trust, inclusion, and accountability, with a commitment to developing future engineering leaders.
Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to NYC or Reston, VA.
Authorization to work in the United States.
All roles at College Board require:
A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions anda comfortlearning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receivingtimely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year,operatingatsignificantscale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways:blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery,operatingas an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.
About the Team

TheCore Assessment Platformis a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time.What makes this group special is its focus oncontinuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.

jobs.title: Director of Data Architect
jobs.text:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
Our Values
Best Life
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
Growth Mindset
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
One Team
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
What You’ll Do
Define and communicate ABC’s data architecture strategy, roadmap, and standards.
Lead the architectural evolution from batch and latency-driven processing toward real-time data.
Partner with executive, product, and engineering leaders to connect data architecture decisions to business and customer outcomes.
Identify practical opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity, data generation, quality, and decision-making.
Lead, coach, and develop a global team of four to five senior data architects.
Establish consistent design review practices across the Data and Reporting organization.
Guide architecture decisions related to data quality, governance, security, compliance, scalability, and reliability.
Partner with Product leaders early in the planning process to shape data and reporting capabilities.
Explain complex technical strategies clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Build alignment across teams and influence decisions beyond your direct reporting relationships.
What You’ll Need
10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including experience leading senior technical professionals.
Demonstrated experience moving data platforms from batch processing toward real-time or near-real-time architectures.
Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture.
Experience with AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog is highly valued.
Strong foundations in data modeling, data warehousing, data governance, and distributed data systems.
Working knowledge of SQL and Python sufficient to review designs and engage credibly with engineers.
Practical experience using AI in your own work, along with sound judgment about where AI creates meaningful value.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to make technical strategy clear to executive leaders and design decisions clear to engineers.
Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying solely on formal authority.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
And It’s Great to Have
Experience in fitness, wellness, SaaS, payments, or another subscription-based business.
Experience building customer-facing analytics or reporting products.
Experience with Databricks SQL, Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
What Success Looks Like
ABC’s data architecture strategy is clear, credible, and supported by executive leadership.
The first real-time capabilities are live, with a practical roadmap for continued transformation.
Data and Reporting teams work against shared architecture, quality, governance, and design standards.
AI is embedded into the team’s everyday approach to building and improving data capabilities.
Product and engineering leaders involve the architecture team early in strategic decisions.
Your team is highly capable, well-developed, and trusted across the organization.
Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -
$173,000 - 198,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:
Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!
At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:
ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com
About ABC Fitness
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com
