jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Closing date: 6 November 2026
Salary scale: £71,595 - £90,000 per annum
Help Shape the Future of Britain's Railway
Rail Delivery Group (RDG) partners with Britain’s train operators to put customers at the heart of everything we do, delivering essential services and dedicated experts who keep the nation’s railway running efficiently.
From journey information, reservations and Railcards to improving performance, safety and accessibility, we drive the services and people that keep the railway moving. Anyone who has travelled by train or booked a journey for friends or family, will have used our services. We are integral to the running of the railway and play a crucial part at every stage of the customer journey – making sure we are delivering a better railway for all our customers, now and in the future.
As we embark on a new era for rail, we are now looking for a Head of Engineering to join us. If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to play a role in the future of Britain's railway, we'd love to hear from you!
What is the purpose of this job?
The post holder is accountable to the Director of Industry Operations and the Rolling Stock Strategy Director, DFTO.
The role:
· provides leadership to the RDG Engineering, ERTMS and Digital Systems Team
· works as part of the DFTO Rolling Stock team
· takes the lead on designing and establishing DFTO’s and GBR’s Fleet Engineering capability and structure.
In addition, the role acts as the Professional Head for RDG railway engineering support activities. The objective is to ensure effective centralised support for RDG, DFTO and industry partners and stakeholder businesses in support of their delivery of a safe, punctual and efficient railway.
This role will help to support the design of organisational rolling stock engineering capability ahead of the formation of Great British Railways (GBR).
What can I expect to do in this job?
1. To act as the Professional Head for the RDG engineering support activities.
2. To assist, advise, alert, advocate and act on behalf of the senior engineering community in GB rail.
3. Working as part of a matrix team between RDG Industry Operations and the DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy team, provide technical leadership and support to develop and promote RDG, DFTO and GBR policy for all Engineering matters, including GB Rail Interoperability, Safety, Standards, Performance, Digital Signalling & Communications, Rolling Stock Strategy & Related Supply Chain etc and to give support to GBR strategic initiatives in the same areas.
4. To influence the future strategic direction of technical leadership for the GB and European rail industry.
5. To ensure the efficient and cost-effective delivery of engineering support-related benefits to RDG/DFTO, GBR and industry partners and stakeholders.
6. To support the development and roll-out of digital signalling technology working closely with Network Rail, RoSCos and suppliers whilst ensuring operator views and experience shape and inform future plans.
7. To provide strategic direction and line management of the RDG Industry Operations Engineering and ERTMS & Digital Systems team and DFTO teams (where applicable) including, but not limited to, carrying out annual appraisals, objective setting and review, agreement of leave.
8. To act as the nominated partner in support of the senior Engineering leadership forum and other senior technical forums facilitated by RDG and DFTO.
9. To prepare and manage all elements of the RDG engineering budget and support DFTO budgeting arrangements as required.
10. To be accountable for the technical input and on-going development of the Railway Engineering Graduate Scheme (REGS) both today and in the context of wider GBR-related graduate/non-graduate engineering training programmes.
Who will my key contacts be?
Internal to the rail industry
· RDG & DFTO colleagues – exchanging information
· DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy Director
· Train Operator Engineering Directors
· GB passenger and freight operator and their trade associations executive and senior teams – exchanging information and networking
· Network Rail Senior Teams & Specialists – exchanging information and influencing
· Railway Safety and Standards Board (RSSB) Executives & senior personnel – exchanging information and influencing
· Rolling Stock Leasing Companies Executives and senior personnel – influencing
· Fleet & related supply chain MDs & Executives - influencing
· European TOC Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· European Representative Bodies (CER and UIC) – influencing, negotiating and exchanging information
External to the rail industry
· Senior officials in government departments including the Department for Transport, Transport Scotland and Transport for Wales – influencing and exchanging information
· Office of Road and Rail Senior Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· Rail Supply Group, Railway Industry Association, Rail Alliance and GB suppliers – networking
· Railway Consultancies – exchanging information
· Wider GB & European Suppliers - networking
· British Standards Institute, CEN/CENELEC, ISO/IEC Personnel – networking
· Professional Institutions - networking

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Core Security & Security Operations
jobs.text:
About Us
At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.
We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.
At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.
Job Summary
Versa Networks is seeking a visionary, technically deep, and execution-oriented Senior Director of Product Management – Core Security & Security Operations to lead and scale our foundational threat prevention, data protection, endpoint/browser security, and SecOps capabilities.
In this role, you will define the multi-year security strategy, roadmap, and vision to ensure Versa outpaces modern adversary tactics and maintains market leadership across SASE, SSE, and core security products and technologies. You will directly steer core inspection engines, govern federal/public-sector compliance certifications, orchestrate 3rd-party technology ecosystems, oversee security incident response and research, and commercialize next-generation security innovations across Versa’s product portfolio.
Responsibilities
Strategic Vision & Product Leadership
Define, own, and execute the multi-year product strategy for core threat prevention, data security, secure browsing, and operational security across cloud-delivered and on-premises architectures.
Benchmark Versa against top-tier competitive solutions (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Fortinet) to maintain market-leading efficacy, low latency, and differentiation.
Act as an authoritative company spokesperson, representing Versa's core security architecture and vision at premier industry conferences (e.g., RSA, Black Hat), customer advisory boards (CABs), and executive briefings (EBCs).
Threat Prevention, Inspection & Secure Access
Drive product definition and roadmap evolution for Unified Threat Protection (UTP), including Next-Gen IPS, Network Antivirus/Anti-Malware (AV), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) / Sandboxing.
Scale and advance Versa's secure web and workspace ecosystem, including Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Enterprise Browser posture/controls, and File Reputation & Filtering (FRM).
Lead email vector defense initiatives, encompassing ATP and DLP for SaaS email (M365, Google Workspace) alongside partnership with turn-key 3rd-Party Email Security Integrations (Proofpoint, Abnormal Security, Mimecast).
Data Protection & Endpoint Risk Posture
Direct the Inline DLP and Data Security roadmap across web, cloud, and edge endpoints, incorporating advanced classification, OCR, and clipboard/removable-media controls.
Own API-driven Data Protection (API DP) and lead technical integrations with leading 3rd-party Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (e.g., Cyera, BigID).
Architect Versa’s native Device Risk Score (DRS) framework to drive dynamic Zero Trust policies; build deep bidirectional integrations with 3rd-Party DRS and EPP/EDR partners (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne).
Security Operations, Intelligence & Versa Security Portal
Lead the product roadmap for Versa Guardian and security operations tooling, streamlining incident workflows, remediation actions, and telemetry export into enterprise SIEM/SOAR/XDR platforms, including Versa’s own working together with colleagues owning respective products.
Help scale the customer-facing Versa Security Portal, delivering real-time visibility into threat trends, tenant security posture, attack surface metrics, and global threat landscape telemetry.
Direct Security Research priorities and weaponize 3rd-party threat intelligence (TI) feeds/APIs directly into Versa’s inspection pipeline to accelerate zero-day protection cycles.
Public Sector, Compliance & Product Security Assurance
Own the compliance and certification roadmap for regulated markets, including FedRAMP, FIPS 140-3, and Common Criteria (EAL4+).
Oversee product requirements for Code Hardening, secure software supply chain posture (SBOM), and platform vulnerability management.
Drive the operational product governance for the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), managing vulnerability disclosures, advisory bulletins, and customer remediation workflows.

Job Summary
We are seeking a visionary, technical, and execution-oriented Director of Product Management to lead Versa’s AI Security and AI Gateway product portfolio.
In this leadership role, you will define the vision, roadmap, architecture, and commercial strategy for how global enterprises discover, protect, optimize, and govern Generative AI models and Agentic AI workflows. You will own market-defining capabilities ranging from Gen-AI Firewalls and AI Gateways to AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), Agentic Bill of Materials (ABOM), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server security.
As the face and champion of AI Security at Versa, you will also serve as a thought leader—representing the company at premier AI, cybersecurity, and networking conferences worldwide.
Responsibilities
Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap
Define and execute the multi-year vision, product roadmap, and strategy for Versa’s AI Security and AI Gateway portfolio.
Translate market shifts, emerging threats, and LLM/agent architectural evolutions into differentiated product capabilities integrated into Versa’s unified SASE/SSE architecture.
Drive end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, requirements collection, use-cases definition, product experience definition working closely with the UX team, to leading new product launch process through to GA, customer adoption, and telemetry feedback loops.
Core Functional Ownership
Gen-AI Firewall & Runtime Defense:
Build next-generation inline defense against Prompt Injections, Jailbreaking, Data Poisoning, System Prompt Leakage, Denial of Service (DoS), and adversarial LLM threats.
Deliver robust Prompt Guard and Guardrail architectures that are integrated seamlessly into network traffic paths governed by Versa
Shadow AI Discovery, Control & Governance:
Deliver complete visibility into enterprise-wide AI adoption, detecting unsanctioned models, external web Gen-AI apps, and hidden API calls.
Build policy-driven governance frameworks enforcing corporate compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR).
Enterprise AI Gateway & Usage Management:
Lead the development of an enterprise-grade AI Gateway providing advanced traffic steering, rate-limiting, and routing based on application, data classification, geographic location, model choice (commercial vs. open-source), and cost efficiency.
Manage latency, fallback strategies, multi-model redundancy, and local vs. cloud inference routing.
AI-SPM (AI Security Posture Management)
Establish continuous auditing, vulnerability management, and misconfiguration detection across enterprise AI pipelines, model weights, data stores, and inference endpoints.
Agentic Security & Identity (ABOM, Agentic Verbo, MCP):
Pioneer security primitives for autonomous AI agents, including Agentic Identity, Agent Bill of Materials (ABOM).
Secure autonomous workflows, runtime permissions, inter-agent communications, and Agentic Verbo implementations.
Architect security and governance for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, securing the transport, tooling, and data access layers between LLMs and external systems.
Tokenomics & Cost Observability:
Deliver granular FinOps capabilities for AI: token consumption tracking, cost attribution by department/application/user, budget enforcement, cache optimization, and quota management.
Packaging, Pricing & Go-To-Market (GTM)
Own business modeling, SKU design, packaging, and monetization strategies for AI Security and AI Gateway add-ons and standalone offerings, working together with Product leadership
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Global Sales to build battlecards, technical collateral, white papers, demo environments, and sales enablement modules.
Act as an executive sponsor for key customer PoCs, design partner programs, and strategic beta rollouts.
Industry Evangelism & Thought Leadership
Serve as Versa’s external authority and public spokesperson for AI Security and Governance.
Represent Versa at leading industry conferences (e.g., RSA Conference, Black Hat, Gartner Security & Risk, AI summits, IEEE/OpenAI/developer forums).
Publish thought leadership articles, participate in standard bodies, and engage industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IDC).

jobs.title: Senior Director of Design, Search & Feeds
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Design to lead the experience strategy for Reddit’s Search & Feeds experiences. Reporting to our Head of Design, you’ll lead a design team shaping how people find relevant conversations, discover communities, and build connections to the topics they care about. Your impact will extend across Reddit, connecting discovery to the experiences that turn initial interest into ongoing participation.
This role combines product vision, design leadership, and a high bar for craft. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across Reddit to make discovery more useful, intuitive, and distinctly Reddit driving growth and retention by helping people connect with communities that matter to them.
What you’ll do
Set the design vision for Search & Feeds. Define a cohesive experience strategy across search, feed experiences, recommendations, and community discovery, connecting near-term improvements to a longer-term vision.
Lead and develop the team. Coach design leaders and individual contributors, build clear ownership, and create an environment where people can do ambitious work and grow.
Shape product direction. Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and guide investment decisions grounded in user needs and business goals.
Raise the bar for quality. Drive thoughtful interaction design, clear information architecture, accessible experiences, and strong execution from early concepts through launch.
Make relevance understandable. Help people understand and influence what they see, bringing clarity and user control to ranking, personalization, and recommendations.
Design for different discovery needs. Support people seeking a specific answer, exploring a new interest, or returning to communities they already value.
Connect discovery to community health. Consider how search and feeds affect participation, conversation quality, and the communities that make Reddit valuable.
Establish how success is measured. Use research, experimentation, and behavioral data to evaluate usefulness, satisfaction, and the quality of discovery alongside engagement.
Influence across Reddit. Communicate a clear point of view, build alignment across teams, and contribute to the broader design organization’s standards and practices.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading design for complex consumer products at scale, with meaningful work in search, discovery, feeds, recommendations, or related experiences.
A track record of building and developing design teams, including managing managers and supporting individual contributors.
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and compelling experiences.
Deep expertise in interaction design and information architecture, with a portfolio demonstrating both design quality and measurable user impact.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Research, and Data Science on experiences shaped by ranking and personalization systems.
The ability to balance user needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and the health of a broader product ecosystem.
Clear communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and make decisions with incomplete information.
An appreciation for community-driven products and the different ways people seek information, participate, and build trust online.
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.
The base salary range for this position is:
$317,000—$443,800 USD
In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.
Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Director, Data & Standards
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.
Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.
Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.
At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.
If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!
Position Overview
The Director, Data & Standards leads API’s data analyst team and owns the standards, governance, and quality practices that make our data trustworthy and usable across the organization. The role also carries forward key parts of API’s AI Enablement program: running AI experiments and pilots, driving adoption of enterprise AI tools, and using AI to improve how the data team works and the insights it delivers. You will balance hands-on AI and analytics work with leadership of the team, setting direction, developing people, and raising the bar on how API defines, measures, and uses data. This is a remote position.
What You’ll Do
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Team leadership and analytics oversight
Lead, coach, and develop a team of data analysts, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, and career growth.
Set priorities and manage the team’s workload across Engineering, Client Delivery, and Corporate stakeholders.
Review analyst work for accuracy, clarity, and business relevance, and ensure reporting and analysis are timely and decision-ready.
Build a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning, including AI fluency across the team.
Data standards and governance
Define and maintain enterprise data standards, including metric definitions, naming conventions, documentation, and a shared data dictionary.
Establish data quality monitoring, validation processes, and issue-resolution workflows, and drive remediation with data owners.
Partner with IT, Engineering, and Security on data access, lifecycle management, and compliance requirements.
Serve as the authority on “one version of the truth” for key operational and commercial metrics.
AI experimentation and pilots
Run intake, hypothesis design, metric definition, and outcome documentation for data and AI experiments across the organization.
Lead go/no-go reviews and graduation-to-production decisions for AI pilots, owning validation evidence, vendor coordination, and integration readiness.
Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and reliability, and set quality standards for AI-generated analysis.
AI adoption and enablement
Partner to drive training, communications, and enablement for Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot, moving seat utilization from license to behavior.
Produce the monthly AI scorecard: experiments launched, seats utilized, automation rates, FTE-equivalent savings, and experiments graduated.
Co-lead AI Sandbox operations with Engineering, including use-case intake, prioritization, and graduation criteria.
Work with IT and internal stakeholders to identify gaps, surface high-value use cases, and improve return on AI spend.
Vendor and budget management
Manage relationships with data and AI tooling vendors and track spend against the approved plan, flagging variances.
What You'll Bring
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, or a related field.

We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

jobs.title: AVP of Enterprise Architecture and Engineering Governance
jobs.text:
TJX Companies
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.
Job Description:
What you’ll discover
Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities.
Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia, click here to learn more.
Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment.
What you’ll do
The AVP of Enterprise Architecture (EA) and Engineering Governance leads a team of IT Architects and Engineers responsible for:
Guiding decision rights and establishing and optimizing the necessary processes, policies, and procedures to ensure successful execution of investment decisions aligned with the business strategy.
Offering implementation accelerators while driving quality within the platforms and portfolio teams.
This role focuses on EA process ownership, assurance to ensure compliance with agreed-upon viewpoints, principles, and standards – and promoting Engineering Quality principles and accelerators.
Key Responsibilities:
Own New Technology Assessment (NTA) process: Operationalize and Optimize how IT make risk-based investments decisions on technology (new technologies, renewal, new capabilities, expansions) in the shortest possible turnaround time.
Drive Application and Technology Portfolio Management Practice: Generate key insights from our tooling (e.g., LeanIX) and data to drive strategic management and ensure our functional and technical portfolios are rationalized, optimized, and enhancing overall IT performance.
Drive Adoption of Built-in Quality: Promote ways to increase adherence to Non-Functional requirements to reduce risks, increase compliance, and accelerate product maturity (e.g., NFR tools, Well-Architected Reviews).
Drive EA Assurance: Implement a formal process to review new and ongoing standards, ensuring compliance with defined guidance, policies, and principles.
Align EA Governance: Integrate EA governance with other IT and corporate governance processes to align strategy, investments, performance, resources, risk, and innovation.
Support Decision-Making: Democratize the EA governance process to support distributed and architecturally significant decisions at speed.
Lead Architecture Review Forums: Facilitate Architecture Review and decision forums to ensure coherent strategy execution.
Communicate and Reinforce Processes: Periodically communicate changes and reinforce processes within the IT organization to increase adherence.
Collaborate with Business of IT Solution Delivery: Work with the Business of IT solution delivery group to prioritize epics and features on EA tools to advance EA practice maturity, gather feedback on EA processes (e.g., NFRs), and optimize them (e.g., NTA due diligence groups)
Generate Insights: Analyze the global application and technology portfolio to inform senior leadership about trends and opportunities.
Assess EA Maturity: Evaluate overall EA maturity and identify continuous improvement opportunities to enhance the EA practice.
What you’ll need (Minimum Qualifications)
We seek creative, customer-focused individuals with technical expertise and a mindset for continuous improvement. We rethink how architecture delivers value by providing hands-on leadership and contributions while embracing agile principles.
Experience: 8-12 years of experience managing teams, experience in guiding teams in a product-oriented operating model.
Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of Cloud, Big Data, AI technologies, and their strategic application in business.
Leadership: Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor teams and enhance overall capabilities.
Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate the technical vision and strategy to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to build strong interpersonal relationships with teammates, leadership, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience working with technical teams, for example Product Development team and Infrastructure team.
Strong decision making and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: Relevant certifications such as TOGAF or similar architectural frameworks, or ITIL.
Innovation: Demonstrated ability to leverage emerging technologies for business advantage.
Agile Mindset: Familiarity with SAFe or other Agile frameworks, and a strong belief in Lean-Agile principles.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and align architectural plans with business goals.
Join us and Discover Different at TJX, click here to learn more.
As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.
Address:
73 Clarendon Road
Location:
EUR Home Office Watford GB

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Community & Livestream
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building a vibrant in-app social community — spanning content, livestream, and creator ecosystems — that connects users, creators, and partners while driving trading engagement across the platform. You'll own the end-to-end Community & Live product, and contribute to north star goals including DAU, high quality creator ratio, and trading conversion within the community, underpinned by a robust safety & moderation stack.
What You’ll Be Doing
Community & Livesteam Product
Own the community and livestream product roadmap: content strategy, content curation, and content recommendation to improve discovery, engagement, and retention.
Drive user segmentation and interest discovery — build the frameworks and tooling to understand user cohorts and personalize content and community experiences at scale.
Define and improve community content quality standards; own the content/community ecosystem governance roadmap.
Creator & Fan Ecosystem
Build the creator and fan economy: creator incentive programs, tasks/missions, creator leveling systems, and tiered benefits that deepen streamer-fan and creator-fan relationships.
Build up creator lifecycle product capability, including discovery, engagement, onboard, grow, retain, and off-board phases.
Drive community's user education, product adoption, and trading conversion via innovative ways including internal advertising, fan economy mechanics, and trader leaderboards to achieve strong content- and trader-driven growth.
Community Monetization & Partnerships
Design and run community growth campaigns that convert community engagement into platform value (acquisition, activation, trading conversion).
Partner with marketing and growth teams to develop content strategies to capture and amplify opportunities from trendy events in the industry.
What We Look For In You
5+ years of experience as a product manager, with solid experience shipping social media, community, livestreaming, creator platforms, growth campaigns, or social products.
Hands-on with Trust & Safety or content moderation tooling.
Adequate understanding of the crypto industry, trading funnels, and risk/compliance constraints.
Able to think and communicate logically, data-sensitive, and able to accurately grasp customer mindsets; strong ability to identify and break down problems quickly.
Strong in execution, with good communication and project management skills; able to mobilize cross-functional resources to solve problems and deliver projects on time.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Us
BTC Inc. is the parent company of Bitcoin Magazine, The Bitcoin Conference, and Bitcoin for Corporations. Our mission is Hyperbitcoinization, the global adoption of Bitcoin as the world's preferred monetary network. We believe Bitcoin opens the door to a global monetary network free from poor incentives, censorship, and government manipulation. Our journey to success involves decades of complex problem-solving, product development, and service creation in order to onboard billions of people into a future where money is more accessible, borderless, and inclusive. If you enjoy working on challenging problems, fast-paced sprints, and navigating ambiguity, you'll find our mission and type of work inspiring and rewarding.
The Role
We are seeking a product-minded Chief Technology Officer to architect and build the data platform that powers BTC Inc's next generation of products. You will lead the design and delivery of our core data infrastructure and consumer app architecture, own engineering standards across the company, and build the engineering organization behind them. You will report directly to the CEO and operate as a peer to product leadership, sharing one joint platform roadmap.
The ideal candidate has personally built, not just managed, a data platform that powers a revenue product. You are a senior IC at heart who has grown into leadership without losing your hands. You read an engineering plan and immediately want to redline it. You are wary of frameworks, transformation roadmaps, and any first-90-days plan that does not include shipping code. You have built or shepherded a modern data stack (BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, identity resolution, BI) and shipped data products that customers paid for. You are Bitcoin-literate or genuinely curious. You are comfortable being the first engineering hire and the last call on architecture.
The Work
Platform Architecture
Own the technical architecture of our data platform: warehouse, ingestion pipelines, identity resolution, and a unified data model across the business.
Make the early infrastructure calls: ETL tooling, dbt structure, BI layer, orchestration, and data governance posture.
Sequence the platform buildout to ship a working unified dataset within the first few months.
Consumer App & Data Connectivity
Define the technical relationship between our consumer app and our data platform: what gets captured, how identity flows, what gets enriched, and what flows back to the user.
Partner with the app engineering team (initially contractor, transitioning to FTE) on the consumer surface and event credentialing.
Ensure event credentialing is production-grade and survives tens of thousands of users on day one.
Engineering Leadership & Standards
Hire and develop the engineering team. Model constraint before headcount: automate, simplify, and ship before you hire.
Establish the engineering culture: code review, on-call, observability, technical writing, and a high IC bar.
Be the technical interviewer and bar-raiser on every engineering hire.
Set and enforce engineering standards company-wide, favoring shipped reference implementations over policy memos.
Own standards on day one; the broader technology portfolio consolidates under you as systems mature.
Surface technical constraints to the leadership team in plain language, and carry commercial constraints back into engineering planning.
Security, Compliance & Data Governance
Stand up SOC 2 readiness on a timeline that supports enterprise-grade commercial products.
Own GDPR, consent tiering, and right-to-erasure capability across the platform from day one.
Make vendor and tooling decisions that survive audit and scale.
Work with existing technology team to architect and enact future IT infrastructure and steward technical philosophies org wide.
Your Experience
10+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years as the senior-most technical leader at a startup, data-intelligence company, fintech, or media-intelligence business.
Personally architected and shipped a data platform that powered a revenue product.
Deep, current expertise in a modern data stack: BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster), and a BI layer (Looker, Hex, Metabase).
Track record hiring and growing senior ICs in a small, high-trust environment; no preference for command-and-control management styles.
Comfortable making product and commercial trade-offs, not just technical ones; able to push back on commercial leadership when the engineering reality requires it.
Bitcoin-literate, or genuinely curious about Bitcoin as a monetary network, the Bitcoin treasury thesis, and the Lightning/x402 stack.
Strongly preferred: AI native with experience building consumer mobile, agent-facing APIs (MCP, x402), or research/intelligence data products at production scale.
Additional Benefits
In addition to working on a meaningful mission in a challenging environment, we also provide the following:
Unlimited Vacation
Company MacBook
Health, Dental, and Vision
Remote First / Your Schedule
100% Paid Life Insurance and Disability
Work alongside a talented, fast-paced team solving complex problems
The opportunity to connect and network with the Bitcoin industry and leaders in the space.

items: Own the technical architecture of our data platform: warehouse, ingestion pipelines, identity resolution, and a unified data model across the business.
Make the early infrastructure calls: ETL tooling, dbt structure, BI layer, orchestration, and data governance posture.
Sequence the platform buildout to ship a working unified dataset within the first few months.

blocks.text: Consumer App & Data Connectivity

items: Define the technical relationship between our consumer app and our data platform: what gets captured, how identity flows, what gets enriched, and what flows back to the user.
Partner with the app engineering team (initially contractor, transitioning to FTE) on the consumer surface and event credentialing.
Ensure event credentialing is production-grade and survives tens of thousands of users on day one.

blocks.text: Engineering Leadership & Standards

items: Hire and develop the engineering team. Model constraint before headcount: automate, simplify, and ship before you hire.
Establish the engineering culture: code review, on-call, observability, technical writing, and a high IC bar.
Be the technical interviewer and bar-raiser on every engineering hire.
Set and enforce engineering standards company-wide, favoring shipped reference implementations over policy memos.
Own standards on day one; the broader technology portfolio consolidates under you as systems mature.
Surface technical constraints to the leadership team in plain language, and carry commercial constraints back into engineering planning.

blocks.text: Security, Compliance & Data Governance

items: Stand up SOC 2 readiness on a timeline that supports enterprise-grade commercial products.
Own GDPR, consent tiering, and right-to-erasure capability across the platform from day one.
Make vendor and tooling decisions that survive audit and scale.
Work with existing technology team to architect and enact future IT infrastructure and steward technical philosophies org wide.

blocks.text: Your Experience

items: 10+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years as the senior-most technical leader at a startup, data-intelligence company, fintech, or media-intelligence business.
Personally architected and shipped a data platform that powered a revenue product.
Deep, current expertise in a modern data stack: BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster), and a BI layer (Looker, Hex, Metabase).
Track record hiring and growing senior ICs in a small, high-trust environment; no preference for command-and-control management styles.
Comfortable making product and commercial trade-offs, not just technical ones; able to push back on commercial leadership when the engineering reality requires it.
Bitcoin-literate, or genuinely curious about Bitcoin as a monetary network, the Bitcoin treasury thesis, and the Lightning/x402 stack.
Strongly preferred: AI native with experience building consumer mobile, agent-facing APIs (MCP, x402), or research/intelligence data products at production scale.

blocks.text: Additional Benefits
In addition to working on a meaningful mission in a challenging environment, we also provide the following:

items: Unlimited Vacation
Company MacBook
Health, Dental, and Vision
Remote First / Your Schedule
100% Paid Life Insurance and Disability
Work alongside a talented, fast-paced team solving complex problems
The opportunity to connect and network with the Bitcoin industry and leaders in the space.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Developer Relations
jobs.text:
Who we are
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Director of Developer Relations.
About the job
We’re hiring a Sr Director of Developer Relations to lead the global team building the strategies and programs that inspire and equip developers to win with Twilio. You’ll lead a unique, world-class org of hybrid engineer-marketers as you evolve the GTM motion that Twilio pioneered. This is a high-visibility, high-agency role reporting into Marketing, while working lockstep with Product and Go-To-Market.
The DevRel team at Twilio exists to make heroes of developers in their own organizations. You'll ensure we do this by showing up where developers live, both online and offline, while being humble, authentic and acting as a servant leader in the community. You are strategic yet deeply plugged into the Dev ecosystem, turning community engagement, technical contributions, and developer awareness into a steady drumb
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
Serve as a figurehead, influencer, and key speaker on the global DevRel circuit, setting a high standard for how Twilio engages with builders online and offline.
Define the long-term global narrative for developer marketing. Build consensus and influence at the executive level to ensure cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and GTM teams.
Recruit, mentor, and cultivate a unique global organization of Developer Evangelists, Advocates, and community specialists. Foster a culture of technical excellence that blends engineering rigor with world-class marketing storytelling.
Guide and scale Twilio's global Startups Program, help the team shape the strategic frameworks, partnerships, and early-stage developer initiatives that establish Twilio as the foundational tech stack for the next generation of high-growth companies.
Oversee a comprehensive technical content program (covering video, newsletters, and YouTube) to showcase the “art of the possible” with Twilio. Partner closely with the PR team to fuel our creator and influencer engine, leveraging both internal advocates and external partners to amplify developer-first storytelling.
Evolve our community and forums strategy into a modern, high-engagement motion. Build robust User-Generated Content (UGC) and ambassador programs that turn developers into long-term advocates across modern developer surfaces.
Spearhead Twilio’s Builder event strategy, ensuring our team is on the ground at major developer gatherings & meetups by showing, not just telling. Build strategic relationships with adjacent ecosystem partners to unlock high-impact co-marketing and launch activations.
Act as the ultimate steward of the developer experience. Navigate and facilitate complex, sensitive public community situations with high empathy, tact, and professional media coordination, while synthesizing community signals to directly inform the product roadmap.
Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
*Required:
7+ years of leadership experience managing developer relations, technical evangelism, or community advocacy programs (and 10+ years total working in this technical field).
Proven track record of building, training, and scaling outstanding technical global teams to support local and global stakeholders.
Deep technical baseline with an understanding of software developer personas and workflows (e.g., former full-time developer or hands-on software development experience).
Strong data-driven execution skills with a demonstrated understanding of marketing motions and user growth metrics.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships with C-level executives, journalists, bloggers, and industry analysts.
Desired:
Experience leading a developer relations team that directly supports a bottom-up, Product-Led Growth (PLG) self-service GTM motion.
Firsthand experience contributing to or directing prominent open-source software communities or public engineering forums.
An established professional network spanning a diverse set of technical communities, platform ecosystems, and developer networks.
Location
This role will be remote and based in the USA.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
Compensation
*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.
The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:
Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $275,840 - $344,800.
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $292,080 - $365,100.
Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $324,480 - $405,600.
This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, 2026 but may change based on business needs.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.
Stay alert to recruitment fraud
We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.
Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to lead and scale Oddball's engineering practice across our federal digital modernization portfolio — someone who brings proven practices from commercial and product-focused organizations and knows how to adapt them to the realities of federal delivery.
What you'll be doing:
Set and drive technical standards, best practices, and engineering consistency across 100+ engineers spanning multiple federal programs — including how teams adopt and build with agentic AI tools
Own engineering talent decisions — identifying and promoting top performers, developing those with growth potential, and maintaining a high bar across the organization
Partner with Program Managers, Tech Leads and VPs to ensure programs are delivering high-quality, technically sound solutions
Roll up your sleeves when it matters — dig into architecture, solve a hard technical problem, or prototype an idea to move it forward
Build and own the engineering career ladder — defining skill levels, growth paths, mentorship structures, certifications, continuing education and promotion criteria
Coach and support Tech Leads in both technical and managerial dimensions
Drive technical strategy across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve performance, tooling, and delivery
Stay current on emerging technology including AI/ML, cloud platform engineering, and developer productivity — and turn it into practical advantages for our clients
Contribute to growth and capture efforts — solutioning, proposal reviews, and technical viability assessments
Provide thought leadership internally and externally, representing Oddball's engineering capabilities to clients and at industry events
What you’ll bring:
Deep experience leading engineering organizations with meaningful time in a federal contracting environment
Commercial, product, or industry experience outside government is strongly preferred — and a clear sense of how to bring those lessons into federal delivery
Hands-on technical credibility — you spend most of your time guiding and enabling, but you can still go deep when the situation calls for it
Track record of building technical culture, career development programs, and high-performing engineering teams
Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevSecOps, and cloud modernization in federal contexts
A collaborative leadership style — you build alignment and empower teams rather than dictate a single way of working
Experience building partnerships and driving technical change with government clients
Exceptional communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
Requirements:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. In alignment with federal contract requirements, certain roles may also require U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and a security clearance.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree
Benefits:
Fully remote
Annual stipend
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Company Match 401(k) plan
Flexible PTO, Paid Holidays
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities:
Oddball is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. At Oddball, it’s important each employee is compensated competitively and fairly. In alignment with state legal requirements. A range for the included position is listed below. Be advised, actual offer details are determined by job category, job location, and candidate skill level.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product — Transact is the business owner of Lone Wolf's Transact product line. Transact is our most-used product line and the transaction management platform agents, brokers, REALTOR® associations, and Multiple Listing Services rely on to get deals to the closing table. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and leads a team of Product Managers across the Transact modules.
This is a business-ownership role, not a feature-management role. Operating as the “Product CEO” for the line, the Senior Director owns the strategy, commercial results, and customer experience of the business, while driving the innovation required to remain the leader in an AI-enabled world.
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Role and Responsibilities:
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
What you will own:
Own the Transact P&L — revenue, bookings, retention, and margin — and report on it through a disciplined, no-surprises monthly Product Line Review.
Define and defend an outcome-based strategy and roadmap tied to Lone Wolf's financial goals, including clarity on what not to build.
Embed AI across the transaction workflow — replacing manual steps with conversational automation and digital workers that customers adopt.
Partner with peer Product leaders so handoffs between Transact and our other product lines are seamless and invisible to the customer.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers who act as owners and innovators, not order-takers.
Maintain a real-time view of competitors and win/loss dynamics, and equip Sales and Marketing with field-ready battle cards and positioning.
Own key customer and partner relationships, turning feedback into prioritized action that protects and grows the base.
Requirments:
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of Product Managers in B2B or vertical SaaS.
Proven ownership of a product line's commercial results — P&L, bookings, or retention — with strong financial fluency.
Real estate technology, transaction management, or document and workflow software experience strongly preferred.
A track record of consolidating or modernizing products and migrating customers off legacy platforms while protecting retention.
Hands-on experience bringing AI and automation into production workflows with measurable adoption.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a single strategy.

This is a business-ownership role, not a feature-management role. Operating as the “Product CEO” for the line, the Senior Director owns the strategy, commercial results, and customer experience of the business, while driving the innovation required to remain the leader in an AI-enabled world.

The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Role and Responsibilities:

The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
What you will own:
Own the Transact P&L — revenue, bookings, retention, and margin — and report on it through a disciplined, no-surprises monthly Product Line Review.
Define and defend an outcome-based strategy and roadmap tied to Lone Wolf's financial goals, including clarity on what not to build.
Embed AI across the transaction workflow — replacing manual steps with conversational automation and digital workers that customers adopt.
Partner with peer Product leaders so handoffs between Transact and our other product lines are seamless and invisible to the customer.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers who act as owners and innovators, not order-takers.
Maintain a real-time view of competitors and win/loss dynamics, and equip Sales and Marketing with field-ready battle cards and positioning.
Own key customer and partner relationships, turning feedback into prioritized action that protects and grows the base.
Requirments:
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of Product Managers in B2B or vertical SaaS.
Proven ownership of a product line's commercial results — P&L, bookings, or retention — with strong financial fluency.
Real estate technology, transaction management, or document and workflow software experience strongly preferred.
A track record of consolidating or modernizing products and migrating customers off legacy platforms while protecting retention.
Hands-on experience bringing AI and automation into production workflows with measurable adoption.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a single strategy.

jobs.title: Director - Product Management
jobs.text:
Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence
EarthDaily | U.S. Remote | Washington Metropolitan Area preferred | Full-Time
Reports to: VP Product
About EarthDaily
EarthDaily is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company delivering daily, scientifically calibrated, AI-
ready imagery of the planet through the EarthDaily Constellation. Capturing 22 spectral bands across nearly
all of Earth's landmass and maritime regions at the same time every day, EarthDaily powers broad-area
change detection, advanced analytics, and mission applications for governments and industries worldwide.
About the Role
The Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence, is the senior product leader responsible for
defining and driving EarthDaily's product strategy for defense and intelligence markets. The Director will
identify high-value mission problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable products that combine
EarthDaily's Earth observation data, analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and workflow capabilities. This role is
highly outward-facing and will spend substantial time with government users, commercial customers,
acquisition stakeholders, Sales & Business Development, and industry partners to understand the market and
translate those insights into clear product priorities and requirements.
The role is part of EarthDaily's Analytics Product organization and works in close partnership with EarthDaily
Federal, Analytics line of business, and Engineering to develop defense and intelligence products for U.S.
Government and international defense agencies and customers. The Director owns the product problem,
customer outcome, product strategy, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, packaging, and commercial
product case. EarthDaily Federal and EarthDaily Analytics market teams along with Sales lead customer
relationships, capture, opportunity strategy, contracting, and revenue execution, while Engineering owns
technical design, delivery planning, sprint management, and implementation. The Director is expected to
move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, develop evidence-driven roadmaps that drive
revenue, stay close to customers and technical teams, and maintain a high level of responsiveness and
accountability.
Minimum Requirements
Location preferred: Washington Metropolitan Area (WMA).
• Senior or Director-level product management experience with demonstrated ownership of product
strategy, discovery, prioritization, and commercialization.
• Must be a U.S. Citizen.
• Must hold a minimum active Secret clearance; active TS/SCI strongly preferred.
• Must have strong knowledge of U.S. Government mission needs, budgets, spending cycles, acquisition
pathways, and commercial GEOINT/EO adoption, with experience in one or more of imagery, geospatial
analytics, AI/ML, or mission workflow solutions.
• Must be able to engage credibly with mission users, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, senior
government leaders, and technical teams and translate among those audiences.
What You'll Own
Defense product strategy: Set and continuously refine the product strategy, roadmap, and investment
priorities for EarthDaily's defense and intelligence portfolio, including Earth observation data, analytics,
AI/ML, contextual data, workflow solutions, and mission applications.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 2
Market and customer discovery: Maintain a continuous external discovery process with U.S. Government
users, buyers, mission owners, partners, and influencers to understand unmet needs, mission priorities,
buying behavior, competitive alternatives, and emerging demand.
• Mission-to-product translation: Translate customer problems and operational workflows into clear
product requirements, desired outcomes, priorities, and success measures that technical teams can act
on.
Productization and reuse: Identify common requirements across customers, programs, and mission areas
and translate them into scalable products, reusable capabilities, and configurable workflows. Distinguish
between strategic product investments, reusable customer-driven capabilities, and one-off custom
development.
• Prioritization and tradeoffs: Make clear recommendations on what EarthDaily should build, improve,
package, partner for, or explicitly not pursue based on customer value, market size, differentiation,
revenue potential, strategic fit, and technical feasibility.
• Commercialization and revenue enablement: Convert recurring customer and mission needs into
differentiated, scalable offerings that can be repeatedly sold and delivered. Work with EarthDaily Federal,
Growth, and Business Development to understand funded demand, inform opportunity shaping and
capture, and create product proof points that support commercialization and revenue growth.
• Pricing and packaging: Develop and evolve pricing, packaging, licensing, and value propositions for defense
and intelligence offerings based on customer willingness to pay, budget structures, acquisition pathways,
competitive dynamics, and product economics.
• Product positioning and external materials: Drive the product substance behind customer-facing
materials, product briefs, demos, presentations, proposal content, use cases, and sales enablement.
Ensure external claims accurately reflect current and planned capability.
• Customer validation: Establish disciplined feedback and validation loops with government end users and
buyers. Validate the problem, value proposition, workflow fit, usability, and willingness to pay before and
after major product investments.
• Cross-functional product leadership: Establish a working operating rhythm with Engineering in which
Product provides customer context, clear priorities, requirements, and desired outcomes while technical
teams own architecture, delivery planning, sprint execution, and implementation. Work closely with
Market and Sales leadership so customer and capture needs inform product decisions without turning
individual opportunities into one-off product direction.
• Competitive and market intelligence: Track relevant commercial EO, GEOINT, analytics, AI/ML, workflow,
and data-fusion competitors and substitutes. Translate market movement into implications for
EarthDaily's differentiation and product choices.
• Executive product leadership: Communicate product strategy, customer evidence, investment choices,
risks, and performance to senior leadership. Surface decisions early and drive alignment across Product,
Engineering, Analytics, Growth, Programs, Partnerships, and EarthDaily Federal leadership.
• Product performance: Define and track outcome-oriented product metrics, including customer validation,
adoption, usage, time-to-value, product reuse across customers and programs, pipeline influence,
revenue contribution, and other measures appropriate to the product lifecycle.
Leadership Expectations
Operate with urgency. Move fast without creating unnecessary process or waiting for perfect information.
• Be highly responsive to customers and internal teams. Product Management is an accountable,
collaborative leadership function, not a process gatekeeper.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 3
Be proactive. Identify customer, market, product, and execution issues before they become leadership
escalations.
Own the outcome. Do not stop at documenting requirements; stay engaged through validation,
commercialization, and customer adoption.
• Lead through influence. Build alignment across teams with different priorities while maintaining clear
product accountability and decision-making.
• Use evidence, not volume. Bring customer data, market signals, economics, and mission impact into
prioritization discussions.
What You Bring
10+ years of product management, product strategy, or closely related product leadership experience,
with meaningful experience at the Senior Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Principal, or
Director level.
• Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive, analytics, geospatial, ISR, AI/ML, or workflow products
from discovery through commercialization and adoption.
• Strong knowledge of U.S. Government defense and intelligence mission environments, with the ability to
understand user and operator workflows as well as government buying behavior.
• Experience working directly with customers and users to conduct product discovery, validate problems,
test concepts, and translate findings into product decisions.
• Strong commercial judgment, including experience with pricing, packaging, market segmentation, product
positioning, and revenue-oriented product decisions.
• Ability to convert complex technical and mission concepts into concise, prioritized product requirements
and executive-level recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create customer-facing product content
and represent the product in external meetings.
• Comfort operating in a matrixed organization where Product owns the market solution, product strategy,
product priorities, requirements, and outcomes; Market leads market selection, capture and revenue
execution; and Engineering owns technical design and delivery execution.
Nice to Have
Direct experience with GEOINT, remote sensing, commercial Electro-Optical imagery, spectral data, SAR,
or multi-source geospatial analytics.
• Prior work with USG IC agencies, COCOMs, Military Services, NRO, NGA, or other civil, defense/intelligence
mission organizations.
• Prior work leading non-U.S. defense products (e.g., Canada, Europe, Australia).
• Understanding of federal acquisition, appropriations, PPBE/budget cycles, OTAs, CSOs, IDIQs, data buys,
software licensing, and other common pathways for commercial technology adoption.
• Experience with product-led capture, market shaping, or building customer advocacy for emerging
commercial capabilities.
• Prior military, IC, or federal service with firsthand exposure to analyst, operator, or mission workflows.
Originally posted on Himalayas
