jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Company Overview
Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.
We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.
Job Summary
Orbis is hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering organization through its most significant period of growth. You will lead our engineering directors and managers, hire and develop an exceptional technical workforce, and shape a culture where engineers do their best work while the organization triples in size over the next year.
You will report directly to the CTO and serve as the senior engineering leader accountable for how Orbis builds: the people, the leaders, the culture, the delivery engine, and the engineering standards. The CTO sets technical vision and architecture direction; you own the organization and operating model that turns that vision into reliable delivery at scale.
This role is built for a leader who has done it before in a small, fast-moving company, and who can bring structure without bureaucracy. You will be a visible, trusted voice with engineers, executives, and government customers alike. Our engineers work remotely across the United States and its territories, including Puerto Rico, so building ways of working that span time zones is central to this role.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop engineering leadership. Own the engineering leadership team, including directors and managers. Set clear expectations, coach with candor, and build a leadership bench that scales with the company.
Build and retain a high-caliber workforce. Own the engineering workforce plan, hiring strategy, and interview process, and apply our career ladder consistently, to triple the team without lowering the bar. Make timely, fair decisions on performance and staffing.
Shape the engineering culture. Define working norms, career paths, recognition, and feedback loops around how our engineers actually want to work, and protect that culture as we grow.
Communicate with clarity at every level. Set direction and context for the whole engineering organization, and represent engineering to the executive team, the board as needed, and customers. Translate technical trade-offs into business and mission terms.
Own delivery and accountability. Partner with product leadership to turn priorities into predictable delivery, balancing roadmap commitments, technical debt, architecture, and capacity across a growing portfolio. Establish the metrics and operating rhythm that show how engineering is performing.
Set technical direction and consolidate platforms. Working with the CTO, rationalize the toolchain, development environments, and shared infrastructure across our Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React codebases and our AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare environments to reduce duplication and speed delivery.
Scale skills and knowledge. Put documentation standards, shared engineering practices, onboarding, and training in place so knowledge lives in the organization rather than with individuals.
Hold the bar on security and quality. Ensure engineering practices meet the security, compliance, and reliability standards our government and allied customers require, including deployments onto small form factor computers in constrained and disconnected environments.
Lead a remote team across U.S. time zones and territories. Set core collaboration hours, meeting cadences, and on-call rotations that work across the continental U.S., Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and other territories, with written, asynchronous communication as the default.
Partner across the business. Work closely with the CTO, Product, Security, People, Business Operations, and IT on budget, headcount, vendor decisions, and company-level planning.
Travel up to 25% to our McLean, VA headquarters, team gatherings, and customer sites.
Required Qualifications
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations through other managers, with at least 3 years at the director level or above.
Prior experience as an engineering leader at a small or early-stage company (for example, under 200 employees), including operating with limited process and building structure as the company scales.
Demonstrated success as a people leader: developing managers, building diverse and high-performing teams, handling difficult performance and staffing decisions, and retaining top talent through rapid growth.
Proven success scaling an engineering organization through rapid growth, including building hiring pipelines and interview processes.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a record of setting direction, giving candid feedback, and explaining engineering trade-offs to executives, boards, and customers.
Proven experience leading a fully remote engineering organization across multiple time zones, including schedules, core hours, meeting cadences, and on-call coverage.
Hands-on technical background in modern software delivery (cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevSecOps), including production experience with at least one of Rust, Go, or TypeScript and with AWS, GCP, or Cloudflare, deep enough to make sound architecture decisions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Ability to travel up to 25%.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on experience across our stack: Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React, deployed on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare (including Workers).
Experience shipping software to small form factor computers and other edge hardware, including resource-constrained or disconnected deployments.
Experience leading engineering for products delivered to the DoD, Intelligence Community, or allied governments, including accredited, air-gapped, or edge environments.
Active TS/SCI clearance.
Experience building or scaling data platforms, data integration, or AI/ML products in production.
Experience leading a toolchain consolidation, platform engineering, or developer-experience initiative across multiple teams.
Experience managing an engineering budget and contributing to company-level strategy.
Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Physical Requirements
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the United States and U.S. territories
Orbis Benefits
Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.
Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.
Orbis Locations
Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.
Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

blocks.text: Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.
Job Summary

Orbis is hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering organization through its most significant period of growth. You will lead our engineering directors and managers, hire and develop an exceptional technical workforce, and shape a culture where engineers do their best work while the organization triples in size over the next year.

You will report directly to the CTO and serve as the senior engineering leader accountable for how Orbis builds: the people, the leaders, the culture, the delivery engine, and the engineering standards. The CTO sets technical vision and architecture direction; you own the organization and operating model that turns that vision into reliable delivery at scale.

This role is built for a leader who has done it before in a small, fast-moving company, and who can bring structure without bureaucracy. You will be a visible, trusted voice with engineers, executives, and government customers alike. Our engineers work remotely across the United States and its territories, including Puerto Rico, so building ways of working that span time zones is central to this role.
Key Responsibilities

items: Lead and develop engineering leadership. Own the engineering leadership team, including directors and managers. Set clear expectations, coach with candor, and build a leadership bench that scales with the company.

Build and retain a high-caliber workforce. Own the engineering workforce plan, hiring strategy, and interview process, and apply our career ladder consistently, to triple the team without lowering the bar. Make timely, fair decisions on performance and staffing.
Shape the engineering culture. Define working norms, career paths, recognition, and feedback loops around how our engineers actually want to work, and protect that culture as we grow.

Communicate with clarity at every level. Set direction and context for the whole engineering organization, and represent engineering to the executive team, the board as needed, and customers. Translate technical trade-offs into business and mission terms.

Own delivery and accountability. Partner with product leadership to turn priorities into predictable delivery, balancing roadmap commitments, technical debt, architecture, and capacity across a growing portfolio. Establish the metrics and operating rhythm that show how engineering is performing.

Set technical direction and consolidate platforms. Working with the CTO, rationalize the toolchain, development environments, and shared infrastructure across our Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React codebases and our AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare environments to reduce duplication and speed delivery.
Scale skills and knowledge. Put documentation standards, shared engineering practices, onboarding, and training in place so knowledge lives in the organization rather than with individuals.

Hold the bar on security and quality. Ensure engineering practices meet the security, compliance, and reliability standards our government and allied customers require, including deployments onto small form factor computers in constrained and disconnected environments.

Lead a remote team across U.S. time zones and territories. Set core collaboration hours, meeting cadences, and on-call rotations that work across the continental U.S., Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and other territories, with written, asynchronous communication as the default.
Partner across the business. Work closely with the CTO, Product, Security, People, Business Operations, and IT on budget, headcount, vendor decisions, and company-level planning.
Travel up to 25% to our McLean, VA headquarters, team gatherings, and customer sites.

blocks.text: Required Qualifications

items: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations through other managers, with at least 3 years at the director level or above.
Prior experience as an engineering leader at a small or early-stage company (for example, under 200 employees), including operating with limited process and building structure as the company scales.

Demonstrated success as a people leader: developing managers, building diverse and high-performing teams, handling difficult performance and staffing decisions, and retaining top talent through rapid growth.
Proven success scaling an engineering organization through rapid growth, including building hiring pipelines and interview processes.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a record of setting direction, giving candid feedback, and explaining engineering trade-offs to executives, boards, and customers.
Proven experience leading a fully remote engineering organization across multiple time zones, including schedules, core hours, meeting cadences, and on-call coverage.

Hands-on technical background in modern software delivery (cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevSecOps), including production experience with at least one of Rust, Go, or TypeScript and with AWS, GCP, or Cloudflare, deep enough to make sound architecture decisions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Ability to travel up to 25%.

blocks.text: Desired Qualifications

items: Hands-on experience across our stack: Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React, deployed on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare (including Workers).
Experience shipping software to small form factor computers and other edge hardware, including resource-constrained or disconnected deployments.
Experience leading engineering for products delivered to the DoD, Intelligence Community, or allied governments, including accredited, air-gapped, or edge environments.
Active TS/SCI clearance.
Experience building or scaling data platforms, data integration, or AI/ML products in production.
Experience leading a toolchain consolidation, platform engineering, or developer-experience initiative across multiple teams.

Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

items: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.
About Magna
Magna Legal Services is a distributed business, and Microsoft 365 is how our people work: email, files, meetings, collaboration, and the security wrapped around all of it. When it works well, nobody notices. When it doesn't, work stops, and the people on the other end are professionals who need it fixed fast.
We're looking for a technology leader to take ownership of that platform — and the Azure cloud and infrastructure underneath it — and to lead and grow the people who keep it running.
Position overview
You'll be accountable for the availability, security, and usefulness of Magna's IT systems, with Microsoft 365 at the center. That means owning the platform's strategy and roadmap, making sure it's secure and well governed, and making sure our people actually get value from it — not just that it's switched on.
You'll partner with operations leadership to understand what the business needs, work with the VP of IT and Technology leadership to set priorities and policies, and coordinate with our Information Security Officer on data security and resiliency. You'll also oversee the Azure and infrastructure environments behind Microsoft 365 and our business-critical applications, and manage the vendors and partners we rely on.
You'll lead a geographically distributed IT team, and a big part of your job is raising the level of the whole organization — developing your people, standardizing how we work, and leading by example.
Primary Responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and other Applications — along with identity, security, and device management
Oversee the Azure cloud and core infrastructure that support Microsoft 365 and business-critical applications, working with our systems and cloud engineers
Partner with operations leadership to turn business needs into practical, cost-effective solutions
Work with the VP of IT and technology leadership to set priorities, policies, and standard operating procedures
Coordinate with the Information Security Officer to keep data secure and systems resilient
Manage relationships with IT vendors and partners, including Microsoft and managed service providers
Look for ways to add value, improve efficiency, and cut costs — including Microsoft 365 licensing and adoption
Develop and coach your team, and build standardized, documented, cross-trained ways of working
Keep end-user and technology support consistent across headquarters and our business units
Maintain accurate inventories of IT assets and licenses, and monitor compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements
Establish and maintain our disaster recovery and business continuity program for your areas of responsibility
Desired Background
Required qualifications
10+ years designing, supporting, deploying, and evolving technology platforms, infrastructure, and solutions
5+ years managing diverse and rapidly evolving IT platforms and services
5+ years of Microsoft platform management and administration, including Microsoft 365
5+ years managing technology teams in a diverse, geographically distributed business
Deep knowledge of the Microsoft stack — SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Power BI, and Office desktop and mobile applications
Experience supporting Microsoft 365 users in a distributed, highly mobile business
Experience building and maintaining secure, highly available cloud environments (Azure; AWS a plus)
A proven ability to translate business requirements into solution strategies in partnership with senior business leaders
Outstanding written and verbal communication, and a collaborative style with peer IT leaders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Sciences or a similar field, or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications
Microsoft 365 or other Microsoft certifications
A deep understanding of the Azure / Microsoft 365 security model and group and policy structures
Experience with Intune/EMS, Purview information protection, Defender, and Entra ID
Experience moving on-premises systems to the cloud (Azure; AWS a plus)
Experience with data security standards and regulations relevant to the legal industry
Experience in a legal or regulated business environment, including handling highly secure and confidential client data
Key Characteristics
Ability to multitask using time management skills such as prioritizing, organizing, tracking details, and meeting deadlines on multiple projects with varying completion dates.
Mature and self-motivated professional able to work in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.
Collaborative problem solver and solution champion.
Strong sense of intellectual curiosity and interest in understanding business objectives and how technology can be leveraged.
Passionate about creative, cost-effective solutions to business problems and opportunities.
Active engagement in and understanding of the business — as a partner and collaborator with operational management.
Capability to work as an effective and collaborative member of a distributed IT leadership team.
A keen focus on customer satisfaction and high-quality service delivery, with strong interpersonal skills, responsiveness, and outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
The team
You'll report to the VP of IT. Your day-to-day partners:
The CTO and peer Technology leadership — for priorities, policies, and shared solutions
The Information Security Officer — for data security, resiliency, and compliance
Operations leadership and business units — for requirements and rollout
Your IT team and our vendors and partners — for delivery
Logistics
Full-time, exempt
Travel to company locations as needed — up to 20%
Specific title flexible based on profile and experience
Magna Legal Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY
321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.
Technology is central to how 321 competes and grows. From our CRM and automation programs to 321 AIM, our proprietary performance marketing platform, the systems we build are a core part of the value we deliver. The Chief Technology Officer is the executive who sets the vision for that technology and turns it into a lasting competitive advantage.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Chief Technology Officer at 321, you will own the agency's technology vision, strategy, and execution at the executive level. This is a C-suite role with company-wide authority — you'll shape how 321 builds, buys, secures, and monetizes technology, lead the technology organization, and help define the agency's direction as a member of the executive leadership team.
The right person for this role thinks in platforms and business models, not just systems. You understand that the right architecture decisions compound over years, that proprietary technology and data can become defensible products, and that AI is reshaping what an agency can deliver and how it should be priced. You're as comfortable advising on a High Level or Salesforce architecture as you are presenting a multi-year technology strategy to ownership, investors, or enterprise clients — and you build the organization that executes it.
You'll provide executive technology leadership in partnership with 321 AIM, guiding platform architecture, scalability, and roadmap decisions so that our proprietary technology and client service delivery grow together.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Executive Leadership & Technology Vision
Define and own the agency's multi-year technology vision and strategy, aligned with company growth goals, service offerings, and market positioning
Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to company strategy, annual planning, and major business decisions
Own the technology budget, including platform, licensing, infrastructure, and headcount investments, with clear return-on-investment expectations
Lead build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for major platforms and capabilities
Report on technology performance, risk, and investment outcomes to ownership and, where applicable, investors or a board
Technology Organization & Talent
Build, lead, and scale the technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration
Design the organizational structure, leadership roles, and hiring plan needed to support the agency's growth
Set the culture, engineering standards, and operating principles for how technology is built, shipped, and supported across the agency
Develop leaders within the technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and clear career paths
Proprietary Platforms & Product Strategy
Provide executive technology leadership for 321 AIM in partnership with its leadership, guiding platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and roadmap priorities
Identify opportunities to turn repeatable agency solutions, data assets, and automations into proprietary products, platforms, or productized services
Oversee product development practices, including requirements, release management, quality assurance, and technical documentation
Protect and grow the agency's technology intellectual property
AI Strategy & Innovation
Set the company-wide AI strategy, positioning 321 as a leader in AI-powered marketing, CRM, and performance services
Govern responsible AI use, including data privacy, model selection, accuracy standards, and client disclosure practices
Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that create new service lines, improve margins, or strengthen client outcomes
Partner with department leaders to embed AI into creative, paid media, CRM, reporting, and agency operations
Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk
Own the agency's enterprise architecture across internal systems, client platforms, data infrastructure, and integrations
Lead the information security program, including policies, access management, vendor risk, incident response, and business continuity
Ensure agency and client technology meets regulatory and contractual requirements in healthcare, insurance, legal, and other regulated industries, including HIPAA, business associate agreements, TCPA, GDPR, and CCPA
Guide the agency toward formal security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as client and growth needs require
Data Strategy & Measurement
Define the agency's data strategy, including how client, campaign, and performance data is collected, governed, stored, and used
Oversee the measurement and attribution infrastructure that connects marketing activity to closed revenue for clients
Build the data foundation needed to support performance-based pricing, benchmarking, and predictive insights across the client portfolio
Client, Partner & Agency Growth
Serve as the agency's senior technology executive with clients, partners, and prospects — including CMO, CIO, and ownership-level audiences
Lead the technology narrative in new business pitches, RFP responses, and strategic client relationships
Build and manage strategic technology partnerships with platforms such as High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, and Meta
Lead technical due diligence for partnerships, acquisitions, or major client engagements as the agency grows
WHAT YOU HAVE
12+ years of experience in technology leadership, with demonstrated depth in MarTech, CRM architecture, data infrastructure, and platform or product development — agency, MarTech, or SaaS experience strongly preferred
At least 5 years in an executive or senior technology leadership role (CTO, VP of Technology or Engineering, or Director overseeing multiple teams), including building and scaling technology organizations
Proven track record of setting technology strategy and delivering measurable business results, including revenue growth, margin improvement, or new product lines
Experience leading the development of proprietary platforms or software products, from architecture and roadmap through launch and scale
Deep understanding of CRM and marketing automation ecosystems — High Level strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot also valued
Strong command of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure), APIs, integrations, and data platforms
Experience leading security and compliance programs in regulated industries, including HIPAA; SOC 2 or similar framework experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated leadership in AI strategy and adoption, including LLM-powered products or workflows, with sound judgment on governance and responsible use
Experience owning technology budgets, vendor strategy, and build-versus-buy decisions
Executive-level communication skills — able to present technology strategy to ownership, investors, boards, and enterprise clients with clarity and credibility
Comfort operating in a fast-growing, remote, multi-client environment with competing priorities
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience; advanced degree a plus
REPORTING STRUCTURE
The Chief Technology Officer reports directly to the CEO and is a member of the agency's executive leadership team. This role leads the full technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration. The CTO partners with 321 AIM leadership on platform strategy and works closely with the SVP of Strategy, Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director to align technology with client delivery and agency growth.
COMPENSATION
Salary Range: $120K+ annually, based on experience
321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, company impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated executive experience, organizational leadership, and a track record of technology-driven business results. Executive performance bonus eligibility applies.
321 BENEFITS
100% remote work environment
Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
Professional development and platform/tool access budget
Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
Opportunity to shape the technology strategy and proprietary platforms of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology
Salary: $120,000+ based on experience

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.text:
About PSD Citywide
Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?
PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.
Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.
Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!
Job Description
Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and making a difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a VP, Engineering to fill an existing vacancy and join our IT Department in a fully remote role (though occasional travel will be required) based in Canada. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping businesses maximize their potential, we want you to be a part of our team!
PSD Citywide is seeking a VP, Engineering to lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of our integrated SaaS platform serving municipalities and public sector organizations across North America.
Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the VP, Engineering, will translate the Company's technology and product strategy into effective engineering execution. The role leads Software Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, with day-to-day accountability for engineering operations, software delivery, technical standards, quality, infrastructure, talent, and continuous improvement.
The VP, Engineering will oversee the development, delivery, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based software solutions, including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Maintenance, GIS, Budgeting, and Permitting. The role will evolve the engineering operating model as the company scales, with particular focus on AI-enabled software development, quality engineering, automation, organizational effectiveness, and increasing the speed and reliability with which customer value is delivered.
What We Offer
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience.
Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.
Job Duties & Responsibilities
Lead Software Engineering, QA / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, building a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative organization.
Oversee the design, development, enhancement, maintenance, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based SaaS platform.
Partner with the CTO, Product Management, Business Analysis, and business leaders to prioritize engineering initiatives, translate product and business priorities into executable engineering plans, and maintain clear accountability between product ownership and engineering delivery.
Develop and lead the Company's AI-enabled engineering strategy, taking direct ownership of the evaluation, adoption, governance, and effective use of AI tools and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across software development, QA / Quality Engineering, and technical operations where appropriate, including design, coding, code review, documentation, debugging, testing, release processes, systems administration, monitoring, and operational workflows.
Establish, monitor, and communicate meaningful engineering performance metrics, including delivery predictability, development cycle time, team capacity, release frequency, software quality and escaped defects, test automation, platform reliability, operational performance, budget effectiveness, and measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering practices.
Lead the modernization of software quality practices, including increased test automation, AI-assisted test development, improved regression testing, CI/CD practices, release quality controls, and greater engineering ownership of software quality.
Lead the engineering technology strategy and architectural direction of PSD Citywide's SaaS platform, ensuring architecture, technical debt, scalability, performance, maintainability, and modernization support long-term product and business objectives.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and operating rhythms across Engineering teams and technical leaders, including delivery commitments, capacity planning, technical quality, risk identification, performance measurement, and timely escalation of issues affecting product commitments or customer outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight for systems administration and infrastructure operations, including cloud environments, deployment infrastructure, platform reliability, monitoring, backup and recovery, operational resiliency, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product, Support, Advisory Services, Implementation, and other business functions to manage the upstream and downstream impacts of increased engineering capacity, automation, and delivery velocity and ensure engineering improvements translate into customer and business outcomes.
Develop and manage departmental budgets, financial plans, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, software licensing, and technology investments to ensure responsible financial stewardship and cost effectiveness.
Support business case development, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure technology initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, and budgeted.
Continuously evaluate and evolve the structure, skills, roles, leadership capacity, and operating model of the Engineering organization as the company scales and technology practices change; lead workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, recruitment, and performance management.
Ensure security, compliance, resiliency, and risk management are incorporated into engineering operations and software development practices, and establish appropriate AI governance covering customer data protection, source code confidentiality, intellectual property, vendor risk, responsible use, and cost management.
Other duties as required.
Qualifications
10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology operations, or software delivery leadership, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, technical leads, or multidisciplinary software development teams.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling a multidisciplinary engineering organization of comparable size and complexity, including developing technical leaders, establishing effective management structures, and evolving processes as the organization grows.
Demonstrated experience successfully leading an engineering organization through the adoption of AI-enabled software development practices, with direct leadership involvement in strategy, implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.
Demonstrated ability to measure and communicate the impact of AI-enabled engineering practices, including improvements in developer productivity, development cycle time, product delivery velocity, software quality, testing efficiency, release frequency, or organizational capacity.
Strong working knowledge and practical experience with contemporary AI-assisted software engineering tools and techniques, including the ability to evaluate their capabilities, limitations, security implications, and appropriate use across development and quality engineering workflows.
Demonstrated experience leading or overseeing QA / Quality Engineering functions, including test automation, regression testing, release quality, and integration of quality practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Experience managing significant departmental budgets, financial planning, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, and technology investments.
Experience operating in a private-equity-backed or similarly metrics-driven environment, including supporting executive and Board-level reporting, performance reviews, and presentations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
Strong understanding of SaaS application development, cloud platforms, software architecture, APIs, and modern software delivery practices.
Experience leading the modernization and evolution of established SaaS platforms, including managing technical debt, architectural improvement, scalability, maintainability, and modernization alongside ongoing customer and product delivery commitments.
Demonstrated experience establishing and continuously improving modern software delivery practices, including iterative planning, capacity management, CI/CD, release management, engineering metrics, and appropriate use of Agile or Lean methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to balance technical priorities with business objectives, budget considerations, and customer requirements.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing, accountable engineering organizations, including developing managers and technical leaders, coaching and performance management, succession planning, talent development, and attracting and retaining strong technical talent.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues, risks, investment decisions, and trade-offs into clear business terms for executive, Board, and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience successfully leading distributed or remote technical teams, including maintaining strong communication, accountability, collaboration, and team culture across locations.
Experience in GovTech, municipal technology, enterprise SaaS, asset management, ERP, or public sector software is considered an asset.
What Success Looks Like
A high-performing, accountable Engineering organization with strong technical and people leadership.
Improved delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, and release efficiency.
Material progress in test automation and modern QA / Quality Engineering practices.
Measurable, responsible adoption of AI that improves engineering productivity, product velocity, quality, and organizational capacity.
An engineering operating model, leadership structure, and skill base capable of supporting PSD Citywide's continued growth.
The Candidate Journey
Resume Review: Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you with a response.
Phone Interview: PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.
Virtual Interview: Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.
Offer/Feedback: The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.
PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.
We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Real World Data (RWD)
jobs.text:
About this opportunity:
As the Senior Director of Real World Data (RWD), you will be accountable for defining, developing, and implementing our RWD strategy, platform, and data pipeline to transform diverse real-world datasets into regulatory-grade, research-ready assets that drive our clinical development, evidence generation, digital health products and product offerings. You will play a key role informing regulatory decisions, improving clinical trial efficiency, evaluating and implementing AI/agentic workflows to strengthen our RWD platform and help bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice to improve patient outcomes and advance our vision of a world without disease.
The Senior Director will lead all informatics aspects of developing and maintaining a “regulatory-grade” RWD pipeline. Specifically, the Senior Director will lead the RWD Informatics team in turning electronic health records (EHR), claims, imaging, and other RWD sources into research-ready datasets accessible by our biostatisticians,computational scientists and other end users while ensuring data quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.
These efforts will contribute to developing and commercializing a portfolio of early cancer detection products — based on both clinical and multiomics data — and digital health solutions that will enable payers, providers, and patients to catch cancers early when curative intervention is most achievable.
The role reports to the Chief Product Officer. This role will be a Remote role.
What you’ll do:
Lead the operations and continuous improvement of our RWD curation pipeline, managing internal and external resources as needed. Evaluate and integrate agentic workflows and AI to ensure accuracy, augment the interpretability and quality, and drive efficiencies across our RWD efforts. This includes:
Designing and implementing processes, analytical methods, and AI tools to integrate a variety of RWD sources.
Preparing data for analysis, including data cleaning and mapping.
Ensuring “regulatory-grade” data quality where required.
Developing a scalable unstructured data curation operation, leveraging automation as much as possible and only transiently leveraging manual techniques with a roadmap towards eliminating these steps as appropriate.
Create a comprehensive, multi-year strategy for the acquisition, management, curation, and use of RWD to support regulatory submissions, clinical evidence generation, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and commercial efforts such as patient identification and care navigation.
Architect, build, and maintain a robust, efficient, and scalable RWD platform and pipeline capable of ingesting, linking, harmonizing, and curating large, complex, and disparate real-world datasets such as Electronic Health Records (EHRs), claims data, imaging, and registries of structured and unstructured data.
Lead clinical data analyses to support product strategy, development and commercialization to improve Freenome’s access to RWD and enhance future product offerings for HCOs.
Serve as the RWD expert, proactively collaborating with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Engineering, Science and Product and Commercial teams to ensure the RWD pipeline meets diverse end-user needs, clinical, scientific and commercial objectives.
Contribute to defining the strategic direction of Freenome's data initiatives, in partnership with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Support data acquisition by conducting technical due diligence, facilitating data acquisition agreements and defining data delivery specifications and lead data product implementation efforts into Freenome’s platforms with strategic partners and customers.
Oversee the translation of raw RWD datasets into research-ready, regulatory-grade datasets, following OMOP or other industry-standard models, suitable for rigorous statistical analysis and real-world evidence (RWE) generation.
Foster a quality mindset through data quality checks, governance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure the integrity, privacy, security, and traceability of all RWD assets to meet regulatory requirements.
Develop the team, building technical and leadership capabilities and coaching for high-performance proficiency.
Directly lead a team of clinical informaticists and data analysts through clear direction and priorities and hands-on management to enable focused execution in alignment with company objectives.
Manage the RWD department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and allocation of expenditures.
Build and maintain a culture of collaboration and inclusivity both within RWD and cross-functionally across Freenome.
Must haves:
Master’s or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
At least 12 years of progressive experience in clinical informatics, including experience with:
EHR, claims, other structured and unstructured RWD, and molecular data.
Applying RWD to device, therapeutic and/or software product development.
RWD across multiple disease areas, including oncology.
At least 10 years of experience building and leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams.
Demonstrated success operating within a matrixed organization and proactively collaborating with teams of internal and external partners to guide product delivery from concept to completion.
Passion for getting in the trenches, leading by example, and scaling technical platforms and teams.
Excellent written and verbal communicator with strong stakeholder management capabilities and problem-solving skills.
Experience leading data modeling, terminology normalization, data curation and/or unstructured data abstraction via natural language processing (NLP).
Deep knowledge of ontologies commonly used by health systems and payers (ICD-10, HCPCS, CPT, LOINC, RxNorm).
Experience with Python, R, and/or SQL.

blocks.text: About this opportunity:

As the Senior Director of Real World Data (RWD), you will be accountable for defining, developing, and implementing our RWD strategy, platform, and data pipeline to transform diverse real-world datasets into regulatory-grade, research-ready assets that drive our clinical development, evidence generation, digital health products and product offerings. You will play a key role informing regulatory decisions, improving clinical trial efficiency, evaluating and implementing AI/agentic workflows to strengthen our RWD platform and help bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice to improve patient outcomes and advance our vision of a world without disease.

The Senior Director will lead all informatics aspects of developing and maintaining a “regulatory-grade” RWD pipeline. Specifically, the Senior Director will lead the RWD Informatics team in turning electronic health records (EHR), claims, imaging, and other RWD sources into research-ready datasets accessible by our biostatisticians,computational scientists and other end users while ensuring data quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.

These efforts will contribute to developing and commercializing a portfolio of early cancer detection products — based on both clinical and multiomics data — and digital health solutions that will enable payers, providers, and patients to catch cancers early when curative intervention is most achievable.
The role reports to the Chief Product Officer. This role will be a Remote role.
What you’ll do:

Lead the operations and continuous improvement of our RWD curation pipeline, managing internal and external resources as needed. Evaluate and integrate agentic workflows and AI to ensure accuracy, augment the interpretability and quality, and drive efficiencies across our RWD efforts. This includes:

items: Designing and implementing processes, analytical methods, and AI tools to integrate a variety of RWD sources.
Preparing data for analysis, including data cleaning and mapping.
Ensuring “regulatory-grade” data quality where required.

Developing a scalable unstructured data curation operation, leveraging automation as much as possible and only transiently leveraging manual techniques with a roadmap towards eliminating these steps as appropriate.

Create a comprehensive, multi-year strategy for the acquisition, management, curation, and use of RWD to support regulatory submissions, clinical evidence generation, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and commercial efforts such as patient identification and care navigation.

Architect, build, and maintain a robust, efficient, and scalable RWD platform and pipeline capable of ingesting, linking, harmonizing, and curating large, complex, and disparate real-world datasets such as Electronic Health Records (EHRs), claims data, imaging, and registries of structured and unstructured data.
Lead clinical data analyses to support product strategy, development and commercialization to improve Freenome’s access to RWD and enhance future product offerings for HCOs.

Serve as the RWD expert, proactively collaborating with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Engineering, Science and Product and Commercial teams to ensure the RWD pipeline meets diverse end-user needs, clinical, scientific and commercial objectives.
Contribute to defining the strategic direction of Freenome's data initiatives, in partnership with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

Support data acquisition by conducting technical due diligence, facilitating data acquisition agreements and defining data delivery specifications and lead data product implementation efforts into Freenome’s platforms with strategic partners and customers.

Oversee the translation of raw RWD datasets into research-ready, regulatory-grade datasets, following OMOP or other industry-standard models, suitable for rigorous statistical analysis and real-world evidence (RWE) generation.

Foster a quality mindset through data quality checks, governance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure the integrity, privacy, security, and traceability of all RWD assets to meet regulatory requirements.
Develop the team, building technical and leadership capabilities and coaching for high-performance proficiency.
Directly lead a team of clinical informaticists and data analysts through clear direction and priorities and hands-on management to enable focused execution in alignment with company objectives.
Manage the RWD department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and allocation of expenditures.
Build and maintain a culture of collaboration and inclusivity both within RWD and cross-functionally across Freenome.

jobs.title: Director, Product Operations
jobs.text:
The Director, Product Operations builds and runs the operating system for Lone Wolf's Product organization — the process, tooling, data, and communication that enable our Product leaders to focus on customer experiences and outcomes. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and partners with the leaders of our product lines, Engineering, Product Marketing, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success.
This is a hands-on leadership role: the Director will do the work from day one and build the function over time. They will modernize how Product works — including leading AI adoption across the team — and become the company's trusted source of product data and insight.
Role and Responsibilities:
The Director owns Product's portion of the software development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch readiness, and partners with Engineering to keep handoffs, capacity, and delivery visible. They run the cadence behind planning and our monthly Product Line Reviews, own the product team's tools and analytics, and make sure product signals flow cleanly between Product and the rest of the business.
What you will own:
Define and improve Product's part of the SDLC — discovery, PRDs, prioritization, and acceptance — and partner with Engineering on clean handoffs, shared definitions, and visibility into capacity and delivery.
Lead internal AI adoption across the Product team, rolling out AI-enabled workflows for research, requirements, analysis, and reporting, and measuring the productivity gains.
Facilitate the Product operating rhythm, including planning cycles, goals, and the data and materials behind monthly Product Line Reviews.
Partner with Product Marketing on go-to-market readiness — launch plans, release notes, and roadmap communication — so Sales and Customer Success are never surprised.
Partner with Operations to give the Enablement team the product knowledge, release information, and content the field needs.
Partner with all customer-facing teams to make sure feedback from customers, support, sales calls, and Deal Desk reaches the right Product leaders and informs prioritization.
Own product analytics — usage, adoption, retention, and product health — and deliver analysis and reporting on our products for other departments.
Own the Product tool stack, data hygiene, and playbook, automating manual reporting and keeping PMs across product lines working consistently.
Requirements:
8+ years in product operations, product management, technical program management, or product-focused consulting in B2B SaaS, including 3+ years at a senior or director level.
Experience building or rebuilding a product operations function in a growing SaaS business — and examples of what you built.
Fluency with AI tools and the ability to design, instrument, and improve workflows that use them.
Strong data skills: defining SaaS product metrics, building dashboards, and turning analysis into recommendations.
Experience with tools like Jira, Lovable, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gainsight, Salesforce, and Gong.
Vertical SaaS, PE-backed, or multi-product portfolio experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Product Ownership – Commercial Products & Platforms
jobs.text:
Position Overview
Director, Product Ownership – Commercial Products & Platforms will be responsible for the product vision, roadmap, governance, backlog management, and stakeholder engagement model for Conduent's portfolio of Shared Commercial Products.
The role will act as the primary technology Product Owner for shared Commercial platforms and serve as the strategic partner to Commercial General Managers, Business Product Managers, Technology General Managers, Client Technology Managers (CITMs), Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and AI teams. In addition to direct product ownership responsibilities, this will be a people leadership role responsible for managing Product Owners supporting Commercial-wide platforms and ensuring product investments align with business priorities and technology strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Product Ownership & Strategy
Define and manage product vision, roadmap, release strategy, and long-term plans.
Establish success metrics and business outcomes.
Prioritize investments balancing customer needs, modernization, AI opportunities, operational requirements, and technical debt.
Drive adoption, innovation, and continuous improvement across the product portfolio.
Governance & Business Engagement
Establish governance councils and recurring business engagement forums.
Create a structured intake and prioritization process.
Facilitate decision-making and roadmap alignment across stakeholders.
Ensure visibility into priorities and delivery commitments.
Product Delivery & Technology Partnership
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, AI, and Operations teams.
Own backlog prioritization, release planning, and roadmap execution.
Translate business objectives into actionable product requirements.
Monitor delivery progress and business value realization.
Modernization & AI
Drive AI, automation, analytics, and modernization initiatives.
Promote reusable technology assets and shared platform capabilities.
Support strategic client pursuits, demonstrations, solutioning activities, and innovation workshops.
Advance Commercial transformation objectives through product-led innovation.
Required Experience
10+ years of experience in product ownership, technology strategy, backlog management or digital transformation, including experience leading the development of AI-enabled and cloud-first technologies.
Proven experience owning enterprise product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery.
Experience translating business needs into scalable technology solutions and measurable outcomes.
Strong cross-functional experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and business teams.
Strong business acumen, executive communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in complex, matrixed organizations.
Preferred Experience
Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure-based technology environments.
Experience supporting client solutioning, demonstrations, strategic pursuits, or innovation workshops.
Experience developing reusable platforms or shared technology capabilities.
Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 plus applicable incentive compensation.

jobs.title: Partner – Head of Data Protection team – Senior Data Protection Solicitor
jobs.text:
Harper James is a growing, ambitious commercial law firm like no other. We are growing our commercial team and have exciting opportunity for an experienced data protection solicitor to lead and grow our data protection team.
This is an opportunity to combine specialist legal advice with people leadership and service development. You’ll help shape how we support clients, develop our team and build practical, scalable services for growing businesses.
About Harper James
Harper James is a modern, ambitious commercial law firm built to support entrepreneurial businesses with accessible, high-quality legal services. We combine legal expertise with a commercial mindset and an operating model designed for growth.
You’ll work with businesses of different sizes across a range of sectors, alongside colleagues in our commercial, technology, corporate and employment teams.
The opportunity
You’ll lead the development of our data protection practice, combining hands-on client work with responsibility for the team and its services.
Key responsibilities
Leading, supporting and developing colleagues, with clear expectations and constructive feedback
Helping grow the team as client demand and the service develop
Managing workloads and maintaining consistent, high-quality advice
Building client relationships and identifying opportunities to grow the practice
Leading on the development of DPO as a service, data protection health checks, shaping clear service scopes, pricing and delivery approaches
Standardising suitable processes, templates and guidance to improve consistency and efficiency
Using legal technology and automation responsibly, while maintaining appropriate oversight
Sharing knowledge and working across teams to give clients joined-up advice
You’ll have the opportunity to influence both what we offer and how we deliver it, making data protection support easier for clients to access and helping colleagues work effectively.
What we’re looking for
We are looking for an experienced senior data protection solicitor with 10+ years’ PQE and substantial experience advising businesses on UK and European data protection law.
You’ll also bring:
Experience managing and developing people, including supporting performance and having constructive conversations
A track record of leading matters and managing client relationships
A commercial approach to developing services and recognising client needs
Experience improving delivery through consistent processes, knowledge sharing or technology
Strong drafting and negotiation skills
The ability to turn complex legal and technical issues into clear, practical guidance
Your technical experience will include:
UK data protection compliance, governance and risk
Data subject rights requests and data protection impact assessments (DPIAs)
International data transfers, ePrivacy, cookies and direct marketing
Data processing and data-sharing agreements
Artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technology issues
Data breach response, incident management and engagement with regulators
The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and wider international privacy developments
Special category and other sensitive data across different sectors
Data protection advice on technology, commercial, corporate and employment matters
You’ll be comfortable working with growing and innovative businesses. You’ll understand when clients need specialist advice and when a proportionate, repeatable service can meet their needs.
You’ll be confident using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint to organise work and collaborate. You’ll also be open to using AI tools and automation where they genuinely improve delivery.
Remote working
We offer fully remote working, with access to meeting space in Birmingham, Cambridge, London, Manchester, Oxford, Southampton, Cardiff and Sheffield.
Our remote set-up gives you flexibility over where you work, while keeping you connected to colleagues. We collaborate on client matters and internal projects, share ideas and make time to get to know each other.
You’ll help create that sense of connection within the data protection team, so colleagues feel trusted, supported and clear about their responsibilities.
What we offer
This is an opportunity to lead a specialist team and shape a growing service, while continuing to do varied, commercially focused legal work.
We offer:
A collaborative working environment where there’s no room for office politics
Competitive salary
33 days’ holiday, including public holidays, with the option to buy up to five additional days each year
Private healthcare
Death in service benefit
Access to our electric car scheme
Flexible working as part of a fully remote but connected team
No agencies, please

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
LeapXpert: Innovating the Future of Business Communication
At LeapXpert, we’ve built the infrastructure that turns enterprise communication into intelligence enterprises can act on.
As the leader in Governed Communication Intelligence, our platform enables employees to connect with clients on the consumer messaging channels they actually use, governs and captures every conversation as enterprise data, and converts that data into deployable intelligence for teams, AI agents, and the business decisions that matter. Governance is the foundation. Intelligence is the value.
Our mission: enable enterprises to build a governed communication infrastructure that makes trust structural, intelligence compound, and every client relationship more productive. We recently announced a $180M growth investment and are recognized as a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving for the second consecutive year. Hundreds of the world’s most demanding enterprises trust LeapXpert to power their most important client conversations every day.
This is just the beginning. We’re growing fast and looking for sharp, driven people to help us define and build the Governed Communication Intelligence category. At LeapXpert, you’ll work on high-impact projects, collaborate with ambitious teams across the globe, and help shape a platform that is rewriting how enterprises communicate, govern, and compete.
Apply now.
Why join us
Innovative Culture: Work at the cutting edge of business communication technology, with a product that’s changing the way Fortune 500 companies communicate.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly impact how millions of professionals connect and collaborate worldwide.
Global Team: Be part of a diverse, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and growth.
Growth Opportunities: With our rapid expansion, there are plenty of opportunities for professional growth and development.
Award-Winning Product: Join a company with a track record of success and recognition, including accolades like being named a Gartner Cool Vendor.
About the role
Title: Director of Platform Engineering
Function: Engineering
Report to: Head of Engineering
Location: Singapore (Remote)
As the Director of Platform Engineering at LeapXpert, you will own the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of our cloud infrastructure powering a globally distributed SaaS platform. You will lead a globally distributed team across APAC, EMEA, and US time zones, spanning DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Database Operations, and Incident Management.
You will drive operational excellence through modern practices including GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and Policy as Code. Security and reliability are foundational to this role - you will embed security-first thinking into every layer of our infrastructure while building systems designed for resilience and high availability. This role requires a hands-on leader with an unwavering commitment to engineering excellence, who can balance strategic vision with deep technical expertise in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
This position is ideal for someone with proven experience operating large-scale cloud infrastructure for SaaS products and a passion for building high-performing platform teams.
What you’ll do
Infrastructure Strategy & Operations
Define and execute the platform engineering strategy across cloud infrastructure, ensuring alignment with business objectives and compliance requirements.
Oversee cloud infrastructure operations across a multi-cloud environment (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Lead infrastructure evolution initiatives to improve availability, reduce costs, and enhance platform scalability.
Drive infrastructure cost optimization through continuous analysis, rightsizing, and efficient resource utilization.
Engineering Practices & Tooling
Champion modern engineering practices including GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and Policy as Code across the organization.
Oversee Kubernetes platform operations, ensuring robust container orchestration and deployment pipelines.
Lead DevOps initiatives encompassing CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and engineering tooling.
Implement and maintain observability frameworks to ensure comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting.
Reliability & Incident Management
Establish and lead incident management processes, serving as a key coordination point between product development, security, and operations teams.
Drive resilience testing and chaos engineering practices to proactively identify and address system vulnerabilities.
Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to maintain platform reliability and inform engineering priorities.
Lead post-incident reviews and ensure continuous improvement through actionable follow-ups.
Change Management & Release Coordination
Implement rigorous change management processes to minimize risk and ensure stable production environments.
Partner with product development teams to plan and coordinate rollouts, balancing velocity with reliability.
Establish and maintain release management standards and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, feature flags).
Team Leadership & Vendor Management
Lead and mentor a globally distributed team across DevOps, SRE, Database Operations, and Incident Management functions.
Manage relationships with cloud providers and service vendors, including coordination of incident reviews and service quality meetings.
Build a culture of operational excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing across time zones.
Compliance & Security Collaboration
Ensure infrastructure operations maintain compliance with SOC2 and ISO 27001 standards.
Support FedRAMP readiness initiatives in collaboration with security and compliance teams.
Partner with the security organization to implement infrastructure security controls and audit requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
15+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position within a SaaS or high-growth technology environment.
Proven experience operating and optimizing cloud infrastructure at scale, with hands-on expertise managing cloud spend exceeding $1M annually.
Strong technical expertise in multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps workflows, and Policy as Code frameworks.
Demonstrated success leading infrastructure migrations, platform modernization, and large-scale technical projects.
Proven track record driving incident management programs, including on-call processes, escalation procedures, and post-incident reviews.
Strong experience implementing and managing change management processes in production SaaS environments.
Excellent communication skills with demonstrated ability to lead globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001) and their infrastructure implications.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Hands-on experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing methodologies (e.g., Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, Litmus).
Experience supporting FedRAMP authorization or operating in regulated environments.
Strong attention to detail with a systematic approach to operational processes and documentation.
Experience with observability platforms and SRE practices (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets).
Cloud certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, CKA/CKAD).
Background in vendor management and contract negotiations with cloud providers and service partners.
Experience scaling platform teams in high-growth environments.
Our Values
Curiosity: We’re curious and future-focused.
One Team: We’re one team, in many colors.
Customer–Driven: We’re obsessed with the customer.
Integrity: We don’t compromise on the integrity.
Excellence: We exemplify excellence.
What you’ll get
Competitive compensation package
Remote-friendly work culture
Regional benefits (country-specific medical, wellness support)
Global exposure with a fast-growing international tech company
A team that values impact, transparency, and growth
Apply now to secure the future of communication with LeapXpert!
LeapXpert values diversity and inclusion as critical components of our culture and success. We believe a diverse team with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives fosters creativity, innovation, and mutual respect. We are committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, or ability. We actively seek to recruit and retain talent from diverse communities and encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Please submit your resume for consideration.

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.text:
We are seeking a hands-on Director of Technology to lead day-to-day execution across
infrastructure, applications, IT operations, and technical vendors. This leader will help scale the
company’s technology function during a period of significant growth by improving reliability,
delivery, business alignment, and operational discipline. The ideal candidate is equally
comfortable driving strategy, managing budgets across capex and opex, and stepping into the
details when needed.
What You Will Own
Lead day-to-day technology operations across infrastructure, business systems, internal IT, and
application delivery.
Oversee both infrastructure and applications, ensuring stability, scalability, security, and business
alignment.
Manage technology budgets across operating expenses and capital expenditures, including software,
cloud, infrastructure, telecom, and technical services.
Drive vendor management, renewal planning, cost optimization, and accountability for third-party
partners and contractors.
Build practical operating discipline for service delivery, change management, escalation,
documentation, and release coordination.
Partner with operations, finance, and executive leadership to prioritize initiatives that improve
visibility, efficiency, and growth.
Support systems integration, acquired business onboarding, and scaling efforts as the company grows
through 2029.
Develop KPIs, reporting rhythms, and execution follow-through for the technology function.
What We Are Looking For
8+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
Experience leading both infrastructure and applications or business systems in a growing business.
Strong operational mindset with the ability to execute in a lean environment without relying on a large
internal team.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, technical roadmaps, and cross-functional priorities.
Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and translate technical work into
business value.
Comfort balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
Preferred Background
Experience in multi-site, field service, industrial, facilities, compliance, construction, or similarly
operational businesses.
Experience in a PE-backed, high-growth, or acquisition-oriented environment.
Track record of improving reliability, delivery discipline, and scale in a small or mid-sized organization.
Experience leading internal staff as well as external vendors, contractors, or managed service partners.
Why This Role Matters
This role is designed for a growing business that is building a stronger technology foundation to
support meaningful expansion over the next several years. The Director of Technology will be a key
operating partner to the VP of Technology and will help transform technology into a scalable business
capability across both infrastructure and applications.
Salary: 150,000-180,000
