items: Background in the insurance, InsurTech, SaaS, financial services, or other complex regulated environments.

Previous involvement in AI adoption, AI enablement, or AI transformation initiatives within a software, data, or product organization.

jobs.title: Head of Product – POS & Commerce
jobs.text:
Head of Product – Point of Sale (POS)
Company: Epos Now
Location: UK
Department: Product
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
About Epos Now
Epos Now is a fast-growing, global technology business transforming how over 100,000 merchants operate, take payments and grow.
Operating across 10 international markets, including the UK, US and Australia, we provide an integrated commerce platform that helps businesses manage everything from payments and inventory to customer engagement and financial services.
We're entering an exciting phase of growth, investing heavily in our core POS platform, embedded financial services and AI-powered products to help merchants run smarter, more successful businesses.
The Opportunity
We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Head of Product – Point of Sale (POS) to take ownership of our core POS platform across Hospitality, Retail and Service.
This is one of the most influential product leadership opportunities within Epos Now. Our POS platform sits at the heart of everything we do, providing the foundation for integrated payments, financial services and our next generation of AI-powered capabilities.
This isn't simply about maintaining an established product. It's about shaping the future of commerce technology, driving innovation and creating new opportunities for growth.
The Role
As Head of Product, you'll own the vision, strategy and execution of our core POS product portfolio, leading product teams and working closely with engineering, design and commercial leadership.
You'll play a central role in evolving our platform, strengthening our competitive position and ensuring we continue to deliver exceptional products to merchants around the world.
Key Responsibilities
Define and deliver the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Hospitality, Retail and Service.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers.
Drive product innovation across POS, integrated payments, embedded finance and AI.
Own commercial product outcomes, including merchant adoption, retention and revenue growth.
Identify opportunities to improve the merchant experience and introduce new product capabilities.
Work closely with engineering, design, sales and marketing to deliver successful product launches.
Use customer insights, market intelligence and product data to inform strategic decisions.
Partner with senior leadership to shape Epos Now's wider product and commercial strategy.
Balance innovation and new product development with the continued evolution of an established international platform.
About You
We're looking for an experienced product leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on, commercially driven approach.
Essential Experience
Significant experience in product management, including leadership of Product Managers.
Background in Point of Sale (POS), commerce technology, payments, retail technology, hospitality technology or vertical SaaS.
Proven experience owning and delivering product strategies and roadmaps.
Strong commercial understanding, with experience influencing revenue, adoption or retention.
Experience building, improving and scaling software products.
Ability to work effectively with engineering, design and commercial teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with senior executives.
A data-driven approach to product development and decision-making.
Desirable Experience
Experience with integrated payments or embedded financial services.
Exposure to AI-powered product development.
Experience working across multiple international markets.
Background in a high-growth technology or SaaS business.
Experience delivering products for SME or merchant customers.
Why Join Epos Now?
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a business-critical product at the heart of an ambitious international technology company.
Scale and impact: Shape technology used by over 100,000 merchants internationally.
Real ownership: Lead the strategy and direction of our core POS product portfolio.
Innovation: Help bring AI, payments and embedded financial services into the next generation of commerce technology.
Leadership influence: Work closely with our senior leadership team and influence strategic decisions.
Growth opportunity: Join a business investing in its technology, products and international expansion.
Build for the future: Play a defining role in how Epos Now evolves from a POS provider into an intelligent, connected commerce platform.
Interested?
If you're an ambitious product leader with experience in POS, payments or commerce technology and want to make a genuine commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help shape the future of commerce at Epos Now.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.text:
Vice President, Technology
GREENBOX CAPITAL | REMOTE, UNITED STATES
Why This Role Matters
Technology is central to how Greenbox Capital operates, serves customers, and scales its business.
As Vice President of Technology, you will lead the evolution of our technology organization, modernize our platforms, and build the engineering capabilities needed to support continued growth.
Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own technology strategy, architectural direction, engineering performance, and the execution of initiatives that create measurable business value.
This is an opportunity for a technology executive who combines strategic thinking with genuine technical depth. You will be expected to understand complex systems, challenge architectural decisions, develop strong technical leaders, and translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions.
You will also help shape how we apply AI across our business and engineering organization, identifying opportunities where emerging technologies can improve productivity, decision-making, and operating performance.
Success requires more than setting a technology vision. You must be able to evaluate what is working, recognize what needs to change, make difficult decisions, and lead the organization through execution.
What Success Looks Like
Establish a clear technology strategy and roadmap aligned with business priorities, growth, and long-term scalability.
Modernize and strengthen our cloud, application, and data architecture to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.
Build a high-performing engineering and data organization with strong technical leadership, clear accountability, and consistent delivery.
Improve engineering effectiveness, development practices, and delivery predictability while maintaining high standards for quality and security.
Identify and implement practical AI capabilities that improve business processes, engineering productivity, and measurable operating outcomes.
Strengthen technology governance, security, system resilience, and operational continuity.
Build effective partnerships across Product, Operations, Risk, Data, and executive leadership.
Connect technology investments and architectural decisions to clear business cases, measurable outcomes, and long-term value.
What You'll Do
Define Technology Strategy and Drive Execution
Partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team to establish technology priorities aligned with business objectives.
Develop and execute a technology roadmap that balances modernization, innovation, scalability, security, and operational needs.
Evaluate technology investments, organizational capabilities, and competing priorities to determine where resources will create the greatest impact.
Translate complex business challenges into clear technical strategies, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Establish performance measures that improve visibility into engineering productivity, delivery quality, reliability, and business impact.
Provide independent, evidence-based recommendations and constructively challenge assumptions when better alternatives exist.
Lead Architecture, Modernization, and Scale
Provide technical and architectural leadership across cloud infrastructure, applications, data platforms, and enterprise integrations.
Evaluate existing architecture, identify technical limitations and risks, and establish a practical modernization strategy.
Lead architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, security, performance, cost, and delivery speed.
Work closely with engineering leaders and architects to evaluate design alternatives, challenge assumptions, and establish appropriate technical direction.
Guide the evolution of production cloud environments and modern data platforms supporting critical business applications, analytics, and operational workflows.
Ensure systems are designed for maintainability, observability, resilience, and sustainable growth.
Balance immediate business needs with long-term architectural health and technical sustainability.
Build and Lead High-Performing Technology Teams
Lead, develop, and strengthen engineering, data, and technical leadership capabilities across a geographically distributed organization.
Evaluate organizational structure, technical capabilities, leadership effectiveness, and talent needs.
Establish clear expectations for quality, productivity, delivery, collaboration, and accountability.
Develop technical leaders who can operate independently, make sound decisions, and build high-performing teams.
Address performance challenges directly and make timely organizational and talent decisions.
Improve engineering processes, execution discipline, prioritization, and resource allocation.
Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, technical excellence, and measurable results.
Advance Practical AI and Engineering Innovation
Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business workflows, customer experiences, operating efficiency, and decision-making.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to evaluate use cases, implementation requirements, risks, and expected returns.
Guide the integration of AI-enabled capabilities into production applications and operational processes where appropriate.
Improve engineering effectiveness through responsible use of AI-assisted development, testing, and related tools.
Establish appropriate standards for security, reliability, quality, governance, and human oversight.
Measure whether AI initiatives deliver meaningful improvements rather than simply introducing new technology.
Strengthen Security, Reliability, and Technology Operations
Establish expectations for secure, resilient, and well-governed technology operations.
Ensure appropriate controls exist for data protection, system availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Partner with internal stakeholders and technical specialists to identify and address security, compliance, and operational risks.
Improve visibility into system performance, incidents, technical debt, and emerging infrastructure needs.
Balance risk management with business agility and execution speed.
You're a Strong Fit If:
You are a technology executive who can move comfortably between business strategy, architectural decisions, and engineering execution.
You have the technical depth to independently evaluate complex systems, challenge recommendations, and make informed architectural tradeoffs.
You have led meaningful technology modernization or platform transformation initiatives and can demonstrate their business impact.
You understand what it takes to operate reliable, secure, scalable cloud and data platforms in production.
You have built, developed, and held engineering and technical leadership teams accountable for performance.
You can distinguish symptoms from root causes, evaluate competing options, and make sound decisions without perfect information.
You are comfortable challenging executive stakeholders and taking ownership of difficult decisions.
You know how to balance technical excellence with commercial realities, resource constraints, and delivery expectations.
You see AI as a practical capability for solving business and engineering problems, not simply a technology trend.
You thrive in environments where priorities evolve, expectations are high, and leaders are expected to take ownership of outcomes.
What You've Done Before
15+ years of progressive experience in technology, engineering, architecture, or related leadership roles, including substantial responsibility for technology strategy and organizational performance.
Demonstrated experience leading engineering and data teams responsible for business-critical applications, platforms, and products.
Direct leadership of production cloud environments, modern data platforms, and complex application architectures.
Experience evaluating architectural designs, directing technical decisions, and managing tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, security, cost, and performance.
Successful delivery of technology modernization, platform transformation, or significant architectural improvements.
Experience building and leading high-performing technical organizations, including developing leaders, evaluating talent, and addressing organizational performance.
Demonstrated ability to connect technology investments to business outcomes such as revenue growth, operating efficiency, customer experience, risk reduction, or scalability.
Experience establishing technology roadmaps, delivery standards, engineering KPIs, and operational accountability.
Experience implementing AI-enabled solutions, automation, or emerging technologies that produce measurable improvements.
Experience partnering with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business priorities into technology decisions.
A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree is preferred.
Helpful Experience and Expertise
The right candidate does not need to have worked in our exact technology environment or industry. We value demonstrated technical judgment, transferable experience, and the ability to lead complex technology organizations.
Relevant experience may include:
Microsoft Azure and Databricks, or comparable production experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake, or other modern cloud and data platforms.
Cloud-native application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
Data engineering, analytics platforms, data pipelines, and data governance.
Modernizing legacy applications, infrastructure, or enterprise technology platforms.
AI-enabled business applications, machine learning, and engineering productivity tools.
Engineering effectiveness, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, and platform reliability.
Security, compliance, disaster recovery, and technology risk management.
Salesforce or other enterprise CRM platforms.
Building and leading geographically distributed engineering and data teams.
Financial technology, commercial lending, payments, financial services, or other environments where data accuracy, security, reliability, and operational continuity are critical.
The Opportunity
This role offers the opportunity to shape the next phase of technology at Greenbox Capital.
You will have direct access to executive leadership, meaningful influence over technology strategy and investment decisions, and responsibility for building an organization capable of delivering at a higher level.
We are looking for someone who brings both conviction and curiosity. Someone who can challenge the status quo, develop talented teams, make thoughtful technical decisions, and deliver results that matter to the business.
Position Details
Title: Vice President, Technology
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Location: Remote, United States
Travel: Approximately 10%

jobs.title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
Reports To:Chief Technology Officer
Location: Remote – US
Job Type: Full-Time, Regular Position
Company Overview:
Asymchem, Inc., is part of Asymchem Laboratories Co. Ltd., founded in 1995 as a global integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing drug R&D and manufacturing for leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates R&D and manufacturing facilities in China, the U.S., and the U.K., offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P.R. China, is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ/6821.HK).
Asymchem Company Information and Social Media
Job Overview:
The Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation advance Asymchem’s chemical engineering capabilities to support the next generation of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Building on Asymchem’s existing technical strengths, this leader will work with teams across the organization to advance process engineering, expand continuous manufacturing, and accelerate progress toward more automated, data-driven operations. The role will extend successful technologies and practices across client programs and global sites. Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer and existing technical and operational leaders, this VP will shape technology priorities, develop talent, and guide investments that connect scientific innovation with manufacturing execution. The opportunity is to influence Asymchem’s technology direction while delivering measurable progress in engineering capability and manufacturing performance.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Partner with technical and operational leaders to continuously improve engineering capabilities, technical practices, and cross-site collaboration. Translate shared priorities into a roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
Support the development of engineering talent across the US, Europe, and China. Mentor technical leaders, share effective methods, and contribute to recruitment aligned with evolving business needs.
Strengthen process understanding, measurement, modeling, and control to enable reliable automation. Connect laboratory development with manufacturing requirements from the outset.
Partner with manufacturing, automation, and digital teams to develop and validate approaches that integrate PAT, process models, and data-driven decisions. Apply AI where it offers demonstrable process value.
Prioritize opportunities for automated and continuous processing, demonstrate their value, and lead the engineering work required for adoption in manufacturing.
Advance capabilities in reaction engineering, continuous processing, crystallization, solid-form and particle engineering, and separation and isolation. Select technologies against process needs, safety, robustness, and economics.
Translate successful approaches into platforms that can be reused across client programs. Extend relevant capabilities from small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, and emerging modalities.
Guide critical engineering decisions through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercialization. Work with process chemistry, analytical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex process challenges.
Engage clients on technical strategy and due diligence. Translate engineering capabilities into credible development and manufacturing solutions that strengthen client confidence and business opportunities.
Partner with the CTO and functional leaders to identify opportunities for technology advancement, shape long-term priorities, and guide investment in people, equipment, and external partnerships.
Evaluate emerging technologies with scientific rigor and implementation discipline. Build academic and industry collaborations, develop future technical leaders, and represent Asymchem in senior technical discussions.
Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):
PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Substantial pharmaceutical development, engineering, or manufacturing experience, typically 15+ years, with increasing leadership responsibility. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CDMO backgrounds are welcome.
Demonstrated success advancing engineering capabilities or technology platforms, developing talent, and translating technical progress into sustained operational results.
Strong chemical engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more relevant process technologies, and the breadth to lead specialists. A record of successful scale-up, technology transfer, or commercial implementation is essential.
A collaborative leader who develops talent, earns trust across functions, and advances technical priorities through shared ownership and disciplined implementation.
Credibility with clients, technical experts, and executives; sound process safety and quality judgment; and the ability to lead across functions, cultures, and locations.
Bilingual English and Mandarin a plus, but not required.
Experience implementing process automation, advanced controls, or continuous manufacturing is desirable.
Experience with peptides or oligonucleotides and external technology partnerships are desirable.
Domestic and International Travel as required. Approximately 40%
Benefits:
Day 1 Coverage for Medical, Vision (Co. Paid), and Dental Insurance
Paid Life Insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) & Long-Term Disability (LTD)
Paid Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, and Maternity Leave
Matching 401K

Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates R&D and manufacturing facilities in China, the U.S., and the U.K., offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P.R. China, is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ/6821.HK).
Asymchem Company Information and Social Media
Job Overview:

The Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation advance Asymchem’s chemical engineering capabilities to support the next generation of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Building on Asymchem’s existing technical strengths, this leader will work with teams across the organization to advance process engineering, expand continuous manufacturing, and accelerate progress toward more automated, data-driven operations. The role will extend successful technologies and practices across client programs and global sites. Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer and existing technical and operational leaders, this VP will shape technology priorities, develop talent, and guide investments that connect scientific innovation with manufacturing execution. The opportunity is to influence Asymchem’s technology direction while delivering measurable progress in engineering capability and manufacturing performance.
Duties & Responsibilities:

items: Partner with technical and operational leaders to continuously improve engineering capabilities, technical practices, and cross-site collaboration. Translate shared priorities into a roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
Support the development of engineering talent across the US, Europe, and China. Mentor technical leaders, share effective methods, and contribute to recruitment aligned with evolving business needs.
Strengthen process understanding, measurement, modeling, and control to enable reliable automation. Connect laboratory development with manufacturing requirements from the outset.

Partner with manufacturing, automation, and digital teams to develop and validate approaches that integrate PAT, process models, and data-driven decisions. Apply AI where it offers demonstrable process value.
Prioritize opportunities for automated and continuous processing, demonstrate their value, and lead the engineering work required for adoption in manufacturing.

Advance capabilities in reaction engineering, continuous processing, crystallization, solid-form and particle engineering, and separation and isolation. Select technologies against process needs, safety, robustness, and economics.
Translate successful approaches into platforms that can be reused across client programs. Extend relevant capabilities from small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, and emerging modalities.

Guide critical engineering decisions through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercialization. Work with process chemistry, analytical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex process challenges.

Engage clients on technical strategy and due diligence. Translate engineering capabilities into credible development and manufacturing solutions that strengthen client confidence and business opportunities.
Partner with the CTO and functional leaders to identify opportunities for technology advancement, shape long-term priorities, and guide investment in people, equipment, and external partnerships.

Evaluate emerging technologies with scientific rigor and implementation discipline. Build academic and industry collaborations, develop future technical leaders, and represent Asymchem in senior technical discussions.

blocks.text: Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):

items: PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

Substantial pharmaceutical development, engineering, or manufacturing experience, typically 15+ years, with increasing leadership responsibility. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CDMO backgrounds are welcome.
Demonstrated success advancing engineering capabilities or technology platforms, developing talent, and translating technical progress into sustained operational results.

Strong chemical engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more relevant process technologies, and the breadth to lead specialists. A record of successful scale-up, technology transfer, or commercial implementation is essential.
A collaborative leader who develops talent, earns trust across functions, and advances technical priorities through shared ownership and disciplined implementation.
Credibility with clients, technical experts, and executives; sound process safety and quality judgment; and the ability to lead across functions, cultures, and locations.
Bilingual English and Mandarin a plus, but not required.
Experience implementing process automation, advanced controls, or continuous manufacturing is desirable.
Experience with peptides or oligonucleotides and external technology partnerships are desirable.
Domestic and International Travel as required. Approximately 40%

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
About the Job:
LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on.
We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design.
The CPO sets the company’s product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work.
Responsibilities:
Lead cross-functional product leadership. Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market.
Build and lead the product management organization. Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about.
Own the product operating system. Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product-to-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped.
Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar. Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do.
Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down. Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support.
Drive finishing. A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team.
Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes. Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals.
Stay close to customers and the field. Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale.
Use AI to increase product and engineering leverage. Help the organization adopt AI-assisted development and product practices in ways that increase delivery speed while maintaining quality and judgment.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:
The organization is complete. The leadership model is in place, product lines have the right pillar leadership, spans and layers are intentional, decision rights are clear, succession risks are understood, and the organization can continue to scale.
Delivery increases every quarter. Shipped output per team rises quarter over quarter as AI-assisted development compounds, with quality holding.
The operating system runs without the CPO driving it. Reviews, check-ins, launch briefs, and NPI happen on cadence and at a consistent bar.
The portfolio is staffed. Every initiative in flight has an explicit staffing decision and plan behind it.
The numbers move. Activation, attach, activity, and expansion targets for each pillar respond to the organization’s inputs.
The team is stronger than you found it. Product managers have more leverage, complementary strengths are valued over a uniform mold, and every hire raises the bar.
About You:
You are direct, decisive, and high-agency. You identify a problem, propose a fix, and act unless someone tells you not to.
You are a relentless simplifier, not a caretaker. When you find friction, your instinct is to remove process rather than add it. You know how to run a company of this size like a small company that ships.
You are a builder of people and move quickly on people problems. Product leaders who have worked for you say you made them better and would work for you again. You raise the bar clearly, promote based on evidence, and do not allow known performance problems to persist.
You are comfortable challenging a strategy and turning it into a sequenced portfolio. You can tell the story of an idea you pushed back on, how you used evidence to make the call, and how you maintained the relationship.
You write clearly and make decisions. You use written argument to create alignment, expect strong writing from your team, and end meetings with a decision.
You are customer-oriented and commercially grounded. You can move from a conversation with a developer or data scientist to a discussion with an executive buyer or sales leader without losing the thread.
Qualifications:
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in Product Management, including 7+ years leading Product Managers and product leaders across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading Product Management at the VP, SVP, or equivalent level across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading a product management organization of 20 or more product managers at a company with approximately $100M to $500M in revenue.
A track record of building and developing a product organization, rather than simply inheriting one.
Demonstrated ability to turn company strategy into a reliable operating system that delivers roadmap commitments and measurable business outcomes.
Experience working with a founder or visionary executive and converting a high volume of ideas into a sequenced, resourced portfolio.
Experience building products for engineering organizations and selling to CTOs, platform leaders, and data science teams.
Strong commercial fluency, including experience owning or materially influencing pricing, packaging, attach, expansion, and go-to-market execution.
Experience balancing enterprise and self-serve motions, including an understanding of what drives a large enterprise expansion and what creates value for a developer on a free plan.
Practical experience using AI agents in your own work and applying AI-native approaches to product management or software development. You should have clear opinions about how AI changes product management, supported by things you have shipped.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and improve delivery speed without compromising product quality.
Pay:
Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level E1:
Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $424,000 - $583,000**
Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $381,600 - $524,700*
Zone 3: All other US locations - $360,400 - $495,550*
All Zones Inclusive of 25% Bonus Target
LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.
*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.
About LaunchDarkly:
Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.
The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:
Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability
At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at .
Do you need a disability accommodation?
Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.
Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to .

jobs.title: Director, Geospatial & Data Analytics
jobs.text:
Scout Clean Energy is seeking a Director of Geospatial & Data Analytics to lead the company's geospatial and analytics capabilities in support of renewable energy development. This role will set strategy, establish standards, and build scalable capabilities that improve project decisions and advance Scout’s long term business objectives.
The Director will provide strategic leadership for the geospatial and analytical capabilities that support site selection, project development, engineering, and construction across Scout's renewable energy portfolio. This position will lead the expansion of the organization's capabilities through enterprise data systems workflow automation, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and support continued organizational growth.
The Director will partner closely with leaders across Development, Engineering, Resource Assessment, Environmental, Real Estate, Interconnection, Preconstruction, and Information Technology to identify opportunities where geospatial intelligence, data systems, automation, and analytics can improve project outcomes, enhance information accessibility, and create competitive advantages. This position will report to Scout’s Vice President of Technical Services and may be assigned other duties to support Scout’s growth as technical experts in renewable energy.
Primary Responsibilities
Renewable Energy Development
Provide strategic leadership for geospatial and analytical support of Scout's wind, solar and storage development activities.
Guide site selection, prospecting, and development risk assessment processes.
Support major investment decisions, acquisitions, due diligence efforts, and portfolio evaluations through data-driven analysis and decision-support tools.
Geospatial Intelligence & Business Enablement
Lead Scout's enterprise GIS, geospatial analytics, and spatial decision-support capabilities, advancing the vision, roadmap, and standards for geospatial intelligence across the organization.
Ensure geospatial insights effectively support prospecting, project development, engineering, and construction.
Oversee enterprise GIS architecture, geospatial data governance, applications, and analytical frameworks that support the full project lifecycle.
Drive innovation in geospatial technologies and analytical capabilities that create competitive advantages and improve project outcomes.
Data Systems & Information Management
Lead the development and governance of enterprise data systems, information management solutions, and digital platforms that improve the quality of business-critical information.
Oversee systems supporting geospatial data, engineering information, technical deliverables, project records, analytics, and organizational knowledge management.
Ensure effective integration and interoperability between GIS, engineering, project management, document management, and business intelligence platforms.
Establish data governance, architecture, and reporting standards that support long-term organizational growth and decision-making.
Automation, AI & Digital Transformation
Develop and execute strategies for automation, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation across development, engineering, preconstruction, and operational functions.
Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity through workflow automation and AI-enabled solutions.
Partner with business leaders to redesign workflows and implement technologies that enhance quality, consistency, and productivity.
Establish governance, adoption, and performance measurement frameworks for emerging technologies and digital initiatives.
Strategy, Organizational Leadership & Growth
Define and execute the Geospatial & Data Analytics strategy, aligning team priorities, investments, and capabilities with Scout's business objectives.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Scale organizational capabilities through process improvement, automation, technology adoption, and strategic resource planning.
Establish performance metrics and communicate the business value and impact of the organization's work.
Resource & Technology Management
Manage budgets, technology investments, software platforms, data subscriptions, consultants, and strategic vendor relationships.
Develop resource and sourcing strategies that balance internal capabilities, external expertise, and technology solutions.
Ensure efficient delivery of services, allocation of resources, and continuous improvement of organizational processes and systems.
Leadership Expectations
As a Director at Scout Clean Energy, this role is expected to:
Establish vision and strategic direction for a critical business function.
Build organizational capabilities that scale with company growth.
Influence decisions across departments and leadership levels.
Drive operational excellence by aligning people, processes, systems, and technology to deliver reliable, scalable services across the organization.
Develop future leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Maintain and advance Scout's position as a leader in renewable energy geospatial intelligence and GIS capabilities.
Translate emerging technologies and industry trends into practical business value.
Deliver measurable organizational outcomes through data-driven decision-making, automation, artificial intelligence, and innovation.
Lead the evolution of the Geospatial & Data Analytics organization into a broader center of excellence that establishes shared standards, scales proven solutions, and advances geospatial intelligence, data systems, analytics, automation, and digital solutions across Scout.
Serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership in defining how geospatial capabilities, data, and technology can accelerate Scout's long-term growth strategy.

jobs.title: Director, Product & Strategy
jobs.text:
Job Title: Director, Product & Strategy
Location: Hybrid (3 days per week) in Toronto / Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada.
Candidates must reside in Toronto or the GTA and be legally authorized to work in Canada.
Travel: Approximately 10-20%
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Hiring Timeline: Immediate
Reporting Line: Head of Tech Delivery
Existing Vacancy: Yes. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
Application Deadline: Open until filled. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Salary Range:
$140,000 - $160,000 CAD base per year, plus 15% bonus eligibility.
About Fulfillment IQ
Fulfillment IQ (FIQ) is a supply chain technology and consulting company helping retailers, brands, and 3PLs solve complex fulfillment and logistics challenges.
Our work spans three core practices: Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery & Transformation, and Implementation. We help customers assess and design supply-chain strategies, select and implement technology, modernize fulfillment operations, and build technology solutions that solve complex operational challenges.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Director, Product & Strategy to lead our Tech Delivery practice across both sides of the house: the internal teams that build, and the client relationships that fund and shape the work. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable in a client boardroom shaping strategy and in a delivery stand-up unblocking a team.
You will own the arc of a client engagement end to end: understanding the business problem, shaping the solution strategy, and directing the cross-functional team that delivers it, all while continuously deepening and expanding the client relationship. You will also help incubate Fulfillment IQ's own internal innovation products, applying the same product discipline to what we build for ourselves.
What You’ll Do
Client & Relationship Leadership
Own the client relationship as the senior point of contact for assigned clients, building trust with stakeholders from operators to executives.
Capture and translate client needs into clearly framed problems and solution strategies, translating business goals into delivery roadmaps.
Grow and expand accounts by identifying new opportunities, shaping proposals and statements of work, and converting successful delivery into expanded scope and long-term partnership.
Manage expectations, scope, risks, and escalations proactively, keeping engagements healthy commercially and operationally.
Delivery & Team Leadership
Lead and mentor cross-functional delivery teams, product managers, business analysts, UX designers, DevOps engineers, developers (front-end, back-end, full-stack), and tech leads.
Direct delivery across engagements, planning, resourcing, quality, timelines, and budgets, and holding teams accountable to outcomes.
Establish delivery standards, ways of working, and reusable practices that raise quality and predictability across the practice.
Attract and develop talent, coaching leads, growing capability, and building a team people want to be part of.
Product & Solution Strategy
Shape solution architectures and product strategies that fit each client's operations, budget, and roadmap.
Incubate Fulfillment IQ's internal innovation products, owning discovery, prioritization, and delivery of what we build for our own IP and platforms.
Translate supply chain and fulfillment technology trends into practical recommendations and differentiated offerings.
Partner closely with sales, partnerships, and leadership to align solutions with market opportunity.
What You'll Bring
8+ years of relevant experience, including leadership of technology delivery, product, or professional-services teams (services, consulting, systems-integration, or product backgrounds all welcome).
Proven ability to manage senior client relationships and grow accounts, turning delivery success into expanded scope and revenue.
Strong command of software delivery: product management, requirements, UX, and engineering across the full stack, plus modern DevOps and agile practices.
Experience shaping solution strategy and translating ambiguous business problems into clear, deliverable roadmaps.
A track record of leading and developing cross-functional teams and setting delivery standards.
Supply chain, fulfillment, logistics, WMS/OMS/TMS, or e-commerce technology experience strongly preferred.
Product ownership instincts: comfortable driving internal innovation products from idea to launch.
Excellent communication and executive presence; able to move fluidly between strategy conversations and hands-on delivery.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience; based in the US or Canada and able to work on a hybrid schedule.
Skills and Competencies
Required Skills
Client & stakeholder management: building and expanding senior relationships and negotiating scope.
Delivery & program management: planning, resourcing, budgeting, risk management, and on-time execution across concurrent engagements.
Solution & product strategy: framing ambiguous business problems and translating them into architectures and roadmaps.
Cross-functional team leadership: directing product, BA, UX, engineering, and DevOps talent.
Software delivery lifecycle fluency: agile/scrum, requirements, UX, and full-stack engineering across front-end, backend, and DevOps.
Commercial acumen: proposals, statements of work, estimation, and account growth.
Executive communication & presentation: clear, credible, and persuasive with technical and business audiences.
Product ownership: prioritization, discovery, and driving products from concept to launch.
Good-to-Have Skills
Supply chain / fulfillment domain: WMS, OMS, TMS, order management, or e-commerce logistics platforms.
Pre-sales & solutioning: shaping deals and demonstrating solutions to prospective clients.
Modern cloud & DevOps tooling: CI/CD, containers, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Product & delivery tooling: Jira, roadmapping, and agile management platforms.
Data & analytics literacy: using metrics to steer delivery and inform product decisions.
Relevant certifications: PMP, SAFe, CSM/CSPO, or equivalent.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience at a technology consultancy, systems integrator, or 3PL/retail technology organization.
Pre-sales / solutioning experience and familiarity with SOW and commercial models.
Hands-on background in one or more delivery disciplines (product, engineering, UX, or DevOps).
Why Fulfillment IQ
You will have the opportunity to help grow our implementation business, develop important client relationships, and contribute to how we approach the market.
Work with experienced implementation leaders who understand the platforms and the operations they support.
Sell services that address practical warehouse challenges and make a visible difference to clients.
Have a voice in account priorities, partner relationships, and the development of the practice.
Work with colleagues who value direct communication, sound judgment, and accountability.
Health and Wellness
Comprehensive extended health and dental coverage for you and your family
Employee wellness programs where applicable
Time Off
Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays
Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards
Retirement and Financial Security
CPP contributions and a group retirement savings plan with employer contributions
Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable
Professional Growth
Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression
Flexible Work
Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs
Additional Perks
Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites
Work Authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:
FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.
Accommodations:
FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com and we will work with you to meet your needs.
Candidate Privacy:
Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available here, and in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy law (PIPEDA). This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.
Equal Opportunity:
Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any ground protected under the Ontario Human Rights Code, including race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, or disability.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.
Role
As Director of Product you own Orcrist’s entire product portfolio - Orcrist’s OIP and Civitas’ Sentinel, and lead the product organisation. You decide what Orcrist builds and in which order: what becomes platform and what stays customer-specific, which customer problem is solved next, and how we measure that it has been solved. Our promise is demonstrable the effectiveness of our software, and making that promise deliverable is the core of this role. You work directly with Engineers, our Government Development-Team and our customers and report to the COO of Orcrist.
What you’ll do
Own product strategy and the portfolio roadmap across all product lines – including the decision about what becomes shared platform and what remains customer-specific engineering.
Build and lead the product organisation: hire and develop Product Managers for the product lines and align them on common standards for discovery, prioritisation and delivery.
Make product effectiveness and customer activity & usage a measurable product goal: define metrics, measurement logic and the subsequent tasks that are triggered by that.
Own discovery with our Government Development team and our customers, and translate their requirements into product decisions rather than collecting feature requests.
Decide prioritisation across competing customer, tender and platform demands, and defend those decisions to customers, the team and the management.
Plan deliverable releases together with Engineering and QA, holding the balance between speed, quality and platform capability.
Assess market, competitive and technology developments in the defence and simulation space and feed them into product strategy.
About you
8+ years of product management experience with complex technical products, preferably in the Analytics or SAAS-space, including several years leading Product Managers or a product organisation.
Proven track record of delivering products from discovery through to customer rollout – with nameable outcomes, not just roadmaps.
Experience with B2B or B2G products in long, formal procurement cycles and with demanding enterprise or public sector customers.
Experience holding platform decisions against customer-specific exceptions – and explaining the commercial consequence of both paths.
Ability to decide with incomplete information, take ownership, and work in an environment without mature processes.
Excellent communication skills in German and English across various hierarchy levels.
Willingness to travel to customers (approx. 10-20%).
Authorization to work in Germany
Nice-to-haves
Experience in defence, GovTech, data fusion; own military or law enforcement background an advantage.
Experience with data analytics platforms.
Experience with on-premise, offline or air-gapped products and their consequences for product decisions.
Experience building a product organisation in a startup or scale-up.
What we offer
Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.
Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Purpose
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead the institutions digital transformation and technology strategy, ensuring robust, secure, and scalable technology infrastructure that supports business objectives, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. The CTO will also assume executive responsibility for Information Security, overseeing the protection of digital assets, data, and systems against cyber threats in alignment with regulatory standards and industry best practices. The CTO will lead the Information Technology Department, which comprises specialized teamsresponsible for the following functional areas:
1. IT Governance, Policy Development, and Project Management
2. Core Business Systems and Application Development
3. IT Operations and Service Delivery Management
4. Infrastructure, Network Administration, and Information Security
Key Outputs
A future-proof, secure IT environment supporting financial operations and customer interactions
Digitally enhanced customer, partner, and employee experiences
Regulatory compliance in all IT and cybersecurity operations (e.g., QCB, AML/CFT, data privacy)
Strategic oversight of the institutions Information Security framework and risk posture
Efficient execution of IT plans, budgets, reports, and resource allocation
Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities
1-Technology Strategy & Planning
Define and execute the Companys technology and digital transformation roadmap
Ensure alignment of IT initiatives with strategic business goals and compliance requirements
Lead enterprise-wide IT budgeting, planning, and performance tracking
Introduce emerging technologies that improve operational efficiency and customer engagement
2. Information Security Leadership

4. IT Operations, Governance & Compliance

Maintain governance over IT service delivery, change management, and regulatory reporting
Ensure audit readiness and oversee compliance with QCB guidelines and data protection laws
5. Vendor & External Partner Management
Lead evaluation, selection, and performance monitoring of IT vendors and service providers

Lead and develop a high-performing IT and cybersecurity team
Promote continuous learning, technical excellence, and innovation
Establish a performance-driven culture that encourages accountability, agility, and secure practices

Demonstrated compliance with cybersecurity and regulatory requirements

jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance - Product & Technology - Digital Business (Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role
Lumen is seeking a strategic, forward-thinking Senior Director of Finance to serve as the CFO and trusted business partner for our Product & Technology organization. This executive-level leader will provide financial leadership across a dynamic portfolio of digital, software, platform, cloud, and technology investments, helping shape decisions that accelerate growth, enhance profitability, and maximize shareholder value.
In this highly visible role, you will partner directly with executive leadership to drive financial strategy, long-range planning, investment prioritization, and business performance. You will lead a high-performing finance organization while influencing critical decisions related to product innovation, technology investments, resource allocation, and long-term growth.
Responsibilities
Serve as the strategic finance leader and key business partner to Product & Technology leadership, translating business priorities into actionable financial strategies.
Lead financial management across a complex portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount planning, capital investments, EBITDA, and free cash flow.
Drive annual planning, long-range planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis to support business growth and investment decisions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Corporate Strategy leaders to align financial plans with business objectives.
Provide executive-level insights and recommendations regarding portfolio prioritization, organizational investments, profitability, and operational performance.
Establish and govern key SaaS and digital business metrics, including recurring revenue, retention, customer economics, and product profitability.
Evaluate strategic investments, product initiatives, acquisitions, and technology programs, ensuring disciplined capital allocation and measurable returns.
Lead, develop, and inspire a world-class Product Finance organization focused on strategic decision support, business partnership, and financial excellence.
Qualifications
Minimum
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or Product Finance.
Experience supporting SaaS, software, cloud, digital platform, or technology-driven businesses.
Demonstrated success leading complex P&Ls and driving business performance in large, matrixed organizations.
Experience partnering with executive leadership teams on strategic planning, investment decisions, and financial performance management.
Deep understanding of SaaS business models, subscription and consumption economics, product development lifecycles, and software investment strategies.
Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing finance teams and future leaders.
Exceptional financial acumen, executive presence, communication, and influencing skills.
Preferred
MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced business or finance credentials.
Experience serving as a Finance Leader, CFO, or senior finance executive within a SaaS, cloud, enterprise software, or high-growth technology environment.
Experience supporting Product, Engineering, or Technology organizations at scale.
Knowledge of software capitalization, cloud infrastructure economics, hosting and delivery models, and digital business performance metrics.
Experience evaluating mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
Background in telecommunications, cloud networking, digital platforms, AI infrastructure, or related technology sectors.
Proven track record influencing outcomes across complex organizations without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to balance growth investments with disciplined financial management and value creation.
Compensation
This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

jobs.title: Technology Operations Director
jobs.text:
ABOUT Resources Legacy Fund (RLF):
Resources Legacy Fund builds the architecture behind lasting environmental progress. From climate resilience to land and water conservation to community well-being, we help visionary ideas take shape—offering the steady support and strategic know-how to turn complex challenges into collective victories.
We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.
Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.
Position Summary:
The Technology Operations Director is responsible for ensuring RLF, FBF, and SAF have the technology, operations, and systems needed to support their missions.
Reporting to the Chief of Staff and Operations and serving as a member of the leadership team, the Technology Operations Director provides strategic leadership over information technology and cybersecurity, with a particular focus on building a vision for and moving large-scale technology and systems projects from concept to completion. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to the organization and its fiscally sponsored projects, bringing an operational and technology lens to organizational decision-making. They balance innovation, flexibility, and speed with security, discipline, and care, helping RLF grow and deliver complex grantmaking and fiscal sponsorship services, support a “remote-first” staff, and achieve programmatic outcomes.
This is a full-time, exempt position that can be performed remotely within the U.S. Travel is required quarterly for meetings, conferences, and staff retreats.
Duties Include:
Technology & Systems Leadership
Serve as the organization's lead on major technology and systems initiatives.
Develop and align long-term technology and operational goals and projects with organizational objectives and strategy; build the roadmaps, timelines, and change-management plans needed to deliver them.
Serve as a cross-functional partner to other directors and fiscally sponsored project staff in selecting and utilizing tech platforms.
Manage technology to support evolving business needs; maintain knowledge of emerging trends and tools to enhance productivity.
Identify new operational system needs, including systems and processes to support connectivity in a remote-first workplace.
Manage information technology contractors and support services.
Oversee CRM/database (Salesforce) design, maintenance, and management, in partnership with the Director of Grants Management and the Director of Development.
Advance the technological fluency of staff.
Cybersecurity and Risk Management
Devise security policies, procedures, hardware, and software solutions to mitigate cybersecurity and other enterprise risks.
Drive data privacy compliance and business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
Advise organizational leadership on technology strategy, operational risk, and resource allocation.
In compliance with RLF policies and procedures, perform technological tasks necessary for the protection of data.
Facilities Oversight
Oversee staff managing the RLF satellite office in Sacramento and approximately five additional leases.
Oversee staff managing co-working locations.
Play a supportive role on staff retreats and other in-person connections.
In collaboration with Human Resources, oversee RLF's health and safety programs.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Provide oversight and management of RLF's technology and operations budget.
Serve as a member of the organizational Leadership Team.
Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure technology and operational solutions serve the varied needs of each team.
Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical/operational teams and non-technical staff and leadership.
Qualifications:
Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.
10+ years leading and managing technology and/or operations teams, with at least 5 years in a director-level or above role; nonprofit or mission-driven sector experience preferred.
Demonstrated ability to move complex technology and systems projects from planning through implementation and adoption (e.g., ERP, CRM/Salesforce, financial systems, infrastructure migrations) at organizations of comparable size (50–200 staff) or larger.
Experience leading the development and implementation of an organization-wide cybersecurity/data protection policy, with direct experience managing security incidents, vendor risk assessments, and compliance with relevant data protection standards.
Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing enterprise software platforms, including grants management systems or other CRMs; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
3+ years experience preferred working with a fiscal sponsor organization or comparable multi-entity structure, with direct exposure to how technology, operations, and facilities needs vary across sponsored projects with distinct programs, funding sources, and compliance requirements.
Experience managing vendor relationships/contracts (IT, real estate, professional services) with demonstrated negotiation outcomes.
Experience directly supervising staff and teams.
Ability to handle sensitive personnel or organizational matters.
Experience presenting to or advising senior leadership/board-level audiences.
Experience operating in a remote-first or hybrid and growth-stage organization.
A commitment to a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel welcomed, valued, and respected.
Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.
Commitment to Nondiscrimination:
We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.
Compensation and Benefits:
The anticipated salary range for the Technology Operations Director is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. The final offer will depend on work location, experience, and job-related qualifications.
We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.
To Apply:
Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.
Recruitment Schedule
October 19th – Recruitment launches
November 2nd – Priority application deadline (applications received after this date may still be considered)
November 9th – Screening Interviews
RLF participates in E-Verify, potential candidates can review the information here and here.

Drive data privacy compliance and business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
Advise organizational leadership on technology strategy, operational risk, and resource allocation.
In compliance with RLF policies and procedures, perform technological tasks necessary for the protection of data.

items: Oversee staff managing the RLF satellite office in Sacramento and approximately five additional leases.
Oversee staff managing co-working locations.
Play a supportive role on staff retreats and other in-person connections.
In collaboration with Human Resources, oversee RLF's health and safety programs.

blocks.text: Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

items: Provide oversight and management of RLF's technology and operations budget.
Serve as a member of the organizational Leadership Team.
Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure technology and operational solutions serve the varied needs of each team.
Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical/operational teams and non-technical staff and leadership.

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

items: 10+ years leading and managing technology and/or operations teams, with at least 5 years in a director-level or above role; nonprofit or mission-driven sector experience preferred.

Demonstrated ability to move complex technology and systems projects from planning through implementation and adoption (e.g., ERP, CRM/Salesforce, financial systems, infrastructure migrations) at organizations of comparable size (50–200 staff) or larger.

Experience leading the development and implementation of an organization-wide cybersecurity/data protection policy, with direct experience managing security incidents, vendor risk assessments, and compliance with relevant data protection standards.
Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing enterprise software platforms, including grants management systems or other CRMs; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.

3+ years experience preferred working with a fiscal sponsor organization or comparable multi-entity structure, with direct exposure to how technology, operations, and facilities needs vary across sponsored projects with distinct programs, funding sources, and compliance requirements.
Experience managing vendor relationships/contracts (IT, real estate, professional services) with demonstrated negotiation outcomes.
Experience directly supervising staff and teams.
Ability to handle sensitive personnel or organizational matters.
Experience presenting to or advising senior leadership/board-level audiences.
Experience operating in a remote-first or hybrid and growth-stage organization.
A commitment to a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel welcomed, valued, and respected.
Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.

blocks.text: Commitment to Nondiscrimination:

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.
Compensation and Benefits:
The anticipated salary range for the Technology Operations Director is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. The final offer will depend on work location, experience, and job-related qualifications.

We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.
To Apply:
Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.
Recruitment Schedule
October 19th – Recruitment launches
November 2nd – Priority application deadline (applications received after this date may still be considered)
November 9th – Screening Interviews
