jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.
We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!
What we’re looking for
We’re seeking a Head of Product to join our Product team and own the full product vision across our growing AI platform, spanning accounts receivable, accounts payable, and analytics.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional ownership and technical depth, and wants to take a hands-on role in shaping product strategy, raising the bar for the PM team, and driving innovation that connects data, AI, and payments into a coherent product experience.
This role is available to candidates eligible to work in New York or Toronto, hybrid.
What you’ll do
Own the product roadmap across AR, AP, and analytics: understanding how these products intersect and where the gaps create friction for customers and engineering.
Manage and grow a team of product managers and product designers, overseeing product design scope across the organisation.
Work closely with PMs to sharpen PRDs and bring technical rigour to requirements, acting as the bridge between product and engineering when needed.
Define and own the future product vision for Alternative Payments, synthesising market signals, customer insight, and company strategy into a coherent roadmap.
Implement AI thoughtfully across the product organization, not just for workflow efficiency, but as a genuine product capability that creates value for partners.
Propose and establish best practices for how the product team operates: discovery, prioritization, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
What you’ll bring
10+ years of product experience, with meaningful time in financial technology (payments, lending, or money movement) or a vertical SaaS company with large payments revenue contribution.
Proven experience managing product managers and designers across a multi-product portfolio.
Technical enough to read a system design doc, challenge an engineering estimate, and help PMs write PRDs that engineering teams trust.
Fluency with AI as a product capability: you can articulate how you’ve implemented AI in a product org, not just team tooling, but as a product surface.
Conceptual depth with AI technology: familiarity with embeddings, RAG, and agent-based architectures at a level that earns engineering credibility.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to write clean strategy docs and run tight leadership reviews.
Nice to have
Experience managing design across an organization (product design + marketing design + sales collateral).
Prior experience transitioning product ownership from a founder — navigating that trust-building and handover process.
Track record of raising the technical floor in a PM team through coaching, process changes, or targeted hiring.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where the roadmap evolves quickly.
What We Offer
Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.
The base salary range for this role is $160K–$250K, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.
Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.
Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.
Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.
Why Choose Alternative Payments?
At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.
Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.
Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.
Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.
Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.
Want to see what we're actually building?
We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.
Our Values
Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.
Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.
Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.
Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.
Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.
Applying to Alternative Payments
We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!
All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

jobs.text:
ABOUT US:
PolicyStreet is a leading InsurTech group, specialising in innovative digital insurance solutions for businesses and consumers in Southeast Asia and Australia. With a network of over 40 providers, we offer a comprehensive range of products, including embedded insurance, customised employee benefits, financial advisory, and digital solutions – making insurance straightforward, for everyone. Through our regional group of companies, we serve more than 5 million customers with over US$ 10 billion in sum insured.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Conducting market research and customer analysis to identify customer needs and preferences.
Collaborating with product development teams to develop new products or enhance existing products based on customer feedback and market trends.
Developing a unique value proposition for the product, including messaging, pricing, and positioning.

Work with the sales teams to train them on the product's features, benefits, and value proposition
Monitoring and analysing product performance to identify areas for improvement and to ensure that the product's value proposition remains relevant and compelling over time.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key insurers and brokers to enhance collaboration and product innovation.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
We are seeking a VP of Product to lead our entire product & engineering organisation. This is one of the most expansive and demanding product leadership roles you will find in the market: the person in this role will own PM, Engineering, Design, Data, and PMM under a single umbrella — a scope typically reserved for C-suite executives at much larger companies.
The organisation you will lead includes 1 Director of Product, 8 PMs, 1 Director of UX & Design, 3 Designers, 1 Director of Data & Analytics, 6 data analysts, 1 data engineer, 1 Lead PMM, 1 VP of Engineering, and 30+ Engineers & QAs across two product tracks- Core Track and AI Clinic Track.
We have already shipped multiple AI initiatives:
AI Scribe that helps clinicians save time on writing progress notes
Chart Review AI that highlights deviations from clinical protocols
Agentic AI Receptionist that owns internal support processes
The role reports directly to the CEO.
We expect the person in this role to bring rare, genuine depth across product strategy, behavioural design, applied AI, data-driven decision making, and people leadership - and to operate effectively at both the executive and hands-on levels simultaneously.
Responsibilities
Define, refine, and execute the long-term AI-first product vision and strategy for MEDvidi
Lead, coach, and manage the full product & engineering organisation across both product tracks
Set and maintain a high bar for product quality and execution speed across all teams
Facilitate quarterly strategy and OKR planning at the executive level
Resolve cross-functional blockers and identify opportunities through direct day-to-day engagement with teams
Continuously improve product & engineering culture and processes
Collaborate with other department heads and the CEO on company-level initiatives
Requirements
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple product teams
Experience leading cross-functional organisations that include design, data, and/or engineering - not just PM
Strong product sense: proven track record of both growing existing products and building new ones from 0 to 1
Hands-on experience building AI-first products, including practical knowledge of RAG systems, Agentic AI, and AI Evals
Ability to build an AI product prototype independently, without involving engineering
Experience with behavioural design - building product experiences that drive user behaviour, not just ship features
Executive-level communication skills: ability to bring clarity to complex, uncertain situations
Experience driving company-level strategy and quarterly OKR planning
Data-driven mindset: ability to diagnose issues with data using a segment → root cause → fix approach
Structured problem solving using issue trees, hypothesis trees, or equivalent frameworks
Culture fit: ownership, focus, radical transparency, evidence-based decisions
Advanced English (C1+) and fluent Russian
What we offer
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.
MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
We are hiring a CTO for one of our UK software businesses: an established company with a long track record and a leading share of its market.
The business has deep customer loyalty and a hard technology problem. It runs a large, mission-critical on-premises estate and is developing a new cloud platform, and it now has the backing to rebuild for the next 20 years. This CTO will lead that rebuild.
This role has two modes. With the established team running the existing products, you lead through managers and team leads; daily production coding is not expected, but you must be able to review architecture and step in to steer major incidents. In the small, elite squad rebuilding the platform, you will be more hands-on.
You will own all technology in the business: product engineering, QA, DevOps and cloud, data, and infrastructure.
ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:
TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.
Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.
Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Run and stabilize the current estate
Lead a production team of 20+ engineers, testers, product and platform staff.
Set priorities, delivery cadence and metrics: velocity, quality, release predictability, cost per product line.
Keep a mission-critical on-premises estate secure, supported and compliant.
Run clear programme governance: every initiative has an owner, plan, budget and honest monthly reporting to the MD.
Own reliability: incident response, postmortems and support escalation, building a team that handles incidents without you.
Build the next-generation platform with a lean, AI-first team
Build a small, senior, AI-native engineering team using AI-assisted development.
Rebuild the core product as a best-in-class cloud platform that aims to be number one in the UK market.
Work hands-on inside the new-platform squad: set the architecture, write and review code if needed, and set the engineering standard.
Make AI development tools part of every engineer's daily work, across both the legacy and new teams.
Lead the move from on premises to cloud
Own the migration strategy for a large installed customer base, including sequencing, integration and data migration.
Keep NHS integrations, accreditations and clinical-safety obligations intact throughout.
Consolidate hosting and infrastructure and reduce the hardware and network footprint our customers carry.
Technical environment
On-premises platform: Mainly C++ , C# and Java; .NET Framework; Microsoft SQL Server; Windows Server; installed at each customer site
Cloud platform: multi-tenant SaaS on Microsoft Azure; C#, ASP.NET Core, React; Kubernetes (AKS); PostgreSQL,
Hardware: company-supplied terminals, handheld scanners and printers; dispensing-robot integrations; NHS HSCN network connectivity; field engineering and workshop
Requirements
8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading teams.
Still hands-on enough to work inside a small, elite squad.
Personally, led a migration of paying customers from on premises to multi-tenant SaaS.
Strong Microsoft stack background: C#/.NET, SQL Server, Azure; able to assess legacy C++ and .NET Framework code.
Using AI development tools in your daily work is expected. You know how to get the most from them for yourself and your team, and can show the impact on delivery
Track record of hard calls: restructuring teams, stopping failing projects, managing R&D to a P&L.
Explains technical trade-offs clearly and rooted in commercial rationale.
Benefits
A rare chance to build a market-leading product with a loyal customer base already in place.
High autonomy within a decentralized operating structure.
Career growth within a rapidly expanding Valsoft ecosystem.
Permanent ownership: Valsoft holds its businesses indefinitely, so you build for the long term, not for an exit.
A peer network of CTOs and engineering leaders across Valsoft's 150+ software companies.
Remote work flexibility.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Product Team Leader, Lung Cancer
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Global Product Team Leader, Lung Cancer
Job Location: Remote (US)
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
Accountable for the asset strategy from proof of concept through global product launch and lifecycle management (LCM), in alignment with disease area and portfolio strategy. Lead the Global Product Team (GPT), a cross-functional team responsible for establishing, driving, and executing a global strategy for a single asset across its entire life cycle — from early clinical development to late-stage pivotal studies, then through commercial launch and market access, and finally into post-marketing commitments, asset growth and patent expiration.
Essential Function of the Job:
Lead the molecule integrated strategy throughout the product lifecycle to maximize value for BeOne Medicines and for the healthcare ecosystem.
Build and lead a high-performing Global Product Team, advocating for appropriate resourcing and ensuring line of sight across all relevant functions to deliver on the program vision and strategy.
Acts at an enterprise level to advocate for the asset in alignment with business priorities.
Ensures cross functional strategic input is embedded in the clinical development plans and regulatory strategy including trial design, endpoints, appropriate comparators, Target Product Profile (TPP) and regulatory pathway, to ensure commercial success and global market access.
Acts as a role model and ambassador for both internal and external stakeholder engagement in strategy development, communicating the science story and differentiation of the molecule.
Collaborates with GPT to development and delivery of the product Target Product Profile (TPP) in collaboration with the GPT (Global Product Team) and key internal stakeholders.
Leads integrated product development and commercialization plans which are aligned with business objectives and are differentiated from competition.
Communicates the development strategy at governance meetings to secure funding and endorsement of the strategy.
Holds self and team accountable for delivery of governance-approved business cases in collaboration with the global commercial franchise leader and functional management for alignment.
Effectively manages, mitigates risk, and then communicates risk and presents potential strategies to mitigate risk to senior leadership.
Works collaboratively with global and regional commercial teams to generate, evaluate, and deliver robust commercial strategies and plans. Defines the range of LCM investment options/business cases and makes recommendations on investment, to maximize the value of the Brand’s portfolio.
Provides leadership support of the multidisciplinary sub-teams whose work ladders up to the GPT and supports the product strategy.
Partners with Global Program Manager assigned to GPT to translate goals and strategy into actionable plans which deliver business value. Execute plans within established guard-rails, proactively managing risks and issues. Drive team effectiveness and alignment with program governance processes.
Responsible for maintaining high team effectiveness through collaboration, influence, coaching and mentoring of cross-functional team members.
Partners with other GPTs in developing disease area or franchise-wide strategies and maximizing synergies with BeOne assets.
Partners with Investor Relations and Corporate Communications to develop and actively manage the external messages for the analyst community in collaboration with clinical development lead.
Collaborates with Business Development and other relevant functions in discussions with external partners to maximize lifecycle opportunities.
Ensures appropriate Governance and Compliance and protects BeOne's Rights, Data, and Intellectual Property
Other Qualifications/Requirements:
Proven ability to demonstrate a flexible leadership style and communication to work effectively in a global, cross-functional matrix organization. Ability to work effectively in diverse cultures,
Demonstrated clinical research expertise in Oncology with a preference for direct expertise in Lung Cancer disease.
Experience in drug development and global commercialization across the product lifecycle.
Business acumen - understands unmet market needs; development of product strategies, provides clear path to win; demonstrated track record in driving innovation through to the global commercialization of assets.
Enterprise thinker with ability to sense the system and problem solve.
Demonstrated record of accomplishment engaging senior leadership, driving business outcomes in multi-disciplinary teams
Demonstrated ability to take decisions that positively impact the business.
Strategic and Decisive Leader - leadership skills that demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and demonstrated competence in thinking strategically, analytically, and innovatively. Able to analyze and provide solutions to complex challenges quickly and creatively. Proven experience as a successful decisive leader in a strategic multifunctional environment.
Experience with global, regulatory submissions and interacting with major health authorities; NDA (New Drug Application) and/or BLA (Biologics License Application) submission experience strongly desired.
Ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels of the organization.
Education/Experience Required:
Advanced degree /10+ years in drug development, product strategy & global commercialization, leading cross-functional teams
Global Competencies
When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.
Fosters Teamwork
Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
Self-Awareness
Acts Inclusively
Demonstrates Initiative
Entrepreneurial Mindset
Continuous Learning
Embraces Change
Results-Oriented
Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
Financial Excellence
Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $312,000.00 - $402,000.00 annually
BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, and any other applicable federal, state or local laws, applicants who require reasonable accommodation in the job application process may contact .

jobs.title: Vice President - Product [Remote-US]
jobs.text:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.
About Us
Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.
Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com
Our Team
Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.
As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.
The Role
We’re looking for a strategic and customer-obsessed product leader to shape the future of insurance through AI-native, data-driven solutions. As the leader of our product portfolio, you’ll define vision, strategy, and operating models that deliver measurable impact for our clients, including State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company. This is a highly influential leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, data, operations, and business strategy. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, modernize how products are built and scaled, and help drive innovation in a highly regulated industry.
Your Day-to-Day
Define and lead the product vision, portfolio strategy, and roadmap across the organization
Partner with executive leaders and clients to align product investments with business priorities and customer outcomes
Drive product lifecycle excellence from discovery and prioritization through launch and continuous improvement
Build and evolve product operating models, governance practices, and portfolio decision frameworks
Use customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to identify opportunities for innovation and growth
Collaborate closely with Technology, Data, Operations, Underwriting, and Actuarial teams to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product organization grounded in accountability, clarity, and collaboration
Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and product performance to senior stakeholders across the business
About You
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Insurance, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
12–15 years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, insurance products, or related leadership roles
Deep insurance industry expertise, ideally within P&C, insurtech, or data-enabled insurance products
Proven success leading product vision, portfolio strategy, prioritization, and cross-functional execution at scale
Strong understanding of modern technology platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and product development tradeoffs
Experience influencing executive stakeholders and connecting product strategy to enterprise business goals
Exceptional communication, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex, matrixed environments
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams while fostering healthy collaboration and accountability
Passion for building customer-centered, AI-native experiences that modernize the insurance industry
Bonus Points
Experience in insurtech, fintech, or another highly regulated, technology-enabled industry
Background leading organizational transformation, modernization, or product operating model evolution
Experience building or scaling direct-to-consumer digital products
Advanced degree or certifications in business, product, technology, strategy, or insurance
Experience launching AI-native products, capabilities, or transformation initiatives
Salary: $550,000 – $650,000*
*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.
Additional Details:
Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.
Work from Home Equipment: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.
Paid Time Off: All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.
Personal and Professional Development: We’re committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.
Location: We are a remote-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.
Hours: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM - 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones.
Quanata, LLC is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
If you are a San Francisco resident, please read the City and County of San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance notice.
This role is employed by Quanata, LLC which is a separate company in the State Farm family of companies.
If you require a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner for assistance.

We’re looking for a strategic and customer-obsessed product leader to shape the future of insurance through AI-native, data-driven solutions. As the leader of our product portfolio, you’ll define vision, strategy, and operating models that deliver measurable impact for our clients, including State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company. This is a highly influential leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, data, operations, and business strategy. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, modernize how products are built and scaled, and help drive innovation in a highly regulated industry.
Your Day-to-Day
Define and lead the product vision, portfolio strategy, and roadmap across the organization
Partner with executive leaders and clients to align product investments with business priorities and customer outcomes
Drive product lifecycle excellence from discovery and prioritization through launch and continuous improvement
Build and evolve product operating models, governance practices, and portfolio decision frameworks
Use customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to identify opportunities for innovation and growth
Collaborate closely with Technology, Data, Operations, Underwriting, and Actuarial teams to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product organization grounded in accountability, clarity, and collaboration
Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and product performance to senior stakeholders across the business
About You
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Insurance, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
12–15 years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, insurance products, or related leadership roles
Deep insurance industry expertise, ideally within P&C, insurtech, or data-enabled insurance products
Proven success leading product vision, portfolio strategy, prioritization, and cross-functional execution at scale
Strong understanding of modern technology platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and product development tradeoffs
Experience influencing executive stakeholders and connecting product strategy to enterprise business goals
Exceptional communication, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex, matrixed environments
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams while fostering healthy collaboration and accountability
Passion for building customer-centered, AI-native experiences that modernize the insurance industry
Bonus Points
Experience in insurtech, fintech, or another highly regulated, technology-enabled industry
Background leading organizational transformation, modernization, or product operating model evolution
Experience building or scaling direct-to-consumer digital products
Advanced degree or certifications in business, product, technology, strategy, or insurance
Experience launching AI-native products, capabilities, or transformation initiatives

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About us
We are Valis - a company building an institutional AI operating layer for mid-market companies: shared company memory, workflow mining and agentic automation.
Why this role exists
We are hiring a CTO-level engineering leader. We need a strong person, able to own a major part of the technology from architecture through production, build their own team, and speak with clients at C-suite level.
What you will do
Platform architecture and engineering
- Own the architecture of the org brain and personal brain: data ingestion, knowledge storage, retrieval, agents, and integrations with Claude and other LLMs.
- Write code yourself where it matters most. This is a hands-on role, not only a management one.
- Design access control so each user sees only data from their own area. You will also own data retention and deletion, GDPR compliance, and multi-tenancy.
- Build MCP servers and connectors to company systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, HRIS, DWH, ERP), and bring them to the point where clients can use them self-service.
Deployments
- Lead complex technical conversations
- Own the technical side of deployments
- Turn what works for one client into a product, so the same custom work is not repeated.
- Be the final technical escalation point for your area.
Infrastructure, data and cost
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Cloudflare), CI/CD, observability and security.
- The data stack: data warehouse (Redshift, MotherDuck/DuckDB), ETL, and large-scale migrations.
- Platform costs: token and inference spend, subscriptions, and vendor negotiations.
Team
- Hire people, develop them, and let them go when needed. Hire people stronger than yourself.
- Build an engineering culture where the team owns outcomes and needs little day-to-day management.
- Use AI agents such as Claude Code as your main working tool, and make them the team's main tool too, not an experiment.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering at VC-backed motorsport startup
jobs.text:
who we are
Track Titan is building the operating system for motorsport – every racer's "personal career mode", from their first casual lap to the pro ranks. Over 300,000 sim racers use our AI coaching to get measurably faster – recording more than 1M km of racing telemetry daily while doing so, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech – and our ambitions stretch far beyond sim racing. We’re a team of pro-level racers who have also been senior employees in startups of all scales that have raised hundreds of millions of dollars. Together as Track Titan, we raised a $5M seed in late 2025, co-led by Partech and Game Changers Ventures, and we're the only company backed by tier-one VCs going deep on racing – which lets us make the big bets that nobody else in this space can. Now we're building the team to execute on those bets.
your mission
To build and lead the engineering org creating the best product in motorsport – one that ships quickly, predictably, and at a quality the whole team is proud of.
As our Head of Engineering, you'll own the people, delivery, and process side of engineering, across product engineering and ML. We're at the point where engineering leadership becomes a craft in its own right, and we're investing in it accordingly. You'll partner closely with the CTPO, who owns product and AI direction, to build the engineering org itself: the standards, the systems, and the culture.
This is a role for someone who is as passionate about speed, quality, team culture and operational excellence as most engineers are about the tech itself. The best teams are demanding and happy: people do their best work when expectations are high, ownership is real, and momentum is visible. We're not looking for someone to keep a machine running. We're looking for someone who is excited to build and fine-tune the machine in the first place.
Why this role, why now
We ship across web, desktop, and mobile, our ML work is moving from research into the product, and our ambitions are growing faster than the team. Our ways of working need to match: delivery that is predictable and visible, process that creates speed, and big ML bets that reach users in iterative steps along the way. We believe the fastest teams do fewer things, better – with high talent density and real ownership.
Up to now, engineering leadership has been shared between our CTPO and technical team leads, on top of everyone’s other responsibilities. This is the first time it becomes someone's full-time job – with real momentum and full backing from leadership.
What you will do
Own and grow the team. Run 1:1s that go beyond status updates, give candid feedback early rather than at review time, and build growth plans people actually follow. Recognise excellence loudly and address underperformance directly and early – and make both feel like the same thing: taking someone's growth seriously.
Own delivery. Own engineering's delivery cadence and commitments, across product engineering and ML. Make commitments clear, output predictable, and progress visible – momentum people can see is momentum they can feel. That includes research-heavy work: big bets broken into staged steps with honest uncertainty, so that user value ships along the way and decisions to double down, pivot or stop come early. When something slips, find the systemic cause and fix it rather than managing around it.
Build the operating system. Own the culture, rituals and processes that make the team fast – planning, retros, definition of done – improving them by shipping changes, not just writing proposals. You know the difference between process that creates speed and process that creates paperwork, and you treat process debt with the same seriousness as tech debt. This should be the part of the job that excites you most – especially at a time when AI is reshaping how engineering orgs are built and operate.
Lead how we build. Own org-wide standards and practices – quality, reliability, infrastructure and cost – and lead how we build as an AI-native engineering org. This is a hands-on management role, especially early on: you'll spend real time in the codebase and work closely with our senior engineers on the technical decisions that matter most.
Raise the bar with every hire. Own engineering's hiring and onboarding. Every person you add should lift the average, not just fill a seat, prioritising talent density over headcount. We expect engineering to grow significantly over the next 12–18 months, organically and potentially through acquisitions, and you'll shape who joins and how quickly they're shipping and feeling at home.
Put the team on the map. How we show up externally – through an engineering blog, conference talks, open source, or something we haven't thought of – is a fairly blank canvas and yours to shape together with the team. A team proud enough to show its work attracts people who raise the bar further.
This is a management role, but we're not adding management for its own sake. If the team isn't faster, prouder, and more ambitious because you're here, the role has failed. And if your instinct when something's broken is more ceremony, this isn't the fit. If it's more clarity, more ownership, more urgency – it is.
What success looks like in your first six months
Delivery is predictable, visible, and measurably faster: commitments are clear and met, and we ship user value in regular increments while also working towards bigger bets with more uncertainty.
Our levelling and performance systems are built for a growing org, and the team trusts them.
You've made your first hires, and each one lifted the average and delivered user impact.
We can absorb new people, teams and codebases – organically or through acquisition – without losing speed.
How we build and run things with AI is something the team is proud of, and that others ask us about.
your profile
What you bring:
Strong track record of managing software engineers, including leading multiple teams or managing managers – and management is the job you are passionate about, not the one you drifted into. The engineers you've managed would sign up to work for you again.
You've both taken over an existing team and built one through hiring, and you know the difference. You can talk concretely about how you earned trust in a team you didn't hire, and how you raised the bar through the people you brought in.
You've made a team measurably faster. You can point to delivery you improved – predictability, scoping, cycle time, the quality of commitments – and explain what you changed and why it worked.
You hold a high, explicit bar – and people rise to it rather than resent it. You'd rather have a hard conversation this week than a harder one next quarter, and you make performance – strong and weak – visible rather than letting it blur. Your former teams would call the experience demanding, and mean it as a compliment.
You've built people-systems, not just used them – engineering ladders, how feedback flows, how work gets planned and reviewed – ideally somewhere they didn't exist yet.
You're technically strong and hands-on. Ideally you've been a strong senior or staff engineer yourself: you can go deep in the stack, pressure-test architecture and delivery risk with senior engineers, and be taken seriously. You don't need to out-code the team, but you can't be a pure process manager.
Startup-scale pragmatism. You're comfortable in a small, early-stage engineering org while designing for one many times its size. No playbook cargo-culting: you understand the principles behind the processes and adapt them to the stage we're at.
Excellent written communicator. As a partially distributed, async-first team, writing is how we work: documentation, expectations, decisions, and feedback all live in writing.
Fluency with AI, both in your own work and in how it reshapes engineering orgs. You have a strong point of view on how AI changes how engineering teams should be structured and operate, ideally with concrete examples from previous teams. We're an AI company and we expect everyone to work like one.
You're obsessed with the product and its users. You use what you build – regularly and critically. For us that means driving: everyone on our team gets in the sim and uses Track Titan the way our racers do. Dogfooding is part of our culture.
Strong plus (if you bring everything above but not all of the below, we'd still love to hear from you):
You've delivered predictably where outcomes are uncertain. You've led ML, data science or research-heavy work into production alongside product engineering. You don't need to be an ML expert, but you know how to run this kind of work.
You've operated at the leadership level. You've owned an engineering budget, reported delivery and risk to execs or a board, and been through technical due diligence or integrated an acquired team.
Motorsport passion. Ideally you're already a sim racer or motorsport fan. If that’s not the case yet, what matters is genuine curiosity and that you go deep fast. If you don’t think you will find this interesting, then this is likely not the role for you.
Based in London. We're fully remote flexible (including some global members), but regular presence at our London HQ is a strong plus for this role.
why us?
Build the engineering org at a defining moment. You won't inherit a heavy legacy structure – you'll create the systems the org runs on for years, with org-level ownership from day one.
Leadership that wants you to win. You'll partner directly with a technically deep CTPO whose focus is product and AI direction – meaning engineering execution is truly yours to own – and you will also be close with the CEO and the commercial team who count on you for honest views on what engineering can deliver and when.
Work worth showing. Exciting technical challenges, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech, and a product that reaches hundreds of thousands of racers across the globe 24/7.
Join a team of fellow motorsport fans and sim racers who have backgrounds in top startups, sports data science, tier-one consulting, and professional motorsport, at the only motorsport startup in the world backed by tier-one VCs
Quarterly learning day and budget
Remote/office flexibility according to what works for you, with a great London HQ
Generous options package as a key early employee
Private pension (for UK employees)
Private health insurance (for UK employees)

Fluency with AI, both in your own work and in how it reshapes engineering orgs. You have a strong point of view on how AI changes how engineering teams should be structured and operate, ideally with concrete examples from previous teams. We're an AI company and we expect everyone to work like one.

You're obsessed with the product and its users. You use what you build – regularly and critically. For us that means driving: everyone on our team gets in the sim and uses Track Titan the way our racers do. Dogfooding is part of our culture.

blocks.text: Strong plus (if you bring everything above but not all of the below, we'd still love to hear from you):

items: You've delivered predictably where outcomes are uncertain. You've led ML, data science or research-heavy work into production alongside product engineering. You don't need to be an ML expert, but you know how to run this kind of work.
You've operated at the leadership level. You've owned an engineering budget, reported delivery and risk to execs or a board, and been through technical due diligence or integrated an acquired team.

Motorsport passion. Ideally you're already a sim racer or motorsport fan. If that’s not the case yet, what matters is genuine curiosity and that you go deep fast. If you don’t think you will find this interesting, then this is likely not the role for you.
Based in London. We're fully remote flexible (including some global members), but regular presence at our London HQ is a strong plus for this role.

blocks.text: why us?

items: Build the engineering org at a defining moment. You won't inherit a heavy legacy structure – you'll create the systems the org runs on for years, with org-level ownership from day one.

Leadership that wants you to win. You'll partner directly with a technically deep CTPO whose focus is product and AI direction – meaning engineering execution is truly yours to own – and you will also be close with the CEO and the commercial team who count on you for honest views on what engineering can deliver and when.
Work worth showing. Exciting technical challenges, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech, and a product that reaches hundreds of thousands of racers across the globe 24/7.

Join a team of fellow motorsport fans and sim racers who have backgrounds in top startups, sports data science, tier-one consulting, and professional motorsport, at the only motorsport startup in the world backed by tier-one VCs
Quarterly learning day and budget
Remote/office flexibility according to what works for you, with a great London HQ
Generous options package as a key early employee

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
Location: Remote, UK
Salary: £125,000 per year
About us
At Arbor, we’re on a mission to transform the way schools work for the better.
We believe in a future of work in schools where being challenged doesn’t mean being burnt out and overworked. Where data guides progress without overwhelming staff. And where everyone working in a school is reminded why they got into education every day.
Our School Management Suite is already making a difference in over 13,000 schools and trusts. Giving time and power back to staff, turning data into clear, actionable insights, and supporting happier working days.
At the heart of our brand is a recognition that the challenges schools face today aren’t just about efficiency, outputs and productivity - but about creating happier working lives for the people who drive education everyday: the staff. We want to make schools more joyful places to work, as well as learn.
About the role
Arbor's product design team works in a centralised capacity at the centre of the business: we set the standards, systems and ways of working for design across a growing portfolio of products, and we embed designers into product teams for focused periods to help them do their most ambitious work. We're bringing together different products - both built in-house and via acquisition - into one coherent suite, and our design language is central to how that comes together for schools.
We're looking for a Head of Product Design to lead this team and be the driving force for design across Arbor. You'll set design strategy and direction, and bring a clear point of view on the role design should play as our R&D organisation evolves as you collaborate with your peers to create our strategy and new ways of working.
You will line-manage the product design team giving them the senior backing and clear direction to focus on building and evolving a design system that can scale across an expanding, increasingly multi-product and multi-company portfolio. In that regard, this is also a role for someone genuinely energised by new ways of working. We are embracing agentic workflows and constructing a model in which anyone can contribute to our product, while the design role evolves into one of stewardship, education, and maintaining high standards of consistency and craft.
Core responsibilities
Set and own design strategy, direction and standards for Arbor, acting as the central voice for design across an expanding portfolio of products and, as we grow through acquisition, newly joining teams.
Be a confident, collaborative advocate for design at leadership level - representing design's perspective in product strategy and roadmap decisions as a core member of the product leadership team.
Line-manage the product design team, setting priorities across the portfolio and helping to grow and mentor the team.
Define the standards, systems and ways of working that all design work follows, and embed designers into product teams for set periods to deliver the most important and innovative work.
Collaborate with the rest of the product leadership team to build long-term product strategy for the suite, and ensure design is integral to that strategy rather than applied after the fact.
Lead the integration of design practice, standards and systems as new products and acquired companies join the portfolio, ensuring a cohesive experience for users across the whole suite.
Champion best practice in usability through user research, testing and feedback analysis, embedding this across the wider product and engineering organisation.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to prioritise and implement UX and UI improvements.
Foster a culture of innovation and close collaboration between product design, product management and engineering.
Stay current on industry trends and best practice in UX/UI design, including being forward-thinking about AI and genuinely curious about what it can do for the design process and for how design, product and engineering work together.

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
Strength in Trust
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
The Challenge
As OneTrust scales its platform and expands globally, our infrastructure must keep pace — growing more automated, more resilient, and more self-service for the engineering teams that depend on it. Today, infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment work is distributed across the R&D organization without a single accountable owner driving strategy, standards, and automation maturity end to end.
We're looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for the infrastructure our products run on — from cloud architecture and CI/CD pipelines to deployment automation and platform reliability. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the technical direction, build a high-performing team of DevOps and infrastructure automation engineers, and give every engineer at OneTrust faster, safer, more reliable ways to ship.
Your Mission
In this role, you will:
Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment automation across R&D, aligning investment with product and platform growth.
Lead, hire, and develop a team of DevOps engineers, infrastructure automation engineers, and deployment engineers, building a strong bench of technical talent across US and India.
Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption and standards (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to make environment provisioning repeatable, auditable, and self-service for product engineering teams.
Own CI/CD pipeline architecture and tooling, reducing deployment friction and time-to-production while improving release reliability and rollback safety.
Set the strategy for multi-cloud/hybrid infrastructure management, container orchestration, and platform scalability to support current and future product growth.
Partner with Security and Compliance to embed security guardrails, access controls, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO) directly into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
Own infrastructure reliability and observability — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call practices — in partnership with Engineering and SRE stakeholders.
Lead cost optimization efforts across cloud spend, right-sizing infrastructure investment against usage and business need.
Act as the primary point of escalation and decision-maker for infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment-related incidents and cross-team dependencies.
Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to represent infrastructure needs in roadmap planning and major technical decisions.
Evaluate and select tooling and vendor partnerships that support the team's automation-first, self-service infrastructure vision.
You Are
A builder who thinks in systems — you see infrastructure as a product that serves internal customers, not just a cost center to keep the lights on.
An automation-first leader who instinctively looks to eliminate manual, repeatable work and replace it with reliable, self-service tooling.
A calm, decisive operator under pressure — comfortable owning incident response and making fast, well-reasoned calls when systems are down.
A people leader who invests in growing engineers' technical depth and career paths, not just managing their day-to-day output.
A pragmatic communicator who can translate deep technical tradeoffs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
Security- and compliance-minded by default, treating guardrails as part of good infrastructure design rather than a separate workstream.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to make and revisit decisions as the organization and its infrastructure needs evolve.
Your Experience Includes
12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or cloud operations, including 4+ years in a people leadership role.
Proven experience building and leading DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.
Deep hands-on background with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
Strong track record architecting and scaling CI/CD pipelines and release automation for enterprise-grade, high-availability software products.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, zero-downtime migrations).
Working knowledge of security, compliance, and regulatory frameworks relevant to SaaS infrastructure (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR).
Experience managing distributed or globally-located engineering teams (US/India or similar) preferred.
Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Security, and Product leadership to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Where we Work
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
Benefits
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
Resources
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram
Your Data
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
Our Commitment to You
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Observability
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the strategy and roadmap for data collection, ingestion, processing and routing, and the integrations framework.
Define and track KPIs focused on product and feature adoption
Partner with Observability, Security, and Search product leaders to provide a shared service everyone can leverage
Make getting data ingestion self-service, with time-to-first-data measured in minutes.
Lead a team of distributed product managers and enable them to deliver measurable outcomes.
Drive roadmap priorities by working with customers, internal teams, and the community
Work with engineers and designers to scope and define compelling features
Enable sales, marketing, and partners with clear messaging and positioning
What You Bring
10+ years in product management, including 4+ years leading PM teams in data infrastructure, observability, or data pipelines.
Deep technical fluency in telemetry ingest: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, log processing, routing, and agent management.
Experience shipping SaaS products with usage-based pricing, and building platform capabilities shared by several product lines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with the Elastic Stack is a plus
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Observability
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the strategy and roadmap for data collection, ingestion, processing and routing, and the integrations framework.
Define and track KPIs focused on product and feature adoption
Partner with Observability, Security, and Search product leaders to provide a shared service everyone can leverage
Make getting data ingestion self-service, with time-to-first-data measured in minutes.
Lead a team of distributed product managers and enable them to deliver measurable outcomes.
Drive roadmap priorities by working with customers, internal teams, and the community
Work with engineers and designers to scope and define compelling features
Enable sales, marketing, and partners with clear messaging and positioning
What You Bring
10+ years in product management, including 4+ years leading PM teams in data infrastructure, observability, or data pipelines.
Deep technical fluency in telemetry ingest: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, log processing, routing, and agent management.
Experience shipping SaaS products with usage-based pricing, and building platform capabilities shared by several product lines.

jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering
jobs.text:
Overview
Gray AES is looking to add a Director, Electrical Engineering-MEP to our office in Atlanta,GA, Birmingham,AL, Charlotte,NC, Cincinnati,OH, Dallas,TX, Lexington, KY, or Remote
Responsibilities
Why Gray AES?
Gray is a family-owned, fully integrated global service provider specializing in engineering, design, construction, digital, equipment manufacturing, and real estate services. Deeply rooted in EAC services, Gray serves both domestic and international customers across our core markets: Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Automotive, Distribution, Mission Critical, and Commercial. At Gray, our purpose is to make a positive difference in people's lives and build a better future.
Gray AES, the design arm of Gray, is a top-ranked firm offering architecture and engineering services across the globe. Made up of multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, and project managers, these collaborative teams work every day to provide unique, customized solutions for our customers.
It’s the spirit of our people – the passion, commitment, and a great team environment – that makes our company a great place to work.
Who we want…
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering technology
Professional Engineering (PE) License required.
15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
Advanced proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, BIM, and other relevant design and modeling software.
Advanced proficiency with electrical design tools (e.g., SKM Power Tools, ETAP, or similar).
Proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Demonstrated success in leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and managing client relationships.
Strong business acumen with experience in budgeting, proposal development, client engagement, and strategic planning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to foster collaboration across departments.
Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Self-directed leader capable of driving initiatives from concept through execution.
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
Qualifications
What we expect… (Essential Functions)
Provide strategic leadership for the electrical engineering discipline, aligning team capabilities with business goals and market demands.
Oversee the technical execution, quality assurance, and delivery of electrical engineering services across all project phases.
Lead and mentor engineering managers, senior engineers, and design staff, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver integrated design solutions, coordinating with architectural, structural, mechanical, and automation teams.
Drive process optimization, including QA/QC standards, technology adoption, and documentation workflows.Support business development efforts, including proposal strategy, client presentations, and relationship management.
Lead resource planning, hiring strategy, and succession planning for the electrical engineering team.
Ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and quality standards across all engineering activities.
Other strategic duties as assigned.
Physical Demands & Work EnvironmentThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Periodic overnight travel to visit jobsites where the ability to traverse undeveloped terrain may be required.
While performing the duties of this position, the team member is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach with hands or arms and talk or hear. They may occasionally be required to climb or balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required include close vision.
Generally, normal office environment where noise level is moderate and temperature/humidity is controlled. Overtime may be required.
Supervisory ResponsibilitiesThis position may supervise the roles of Manager, Electrical Engineering, Principal Engineer, or Senior Engineers.
EEO DisclaimerGray is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes everyone to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
