jobs.title: Director, Real World Data Strategy
jobs.text:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary:
At BMS, the Director, Real-World Data Strategy sits at the intersection of business strategy, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation, serving as a key member of the enterprise Real-World Data (RWD) Strategy team. This is a business-first role powered by data and accelerated by artificial intelligence. The Director is responsible for translating BMS's most pressing business and R&D priorities into sharp, actionable RWD strategies, and for leading the team's adoption and application of AI to reshape how the organization identifies, evaluates, acquires, and deploys real-world data assets to drive evidence generation, competitive differentiation, and patient impact.
This role is expected to be the AI innovation driver on the enterprise RWD Strategy team, someone who brings a high AI IQ, actively identifies where AI unlocks new strategic value, and sets the standard for how AI thinking is embedded in the team's work and in service of BMS customers and partners.
As part of an enterprise-wide team, this Director will serve as a connector between the external RWD and AI landscape and BMS's internal needs, ensuring that every data and technology investment is grounded in clear business value and strategic alignment. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise, AI fluency and curiosity, executive presence, rigorous analytical thinking, and a relentless focus on outcomes for the business.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Leadership & Innovation:
Serve as the team's AI innovation lead, setting direction for how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics are integrated into RWD strategy, data evaluation, market intelligence, and evidence generation.
Proactively identify, evaluate, and champion AI-enabled data opportunities and emerging technologies that enhance RWD exploration, dataset assessment, and strategic decision-making at scale.
Translate the rapidly evolving AI and data science landscape into practical, high-impact applications aligned with BMS R&D priorities and pipeline needs.
Model AI-forward thinking across the team and for customers, building shared literacy, frameworks, and best practices that elevate the team's collective AI capability.
Align novel AI-driven research ideas with available RWD assets to accelerate exploratory use cases, enabling faster, smarter data-driven decisions across the enterprise.
Business-Driven Strategy & Prioritization:
Champion and communicate a forward-looking RWD exploration strategy that is anchored in BMS business priorities, translating R&D needs, pipeline goals, and evidence gaps into targeted data investment and exploration decisions.
Synthesize inputs from RWD users, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to define and evolve strategic priorities, ensuring every data initiative is tied to measurable business value.
Develop and present clear, executive-ready business cases for RWD investments, acquisitions, and licensing decisions, balancing strategic ambition with budget realities and portfolio needs.
Data Landscaping & Opportunity Identification:
Monitor and interpret the global RWD ecosystem, including emerging datasets, vendors, technologies, AI platforms, partnerships, and market trends, through a business lens, connecting evolving research questions and R&D needs with differentiated data sources and novel use cases.
Lead rigorous evaluation and piloting of priority RWD sources, assessing fitness, quality, coverage, differentiation, and applicability, and translating findings into clear investment or adoption recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Establish scalable assessment frameworks, dashboards, and methodologies that enable consistent, repeatable evaluation and prioritization of RWD opportunities across the enterprise portfolio.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration:
Drive high-visibility engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through a hub model of ongoing consultations, ensuring transparent, interactive strategy development processes that build trust and alignment.
Collaborate across Strategy, Acquisition, Data Product, Governance, Customer Success, and R&D stakeholder groups to convert exploration insights into actionable data, investment, partnership, and portfolio decisions.
Serve as a thought leader across the enterprise RWD Strategy team, contributing to shared capabilities, best practices, and strategic frameworks, with particular emphasis on AI integration, that elevate the team's collective impact.
Partner & Vendor Development:
Identify, assess, and engage RWD data providers and external partners to evaluate differentiated partnership opportunities that address emerging or unmet data needs, including AI-powered data and analytics platforms.
Lead assessment of RWD partners for comprehensive data development capabilities, ensuring partnerships create clear, lasting strategic advantage for BMS.
Qualifications:
Education:
Advanced degree in health research, life sciences, data science, quantitative sciences, or a related field. PhD preferred but not required.
Experience:
10+ years of relevant experience in real-world healthcare data, data strategy, market intelligence, life sciences, or consulting, with a demonstrated track record of translating complex business and scientific problems into data-driven strategies and outcomes.
Demonstrated experience applying AI and advanced analytics in an RWD, life sciences, or data strategy context, including familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or AI-enabled data tools.
Proven ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed life sciences organization.
Deep expertise in RWD sources, data evaluation approaches, research and analytic applications, and the evolving external RWD ecosystem.
Significant experience engaging with RWD vendors and data partners, including negotiating and shaping strategic relationships.
Skills & Competencies:
AI fluency and innovation mindset: Ability to identify, evaluate, and operationalize AI-driven opportunities that create tangible value for RWD strategy and enterprise customers. Expected to be a visible AI champion within the team.
Business acumen: Strong ability to frame data and AI opportunities in terms of business value, pipeline impact, and investment return.
Strategic thinking and executive communication: Ability to synthesize complex data, AI, and market intelligence into concise, compelling recommendations that influence senior decision-making.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience building evaluation frameworks and investment cases.
Familiarity with analytic platforms, federated environments, and AI/data science approaches relevant to RWD access and exploration.
Knowledge of RWD compliance requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.), including emerging considerations for AI use in healthcare data contexts.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with comfort operating in a fast-changing, cross-functional enterprise environment.
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
Compensation Overview:
Remote - United States - US: $197,800 - $239,681
The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.
Benefits:
Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).
U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.
Non-exempt employees, RayzeBio employees, and employees located in Puerto Rico receive 160 hours of paid vacation annually for new hires (subject to manager approval), 11 paid company holidays, and 3 optional holidays.
Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

R1607515 : Director, Real World Data Strategy
Originally posted on Himalayas

blocks.text: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary:

At BMS, the Director, Real-World Data Strategy sits at the intersection of business strategy, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation, serving as a key member of the enterprise Real-World Data (RWD) Strategy team. This is a business-first role powered by data and accelerated by artificial intelligence. The Director is responsible for translating BMS's most pressing business and R&D priorities into sharp, actionable RWD strategies, and for leading the team's adoption and application of AI to reshape how the organization identifies, evaluates, acquires, and deploys real-world data assets to drive evidence generation, competitive differentiation, and patient impact.

This role is expected to be the AI innovation driver on the enterprise RWD Strategy team, someone who brings a high AI IQ, actively identifies where AI unlocks new strategic value, and sets the standard for how AI thinking is embedded in the team's work and in service of BMS customers and partners.

As part of an enterprise-wide team, this Director will serve as a connector between the external RWD and AI landscape and BMS's internal needs, ensuring that every data and technology investment is grounded in clear business value and strategic alignment. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise, AI fluency and curiosity, executive presence, rigorous analytical thinking, and a relentless focus on outcomes for the business.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Leadership & Innovation:

items: Serve as the team's AI innovation lead, setting direction for how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics are integrated into RWD strategy, data evaluation, market intelligence, and evidence generation.
Proactively identify, evaluate, and champion AI-enabled data opportunities and emerging technologies that enhance RWD exploration, dataset assessment, and strategic decision-making at scale.
Translate the rapidly evolving AI and data science landscape into practical, high-impact applications aligned with BMS R&D priorities and pipeline needs.
Model AI-forward thinking across the team and for customers, building shared literacy, frameworks, and best practices that elevate the team's collective AI capability.
Align novel AI-driven research ideas with available RWD assets to accelerate exploratory use cases, enabling faster, smarter data-driven decisions across the enterprise.

blocks.text: Business-Driven Strategy & Prioritization:

items: Champion and communicate a forward-looking RWD exploration strategy that is anchored in BMS business priorities, translating R&D needs, pipeline goals, and evidence gaps into targeted data investment and exploration decisions.
Synthesize inputs from RWD users, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to define and evolve strategic priorities, ensuring every data initiative is tied to measurable business value.
Develop and present clear, executive-ready business cases for RWD investments, acquisitions, and licensing decisions, balancing strategic ambition with budget realities and portfolio needs.

blocks.text: Data Landscaping & Opportunity Identification:

items: Monitor and interpret the global RWD ecosystem, including emerging datasets, vendors, technologies, AI platforms, partnerships, and market trends, through a business lens, connecting evolving research questions and R&D needs with differentiated data sources and novel use cases.

Lead rigorous evaluation and piloting of priority RWD sources, assessing fitness, quality, coverage, differentiation, and applicability, and translating findings into clear investment or adoption recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Establish scalable assessment frameworks, dashboards, and methodologies that enable consistent, repeatable evaluation and prioritization of RWD opportunities across the enterprise portfolio.

blocks.text: Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration:

items: Drive high-visibility engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through a hub model of ongoing consultations, ensuring transparent, interactive strategy development processes that build trust and alignment.

Collaborate across Strategy, Acquisition, Data Product, Governance, Customer Success, and R&D stakeholder groups to convert exploration insights into actionable data, investment, partnership, and portfolio decisions.

Serve as a thought leader across the enterprise RWD Strategy team, contributing to shared capabilities, best practices, and strategic frameworks, with particular emphasis on AI integration, that elevate the team's collective impact.

blocks.text: Partner & Vendor Development:

items: Identify, assess, and engage RWD data providers and external partners to evaluate differentiated partnership opportunities that address emerging or unmet data needs, including AI-powered data and analytics platforms.
Lead assessment of RWD partners for comprehensive data development capabilities, ensuring partnerships create clear, lasting strategic advantage for BMS.

blocks.text: Qualifications:
Education:

items: Advanced degree in health research, life sciences, data science, quantitative sciences, or a related field. PhD preferred but not required.

blocks.text: Experience:

items: 10+ years of relevant experience in real-world healthcare data, data strategy, market intelligence, life sciences, or consulting, with a demonstrated track record of translating complex business and scientific problems into data-driven strategies and outcomes.
Demonstrated experience applying AI and advanced analytics in an RWD, life sciences, or data strategy context, including familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or AI-enabled data tools.
Proven ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed life sciences organization.
Deep expertise in RWD sources, data evaluation approaches, research and analytic applications, and the evolving external RWD ecosystem.
Significant experience engaging with RWD vendors and data partners, including negotiating and shaping strategic relationships.

blocks.text: Skills & Competencies:

items: AI fluency and innovation mindset: Ability to identify, evaluate, and operationalize AI-driven opportunities that create tangible value for RWD strategy and enterprise customers. Expected to be a visible AI champion within the team.
Business acumen: Strong ability to frame data and AI opportunities in terms of business value, pipeline impact, and investment return.
Strategic thinking and executive communication: Ability to synthesize complex data, AI, and market intelligence into concise, compelling recommendations that influence senior decision-making.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience building evaluation frameworks and investment cases.
Familiarity with analytic platforms, federated environments, and AI/data science approaches relevant to RWD access and exploration.
Knowledge of RWD compliance requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.), including emerging considerations for AI use in healthcare data contexts.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with comfort operating in a fast-changing, cross-functional enterprise environment.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound (Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role
The Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound translates Lumen’s product strategy into market-ready offerings that scale revenue, improve adoption, and differentiate Lumen in the enterprise and wholesale markets. This leader owns the outbound motion for a portfolio of network, cloud connectivity, and digital platform services, ensuring products are clearly positioned, launch-ready, and operationally executable for Sales, Partners, and Customers.
This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and commercial outcomes. You will work backward from customer and market requirements, shape portfolio direction with Product Management and Engineering, and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Partners.
Effectiveness in this role requires strong product instincts, commercial judgment, and executive presence paired with the ability to operate in a complex, scaled enterprise environment. This role ensures Lumen doesn’t just build great products but wins in the market by bringing clarity, focus, and commercial intensity to how our offerings reach customers and sellers. It is a critical lever in turning strategy into long-term growth.
Location
This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.
The Main Responsibilities
Own the Outbound Product Strategy
Define and lead the outbound product strategy for assigned domains, from positioning through launch and lifecycle optimization.
Translate product capabilities into clear value propositions, differentiated messaging, and market‑ready offers.
Create and maintain product launch frameworks, including target segments, pricing logic, packaging, sales plays, and success metrics.
Drive Go‑to‑Market Execution
Lead multifunctional launch teams to bring new products and features to market quickly, with quality and discipline.
Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Marketing to ensure readiness across training, tools, content, and field execution.
Develop and sustain strategic sales motions, including executive selling scenarios, competitive strategy, and customer proof points.
Shape the Product Roadmap from the Market Back
Represent market, customer, and revenue insights concerning Product Management and Engineering planning cycles.
Size customer and market opportunities and develop business cases that target roadmap investments based on growth, profitability, and strategic fit.
Manage short‑term revenue opportunities with long‑term platform and portfolio evolution.
Operate as a Cross‑Functional Leader
Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Partners to ensure offers are technically sound, operationally viable, and financially solid.
Build alignment at the executive level by communicating tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Anticipate and resolve issues that could impair launch success, customer experience, or commercial performance.
Measure, Learn, and Optimize
Define success metrics for launches and ongoing performance such as adoption, attach, churn, margin, and revenue.
Use market data, customer feedback, and performance analytics to improve positioning, packaging, and sales execution.
Continuously improve how Lumen brings products to market—simplifying where possible, innovating where needed.
Leadership Scope
Senior leadership role with significant influence across Product, GTM, and Sales.
High visibility with executive stakeholders.
Expected to mentor and develop product leaders and outbound talent.
What We Look For in a Candidate
10+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or go‑to‑market leadership roles.
Demonstrated success launching and scaling complex technology products in B2B or enterprise environments.
Strong experience working with Sales organizations on commercialization, enablement, and revenue acceleration.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders through data, judgment, and clear storytelling.
Strategic thinker who can also execute with immediacy and carefulness.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills—equally effective with operators, sellers, and executives.
Highly analytical, with the ability to turn insight into action.
Comfortable operating amid ambiguity while driving clarity for others.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with network services, cloud connectivity, digital platforms, or infrastructure‑enabled services.
Familiarity with enterprise buying motions, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, and partner ecosystems.
Experience developing pricing, packaging, and offer constructs at scale.
Compensation
This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As the Director of Dedicated Infrastructure Engineering & Platforms, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for GitLab Dedicated, GitLab's premium single-tenant SaaS offering for enterprise customers in regulated industries, and public sector.
You will lead a high-performing organization of managers and engineers who own the entire lifecycle of dedicated and cellular platforms, from orchestration, integrations, resilience, and incident response to switchboard APIs, public sector compliance, and enterprise customer migrations. Your mission is to scale GitLab Dedicated from its current trajectory toward an aggressive growth target, ensuring enterprise customers experience full platform capabilities with dedicated infrastructure, compliance certifications, and enterprise-grade SLAs in an isolated environment.
As a high-impact executive leader, you will define the strategy for single-tenant and public sector SaaS platforms, drive critical infrastructure investments, ensure FedRAMP/compliance operational readiness, and build the switchboard and migration capabilities that allow enterprise customers to seamlessly transition to and scale on Dedicated. You will succeed by cultivating a culture of operational excellence, closing key business and roadmap gaps, and leading distributed engineering teams to deliver high-availability, highly secure platform experiences.
What you'll do
Own the strategy and roadmap for GitLab Dedicated, and ensure the platform scales with customer growth and converges with GitLab's cellular architecture.
Partner with Product and executive leadership to deliver on growth targets, with a focus on platform reliability, faster customer onboarding, infrastructure cost efficiency, and self-service administration.
Lead the engineering teams that build and run the platform: tenant orchestration and integrations, resilience and incident response, the Switchboard control plane, public sector platforms and compliance, and enterprise migrations and import tooling. Uphold enterprise-grade SLAs across every tenant.
Deliver GitLab Dedicated for Government: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP operations and audit readiness, air-gapped isolation, and public sector feature delivery.
Make enterprise migrations to Dedicated predictable, repeatable, and low-disruption through self-service tooling and guided workflows.
Hire, coach, and scale engineering managers across distributed teams, and bring practical AI-enabled workflows into how the organization works.
Partner with Product, Security, and Customer Support to keep customer commitments, architecture, and investments aligned.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you'll bring
You have led engineering organizations that run enterprise single or multi tenant SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms at scale.
You have measurably improved production reliability, reduced toil, or lowered infrastructure cost on a platform you owned.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Data & Artificial Intelligence)
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product Management (Data & AI) is responsible for defining, driving, and delivering Fortrea's enterprise Data & AI product strategy, product portfolio, and multi-year product roadmap. This role serves as the senior product leader for Data & AI, accountable for ensuring that enterprise data products, analytics products, AI solutions, and emerging digital capabilities align with Fortrea's strategic objectives and long-term technology vision. The position owns the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product vision, roadmap development, investment prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
The Senior Director, Product Management will lead a team of Product Managers and work closely with Engineering, Data, AI, Enterprise Architecture, Business Stakeholders, Program Management, Security, and Operations teams to ensure products are delivered successfully and produce measurable business outcomes. As a member of the Data & AI leadership team, this role is accountable for translating Fortrea's three-year Data & AI strategy into an executable and measurable product portfolio that delivers enterprise value, operational efficiency, innovation, and competitive advantage.
Summary of Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Develop and maintain the enterprise Data & AI product strategy aligned to Fortrea's business objectives and three-year technology roadmap.
Establish a clear product vision for enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging digital capabilities.
Define and maintain multi-year product roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical investments, innovation opportunities, and organizational capacity.
Partner with executive stakeholders to identify future product opportunities and strategic business needs.
Translate enterprise strategy into actionable product objectives, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Drive product innovation and identify opportunities to maximize the value of enterprise data and AI investments.
Data & AI Product Portfolio Leadership
Own the enterprise Data & AI product portfolio, including product lifecycle management, prioritization, governance, and performance management.
Establish portfolio management processes supporting product intake, evaluation, funding, prioritization, and roadmap planning.
Ensure alignment and integration across data, analytics, AI, reporting, governance, and platform-related products.
Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic product investments.
Define product success metrics and value realization frameworks across the portfolio.
Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and optimize investment decisions based on business outcomes and strategic priorities.
Product Delivery & Execution
Own successful delivery of enterprise data and AI products from concept through deployment and ongoing enhancement.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, and Program Management leaders to ensure successful delivery of product roadmaps.
Drive prioritization of product backlogs and delivery plans to maximize business value.
Remove obstacles impacting product execution and serve as an escalation point for strategic product issues.
Ensure products are delivered within approved scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations.
Oversee adoption, usage, performance, and ongoing evolution of deployed products.
Establish product governance and operating models supporting sustainable delivery and continuous improvement.
Business Partnership & Value Realization
Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Data & AI delivery teams.
Establish strong relationships with functional leaders to understand business objectives, challenges, and opportunities.
Ensure product investments align with measurable business outcomes and enterprise priorities.
Develop business cases supporting product investments and strategic initiatives.
Lead value realization reviews to demonstrate business impact and return on investment.
Drive customer-centric and business-driven product development practices.
People Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, Product Owners, and product leadership professionals.
Establish the product management operating model and organizational structure for the Data & AI organization.
Provide coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development opportunities for team members.
Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational capability development.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Develop product management capabilities and best practices across the broader Data & AI organization.
Financial & Investment Management
Develop and manage Data & AI product investment plans and strategic funding priorities.
Partner with Finance and Technology leadership on annual budget planning and investment governance.
Evaluate product investment opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
Support build-versus-buy decisions and product investment recommendations.
Monitor product portfolio investment performance and value realization.
Ensure effective stewardship of product-related technology investments.
Stakeholder & Executive Leadership
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership regarding Data & AI product strategy, performance, and future investments.
Prepare and deliver executive-level product roadmaps, business reviews, investment recommendations, and performance updates.
Lead product governance forums, roadmap reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
Communicate product strategy and business value across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, Program Management, and Technology leaders to ensure alignment across all product initiatives.
Qualifications (Minimum Required):
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.
Experience (Minimum Required):
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in Product Management, Technology Leadership, Data & Analytics, Digital Products, or related disciplines.
7+ years of experience leading enterprise product portfolios, product organizations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated success developing and delivering multi-year product strategies and roadmaps.
Experience managing enterprise technology, data, analytics, or AI-related products.
Proven people leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, developing, and leading Product Managers.
Experience managing investment portfolios, business cases, budgeting, and strategic planning activities.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Preferred Qualifications Include:
Master's Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline.
Experience leading Data, Analytics, AI, Machine Learning, Digital, or Platform Product organizations.
Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, AI platforms, and enterprise analytics environments.
Experience operating within life sciences, healthcare, CRO, or other regulated industries.
Product Management certifications or Agile Product Management experience preferred.
Physical Demands / Work Environment:
Office/Home-Based:
Work Environment:
Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.
Physical Requirements:
Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
Light to moderate lifting and carrying, or moving of objects, including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
Regular and consistent attendance.
Varied hours may be required.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
StrideUp is leading a new era of values-driven finance. Ranked the 5th fastest growing fintech in the UK and Ireland in 2025, we have already deployed hundreds of millions in property finance, supporting people in achieving their financial goals.
What makes us different is how we combine purpose with performance. We began with home finance, creating an alternative trusted by the Muslim community and welcomed by anyone seeking fairer, more transparent products. This product-market fit has powered our growth, and is only the beginning. Our vision is bigger; to expand our offering and build a financial institution that opens doors for communities often left behind.
Joining StrideUp means being part of a high-performing, values-driven team at the most exciting point in our journey. We have proven success behind us and huge opportunity ahead, and now we are ready to build beyond. Are you?
StrideUp is backed by leading VC and private equity investors, having raised over £40m in corporate funding, and over £600m in institutional funding lines.
The Role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead StrideUp’s engineering function as we enter our next phase of growth. You will be our most senior technology leader, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Executive Committee (ExCo).
This is a technical leadership role. You will lead and coach our engineers, own technical strategy, and stay close to the detail: architecture and design, engineering standards and best practices, tooling choices and code review. Above all, you will treat technology as a tool for solving business problems, keeping the team focused on what moves the business forward.
You will also own IT, cyber and information security, and represent technology to stakeholders including investors and regulators. These responsibilities may be reallocated over time as we scale.
You will champion smarter use of AI and automation to raise quality and speed, rather than simply adding headcount, and work closely with our Product Manager and Product Team.
What You'll Do
Engineering Ownership
Own platform architecture and strategic technical decisions, including build vs buy and technical debt
Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and QA, CI/CD and incident management
Review code and designs, and choose the tools, patterns and best practices the team works to
Team Leadership
Line manage and coach our engineers, with regular 1:1s, clear objectives and a visible path for growth
Set the team structure and operating model, and lead hiring and retention as we scale
Develop future technical leaders, so the function does not depend on one person
Business Alignment & Delivery
Start with the business problem, and work with the CEO and Product Manager to turn commercial objectives into deliverable plans
Own the budget and annual OKRs, and deliver predictably so technology drives growth
Champion AI, automation and agentic tooling where they clearly raise quality and speed
Technology, Security & Risk
Own IT infrastructure, workplace technology, cybersecurity and information security, including vendors
Own technology risk, working with Compliance & Risk to meet regulatory obligations
ExCo Leadership
Sit on ExCo and contribute to company-wide strategy beyond technology
Explain technical decisions in plain language, linked to commercial outcomes
Be the senior voice on technology with senior stakeholders including investors, funders, auditors and regulators, including technical due diligence for fundraising
You Are
An exceptional engineer: you set a high technical bar through architecture, design, tooling choices and code review
A leader and coach who develops engineers and gets the best out of them
Commercially minded: you start with the business problem and treat engineering as the tool to solve it
An ExCo-level operator who can present ideas and explain trade-offs without jargon
Pragmatic and accountable: you make sound decisions under uncertainty, own outcomes and never compromise on security or compliance
Open to challenge and feedback, and comfortable building structure in a scale-up

You will also own IT, cyber and information security, and represent technology to stakeholders including investors and regulators. These responsibilities may be reallocated over time as we scale.
You will champion smarter use of AI and automation to raise quality and speed, rather than simply adding headcount, and work closely with our Product Manager and Product Team.
What You'll Do
Engineering Ownership

items: Own platform architecture and strategic technical decisions, including build vs buy and technical debt
Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and QA, CI/CD and incident management
Review code and designs, and choose the tools, patterns and best practices the team works to

blocks.text: Team Leadership

items: Line manage and coach our engineers, with regular 1:1s, clear objectives and a visible path for growth
Set the team structure and operating model, and lead hiring and retention as we scale
Develop future technical leaders, so the function does not depend on one person

blocks.text: Business Alignment & Delivery

items: Start with the business problem, and work with the CEO and Product Manager to turn commercial objectives into deliverable plans
Own the budget and annual OKRs, and deliver predictably so technology drives growth
Champion AI, automation and agentic tooling where they clearly raise quality and speed

blocks.text: Technology, Security & Risk

items: Own IT infrastructure, workplace technology, cybersecurity and information security, including vendors
Own technology risk, working with Compliance & Risk to meet regulatory obligations

blocks.text: ExCo Leadership

items: Sit on ExCo and contribute to company-wide strategy beyond technology
Explain technical decisions in plain language, linked to commercial outcomes
Be the senior voice on technology with senior stakeholders including investors, funders, auditors and regulators, including technical due diligence for fundraising

A leader and coach who develops engineers and gets the best out of them

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader to guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. This dual mandate combines solution architecture with organizational leadership, bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will assume direct leadership of the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure, with particular emphasis on Snowflake and modern cloud data architecture.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable solution approaches, support pre-sales technical strategy, and help ensure complex opportunities are well-defined and feasible.
This role is ideal for a strong technologist with leadership instincts—someone who can own a technical function, contribute meaningfully to client conversations, and bring structure to how Statara designs and delivers solutions. You don’t need to have done all of this before, but you should be ready to grow into the full scope.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, and data product quality
Drive continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and modern data workflows across the organization
Align engineering and data product priorities with commercial objectives and the broader product roadmap
Solution Architecture & Strategy
Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through high-level design and delivery planning
Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases
Client & Pre-Sales Support
Partner with Business Development to scope opportunities, clarify technical requirements, and assess feasibility
Participate in client conversations as a technical resource, translating capabilities into clear business value
Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to align solution designs with platform capabilities and delivery realities
Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams
What Success Looks Like
The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear direction, strong execution, and alignment to company priorities
Snowflake-based data infrastructure is reliable, well-maintained, and evolving to meet growing demands
Client opportunities are scoped accurately and efficiently, with strong technical grounding
Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
The solutions function becomes more repeatable, effective, and scalable over time
Requirements
We’re looking for demonstrated technical depth and sound judgment—earned through real exposure to complex problems—more than a specific career path or title history.
Snowflake working experience required. You should have hands-on working knowledge of Snowflake. You don’t need to be a certified architect, but you need to be able to contribute to technical decisions confidently in a Snowflake-centric environment.
Experience in solutions engineering, data engineering, analytics, data products, or a related technical role
Familiarity with data integration, pipelines, data modeling, and solution architecture concepts
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics workflows; AWS environment experience is a plus, as is Alteryx
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and executable solution plans
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with complex datasets
Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Team leadership experience required—whether through direct management, tech-lead roles, or running cross-functional workstreams. Formal people-management experience is preferred but not the only path.
Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, or analytics functions is a strong plus
Plus: Background in data onboarding, identity resolution, audience strategy, martech/adtech, or measurement partnerships. Experience in activation, programmatic, or audience deployment.
Benefits
We believe that a diverse, inclusive staff is a fundamental strength. We’re committed to hiring people of all races, ethnicities, religions, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of untapped groups are strongly encouraged to apply and are welcome on our teams.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require an accommodation to apply for or interview for this position, please let us know (email Gideon at ).
We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.
COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION
Including a 401(k) with generous company matching.
100% REMOTE WORKING OPPORTUNITY
Always have been and always will be.
TOP-NOTCH MEDICAL COVERAGE
Domestic-partner inclusive, health, dental, vision, life, cancer coverage, and long-term disability insurance for you and your dependents.
GENEROUS PAID TIME OFF
23 days of PTO per year. We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to use your time off.
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE
10 weeks of fully paid time off. All genders qualify equally, and the policy includes adoptions.

jobs.title: Sr Director Product Management
jobs.text:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.
Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!
The Company:
Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.
What’s in it for you:
Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.
Address:
Ontario
The Sr. Director, Product Manager is a senior leadership role reporting to the Head of Product Management, responsible for leading strategic product initiatives and driving product excellence across the Digital Product organization. This role provides deep product leadership for critical customer-facing products and platforms while building product management capabilities, establishing best practices, and mentoring product teams throughout the organization.
The Sr. Director serves as a key strategic partner to executive leadership, translating business strategy into product vision and roadmaps that deliver measurable customer and business value. This position requires balancing hands-on product ownership with organizational leadership, coaching product managers, and driving consistent product discipline across teams.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Product Strategy & Leadership
Define and own multi-year product strategy aligned with EZCORP’s business and operating objectives.
Translate executive priorities into structured product roadmaps and investment plans.
Ensure consistent prioritization across platforms based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and operational efficiency.
Customer & Business Outcomes
Champion a customer-centric approach grounded in measurable business outcomes.
Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, digital adoption, and revenue performance.
Improve operational efficiency across store and corporate workflows.
Ensure product performance is measured, reviewed, and continuously improved.
Team Leadership & Development
Lead and develop senior product leaders, including Directors and Group Product Managers.
Establish consistent product management standards, governance, and accountability.
Build leadership depth and succession readiness within the product organization.
Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, and execution discipline.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Operations, IT and Design teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule and on budget
Collaborate with Marketing to drive product adoption, positioning, and go-to-market strategies
Work with Operations and Store Experience teams to ensure products meet field team needs and drive operational efficiency
Engage with Compliance and Legal to ensure regulatory adherence in financial services products
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across functions to understand needs, gather requirements, and align priorities
Lead cross-functional product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and stakeholder alignment meetings
Product Excellence & Standards
Establish and drive consistent product management practices, standards, and operating rhythms across the Digital Product organization
Define and implement product frameworks for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and delivery
Create templates, tools, and resources that enable product teams to work more effectively
Drive adoption of product analytics, user research, and experimentation capabilities
Advocate for technical excellence, platform thinking, and reduced technical debt in product decisions
Champion customer-centric design and accessibility in all Digital products
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, or Platform Leadership roles.
8-10+ years in senior leadership positions (Director / Senior Director or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience delivering complex products in regulated industries, preferably financial services, lending, payments, or retail finance.
Proven ability to scale and modernize large, mission-critical platforms.
Strong cross-functional leadership experience with Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Finance.
Track record of driving execution predictability and measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional communication and decision-making skills at the executive level.
Experience with AI-assisted prototyping (Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI) to create stateful, interactive prototype
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or related field required
MBA or Master's degree strongly preferred
EZCORP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
We are hiring a CTO for one of our UK software businesses: an established company with a long track record and a leading share of its market.
The business has deep customer loyalty and a hard technology problem. It runs a large, mission-critical on-premises estate and is developing a new cloud platform, and it now has the backing to rebuild for the next 20 years. This CTO will lead that rebuild.
This role has two modes. With the established team running the existing products, you lead through managers and team leads; daily production coding is not expected, but you must be able to review architecture and step in to steer major incidents. In the small, elite squad rebuilding the platform, you will be more hands-on.
You will own all technology in the business: product engineering, QA, DevOps and cloud, data, and infrastructure.
ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:
TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.
Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.
Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Run and stabilize the current estate
Lead a production team of 20+ engineers, testers, product and platform staff.
Set priorities, delivery cadence and metrics: velocity, quality, release predictability, cost per product line.
Keep a mission-critical on-premises estate secure, supported and compliant.
Run clear programme governance: every initiative has an owner, plan, budget and honest monthly reporting to the MD.
Own reliability: incident response, postmortems and support escalation, building a team that handles incidents without you.
Build the next-generation platform with a lean, AI-first team
Build a small, senior, AI-native engineering team using AI-assisted development.
Rebuild the core product as a best-in-class cloud platform that aims to be number one in the UK market.
Work hands-on inside the new-platform squad: set the architecture, write and review code if needed, and set the engineering standard.
Make AI development tools part of every engineer's daily work, across both the legacy and new teams.
Lead the move from on premises to cloud
Own the migration strategy for a large installed customer base, including sequencing, integration and data migration.
Keep NHS integrations, accreditations and clinical-safety obligations intact throughout.
Consolidate hosting and infrastructure and reduce the hardware and network footprint our customers carry.
Technical environment
On-premises platform: Mainly C++ , C# and Java; .NET Framework; Microsoft SQL Server; Windows Server; installed at each customer site
Cloud platform: multi-tenant SaaS on Microsoft Azure; C#, ASP.NET Core, React; Kubernetes (AKS); PostgreSQL,
Hardware: company-supplied terminals, handheld scanners and printers; dispensing-robot integrations; NHS HSCN network connectivity; field engineering and workshop

jobs.title: AVP, Tech - Change Management & Service Transition.MGN Egypt - Technology Servic
jobs.text:
As a Senior Manager in Service Management, you will lead the governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of ITIL processes, with a strong focus on Change Management and Service Transition. You will be responsible for driving process excellence by identifying improvement opportunities, overseeing technology change governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of production implementations.

You will collaborate closely with technology, operations, and business teams to ensure that all non-functional, operational readiness, and compliance requirements are met prior to production go-live.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
jobs.text:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates.
The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000.
What you will do
Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice
Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.
Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.
Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.
Own the methodology and its defensibility
Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.
Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.
Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.
Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.
Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory
Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.
Partner with Product and Engineering
Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.
Lead clients and cross-functional partners
Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.
What you bring
Required:
10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.
Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.
Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.
Preferred:
Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.
Our mission and core values:
We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.
Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.
Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.
Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.
Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Who are we?
StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.
Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.
About the role
StoryToys is looking for an interim Head of Engineering to lead the engineering department behind our portfolio of award-winning children's mobile games.
This role is responsible for the performance and growth of our engineering function, ensuring teams can consistently deliver high-quality and engaging mobile experiences for children and families around the world. This is a product-focused role requiring deep experience in Unity, building and maintaining mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a senior engineering leader with a passion for mobile app development and an interest in children's play to join our dynamic and growing team.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
Atria is a membership-based preventive health care practice delivering cutting-edge primary and specialty care in New York, South Florida, Los Angeles (2026), and through 24/7 telemedicine globally.
Our multi-specialty team of 60+ top in-house physicians provides proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. We aim to optimize lifespan and healthspan through meticulous screening, leading-edge therapeutics, and tailored interventions designed to prevent disease and detect it at the earliest possible stages.
Each member's care is led by a dedicated Chief Medical Officer who collaborates with specialists in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, women's health, endocrinology, integrative health, performance and movement, nutrition, and more.
Through our nonprofit Atria Research Institute and Public Health Institute, we also work to accelerate the translation of medical breakthroughs and expand access to preventive care for as many people as possible.
About this role:
You will lead Product Engineering, the three teams that build everything our members, clinicians and care teams use:
Member Experience: registration, the member portal and the mobile app
Clinical Experience: the patient dashboard, results and clinical AI
Care Delivery: scheduling, the care calendar and clinician task management
The role is hands-on: you will work fluently in the AI-assisted workflows our engineers use every day to generate, review, and deploy code.
Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript
Backend: Node, Express
Frontend: React, Honeypot SDK
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform
Database: MySQL (migrating to Postgres)
Tooling & Integrations: Github, Sentry, Okta, Mixpanel, Omni, third-party APIs
Key Responsibilities
Product & Delivery
Lead the Member Experience, Clinical Experience and Care Delivery squads, and own their delivery: plans, priorities and predictable shipping at a high quality bar.
Work with Product, Design and clinical leaders to turn unclear problems into clear technical plans and roadmaps.
Drive system design for the core product areas that keep the platform reliable, HIPAA-compliant, and speed up future work.
Stay hands-on: write, review and ship code using the AI-assisted workflows the team uses every day.
Quality, Observability & Analytics
Set testing and code-review standards across Product Engineering, including how AI-generated code is reviewed and governed.
Make sure features ship with consistent observability (Mixpanel, Datadog, Sentry)
Run post-incident reviews and follow through on the fixes they turn up.
Teamwork, Mentorship & Culture
Hire, coach and manage the performance of engineers and tech leads in NYC and on the distributed team.
Set and uphold engineering standards: coding conventions, architecture patterns and documentation.
Build a practical, product-focused culture that balances high standards with fast, iterative delivery.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
We are currently hiring a Field CTO to join our Strategic Field Organization at a Principal Solutions Architect level to be based in Australia or Singapore. This role reports into our Global Head, Field CTOs. The Strategic Field Organization is a team of Principal Solutions Architects that supports global strategic prospects and customers. This team collaborates with the regional account teams to work together on large engagements that require a high degree of strategic planning - such as DevSecOps transformation, solution recommendations, and advisory for our customer's senior technical leadership.
Field Solutions Architects (SA) are the trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers during the presales motion. We demonstrate how the GitLab platform and GitLab Professional Services address common and unique business requirements. Our Solution Architect team adds value to GitLab's customers by providing subject matter expertise and industry experience throughout the sales process and collaborating internally with the product.
Our Field SA's also engage proactively with existing GitLab customers to provide thought-leadership, engage in innovative solutions, collaborate around evangelism activities around unique customer requirements (i.e. meetups and presentations) and continuously seek market feedback to improve the GitLab platform.
What you'll do
Create and maintain relationships with customer executives that contribute to large Net ARR deals and customer success
Provide executive-level, thought leadership on strategic opportunities (i.e., new logo and growth)
Curate and manage field feedback, while collaborating with the product team on roadmap and issue prioritization
Scale and grow regional-level expertise within the field (SAE/AE,SA,CSM) through contributions to enablement and content
Act as a prospect / customer advocate on DevSecOps transformation initiatives
Build and maintain select subject matter expertise related to GitLab targeted technology sectors through industry monitoring and participation in external working groups, committees and development projects
Keep up to date on GitLab-relevant emerging methodologies and technologies and leverage that knowledge to drive solution strategy and influence product strategy
What you'll bring
Significant experience as a CTO/ Principal Solution Architect with architecture of enterprise software development workflow
Experience delivering information/Cyber Security and compliance related solutions and assessments
Experience with software development tools, practices, and methodologies
Strong verbal and written skills with a strong ability to articulate and communicate strategies to all levels in an organization (i.e., executive to staff engineer)
Ability and willingness to learn and use GitLab as an integral part of the role
Ability to travel and comply with the company’s travel policy

Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support
