jobs.title: National Council for Mental Wellbeing Director, Learning Technology
jobs.text:
About the National Council for Mental Wellbeing
The vision of the National Council for Mental Wellbeing is to make mental wellbeing, including recovery from substance use challenges, a reality for everyone. Despite overwhelming need, nearly 30 million people across the U.S. do not have access to comprehensive mental health and substance use treatment.
Founded in 1969, the National Council is a 501(c)(3) membership organization that drives policy and social change on behalf of more than 3,100 mental health and substance use treatment organizations and the more than 10 million children, adults and families they serve. We advocate for policies to ensure equitable access to high-quality services, build the capacity of mental health and substance use treatment organizations, and promote greater understanding of mental wellbeing as a core component of health and health care. Through Mental Health First Aid (MHFA), we have trained more than 4.5 million people in the U.S. to identify, understand and respond to signs and symptoms of mental health and substance use challenges.
The National Council operates as a remote-first organization, with employees working from locations across the United States.
The Opportunity
As Director, Learning Technology, you will help the National Council expand and improve its learning offerings by translating learner needs and program priorities into effective technology solutions. You will lead the continued development of an established learning technology ecosystem, including a custom-built platform, and help shape what it can do next. The opportunity is to understand the problems learners and program teams need to solve, explore the technical possibilities and guide the development of capabilities that make a meaningful difference.
From the start, you will work with product, program and learning colleagues to understand how the platform is used, where learners and teams encounter challenges, and what new use cases require. You will get to know its architecture, integrations and workflows, translate needs into functional specifications, and work with developers and vendors to carry improvements from design through testing and release. The product and program teams provide the business needs for the National Council’s learning ecosystem; you will bring the learning technology expertise and technical judgment that help turn those choices into practical, sustainable solutions.
Our programs serve different audiences, funders and learning goals, and learning paths are not always linear. A learner may enter through an assessment or survey, browse a catalog, receive a recommendation, or move through content based on outcomes, competencies or prior activity. The platform is already built to support complexity that conventional learning management systems do not easily accommodate. You will build on that foundation as learner needs and program use cases evolve.
This role will appeal to someone who enjoys exploring technology and building useful products, and who is equally curious about the people, business needs and practical constraints behind them. Working with Enterprise Technology colleagues and directly managing a team of three, you will guide platform decisions and delivery while keeping the system reliable, adaptable and sustainable as it grows.
Key Responsibilities
Learning Technology Strategy and Development
Lead platform strategy, architecture and the technical roadmap for the National Council’s learning delivery ecosystem, with particular responsibility for the custom learning platform. Partner with product and program teams to connect business goals and user needs with opportunities to improve and extend the system.
Develop a deep understanding of how National Council programs deliver learning, including non-linear pathways shaped by assessments, recommendations, competencies, outcomes, audience needs and program or grant requirements.
Partner with product and program colleagues to shape functional specifications for new capabilities and enhancements. Translate business requirements and learner needs into clear platform requirements, workflows, user stories and acceptance criteria, contributing a technical perspective on feasibility, dependencies and tradeoffs.
Make thoughtful build, buy, configure and integrate decisions in partnership with product and Enterprise Technology, preserving custom capabilities where they create meaningful value and using commercial tools where they are the better fit.
Use learner feedback, platform data and operational insight to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop measures with product and program colleagues to understand how platform enhancements support learning and business outcomes and guide further development.
Platform Development and Technical Leadership
Develop a deep understanding of the platform’s functional design, architecture, data flows, integrations and operating model to lead its continued development and day-to-day operation.
Evolve the platform to accommodate new use cases and workflows while maintaining its coherence and reliability. Guide design choices that add useful capabilities and keep the system maintainable as it grows.
Partner with developers, vendors and internal technology colleagues on solution design, APIs and integrations, identity and access, data and analytics, security, accessibility, scalability, reliability and performance.
Guide solution design and review proposed technical approaches, helping developers and partners work through tradeoffs and ensuring new capabilities meet learning and business needs.
Maintain strong functional and technical documentation so knowledge of the platform is durable and shared rather than concentrated in a single person.
Lead enhancements and releases through testing, change management and operational readiness, bringing new capabilities into use while ensuring continuity for active learners and programs.
Cross Functional Collaboration
Explore emerging needs and new use cases with product, program, curriculum, operations and technology colleagues, and shape a learning technology roadmap that supports the organization’s evolving goals.
Develop clear intake and delivery planning practices with product and other partners so ideas can move from discovery to implementation. Work together on priorities, feasibility and sequencing, keeping stakeholders informed as enhancements take shape.
Translate effectively between product, learning, program and technical teams, making complex choices understandable to non-technical partners and business needs actionable for developers.
Manage external technology and development partners, setting clear expectations for scope, quality, timelines, documentation and support.
Anticipate platform risks and dependencies and bring forward practical recommendations before they become barriers to program delivery.
Team Leadership
Lead and develop a team of three, creating clarity around responsibilities, priorities and service expectations.
Coach team members to deepen their learning technology, technical-product and operational capabilities, build shared knowledge of the platform and contribute to its continued development.
Establish goals and measures for the team and ensure work aligns with Enterprise Technology and organizational priorities.
Create an environment of accountability, collaboration, learning and respectful challenge.
What We Are Looking For
There are several paths to this role. Strong candidates may have grown through learning technology, LMS/LXP product ownership, education technology, customer education platforms, learning systems implementation, or a related product or technology discipline. We are more interested in the capabilities you bring than in a single prescribed career path.
Core Qualifications
Significant experience owning, implementing or evolving learning technology products or platforms, with a strong understanding of how technology supports real learning journeys and program outcomes.
Experience serving as a product owner, product manager, learning technology leader, systems lead or comparable role in which you translated user and business needs into platform requirements and delivery priorities in partnership with business and program colleagues.
Strong technical fluency with modern web applications and integrated platforms. You do not need to be the primary software engineer, but you should be comfortable discussing application architecture, APIs, integrations, data flows, SSO/IAM, environments, testing, security and release decisions with technical teams.
Working knowledge of learning technology concepts, standards and ecosystems, such as LMS/LXP platforms, SCORM and/or xAPI, learning content, assessments, catalogs, credentials, reporting and learning analytics.
Experience guiding developers, implementation partners or technology vendors and evaluating whether proposed solutions meet functional and technical requirements.
Experience managing a technical roadmap, balancing competing technical needs and leading enhancements or releases from discovery and requirements through testing, launch and measurement, aligned with business priorities.
Ability to understand complex workflows, simplify ambiguity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
People leadership experience, including coaching, setting expectations and building accountability.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Especially Valuable
Experience with custom or highly configured learning platforms, particularly environments that support multiple audiences, programs or non-linear learning pathways.
Experience with Ruby on Rails or another modern web application framework, whether through development, technical product ownership or close partnership with engineering teams.
Hands-on ability to configure platforms, prototype solutions, work with APIs or make targeted application changes. Comfort using AI-assisted development tools is a plus.
Experience with AWS or another major cloud environment.
Experience with LearnUpon or other commercial LMS/LXP platforms and integrating them with custom learning experiences.
Experience in a nonprofit, association, education, public health or other mission-driven environment.
Experience supporting learning programs shaped by grant, contractual, credentialing or reporting requirements.
A note on technical depth: We are looking for someone who can lead the ongoing development of a sophisticated technical product in close partnership with product, make sound decisions with developers and vendors, and understand how the pieces fit together. Hands-on configuration, prototyping or development experience is valuable, but is not a requirement for success in this role.
Compensation and Benefits
The salary range for this position is $155,000–$170,000. Salary decisions within the range are based on experience, education and internal equity.
The National Council offers a comprehensive benefits package, which includes (but is not limited to):
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
403(b) retirement plan with employer contributions after 1 year of service
Paid time off, including vacation, sick, personal, floating holiday, bereavement and observed federal holidays
Parental support benefits, including adoption, fertility and surrogacy reimbursement and two weeks paid parental leave
Free unlimited Relias professional development courses
Annual professional development and tuition reimbursement funds
Calm Premium access
This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Employees in this role must primarily work Washington, D.C. business hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET.
How to Apply
Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their applications promptly through our online portal. All applicants will receive a response. Please questions or to request support in submitting your application.
Candidates who advance can expect an initial phone interview with the Positively Partners team, a follow-up interview with the Vice President, Enterprise Technology, and a multi-part final interview with a range of stakeholders.
Positively Partners is committed to conducting an equitable, accessible search process. Accommodation requests during the interview process will be handled confidentially. Please make a request.
The National Council is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We embrace individuals from all backgrounds and perspectives, welcoming people of all races, ethnicities, religions, genders, sexual orientations and ages, as well as veterans, people with disabilities, and those with lived experiences in mental health and substance use challenges to apply. We are committed to fostering a welcoming environment and recruitment process for everyone.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Microsoft Product Partnership
jobs.text:
We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.
The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.
What you get to do in this role:
Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.
Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.
Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.
Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.
Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.
To be successful in this role you have:
Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.
Ability to paint a compelling vision to inspire teams and senior stakeholders across a broad, evolving scope.
Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.

Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.

blocks.text: To be successful in this role you have:

items: Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.
Ability to paint a compelling vision to inspire teams and senior stakeholders across a broad, evolving scope.
Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.

jobs.text:
(GAQ427R229)
About the role
AI is the defining platform shift of our generation, and Databricks is right at the center of it. We are looking for a Product Finance leader to scale the fastest growing part of our business with both speed and financial rigor. You will be the primary finance partner to our AI Engineering and Product leaders, with a mandate that spans the full arc of the AI business: planning GPU supply and demand across clouds, shaping how we price AI products, and building the unit economics that will define the margins of this category for years to come.
The impact you will have
Plan the GPU supply and demand that powers the business
Establish a trusted, unified GPU demand plan across production inference, internal research, and new product bets so we invest ahead of growth without over-provisioning.
Drive capacity commitment and procurement strategies across major hyperscalers and emerging neoclouds, optimizing the mix of reserved, spot, and on-demand compute.
Own AI product economics and partner on pricing
Lead revenue and margin analytics across the AI product portfolio, turning raw consumption telemetry into a clear read on customer adoption, retention, and product profitability.
Model the end-to-end unit economics of AI products before they ship, partnering with Product and Pricing to design consumption structures that drive adoption while protecting gross margin targets.
Establish robust KPIs and operations to drive best-in-class execution
Partner with Engineering to define north star efficiency KPIs (e.g., GPU utilization, cost per token/query, serverless efficiency) and translate them into committed engineering roadmaps.
Run tight financial operations, from auditable multi-cloud cost allocation to automated reporting, giving product and engineering leaders real-time visibility into their economic goals.
Bring finance rigor to the biggest investment decisions
Design ROI and capital allocation frameworks to evaluate asymmetric bets—including frontier model research, internal compute clusters, and strategic partnerships.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product finance analysts capable of operating at the intersection of deep technical infrastructure and commercial strategy
What we look for
Required
10+ years of experience in Strategic/Product Finance, complemented by foundational training in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting.
Deep fluency in consumption-based business models, public cloud infrastructure costs, unit cost analysis, and gross margin optimization.
A proven track record of partnering directly with senior Engineering and Product executives to influence technical roadmaps and commercial pricing.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial systems from scratch and distill massive, complex telemetry data into models and recommendations leaders act on.
Experience building, leading, and developing high-output finance teams in fast-moving environments.
Preferred
Direct experience operating in the AI and GPU economy, including familiarity with training/inference workloads, hyperscaler commitment structures, and neocloud economics.
Ownership of a multi-product P&L within a high-growth enterprise SaaS, PaaS, or data infrastructure company.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, or notebook environments to self-serve insights from raw usage data.

jobs.title: Chief Product and Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Who we are
Athos Commerce is the only all-in-one intelligent discovery platform that connects shoppers to the right products across whatever channel they are shopping: a brand's own site, marketplaces, social, comparison shopping engines, and AI platforms.
More than 2,700 brands, including Adidas, Burberry, Clarins, and Marks & Spencer, rely on our AI-powered search, merchandising, personalization, and product feed management to help shoppers find the right product faster, reduce manual work for merchandisers, and drive higher conversion and average order value.
Who You Are
You are a strategic, commercially minded product and technology executive who combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs and business outcomes. You have a proven ability to lead both Product and Engineering organizations, build scalable technology platforms, and translate market insights into successful products.
You are a hands-on leader who thrives in complex environments, makes thoughtful investment decisions, and balances innovation with operational excellence. You are comfortable leading organizational transformation, integrating technology platforms, and developing high-performing global teams.
You bring strong executive presence, sound technical judgment, and a collaborative leadership style. You enjoy engaging directly with customers and partners, challenging conventional approaches, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and organizational effectiveness.
What You'll Do?
As Chief Product and Technology Officer, reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the product and technology strategy for Athos Commerce, translating commercial objectives into a clear product direction, strategic investment decisions, and consistent execution. You will oversee Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Platform Operations, Product Design, Data, and Information Security while leading the next stage of integration across our established commerce platforms. Working closely with customers, agency partners, and executive leadership, you will drive product innovation, improve customer experiences, and ensure our technology remains secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. This is a hands-on executive role where you will balance long-term strategic priorities with delivering meaningful improvements to customers across our platforms.
How You Will Succeed
Define Product and Technology Strategy: Establish a unified product and technology vision aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth objectives, including the strategic application of AI and emerging commerce channels.
Lead Product Strategy and Execution: Oversee customer discovery, product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and investment prioritization, using customer evidence, commercial potential, and engineering capacity to guide decisions.
Drive Platform Integration and Modernization: Lead the continued integration of Athos Commerce's established platforms while maintaining product delivery, improving technical architecture, and managing technical debt.
Improve Customer Experience and Self-Service: Make Athos products faster to implement and easier for merchants and agency partners to configure independently, reducing reliance on engineering resources and improving time to value.
Build a High-Performing Engineering Organization: Lead global engineering teams to deliver high-quality software improvements predictably while maintaining strong development practices, accountability, and execution.
Ensure Platform Reliability and Security: Oversee architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform operations, security, and compliance to maintain reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology.
Strengthen Customer and Commercial Partnerships: Engage directly with merchants, agency partners, and prospects while partnering with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance on product positioning, pricing, launches, and strategic customer commitments.
Develop and Scale Global Leadership Teams: Recruit, mentor, and develop senior Product and Technology leaders, establish clear ownership and accountability, and foster a collaborative culture across distributed teams.
Drive AI Innovation and Adoption: Identify opportunities to bring AI and machine learning capabilities to market while embedding AI into Product and Engineering workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes.
Own Financial Planning and Technology Governance: Manage Product and Technology budgets, workforce planning, vendor decisions, technology investments, and risk management while communicating priorities, performance, and material risks to executive leadership and the board.
What We're Looking for
Significant senior leadership experience within a software or SaaS organization, with direct responsibility across both Product and Engineering functions.
Proven track record of developing and executing product and technology strategies that deliver measurable customer value and commercial results.
Direct experience building ecommerce search, product discovery, merchandising, or personalization products; marketing technology experience is a plus.
Strong technical judgment across software architecture, development practices, cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, scalability, and information security.
Experience leading complex platform integrations, technology modernization initiatives, or organizational transformation while maintaining ongoing product delivery.
Practical experience bringing AI and machine learning capabilities to market and integrating AI into Product and Engineering workflows.
Strong commercial understanding of SaaS business models, including recurring revenue, customer retention, margins, profitability, and cost to serve.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, and developing senior Product and Engineering leadership teams.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones.
Ability to make and communicate complex tradeoffs between business growth, customer commitments, delivery capacity, and long-term platform sustainability.
Strong financial and operational management experience, including departmental budgets, workforce planning, and strategic technology investments.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to engage customers, agency partners, technical teams, executive leadership, and board members.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across commercial and technical functions to drive shared business objectives.
Benefits
Open PTO
Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
Medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Company-paid Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
Company-paid Life and AD&D coverage
Voluntary benefits, including critical illness, accident insurance, legal services, and pet insurance
401(k) plan with employer match
Flexible work environment. Work from one of our offices, hybrid, or remote.
Athos Commerce is an equal-opportunity employer and proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We strongly believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential in cultivating an inclusive culture and building an innovative, successful organization. All qualified applicants are considered for employment, without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you require accommodation during the application process, please don't hesitate to contact us.

jobs.title: Vice President, AI Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
About You
You have clear and proven attribution of commercial success and business outcomes in self-serve SMB products (i.e. products similiar to Patch's promoted events and featured business listings: self-serve, low price point, recurring).
You are fluent in Clay Christensen's JTBD framework.
You have 5+ years of leading leaders in technical and product roles in entrepreneurial environments.
You have technical credibility: 10+ years of experience as an engineer and/or managing engineering teams, and the ability to reason directly about architecture, data, feasibility, and trade-offs.
You are hands-on: You prototype, inspect the data, talk with customers and work through details with the team; you do not delegate the substance of product leadership.
You lead with curiosity, candor, self-awareness, low ego, and a sense of humor.
What We Offer / Why Patch
Patch -- the largest, and one of the few thriving local media businesses -- has been on the cutting edge of AI since 2022. We have approximately 15,000 communities with AI newsletters that have a 94+ NPS. Our moderation for 160M active users (and many other parts of the business) are AI-native.
Our work connecting people with their communities matters. We are Patchy: we have fun and take our mission seriously but not ourselves.
Even if you are a world-class leader, you will become a better leader at Patch through our leadership standards. All applicants for the role will go through them.
Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Ancillary benefits
401(k)
Unlimited discretionary time off (DTO)
10 paid holidays a year
Paid parental leave
Product and Technology Environment
Patch’s products span consumer web and mobile, email, publishing, user-generated content, payments, data, search and advertising integrations.
The technology environment includes JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Drupal/PHP, AWS, Heroku, Pantheon, GCP/BigQuery/GA4, Stripe, Auth0/Okta, Typesense/OpenSearch, GitHub/Jira and modern AI tools.
You need not master the stack, but you must be technically fluent and able to earn the trust of engineers.
What You Will Lead
Commercial success for platform products, leading with with force, courage, and velocity. If you are doing something common in media, it is not bold enough.
Helping sales make more money, especially through applying our AI work with large brands (separate from platform products)
Finding ways to make our journalists' careers more rewarding financially and operationally.
Working at Patch
Patch is remote-first, with employees and contractors across countries and time zones. The ideal candidate feels a real connection to our mission: keeping people informed about their communities and helping local businesses and event marketers get the word out to the audiences that matter most.
Patch Media is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our commitment to equality extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and general treatment.

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About the Role
Monks is seeking an experienced Design Director to provide creative leadership for an embedded team supporting one of our largest technology clients. Working in person alongside client stakeholders, this role will maintain creative continuity, uphold a high standard of craft and ensure work remains cohesive across teams, shifts and deliverables.
The ideal candidate has deep experience working within robust design systems and knows how to apply established standards without making the work feel mechanical. You will guide designers and motion creatives, resolve design questions quickly and help the team deliver polished editorial and marketing content at speed.
An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.
Work Location & Schedule
This role requires working onsite at our client's office in Menlo Park, CA, 4–5 days per week.
In This Role, You Will
Provide day-to-day creative leadership for the embedded design and motion team.
Maintain continuity and a consistent creative standard across locations, shifts and workstreams.
Translate established brand guidelines and design systems into clear, actionable direction.
Ensure work is visually cohesive, accurate and appropriately tailored to its audience and channel.
Review and guide digital, web, editorial, presentation, graphic and motion deliverables.
Partner closely with the Executive Producer to balance creative quality with timing, capacity and business priorities.
Work directly with client stakeholders to clarify creative direction, resolve feedback and keep work moving.
Provide clear, consolidated feedback that enables teams to execute efficiently.
Identify when existing components or templates can be used and when a new design solution is required.
Support the evolution of templates, component libraries and documentation as program needs develop.
Collaborate with technical writers to ensure design supports the clarity and integrity of complex subject matter.
Mentor designers and motion creatives, providing practical guidance and helping them operate with greater independence.
Partner with AI and creative technology specialists to explore responsible ways to improve workflows, consistency and production efficiency.
Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.
Experience You Bring
8+ years of experience in design, art direction or creative direction within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and maintaining quality across high-volume or rapid-turn work.
Deep familiarity with established brand systems, component libraries, templates and scalable design frameworks.
Strong digital and web design experience, including responsive layouts and accessibility considerations.
Ability to assess work quickly, provide decisive direction and distinguish critical issues from subjective preferences.
Strong understanding of typography, hierarchy, composition, visual storytelling and motion principles.
Experience collaborating with production, editorial, product, legal and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required.
Excellent presentation, communication and feedback skills.
Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.
Working Model
This is an in-person, client-facing role embedded with the client team. The Design Director will guide a distributed creative team operating across multiple global locations and shifts, with availability during core client working hours and flexibility around urgent priorities.
At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
#LI-INPERSON
#LI-ZZ1
What We Offer
Benefits
Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance - more about our coverage here!
Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays
401k with company contribution
Paid parental leave
Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being
Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network
A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!
Authentic commitment to DEI efforts and sustainable growth. (Why Sir Martin Sorrell signed The Climate Pledge here!)
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.
Salary Range:
$130,000—$150,000 USD
About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management – Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.text:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
Director, Product Management – Enterprise Data Platform
Primary Purpose
The Director, Product Management - Data Systems leads product strategy for our enterprise data foundation, including the Snowflake-based platform and supporting data systems that power OmniAnalyst, OmniInsights, and our broader data product ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President of Data Product Management, this role defines the capabilities, governance, and roadmap needed to deliver scalable, secure, and trusted data products across the enterprise.
As the product leader for the data platform, this individual serves as the primary intake and prioritization point for platform requests, aligns stakeholders across business and technology teams, and ensures the platform delivers business value while maintaining long-term scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
Essential Responsibilities
Define Platform Capabilities
Defines the capabilities required of the enterprise data foundation, including governed data sharing, access controls, entity resolution, semantic models, shared definitions, and data quality standards.
Partners with Data Architecture and Data Engineering to design scalable, secure, and well-governed platform capabilities aligned with enterprise standards.
Champions modern data architecture practices, including data mesh and layered (medallion) architectures, to drive consistency and reusability across the enterprise.
Establishes standards for semantic context, metadata, governance, and data design to ensure data is consistently understood by business users, analytics tools, and AI applications.
Set Vision & Roadmap for Data Systems
Defines and owns the vision and multi-year roadmap for the enterprise data foundation, beginning with the Snowflake platform and evolving as business needs grow.
Partners with Data Architecture leadership, business stakeholders, and internal data consumers to align platform investments with enterprise priorities.
Collaborates with product leaders supporting OmniAnalyst, OmniInsights, and other data products to ensure platform capabilities meet downstream product needs.
Establishes and monitors platform success measures, including data quality, availability, performance, adoption, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.
Applies Product Operating Model principles to platform intake, prioritization, backlog management, and outcome measurement.
Intake, Prioritization & Platform Governance
Owns the intake and prioritization process for enterprise data platform initiatives, maintaining a transparent framework for evaluating business requests.
Balances business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, effort, and cost when prioritizing platform investments and managing tradeoffs.
Maintains a strategic backlog and facilitates stakeholder alignment through recurring prioritization forums and governance discussions.
Identifies demand trends and opportunities for reusable platform capabilities that improve efficiency and scalability.
Drive Platform Delivery
Partners with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Governance, and platform administration teams to deliver roadmap commitments and platform enhancements.
Translates business requirements into technical product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data models, pipelines, access patterns, and platform services.
Leverages SQL and strong technical fluency to validate delivered solutions and ensure business requirements are met.
Partners with Governance and FinOps teams to manage platform consumption, forecast costs, and promote cost-effective platform growth.
Ensures the platform supports analytics, data science, and AI workloads through strong data quality, lineage, governance, semantic context, and performance management.
Establishes performance metrics, reporting, and documentation standards that support platform adoption, reliability, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Builds alignment across business, operations, technology, governance, security, privacy, and compliance stakeholders.
Ensures appropriate platform controls are implemented and maintained, including role-based access, masking policies, data classification, retention, lineage, and auditability.
Communicates platform strategy, releases, priorities, and performance through executive reporting, documentation, and stakeholder engagement.
Acts as a trusted advisor on data platform capabilities, governance requirements, and strategic opportunities.
Maintains awareness of emerging Snowflake capabilities and modern data architecture trends to inform platform strategy.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field required.
Advanced degree a plus.
Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced Architect) preferred.
Experience
Ten (10) or more years of experience in product management, data platform, data engineering, or data architecture roles, including at least five (5) years in technical product management for data platforms.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake, either as a technical practitioner or product owner of a Snowflake-based platform.
Strong experience with modern data architecture concepts including data warehousing, data mesh, dimensional modeling, layered (medallion) architecture, semantic modeling, and ELT pipelines.
Demonstrated success shaping data platform capabilities, influencing engineering direction, and partnering across business and technology teams.
Experience leading intake and prioritization processes for shared enterprise platforms serving multiple business units.
Experience supporting analytics, data science, and AI-enabled use cases preferred.
Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata management, entity resolution, master data management, or governed data-sharing solutions preferred.
Experience working in regulated industries preferred.
Skills & Knowledge
Strong knowledge of enterprise data platform architecture, storage concepts, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
Expertise in data modeling, semantic modeling, metadata management, lineage, and data catalog concepts.
Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to independently validate data solutions and review technical designs.
Familiarity with Snowflake governance and administration concepts including RBAC, secure data sharing, access controls, and consumption management.
Strong prioritization, stakeholder management, communication, and executive influencing skills.
Understanding of how data quality, governance, and semantic context impact analytics and AI outcomes.
Ability to lead through influence in highly matrixed environments while balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and long-term platform health.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and Product Operating Model practices.
As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is (107,667.00 - 150,734.00 USD Annual). A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits.
Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.
We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.
Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.
India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.
Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.
What you will do
We’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation. You’ll lead a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and the team is still growing. They work across our Data and Digital Products & CRM practices and deliver for clients and colleagues around the world.
You’ll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you’ll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad.
This is a leadership role first and foremost. You’ll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You’ll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team’s performance visible to the rest of the business.
You’ll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You’ll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won’t be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it’s executed brilliantly in India.
We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.
Key responsibilities
Leading the team and its culture
Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You’ll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.
Delivery and engineering excellence
Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM.
Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.
Performance, metrics and governance
Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives.
Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work.
Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
Global collaboration
Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.
Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
What success looks like in your first year
A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
A clear monthly view of the India team’s health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Innovation COE
jobs.text:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
Job Details
JOB SUMMARY:
The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations — ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.
This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Stage Gate Process Ownership
Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations
Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)
Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders
Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates
Technology Evaluation & Scouting
Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)
Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)
Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling
Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.
Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates
Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors
Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline
Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap
Portfolio & Performance Management
Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process
Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time
Team Leadership & CoE Culture
Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving
Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process
Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions
Cultivate a culture of curiosity and structured experimentation across the stakeholder community, encouraging teams to surface and champion emerging technology ideas
QUALIFICATIONS:
Required
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
10+ years of experience in supply chain operations, strategy, or technology — with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
Demonstrated experience designing or managing a stage gate, innovation pipeline, or technology governance process
Strong understanding of supply chain operations across distribution, logistics, procurement, or inventory management
Proven ability to build executive-level presentations and facilitate senior leadership decision-making forums
Experience managing cross-functional programs from concept through implementation
Preferred
Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, or related)
Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare supply chain, or highly regulated industries
Familiarity with frameworks such as Stage-Gate®, Lean Startup, or Design Thinking
PMP, Agile, or related certifications
Experience working with or evaluating enterprise technology vendors (ERP, WMS, TMS, AI platforms)
What Cencora offers
We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit
Full time
Salary Range*
$119,100 - 186,560
*This Salary Range reflects a National Average for this job. The actual range may vary based on your locale. Ranges in Colorado/California/Washington/NewYork/Hawaii/Vermont/Minnesota/Massachusetts/Illinois State-specific locations may be up to 10% lower than the minimum salary range, and 12% higher than the maximum salary range.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.
The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.
Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.
1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.
Your Title: Senior Director of Engineering
Your Location: Hybrid – Edison, NJ HQ
You Report to: SVP of Engineering and Chief Architect
Compensation: $225,000 or more depending upon experience
At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.
You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we’ve built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.
What You’ll Do:
- Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure.
- Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms.
- Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security.
- Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology.
- Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments.
- Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides.
What you bring:
- 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent, hands-on engineering leadership (Director / VP level in high-growth B2B SaaS).
- Core Microservices Stack: Deep, practical experience in Node.js (90% of our stack) alongside Java or GoLang.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of containerized, cloud-agnostic environments (Kubernetes, AWS).
- Applied Agentic Experience: Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing autonomous agents and agentic workflows (experience with AWS Bedrock is a huge plus).
- Security-First Mindset: Deep appreciation for platform security, identity management, compliance, and secure software development practices.
- Leadership Style: Proven track record of both building 0-to-1 systems and taking ownership of mature, inherited codebases.
Who thrives here:
Builders who love creating something from nothing and aren't afraid of rolling up their sleeves
Fast movers who navigate ambiguity with confidence and iterate at speed
Problem solvers who are energized by complex, evolving challenges
Collaborators who can influence without authority and build strong cross-functional relationships
Data enthusiasts who let evidence drive decisions, not opinions
Mission-driven professionals passionate about fighting fraud and protecting customers
What we offer:
Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
Competitive salary and equity package
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Unlimited PTO Policy
Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

Compensation: $225,000 or more depending upon experience

At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.

You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we’ve built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.
What You’ll Do:
- Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure.

- Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms.

- Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security.
- Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology.
- Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments.
- Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides.
What you bring:
- 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent, hands-on engineering leadership (Director / VP level in high-growth B2B SaaS).
- Core Microservices Stack: Deep, practical experience in Node.js (90% of our stack) alongside Java or GoLang.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of containerized, cloud-agnostic environments (Kubernetes, AWS).
- Applied Agentic Experience: Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing autonomous agents and agentic workflows (experience with AWS Bedrock is a huge plus).
- Security-First Mindset: Deep appreciation for platform security, identity management, compliance, and secure software development practices.
- Leadership Style: Proven track record of both building 0-to-1 systems and taking ownership of mature, inherited codebases.
Who thrives here:
Builders who love creating something from nothing and aren't afraid of rolling up their sleeves
Fast movers who navigate ambiguity with confidence and iterate at speed
Problem solvers who are energized by complex, evolving challenges
Collaborators who can influence without authority and build strong cross-functional relationships
Data enthusiasts who let evidence drive decisions, not opinions
Mission-driven professionals passionate about fighting fraud and protecting customers
What we offer:
Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
Competitive salary and equity package
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Unlimited PTO Policy
Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible
