jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Acquisition Intelligence
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
The Role
The Director of Product Management for ZX leads product strategy and delivery for Zeta’s customer acquisition business unit. This leader turns the needs of ZX’s clients and teams into a clear product vision, roadmap, and set of priorities, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Cloud, and business unit leadership to bring them to market.
The role requires both ownership of ZX’s distinct needs and a commitment to building One Zeta. The Director will identify where Zeta’s core platform can serve acquisition use cases, adapt those capabilities to ZX workflows, and help turn successful solutions into reusable products across the company. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, commercial understanding, and the ability to lead through cross-functional partnerships.
Key Responsibilities
Own the ZX product vision and roadmap. Define a product strategy for customer acquisition that reflects client needs, business priorities, and Zeta’s broader platform direction. Set priorities, articulate tradeoffs, and measure the impact of what the team ships.
Connect the business unit with Product and Engineering. Serve as the product lead for ZX, translating business opportunities and operational needs into clear requirements and delivery plans. Partner with engineering and platform teams from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.
Build on Zeta’s core capabilities. Apply Zeta’s identity, data, AI, activation, and measurement capabilities to ZX use cases. Determine when an existing platform capability should be configured, extended, or developed into a new product experience.
Lead the email acquisition product experience. Bring strong command of email acquisition and ESP ecosystems to the role. Shape the products and integrations that support audience targeting, deliverability, campaign execution, optimization, and measurement at scale.
Scale solutions across One Zeta. Identify common needs across ZX and other business units. Champion shared components, consistent workflows, and reusable approaches that strengthen the platform and avoid duplicative development.
Understand customers and the acquisition workflow. Work with ZX leadership, client teams, Sales, and customers to understand how marketers identify prospects, plan and activate campaigns, optimize performance, and measure outcomes. Use those insights to shape product decisions.
Drive execution and adoption. Align stakeholders around scope, milestones, dependencies, and success measures. Partner with GTM and client-facing teams on launches, demonstrations, and enablement so new capabilities solve real problems and are used effectively.
Qualifications
Significant product management experience, including ownership of a roadmap and delivery across multiple teams.
Experience with advertising technology, customer acquisition, marketing technology, or a related data-driven product area.
Deep understanding of email as an acquisition channel, including ESP platforms and integrations, audience and identity resolution, deliverability, campaign orchestration, and performance measurement.
Ability to translate commercial and customer needs into scalable product decisions and clear requirements for engineering teams.
Strong understanding of how data, identity, activation, and measurement work together in a marketing workflow.
A track record of influencing teams across business units and central platform organizations without relying on direct authority.
Sound judgment about when to tailor a product to a business need and when to invest in a shared capability.
Clear communication with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Unlimited PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $220,000 - $250,000, depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Ügyfelünk egy svájci mérnöki hátterű, világszerte elismert név a hídalkatrészek tervezésében és gyártásában. Ez a cég áll azon hídsaruk és dilatációs szerkezetek mögött, amelyek a világ legismertebb hidjaiban találhatók. A nyírteleki üzem ennek a globális gyártási hálózatnak egyik kulcsfontosságú szereplője, így a régióból való elköltözés nélkül is lehetőség nyílik magas színvonalú mérnöki és gyártási munkára, valódi nemzetközi környezetben. Ha stabil, szakmailag komoly, 60+ éves múltra visszatekintő, minden kontinensen jelenlévő munkáltatót keresel, ezt érdemes megfontolni.
Feladatok:
A mérnökség felépítése: szerepek, döntési jogok, prioritások, szakmai kontroll, helyettesítés és fejlesztés. Aktív részvétel az új mérnökök kiválasztásában és betanításában.
A gyártás-előkészítés technológiai megalapozása: gyárthatóság, műveleti sorrend, alapanyag, gép, készülék, tűrés és erőforrás meghatározása. A vezető legyen otthon a gyártástechnológiákban, és biztosítson műszakilag megalapozott, műhelyben használható dokumentációt.
3D CAD-képesség, modellezési és rajzolási standardok, PDM/PLM és dokumentumjóváhagyás bevezetése; ECR/ECO változáskezelés és az elavult verziók visszavonása.
Gyárthatósági felülvizsgálat a vágás, hajlítás, hegesztés, forgácsolás, szerelés és felületkezelés területén. Új és módosított termékek bevezetése: prototípus, kockázatelemzés, gyártási jóváhagyás és stabil gyártás.
Alvállalkozók műszaki támogatása: dokumentációátadás, technológiai egyeztetés és problémamegoldás. Képességeik, készülékeik és folyamataik értékelése a Supply Chain és Quality bevonásával.
A hegesztési tevékenység szakmai és vezetői felügyelete: utasítások, eljárásminősítések, személyi jogosultságok, nyomonkövethetőség és megfelelőség. Ideális esetben IWE/EWE képesítéssel a fő hegesztési felelősi feladatkört is vállalja.
A Lean Manager irányítása és a lean fejlesztések prioritásainak kijelölése: anyagáramlás, várakozás, átfutási idő, ciklusidő, kapacitás és költség. Gyártási eltérések gyökérokelemzése és tartós javító intézkedések a termeléssel együtt.
Technológiai és CAPEX-javaslatok: műszaki specifikáció, alternatívák, megtérülés, próbák, beüzemelés és gyártási átadás.
Mérnöki KPI-k, prioritások, erőforrás-, kompetencia- és költségtervek kezelése; kritikus tudás és helyettesítés biztosítása. Együttműködés a helyi társterületekkel és a Group Engineeringgel.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Fraud
jobs.text:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.
We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.
We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.
We're looking for a Director, Product Management for our Fraud team. In this pivotal role, you'll own and drive strategic initiatives shaping our end-to-end fraud detection architecture, advanced risk models, third-party data integrations, and consumer verification systems. The role is perfect for seasoned product leaders with 10+ years of experience who excel in fast-paced fintech environments, bring deep domain expertise in risk strategies, and master the balance between robust fraud prevention and seamless user conversion. You’ll be responsible for spearheading engineering scrum teams, resolving cross-functional trade-offs, and partnering closely with fraud management, information security, data, and operations to deliver impactful, high-integrity outcomes. Please note that this is a role in a hybrid capacity based in our downtown San Francisco office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
What You’ll Do:
Drive product development for all of Upgrade’s fraud infrastructure including detection, models, third party data integration, and consumer verification measures.
Facilitate cross-functional decision making, driving key tradeoffs between conversion, fraud prevention, information security and operational considerations
Partner closely with Upgrade’s fraud management team to monitor and drive improvements on all relevant fraud KPIs
Act as product owner for scrum teams working to ship fraud platform enhancements
Evaluate and drive implementation of new third party data and software integrations
Work closely with the operations team to monitor, troubleshoot and solve issues.
What We Look For:
Significant expertise in fraud strategies, models, data sources and infrastructure in a Fintech environment preferred.
Proven track record in leadership, organizational conflict resolution, and data-driven decision-making.

jobs.title: Director - Geospatial Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director, Geospatial Governance is accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, management, and continual improvement of QIC’s enterprise geospatial capability. The role leads the GIS team and serves as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise platform, including the Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE), ArcGIS Enterprise environment, geospatial services, standards, and governance frameworks.
The position ensures that geospatial information is managed as a trusted enterprise asset, supporting planning, design, development, construction, operations, asset management, and digital twin initiatives. The Director establishes and maintains geospatial governance, data stewardship, quality assurance, platform performance, security, and compliance while driving innovation and business value through geospatial technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
· Develop and execute the enterprise geospatial strategy and roadmap.
· Align GIS initiatives with corporate objectives, digital transformation programs, and business priorities.
· Promote geospatial information as a strategic enterprise asset.
· Lead the adoption of emerging geospatial technologies, automation, analytics, and digital twin capabilities.
· Provide executive-level advice on geospatial data, systems, and governance.
Geospatial Governance
· Establish and maintain enterprise GIS governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures.
· Define authoritative geospatial datasets and manage their lifecycle.
· Lead enterprise data stewardship and accountability frameworks.
· Establish decision rights for geospatial information management.
· Chair GIS governance and technical review forums.
· Ensure compliance with enterprise data management and information governance policies.
· Oversee schema governance and change control processes.
Enterprise GIS Platform Ownership
· Serve as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise environment.
· Lead governance and oversight of ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, and Enterprise Geodatabases (SDE).
· Establish standards for service publishing, deployment, security, and lifecycle management.
· Oversee platform availability, performance, scalability, resilience, and disaster recovery.
· Lead upgrade planning, release management, and platform modernization initiatives.
· Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and infrastructure standards.
Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE) Governance
· Govern the design, structure, and management of enterprise geodatabases.
· Establish standards for branch versioning, data editing, reconciliation, and data publishing workflows.
· Oversee database architecture, performance optimization, and operational health.
· Approve enterprise schema modifications and geodatabase design changes.
· Ensure long-term integrity, consistency, and sustainability of enterprise geospatial data assets.
Data Quality and Assurance
· Define enterprise GIS quality management frameworks.
· Establish validation rules, quality controls, and acceptance criteria.
· Oversee geospatial QA/QC activities across projects and business units.
· Implement auditing, monitoring, and reporting mechanisms.
· Drive continual improvement in data quality, completeness, and accuracy.
· Ensure all submissions into the enterprise environment meet approved standards.
Digital Delivery and Project Assurance
· Define digital geospatial deliverable requirements for projects and programs.
· Support project stage-gate reviews and technical assurance processes.
· Review and approve geospatial submissions from consultants, contractors, and project teams.
· Ensure compliance with GIS standards, contracts, and information management requirements.
· Act as the escalation point for geospatial compliance and delivery issues.
Enterprise Integration and Interoperability
· Lead integration of GIS with BIM, CAD, Civil 3D, asset management systems, digital twins, and enterprise platforms.
· Establish interoperability standards and data exchange processes.
· Govern geospatial APIs, web services, and integration patterns.
· Support enterprise-wide information management initiatives.
Team Leadership and Capability Development
· Lead and develop a high-performing GIS team.
· Establish workforce plans and capability development programs.
· Provide mentoring, coaching, and professional development opportunities.
· Manage recruitment, succession planning, and performance management activities.
· Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
· Manage specialist consultants, vendors, and service providers.
Stakeholder Engagement
· Build strong relationships across business units, projects, and executive leadership teams.
· Represent geospatial interests in enterprise governance forums.
· Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define information requirements.
· Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics Engineering
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Analytics Engineering, you'll lead a team of 8 and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You set direction across the data organization, stay close enough to the work to guide technical decisions credibly, and partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, IT, and business leaders.
You will have three mandates:
Build trusted, AI-ready self-service. Deliver a semantic model that answers business questions correctly, with the telemetry, evals, and model flexibility to prove it and keep costs in check.
Set the strategy for how GitLab accesses data. Own the data models, BI tools, and AI access patterns (Claude, MCP servers, Slack agents) that put trusted data in everyone's hands.
Build data applications the whole company relies on. Ship production-grade apps that combine trusted data, APIs, and AI to answer questions dashboards can't.
What you'll do
Build and own a trusted semantic model, with governed metrics and business definitions, that answers business questions consistently across every tool
Build evals and ground-truth datasets that measure answer quality, and use them to drive improvements and catch regressions
Instrument telemetry to see who uses the semantic model and AI tools, what they ask, and where they get stuck
Build a model-selection harness so GitLab can route work across LLMs and stay flexible on cost and quality
Own data modeling and curated datasets for self-service, with the ownership, data contracts, testing, and documentation that make them AI-ready
Define the AI data access strategy: when to use BI, Claude, MCP servers, or Slack agents, with the governance and security to keep access trusted and reliable
Own the enterprise BI and self-service tools strategy (e.g., Tableau, Omni), including evaluation, adoption, and cost
Build self-service capabilities, such as Claude skills, documentation, and guided workflows, that help people find and use data on their own
Build and own company-wide data applications, from Claude-built single-page apps to apps inside BI tools, that combine Snowflake data, API calls, AI-powered deep dives, and write-back to Postgres or Snowflake
Set engineering standards for data apps (security, authentication, testing, deployment, and monitoring) so they're reliable at company scale
Set a long-range roadmap tied to company strategy, and a lightweight operating model that balances urgent stakeholder needs with investment in reusable data products and tech-debt reduction
Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of 8: build career paths, develop leaders, distribute ownership, and recognize great work
Act as customer zero for GitLab and GitLab Duo in data workflows, sharing feedback with Product and Engineering
What you'll bring
12+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, including 5+ years leading teams and 2+ years managing managers or senior leads
Deep expertise in data modeling and semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, LookML, Cube), and expert dbt, including testing and CI/CD across a multi-team project
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered data access (text-to-SQL, agents, MCP servers), including evals and telemetry for answer quality, and advanced use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code
Expert SQL and strong Snowflake experience; working knowledge of Python
Strong data governance experience: data quality, lineage, certified datasets, and access controls (RBAC, row access and masking policies)
Track record of leading cross-functional data initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable business impact, including enterprise BI and self-service at scale
Systems thinker who sees how models, pipelines, and architecture decisions connect, and designs for second-order effects
Exceptional communicator who writes clear technical specs, sets a clear vision, makes trade-offs visible, and influences executives and peers across the company
Pragmatic in ambiguity: makes sound decisions on emerging technology and ships the right next version rather than waiting for the ideal end state
Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values
Nice to Have
Experience with LLM routing or gateway tools and managing model costs
Experience with Tableau, Omni, or a BI platform migration
Experience with web app development (e.g., React, TypeScript) and Postgres
Experience owning finance or revenue-critical data (e.g., ARR, consumption) where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable
About the Team
Analytics Engineering makes GitLab's data trusted, easy to find, and ready for anyone to use, whether they ask a dashboard, Claude, or a Slack agent. We own the curated data models, the semantic layer, the self-service tools, and the data applications that let teams answer their own questions.
AI is changing how people get to data. Questions that once went through an analyst now go straight to AI tools, so the answers are only as good as the data models and business definitions behind them. Our job is to make those answers correct, consistent, and measurable.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$139,200—$285,600 USD

Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups

Growth and Development Fund

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Director, Onboard Core Software
jobs.text:
Motional is at the forefront of the driverless revolution. We are looking for a Director of Onboard Core Software to lead the teams that deliver the software foundation Motional's products are built on: embedded firmware, the operating system, the runtime, and middleware on the vehicle's various computing platforms. You will own the onboard software infrastructure end to end and lead the teams responsible for it.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with systems software on physical hardware and has led engineering organizations with several levels of management. You should be comfortable owning a large area that spans many teams, taking on problems that aren't well defined yet, and working out boundaries directly with other organizations.
Mission Summary:
As the Director of Onboard Core Software, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for the software foundation of Motional's autonomous vehicles, from embedded firmware through the operating system, runtime, and middleware. This leadership role is centered on establishing a single roadmap, intake process, and escalation path for the onboard stack, and serving as the primary engineering counterpart to Vehicle Platform Engineering, Autonomy, and Safety for everything that runs on the vehicle's compute platform. You will keep the current-generation platform healthy in production while building the next-generation platform program. You will own cross-cutting system behaviors such as startup sequencing, storage lifecycle, compute, ECU bring-up, and cross-layer latency to ensure the platform performs safely and reliably, and that the entire product is a delight for our customers, from the autonomy features that drive the vehicle to the customer-facing features riders experience in our cars.
What You'll Be Doing:
Stack Ownership: Own the onboard software stack from firmware through middleware. That includes software on embedded platforms including SoCs, safety MCUs, and GPU compute; the operating systems, drivers, and interfaces to the physical world; task runtime and compute resource management; system health monitoring; and safety and diagnostics software.
Organizational Leadership: Lead and develop a team of engineering managers and technical leaders. You own hiring, leveling, performance, and career growth for the group, and you will build leaders who can run their teams autonomously.
Cross-Functional Accountability: Be the main contact for onboard software for stakeholder and partner teams. You will settle boundary questions between organizations, run intake and prioritization, and handle escalations when your teams’ software is on the critical path.
Delivering Quality: Define what "done" means for onboard software at each release, including quality metrics to ensure delivery of a safe and reliable product.
What We're Looking For:
Education: BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience.
Experience: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading organizations of 40 or more engineers as a manager of managers. This should be in a field where software runs on physical hardware, such as automotive, robotics, aerospace, or consumer devices.
Systems Software Depth: Hands-on experience building, or leading teams that built, embedded firmware, Linux kernel or BSP software, real-time middleware, or high-performance runtimes. You can talk through boot sequencing, IPC latency, or resource scheduling with Principal Engineers.
Production Operations: Experience running software in production on a fleet or in the field, including keeping a current platform healthy while bringing up the next one.
Technical Leadership: Experience hiring, developing, and retaining talent as an organization grows.
Cross-Organizational Ownership: Experience owning a large area that spans many teams. You build trust with peer organizations, work out boundaries directly, and make decisions people follow.
Communication: Clear writing and speaking. You can explain technical tradeoffs to executives, peers, and engineers across your team and others.
Inclusive Leadership: Experience building inclusive teams and making room for people with different working styles, ideas, and backgrounds.
Engineering Rigor: Ability to set and hold the team to high standards for engineering quality.
Bonus Points (Not Required):
Experience with functional safety in automotive (ISO 26262, safety MCUs, safety monitors, diagnostics), or working closely with a safety organization on requirements and designs for safety-critical/regulated environments.
Experience with high-performance, high-bandwidth, low-latency systems, such as moving large amounts of data across numerous subsystems with tight timing requirements.
Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, where machine learning models sense and act in the real world. That includes how those models run on embedded compute, how they depend on sensors and the onboard runtime, and how on-road and simulation data is used to train and evaluate them.
Experience in the autonomous vehicle or robotaxi industry.
We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

jobs.title: VP of Technology Delivery & Transformation
jobs.text:
Kurt Geiger | About Us
We are an inclusive, creative footwear and accessories brand powered by kindness. We want to empower our talent to be confident and true to themselves, the London way. London is our home, our heartbeat, and we draw inspiration from the energy and spirit of the city; its diversity and creativity. For over fifty years our team of in-house shoe and accessory designers have been creating authentic, distinctive designs from our London headquarters. The rainbow is our signature. It represents the good energy and love we have for our community and the many ways we collectively express our individual style.
Kurt Geiger Digital
Kurt Geiger’s Digital Team is a leading edge, multichannel, global, fully integrated function within the business. We have built an inclusive and diverse team that operates across 4 layers of the Business: Back End Systems and Engineering; Platforms; Marketing; Customer Service.
Our in-house team of over 100 Digital experts are augmented with expertise from partners across the globe to deliver the very best in Retail Technology with a firm eye on the future. We operate in a fully Agile, fast paced environment, with a strong focus on individual leadership talent and development through an integrated Excellency Framework to ensure every member of the team develops the very best leadership development for themselves whilst delivering business objectives in line with growing our Global Digital Brands.
Purpose of the Role
This role is responsible for the successful delivery and operation of the organisation’s technology platforms and engineering capability. It ensures that technology programmes are executed effectively, engineering teams are high performing, and operational systems continue to meet business needs throughout a period of significant transformation.
The role provides leadership across software engineering, enterprise applications and major business systems, overseeing the transition from the current technology landscape to the organisation’s future operating model. It works closely with the SVP of Architecture, Data & AI to ensure all delivery aligns with approved technology strategy, architecture principles and transformation roadmaps.
Initially, the role will oversee IT Operations, ERP, Wholesale & Warehouse Systems, and Software Engineering. As organisational responsibilities transition to the parent company, the role will increasingly focus on two strategic delivery domains:
ERP Transformation (Retail Express → Infor M3)
Digital Engineering Transformation (Adobe Commerce → Shopify)
The role is deliberately focused on execution, delivery, operational excellence and engineering leadership rather than defining long-term technology strategy or enterprise architecture.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
Role Overview
You will be the primary steward of Ajaib’s technical resilience. Your role is to bridge the gap between visionary business objectives and world-class system design, ensuring that our infrastructure scales ahead of our user base.
Your Core Pillars of Impact
1. Architectural Stewardship: Drive the long-term technical direction for our high-traffic microservices. You will ensure our backend systems set the industry benchmark for observability, performance, and financial-grade security.
2. Strategic Orchestration: Serve as the vital link between C-suite objectives and engineering execution. You will manage complex stakeholder expectations, resource allocation, and the technical roadmap for our Digital Bank.
3. Talent Alchemy: You are a "Leader of Leaders." Through sophisticated coaching and mentorship, you will cultivate a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, technical excellence, and professional growth.
4. Operational Maturity: Refine engineering processes to increase innovation throughput. You will identify and eliminate systemic bottlenecks, ensuring the organization maintains "Blitzscaling" speed without compromising stability.

jobs.title: Global Head of Product, T&S Mandarin Required
jobs.text:
Global Head of Product, Trust & Safety (Mandarin Required)
Location:
- Singapore / NYC / Palo Alto
Industry:
- Consumer Internet / Technology
Function:
- Product Management
- Trust & Safety
Language:
- Mandarin & English (Mandatory)
The Company:
Our client is a leading global consumer technology company with a significant international presence and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem. As the business continues to strengthen its international operations, it is investing in advanced Trust & Safety, risk management, and platform governance capabilities to support a safe, trusted, and scalable user experience. We are seeking an experienced Head of Product, Trust & Safety to lead the product strategy, development, and execution of critical safety and risk-management capabilities across international markets.
The Role:
This is a senior product leadership position combining Product Strategy, Trust & Safety, Risk Technology, and People Management. You will lead a team of Product Managers responsible for building and scaling solutions across content safety, platform integrity, risk prevention, policy enforcement, and governance infrastructure. The role requires someone who can translate complex platform risks and operational challenges into scalable product solutions, while balancing user safety, operational efficiency, regulatory considerations, and business objectives. You will work closely with Engineering, Algorithms, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Trust & Safety Operations teams across international markets.
Key Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the international Trust & Safety product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers, establishing clear priorities and execution standards.
- Drive product initiatives across content safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, risk detection, and policy enforcement.
- Develop and optimise moderation platforms, risk-control systems, policy enforcement workflows, and other Trust & Safety infrastructure.
- Partner with Engineering and Algorithm teams to improve automated risk detection, content classification, decisioning, and enforcement capabilities.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and large language models to improve Trust & Safety effectiveness and scalability.
- Translate complex policy, operational, and regulatory requirements into practical product capabilities.
- Establish product success metrics covering risk reduction, enforcement effectiveness, operational efficiency, and user experience.
- Ensure product capabilities can support different international markets, languages, cultural contexts, and regulatory environments.
- Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Operations.
- Collaborate closely with senior stakeholders and technical teams based in China to align international product priorities with global platform capabilities.
The Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for a senior Product leader with strong experience developing and scaling complex technology products, ideally within Trust & Safety, platform governance, risk control, or related areas. The strongest candidates will have:
- Significant Product Management experience, including leadership responsibility within a technology or consumer internet environment.
- Proven experience directly managing a team of at least 5 Product Managers (mandatory requirement).
- Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, owning complex roadmaps, and delivering products at scale.
- Strong understanding of Trust & Safety, content moderation, risk detection, policy enforcement, or platform integrity systems.
- Experience developing complex internal platforms, risk-control products, or operational technology systems.
- Strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Algorithms, and Data Science teams.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience defining product metrics and driving data-informed decisions.
- Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
- Strong people leadership, organisational development, and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Experience within a large-scale consumer internet, social media, UGC, marketplace, or technology platform would be highly advantageous.
- Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, international environment.
Language Requirements:
- Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is mandatory.
- Candidates must be comfortable conducting senior-level product strategy discussions, technical discussions, and stakeholder alignment in Mandarin.

jobs.title: VP Product Management
jobs.text:
Our client is a leader in AP Payments as a Service, specializing in embedded B2B payments. They streamline the payment process by integrating electronic payment and cash flow solutions into accounts payable and procurement software.
Their vision is for finance leaders to decide only "what" to pay, while their software manages the "how" and "when."
The company is a major disruptor in B2B Payments and Fintech, growing revenue by over 100% annually. They've raised over $65M from investors like JP Morgan, Discover, NBH Bank, Mendon Venture Partners, and Valley Bankwho are also customers and partners.
Role Overview:
As the Vice President of Product Management, you will shape and drive our software roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering top-notch results. You will lead a dynamic team, defining product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, or related field; MBA preferred.
8-10 years in product management with a proven track record.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Expertise in product development processes and methodologies.
Experience in B2B, technology, software, or SaaS industries.
Success in product innovation and revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Act as the primary liaison between business P&L owners and the product development team.
Drive product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Ensure leadership alignment and support for product management methodologies.
Define and manage internal and external product roadmaps.
Develop processes for customer feedback management and prioritize needs.
Install project plan methodology for efficient product commercialization.
Create C-suite/board-ready presentation materials on product strategy.
Develop external materials communicating product strategy and value.
Collaborate with P&L owners to develop business cases for product initiatives.
Execute product commercialization, planning, and go-to-market strategies.
Foster strong relationships with internal customers and support their needs.
Conduct market analysis to understand current and future needs.
Establish and track KPIs to measure and optimize product performance.
Lead and delegate product management and commercialization activities.
Benefits:
Fast-paced start-up environment with experienced leaders.
Opportunities to engage with the latest technologies and make a measurable impact.
Quarterly virtual team-building activities and monthly team lunches.
Competitive salary ($150,000 - $175,000) plus equity.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Unlimited vacation policy.
This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role
Navable is hiring a senior, hands-on Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering to own the technical foundation of the company.
This is a foundational leadership role for an experienced full-stack engineer who wants real ownership across architecture, execution, AI strategy, and team building — with a clear path to leading Navable’s long-term engineering organization.
You will work directly with the Founder & CEO to:
Scale and harden our core platform
Architect systems built for financial accuracy, auditability, and security
Execute on a roadmap of AI-powered products embedded directly into fund operations workflows
Establish engineering standards and hire our early in-house team
In the near term, this role is deeply hands-on. You will write production code, own architectural decisions, manage external engineering resources, and establish engineering standards. Over time, you will hire and lead a growing in-house team.
While this is a remote role, candidates must be based in the U.S., with a strong preference for someone in the greater New York area.
What You’ll Own
Architecture & Platform
Own system architecture and technical roadmap
Evolve our carry and compensation engine to support increasingly complex firm structures
Ensure scalability, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability
AI Product Execution
Lead development of AI-based features that enhance workflows, automation, and decision support
Translate real customer pain points into practical, production-ready AI solutions
Establish the foundation for applied AI across the Navable platform
Hands-On Development
Write high-quality production code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure
Lead technical refactors and improve developer velocity
Security & Compliance
Design secure systems appropriate for institutional financial clients
Support SOC 2 and enterprise security requirements
Engineering Leadership
Manage current external engineering resources
Define hiring needs and build Navable’s in-house engineering team
Establish strong engineering culture and standards
Who You Are
Senior full-stack engineer with early-stage startup experience
Have owned architecture through periods of growth
Comfortable across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure
Experienced building systems that handle sensitive financial or regulated data
Excited about applying AI in structured, high-value enterprise workflows
Thrive in high-ownership, ambiguous environments
Want to build and lead an enduring engineering organization
Compensation
Competitive base salary
Meaningful equity ownership
Flexible PTO
This is an opportunity to define the technical and AI foundation of a company building infrastructure for the alternative asset ecosystem.

jobs.title: Director, Developer Relations
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As Director, Developer Relations – Europe, you will lead Roblox’s developer ecosystem strategy and growth across Europe. You will be accountable for defining the regional strategy, establishing the partnerships and programs required to execute it, and delivering measurable outcomes for the Roblox developer ecosystem.
You will build deep relationships with leading developers, studios, publishers, technology partners, and emerging creators while identifying the next generation of high-potential partners for Roblox. You will serve as a senior representative of Roblox within the regional games and technology industries and as an executive-level advocate for the needs and opportunities of developers within Roblox.
This role requires both strategic vision and operational leadership. You will translate Roblox’s global priorities into a regional strategy, identify opportunities and barriers to ecosystem growth, and mobilize teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Creator, and International to deliver against those opportunities.
Note: This is a 1-year contract position, with the potential to convert to a full-time role, subject to business needs and mutual agreement.
You Have
Tack record of building trusted relationships with game developers, studios, or publishers. Developer relations, partner or account management, business development, licensing or partnerships experience preferred
Experienced leading regional or ecosystem strategy with measurable business impact.
Deeply knowledgeable about the games and developer landscape in Europe.
Able to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
Data-driven, strategic, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
Familiar with Roblox Studio, Unity, Unreal, or similar development tools.
Proficiency in one or more of the following European languages is a plus: Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Swedish, or Finnish.
Based in the Netherlands or willing to relocate.
You Will
Own the multi-year developer ecosystem strategy for Europe.
Drive developer acquisition, engagement, and long-term success.
Build executive relationships with key studios, publishers, and ecosystem partners.
Identify regional developer needs and influence Roblox product priorities.
Set goals, metrics, and operating rhythms for regional ecosystem growth.
Partner cross-functionally to turn strategy into execution.
Represent Roblox at major industry and developer events.
Surface market trends, opportunities, and risks to senior leadership.
Build and lead the regional Developer Relations organization as the opportunity grows.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means that Roblox has a clear and durable developer ecosystem strategy for Europe, stronger relationships with the region’s most important developers and studios, a growing pipeline of high-potential developers building on Roblox, and a measurable increase in the quality and success of experiences emerging from the region.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: VP Data Management
jobs.text:
Vice President Data Management
Department: Data Management
Location: Remote (USA-based, with travel as required)
Job Summary
The Vice President of Data Management is an executive leader responsible for overseeing client engagement strategy, delivery success, account growth, and financial performance across a diverse set of industry verticals (e.g., Sports & Entertainment, Media, CPG, Manufacturing, Energy, CPG etc).
This role combines hands-on leadership in data management with a consultative approach to solving complex enterprise data challenges. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in a global consulting firm, a strong background in enterprise data management (EDM), and a track record of owning P&L, building high-performing teams, and delivering measurable client outcomes across varied sectors.
Key Responsibilities
40% Vertical Expansion & Strategic Growth
Drive $10M+ in annual revenue through the growth of client accounts across diversified industries.
Build industry-specific go-to-market strategies and consultative solutions in EDM, data governance, data platforms, and analytics.
Lead client portfolio strategy and collaborate with business unit leaders to shape offerings and account pursuits.
Act as a strategic advisor to client executives across industries, identifying opportunities to expand data and analytics services.
30% Client Relationship Leadership
Serve as the executive sponsor for client engagements, ensuring business value delivery and client satisfaction.
Cultivate long-term C-level relationships and identify opportunities for cross-sell and upsell into data, digital, analytics, cloud, and AI/ML.
Conduct executive business reviews, ROI demonstrations, and client feedback sessions to ensure alignment with client goals.
Lead strategic solutioning and proposal development for complex data transformation programs.
15% Engagement Oversight & Operations
Oversee delivery excellence through structured engagement metrics, governance, and financial tracking (revenue, margins, utilization).
Manage SOW execution, change orders, and project escalations to ensure delivery success.
Coordinate with finance, delivery, and resourcing to forecast, provision, and optimize account profitability.
10% Leadership & Talent Development
Mentor project leaders, solution architects, and client partners; build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and skills development initiatives across the data management practice.
Serve as an executive presence in internal forums and industry events to elevate brand and talent attraction.
5% Cross-BU Collaboration & Other Duties
Partner with leaders from analytics, digital, and AI/ML to develop joint offerings.
Contribute to IP development, industry playbooks, and reusable accelerators in EDM and cloud data solutions.
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
15+ years of experience in enterprise data management and transformation (EDM, data warehousing, MDM, data quality, governance).
10+ years in a consulting or professional services environment, with delivery, practice, and business development responsibilities.
Prior P&L ownership and demonstrated success in growing multi-million-dollar accounts across different industries.
Experience leading pre-sales, proposals, and solution shaping with cross-functional delivery and sales teams.
Nice to Have
Domain expertise in at least 2 - 3 industries such as CPG, Retail, Manufacturing, Sports & Entertainment.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, AWS, Azure), MDM tools, and governance frameworks.
Certifications in Agile, PMP, or industry-standard data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
Exposure to emerging technologies like AI/ML, GenAI, and real-time data integration tools.
Key Skills & Competencies
Expertise in leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery teams (onshore/offshore).
Strong executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Deep understanding of SDLC, agile methodologies, and data modernization strategies.
Proven consultative approach to client problems and solution selling.
Analytical and financial acumen in managing forecasts, staffing, and revenue targets.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Direct oversight of account leads, project managers, and solution architects across engagements.
Provides regular feedback, performance evaluations, and growth path development for team members.
Collaborates with HR and competency leads to manage hiring and team health.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, TradingView (Growth & Trading Experience)
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.
What You’ll Be Doing
Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity —
Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey —
Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention —
Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships —
Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration —
Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment —
Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.
What We Look For In You
Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.
Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.
An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.
Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.
Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.
Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.
What Success Looks Like
An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.
Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Hey, mabuhay! 👋
Thanks for dropping by. We know looking for the right job can feel like being stuck in EDSA traffic, so we’ll keep it moving and get straight to the point.
With over 8 million downloads and a powerful network of thousand of dedicated biker-partners, we are a leading ride-hailing platform operating across the Philippines. Our vision is to end poverty in the Philippines through revolutionary transportation solutions. We aim to provide our customers with convenient, reliable, and safe rides, impacting millions of lives positively every single day.
Now, we're looking for a Head of Engineering. You will lead our multi-team engineering organization across our customer and driver apps, backend platforms, and operations tools, while spearheading our transition to an AI-native organization.
Responsibilities:
Keep mission-critical services reliable. Build robust, highly available systems at scale, designed to self-heal and backed by tested failover and disaster recovery for critical workflows.
Lead incidents end to end. Take command when things break, coordinate across engineering, SRE, and Ops, drive rigorous RCAs, and put preventive measures in place so issues don't recur.
Build a healthy, high-performing org. Grow the engineering organization through hiring as well as career and skill development. Set a culture of ownership and align teams around clear goals and metrics.
Deliver the roadmap predictably. Work with Product to shape features and sharpen scope, ensuring solutions are scalable, well architected, and built as reusable platforms. Keep commitments predictable, rescue projects that drift, and make releases safe.
Set the technical bar. Quality-gate architecture and designs for scalability, security, and cost before they reach the CTO, and provide senior technical direction across squads.
Raise the bar on velocity and stability. Establish meaningful delivery and reliability metrics for our systems and teams, use them to spot bottlenecks, and remove what slows engineers down.
Lead the shift to AI-native engineering. Use AI to improve developer experience: remove friction and toil from how engineers build, review, ship, and operate, and drive measurable gains in speed, quality, and system health.
At Angkas, we believe in giving our people the trust and flexibility to work in a way that helps them and their teams perform at their best. Whether you’re working onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid setup, we provide the flexibility, you bring the drive. ⚡
Let’s get this show on the road!🚦

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Data
jobs.text:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
The Opportunity
At Praxis, we’re building the commercial capabilities to bring transformative therapies to patients with CNS disorders—and we’re looking for builders who dare for more.
As Director, Commercial Data, you will own the strategy and build the trusted, connected, and AI-ready data foundation that powers smarter decisions, accelerates execution, and enables our commercial organization to scale through launch and beyond.
You will work at the intersection of Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to turn business priorities into high-impact data solutions. You will challenge conventional approaches, establish clear data governance and accountability, and ensure our teams have access to reliable, actionable insights when they need them. With a builder’s mindset and a bias for action, you will identify opportunities to leverage analytics, automation, and AI to elevate customer engagement, strengthen commercial performance, and ultimately help us deliver more for patients.
Primary Responsibilities
Build and continuously advance a trusted commercial data environment across customer, product, payer, patient, engagement, and other critical commercial data domains.
Establish the business requirements, standards, ownership, and operating model needed to ensure commercial data is connected, well-defined, high quality, accessible, and ready to support analytics and AI.
Advance commercial data readiness to support emerging AI capabilities.
Partner with business, analytics, product, and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities, define the data and business context required, and develop reusable capabilities that scale across commercial functions rather than isolated solutions.
Establish and lead a commercial data governance framework that ensures data is trusted, consistent, and fit for purpose across reporting, analytics, automation, and AI. Define clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, common definitions, hierarchies, metrics, metadata, and business rules.
Proactively monitor data quality, resolve issues at their root cause, and establish accountability for maintaining trusted data as the business scales.
Partner across Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to identify and prioritize opportunities where data, analytics, automation, and AI can improve decision-making and commercial execution.
Translate business priorities into actionable capabilities, establish clear ownership and success measures, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners to drive adoption, measurable business impact, and scalable ways of working.
Qualifications and Key Success Factors
8+ years of relevant experience in commercial data, analytics, commercial operations, data strategy, or related roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences organizations.
Experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial operations, ideally including a product launch or significant commercial expansion.
Demonstrated ability to translate commercial priorities into a data strategy, capability roadmap, and investment recommendations, ideally in a launch or rapidly growing organization.
Experience establishing data governance, ownership, quality standards, and operating processes that improve trust in and use of data.
Practical understanding of AI and automation, with the ability to assess use cases, define business requirements, and evaluate value, feasibility, and responsible use.
Ability to partner effectively with IT, data engineering, analytics, and commercial systems teams, with sufficient technical fluency to guide business decisions and delivery priorities.
Strong communication and changing leadership skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, managing external partners, and driving adoption in a fast-moving environment.
The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$213,500—$243,000 USD
Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let’s achieve the impossible together!
Company Overview
Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to
does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.
