jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
About Onfleet
Onfleet is the last-mile delivery platform behind millions of deliveries every month for thousands of businesses around the world. We enable shippers to manage deliveries across their private fleet, carriers, and couriers. We make it easy for dispatchers to plan and run their operations, drivers to execute deliveries, and recipients to get real-time tracking and notifications. Our customers span grocery, prepared meals, pharmacy, flowers, furniture, and more.
The Role
We're looking for a Vice President of Product to lead Product at Onfleet, owning how our strategy gets translated into roadmaps and how roadmaps turn into shipped, adopted products. Your job is to sharpen our strategy where needed and define how the Onfleet product suite evolves as we scale up in a fast-growing market. This is a hands-on leadership seat where you'll stay close to the details and roll up your sleeves when the team needs it.
You'll report to our CEO and lead Product Management, Design, and User Research. You’ll also work closely with Engineering, QA, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience. As our senior-most product leader, you'll sit on our Strategic Leadership Team and represent Product in company planning.
What You'll Do
Own the product roadmap that delivers on our strategy, and update both as our market and target customers change.
Prioritize aggressively by committing to a few well-scoped bets per quarter and saying no to other competing initiatives.
Build deep knowledge of the last-mile delivery industry and our core users: shippers, carriers and couriers, dispatchers, drivers, and recipients.
Lead quarterly and annual planning with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and partner with them to set company goals that tie product work to business outcomes.
Own how we gather, prioritize, and close the loop on product feedback from customers, Sales, CX, and other internal teams.
Coordinate work across squads so dependencies and risks surface early, and keep one roadmap view the whole company can see.
Connect product success metrics to company metrics, and build a team habit of defining success before launch and acting on what adoption data shows.
Represent Product internally and with our board of directors, customer advisory boards, and key customers.
Foster a collaborative team culture and think ahead about team structure, process, and tooling.
Coach the team and define clear growth paths for each member.
What You'll Bring
You have 10+ years in B2B SaaS product roles, including 5+ years leading product teams and 3+ years as Director of Product or above.
You've run Product at a Series B+ company generating tens of millions of dollars in ARR.
You've led a product through a move upmarket into enterprise.
You've directly hired, managed, and developed Product Managers, Designers, and User Researchers.
You have significant UX and design experience, and you champion it across the company. You've overseen teams that run usability tests, user interviews, and experiments.
You've partnered with Engineering as equals: scoping work together before committing, keeping scope stable once work starts, and shipping in small iterations.
You've run market research to size opportunities in a customer base and adjacent markets.
You make roadmap calls by weighing customer evidence, usage data, strategy, and business impact, and you explain the trade-offs clearly.
You're analytical, using data to make decisions and hold yourself and your team to the numbers.
You've built or managed a Product Operations function, with working fluency in tools like Jira, Productboard, and Amplitude.
You communicate clearly in writing and in person.
You're highly organized and focused on outcomes.
Nice To Have
Experience in last-mile logistics or delivery.
What We Offer
Remote-first work environment with quarterly domestic travel
Generous employee stock options
Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k)
Flexible PTO
Onfleet Is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.
We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.
We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job Description
Vice President, Enterprise Data Strategy & Governance (Solventum)
3M Health Care is now Solventum
At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.
We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.
The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Vice President, Enterprise Data Strategy & Governance, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
Defining and evolving the enterprise data strategy aligned to business priorities, digital transformation goals, and the operating model
Driving the design and adoption of enterprise data governance frameworks, including data ownership, stewardship, quality, and standards
Partnering with IT and business leaders to shape scalable data platforms, including cloud, MDM, metadata, and analytics capabilities
Establishing governance forums and executive steering committees to align priorities, manage risk, and ensure value realization
Leading cross-functional change management to embed data-driven decision-making, trusted data usage, and enterprise-wide adoption
Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND fifteen (15) years of experience in enterprise data strategy, governance, analytics, or digital transformation
OR
High School Diploma/GED AND nineteen (19) years of experience in enterprise data strategy, governance, analytics, or digital transformation
AND
In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:
Proven success implementing or maturing enterprise data governance frameworks in complex, multi-business unit organizations
Deep expertise in data architecture, MDM, metadata, data quality, lineage, and modern cloud data platforms
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across business and technology functions
Experience leading large-scale transformation, operating model design, and cross-functional change initiatives
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics into actionable insights
Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
Master’s degree in Data, Information Systems, Business, or a related field from an accredited institution
Experience building and leading enterprise data governance organizations and data domain models
Strong strategic thinking with a focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and enterprise value creation
Work location: Remote
Travel: May include up to 20%
Relocation Assistance: May be authorized
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).
Supporting Your Well-being
Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other comparable organizations.
Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.

jobs.title: SVP, Technology
jobs.text:
Lead the Future of Financial Technology
We are seeking an experienced and transformational Senior Vice President of Technology to lead a diverse portfolio of cloud-based fintech products serving customers across accounts payable automation, source-to-pay, supplier networks, electronic invoicing, and payments. This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a technology leader who thrives in complex environments and has a passion for modernizing platforms, scaling global teams, and building an AI-first culture and delivery model that redefines how software is created and delivered.
As the SVP, Technology - you will oversee Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Customer Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Security. You'll lead a global organization while shaping the technology strategy that will accelerate growth, improve operational excellence, and unify a portfolio of products into a modern, scalable ecosystem.
What You'll Do
Define and Execute Technology Strategy
Execute the technology vision, roadmap, and investment strategy across a portfolio of SaaS products.
Lead platform modernization initiatives, including architecture simplification, cloud optimization, and AI-enabled product capabilities.
Partner with executive leadership to evaluate technology investments, product consolidation opportunities, and strategic initiatives, supported by clear, well-constructed business cases.
Champion a service-pack based strategy for delivering key platform enhancements and features, including agentic plug-ins, APIs, and reporting, on a predictable cadence.
Drive Engineering Excellence
Lead high-performing engineering, quality assurance, and DevOps organizations responsible for building, securing, and operating mission-critical SaaS solutions.
Establish best practices across software development, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and engineering operations.
Create and lead an AI-focused culture and development delivery model that drives order-of-magnitude productivity gains, more reliable release cycles, and continuous improvements in quality and efficiency.
Scale Global Teams and Delivery
Lead and develop a globally distributed organization of employees and strategic technology partners.
Build a culture focused on accountability, execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Manage outsourced engineering and operations partnerships to ensure high-quality outcomes and cost-effective delivery.
Elevate Customer Experience
Lead Customer Engineering teams responsible for onboarding, implementation, integrations, and application support.
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Operations leaders to improve customer adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
Standardize implementation and support processes to accelerate time-to-value.
Ensure product delivery remains aligned to customer needs and business strategy, translating customer insight into platform priorities and measurable outcomes.
Ensure Security, Reliability, and Compliance
Own cloud operations, infrastructure performance, security, compliance, and business continuity.
Lead programs supporting PCI DSS, SOC compliance, data protection, vulnerability management, and regulatory requirements.
Drive cloud modernization through automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and cost optimization.
Build Organizational Capability
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional technology leaders.
Lead workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational transformation initiatives.
Own technology budgets, vendor relationships, and technology investment planning.
What Success Looks Like
Within your first year, you will:
Establish clear technical ownership and accountability across every product.
Improve release predictability, software quality, and operational performance.
Reduce key-person and vendor dependency through stronger documentation, processes, and organizational design.
Strengthen security, compliance, and operational maturity across the portfolio.
Develop a technology roadmap that positions the organization for long-term growth and innovation.
Embed AI-assisted development practices across the organization, demonstrating order-of-magnitude productivity gains and more reliable release cycles.
Launch a service-pack delivery model for key platform enhancements, including agentic plug-ins, APIs, and reporting.
Requirements
Required Qualifications
15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including executive-level responsibility across multiple technology functions.
Proven experience leading software engineering, QA, cloud operations, and customer-facing technical organizations for SaaS products.
Experience in customer-facing roles, with demonstrated success aligning product delivery to customer needs and business strategy.
Experience managing complex, multi-product environments, including acquired or legacy platforms.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, software quality, and modern engineering practices.
Experience leading AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, with measurable gains in engineering productivity and release reliability.
Experience in fintech, payments, or another highly regulated industry.
Demonstrated success leading global, distributed teams and third-party technology partners.
Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, business case development, vendor management, and technology investment decisions.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Business Administration.
Experience in private equity-backed organizations and transformation environments.
Experience applying AI and automation to both customer-facing products and engineering operations, including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
Background in accounts payable automation, procure-to-pay, electronic invoicing, or payments platforms.
Relevant cloud, security, or technology leadership certifications.
Why Join Us?
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of a growing fintech platform portfolio while leading large-scale technology transformation initiatives. You'll have executive visibility, significant influence over strategy, and the ability to build a modern technology organization that delivers measurable business impact.
If you're a transformational technology executive who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director of Advertising Technology and Operations
jobs.text:
The Director of Advertising Technology & Operations leads the IT function that supports Lee Enterprises’ advertising business. The role is accountable for the reliability and direction of advertising platforms, integrations, and technical operations spanning sales and order entry, digital fulfillment, creative and print production, billing and payments, and reporting. The Director leads technical staff, sets priorities across daily support and change initiatives, and serves as a primary IT partner to Advertising leadership. Working with Finance, Sales Enablement, Product, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security, the PMO, and vendors, this position turns business needs into practical technology plans and provides leadership for major implementations and migrations.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
Directly supervises and develops the platform support analysts and other technical staff assigned to Advertising Operations. Sets individual and team priorities, allocates work, manages performance, plans coverage and succession, and supports staff development. Core Responsibilities:
Own the IT strategy and operational performance of advertising order management, CRM and sales workflows, creative and production systems, digital advertising, payment processing, reporting, and related third-party platforms. Directly lead the platform support analysts and other assigned technical staff; establish priorities, allocate capacity, develop employees, and maintain support coverage and institutional knowledge for critical systems. Partner with Advertising and IT leadership to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and a prioritized Jira backlog, balancing operational support, enhancements, and project delivery against available capacity. Oversee application support, incident escalation, problem resolution, upgrades, change management, and operational readiness for revenue- and production-critical systems. Lead the technical and operational aspects of platform implementations and migrations, including requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization, and transition or retirement of legacy systems. Oversee integrations and data flows among order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, creative and pagination systems, billing, payments, and reporting; establish priorities for configuration, automation, and enhancements. Ensure system changes are tested across connected workflows and validated with business users, including production checks and reconciliation where transactions affect financial records. Partner with Finance on advertising billing, accounts receivable, payments, reconciliation, and controls at the points where advertising and financial systems meet. Coordinate with development, architecture, infrastructure, security, and service management teams to resolve issues and align platforms with enterprise standards. Manage advertising technology vendor relationships, including escalations, implementation commitments, service performance, technical requirements, and product direction. Maintain operational documentation, access governance, audit support, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices for advertising systems. Use Jira and a regular Agile planning and review cadence to track commitments, completed work, blockers, and dependencies; report delivery progress, system health, risks, and resource needs to IT leadership and business stakeholders. Coordinate timely response to critical issues, including after-hours escalation when necessary.
Preferred Skills & Experience:
Experience leading enterprise applications and technical teams in a complex, integrated operating environment. Ability to direct work across application support, systems analysis, integrations, production technology, and software development disciplines. Working knowledge of APIs, data exchanges, automation, vendor-hosted platforms, and the controls needed to support reliable cross-system processes. Experience leading major implementations, migrations, upgrades, and vendor relationships while balancing ongoing support needs. Ability to use Agile practices and Jira to manage a transparent backlog, guide planning and delivery reviews, and communicate progress and technical risks to engineers, vendors, business partners, and senior leaders. Advertising, media, order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, payment, or production systems experience preferred; familiarity with Naviga Ad, Adbase, HubSpot, Google Ad Manager, or related platforms is an advantage.
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT, enterprise applications, business systems, or related work, including at least three years leading technical teams or major technology programs. Experience supporting integrated systems in a multi-location or enterprise environment preferred.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management, Social
jobs.text:
Job Description:
Build the Future of Social Technology at Scale
Social is evolving fast. The technology that powers it should too.
At dentsu, we're looking for a strategic product leader who understands the intersection of social media, marketing technology, data, and product innovation. If you're passionate about building enterprise products, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and shaping the future of social activation technology, this could be the role you've been waiting for.
As our VP, Product Management, Social, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products that support audience intelligence, social activation, creator workflows, reporting, measurement, and emerging AI-powered capabilities across our media technology ecosystem.
This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll influence senior stakeholders, collaborate across business and technology teams, and drive products from concept through launch and adoption.
What You'll Do
Set the Vision
Develop and communicate a multi-year product vision for dentsu's social activation portfolio.
Identify market opportunities across social media, creator marketing, audience intelligence, AI, identity, privacy, and workflow automation.
Turn ambiguous business challenges into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
Drive Product Strategy & Execution
Lead cross-functional product initiatives involving business, engineering, data, design, operations, and external partners.
Prioritize investments, features, integrations, and platform enhancements based on customer needs and business impact.
Ensure products move from vision to delivery while maintaining alignment with strategic goals.
Create Scalable Solutions
Transform one-off client solutions into repeatable, productized offerings.
Improve workflows through automation, orchestration, and platform integration.
Establish operating models that support adoption, onboarding, support, reporting, and long-term growth.
Influence & Collaborate
Partner with senior leaders across social, media, technology, data, commercial, and product organizations.
Support executive presentations, strategic client discussions, product demonstrations, and new business opportunities.
Serve as a trusted advisor on social technology, activation, audience intelligence, and product strategy.
What Makes You a Great Fit
You're a product leader who can see the big picture while remaining close enough to the details to get things done.
You likely bring:
10+ years of product management, product strategy, AdTech, MarTech, media technology, SaaS, or related experience.
Experience building product vision and strategy, not just managing features or backlogs.
Deep understanding of social media technologies, workflows, and activation platforms.
Experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions and actionable plans.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Why Join dentsu?
This is an opportunity to shape a strategic growth area within one of the world's leading marketing and technology organizations.
You'll have the chance to:
Define the future of social activation products at enterprise scale.
Influence AI-enabled and next-generation workflow solutions.
Partner with industry leaders across media, technology, and data.
Solve complex challenges with real business impact.
Help create products used by practitioners and clients across the dentsu ecosystem.
Ready to Build What's Next?
We're looking for a leader who understands social technology, thrives in complexity, and can turn vision into reality. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.
At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.
The annual salary range for this position is $1360,000 - $170,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.
Benefits available with this position include:
• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
• Life insurance,
• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
• 401k,
• Flexible paid time off,
• At least 15 paid holidays per year,
• Paid sick and safe leave, and
• Paid parental leave.
Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

Career-defining. Life-changing.
At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. About This Role:
iRhythm is seeking a Vice President of Software Engineering to provide technical and organizational leadership across our regulated software platforms. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Systems Development, this leader is accountable for ensuring the successful delivery, performance, and scalability of software products and platforms. These solutions enable clinician workflows, enhance patient experiences, integrate connected medical devices, and provide the data infrastructure necessary to support innovation, operational excellence, and growth. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution at scale, requiring executive leadership and offering exceptional visibility across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Software Delivery & Operational Execution
Lead end-to-end software engineering execution across clinical, patient-facing, platform, and device-integrated software systems within a highly regulated Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) environment.
Establish and continuously evolve the engineering operating systems, governance frameworks, and development practices that enable disciplined planning, transparent execution, effective risk management, and predictable delivery across a complex software portfolio.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives that measurably enhance engineering velocity, product quality, release confidence, system reliability, and customer outcomes.
Ensure software development lifecycle processes consistently meet regulatory, compliance, and quality standards, including FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, cybersecurity, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
Translate complex technical concepts, delivery risks, and strategic tradeoffs into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Advance software engineering capabilities through scalable CI/CD frameworks, development platforms, automation, and engineering enablement tools appropriate for regulated medical technology environments.
Lead the responsible adoption and governance of AI-assisted software development practices to accelerate innovation, enhance productivity, improve quality, and reduce delivery risk.
Establish a metrics-driven engineering culture by leveraging meaningful operational and quality indicators to increase transparency, predictability, accountability, and data-informed decision making.
Team Development & Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of software engineering directors, managers, and senior technical leaders, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Serve as a thought leader, trusted advisor and mentor to engineering leaders, cultivating leadership capability, organizational resilience, and a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical excellence across the company.
Cross-Functional & Strategic Contributions
Partner closely with executive and functional leaders across Product Security, Software Quality, Research & Systems Engineering, Machine Learning, and IT to ensure seamless execution, architectural alignment, and delivery excellence across the product portfolio.
Drive alignment and shared accountability across Product Management, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and other cross-functional teams to successfully deliver innovative solutions from concept through commercialization.
Lead software engineering diligence, technical assessments, and post-acquisition integration activities in support of the company's mergers and acquisitions strategy.
Contribute to the development and execution of the long-term software platform, architecture, and technology strategy, ensuring scalability, innovation, and competitive differentiation.
Qualifications
Required Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive software engineering leadership experience, including leadership of large-scale engineering organizations and senior technology leaders.
Demonstrated success leading the development and delivery of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions within highly regulated medical device environments.
Proven track record bringing complex regulated software products from concept and development through verification, validation, regulatory approval, commercialization, and post-market support.
Deep expertise in FDA software regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and medical device quality systems, with a strong understanding of applying these requirements within modern software development environments.
Experience leading complex, matrixed software engineering organizations through periods of growth, transformation, organizational change, and technology modernization.
Preferred Experience
Experience spanning both high-growth and established healthcare, medical device, digital health, or regulated technology organizations.
Experience scaling software organizations supporting connected products, cloud platforms, data ecosystems, and customer-facing applications.
Exposure to technical diligence, integration planning, or software leadership support for mergers and acquisitions.
Demonstrated success modernizing software delivery capabilities, including CI/CD frameworks, automation, and engineering productivity tools within regulated environments.
Practical experience evaluating, implementing, and governing AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering effectiveness, product quality, and delivery outcomes.
Leadership Profile
Strategic and execution-oriented leader with the ability to translate business priorities into operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Equally comfortable shaping long-term technology strategy and engaging directly in delivery execution, organizational design, and engineering operations.
Proven builder of high-performing teams and leadership talent, with a strong track record of developing leaders and creating a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional cross-functional collaborator capable of influencing executive stakeholders and aligning diverse teams around shared objectives.
Data-driven, pragmatic, and decisive, with the ability to balance speed, quality, regulatory compliance, and business impact.
Resilient and adaptable leader who thrives in complex environments and successfully leads organizations through change, growth, and transformation.

jobs.title: Firm-wide Data Governance - Data Quality and Data Contracts - Vice President
jobs.text:
You will drive the execution of data governance across large-scale initiatives. This role sits at the center of improving data quality, strengthening controls, and enabling teams to manage data effectively. You will influence outcomes by ensuring data is governed with consistency and accountability.
As a Data Quality Governance Lead in the Firmwide Data Governance Function, you will lead the design and implementation of comprehensive data governance frameworks that ensure data integrity, quality, and compliance across the organization. Your role is pivotal in shaping the strategic direction of data management practices, influencing operational and business decisions that extend beyond immediate outcomes. You will leverage your deep expertise in regulatory compliance and data quality to mitigate risks and safeguard our reputation. By fostering collaboration across diverse teams, you will drive the adoption of best practices and innovative solutions, ensuring our data assets are responsibly managed and aligned with business goals. Your leadership will empower teams to navigate complex data challenges, enhancing our operational efficiency and supporting sustainable growth.
Job responsibilities
Develop and enforce data quality governance policies and standards to ensure compliance with data quality standards
Lead the design and implementation of data quality controls and data contracts for firm's most important data
Establish governance strategy, operating model, and ownership
Oversee adoption and implementation of data quality controls and data contracts for critical data elements along the lineage
Partner with CDOs, Data Owners, product, and technology teams to implement and enhance tooling solutions
Lead governance forums and cross-functional engagement to data quality and data contracts implementation across the bank for scoped activities.
Resolve complex data issues by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions
Drive the adoption of change management initiatives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in data governance practices
Build knowledge of how business areas, architecture, applications, data platforms, and infrastructure integrate to accomplish business goals
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
8 years of experience or equivalent expertise in designing and implementing data governance frameworks and policies
Experience in data, analytics, or product roles supporting data governance outcomes
Hands on experience in driving data quality transformation programs including data quality controls, data contracts, and lineage
Experience implementing enterprise Data Quality controls and monitoring frameworks
Experience with industry tools like Collibra, Snowflake, Databricks
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional and multi-disciplinary teams
Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and project management skills

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
BrightHire is a category-creating, high-growth, Series B software company with a mission to give everyone the hiring experience they deserve.
We deliver on this mission by transforming the way many of the world’s leading companies build exceptional teams. We created the Interview Intelligence category, and our clients include some of the world’s most innovative companies—Canva, OpenAI, Ramp, Hubspot—up to the Fortune 500.
BrightHire is building a leading AI-native hiring platform.
We created the Interview Intelligence category by applying conversation intelligence to how companies evaluate and hire talent. Today, hundreds of organizations—from Ramp and Canva to SAP and HCA Healthcare —use BrightHire to make better hiring decisions, improve interviewer performance, and deliver stronger candidate experiences.
BrightHire is now part of Zoom and operates as a stand-alone business unit. This gives us a rare combination of startup velocity and global scale. We are growing more than 100% year over year, with significant opportunities to accelerate through Zoom’s technology, distribution, customer relationships, and broader platform.
We currently have two rapidly growing products:
BrightHire Interview: Conversation intelligence for human-led interviews.
BrightHire Screen: An AI interviewer for structured candidate screening at scale.
This is only the beginning. Our ambition is to become one of the three most consequential hiring platforms in the world.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional Head of Product to lead BrightHire’s next chapter.
You will be our senior-most product leader, responsible for helping determine where we play, how we win, and how we translate our ambition into products that create meaningful customer and business impact.
You will rapidly build context across our customers, products, technology, market, competitive landscape, and commercial model. From that context, you will develop a clear point of view about the opportunities that matter most and translate it into a focused set of high-conviction product investments.
You will lead product across BrightHire Interview, BrightHire Screen, and future products. This will require difficult decisions about how to balance products with strong existing momentum, platform investments, and entirely new opportunities created by advances in AI.
A critical part of the role is bringing leverage to the CEO, Head of Engineering, and broader leadership team. You will bring clear recommendations, articulate the underlying reasoning and trade-offs, and help the organization make better and faster decisions about where to focus its resources.
You will also ensure that strategy translates into excellent execution. You will stay close to customers, active product work, roadmap decisions, product reviews, launches, and adoption—helping teams resolve ambiguity, raise product quality, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
You will work across Zoom to identify R&D, platform, go-to-market, and distribution synergies that can create differentiation and growth at a scale BrightHire could not achieve independently.
The goal is not to build a large product organization for its own sake. It is to build an exceptional product and business. The right candidate is motivated by customer impact, product quality, strategic advantage, and growth—not team size or span of control.
What You’ll Do
Define how BrightHire wins
Rapidly develop a deep understanding of our customers, products, market, technology, economics, and competitive position.
Develop a clear perspective on strategy – where BrightHire should play and how we can win.
Translate our strategy into a focused sequence of product investments.
Bring the CEO and leadership team clear points of view, recommendations, and trade-offs.
Continually reassess our assumptions and priorities as the market and technology evolves.
Lead a multi-product portfolio
Partner with the CEO and Head of Engineering on strategy, roadmap, resourcing, execution, launches, adoption, and business impact.
Allocate resources across BrightHire’s current products, platform capabilities, and new bets.
Ensure our largest initiatives have a clear customer, value proposition, competitive position, success measures, and path to meaningful impact.
Create the product and platform foundations required to expand BrightHire into a broader AI-native hiring platform.
Turn strategy into exceptional products
Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, ownership, resource allocation, and execution.
Create a lightweight operating model that drives speed and quality.
Hold a high bar for product value, usability, reliability, and trust.
Stay close to workstreams to identify risks, resolve ambiguity, and maintain momentum.
Ensure products move successfully from insight and concept through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Build AI-native products
Identify opportunities that become possible as model capabilities improve.
Apply your experience building great AI products – prototyping, evaluations, reliability, trust, product economics, and continuous improvement.
Balance rapid innovation with the transparency, quality, and trust required for enterprise adoption.
Personally use and experiment with modern AI tools and workflows.
Turn product into growth
Connect roadmap decisions to adoption, retention, and revenue.
Partner with sales, marketing, and CS to translate product investments into revenue.
Participate in customer and prospect conversations and use them to sharpen product strategy.
Shape positioning, launches, enablement, adoption, and competitive narratives.
Identify opportunities to use Zoom’s tech, relationships, and distribution to accelerate growth.
Raise the bar across product
Be an insightful, high-leverage resource to product managers and designers, helping them sharpen their thinking, make better decisions, and produce stronger work.
Raise the quality of product strategy, judgment, craft, and execution across the team.
Build a culture of intellectual honesty, customer obsession, speed, and accountability.
What We’re Looking For
Strategic judgment
You quickly understand complex customers, markets, products, and technologies.
You identify what matters most and turn incomplete information into clear recommendations and trade-offs.
You can focus an organization around a few high-conviction product bets.
Commercial instincts
You connect product decisions to adoption, retention, revenue, and competitive advantage.
You are strong with customers and prospects and can distinguish broad market demand from isolated requests.
You understand how to build scalable enterprise products.
Product leadership
You have led significant products from strategy through launch, adoption, and measurable impact.
You have made difficult prioritization and resource-allocation decisions across multiple products or workstreams.
You raise the judgment, product craft, and effectiveness of PMs and designers.
AI product experience
You have successfully shipped AI-first products.
You understand model capabilities, evaluations, reliability, trust, economics, and customer value.
You actively use modern AI tools and stay close to advances in the field.
Execution excellence
You translate strategy into focused, high-quality execution without unnecessary process.
You stay close to the details that matter, resolve ambiguity, and maintain momentum.
You are decisive, dependable, and consistently raise the quality of the work.
Experience in recruiting technology or an adjacent hiring category is strongly preferred, but not required.
How You Operate
Hands-on: You want to build, not simply supervise. You stay close to customers, product experiences, and the work of the team while focusing your own time on the decisions and interventions that create the most leverage.
Positive and energizing: You bring urgency, optimism, and an attitude that raises the performance of the people around you.
Highly collaborative: You bring clear opinions without ego, engage constructively in disagreement, and earn trust through judgment and follow-through.
Passionate about hiring: You believe hiring is an important and underserved problem and are motivated to improve it for companies and candidates.
Competitive: You study the market, care deeply about pace, and want to build the product that defines the category—not merely participates in it.
*Note to Recruiters and Placement Agencies: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website. We will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered our property.

Today, hundreds of organizations—from Ramp and Canva to SAP and HCA Healthcare —use BrightHire to make better hiring decisions, improve interviewer performance, and deliver stronger candidate experiences.

BrightHire is now part of Zoom and operates as a stand-alone business unit. This gives us a rare combination of startup velocity and global scale. We are growing more than 100% year over year, with significant opportunities to accelerate through Zoom’s technology, distribution, customer relationships, and broader platform.
We currently have two rapidly growing products:

items: BrightHire Interview: Conversation intelligence for human-led interviews.
BrightHire Screen: An AI interviewer for structured candidate screening at scale.

blocks.text: This is only the beginning. Our ambition is to become one of the three most consequential hiring platforms in the world.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional Head of Product to lead BrightHire’s next chapter.

You will be our senior-most product leader, responsible for helping determine where we play, how we win, and how we translate our ambition into products that create meaningful customer and business impact.

You will rapidly build context across our customers, products, technology, market, competitive landscape, and commercial model. From that context, you will develop a clear point of view about the opportunities that matter most and translate it into a focused set of high-conviction product investments.

You will lead product across BrightHire Interview, BrightHire Screen, and future products. This will require difficult decisions about how to balance products with strong existing momentum, platform investments, and entirely new opportunities created by advances in AI.

A critical part of the role is bringing leverage to the CEO, Head of Engineering, and broader leadership team. You will bring clear recommendations, articulate the underlying reasoning and trade-offs, and help the organization make better and faster decisions about where to focus its resources.

You will also ensure that strategy translates into excellent execution. You will stay close to customers, active product work, roadmap decisions, product reviews, launches, and adoption—helping teams resolve ambiguity, raise product quality, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
You will work across Zoom to identify R&D, platform, go-to-market, and distribution synergies that can create differentiation and growth at a scale BrightHire could not achieve independently.

The goal is not to build a large product organization for its own sake. It is to build an exceptional product and business. The right candidate is motivated by customer impact, product quality, strategic advantage, and growth—not team size or span of control.

Define how BrightHire wins

items: Rapidly develop a deep understanding of our customers, products, market, technology, economics, and competitive position.

jobs.title: Director, Product Operations
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
The Director of Product Planning will act as the connection within our product group, converting strategy into a practical, well-ordered plan. This person keeps the product team coordinated, informed, and progressing effectively. This role offers high visibility and influence for someone wanting to engage with the full product organization.
You will not directly own a feature roadmap. Your role is to guide the process that aligns and prioritizes all product leaders’ roadmaps. The metrics themselves are created by our Data Science team. Your responsibility is to manage how these metrics are analyzed, communicated, and formed into a decisive narrative.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Roadmap and Prioritization
Own the end-to-end planning process that turns strategic priorities into a resourced, sequenced roadmap across product lines
Facilitate tradeoff and prioritization discussions among product leaders, surfacing conflicts and dependencies before they become blockers
Keep the roadmap current and credible as priorities shift, and make sure changes are communicated clearly to collaborators
Cross-Functional Execution and Operating Rhythm
Build and manage the product org's operating rhythm — planning cycles, launch readiness reviews, cross-team syncs, retros
Own the tooling and systems (e.g., Jira, Linear, Notion) that keep planning artifacts organized and trustworthy as a single source of truth
Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and process gaps before they slow down execution
Metrics Reporting and Synthesis
Partner closely with Data Science, who build and maintain the underlying metrics and dashboards
Own the reporting layer on top of the data. Pull the right numbers together, synthesize their meaning, and package them into clear, recurring updates for product and company leadership.
Translate data into recommendations and talking points — not just charts — to inform planning and prioritization decisions
Special Projects and Organizational Support
Serve as a versatile resource for the Senior Director of Product Management, leading cross-organizational initiatives, coordinating process enhancements, or conducting ad hoc analyses
Represent the product org's planning function in conversations with adjacent teams (engineering, build, legal/compliance, finance) as needed
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
5+ years in product operations, technical program management, chief-of-staff, or a similar cross-functional planning role
Strong track record running planning/prioritization processes across multiple teams or product lines
Comfortable working with data and metrics, even if you do not build the underlying pipelines. You know how to ask Data Science the right questions. Then, you turn their output into a story.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to synthesize complexity into something leadership can act on quickly
Highly organized, low-ego, and energized by making other people's work easier and more coherent
Experience leading or managing a team is a plus, though this role may start as an individual contributor
Experience in a fast paced, regulated, or high-stakes industry is a plus
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$310,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Director, Scientific Data
jobs.text:
About the Role
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve >250 R&D institutions, including most of the top global biotech & pharma companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, Scientific Data will own the integrity, structure, and evolution of Drug Hunter’s scientific data across our knowledge platform and scientific databases. You will lead the scientific data team within our Technical organization and be the bridge between our scientists and our engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary internal subject-matter expert for cheminformatics and scientific data, with sufficient breadth across bioinformatics and drug discovery data to guide data decisions spanning chemistry and biology.
Own the scientific strategy for how Drug Hunter acquires, represents, integrates, normalizes, and maintains scientific data, partnering with Engineering on the architecture and systems that operationalize that strategy and Science on both automated and manual data curation processes.
Define how chemical entities are represented, registered, standardized, and resolved across sources, and establish curation standards, controlled vocabularies, QA rules, and tooling that allows data curation to take place at scale
Define approaches for extracting structured scientific information from unstructured content, including chemical structures, text, and tables from literature and patents, and establish how extracted information should be linked to canonical entities.
Own the scientific semantics, entity resolution, and ontology strategy that unifies compound synonyms, target and gene nomenclature, disease terms, organizations, assays, and other scientific concepts across sources, including approaches for handling ambiguity and conflicting source assertions.
Evaluate scientific data sources across chemistry, biology, DMPK, drug, and clinical domains, assessing their coverage, scientific quality, overlap, limitations, licensing considerations, and update characteristics, and determine how they should contribute to Drug Hunter's data.
Establish standards for scientific data quality, provenance, validation, completeness, and freshness, and ensure the Data team has effective processes for identifying and resolving data-quality issues.
Partner closely with Science to translate scientific expertise and curation decisions into consistent, maintainable data models, standards, and processes.
Partner with Engineering to define data models and technical approaches that accurately represent complex scientific information and support the Drug Hunter platform, jointly evaluating architectural decisions and trade-offs where data and application systems intersect.
Partner with Product Management to translate scientific and technical requirements into project specifications for the data team and communicate the trade-offs the technical decisions carry.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for scientific datasets, chem- and bio-informatics capabilities, and data tooling, partnering with Engineering where decisions involve shared technical infrastructure or application architecture.
Lead the Data team in translating scientific data priorities into executable projects, remaining sufficiently involved in day-to-day work to understand progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and workload.
Provide scientific and technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data team, creating, hiring, and managing roles as needed.
Requirements
PhD in cheminformatics, bioinformatics, computational biology, structural biology, or a related quantitative life-science field.
10+ years working with scientific data in drug discovery, biotech, or life science data/informatics companies, including 3+ years leading people or a data function
Working cheminformatics literacy (molecular representations, structure standardization, substructure/similarity search concepts, RDKit or similar tools)
Fluency in bioinformatics, with a deep working knowledge of biological databases and ontologies, target and pathway biology, and gene/protein identifier mapping
Strong data modeling skills and hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with data pipelines and modern data tooling
Understanding of the drug discovery process from target to clinic, and ability to converse fluently with medicinal chemsits and biologists
Clear communicator who can move seamlessly between scientific details and engineering/product trade-offs
Benefits
Drug Hunter provides industry-leading benefits, including the following:
Competitive salary, variable compensation, and equity
Broad range of medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees and their dependents, including generous coverage for a platinum PPO healthcare plan
Short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
Cancer and critical illness coverage
Up to 14 weeks paid parental leave (after 1 yr tenure) and childcare FSA plan
401(k) + employer match
Home office set up stipend for fully remote employees
Learning and development support
Generous and flexible vacation and leave policies

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Identity has become a critical to an organizations security posture. This is true across their entire digital landscape include cloud, traditional on prem and emerging technologies like agentic ai.Britive is at the forefront of a modern approach to delivering identity security with the only modern privileged access management platform that provides unified Privileged Access Visibility, Dynamic Privilege Management and Secrets Governance across infrastructure, platforms & SaaS.
Our patent-pending technology is deployed at companies of all sizes around the world, including Fortune 500 companies. We have repeatedly ranked among the hottest Cloud Security startups. Britive is founded by CyberSecurity industry veterans with a successful prior exit and is backed by top-tier VCs.
About Britive
Britive is the cloud-native Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform built to secure human, machine, and agentic identities across multi-cloud and hybrid environments. Founded on a Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) model, Britive replaces static, standing entitlements with just-in-time, ephemeral access — closing off the identity attack surface that traditional PAM and IAM tools leave exposed. Recognized as an architect of Third-Gen PAM, Britive is API-first and built to serve as the identity security control plane for modern, cloud-first enterprises.
Role Summary
Britive is hiring a Director, Technology Alliances to build and lead our technology partner ecosystem across the identity and security landscape. This is a revenue-focused role: the mandate is to identify, prioritize, and build partnerships with technology vendors (IAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, cloud security, DevOps/CI-CD, ITSM, and adjacent categories) whose customer bases, integrations, and go-to-market motions can generate measurable pipeline and revenue for Britive — not partnerships that are simply interesting from a technology standpoint.
The ideal candidate brings deep, credible knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape and an established network of relationships with alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant vendors. They will independently evaluate partnership opportunities against commercial criteria, build the business case and integration requirements for the partnerships worth pursuing, and work cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and sales to bring those partnerships to market.
Key Responsibilities
Partnership Strategy & Prioritization
Maintain a prioritized view of the identity and security technology landscape (IAM/IGA, PAM, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM/CNAPP, ITSM, DevOps/CI-CD, cloud service providers) and identify which vendors represent the highest-value alliance opportunities for Britive.
Score and rank prospective partners against clear commercial criteria — overlapping customer base, co-sell motion, deal size influence, and pipeline/revenue potential — rather than technical novelty alone.
Say no to partnerships that lack a credible path to revenue, even when they are technically compelling, and be able to articulate why.
Deal Development & Business Casing
For each prioritized partner, define and document the value proposition: what joint problem is solved, why customers would buy the combined solution, and how the partnership differentiates Britive competitively.
Author the business requirements for how the two platforms should integrate — use cases, API/data touchpoints, deployment model, and shared customer workflows — in partnership with product and engineering.
Define the monetization model for each partnership (co-sell, referral, OEM/embed, marketplace, technology royalty, etc.) and the commercial terms needed to make it work for both parties.
Negotiate and close partnership agreements, working with legal and finance as needed.
Go-To-Market Execution
Translate signed partnerships into active go-to-market programs: joint solution briefs, co-sell playbooks, enablement for sales and SEs, and marketing campaigns.
Partner with sales leadership to build pipeline generation motions with alliance partners and track sourced/influenced revenue.
Represent Britive at partner and industry events, and build/maintain executive relationships with key alliance contacts.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Act as the primary interface between Britive and partner alliance, product, and BD teams.
Brief product and engineering leadership on partner-driven integration requirements and advocate for roadmap investment where it unlocks revenue.
Report regularly to sales and executive leadership on alliance pipeline, partnership health, and revenue impact.
What Success Looks Like
A short list of active, well-documented technology partnerships — each with a clear value proposition, integration requirements, and monetization model — rather than a long list of loosely-defined technical integrations.
Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue within the first 6–12 months.
Strong working relationships with key alliance and BD leaders across the identity and security ecosystem.
What You’ll Need
Required Qualifications
7+ years in technology alliances, business development, or partnerships, with at least 3 years focused on identity, security, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure categories.
Deep working knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape — IAM, PAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, CNAPP/CSPM, and how these categories intersect with cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
An existing, active network of contacts among alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant technology vendors.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate partnerships commercially — building business cases, prioritizing against revenue potential, and saying no to low-value opportunities.
Experience defining integration requirements and working directly with product/engineering teams to scope joint solutions.
Experience in a solution design / architecture role listening to and translating client requirements into proposed designs including those with integrations to other products.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives internally and externally.
Willingness to travel for partner and industry events (estimated 20–30%).
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience at a cybersecurity or identity-focused SaaS company, ideally in a high-growth or startup environment.
Experience building tech alliances from the ground up.
Familiarity with cloud-native and Zero Standing Privileges / just-in-time access concepts.
Existing relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) marketplace and partner teams.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note describing a technology partnership they built or led — including the commercial rationale, integration scope, and revenue outcome.
The estimated base salary for this role is $140,000 - $180,000 annually. This position is also eligible for variable compensation tied to the performance of technology partnerships. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including experience, expertise, location, and other factors.
Perks + Benefits:
Work from anywhere in the US! We are fully remote (US only, other areas are subject to review).
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid parental leave benefits
401k (U.S.)
Flexible + Unlimited PTO (U.S.)
Career development opportunities and paths
Home office and connectivity stipends
Team socials + Offsites

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management (US)
jobs.text:
About Prilenia
Prilenia, a private biopharmaceutical company with a highly committed and talented global team, is seeking a Vice President, Data Management in the US.
Prilenia has a simple but urgent mission - to bring transformative medicines to people affected by devastating neurodegenerative diseases. Unwavering in our commitment to scientific excellence, Prilenia is developing pridopidine, a potent and selective sigma-1 receptor (S1R) agonist investigational therapy, which stimulates key neuroprotective mechanisms impaired in neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS and Huntington’s disease (HD). Prilenia, along with its partner Ferrer, has commenced, in 2026, two pivotal late-stage trials to support potential approval globally in ALS and in HD.
To learn more about our story and company culture, visit us at
About the role
The Vice President, Data Management, Chief Data Scientis will lead the strategy, build-out, and execution of clinical data management across the company’s clinical development portfolio, with direct responsibility for ensuring that data supporting the company’s marketing authorization applications globally are complete, accurate, consistent, and submission-ready. This role owns data management planning, electronic data capture (EDC) systems, data standards (CDISC/SDTM/ADaM), database lock, and CRO/vendor oversight, and partners closely with Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and Quality to ensure the clinical database will withstand Regulatory Authority scrutiny , including pre-approval inspection. The VP will build and lead a fit-for-purpose data management team (internal staff and/or outsourced functions) and establish the SOPs, systems, and governance needed to scale as the company advances toward and beyond potential approval.
Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & NDA Readiness
Serve as the senior data management leader and subject matter expert for all data management, supporting the company’s preparations for marketing authorization applications globally.
Collaborate with the Chief Data Protection Officer to ensure overall date integrity and compliance globally.
Develop and execute the clinical data management strategy across ongoing and planned trials, aligned with the company’s regulatory timeline and submission milestones.
Own end-to-end database lock planning and execution for pivotal trials, ensuring on-time, audit-ready locks that support statistical analysis and NDA filing timelines.
Represent data management in FDA interactions (e.g., Type B/C meetings, briefing document preparation) and any other relevant meetings with other Regulatory Authorities, and respond to information requests during regulatory review.
Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Biostatistics to ensure the submission data package (SDTM, ADaM, define.xml, reviewer’s guides) meets FDA Technical Rejection Criteria and current CDISC standards, and any other relevant regulations.
Data Management Operations
Oversee development of Data Management Plans (DMPs), CRF/eCRF design, edit check specifications, and data validation plans for all studies.
Ensure timely and high-quality data cleaning, query management, SAE reconciliation, and coding (MedDRA, WHO-DD) across all active protocols.
Establish and monitor key data quality metrics (query rates, query aging, data entry lag, protocol deviations affecting data) and drive continuous improvement.
Oversee external data reconciliation (central lab, ECG, imaging, ePRO/eCOA, IRT/IWRS) and third-party data integration.
Systems, Standards & Technology
Ensure company-wide adherence to CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and maintain a standards governance process across studies and vendors.
Partner with IT and other relevant functions to ensure relevant systems and processes comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR/HIPAA as applicable, and company data privacy and information security policies.
Vendor & CRO Oversight
Manage relationships with data management CROs, EDC vendors, and specialty data vendors, including scope, budget, timelines, and quality oversight via service level agreements and metrics.
Lead vendor selection (RFP process, bid defense) for data management services and systems as the portfolio scales.
In collaboration with Quality, conduct or oversee relevant vendor audits and ensure timely resolution of findings related to data management deliverables.
Quality, Compliance & Inspection Readiness
Ensure data management practices comply with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and company SOPs; maintain inspection-ready documentation (Trial Master File data management sections, audit trails, data management plans).
Lead data management readiness for regulatory authorities (including FDA) pre-approval inspections (PAI) and sponsor audits, including mock inspections and CAPA management.
Review for completeness and maintain data management SOPs, working practices, and training materials; ensure staff and vendor training compliance.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage a hybrid internal/outsourced model, appropriate to the size and stage currently of Prilenia.
Partner closely with Biostatistics and Statistical Programming on analysis-ready data timelines, and with Clinical Operations on site-level data quality and monitoring plans.
Manage the data management function’s budget, resourcing, and vendor spend; report progress and risks to senior leadership and, as appropriate, the Board.
Contribute and serve as data management SME in cross-functional, alliance management and BD activities, as may be required from time to time.
Qualifications:
Advanced degree in life sciences, health informatics, statistics, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive clinical data management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
Direct experience leading data management through at least one successful NDA, BLA, or MAA submission, including database lock and submission data package delivery.
Deep working knowledge of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and experience ensuring submission-ready datasets.
Hands-on experience with major EDC/CDMS platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault CDMS, Oracle InForm/Clinical One).
Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, ICH-GCP, and 21 CFR Part 11 as applied to clinical data management.
Demonstrated success managing CROs and data management vendors, including budget and timeline accountability.
Experience supporting or leading through an FDA pre-approval inspection or comparable regulatory audit.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and interacting with regulatory agencies.
Skills:
Experience in a small and/or mid-size clinical-stage biotech environment, including building a data management function, including direct experience in US marketing authorization submission.
Therapeutic area experience relevant to Prilenia’s pipeline (e.g., neurology, rare disease, CNS).
Experience with risk-based quality management (RBQM) and centralized statistical monitoring approaches.
Excellent knowledge of regulatory frameworks and requirements for data management including but not limited to FDA and EMA
Familiarity with real-world data sources, patient registries, or external control arms.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Proficient in EDC/CDMS platforms
Familiarity with the evolving roll of AI and Computational Science as it relates to clinical and regulatory activities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
Strong attention to detail
Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure
Highly organized and self-motivated
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and tasks
Ability to work effectively in a global collaborative team environment
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships
Location/Time Zones:
This is a full-time remote position in US.
Flexible schedule with interactions across North America, Europe and Israel time zones.
Up to 15%, including CRO and site visits, investigator meetings, and regulatory interactions
Prilenia operates across the United States, Canada, Europe and Israel, is incorporated in the Netherlands and backed by leading life sciences investors. We are a highly flexible organization that is mostly remote and encourages team members to work in the ways that make them most effective, with a focus on our common goals and getting the job done.
Prilenia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace for all.

jobs.title: Senior Product Director, AI & Agent
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
AI is not a feature at OKX. It is the next fundamental layer of how we serve users, operate at scale, and maintain trust in a regulated, global market.
We are hiring a Senior Directort of Product, AI & Agent (Chatbot) to own OKX's full AI product agenda — outward, through a crypto-native AI assistant that transforms how users experience our platform; and inward, through agentic systems that make our operations intelligent, auditable, and scalable. This is a single role with a unified mandate: building the AI layer that defines OKX's next decade.
What You’ll Be Doing
User-Facing AI Lead the strategy and execution of OKX's conversational AI assistant — an experience that lets users onboard, trade, stay informed, and get support through natural language. You will define what this product is, how it earns user trust, and how it deepens over time.
Operational AI & Agent Systems Own the agentic AI roadmap for OKX's internal functions — compliance, risk, fraud, and operations. You will identify the highest-leverage workflows, lead their systematic transformation into agent-driven systems, and ensure every output is traceable and regulatorily defensible.
AI Platform Own the product design of shared infrastructure that powers both mandates — orchestration, evaluation, safety architecture, and the governance layer that makes AI products configurable and auditable across all markets.
What We Look For In You
12+ years in product & tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale
Proven track record shipping conversational AI or agentic AI products — as the owner, not a contributor
Deep familiarity with LLM product architecture: multi-agent systems, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and safety design
Experience operating in regulated environments where auditability and explainability are hard requirements
Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor
Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust
Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin
Nice-To-Haves
Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale
Graduate degree in a technical field
Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products
Why this role
OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap — on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

#LI-ONSITE

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
