Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
AI is not a feature at OKX. It is the next fundamental layer of how we serve users, operate at scale, and maintain trust in a regulated, global market.

We are hiring a Senior Directort of Product, AI & Agent (Chatbot) to own OKX's full AI product agenda — outward, through a crypto-native AI assistant that transforms how users experience our platform; and inward, through agentic systems that make our operations intelligent, auditable, and scalable. This is a single role with a unified mandate: building the AI layer that defines OKX's next decade.
What You’ll Be Doing

User-Facing AI Lead the strategy and execution of OKX's conversational AI assistant — an experience that lets users onboard, trade, stay informed, and get support through natural language. You will define what this product is, how it earns user trust, and how it deepens over time.

Operational AI & Agent Systems Own the agentic AI roadmap for OKX's internal functions — compliance, risk, fraud, and operations. You will identify the highest-leverage workflows, lead their systematic transformation into agent-driven systems, and ensure every output is traceable and regulatorily defensible.

AI Platform Own the product design of shared infrastructure that powers both mandates — orchestration, evaluation, safety architecture, and the governance layer that makes AI products configurable and auditable across all markets.
What We Look For In You
12+ years in product & tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale
Proven track record shipping conversational AI or agentic AI products — as the owner, not a contributor
Deep familiarity with LLM product architecture: multi-agent systems, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and safety design
Experience operating in regulated environments where auditability and explainability are hard requirements
Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor
Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust
Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin
Nice-To-Haves
Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale
Graduate degree in a technical field
Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products
Why this role

OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap — on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution
Requirements
Non-Negotiable
Deep, production-level experience with n8n automation systems
Strong full-stack development skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases)
Proven experience leading engineers while remaining hands-on
Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code in development workflows
Strong working experience with Clay for data enrichment, signal detection, or GTM automation
Experience building and scaling AI/LLM systems in production
Strong systems architecture thinking (scalability, reliability, fault tolerance)
Executive-level mindset with the ability to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Preferred Experience
Agency or services background with multi-client automation systems
Experience building SaaS or productized internal tools
Familiarity with tools like Airtable, HubSpot, Slack APIs, and outbound infrastructure
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.)
Benefits
💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams
🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services
🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network
🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement
💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

VP AI Engineering - Enterprise
PRIMARY PURPOSE: The Vice President, Generative (Gen) AI Engineering Enterprise, provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and accountability for the enterprise data and AI engineering ecosystem that enables the organization’s most advanced analytics, data science, and generative AI initiatives. This role owns the vision, governance, and execution model for the enterprise data supply chain that powers machine learning platforms, feature stores, and production‑grade generative AI capabilities.
As a senior leader, the Vice President establishes and scales the engineering strategy required to transform legacy and modern data assets into trusted, AI‑ready enterprise capabilities. The role ensures that data and AI engineering investments are aligned to business outcomes, regulatory expectations, and long‑term architectural sustainability across on‑premise and multi‑cloud environments, including Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Defines and leads the enterprise strategy for data and generative AI engineering, establishing standards, roadmaps, and operating models that support analytics, machine learning, and AI at scale.
Provides executive oversight for the design, delivery, and operation of enterprise ETL/ELT platforms that integrate legacy on‑premise systems (including mainframe, SQL Server, and DB2) with modern cloud data and AI platforms.
Establishes governance and accountability for feature stores, analytically optimized datasets, and AI‑ready data products to ensure reproducibility, regulatory compliance, and production reliability.
Sets direction for generative AI enablement, including enterprise approaches for vectorization, embeddings, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and secure consumption of structured and unstructured data.
Owns the enterprise Snowflake strategy, including architectural patterns, performance standards, cost governance, and integration with cloud‑based AI services across AWS and Azure.
Leads cross‑functional collaboration with Technology, Security, Infrastructure, Legal, Risk, and Compliance leaders to ensure data and AI engineering practices meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Establishes executive‑level operating metrics and financial discipline to ensure data and AI engineering investments deliver measurable business value and return on investment.
Provides leadership and direction to engineering leaders and teams, setting priorities, removing organizational barriers, and ensuring consistent execution across portfolios and initiatives.
Serves as a senior advisor to executive leadership on data, AI, and generative AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities, translating technical complexity into business‑level insights and decisions.
Drives organizational readiness by shaping talent strategy, capability development, and succession planning for data and AI engineering roles across the enterprise.
Job Responsibilities
Lead AI engineering for enterprise functions including HR, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and other corporate functions.
Identify and deliver high-value LLM, agentic AI, workflow automation, and knowledge-assistant use cases.
Build reusable AI capabilities, agents, APIs, connectors, and workflow integrations rather than isolated point solutions.
Own the enterprise administration and operational management of ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude.
Manage user access, licenses, roles, permissions, workspaces, and enterprise configuration for these platforms.
Establish and manage approved connectors and integrations to enterprise data and applications.
Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and AI Governance to define appropriate access controls and data-use guardrails.
Establish standards for enterprise use of GPTs, agents, projects, connectors, and other platform capabilities.
Monitor adoption, utilization, license consumption, token/API usage, and overall platform effectiveness.
Partner closely with Finance and Procurement to manage AI platform spend, forecasting, chargeback/showback, license optimization, and vendor commitments.
Develop cost-management practices to identify unused licenses, excessive consumption, duplicated capabilities, and opportunities for optimization.
Own relationships with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other relevant enterprise AI technology providers.
Evaluate new platform capabilities and determine when they should be enabled, restricted, piloted, or adopted broadly.
Ensure enterprise AI tools align with Sedgwick's broader AI architecture and do not create unmanaged technology or data silos.
Establish operational dashboards for adoption, usage, cost, risk, and business value.
Lead a small engineering/platform team responsible for enterprise AI solutions, integrations, administration, and support.
Partner with business leaders to drive responsible adoption and measurable productivity improvement from enterprise AI.
Strong balance of technical depth, operational discipline, and business orientation
ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES
Performs other duties as assigned.
Travel as required.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
Provides support, guidance, leadership and motivation to promote maximum performance.
Administers company personnel policies in all areas and follows company staffing standards and training recommendations.
Interviews, hires and establishes colleague performance development plans; conducts colleague performance discussions.
QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Licensing
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related field from an accredited college or university required. Masters Degree preferred.
Qualifications
10+ years of engineering, platform, or enterprise technology experience with 5+ years in technical leadership.
Strong hands-on understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, APIs, workflow automation, and enterprise integration.
Experience building AI solutions for corporate functions such as HR, Marketing, Finance, or Legal.
Experience administering enterprise SaaS or AI platforms at significant organizational scale.
Strong understanding of identity, SSO, RBAC, connectors, APIs, data permissions, and enterprise security.
Experience with ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI platforms strongly preferred.
Strong AWS and/or Azure knowledge and understanding of how enterprise AI platforms integrate with cloud environments.
Experience establishing AI governance, access controls, monitoring, and responsible-use standards.
Strong financial management skills with experience managing technology consumption, licenses, vendor spend, and forecasts.
Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Security, Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, Marketing, and executive leadership.
Experience
Ten (10) years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics platforms, or AI‑related technologies, including senior leadership responsibility for enterprise‑scale data or AI initiatives, or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
Skills & Knowledge
Executive‑level expertise in modern data architectures, cloud data platforms, and AI enablement, including Snowflake and AWS/Azure ecosystems
Proven experience establishing enterprise governance models for data, analytics, and AI systems
Strong understanding of machine learning and generative AI data requirements, including feature engineering, vector databases, and RAG‑based architectures
Ability to set technical direction without direct hands‑on execution, guiding senior engineers and leaders through complex architectural and delivery decisions
Experience managing large, cross‑functional initiatives with significant financial and organizational impact
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, investment prioritization, and ROI measurement for technology initiatives
Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across business and technology domains
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, scale new capabilities, and drive enterprise change
Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies
WORK ENVIRONMENT
When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines
Physical: Computer keyboarding, travel as required
Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision and talking

They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time.
Position is based in the U.S. and is remote.
Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.text:
You
Are passionate about technology, wake up every morning to experiment, learn and develop new solutions!
You Will
Work on latest edge Cloud computing to solve difficult, manual and repeatable tasks for users adopting Cloud technologies like AWS, Salesforce, Microsoft and more
Use the latest trends on building SaaS applications using multitenancy, scalability large data volumes / Big Data and more
Develop and expand our portfolio to support most popular Cloud apps (200+)
Develop understanding of not just software development, but also how to design, develop and launch a product from concept to high customer use.
About Us
At DBSync we provide opportunity to use technology that creates innovative and next generation data integration products which helps our employees to cultivate their creativity and sense of belonging. DBSync is a leading provider for data integration and Data warehousing services for both cloud/SAAS-based-on-demand applications. We were incubated by Salesforce.com (as a part of Avankia), before getting spunned off as a separate company. DBSync provides data integration as a SAAS-based, Standalone or hosted integration at a competitive price with a plethora of benefits for business users.
Our main motto is to provide a strong foundation for businesses in solving complex problems and automating their workflows while acting as a pillar of support for all their data integrations needs. At DBSync we encourage innovation and creativity and our team is diverse comprising of a nice mix of cultural blends. jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.text:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.
Why you’ll love this role
Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, and business leaders to decide where we invest, what we build, and how we measure success.
What you’ll do
Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.
About you
10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.
Nice to have skills
Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.
About StockX
StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.

jobs.title: Director, Scientific Data & Informatics
jobs.text:
About the Role
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve >250 R&D institutions, including most of the top global biotech & pharma companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, Scientific Data & Informatics will own the integrity, structure, and evolution of Drug Hunter’s scientific data across our knowledge platform and scientific databases. You will lead the scientific data team within our Technical organization and be the bridge between our scientists and our engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary internal subject-matter expert for cheminformatics and scientific data, with sufficient breadth across bioinformatics and drug discovery data to guide data decisions spanning chemistry and biology.
Own the scientific strategy for how Drug Hunter acquires, represents, integrates, normalizes, and maintains scientific data, partnering with Engineering on the architecture and systems that operationalize that strategy and Science on both automated and manual data curation processes.
Define how chemical entities are represented, registered, standardized, and resolved across sources, and establish curation standards, controlled vocabularies, QA rules, and tooling that allows data curation to take place at scale
Define approaches for extracting structured scientific information from unstructured content, including chemical structures, text, and tables from literature and patents, and establish how extracted information should be linked to canonical entities.
Own the scientific semantics, entity resolution, and ontology strategy that unifies compound synonyms, target and gene nomenclature, disease terms, organizations, assays, and other scientific concepts across sources, including approaches for handling ambiguity and conflicting source assertions.
Evaluate scientific data sources across chemistry, biology, DMPK, drug, and clinical domains, assessing their coverage, scientific quality, overlap, limitations, licensing considerations, and update characteristics, and determine how they should contribute to Drug Hunter's data.
Establish standards for scientific data quality, provenance, validation, completeness, and freshness, and ensure the Data team has effective processes for identifying and resolving data-quality issues.
Partner closely with Science to translate scientific expertise and curation decisions into consistent, maintainable data models, standards, and processes.
Partner with Engineering to define data models and technical approaches that accurately represent complex scientific information and support the Drug Hunter platform, jointly evaluating architectural decisions and trade-offs where data and application systems intersect.
Partner with Product Management to translate scientific and technical requirements into project specifications for the data team and communicate the trade-offs the technical decisions carry.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for scientific datasets, chem- and bio-informatics capabilities, and data tooling, partnering with Engineering where decisions involve shared technical infrastructure or application architecture.
Lead the Data team in translating scientific data priorities into executable projects, remaining sufficiently involved in day-to-day work to understand progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and workload.
Provide scientific and technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data team, creating, hiring, and managing roles as needed.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Strategic Solution Engineering (Central)
jobs.text:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?
JFrog is seeking a dynamic and visionary leader to join as the Regional Vice President of Strategic Solution Engineering. In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of expanding JFrog’s presence within key accounts, driving the adoption of our cutting-edge DevOps, DevSecOps, and MLOps solutions, and ensuring the success of our most strategic customers.
As Regional Vice President (RVP), you’ll lead a high-performing team of technical professionals, working with JFrog’s most strategic customers, forming strong customer relationships, delivering exceptional technical proofs of concept (POCs) and pre-sales guidance while acting as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders. Reporting directly to the VP, Strategics and Field CTO, you’ll align regional strategies with corporate objectives, ensuring revenue growth, customer happiness, strategy alignment, and market leadership.
As a RVP of Strategic Solution Engineering in JFrog you will...
Develop and execute strategies to drive customer happiness and revenue growth within strategic accounts.
Align team efforts with market trends, corporate goals, and competitive insights to enhance regional impact.
Lead and inspire a high-performing team of technical professionals, ensuring exceptional customer outcomes.
Partner with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to align strategies and optimize processes.
Engage with executive stakeholders, positioning JFrog as a strategic partner while addressing complex challenges.
Stay ahead of DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps trends, refining strategies to address customer needs effectively.
To be an RVP of Strategic Solutions in JFrog you need...
10+ years of experience in enterprise software/SaaS, including 5+ years managing technical or solution-oriented teams.
Proven ability to drive seven- and eight-figure deals using methodologies like MEDDPICC and value-based selling.
Deep expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, and pre-sales activities such as needs analysis and product demonstrations.
Proven track record of driving high-value deals, developing strategic account plans, and achieving corporate objectives.
Exceptional analytical and communication skills, data driven, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
Willingness to travel to engage with customers and support team success.
Passionately drives agility and proactive approach, ensuring seamless alignment with stakeholders, customer goals, and JFrog's mission.
WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…
At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package. This position has a base salary range between $192,000 to $215,000. Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU). In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!
JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

Who We Are
Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.
This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.
The Position
We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership and Operations:
Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.
Solution Engineering:
Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.
Customer Support Operations:
Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.
Who You Are
Skills/Knowledge:
Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.
Requirements:
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team
Preferred Skills:
SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.
Join Us
We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.
In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.
Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!
At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:
•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.
Learn more about how to spot recruitment scams and protect yourself - FBI warning:
Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Engineering Leadership & Technical Excellence
Own Arran’s engineering strategy, standards and technical assurance across client engagements. Champion secure, scalable and maintainable services using modern cloud, DevSecOps and software engineering practices.
Build our AI Engineering Capability
Develop Arran’s practical capability to build and integrate AI into production government services. Establish engineering approaches for technologies such as LLMs, RAG and agentic systems, ensuring solutions address security, privacy, responsible AI, operational resilience and government constraints.
Government Digital & Technical Assurance
Ensure engineering aligns with the GDS Service Standard, Technology Code of Practice, NCSC Secure by Design and relevant accessibility and data protection requirements. Work with architects and client technical authorities to provide effective technical governance and assurance.
People & Capability
Act as Head of Profession for Engineering, building and developing high-performing engineers and technical leaders. Identify future capability needs and create opportunities for people to develop practical AI and emerging technology experience through delivery, accelerators and learning.
Client Leadership & Consultancy
Act as a trusted senior technical advisor to Central Government clients, translating complex problems into pragmatic technical approaches. Challenge assumptions, communicate trade-offs and represent Zaizi in senior client and technical governance discussions.
Growth, Propositions & Bids
Shape technical propositions, solutions, teams and estimates for strategically important opportunities. Turn successful delivery into credible, reusable capabilities and propositions that strengthen Arran’s position in the government market.
Club Leadership
Share accountability with the Club Executive and Heads of Product and Delivery for Arran’s overall performance. Help protect and grow clients, build capability through delivery and balance client outcomes, people, quality and commercial performance.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Risk Management
jobs.text:
About Us
Finance of America helps homeowners 55+ access the equity they’ve built while staying in full control of their home and their financial future. Through a range of reverse mortgage solutions, we help customers shape the retirement they’ve earned while continuing to evolve how we serve and work together.
Joining Finance of America now means stepping into a period of momentum and growth, with teams actively shaping what comes next and opportunities to make an impact and grow your career.
To learn more about us, visit
Purpose of Role
Responsible for leading the identification, assessment, and proactive management of technology risk across the enterprise, ensuring alignment with defined risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and business objectives. Drives a forward-looking, data-driven risk management approach across cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and third-party ecosystems, while embedding risk management into day-to-day technology and product decision-making. Partners across the enterprise to strengthen control maturity, enable responsible innovation, and provide clear, actionable risk insights to senior leadership.
Key Responsibilities and Expectations
Technology Risk Strategy & Governance
Leads execution of the Technology Risk Management framework, aligned to industry standards (e.g., NIST CSF, FFIEC, SOX ITGC).
Translates regulatory expectations into pragmatic, delivery-aligned controls and practices across Technology and Product teams.
Drives definition, operationalization, and monitoring of technology risk appetite, tolerances, and KRIs.
Risk Identification, Assessment & Insights
Oversees enterprise-wide identification and assessment of technology risks across: Cloud and Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and data protection, AI and emerging technologies, and Third-party/vendor ecosystems.
Delivers data-driven risk insights and reporting, that clearly articulate risk posture, trends, and emerging risks to senior leadership.
Evolves risk reporting from static outputs to forward-looking, decision-enabling intelligence.
Control Environment & Regulatory Compliance
Drives continuous improvement of control maturity to meet regulatory expectations, including sustained SOX ITGC effectiveness.
Partners with Technology teams to design and implement scalable, automated controls.
Ensures timely and high-quality execution of regulatory exams, internal audits, and remediation commitments.
Issue & Remediation Management
Oversees end-to-end issue management lifecycle, including identification, prioritization, root cause analysis, and sustainable remediation.
Drives accountability for timely remediation of high-risk issues and reduction of aged items.
Ensures systemic fixes over point-in-time remediation.
Technology & Process Enablement
Leads adoption of automation and tooling to enhance risk identification, monitoring, and reporting
Evaluates and improve end-to-end technology processes to reduce risk, increase resilience, and enhance operational efficiency.
Promotes integration of risk management into SDLC, product development, and change management processes.
Emerging Risk & Innovation Oversight
Establishes governance and risk oversight for AI and emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with internal standards and evolving regulatory expectations.
Assesses risks associated with new technology initiatives and provide actionable guidance to enable safe adoption.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
Serves as a trusted partner to Technology and Business leaders to proactively manage risk.
Leads engagement with Internal Audit, External Audit, and second line of defense functions.
Builds and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Reports To
VP, Technology Risk Management
Direct Reports
(1-3) Direct: Technology Risk Management team members
Qualifications - Experience/Skills/Competencies
Minimum 10 years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, IT Audit or related disciplines within financial services or regulated environments.
Proven experience operating in or alongside first line technology functions, with strong business partnership orientation.
Demonstrated success in evolving risk programs to strategic, insight-driven functions.
Deep understanding of technology risk domains, including: Cloud and infrastructure risk, Cybersecurity and data protection, Third-party/vendor risk, and AI/emerging technology risk.
Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks (FFIEC, NIST CSF, SOX ITGC).
Ability to translate complex technical risks into clear, concise executive-level reporting.
Strong judgement, with the ability to balance risk management with business enablement.
Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership and regulators.
Able to drive accountability, foster collaboration, and promote a culture of continuous improvement.
Qualifications - Education - Required
Bachelor's Degree
Qualifications - Education - Field(s)/Profession(s)
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP).
Compensation
The base salary range for this position is ($150,000 - $200,000) inclusive of all geographical differences in the labor market. The base salary for the position will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members in determining any final offer. We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time-off benefits, flexible spending account, 401(k) with employer match, and ESPP.
Additional Information
The application deadline for this job opportunity is 11/26/2026.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.
Finance of America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, religion, creed, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Head / Vice President - Engineering
jobs.text:
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role with a growing startup and a young, energetic team of engineers. We're looking for a leader who can balance strategic thinking with technical execution, helping shape the company's technology direction while mentoring and growing the team. Engineering leaders with 812 years of industry experience will be highly desirable.
Primary Responsibilities:
Serve as a hands-on technical leader, overseeing the engineering function including architecture, design, development processes, and infrastructure while making individual contributions when needed.
Define and execute strategies to drive innovation, scale technology solutions, and uphold product quality and performance standards.

jobs.title: Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, Global
jobs.text:
About Nscale
Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.
At Nscale, our Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs the systems, data, and intelligence that let us build and operate AI data centres at a speed and density traditional operating models were never designed for. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
About the Role
Nscale's operational systems (BMS, DCIM, EPMS/SCADA, CMMS/EAM, ITSM, fabric and GPU telemetry) and equipment data were procured independently. Each works well on its own, but together they give overlapping and sometimes contradictory views of the same assets.
As Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, you will bring that data centre insight together. You'll own the equipment digital thread — from product definition and procurement through commissioning and handover into maintenance — along with the telemetry and analytics foundation that lets the Nscale Operational Systems (NOS) act on our physical estate with confidence.
The goal is data centres that are measurably self-aware and progressively self-operating, where a site is declared ready based on evidence rather than judgement.
What You'll be Doing
Set strategy and investment: own a costed, sequenced multi-year roadmap and investment portfolio across CMMS/EAM, PIM/PLM, integration, telemetry, and the data platform, starting with an assessment of which systems should be consolidated, retained, replaced, or newly instrumented.
- Own the asset master and governance: establish one canonical identity for every asset, along with taxonomy, hierarchy, configuration, and BOM standards, ensuring every critical data object has one system of record.
- Lead cleansing and validation-at-source programmes so governed lifecycle data replaces spreadsheets.
- Build the telemetry foundation: deliver a unified asset and topology model from grid connection down to GPU and network port, with OT/IT ingest (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, MQTT, Redfish, DCGM) and IEC 62443-aligned segmentation.
- Publish data-quality scores and agree single, shared definitions for PUE, WUE, capacity, stranded power, and availability.
- Make maintenance and reliability trustworthy: own the CMMS/EAM configuration baseline (criticality, PM strategy, spares, warranties) and controlled SOP/MOP/EOP libraries.
- Map condition data deterministically to assets so predictive maintenance raises work orders, not just reports.
- Move NOS intelligence toward autonomy: build anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life prediction, and thermal and power optimisation.
- Progress control loops through shadow, recommend-only, human-approved, and bounded-autonomous stages, each with explicit safety envelopes and engineering sign-off.
- Assure site readiness: turn commissioning (L1–L5) into data, set acceptance gates for handover, and score readiness quantitatively per hall and per site.
- Benchmark readiness across the portfolio so defects found on one build are designed out of the next.
- Act as the senior escalation point across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Operations, Reliability, Platform, Finance, and HSE, and enforce supplier and OFCI data deliverables.
- Build and develop a high-performing team spanning lifecycle engineering, data science, and data engineering.
About You
15+ years of experience across engineering, asset management, enterprise systems, or industrial analytics, including 7+ years leading cross-functional programmes at director level or above.
- Ownership of a CMMS/EAM platform at scale (e.g. Maximo, SAP PM, Infor, Nuvolo), plus depth in master data, PIM/PLM, BOM, and configuration management.
- Proven delivery of analytics or ML on physical infrastructure (data centres, energy, utilities, heavy industry, or similar), including hands-on experience with messy BMS/SCADA/historian data.
- Experience taking models into control or decision loops, along with the safety, validation, and governance work that requires.
- Strong judgement on enterprise and data architecture, including ERP, integration, streaming, time-series storage, lineage, and Palantir Foundry or an equivalent platform.
- Experience with ITIL-aligned operations and controlled MOP, LOTO, and permit-to-work regimes in mission-critical environments.
- Credibility with both facilities engineers and software teams.
- A track record of building a function from scratch.
- Honesty and clarity with executives about uncertainty.
Nice to Have
Knowledge of AI/HPC data centre plant, including liquid cooling, UPS, switchgear, and GPU and fabric telemetry.
- Familiarity with reliability standards such as RCM, FMEA, ISO 14224, and ISO 55000.
- Experience with digital twin or CFD-informed modelling.
- Experience with BIM/COBie handover.
Background in energy and grid optimisation.
Why this role matters
This role turns a fragmented set of systems into a single, trusted source of truth for how Nscale's data centres are built, run, and improved. Success will be measured by:
Fewer unplanned incidents, faster detection and diagnosis, and more interventions triggered by prediction rather than alarms.
- Improved PM compliance, MTTR, and spares fill rate.
- PUE/WUE gains and stranded capacity recovered.
- Cohesive analytics views across the data centre landscape.
- Fewer post-energisation defects and a shorter time from mechanical completion to customer-ready.
- Less redundant tooling and more critical assets with governed, quality-scored data.
- Control loops advanced toward autonomy with zero safety-envelope breaches.
What We Can Offer You
At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.
Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
- Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
- Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
- Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
- Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.
Equal Opportunities Statement
At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.
For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice:
Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Salary Range
$280,000—$400,000 USD

jobs.title: VP, Subscription Product
jobs.text:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.
ABOUT THE ROLE
iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and VP, Subscription Product is the leader who sets its direction. You own the product vision, the differentiation thesis, and the AI and personalization philosophy.
You report to the Chief Subscription Officer. You partner with the CSO on where the vision product roadmap. You work as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Retention, Content, and Analytics leaders, who operate as first class members of the model.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Product vision and differentiation. Set and defend the product vision, the member experience vision, and the defensibility thesis. Make the final call on the AI and personalization philosophy.
Product prioritization/Roadmap. Set the quarterly percentage split across Core, Growth, and Partner work with the CSO investment lens and Engineering capacity reality. Set the platform and tech debt percentage, which Engineering defines and spends.
Product strategy. Decide product strategy across domains and review domain roadmaps, PRDs, and the single backlog (one queue, three lanes) for coherence.
Monetization innovation. Own the concept pipeline for new revenue ideas. Build the business case, make a clear recommendation, and drive the CSO to a decision on pricing, plans, packaging, and investment.
Innovation pipeline. Own future state concepts and the innovation pipeline, in consultation with Design, Engineering, and Analytics.
Product leadership. Lead and develop the Core Product Leader, Growth Product Leader, and Partner Product Leader. Hold each accountable for outcomes: engagement for Core, funnel for Growth, and partner experiences for Partner.
HOW YOU DECIDE
Decides - Product vision, member experience vision, AI and personalization philosophy, differentiation thesis, innovation pipeline, product strategy, and the quarterly capacity split.
Consulted on - Pricing, plans and packaging, investment decisions, domain roadmaps, retention strategy, content strategy, and acquisition strategy.
Informed on - Commercial partner negotiations, partner sales, paid acquisition, and brand and campaigns.
Does not own - The subscription P&L, pricing, or commercial deals, Architecture and delivery, The retention number, The experiment gate,
OPERATING RHYTHM
Quarterly planning: set the capacity split with the CSO and Engineering, with Analytics arriving with the insights agenda.
Ongoing: review domain roadmaps and resolve cross domain conflicts, then communicate decisions directly and in public.
Regular readouts to the CSO and executive team on product outcomes, bets, and tradeoffs.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
Best in class engagement and retention results.
Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
Building the #1 app in Fitness
Three domain leaders who own their slices and escalate only when they should.
WHAT YOU BRING
12 or more years in product, with 5 or more years leading product leaders at a consumer subscription, mobile, or connected fitness company.
Proven record of setting product vision and turning it into a prioritized portfolio with real tradeoffs.
Deep fluency in subscription economics: conversion, retention, LTV, CAC, and pricing and packaging.
Hands on experience shaping an AI and personalization strategy for consumers.
Comfort making direct decisions and holding the tiebreaker without losing partnership with Design, Engineering, and Marketing.
Experience running experimentation programs with an analytics gate.
Executive presence and the ability to present to the CEO and board.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven products.
Experience with partner ecosystems, integrations, and platform products.
Experience scaling a product organization through a reorganization or operating model change.
DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.
Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.
Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.
Pay Range:
$200,000—$225,000 USD
iFIT does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ancestry, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product and Technology PMO
jobs.text:
Workiva is seeking an exceptional PMO executive to lead and evolve our Product & Technology Program Management Office as the company enters its next phase of growth, beyond $1B ARR. This leader will drive execution excellence across R&D, ensuring that our most critical product, platform, and enterprise initiatives are delivered with clarity, discipline, and confidence.
This role is for a strategic, influential leader who elevates how a product and technology organization plans, prioritizes, and delivers at scale. The VP of Product & Technology PMO will oversee the organization’s operating rhythm, bringing a proactive, business-driven approach to portfolio leadership and execution.
As a core member of the Product & Technology leadership team, you will partner closely with the SVP & Head of Technology, the Chief Product Officer, and senior leaders across Product, Technology, and UX to lead annual and quarterly planning, clarify priorities and trade-offs, and ensure disciplined execution across the product and technology portfolio. This role serves as the connective tissue across strategy, investment, and delivery, ensuring teams are aligned on the right work, sequenced appropriately, and held to clear delivery commitments with transparent timelines and outcomes.
What You'll Do
Strategic Leadership & Product & Technology Operating Model
Drive and partner with the P&T leaders to continuously mature the planning and delivery operating model, spanning multi-year strategic planning, annual investment decisions, quarterly execution cycles, and release delivery
Establish the PMO as a trusted strategic partner to Product, UX, and Technology leadership, proactively contributing to shaping priorities and decisions rather than coordinating execution after the fact
Drive prioritization and trade-off frameworks that balance customer value, business outcomes, capacity, and technical health
Partner with business and GTM leaders on large, cross-company initiatives to ensure technology execution aligns with commercial objectives, regulatory commitments, and customer impact
Bring commercial context into portfolio and execution discussions, proactively surfacing misalignment between strategy, investment, and expected business outcomes, and calling out high-risk areas early
Own the definition, communication, and ongoing management of delivery commitments for the Technology portfolio, ensuring predictable timelines and early visibility into risks and trade-offs
Elevate executive communication by translating complex delivery realities into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior leadership
Portfolio, Planning & Execution Excellence
Design, implement, and govern a lightweight, outcome-driven portfolio management approach spanning software engineering, platform, security, and infrastructure initiatives
Lead portfolio-level planning, sequencing, and capacity alignment to ensure investments are clearly tied to strategic priorities and measurable outcomes
Establish and maintain portfolio-level delivery confidence through clear sequencing, dependency management, and accountability for committed milestones across teams
Provide executive-level visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and resource allocation
Partner with leaders to evolve delivery practices and tooling aligned with modern SaaS and product operating models
Oversee critical cross-functional programs such as major product launches, platform modernization efforts, enterprise transformations, and M&A integrations
Hold Product and Technology leaders accountable to delivery commitments with confidence, judgment, empathy, and strong executive presence
Organizational Development, Talent & Enablement
Build, coach, and scale a high-performing PMO organization with a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and constructive challenge
Develop program and technical program managers into strategic advisors who can influence priorities, manage complexity, and protect outcomes
Partner with Technology and Product leaders to strengthen operating discipline across the organization, including planning cadences, execution reviews, and decision forums
Define and evolve KPIs, OKRs, and metrics that measure delivery predictability, investment efficiency, and business impact
Own and evolve the PMO’s planning, portfolio, and delivery tooling, leveraging automation and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, to improve planning, visibility, and execution at scale
Lead and evolve shared delivery standards and practices across Product and Engineering, including ownership of the Product Center of Excellence and SDLC frameworks, to improve consistency, quality, and execution outcomes at scale
What You'll Need
Minimum Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Operations, R&D Operations, or Product/Technology leadership with advanced degree within high-growth SaaS
5+ years leading a global or enterprise PMO, Technical Program Management, or equivalent strategic operations function
Experience implementing or evolving portfolio management, planning, or workforce visibility tooling in scaled environments
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage in high-level SaaS and platform architecture discussions, understand system trade-offs, and ask the right questions across business requirements, design, and execution
Deep understanding of modern product development and engineering delivery models, including Agile, Lean, and hybrid approaches.
Exceptional executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to partner credibly with Product, UX, Engineering, and executive leadership
A leadership style grounded in clarity, empathy, data-driven thinking, and the courage to challenge priorities when necessary to protect outcomes
Preferred Qualifications
MBA or advanced technical or business degree
Relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile credentials
Working Conditions & Travel Requirements
Up to 30% travel to meet with teams in other offices, customers, vendors, and/or suppliers, attend trade shows, etc
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office
How You’ll Be Rewarded
✅ Salary range in the US: $247,400.00 - $345,000.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually
✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire
✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package
The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.
Why Join Workiva
Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.
At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.
Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .
Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.
Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

jobs.title: UNPAID VOLUNTEER - Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
UNPAID VOLUNTEER – Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Type: Unpaid Volunteer
Number of Positions: 1
Location: Home-based / Remote
Time Commitment: Approximately 20 hours per week, flexibly arranged
Reporting To: Director-General
THIS IS AN UNPAID VOLUNTEER ROLE.
About DTID
The Digital Technology Institute for Development (DTID) is an international non-profit institute advancing the responsible use of artificial intelligence, blockchain and emerging digital technologies to support sustainable development and policy implementation.
DTID brings together professionals, researchers, technology specialists and other stakeholders to generate research, develop practical solutions, strengthen partnerships and support informed decision-making at the intersection of technology, climate change and sustainable development.
The Role
DTID is seeking an experienced, innovative and technically accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to provide strategic and technical leadership across the organisation's emerging technology portfolio.
Reporting directly to the Director-General, the CTO will lead DTID's work across Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)/Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Data Science, Big Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Quantum Computing and technology standards.
The successful candidate will be responsible for defining DTID's technology strategy, overseeing technology research and development, leading technical teams and translating emerging technologies into practical solutions that support climate action, sustainable development and policy implementation.
The CTO will also oversee the development of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology applications; strengthen DTID's internal technical capabilities; develop strategic partnerships; and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary projects.
Strong practical proficiency in blockchain development and programming is essential for this role. Experience developing artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions is highly desirable.
This is a senior leadership position requiring strong technical expertise, strategic thinking, people leadership and the ability to communicate complex technology concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
The Chief Technology Officer will:
Define and lead DTID's technology strategy and roadmap across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies, quantum computing and related emerging technologies.
Lead and manage DTID's emerging technology teams and standards-development activities, including recruitment, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.
Oversee the design, development, testing and deployment of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology solutions.
Guide the application of DLT/Blockchain, AI, machine learning, data science, data modelling, IoT and other emerging technologies across DTID projects.
Ensure appropriate standards for the quality, reliability, security, scalability and documentation of DTID's technology products and solutions.
Monitor and evaluate the performance and impact of technology initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to Technology Officers and multidisciplinary project teams.
Identify and develop strategic technology partnerships with research institutions, technology organisations, governments, international organisations and other relevant stakeholders.
Monitor emerging technology trends and assess their potential application to climate action, sustainable development and public policy.
Represent DTID at relevant conferences, technical forums, stakeholder meetings and external engagements.
Contribute technical expertise to DTID research, publications, standards, proposals and institutional initiatives.
Collaborate with the Director-General and other senior leaders to ensure technology priorities support DTID's wider strategic objectives.
