jobs.title: VP Product Management, Teaching and Learning (OnCourse)
jobs.text:
Clarivate is seeking a Vice President, Teaching & Learning to shape and scale onCourse, our AI-native platform designed to help higher education institutions transform teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, and student success. This is a high-impact opportunity for a product-led, commercially minded executive to build a new growth business by pairing deep higher education market expertise with Clarivate’s trusted university relationships, differentiated content and data assets, global commercial reach, and scale.
About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments
10+ years of leadership experience in higher education technology, enterprise edtech, digital learning, curriculum technology, SaaS, or a closely related market.
5+ years of experience leading product management, product strategy, business unit, or general management functions.
Demonstrated experience launching, building, repositioning, or scaling a software product, product line, platform, or new venture.
Experience owning or contributing to product strategy, roadmap prioritization, pricing, go-to-market planning, pipeline development, or sales enablement.
Experience working directly with higher education institutions, university leaders, enterprise customers, strategic partners, design partners, or early adopters.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, finance, operations, or customer-facing functions.
It would be great if you also have . . .
Business-unit, general management, founder, or startup leadership experience.
Experience taking a business from early validation to meaningful commercial scale.
Familiarity with AI-enabled teaching and learning, curriculum intelligence, learning analytics, or emerging education platforms.
Strong understanding of institutional buying, enterprise sales cycles, customer adoption, implementation realities, and commercial execution.
Established relationships and credibility across the higher education market, including a network of institutional leaders, partners, influencers, or potential early adopters.
Ability to influence investment decisions, align senior stakeholders, and communicate clearly with executives, customers, partners, and internal teams.
What will you be doing in this role?
Own the business strategy, product direction, market development, commercialization, customer adoption, and revenue growth for onCourse and related Teaching & Learning opportunities.
Define market focus, customer segments, value proposition, growth model, investment priorities, and the path from launch to repeatable adoption and revenue scale.
Set product vision and roadmap priorities in partnership with Technology, grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, and commercial goals.
Lead customer discovery, design partner engagement, and product-market fit validation to focus on capabilities that drive adoption.
Own the revenue plan, go-to-market approach, pricing, pipeline strategy, and sales enablement model in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Technology.
Develop executive relationships with universities, design partners, early adopters, and strategic prospects to accelerate validation, pipeline creation, and market credibility.
Drive pipeline creation, deal progression, customer conversion, and predictable commercial performance.
Lead an integrated team across sales, product management, and product marketing while partnering closely with technology, content, AI, finance, and operations.
Align senior leaders around the business case, market opportunity, investment needs, and path to growth.
About the Team
The Teaching & Learning business is focused on creating AI-powered solutions that help higher education institutions improve teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, adoption, and student success. This role will work closely with leaders and teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, content, AI, finance, and operations to bring onCourse and related opportunities to market.
Hours of Work
This is a full-time position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to adjust to various global time zones as needed. Work arrangement and office expectations should be confirmed based on the approved posting location.
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

jobs.text:
Would you like to work on a new IP and new genre at teamLFG that combines amazing action feel with lighthearted and whimsical characters? Are you on a mission to create games that bond players together into deeply invested communities?
As an Engineering Director at teamLFG, you will hire, build and direct a technology organization to deliver amazing never-seen-before game experiences. Your organization will build and utilize a wide range of technologies and workflows to develop, continuously deliver, and maintain a live production game service. As part of the project and studio leadership team, you will create and evolve a technology strategy that is aligned with project goals and initiatives and serves the needs of the game, its players, and employees. As part of a diverse company that prizes creativity and technical excellence, your servant leadership will inspire and motivate a cross-discipline team to help build a new franchise beloved by millions.
We look for candidates who value joining a mission-focused team with a diverse set of backgrounds, experiences, interests, and viewpoints.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary project leadership team to develop and maintain a product technology strategy that is informed by product vision, technical costs, and long-term technology goals
Leveraging the Unreal Engine and technology the team has built, direct the engineering organization to tackle challenging problems, find combinations of innovative technology with proven models, and build reliable solutions that deliver game experiences while sensibly managing technology risks
Recruit, nurture, and retain an engineering organization (30+ engineers, both internal FTE and external codev) with the skills, capacity, and adaptability to navigate uncertainty and deliver on the changing needs of the project
Manage multiple senior engineering leads, providing management support, technical guidance, constructive feedback, and career development coaching
Work with production leadership to schedule, track, deliver, and close out game features and releases, anticipating and mitigating any critical risks encountered, technical or otherwise
Communicate with PlayStation executives, directors, and technology teams, as needed
REQUIRED SKILLS
Experience managing an organization of 20+ engineers on AAA game engineering teams
Experience working with and directing co-development engineering teams
Experience with developing and running online games in a live service environment
Ability to align with leadership and executive stakeholders, translate goals into strategic technology solutions with a thorough understanding of cost, efficiency, and quality tradeoffs, and then lead an organization to execute on a technology strategy
Effectively communicate with and inspire fellow engineers by driving team alignment and buy-in on technology vision and architectural principles
Ability to work with a team in a hybrid environment, leveraging real time chat communications and documentation across an entire game studio
Ability to communicate with stakeholders of different business, technical, and non-technical backgrounds, to help align objectives and negotiate common goals
NICE TO HAVE SKILLS
Experience with development using the Unreal Engine
Experience with development on a variety of platforms (PC, console)
Experience with agile development methodologies
At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.
Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.
This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
$255,000—$383,000 USD

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Location: Kassel , Germany
Work Policy: Remote-first within Germany; optional office days; not advertised as fully remote internationally
Work Experience: Several years in a CTO/VP Engineering (or similar) role within FinTech or banking
Language Requirement: English C1, German C1
Employment Type: Full-time
Technical Skills Required: Engineering Management, Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), REST/GraphQL APIs, data analytics & AI/ML stacks, banking security & compliance frameworks
Industry: FinTech/Data Analytics for Banking
Positions Available: 1
Company Mission
Account transaction data reflects the entirety of a customer's life—we help our partners understand this data quickly, easily, and efficiently, and leverage it profitably.
Core Values
Scope to Shape Your Role:
High level of personal responsibility, open communication, active involvement in shaping the business, and a motivated, success-oriented team
Flexible Work:
Remote-first with hybrid options, flexible working hours, modern equipment, "workation" opportunities—plus time off on December 24th and 31st
Tech & Innovation:
Modern tech stack and AI-driven culture
Attractive Perks:
Annual bonus, gifts for work anniversaries and milestone birthdays, corporate benefits program, discounted mobile phone plans, company pension contributions exceeding statutory requirements, capital-forming benefits, and automatic salary adjustments at fixed intervals
Health & Mobility:
Commuter pass, bike leasing, and discounted fitness & wellness offers in your city (egym)
Tasks
You position the company as a pioneer of data-driven business models in Europe and help define how the financial industry of tomorrow will utilize data
You actively drive the company’s technological vision—ranging from new technologies to entirely new product concepts—while maintaining a consistent customer-centric focus
You independently conduct sales discussions at the C-level, inspiring decision-makers with your technological foresight and a clear understanding of the business value for them
You collaborate with our customers to identify new use cases and develop viable business ideas and models based on our existing capabilities
You own the technology roadmap, prioritizing initiatives clearly and based on data to ensure engineering and product teams focus on the areas that deliver the greatest impact.
You work closely with our founder and executive leadership as a strategic partner, actively shaping fino’s strategic direction
You measure the success of your decisions using clear metrics and consistently derive the next steps from those insights
Requirements
You bring several years of experience in a CTO, VP of Engineering, or comparable technical leadership role, ideally within the FinTech or banking sector
You possess an entrepreneurial and visionary mindset, a keen sense for emerging technologies, and the ability to independently derive promising business models from them
You are characterized by a strong hands-on mentality and genuinely enjoy championing and advancing your ideas directly in client discussions
You communicate clearly and persuasively with clients, your team, and executive management—including at the decision-maker level
You possess a deep technical understanding of modern cloud architectures, APIs, data analytics, and AI, as well as the security and regulatory requirements of the banking industry
You are fluent in German and English (negotiation level) and—given our ongoing European expansion—ideally possess additional foreign language skills
Benefits
Key role in positioning the company as a European pioneer of data-driven business models and significantly shaping the tech vision.
Direct collaboration with the founder and CEO offers great strategic scope and quick decisions.
Mixture of technology leadership and customer-centered business development enables high impact right up to your own C-level sales.
Remote-first with 5 home office days, flexible working hours and workation option creates maximum freedom and work-life balance.
Modern cloud, API and AI tech stack as well as strong AI culture promote continuous learning and innovation.
Attractive package: fixed salary, individual annual bonus, 28 vacation days plus December 24th/31st free, job ticket, bike leasing, egym and much more.
Medium-sized, unbureaucratic environment with regular team events and dog-friendly Kassel office strengthens cohesion and ownership.
Why Work With Them
Strategic freedom to shape a market-leading FinTech
Direct impact on European expansion
Modern AI-first stack
Remote-first flexibility without corporate red tape

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About the Role
The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.
What you will be doing
Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.
Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Security Technology Specialist
jobs.text:
As a Lead Product Specialist you will use your knowledge and experience to work with customers to better understand their needs and challenges and map them to capabilities across our products and services. You’ll work closely with the Cloud Software Group (CSG) field teams and provide hands-on product expertise to a variety of customer segments, including many Fortune 100 & 500 customers, to deliver technical outcomes that help drive the successful adoption and expansion of our solutions. As a specialist, you’ll focus on new and advanced capabilities of our products as well as use cases to help support expanding the customer’s journey with CSG. As part of the Product Specialist team you’ll work with Account Technology Strategists, Account Executives, SolutionEnterprise Architects, Customer Success and Field CTOs to establish a shared vision with our customers and help them achieve their strategic goals.
Role Responsibility:
Deliver subject matter expert knowledge on designated specialist focus areas and establish yourself as a trusted advisor within the customer to accelerate time to value
Deliver complex, customized demonstrations and proof of value that highlight the outcomes that can be delivered
Navigate technical decision points, architecture, and technical strategy to aid in the adoption and expansion of products and services
Support a successful hands-on technical onboarding experience by managing readiness and assisting with the initial configuration to adopt new products and services
Build awareness of products and features and help remove barriers to adoption
Collaboration with cross-functional teams within the Cloud Software Group including Account Executives, Account Technical Specialists,, Demo Center team, Enablement, and Solution Architects
Collaborate with Product Management to provide bi-directional feedback to and from the PM team to influence product roadmap and provide valuable customer feedback
Help drive awareness into the field technical teams on product specialties including new technical capabilities, new tech previews, customer use cases, and success stories
Delivering value throughout the life of the subscription by supporting the accounts teams, driving deep solution awareness
Have good communication skills, consistently communicating status, next steps, risks, etc. to both internal and external stakeholders
Support emerging technical needs, working to uncover use cases and customer success stories to share with the field
Contribute to internal initiatives to deliver webinars, presentations, and the creation of reference architectures, Techzone guides, etc. to aid onboarding and adoption of new technologies within the field and our customer accounts
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical domain, including but not limited to Computer Science, Engineering IT, or equivalent experience is required experience
8 + years in a high-tech customer-facing role (Professional Services, engineering, systems administrator, sales engineering, or consulting)
High level of specialized knowledge of Cloud Software Group products, including Citrix and NetScaler
Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Certifications are a plus
Ability to effectively deliver and implement technical projects across multiple simultaneous engagements in a customer-facing capacity
Excellent oral, written skills and presentation skills
An excellent customer service demeanor and able to engage with different levels of audiences
About Us:
Cloud Software Group is one of the world’s largest cloud solution providers, serving more than 100 million users around the globe. When you join Cloud Software Group, you are making a difference for real people, each of whom count on our suite of cloud-based products to get work done — from anywhere. Members of our team will tell you that we value passion for technology and the courage to take risks. Everyone is empowered to learn, dream, and build the future of work. We are on the brink of another Cambrian leap -- a moment of immense evolution and growth. And we need your expertise and experience to do it. Now is the perfect time to move your skills to the cloud.
Cloud Software Group is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, genetic carrier status, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions (including lactation status), marital status, military service, protected veteran status, political activity or affiliation, taking or requesting statutorily protected leave and other protected classifications.
If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any part of the application process, please contact us via the Bridge portal for assistance.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution
jobs.text:
Trustmark’s mission is to improve wellbeing – for everyone. It is a mission grounded in a belief in equality and born from our caring culture. It is a culture we can only realize by building trust. Trust established by ensuring associates feel respected, valued and heard. At Trustmark, you’ll work collaboratively to transform lives and help people, communities and businesses thrive. Flourish in a culture of diversity and inclusion where appreciation, mutual respect and trust are constants, not just for our customers but for ourselves. At Trustmark, we have a commitment to welcoming people, no matter their background, identity or experience, to a workplace where they feel safe being their whole, authentic selves. A workplace made up of diverse, empowered individuals that allows ideas to thrive and enables us to bring the best to our colleagues, clients and communities.
About the role
Trustmark is looking for an Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution. Please apply if you are qualified and would like to be considered for the role.
Responsible for driving new product development through deep market research, trend analysis, and customer insight to establish and sustain competitive advantage. Identifies emerging market opportunities and translates data-driven insights into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap aligned with business strategy for group and individual products. . By leveraging continuous discovery and validation, ensures products solve meaningful customer problems while minimizing risk and accelerating time to market. Partners cross-functionally to align innovation efforts with long-term growth objectives and operational execution. Builds repeatable systems for market intelligence, feedback, and performance measurement to support ongoing optimization. Through disciplined governance and outcome-driven decision-making, enables scalable innovation and long-term health product portfolio success.
Key Accountabilities:
Product Development & Leadership
Ensures the health product portfolio is top tier in market; proactively identifies portfolio gaps and leads product prioritization and development to ensure the right offerings are available to sell.
Strong knowledge and insight into the voluntary benefits marketplace, building relationships throughout the voluntary market and deepening understanding of evolving trends.
Primary storyteller in supporting field partners, making sure products are effectively sold, understood, and communicated across teams and channels.
Leads all facets of the product development process including research, product design, sales strategy, market analysis, documentation of product requirements, cost benefit analysis and implementation.
Leads risk analysis on key issues including internal and external resources and capabilities needed to bring new products successfully to market.
Establishes and manages budgets, operational plans for products under development and management.
Leads development of health product claims strategy, including claims integration solutions, as well as ongoing customer experience opportunities.
Responsible for overall value-add/care delivery strategies relative to supplemental health products; manages relationships with external vendors and partners; responsible for RFP/finalist process in partner selection, leading overall process and collaborating internally to identify best options.
Owns product strategy from concept to market by leveraging deep market and competitive analysis to define, position, and champion new product offerings that strengthen the company’s product and business position
Product Execution
Collaboratively works with underwriting, sales and marketing teams to competitively position and build awareness of new products with producers.
Leads as the central point of expertise on product knowledge and market needs, enabling associates to successfully sell and administer the product.
Product Management
Accountable for ensuring all product line initiatives achieve targeted return on investment goals, being adaptive and nimble to drive expected results.
Coaches direct reports on how to maintain product health across the organization; ultimately responsible for success, prioritization, and driving initiatives with internal technology and project partners.
Develops and owns KPIs that measure the success of new product initiatives, providing actionable insights that enable data‑driven decisions and rapid course correction throughout the product lifecycle.
Ensures all products are compliant and timely action is taken to address regulatory changes.
Other duties as needed/assigned.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree.
7-10 years of experience in industry with some experience across product development, product management and implementation.
Experience developing or managing voluntary and/or group products.
Ability to lead/influence without direct oversight.
Proven ability to develop and revise strategy and tactics to propel business growth.
Ability to analyze and interpret challenging concepts and resolve complex issues.
Ability to inspire, lead, and coach both leaders and employees.
Experience working collaboratively across the organization to build consensus and synergies that support attainment of division goals, handle conflicts, negotiate, and promote team spirit.
Must be innovative and creative in looking for ways to improve current processes.
Integrity and strength of character.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Preferred:
Deep broker/market connections in voluntary benefits and adjacent markets.
Sales-related experience, including any client-facing roles – technology, partnerships, account executive/account management, or similar.
Expertise in leading research projects and synthesizing consumer insights.
The compensation range for this role is (based on the corporate location in Lake Forest, Illinois):
$136,933 - $204,463 per year
The final salary offer will be determined based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, skill set, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus. We understand that compensation is an important factor when considering a new opportunity, and we strive to provide a competitive salary within the market.
Brand: Trustmark
In addition to compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Health/dental/vision, life insurance, FSA and HSA, 401(k) plan, Employee Assistant Program, Back-up Care for Children, Adults and Elders and many health and wellness initiatives. We also offer a Wellness program that enables employees to participate in health initiatives to reduce their insurance premiums. A workplace made up of diverse, empowered individuals that allows ideas to thrive and enables us to bring the best to our colleagues, clients and communities.
About the role
Trustmark is looking for an Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution. Please apply if you are qualified and would like to be considered for the role.

Responsible for driving new product development through deep market research, trend analysis, and customer insight to establish and sustain competitive advantage. Identifies emerging market opportunities and translates data-driven insights into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap aligned with business strategy for group and individual products. . By leveraging continuous discovery and validation, ensures products solve meaningful customer problems while minimizing risk and accelerating time to market. Partners cross-functionally to align innovation efforts with long-term growth objectives and operational execution. Builds repeatable systems for market intelligence, feedback, and performance measurement to support ongoing optimization. Through disciplined governance and outcome-driven decision-making, enables scalable innovation and long-term health product portfolio success.

Product Development & Leadership

Primary storyteller in supporting field partners, making sure products are effectively sold, understood, and communicated across teams and channels.

Leads risk analysis on key issues including internal and external resources and capabilities needed to bring new products successfully to market.
Establishes and manages budgets, operational plans for products under development and management.
Leads development of health product claims strategy, including claims integration solutions, as well as ongoing customer experience opportunities.

Responsible for overall value-add/care delivery strategies relative to supplemental health products; manages relationships with external vendors and partners; responsible for RFP/finalist process in partner selection, leading overall process and collaborating internally to identify best options.

Owns product strategy from concept to market by leveraging deep market and competitive analysis to define, position, and champion new product offerings that strengthen the company’s product and business position
Product Execution
Collaboratively works with underwriting, sales and marketing teams to competitively position and build awareness of new products with producers.
Leads as the central point of expertise on product knowledge and market needs, enabling associates to successfully sell and administer the product.

Accountable for ensuring all product line initiatives achieve targeted return on investment goals, being adaptive and nimble to drive expected results.

Coaches direct reports on how to maintain product health across the organization; ultimately responsible for success, prioritization, and driving initiatives with internal technology and project partners.

Develops and owns KPIs that measure the success of new product initiatives, providing actionable insights that enable data‑driven decisions and rapid course correction throughout the product lifecycle.

Ability to analyze and interpret challenging concepts and resolve complex issues.
Ability to inspire, lead, and coach both leaders and employees.
Experience working collaboratively across the organization to build consensus and synergies that support attainment of division goals, handle conflicts, negotiate, and promote team spirit.

Integrity and strength of character.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Deep broker/market connections in voluntary benefits and adjacent markets.
Sales-related experience, including any client-facing roles – technology, partnerships, account executive/account management, or similar.
Expertise in leading research projects and synthesizing consumer insights.

jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering - Combustion Systems - Remote
jobs.text:
About Roadrunner Venture Studios
Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation's leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in frontier technology. We partner with scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs to turn deep technology into real companies. Our work spans energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, quantum computing, aerospace, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, and high performance computing.
About the Role
Roadrunner Venture Studios is recruiting a Head of Hardware Engineering for a portfolio company developing rainfall enhancement technology.
You will lead the deployment system from architecture and prototyping through operational qualification and production-scale manufacturing.
You will apply aerospace rigor to industrial hardware that must operate reliably in the field and support repeatable manufacturing at automotive scale. The work spans mechanical, thermal, combustion, fluid, structural, controls, and instrumentation systems.
This is a hands-on role. You will work with internal science and field teams and lead external engineering firms, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
This role includes significant equity.
This is an early-stage startup building something that has not been built before. Priorities will change quickly. If this working environment does not excite you, this role is probably not for you.
What You Will Do
Technical Leadership
System Architecture: Own requirements and architecture across mechanical, thermal, combustion, structural, fluid, gas-handling, controls, and instrumentation systems.
Hardware Development: Lead the system from early design through prototypes, integrated builds, field-ready hardware, and production planning.
Combustion and Thermal Systems: Lead the design and qualification of combustion hardware, fuel and gas handling, flow and pressure systems, and thermal management.
Qualification and Field Operations: Define verification methods and lead shop tests, integrated system tests, field qualification, troubleshooting, and failure reviews.
Manufacturing and External Partners
Turn engineering concepts into computer aided design models, drawings, bills of materials, supplier packages, build instructions, and acceptance criteria.
Lead design for manufacturing and assembly so prototypes can mature into reliable production hardware.
Manage engineering, procurement, and construction firms, fabricators, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other external partners.
Use test data, field observations, supplier feedback, and failure analysis to drive design improvements and production readiness.
Business and Team Management
Outcome Ownership: Own the hardware schedule, budget, qualification timeline, technical quality, partner deliverables, and production plan.
Team Building: Recruit, mentor, and manage a small team of hardware engineers.
Work across science, field operations, business, and external partners to resolve technical risks and keep the hardware program moving.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or a related field.
Experience leading complex hardware from concept through prototype builds, operational qualification, and production planning.
High proficiency with computer aided design software such as SolidWorks or NX and product lifecycle management systems.
Experience with engineering release processes, configuration control, drawings, bills of materials, and supplier documentation.
Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly for industrial, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy, or other complex hardware.
Experience with combustion hardware, thermal systems, fluid systems, gas handling, pressure systems, large field equipment, or power systems.
Experience with test instrumentation, data acquisition, controls interfaces, inspection methods, qualification plans, and operational readiness reviews.
Experience managing engineering firms, fabrication shops, suppliers, contract manufacturers, or engineering, procurement, and construction partners.
Experience supporting field tests or deployments and making engineering decisions under changing operating conditions.
At least three years of experience leading hardware development and developing engineering talent.
Ability to move quickly, take broad ownership, and solve complex problems with limited resources in a startup environment.
Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD), especially for combustion, heat transfer, fluid flow, or gas-handling systems.
Experience taking hardware from prototype builds into first-article or low-rate production.
Experience with aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, robotics, or other high-reliability hardware programs.
Experience building a hardware engineering function at an early-stage company.
Location
This role is remote but may be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, or New Mexico if you would like to be near on of our hubs. The balance between in-person and remote work can be tailored to the candidate and team needs. Frequent travel is required.

jobs.title: Director of Business Systems Product Management
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.
Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.
The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth.
Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole — including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.
This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ
What You'll Do
Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Recruit and coach 6–10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.
Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6–10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.
Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.
Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.
Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.
Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.
Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.
Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.
What You Bring
Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Finance, Business, or another technical/analytical field.
10+ years in product management, business systems, or a related technical role, including 3+ years leading product managers. Experience managing managers is a plus.
Track record owning enterprise systems end to end across more than one business function, accountable for the outcome rather than the delivery alone.
Experience across both external-facing and internal-facing systems, and a clear point of view on why the quality bar should be the same for both.
Experience designing for multiple personas on a shared surface, where a seller, an admin, and a finance user all need the product to work without it becoming a compromise for all three.
Depth in at least two of: quote-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, supply chain planning and fulfillment, or the employee lifecycle — with credible curiosity about the rest.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, or comparable platforms, and with the integration patterns that connect them.
Basic SQL, Python, JavaScript and HTML. You should be able to interrogate the data yourself.
Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and experience partnering with design. You can review a wireframe and tell the difference between a workflow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around.
Experience preparing and delivering to executive leadership, including defending a roadmap and a make-versus-buy recommendation.
An ideal candidate handles ambiguity, moves fast, and builds alignment across a demanding stakeholder group — keeping leadership informed and bought in along the way.
Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits
Additional Information
We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.
Annual Pay Range

blocks.text: Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.

The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth.

Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole — including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.
This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ
What You'll Do

items: Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Recruit and coach 6–10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.
Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6–10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.
Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.
Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.
Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.
Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.
Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.
Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Mission Summary:
Reporting to the VP, Commercialization, the Director of Product Management will serve as the strategic leader for Motional’s product team and lead the design and execution of product vision and design to ensure every rider has the best rider experience possible. Working closely with executive and senior leaders and a team of product managers, you will build out our product vision and oversee the design of our entire AV system of systems. You will incorporate feedback from riders, executives, shareholders and customers and leverage these insights to ensure we are providing the best possible experience with a sustainable business mindset. This includes aligning roadmaps and products across Autonomy, Engineering, Operations, Mission Support, and Commercial teams.
This is a pivotal time to join Motional because we are at a historic stage of transitioning from developing an autonomous vehicle to deploying and operating a commercial driverless service. As we transition from development to deployment in Las Vegas in 2026, we are setting the stage to scale our technology globally. This role requires a visionary product leader who can zoom out to build a cohesive Motional point of view on the product experience, while zooming in to untangle complex technical dependencies between hardware, AI, and operations. You will ultimately lead our product teams, establishing a high-velocity development loop that ensures every release is safer, more performant, and more commercially viable than the last and our tools develop and scale for growth.
This role will be expected to travel up to 50% of the time depending on the business purpose and product deliverables.
What you'll be doing:
Build and Lead the Product Organization: Attract, hire, and inspire a small and mighty world-class team of Product Managers. You will establish a product culture focused on analytical rigor, cross-functional collaboration, and high-quality execution.
Define the Motional Product POV: Lead the development of a unified product vision that spans the entire rider journey and technical stack on and off the AV. You will consolidate disparate roadmaps into a single, unified strategy for Motional’s robotaxi service. You have expertise at managing all aspects of the product life-cycle, from conceptualization to market introduction and production, and product dimensions including technical, commercial/business, financial, legal and legislative.
Establish Prioritization Frameworks: Create and enforce rigorous, data-driven frameworks to balance competing priorities across Engineering, Fleet Operations, and Commercial teams. You will make the hard trade-offs between technical capability, system complexity, and time-to-market.
Catalyze Autonomous Performance & Developer Velocity: Oversee the product strategy for our underlying autonomy tools and data pipelines. Partner deeply with leads to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve strategies, and ensure engineering teams can rapidly iterate on performance.
Orchestrate Hardware & Software Synergy: Own the feedback loop between the in-vehicle experience, the physical fleet, and the backend software. Ensure the product roadmap maximizes the capabilities of our vehicle platform and scales effectively for daily operations. Influence and support the current and future generation platforms with OEMs, help execute commercial and go-to-market strategies for expansion and prepare for growth.
Lead Strategic Internal Collaborations: Establish the product organization's "rhythm of business," including roadmap reviews, resource allocation meetings, and executive briefings. You will act as the primary operational bridge aligning internal technical execution with external commercial obligations.
Customer and Partner Obsession: You will collaborate to define the integration scope and milestones with partners. Your team will own the technical customer-facing aspects of our integrations with ride-hail partners and owners and operators, ensuring a seamless and successful partnership.
Define Success & Track KPIs: Define what "winning" looks like across Safety, Progress, and Comfort. Track and report on key performance indicators, ensuring our engineering velocity translates directly into measurable improvements in the Operational Design Domain (ODD) and rider experience.
What we're looking for:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent field, or commensurate professional experience.
10+ years relevant professional experience in Product Management, with a minimum of 5+ years leading product teams within Autonomous Vehicles, Ride-Hail, robotics, or complex AI/ML industries.
Systems-Level Thinking: You have a proven ability to unify fragmented workflows and consolidate disparate product strategies into a single cohesive vision.
Technical Authority: Deep foundational understanding of the ML development lifecycle, data curation, and autonomous systems. You can hold your own in architecture reviews and engage with engineers on data pipelines and algorithmic requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership: You possess a proven track record of orchestrating complex projects across highly technical and non-technical teams, translating commercial needs into clear directives for Autonomy and Operations.
Executive Presence: You possess superb communication skills and can command a room. You are experienced in leading executive presentations, strategy discussions, and high-visibility roadmap reviews with polish and professionalism.
Strategic & Operational Balance: You can set the multi-year vision for the product while also sweating the details of short-term technical execution and developer efficiency.
Interpersonal Savvy: Soft skills that earn the confidence of leaders and peers, including empathy, organization, clear communication, influencing without authority, low ego, and the ability to build trust.
Bonus points (preferred, not required):
Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience building and scaling product organizations at a leading Level 4 autonomous vehicle or advanced robotics company.
Commercial Launch and Scale Experience: Experience coordinating the commercial side of a complex, physical-world product launch in a new market and scale.
This role is based in our Pittsburgh office and requires in-office days each week.
#LI-AM1
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.
Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.
Salary Range
$212,000—$291,500 USD
Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

jobs.text:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From Home
We are looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who can think clearly about systems, make strong technical decisions, and help build the engineering organization from the ground up. The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will be part of founding team to shape the technical direction of the company, while helping build a strong engineering team across the globe. This position is 100% Remote.
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Responsibilities:
Technical Direction:
Define the long-term architecture for AI systems, infrastructure, and developer platform.
Evaluate trade-offs between speed of iteration and long-term system design.
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, and long-term evolution.
Guide key decisions across model integration, data pipelines, distributed systems, and product architecture.
Engineering Leadership:
Work with engineers to translate product direction into clear technical execution.
Help structure engineering workstreams and keep teams aligned on priorities.
Maintain high engineering standards while keeping the team focused on shipping.
Establish engineering culture, development practices, and technical standards across the company.
Building the Team:
Build and scale a world-class engineering team across key talent hubs including China and US.
Identify strong technical leaders and help build a high-quality engineering organization.
Define hiring standards and interview processes to maintain a high engineering bar.
Coordination and Execution:
Work closely with product, research, and leadership teams.
Ensure technical workstreams move forward smoothly across teams and locations.
Help resolve cross-team technical and execution challenges.
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Qualifications:
Strong technical foundation in system architecture, large-scale systems, distributed architecture.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) experience required.
Ability to reason clearly about complex systems and make pragmatic technical decisions.
Experience building or leading high-performing engineering teams.
Strong judgment on technical trade-offs and engineering priorities.
Comfortable operating in early-stage environments with high ambiguity.
Clear communication and ability to align teams.
We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy building teams, superior products and shaping engineering organizations.
Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

Accelerate your career with PradeepIT
PradeepIT is one of the largest, globally recognized IT Consulting firm to connect India's deeply vetted talent team to global customer.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Director, Trading Products
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.
We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.
What We Look For In You
Domain Depth
5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.
Ways of Working
Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.
Nice-To-Haves
Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Technology and Security Risk Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated Technology and Security Risk Manager within the Second Line of Defence (2LOD). You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.
You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security & Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.
You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.
The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.
What You’ll Be Doing
Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.
Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight
Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.
Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.
Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight
Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.
Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.
What We Look For In You
8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.
Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.
Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.
Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.
Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.
Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.
Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.
Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.
Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.
A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Director of Forensic Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role:
The Director of Engineering provides technical and people leadership within YA Engineering Services’ forensic engineering practice, focusing on the evaluation of damaged building structures and related mechanical and electrical systems for insurance carriers, law firms, and other stakeholders. The position leads and mentors engineers while remaining hands on throughout the project lifecycle—from coordinating site visits and conducting field inspections to performing engineering analysis, interpreting applicable building codes, and producing clear, defensible reports that determine the cause and extent of building distress or failure. Work is field based and investigative in nature, emphasizing physical assets, materials, environmental factors, and building performance rather than information technology systems. The ideal candidate has an established client network and has a strong track record of building rapport and maintaining lasting client relationships. Please note that this position is not an IT or Software Engineering role.
In This Role, You Will:
Lead and mentor a team of engineers, supporting their development and project work
Reviews junior consultants’ work to ensure accurate, high-quality, and timely deliverables before client submission.
Ensure project budgets and scope are timely communicated to clients and strictly adhered to.
Drive timely delivery of all project milestones, consistently meeting or surpassing established deadlines.
Coordinates with clients to set up site visits and complete deliverables on projects
Produces project reports that synthesize data collected from our onsite inspections with environmental factors, material properties, and engineering analysis to determine the most likely cause and scope of distress and failures to buildings and components.
Performs site visits to collect field data on residential and commercial properties.
Reviews and interprets the relevant building codes as necessary for issues pertaining to our scope of work.
Assist in business development activities. Work with business development representatives to attend conferences, events, dinners, lunches, when applicable, to promote the company and your personal capabilities.
Performs additional duties as assigned.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
Active PE license
15 + years of forensic engineering experience
Proven ability to write comprehensive technical reports on inspection results
Willingness to travel up to 50%
Who We Are:
YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA Engineering Services (“YAES”) is a national forensic multi-disciplinary consulting firm. YAES provides immediate response to new assignments, performs investigations in a timely manner, and provides comprehensive reports that are clear, concise, and backed by reasonable analyses and recommendations. YAES offers a team of highly qualified, technically excellent engineering professionals who work seamlessly together to service the needs of our clients in the model of an engineering cooperative.
What We Offer:
Employee-focused culture
Strong commitment to work-life balance
100% Remote work
Flexible vacation & Paid holidays
Paid family care/sick leave
Parental leave
Comprehensive benefits
401k w/match
Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:
Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .
Disclosures:
As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist—rather than replace—human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.
