jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
About Nexcess
Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.
Overview
You will run and own the product engineering organization end to end: their architecture,delivery,andengineering roadmap. You are here to build and enable an engineering organization that ships fast and reliably, and how much of it is AI-efficiently enabled.
How we work
Business alignment and focus come first. Engineering here exists to move the business.
Key Performance Indicators
Speed: DORA metrics with High/Elite as the target.
Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software.
AI adoption and its impact.
Responsibilities
Product and delivery
Own architecture design, delivery and engineering roadmap for your teams. Build the partnership with Product: shape it together, commit to it, and then deliver it.
Run delivery on monthly cycles with an explicit cut line. Scope, design and deliver demonstrable value each month. Your teams must have an evidence backed ability to meet commitments rather than explained afterwards.
Organization and people
Design teams that deliver. Draw team boundaries so a team can finish its work without waiting on any other team. One accountable Engineering Manager per team, so the owner of any piece of work is known the moment it arrives.
Build the manager bench. Hire, develop, and calibrate engineering managers, own the hiring bar, and know who is ready to run each team. Coach them to lead rather than code.
Qualifications
Required
12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ leading engineering teams, and experience leading managers.
Evidence you have made an engineering organization measurably faster. You instrumented DORA or an equivalent, you know your before-and-after numbers, and can walk through what you changed and what broke while it settled.
Real, hands-on AI-assisted engineering at organizational scale, with impact you can quantify. Not a pilot and not a vendor rollout: adoption driven across teams, agentic tooling you use yourself every week, your own harness you can describe, and a clear view of where it fails and what to verify. Bring the evidence: the harness you run, a skill you wrote and shared, a spec an agent executed, the review gates you shipped.
Experience redesigning how teams and work are organized: boundaries, ownership, cadence, and living with the result.
Delivered and modernized complex software through multiple teams, including reassessing scope or dates with senior stakeholders and absorbing the consequences.
Hands-on enough to review a design, read a change and hold a defensible technical position without owning the implementation.
Owned a hiring plan end to end and held a bar; run software in production with real accountability for availability; led remote teams across time zones with vendor squads inside them, on agreements you shaped.
Managed hosting, cloud or another high-availability service business is a must.
Hard skills
Depth in any single technology matters less than the judgment to specify, verify and decide; AI supplies the syntax and the reference. These are the areas we will test that judgment in.
AI-native engineering. Agentic coding tools as your daily instrument and a harness you designed: repository instructions, shared skills, tool connectors, permission boundaries. Specification-first working, automated review in the pull-request path, a defensible position on what may be auto-approved, and quota and cost governance.
The delivery system. DORA instrumented and moved, tests on every change with coverage gating, trunk-based delivery and feature flags, observability and service levels, one tracker with one intake door, incident command with actions closed on dates.
Long-lived cores. Leading change on twenty-year Perl and PHP monoliths without writing either: strangler seams behind an API gateway, an identity issuer and an event bus, characterization tests before change, a system of record chosen where there are two of everything, and knowing what not to rewrite.
Revenue-bearing systems. Billing and payments consolidation across processors, Stripe among them: dual-run, reconciliation to Finance, and a rollback you prepared.
Hosting platforms. cPanel and InterWorx, the control panel we develop ourselves; WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware above them; Linux on bare metal, and a VMware to Nutanix migration that product delivery has to sequence around.
Security in an AI-assisted SDLC. Secrets hygiene and push protection, static analysis in the merge path, the tool and connector supply chain, prompt injection through repository content.

Nexcess is committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military status, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Data Management Office Director
jobs.text:
We are seeking an experienced leader to join a Government Entity in Saudi Arabia as:
Data Management Office Director
The Data Management Office Director will be responsible for leading the organization’s data management and governance agenda, establishing the required frameworks, policies, and operating models to ensure data quality, compliance, and effective utilization of data across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the development and implementation of the organization’s Data Strategy and Data Management Office roadmap in alignment with organizational objectives and national data regulations and standards.
• Establish and oversee data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Lead initiatives related to data quality, data classification, data protection, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
• Oversee the development and continuous improvement of policies and procedures governing data management practices.
• Enable effective use of data to support executive decision-making, organizational performance, and strategic initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with applicable national data management, governance, and protection requirements.
• Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across business functions.
• Oversee initiatives related to data sharing, open data, master and reference data, and other relevant data management domains.
• Define and monitor Data Management Office KPIs, data maturity indicators, compliance metrics, and data quality performance.
• Promote a data-driven culture and increase organizational awareness of data governance and management practices.
• Build, lead, and develop the Data Management Office team while ensuring effective delivery against strategic priorities.

• Lead the development and implementation of the organization’s Data Strategy and Data Management Office roadmap in alignment with organizational objectives and national data regulations and standards.
• Establish and oversee data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Lead initiatives related to data quality, data classification, data protection, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
• Oversee the development and continuous improvement of policies and procedures governing data management practices.
• Enable effective use of data to support executive decision-making, organizational performance, and strategic initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with applicable national data management, governance, and protection requirements.
• Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across business functions.
• Oversee initiatives related to data sharing, open data, master and reference data, and other relevant data management domains.
• Define and monitor Data Management Office KPIs, data maturity indicators, compliance metrics, and data quality performance.
• Promote a data-driven culture and increase organizational awareness of data governance and management practices.
• Build, lead, and develop the Data Management Office team while ensuring effective delivery against strategic priorities.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Role:
We are looking for a visionary and strategic Field CTO with a "learn-it-all" mindset to serve as a high-impact technical advisor for our most strategic prospects and customers. In this role, you will act as a peer to client executives, translating complex business transformations into scalable technical strategies. You will drive innovation by championing Process Intelligence ,Agentic AI and Enterprise Modernization, ensuring our technology aligns with the evolving needs of the global market.
The work you’ll do:
Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, aligning their long-term strategic goals with the Celonis technical vision.
Strategic Architecture & Roadmap: Lead the overarching data, cloud, and innovation strategy for our largest global accounts, utilizing methodologies like Capability Mapping to identify high-value opportunities.
Innovation Leadership: Architect "first-of-a-kind" solutions using emergent technologies like Agentic AI to solve complex enterprise challenges.
Sales & Business Impact: Partner with Sales and Value Engineering driving revenue through new customer acquisition and strategic up-selling.
Product Advocacy: Act as a critical feedback loop between our Product & Engineering teams and the market, ensuring the voice of the customer shapes our future offerings.
Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver customer-facing position papers, assets, and presentations that establish our brand as a leader in architecture and innovation.
The qualifications you need:
Experience: 15 to 20 years of relevant experience, ideally having served as a CTO at a consulting firm, as Field CTO at a software vendor, or Director/VP of Enterprise Architecture within a major corporation.
Strategic Communication: Proven track record of presenting complex technical visions to C-suite stakeholders in a way that emphasizes business value.
Modernization Expertise: Deep experience in Enterprise Modernization, EA Methodologies, and a robust understanding of Agentic AI.
Technical Versatility: Ability to pivot from high-level architecture diagrams to hands-on demo.
Technical Foundation: Excellent background in Data Architecture, API ecosystems, and cloud-native SaaS solutions like Salesforce and ServiceNow.
ERP/Domain: Strong knowledge of Oracle
Education: MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent IT-related field.
Preferred:
Tech Stack: Celonis, OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
Certifications: TOGAF/Zachmann , AWS/Azure/GCP , and ESB/ETL certifications (e.g., Mulesoft, Informatica).
Industry Breadth: Experience across at least two domains (e.g., Finance, Supply Chain) and two industries (e.g., Pharma, Banking, Aerospace)
Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

$204,000—$272,000 USD
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

jobs.title: Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.
The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis.
Mission Summary:
As the Director of Data Science, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for extracting intelligence from petabyte-scale on-road fleet data and simulation ecosystems. This leadership role is centered on building advanced data-driven methodologies, developing predictive and generative models, and serving as the primary analytical anchor supporting not only the Systems Readiness and Performance/Metrics teams but the whole company. You will drive the statistical rigor necessary to translate raw road data into high-fidelity performance metrics that directly inform vehicle launch readiness and safety-critical decisions.
What You'll Be Doing:
Rapid Operational Analytics: Execute fast-turnaround investigations on emergent fleet issues, converting real-time operational data into high-impact insights for launch decisions.
Advanced Exposure Modeling: Build complex statistical models to evaluate vehicle safety and performance across diverse environmental variables and Operational Design Domains.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the primary analytical anchor for Systems and Autonomy teams (Perception, Prediction, Planning).
Executive Artifacts: Work with other systems teams to distill raw telemetry and rapid-response findings into high-level strategy documents, visualizations, and dashboards.
Team Leadership: Mentor and scale a dedicated four-person team, instilling a culture that pairs rapid analytical agility with absolute scientific rigor.
What We're Looking For:
Industry Experience: 10+ years of professional experience leading data science or applied AI/ML initiatives, with at least 5 years explicitly scaling data-driven programs for autonomous driving, robotics, or complex safety-critical engineering systems.
Educational Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, or a highly quantitative field.
Expertise in Advanced Analytics: Deep foundational knowledge in statistical analysis, density estimation, hypothesis testing, uncertainty quantification, and causal reasoning.
Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Python, SQL, and data science infrastructure libraries, alongside a strong understanding of modern sequence modeling (Transformers) and distributed compute scaling frameworks (e.g., Ray, AWS).
System Deconstruction: Demonstrated track record of translating ill-defined, ambiguous real-world performance questions into structured metric designs and concrete solution architectures.
Exceptional Communication: Proven capacity to articulate highly technical data patterns and trade-offs into compelling strategies for cross-functional engineering peers and C-suite executives.
Collaborative Leadership: Strong interpersonal ability to wield cross-functional technical influence, resolve technical disagreements across teams, and establish organizational best practices around data integrity.
Bonus Points (not required):
Experience designing reward functions or applying Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) to evaluate human-like driving intent, assertiveness, and comfort.
Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, open-weights Vision-Language models (VLMs), or processing raw telemetry without text-translation bottlenecks.
Direct experience evaluating core onboard software subsystems like Perception, Prediction, or Motion Planning.
Deep familiarity with functional safety engineering standards like ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF)
This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Motional by enhancing our data understanding and accelerating development speed for our industry-leading autonomous vehicle metrics and capabilities ecosystem. We take pride in having some of the brightest and most dedicated talent in the world on our team. If you're innovative, driven, and eager to tackle challenges, we'd love to have you join us!
Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.
Travel Requirements (greater than 20%):
Expected to travel for 1-2 weeks each quarter visiting all of our testing sites - mostly to LV, but also domestically as needed for the business.
Working Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particlesThe noise level in the environment is low to moderate.
We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.
#LI-RR1 #LI-BP1
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.
Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.
Salary Range
$288,000—$396,000 USD
Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Head of Product, AI Enablement (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Purpose of Position
Own the product agenda for how AI creates real, measurable value across Awin — translating AI capability into shipped product outcomes, not experiments.
Context
Thousands of advertisers and publishers who stay on Awin platform because of the people and product behind the service. The next chapter of Awin's product strategy is defined by how deliberately we put AI to work — not as a slogan, but as a set of practical capabilities embedded into what we build and how the business runs.
Most companies treat AI as a layer bolted onto existing product thinking. We want the opposite: a Head of Product who treats AI as core to the product strategy itself — where it belongs, what it should never touch, and how it compounds value over time rather than producing one-off wins.
What you'll own
Product strategy for AI-driven value. Define where AI genuinely changes the economics or experience of our product — and where it doesn't. Prioritise like a product leader: value creation and value capture, not novelty.
Translate capability into roadmap. Convert what AI can practically do today into a prioritised, sequenced product agenda with clear outcomes — not a lab of disconnected pilots.
Own outcomes, not outputs. Every initiative under your remit is judged on measurable business impact — adoption, efficiency, revenue, or customer outcome — not on whether something "uses AI."
Partner at exec level. Work directly with leadership to align AI investment with company priorities, and defend that investment in commercial terms.
Lead a product team. Hire and develop the product talent needed to execute — with real ownership over people and budget.
Set the standard for build vs. buy. Make disciplined calls on when to adopt existing AI tooling versus build proprietary capability, with opportunity cost as the deciding factor.
Champion practical adoption over theatre. Internal and external users are your test of success — if a capability isn't used, it isn't done.
Who you are
Product leader with technical fluency. You've run product organisations and you understand, in practical terms, where AI creates leverage versus where it's a distraction.
Outcome-obsessed. You think in business impact first, technology second.
Commercially sharp. You can defend a roadmap in P&L terms as comfortably as in a product review.
Credible with engineering. You can go deep enough on data, APIs, and model capability to make good calls, without needing to be the one building it.
A builder of teams, not just plans — you know how to hire and develop product talent that ships.
What success looks like
A clear, prioritised AI product agenda in place; first initiatives shipped with measurable adoption.
A functioning product team; multiple AI-enabled capabilities live and driving demonstrable business outcomes.
AI is a defining, differentiated part of Awin's product experience — not a side initiative, but core to how the product wins in market.
What this role is not
Not an automation function. Not a central bureaucracy that runs projects for other teams. Not a lab for AI experimentation without a business case. This is a product leadership role — where AI is the primary lens, not a side interest.
Our Offer
Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.
Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.
Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.
Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.
Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why
Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering Applications, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From
jobs.text:
VP of Engineering Applications, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From Home
As the VP of Engineering Applications, you will turn intelligence into a real product. The VP of Engineering Applications is responsible for the engineering systems, teams, and execution that turn Machine Learning (ML) capability into reliable, fast, and intuitive user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop platforms. The VP of Engineering Applications role is a senior engineering leader who stays close to the product, makes hard technical decisions, and holds a high bar for quality and delivery. This position is 100% Remote.
MUST BE WILLING TO TAKE A 60 MINUTE CODING ASSESSMENT.
VP of Engineering Applications Responsibilities:
Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.
Lead and grow a small, senior applications team, including backend, mobile, and desktop engineers.
Set the architectural direction for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered product workflows, APIs, and client integrations.
Ensure AI capabilities are integrated into the product with clear abstractions, predictable behavior, and graceful failure modes.
Partner closely with Machine Learning leadership to translate model capability into shippable product features.
Make high-impact decisions across latency, cost, reliability, security, and user experience.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across backend, mobile, and desktop to prevent architectural drift.
Ensure production readiness: observability, monitoring, retries, fallbacks, privacy, and cost controls.
Balance speed and discipline shipping quickly without compromising long-term system quality.
VP of Engineering Applications Outcomes:
Reliable, low-latency Artificial Intelligence (AI) user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop
Clear architectural boundaries that allow teams to move fast without constant rewrites.
Measurable improvements in system performance, stability, and production reliability.
Strong observability and operational discipline across all application systems.
A small, senior team that ships frequently, owns what they build, and raises the technical bar.
Team members are empowered, growing in their roles, and able to make high-impact contributions.
VP of Engineering Applications Qualifications:
Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) experience required.
Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.
Experience delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered products, with a deep understanding of model integration trade-offs.
Excellent system design skills across services, APIs, clients, and data flows.
Comfort operating across platforms (backend, mobile, desktop), even if your depth is in one.
Proven ability to make high-impact technical decisions under ambiguity.
A strong bias toward shipping, iteration, and learning from real-world usage.
Low ego, strong judgment, and the ability to raise the technical bar for the entire applications organization.
Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

jobs.title: Executive Director of Product Management , Resiliency
jobs.text:
The Executive Director, Product Management – Supply Chain Resiliency reports to the VP, Product Management and owns the full product development lifecycle and go-to-market execution for GHX's Supply Resiliency Platform — the cross-application layer spanning two use-case tracks: Procure-to-Pay (hospital) and Order-to-Cash (manufacturer/supplier) workflows. This is a build-and-commercialize role: the Executive Director owns the platform requirements, product launch, and forward-deployed pilot through general availability, driving pilot customer selection and execution, product requirements and roadmap, commercial packaging and pricing, and cross-functional GTM alignment across Engineering, forward-deployed teams, Sales, Marketing, Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Care and Finance.
Areas of focus include, but are not solely limited to: pilot program design and stage-gate governance; product definition, roadmap execution, and technical alignment; commercial packaging, pricing, and profitability; competitive positioning; cross-functional consensus building; and executive/steering-committee reporting.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Healthcare supply chain resiliency is now a contested category: well-funded, AI-native challengers are selling point solutions directly to hospitals. This role is chartered to win that fight — turning GHX's two-sided network of 600+ connected providers and their suppliers into a resiliency platform that out-executes single-sided competitors on speed, breadth, and proven customer outcomes. The Executive Director owns that competitive outcome end to end, from platform definition through GA and beyond.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Working with a broad group of stakeholders and partners — across GHX product pods, Forward-Deployed Engineering, current and prospective pilot customers, and the executive leadership team — the Executive Director develops and leads GHX Product Management execution for the Supply Resiliency use case. Responsibilities also include identification and qualification of future use case prioritization.
Specific responsibilities include:
Own end-to-end product development lifecycle (PDLC) for GHX Orchestration, from forward-deployed pilot and prototype through GA commercialization, across both use-case tracks (Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash).
Design, govern, and continuously refine the pilot selection engine: Layer 1 binary hard gates (data access, SME time, on-site access, feedback cadence, executive sponsor) and the Layer 2 weighted scorecard used to rank and select pilot candidates.
Own pilot cohort selection and all stage-gate decisions (entry, mid-pilot, exit), including go/kill/reallocate calls on stalled accounts.
Partner directly with the Forward-Deployed Engineering team to scope on-site pilot engagements, define track-specific entry criteria and success metrics, and translate pilot learnings into a repeatable deployment playbook.
Own product-level success criteria and report progress against exit bars: P0/P1 issue resolution, GA-candidate certification, referenceable-logo targets, and quantified ROI proof points, by persona and by track.
Lead product's input into the GTM execution plan, keeping the commercial (pricing/packaging), pilot delivery, and marketing workstreams synchronized against the shared milestone schedule and dependency chain.
Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.
Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.
Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.
Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.
Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
A minimum of 10 years of Product Management experience.
Experience leading Product Management initiatives within the healthcare space is required.
Demonstrated experience designing or running structured pilot programs, forward-deployed engineering models, or similar early-access/co-development customer AI engagements.
Experience developing or executing usage-based, outcome-based, or hybrid commercial pricing models for enterprise software.
Ability to clearly communicate; work in team environments, with a minimum of 3 years people management experience.
Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.
Competency at developing strategies and execution plans for new businesses or new platform offerings.
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional project teams spanning Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services.
Strategic planning skills, including experience building and defending a go-to-market roadmap with executive stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills (oral and written communication).
Outstanding organizational skills and time management skills.
Travel is as needed (approximately 25%–50%), including on-site pilot customer visits.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
5+ years of healthcare software product management experience.
Experience managing healthcare supply chain products and services (Procure-to-Pay and/or Order-to-Cash) desirable but not necessary.
Experience launching or commercializing agentic AI or AI-enabled product capabilities.
Experience building pricing models that incorporate a metered or outcome-based component alongside a base subscription.
Experience showing ability to drive customer adoption of emerging technologies and solutions.
Track record winning head-to-head competitive evaluations against market challengers in enterprise or healthcare software.
Estimated Salary: $150,000 - $214,000 plus bonus

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Ndustrial has delivered $100M+ in energy savings for food producers, storage operators and retailers across the cold chain. Our Nsight™ platform integrates existing systems to turn energy into a measurable production input. It deploys in weeks and verifies savings in real time, without disrupting operations. Trusted by industry leaders like Lineage, Americold and ABB, we’re revolutionizing the way the cold chain uses energy for a more sustainable future.
More About Us:
We are a Raleigh, NC based Series B startup backed by world class investors and serve global customers in energy-intensive sectors like cold storage, logistics, and manufacturing.
We live by our values: Teamwork, Customer First, Quality, and Curiosity. With a team of forward-thinkers and problem-solvers, we’re driving the digital transformation of industries globally.
Ndustrial builds software that helps the world's largest food, cold chain, and industrial operators understand and control their energy in real time.
If you want your work to make real change, this is the place.
About the Role:
The VP of Engineering is a key member of Ndustrial’s leadership team, responsible for leading, developing, and scaling our engineering organization while ensuring the team delivers against the company’s most important priorities.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this role requires a proven engineering leader who understands what it takes to build and lead teams in an early-stage, high-growth environment. The VP of Engineering will create clarity and accountability across the organization, develop and motivate a high-performing team, and ensure engineering priorities and execution are closely aligned with company objectives.
We are an AI-forward engineering organization, and this leader will help ensure our team is effectively using modern AI tools and practices to improve how we build, solve problems, and deliver value to customers. This is a people-oriented leadership role for someone who knows how to get things done through others and can build an engineering organization that consistently executes, grows, and adapts as the company evolves.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, develop, and motivate a high-performing engineering team, creating clear expectations, ownership, and accountability.
Translate company objectives into clear engineering priorities and ensure the team understands both what they are working toward and why it matters.
Manage team and individual performance against defined objectives, providing direct feedback, coaching, and addressing performance issues when expectations are not being met.
Champion an AI-forward engineering culture, ensuring the team effectively uses AI-assisted tools across design, development, testing, problem-solving, and decision-making to improve both speed and quality.
Bring firsthand experience navigating the early-stage startup lifecycle, knowing when to introduce structure and process, when to move quickly with imperfect information, and how to keep teams focused and executing as company priorities evolve.
Partner with Product and other leaders to identify opportunities to incorporate AI into our platform and deliver meaningful customer value.
Provide strong technical judgment across architecture, cloud infrastructure, SaaS development, AI-enabled capabilities, security, reliability, and scalability while empowering the team to own implementation.
Own engineering execution, balancing speed, quality, scalability, technical health, and available resources.
Create visibility into engineering priorities, progress, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs for the CEO and leadership team.
Report directly and partner closely with the CEO by proactively bringing recommendations, surfacing risks, providing context, and constructively challenging assumptions when appropriate.
Serve as an active member of the leadership team, contributing to company strategy, priorities, organizational decisions, and growth beyond the engineering function.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and other functions to align Engineering with customer and business needs.
Drive decisions and execution in an environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and limited resources.
Build a culture that reflects what motivates strong startup talent: ownership, autonomy, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Director, Market Access Analytics (Remote)
jobs.text:
About Ogilvy
Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD
Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision, cultural fluency, and AI-enabled capabilities to build healthcare's most influential movements. We believe the future belongs to those who can seamlessly blend human ingenuity with emerging technologies, using AI not simply as a tool, but as a catalyst for deeper insights, faster problem solving, and more impactful work. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what's next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.
For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.
About the Role
Ogilvy Health Market Access brings together market access strategy, analytics, technology, and creative capabilities to help pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare clients navigate the complexities of reimbursement and patient access. We transform complex access information into actionable solutions that support clients and field organizations throughout the product lifecycle.
We are seeking an experienced Market Access Analytics leader to drive the data strategy, development, and delivery of our proprietary market access solutions and custom analytics offerings. This individual will work closely with clients and internal teams to translate complex pharmaceutical market access data into accurate, actionable solutions for clients and field teams.
The Director will manage and develop members of the analytics team while remaining hands-on with complex data challenges, solution design, validation, and client deliverables.
What You’ll Do
Lead the timely implementation of data solutions supporting proprietary market access products, field-facing tools, and custom client analytics.
Integrate and analyze pharmaceutical data sources, including formulary and coverage data, prescription and medical claims, HCP data, payer and plan hierarchies, lives, geographic alignment, and CRM data.
Translate complex business questions into analytical methodologies, business rules, data requirements, and scalable solutions.
Use MySQL, advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other analytic tools to manipulate, integrate, analyze, and validate large datasets and troubleshoot complex data issues.
Apply deep knowledge of pharmaceutical reimbursement, including payer channels, formulary coverage, utilization management, payer/PBM relationships, plan structures, and patient access dynamics.
Develop methodologies that translate market access data into actionable HCP-, account-, payer-, geographic-, and national-level insights and field-facing messages.
Own quality control and validation of analytical methodologies and client deliverables, including investigation and reconciliation of discrepancies across data sources and systems.
Serve as the analytics and market access subject matter expert throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing and validation, launch, data migrations, recurring refreshes, and enhancements.
Partner with development, UX, account, strategy, production, and external data-provider teams to ensure solutions are accurate, scalable, actionable, and delivered on time.
Serve as a senior analytics subject matter expert in client meetings and pre- and post-sale discussions, clearly communicating complex methodologies, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
Establish efficient, repeatable processes and high standards for analytical rigor and quality.
Remain hands-on as needed to investigate data, troubleshoot MySQL queries, perform Excel-based analyses, validate methodologies, and resolve complex data challenges.
What You’ll Need
8+ years of analytics experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, market access, managed markets, or a closely related data environment.
Ideally, understanding of pharmaceutical market access and reimbursement, including commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels, payer and plan structures, formulary coverage, and utilization management.
Significant experience with pharmaceutical data, including formulary/coverage, prescription or medical claims, HCP, payer/plan, and lives data.
5+ years hands-on MySQL skills, with demonstrated ability to query, join, transform, aggregate, troubleshoot, and validate large datasets.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to analyze, validate, and present complex data.
Experience harnessing AI to streamline data processes.
Experience designing analytical methodologies and translating business needs into detailed data and product requirements.
Strong understanding of data quality, integration, attribution, aggregation, and validation methodologies and experience using a revision control system in a production environment (i.e. SVN, Git, Perforce).
Exceptional client communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage multiple complex workstreams.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions to complex data challenges.
Bachelor's degree required; STEM degree, advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.
AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using generative AI and applicable emerging technologies. Ability to adapt to new tools and integrate AI responsibly into day-to-day work is expected.
Preferred Experience
Experience with pharmaceutical market access data sources such as IQVIA, MMIT, Symphony Health, or similar platforms.
Experience developing HCP- or account-level market access analytics and field-facing solutions.
Familiarity with Veeva or other pharmaceutical CRM/field enablement platforms.
Experience with payer hierarchies, PBM relationships, geographic attribution, HCP alignment, product launches, or major data migrations.
How We’ll Support You
Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.
#LI-Remote
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.
Pay Range
$100,000—$230,000 USD
At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.
We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.
Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.
Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Technology Operations
jobs.text:
About The Role
The RealReal is looking for a Vice President of Enterprise Technical Operations to lead the teams and systems that keep our business running — from core networking and device management to the enterprise applications and AI platforms that power our people. This leader will own technical operations at scale across our corporate, retail, and authentication center locations, drive enterprise AI enablement, and build a high-performing organization that attracts and grows top talent.
What You Get To Do Every Day
Own and evolve TRR's technical operations strategy across core networking, endpoint/device management, and infrastructure supporting corporate, retail, and authentication center locations
In Partnership with the VP of AI, lead enterprise AI enablement across the organization, driving adoption and governance of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise for employee productivity and workflow automation
Direct enterprise application support and roadmap for NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, and related systems, partnering closely with Finance, HR, and Sales/CX stakeholders
Build and mature enterprise incident and problem management practices — from real-time response and escalation to root-cause analysis and prevention — to minimize business disruption
Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and connectivity for retail stores and authentication centers, where operational uptime directly impacts customer and consignor experience
Partner with Product & Technology leadership to align technical operations with broader enterprise architecture and AI platform strategy
Set and manage SLAs, operational metrics, and vendor relationships across managed services, telecom, and SaaS providers
Attract, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing technical operations team; build clear career paths and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Drive automation and self-service across IT operations to reduce manual toil and free the team to focus on higher-value, strategic work
Serve as an escalation point and trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on technology operations, risk, and resilience
What You Bring To The Role
Minimum Requirements:
10+ years of progressive technical operations leadership, including experience running enterprise IT/infrastructure at scale in a multi-site environment (retail, distribution, or similar physical footprint a plus)
Demonstrated success leading enterprise AI enablement initiatives — deploying and driving adoption of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or similar across a workforce
Deep hands-on knowledge of core networking, endpoint/device management (MDM), and infrastructure supporting distributed retail or field locations
Strong track record managing enterprise applications (NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, or comparable systems) and the vendor/stakeholder relationships that come with them
Proven ability to build and run mature incident and problem management functions, including postmortem discipline and continuous improvement processes
A people-first leadership style with a demonstrated record of attracting, developing, and empowering top talent — you build teams people want to stay on
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Security, Product & Technology, Finance, and Retail Operations leaders
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing hands-on execution with strategic planning
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with enterprise AI adoption and agentic workflows
Experience in e-commerce or marketplace technology
Experience managing vendor partnerships and budgets
Compensation, Benefits, + Perks
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
401K with Company Match
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
Paid Parental Leave
9 Paid Company Holidays
Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)
Find out more about our Benefits here.
The expected salary range for this role is $-$. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.
The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.
The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and connectivity for retail stores and authentication centers, where operational uptime directly impacts customer and consignor experience
Partner with Product & Technology leadership to align technical operations with broader enterprise architecture and AI platform strategy
Set and manage SLAs, operational metrics, and vendor relationships across managed services, telecom, and SaaS providers
Attract, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing technical operations team; build clear career paths and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Drive automation and self-service across IT operations to reduce manual toil and free the team to focus on higher-value, strategic work
Serve as an escalation point and trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on technology operations, risk, and resilience

Minimum Requirements:

10+ years of progressive technical operations leadership, including experience running enterprise IT/infrastructure at scale in a multi-site environment (retail, distribution, or similar physical footprint a plus)

Demonstrated success leading enterprise AI enablement initiatives — deploying and driving adoption of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or similar across a workforce
Deep hands-on knowledge of core networking, endpoint/device management (MDM), and infrastructure supporting distributed retail or field locations
Strong track record managing enterprise applications (NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, or comparable systems) and the vendor/stakeholder relationships that come with them
Proven ability to build and run mature incident and problem management functions, including postmortem discipline and continuous improvement processes
A people-first leadership style with a demonstrated record of attracting, developing, and empowering top talent — you build teams people want to stay on
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Security, Product & Technology, Finance, and Retail Operations leaders
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing hands-on execution with strategic planning
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with enterprise AI adoption and agentic workflows
Experience in e-commerce or marketplace technology
Experience managing vendor partnerships and budgets

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Financial Platforms)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
About the Product team
The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role
Affirm’s financial platforms power how loans are created, recorded, funded, serviced, and repaid, as well as how money moves across our products, partners, and markets. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead a portfolio spanning Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services.
This leader will oversee a large, multi-domain product organization of approximately 15 product managers, including experienced people managers, with room to grow. They will set the long-term strategy for their portfolio, modernize Affirm’s ledger and downstream financial pipelines, strengthen Payment Services, and expand our Money Movement capabilities. The ideal candidate brings deep financial-domain knowledge, strong platform judgment, international experience, and a record of developing senior product leaders.
What you’ll do
Lead and scale a high-performing product organization. Manage and develop experienced product leaders and people managers across Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services. Shape the organization as its scope and size grow, while setting a high bar for product craft, strategy, execution, and talent development.
Set the multi-year strategy for the portfolio. Establish a coherent direction across lending, Capital Markets, banking, the loan lifecycle, ledger and accounting capabilities, Money Movement, Open Banking, payment instruments, and processing.
Modernize Affirm’s ledger and financial pipelines. Lead the strategy for evolving the systems that record and reconcile financial activity and support downstream Capital Markets, accounting, reporting, and Money Movement workflows. Improve scalability, reliability, controls, and development speed while protecting critical financial operations.
Strengthen Payment Services. Develop the strategy for Open Banking, payment instruments, processing, routing, and related payment infrastructure. Improve payment success, resilience, processing flexibility, and transaction economics across Affirm’s products and markets.
Expand Money Movement capabilities. Build the platforms and controls needed to support new account-based products, funds flows, payment rails, and financial experiences. Ensure settlement, reconciliation, reporting, and operational processes can scale with increasing product and geographic complexity.
Advance Affirm’s lending, capital, and banking platforms. Guide the evolution of Loan Products, loan-lifecycle capabilities, Capital Markets systems, and Affirm Bank infrastructure. Develop shared capabilities that support new products and reduce fragmentation across financial systems.
Deliver meaningful business and customer impact. Establish clear goals and success metrics across platform reliability, payment performance, processing costs, reconciliation accuracy, operational efficiency, financial controls, and the speed of launching new products and markets.
Make sound platform investment decisions. Balance architectural modernization with product growth, regulatory requirements, operational risk, and near-term business needs. Establish clear sequencing and migration strategies for complex, interconnected systems.
Drive cross-functional alignment at scale. Partner closely with Engineering, Analytics, Capital Markets, Treasury, Finance, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Servicing to establish shared priorities and translate strategy into coordinated execution.
Enable global scale. Build platform capabilities that support international markets and account for differences in payment rails, banking relationships, currencies, regulation, legal entities, controls, and operating models.
Influence senior leadership. Clearly communicate strategy, investment priorities, performance, dependencies, and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders. Help shape decisions across the broader Financial Platforms organization.
What we look for
15+ years of product management experience, including leading large, high-performing teams of PMs and people managers across multiple domains
Demonstrated manager-of-managers experience, including developing senior leaders, designing organizations, hiring strong teams, and managing through growth and change
Substantial experience across several relevant domains, including lending, Capital Markets, regulated banking, financial ledgers or accounting systems, Money Movement, payment processing, Open Banking, or consumer payments
Direct experience leading complex platform or architecture transformations involving high-stakes financial systems
Proven ability to define and execute multi-year strategies spanning customer experiences, complex platforms, and operational capabilities
Strong knowledge of how money moves across financial products, institutions, processors, bank partners, and markets, including settlement, reconciliation, reporting, and operational controls
Experience building financial products or platforms across multiple countries and navigating differences in payment rails, banking relationships, regulation, legal entities, currencies, and operating models
Track record of driving alignment and execution across Engineering, Analytics, Capital Markets, Treasury, Finance, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and executive leadership
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence senior stakeholders, and develop strong product leaders
Proficiency with AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, decision-making, and team effectiveness
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Base Pay Grade - V
Equity Grade - USA 21
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, CT, NJ, NY, WA) per year: $340,000 - $375,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $305,000 - $340,000
#LI-Remote
Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Auto Electric Service Ltd. is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead one of the most important functions in our next stage of growth.
Founded in 1943, AES is a locally owned Saskatchewan wholesale distribution company serving the automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, PBE, commercial paint, retail, OEM dealer, jobber, and service markets across Southern Saskatchewan. We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy.
This is not simply a purchasing role.
The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics.
The Opportunity
The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
What should we sell?
What should we stock, where, and how much?
Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
How should we price by market, category, and customer?
Where should we enter new categories?
How can data and technology improve these decisions?
The mission is to build a disciplined, accountable, technology-enabled Product function that delivers broad product availability while improving inventory productivity, contribution margin, GMROI, and return on invested capital.
Key Outcomes
Build a Smarter Inventory Network
Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE.
Lead Pricing Strategy
Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness.
Elevate Purchasing
Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes.
Build a Disciplined New Product Process
Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data.
Build the Team and Function
Develop the structure, people, processes, scorecards, and operating rhythms required to support AES’s growth. Participate as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Marketing, and Technology.
