jobs.title: SVP, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy
jobs.text:
Job Title: SVP, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy
Location:Canada – Remote or Mississauga, ON – Hybrid
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
Position Summary:
Reporting directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Senior Vice President, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy establishes and leads PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for Data as a Product. This executive leader is accountable for transforming PointClickCare’s unique data assets, ecosystem position, and network scale into differentiated products, strategic growth opportunities, and new sources of enterprise value.
The role owns the long-term strategy for customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace capabilities, data monetization, and data-enabled AI solutions while ensuring appropriate protection of intellectual property, privacy, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the senior Product Leadership Team, the SVP influences corporate strategy, investment priorities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives while leading a team of senior Product leaders responsible for PointClickCare’s data product portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Define and lead PointClickCare’s enterprise Data Products strategy, including establishing a multi-year vision for Data as a Product that aligns with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and evolving market opportunities.
Identify, evaluate, and champion new business models and growth opportunities enabled by PointClickCare’s data assets, network scale, interoperability capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships.
Serve as the executive sponsor for customer-facing data strategy and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, Corporate Strategy, Legal, Go-to-Market, and the Corporate Data Office.
Own the strategy, roadmap, performance, and long-term success of PointClickCare’s data products portfolio, including customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability services, marketplace capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish investment priorities, resource allocation decisions, portfolio success measures, and business outcomes that balance customer value, market opportunity, and financial performance.
Drive adoption, customer value realization, commercial performance, and scalable product growth through strong portfolio management and strategic execution.
Lead PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for data monetization, marketplace growth, and ecosystem expansion.
Define customer access models, API strategies, pricing frameworks, packaging approaches, and commercial models that support sustainable growth while preserving trust and protecting intellectual property.
Identify new revenue opportunities, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem capabilities that strengthen PointClickCare’s competitive position and expand customer value.
Represent PointClickCare’s data strategy with executive stakeholders, customers, strategic partners, industry analysts, and industry organizations.
Lead executive-level discussions related to data products, healthcare interoperability, marketplace participation, data monetization, and AI-enabled customer solutions.
Build relationships that influence product direction, market positioning, and long-term growth opportunities across the healthcare technology landscape.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing product leadership organization through senior leaders, including VPs and Directors.
Establish succession planning, leadership development, talent strategies, and organizational capabilities that strengthen expertise in data products, APIs, ecosystem platforms, marketplace solutions, and monetization strategies.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management, technology, data products, platform strategy, enterprise software, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-level product, growth, or business strategies with measurable impact on organizational performance, customer outcomes, and financial results.
Proven experience leading large, complex product or technology organizations through multiple layers of leadership, including developing senior leaders and building organizational capability.
Track record of leading enterprise transformation initiatives requiring alignment across multiple functions, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.
Deep expertise in data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace and ecosystem strategies, data monetization models, AI-enabled products, and the business dynamics of data-driven organizations.
Strong strategic, financial, and operational acumen, including ownership of portfolio-level investment decisions, business cases, risk management, and performance outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, shape investment decisions, and represent organizational strategy with customers, partners, analysts, and other external stakeholders.
Experience leading marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or data monetization strategies is highly preferred.
Experience within healthcare technology, post-acute care, payer, provider, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
Experience engaging with industry analysts, strategic partners, customer advisory groups, or external industry bodies is preferred.
Ability to balance growth objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and intellectual property protection in a complex business environment.
At PointClickCare, base salary is one of the many components that make up our total rewards package. This role offers a competitive base salary+ bonus + benefits, non-overtime eligible. Our salary ranges are determined by job and level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills and knowledge, relevant experience including professional and lived experience, and/or work location. Your recruiter can share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.
PointClickCare Benefits & Perks
Benefits starting from Day 1
Retirement Plan Matching (RRSP & 401K)
Flexible Paid Time Off
Lifestyle/Wellness Spending Account
Parental & Caregiver Leaves
Fertility & Adoption Support
Continuous Development Support Program
Employee Assistance Program
Learning Programs & Resources
Employee Recognition … and more!

It is the policy of PointClickCare to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, religion, national origin, status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. PointClickCare welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Please contact should you require any accommodations.

We use this information to evaluate your candidacy for the posted position. We also store this information, and may use it in relation to future positions to which you apply, or which we believe may be relevant to you given your background. When we have no ongoing legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. If you have any questions about how PointClickCare uses or processes your information, or if you would like to ask to access, correct, or delete your information, please contact PointClickCare’s human resources team:
PointClickCare is committed to Information Security. By applying to this position, if hired, you commit to following our information security policies and procedures and making every effort to secure confidential and/or sensitive information.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
jobs.text:
Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
Location: Saudi Arabia / Riyadh
Employment Type: Full-time
Company: nakhla.ai
Reports to: CEO
About nakhla.ai
nakhla.ai builds enterprise-grade, AI-enabled software solutions that help organizations automate operations, integrate business systems, and deploy intelligent agents securely at scale.
Our platform combines enterprise applications, intelligent automation, system integrations, workflow orchestration, and AI capabilities to deliver measurable business outcomes for organizations.
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery to lead the design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing delivery of enterprise technology solutions.
This role combines solution architecture, customer implementation, platform engineering, technical program management, operational reliability, security, quality assurance, and delivery leadership.
The successful candidate will own the customer delivery lifecycle, starting with technical discovery and solution design and continuing through configuration, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
This is not a traditional project management or advisory position. The candidate must be technically strong, commercially aware, customer-facing, and capable of making practical architecture and delivery decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Solution Architecture
Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer business processes, operational requirements, existing systems, security constraints, and success criteria.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.
Design solutions involving enterprise applications, APIs, AI agents, workflow automation, identity management, data migration, and third-party integrations.
Define system boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, security controls, and deployment models.
Ensure customer requirements align with nakhla.ai’s long-term product and platform strategy.
Challenge unnecessary customization and identify opportunities to create reusable product capabilities.
Produce solution architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation blueprints, and acceptance criteria.
Customer Implementation and Delivery
Own enterprise implementation projects from initial kickoff through production launch.
Develop delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external partners, and customer stakeholders.
Manage project scope, priorities, timelines, risks, and customer expectations.
Configure enterprise applications, workflows, roles, permissions, approval processes, and business rules.
Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and production transition activities.
Lead user acceptance testing, customer training, deployment readiness, and go-live planning.
Ensure implementation decisions, configurations, and technical dependencies are documented clearly.
Manage post-launch stabilization and transition customers into ongoing support and operations.
Platform Engineering and Integrations
Contribute directly to backend services, system integrations, APIs, and platform components when required.
Design and implement secure integrations with customer applications, financial systems, productivity platforms, identity providers, databases, and external services.
Work with APIs, webhooks, message queues, event-driven architectures, authentication protocols, service accounts, and secure credential management.
Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.
Enterprise Applications and Business Processes
Lead discovery, configuration, customization, migration, and integration activities for enterprise business systems.
Map customer processes across finance, procurement, sales, inventory, operations, human resources, and other business functions.
Configure workflows, approval processes, roles, permissions, reports, and operational controls.
Ensure data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation during migration from existing systems.
Identify where standard platform functionality should be used instead of unnecessary custom development.
Work closely with finance, operations, technology, and executive stakeholders to validate business logic and controls.
Ensure implemented solutions support customer governance, accountability, and operational requirements.
AI and Intelligent Automation
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate intelligent agents and automation into enterprise processes.
Define safe and auditable agent actions, permissions, tools, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
Design human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive, regulated, or high-impact operations.
Ensure AI-enabled capabilities comply with customer security, privacy, governance, and operational requirements.
Support the integration of AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, documents, APIs, and communication systems.
Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, operational feasibility, technical complexity, implementation risk, and scalability.
Establish monitoring, evaluation, testing, and quality controls for production AI systems.
Ensure AI capabilities remain explainable, traceable, controlled, and aligned with customer policies.
Security, Infrastructure, and Reliability
Define and enforce deployment, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Support cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and release processes.
Establish appropriate separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement or oversee monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery procedures.
Ensure secure secrets management, credential rotation, network controls, encryption, and access governance.
Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and production reliability improvements.
Ensure customer environments meet agreed security, availability, performance, and data protection requirements.
Support enterprise security reviews, technical due diligence, risk assessments, and compliance readiness activities.
Maintain operational documentation, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and production support standards.
Quality Assurance
Define quality standards, release gates, and acceptance criteria.
Establish automated testing practices for APIs, integrations, permissions, workflows, data processing, and critical user journeys.
Ensure testing covers customer data isolation, role-based access, authentication, authorization, billing, data integrity, and intelligent agent behavior.
Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
Prevent production releases without appropriate validation, documentation, rollback plans, monitoring, and approvals.
Track defects, production incidents, recurring failures, and quality trends across implementations.
Ensure lessons from customer deployments are incorporated into platform and delivery improvements.
Delivery Operations and Team Leadership
Build repeatable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, templates, checklists, and operational playbooks.
Define ownership, accountability, and handoff points across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and support.

blocks.text: Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
Location: Saudi Arabia / Riyadh
Employment Type: Full-time
Company: nakhla.ai
Reports to: CEO
About nakhla.ai
nakhla.ai builds enterprise-grade, AI-enabled software solutions that help organizations automate operations, integrate business systems, and deploy intelligent agents securely at scale.
Our platform combines enterprise applications, intelligent automation, system integrations, workflow orchestration, and AI capabilities to deliver measurable business outcomes for organizations.
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery to lead the design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing delivery of enterprise technology solutions.
This role combines solution architecture, customer implementation, platform engineering, technical program management, operational reliability, security, quality assurance, and delivery leadership.

The successful candidate will own the customer delivery lifecycle, starting with technical discovery and solution design and continuing through configuration, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and post-launch stabilization.

This is not a traditional project management or advisory position. The candidate must be technically strong, commercially aware, customer-facing, and capable of making practical architecture and delivery decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Solution Architecture

items: Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer business processes, operational requirements, existing systems, security constraints, and success criteria.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.
Design solutions involving enterprise applications, APIs, AI agents, workflow automation, identity management, data migration, and third-party integrations.
Define system boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, security controls, and deployment models.
Ensure customer requirements align with nakhla.ai’s long-term product and platform strategy.
Challenge unnecessary customization and identify opportunities to create reusable product capabilities.
Produce solution architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation blueprints, and acceptance criteria.

blocks.text: Customer Implementation and Delivery

items: Own enterprise implementation projects from initial kickoff through production launch.
Develop delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external partners, and customer stakeholders.
Manage project scope, priorities, timelines, risks, and customer expectations.
Configure enterprise applications, workflows, roles, permissions, approval processes, and business rules.
Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and production transition activities.
Lead user acceptance testing, customer training, deployment readiness, and go-live planning.
Ensure implementation decisions, configurations, and technical dependencies are documented clearly.
Manage post-launch stabilization and transition customers into ongoing support and operations.

blocks.text: Platform Engineering and Integrations

items: Contribute directly to backend services, system integrations, APIs, and platform components when required.
Design and implement secure integrations with customer applications, financial systems, productivity platforms, identity providers, databases, and external services.

Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.

jobs.text:
Summary of the position :
The Head of Engineering – Delivery, will be directly responsible for leading PMC’s India based delivery teams providing it’s software services & projects in to global customers.
The role requires strong technical leadership skills and able to navigate the complex project scenarios to drive best outcomes for PMC & customers. The role also emphasize on the deep technical knowhow, such as software development (across multiple programming stacks) and hold on SDLC using Cloud , Automation, DevOps & AI & ML practices.
This role will be primarily responsible for ensuring high quality & timeliness delivery of services for the Engineering team in India with focus on execution, governance of delivery and a continuous collaboration across all levels.
Leading a talented team of delivery managers, delivery leads and project managers you will ensure that through proactive planning, the team are set up to deliver current and future customer requirements across the range of Engineering propositions – Design & Architecture, Development, Test and Automation.
Key accountabilities:
As a leader you will be primary focused on
As Delivery leader, you are a hands-on, have strong technical foundation in SDLC and last 5+years as people leader able to manage directly and through others.
As a technically astute leader, your recognized subject matter expertise allows you regularly dive deep into key projects & services your teams provide.
Your focus is to provide strong technical and on-floor leadership & coaching to a talented team of project and dedicated service leaders, ensuring they are set up for success to deliver customer and team needs (total team size > 200-400).
As a Delivery leader, you shall be an Engineering face for PMC customers to drive higher standards of Agile Delivery , DevOps , Automation , AI/ML , Cloud and cutting edge technology conversations.
You will drive delivery performance and work closely with engineering excellence and operations team across all PMC’s Engineering Customers, working with your leadership team to ensure effective service set-up & transition, project governance & assurance, and customer satisfaction.
Be responsible to develop a strong high performance culture with engineers on the floor that focuses on sense of collective and individual ownership, high quality outcome and continuous learning
Contribute to and implement the strategic plan for engineering such as future proposition, technical initiative & learning in alignment with the company’s vision, objectives and future customer base.
Lead and drive a culture of innovation and collaboration across Engineering teams and wider PMC business units.
Lead on and act as the escalation for the resolution of customer specific service delivery issues in a timely way overseeing the design and implementation of specific ‘get well’ plans. Act as the senior ‘escalation’ for major service issues and customer champion for critical services.
Serve as a liaison between the engineering teams and senior management, providing regular updates on progress, challenges, and achievements to Engineering Director on our teams and our people.
Your role will collaborate with
Work with operations/resourcing & service design/pre-sales to ensure all new customer engagements are planned and successfully delivered.
Work with engineering excellence to ensure strong drive of the Continual Services Improvement Plan (CSIP) across the dedicated teams, covering contract understanding/compliance, service standards (productivity & quality) and customer Satisfaction reporting
You will also support in the driving of incremental new business and in the management of customer commercial performance.
Work with engineering excellence to drive best practices, enforce governance models, quality, standards, measurements (KPIs), ISO Compliance across engineering deliveries.
Work in partnership with the resourcing and planning team to effectively schedule and utilise the engineering talent for strong delivery performance. Work with the resource management team to map resources effectively to support optimal team performance and productivity.
Work with engineering governance to undertake periodic reviews to ensure that all processes drive strong efficiency and best practice, working with your leadership team to implement recommendations for improvement.
Work with senior stakeholders at BU level to effectively drive the change , communicate issues & implement improvement plan.
Work with Sales & Marketing teams by supporting them as required during internal & external customer meeting.
Skills and Experience| Essential:
You’ve at-least 15+ years of IT experience across various trends & cycles of Software Development and methodologies.
At least last 5+ years of experience in managing Software Delivery teams at scale of various application stacks & technologies.
You are obsessed with results, and effectively communicate objectives and how success will be measured to your teams and other stakeholders.
An inspirational leader and role model, with strong experience leading large & multiskilled engineering teams.
Proven experience and ability to provide a steer on how to apply engineering mindset to large number of delivery workstreams.
Experience in building and scaling service delivery teams (circa 200 to 400 member teams).
Passion for innovation and staying current with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Extensive experience in managing complex IT solutions delivery to the highest standard.
Commercially aware, with a good understanding of contractual requirements and obligations.
Experience in setting, improving and attaining service standards.
Customer credible and able to engage with customer stakeholders at all levels.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Advertiser Growth
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
As the PM Director for Advertiser Growth, you will own product strategy for a major monetization lever and serve as a critical thought partner to our Business Platforms leadership. You will sit at the intersection of AI and monetization growth, defining the "AI era" for our core advertiser tools.
This role offers a unique combination of platform depth and tangible business impact. You won’t just be managing features; you will establish durable platform strategies that scale. Furthermore, this is a dedicated people leadership role where you will have the mandate to develop the next generation of product talent at Pinterest.
What you’ll do:
Product Led Growth: Drive the adoption, retention, and revenue impact of our suite of business-facing tools through intelligent product investments.
Platform Leadership: Establish a durable platform strategy for the Pinterest Business Assistant, encompassing various sub-agents while leading the advertising and merchant sub-agent efforts.
Cross-Functional Execution: Drive business outcomes by aligning priorities across Engineering, Data Science, TPM, Product Marketing, Sales, UX, and UXR teams to deliver best-in-class business tooling.
What we’re looking for:
Platform Product Strategy: Demonstrated experience developing and scaling platforms, with a strong ability to distinguish between high-level orchestration and specific feature development.
Business Tools Product Experience: Proven background in designing and managing sophisticated business-facing tools, account management consoles, or complex user journeys in an advertising or related environment.
People Leadership: A track record of building, managing, and growing high-performing teams, including experience in talent development and performance management.
AI/Agentic Fluency: Experience building AI-assistance functionality, specifically in a chatbot or agentic capability context.
Strategic & Operational Rigor: Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence across multiple stakeholders, and drive durable revenue growth through principled trade-offs.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.
Relocation Statement:
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

#LI-REX

In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. jobs.title: VP of Product, Foundation
jobs.text:
🚀 VP of Product, Foundation | United States | Remote | Pax8
Join Pax8 as our VP of Product, Foundation and shape the future of the world's leading cloud marketplace platform, driving the product strategy behind the commerce engine that powers thousands of managed service providers across the globe.
🌟 Why This Role?
This is a rare opportunity to own the product vision for Pax8's largest and most strategically important portfolio. Foundation sits at the heart of our marketplace, enabling everything from product discovery and purchasing to provisioning, billing, subscriptions, integrations, and partner growth.
As AI reshapes software development and customer experiences, you'll help define how a modern, intelligent commerce platform evolves. You'll influence how thousands of partners buy, sell, manage, and grow through technology while building capabilities that support both hypergrowth and enterprise-grade financial rigor.
You'll join at a pivotal moment where platform scale, artificial intelligence, automation, and operational excellence converge, giving you the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on both Pax8 and the wider technology ecosystem.
💜 Life at Pax8
At Pax8, business is personal. We're passionate about creating an environment where people can do their best work while continuously learning and growing. Guided by our values of Compassionate Candor, Seek to Understand, We Before Me, Do What You Say, Light Up Learning, and Driven by Passion, we foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
You'll join a global organization that embraces emerging technologies, invests heavily in learning, and empowers individuals to challenge conventional thinking while delivering exceptional outcomes for our partners.
🎯 What You'll Be Responsible For
📈 Define the Future of Commerce at Pax8
Establish and execute the long-term product vision for Foundation, Pax8's core commerce platform.
Create a strategic roadmap that balances operational excellence, compliance, financial controls, scalability, and growth.
Guide investment decisions across marketplace capabilities, billing, subscriptions, ordering, provisioning, analytics, integrations, and partner experiences.
💡 Drive Growth Through Product Innovation

jobs.title: VP - Product Management, Digital Assets Proxy
jobs.text:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
Broadridge is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and execution-oriented VP, Product Management – Digital Assets Proxy to lead the strategy, development, delivery and ongoing management of Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy capabilities. This highly visible leadership role will define the product vision and roadmap for innovative, scalable, and compliant digital assets proxy solutions that address the evolving needs of institutional clients and support Broadridge’s long-term growth objectives.
The VP will operate at the intersection of product, technology, operations, commercial teams, legal, compliance, and risk. The successful candidate will combine deep product-management discipline with a strong understanding of digital asset market infrastructure, regulatory considerations, and the proxy ecosystem. They will translate market opportunity and client insight into differentiated product offerings, drive delivery from concept through launch, and continuously optimize the portfolio based on performance and market feedback.
What You’ll Do
Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy products and capabilities
Develop a clear point of view on the evolution of digital assets, tokenization, governance, and governance related market infrastructure, translating market developments into actionable product priorities
Identify and assess client needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics, and regulatory developments to inform product strategy and investment decisions
Own the evaluation, prioritization, development, launch, and enhancement of digital asset proxy focused products and features aligned with client demand, strategic objectives, and operational readiness
Build compelling business cases, including market sizing, financial analysis, pricing, return-on-investment assessments, and commercialization plans. This can also include development of white papers and related thought pieces
Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to establish product requirements, guide execution, manage trade-offs, and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
Collaborate with operations, legal, compliance, risk, and control functions to ensure products are operationally viable and aligned with applicable regulatory, risk, and governance requirements
Develop go-to-market strategies in partnership with sales, marketing, relationship-management, and client facing teams
Establish product performance measures and use adoption data, client feedback, commercial results, and market intelligence to improve product outcomes and portfolio performance
Serve as a senior thought partner and subject matter expert on digital assets proxy-related product strategy across Broadridge
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions
What We’re Looking For
Significant product-management experience, including a demonstrated record of leading complex products, platforms, or market-infrastructure capabilities from strategy through execution and commercialization
Strong knowledge of digital assets and related market infrastructure, including relevant experience with tokenized assets, blockchain-based products, custody, wallets, trading, settlement, staking, or adjacent capabilities
Experience developing products within a regulated financial services environment, ideally including exposure to SEC regulated businesses
Demonstrated understanding of proxy, corporate governance, issuer services, or related workflows is strongly preferred
Strong commercial acumen, with experience developing product strategies, business cases, pricing models, and go-to-market plans
Proven ability to lead through influence across technology, operations, legal, compliance, risk, sales, and other cross-functional stakeholders
Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and decision making skills
Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical, regulatory, and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
A client focused, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a rapidly evolving market
What Sets You Apart
Deep understanding of trends shaping the digital assets landscape and their implications for institutional and enterprise clients
Experience building and scaling product offerings in emerging, regulated, or rapidly changing markets
Ability to balance innovation with strong operational, regulatory, and risk discipline
A strong network and credibility within digital assets, capital markets, proxy, governance, or financial market infrastructure communities
A collaborative leadership style that aligns diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and measurable business outcomes
Why Join Us
You will have the opportunity to shape the future of digital assets products within a dynamic and highly visible leadership role. You will work with cross-functional teams to bring new capabilities to market, solve complex industry challenges, and help define how digital asset solutions evolve in a changing financial and regulatory landscape.
Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $240,000 to $250,000
Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
Benefits Information: Please visit for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
Use of AI in Hiring
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster.
Disability Assistance
We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888-237-7769 or by sending an email to .

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.

You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on

items: Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.

Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Logistics
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
About the Team
Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.
#LI-Remote
Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.
Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.
CA, NY, CT, NJ
$291,000—$307,000 USD
WA
$279,000—$294,500 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$266,000—$281,000 USD
All other states
$242,000—$255,500 USD

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, On-chain Payments
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
We’re looking for a senior product leader to shape the future of payments and financial applications on the XRP Ledger.
In this role, you’ll own product strategy and execution across areas such as stablecoin payments, on-chain liquidity and foreign exchange, and emerging forms of programmable commerce. You’ll work at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, financial markets, and real-world customer needs - turning new capabilities into products and experiences that can achieve meaningful adoption.
This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with engineering, business development, ecosystem partners, and customers to identify the most important problems to solve, develop a clear product strategy, and drive complex initiatives from concept through market adoption.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Own product strategy and roadmap for key payments and on-chain financial capabilities on the XRP Ledger
Identify and prioritize opportunities where blockchain infrastructure can meaningfully improve how value is exchanged, converted, and settled
Develop product-market fit hypotheses and validate them through customer discovery, market research, product data, and real-world usage
Partner closely with Engineering to translate market and customer needs into scalable product and protocol capabilities
Work with financial institutions, payment providers, liquidity providers, developers, and other ecosystem participants to understand workflows and adoption barriers
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Business Development, and external partners
Define the capabilities and ecosystem requirements needed to deliver compelling end-to-end customer experiences
Navigate technical, commercial, and market tradeoffs to drive clear decisions and maintain momentum
Represent the product strategy internally and externally with customers, partners, and the broader ecosystem
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
Significant product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, trading, or other technically complex products
Proven ability to define product strategy and lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment across technical and commercial organizations
Strong technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams on backend, infrastructure, API, or protocol-level products
Deep customer orientation and the ability to translate complex financial workflows into clear product opportunities
Strong systems thinking and judgment across product, technology, market dynamics, and go-to-market considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when simplifying complex problems and driving decisions across diverse stakeholders
Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the market, technology, and customer needs are still evolving
Nice to Have:
Experience in payments, FX, liquidity, settlement, treasury, or financial market infrastructure
Experience building crypto, blockchain, or stablecoin products
Familiarity with wallets, digital assets, on-chain transactions, and decentralized or electronic trading systems
Experience with developer platforms, open-source ecosystems, or protocol-level product development
Experience launching products that depend on adoption across multiple ecosystem participants
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$310,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.
Please find our California, UK/EU, Singapore, DIFC, ADGM, Australia, and Switzerland Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect & Data Governance Head
jobs.text:
To supercharge this next decade of unprecedented growth, we are seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to join the Chief Digitalization Officer’s (CDO) Leadership Team.
Reporting directly to the CDO, s/he/they will serve as the strategic architect and technical anchor for Masdar’s global digital ecosystem. S/he/theywill spearhead the Enterprise Digital function, designing a flexible, best-of-breed composable architecture that seamlessly bridges modern corporate systems with agile, field-level renewable asset operations. Crucially, s/he/they will own and steer the global Data Management & Data Governance strategy, defining the universal data taxonomies that transform cross-border operational insight into a competitive advantage.
S/he/they will build up high-performing domain architects, to safeguard and scale our Digital Architecture and infrastructure, as well as a robust team of competent data management specialist. Masdar’s future Enterprise Digital Architecture will empower Masdar to continue scaling and expanding securely, rapidly, and intelligently, and powering the world's clean energy future.
Minimum Requirements
15+ years of progressive experience operating at a global, enterprise-level architecture capacity, preferably within heavily asset-intensive or energy environments.
10+ years of direct experience leading, managing, and developing a team of specialized domain architects.
10+ years of hands-on experience in ERP and Data architecture design, with a proven track record of transitioning legacy setups into modern, composable designs.
8+ years of experience architecting and managing global data management platforms.
5+ years of dedicated experience driving Data Governance initiatives (establishing policies, frameworks, and master data hierarchies), as well sa running governing bodies.
5+ years of people management and stakeholder management
Strong & clear Communicator who can translate complex technical design into business languages/value, while influencing peers and stakeholders for consensus.
Ability of resolving design difference, prioritizing enterprise architecture design build-up into phases that matter to Masdar operations and efficiency.
A collaborator and a team player, who can mentor and coach team members across the CDO team
Preferred & Plus Factors
Prior experience with SAP S/4HANA ERP Core and O&M (Operations & Maintenance) global deployment.
Deep familiarity with cybersecurity and industrial architectural frameworks specific to critical infrastructure (e.g., NIST, NERC CIP, or IEC 62443).
As part of the application process, we will collect, store and process personal information about you.
Masdar will use your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice, which provides details on the purposes for which your data is processed.
Established in 2006, Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a global clean energy leader, transforming how the world produces and consumes energy through bold innovation and commercial excellence.
Masdar is a clean energy investor, developer and operator, advancing renewable energy projects across key markets and technologies, with a global project portfolio capacity to date of over 65 gigawatts (GW).
Jointly owned by TAQA, ADNOC and Mubadala, Masdar is driving the scale-up of renewables worldwide, targeting a portfolio capacity of 100GW by 2030.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Product
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees & Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.
What You’ll Be Doing
Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.

PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.

Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
Own the agentic translation system
Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.
Build the agentic QA and quality automation
Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.
Make it self-improving
Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
What We Look For In You
PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.
Nice to Haves
Built an agentic system from scratch
Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Interior Designer/ Head of Product
jobs.text:
About SQ1 Living
SQ1 Living is the furniture and interiors arm of the Square One Group. We sell turnkey, whole-apartment furniture bundles — designed, delivered, assembled and staged in seven days — to buyers (increasingly overseas investors) who would otherwise spend three to six months sourcing furniture from a dozen separate suppliers across Cyprus.
One package, one price, one week, with a single warranty and a single point of contact.
The Role
This is the founding design hire and the first of two people who start the business. It is best understood as an FF&E Design Manager with a commercial side, rather than a pure interior designer: you specify and curate what SQ1 Living sells, but you also own its cost, margin and roadmap as a product. You define what the company actually sells — a small number of curated, fully-specified apartment packages rather than an open catalogue — and you own that product end-to-end, from supplier selection through to the visual assets customers buy from, through to the eventual transition to our own manufactured designs.
What You'll Do
Design and specify six to eight curated FF&E packages covering every room, across multiple unit sizes — furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles, art, styling and kitchenware.
Source, shortlist and negotiate directly with suppliers and factories; agree trade terms and order and approve samples.
Own each package as a product: cost it, price it, and manage the margin and trade-offs between design intent and commercial viability.
Produce or direct the visual assets (renders, styling, photography direction) that let a remote buyer purchase an apartment's worth of furniture having only seen it visualised online.
Set and hold the quality bar: sample approval and field testing in live rental units before any item enters a package.
Own the long-term roadmap from imported packages to SQ1's own manufactured product line, including early input on sourcing and tooling as the company moves toward direct production in Asia.
Partner closely with the Business Development Manager to keep packages priced, buildable and sellable.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a VP of Product to own product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will be responsible for helping determine where Seated makes its next major product investment, strengthening critical parts of our underlying product infrastructure, and identifying new ways for product to drive growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with executives and the board while staying close to the work - talking to customers, digging into data, writing requirements, testing ideas, and working directly with Design and Engineering to ship great products.
The VP of Product will lead a Product and Design team and work as a close partner to Engineering. Scope may expand based on the individual, potentially including Analytics, Consumer, or broader GM responsibilities.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products
Partner with the CEO and executive team to identify, evaluate, and validate Seated’s next major product bets
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, business-case development, and validation
Evaluate opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Strengthen critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, prioritization, and execution
Identify opportunities for product-led growth across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Build and lead a small, high-performing Product and Design team
Translate company strategy into a focused product roadmap with clear priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics
