jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do
Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.

You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. jobs.title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
Apollo has hundreds of technical integrations across its ecosystem. Only a select few graduate into full Technology Alliances — partnerships significant enough to warrant real commercial investment: co-selling, joint go-to-market programs, and coordinated effort across product, marketing, sales, and partnerships. This is where Apollo puts the large majority of its focus and resources once an integration has proven it's worth building a genuine alliance around.
You'll own 360-degree responsibility for a select group of Apollo's most important technology alliances — the commercial and relationship layer that turns a technical integration into a real go-to-market motion. Where Product Partnerships owns integration depth and breadth (the technical relationship with each partner's R&D org), you own everything commercial: field-level co-selling, joint business planning, co-marketing execution, and stakeholder alignment from the executive level down to the field. You'll start by owning and running a focused portfolio of these alliances yourself. As Apollo's technology alliance ecosystem and revenue contribution scale, you'll hire and lead a team of Technology Partner Managers to carry that portfolio forward.
What you'll do:
1. Own 360-Degree Alliance Relationships
Take full ownership — commercial, relational, and operational — of a select portfolio of Apollo's graduated technology alliances
Build and maintain joint business plans with each partner, and be the single point of accountability for the health and growth of the relationship
Work with Product Partnerships to help decide which integrations are ready to graduate into a full alliance, and which alliances need to evolve or wind down
2. Drive Field-Level Co-Selling and Revenue
Get Apollo's own sales org and each partner's sales org actually selling together, not just aware of each other
Broker rep-to-rep introductions and build the field enablement that makes co-selling easy on both sides
Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue as a core, measurable outcome of the role
3. Design and Run Co-Marketing Programs
Build joint go-to-market programs that span demand generation, field events, and content — not one-off co-marketing moments
Partner with Apollo's marketing team to execute programs that generate real pipeline, not just brand association
4. Align Stakeholders Across the Business
Drive alignment across every level of the organization — from executive sponsors to management to the field — on each alliance's priorities and goals
Be the connective tissue between Partnerships, Product, Marketing, and Sales for each alliance you own
5. Build and Lead the Team as You Scale
Start as an individual contributor, personally owning and running a focused portfolio of alliances
As the technology alliance ecosystem and revenue contribution grow, hire, coach, and lead a team of Technology Partner Managers
Design how ownership divides as the team grows — by partner, partner type, or motion — and build the operating rhythm (QBRs, planning cadence, reporting) the team runs on
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years in technology alliances, strategic partnerships, or channel roles, with a demonstrated track record driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue
Experience owning the full commercial lifecycle of a technology partnership — joint business planning, field co-sell, and co-marketing execution
A track record designing and running joint go-to-market programs across demand generation, field events, and content, in partnership with a marketing team
Proven ability to align stakeholders across levels (executive, management, field) and across functions (product, marketing, sales, partnerships) around a shared plan
Comfortable starting as an individual contributor owning a personal portfolio, with a clear trajectory toward hiring and leading a team as the function scales
Comfortable operating as the commercial counterpart to a technical partnerships function — you don't own integration depth, but you make sure the partnership generates real business value
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with major CRM, cloud, or platform ecosystems and their partner/alliance programs
Experience running rep-to-rep co-sell motions and marketplace listings
Prior people-management experience, or demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team, is a plus
Background at a high-growth SaaS company with both a self-serve and enterprise/mid-market motion, where alliance revenue had to be earned rather than assumed
The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. blocks.text: Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Description
Checkmarx is the AI-powered application security leader helping the world’s most security-conscious enterprises secure the software that powers modern life. For more than two decades, our unified platform and services have helped organizations protect human and AI-generated code from the first line through runtime, reducing risk across applications, cloud, and the software supply chain without slowing innovation.​
We’re trusted by 1,600+ customers in 70+ countries, including some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world. Guided by research-led innovation and a developer-first mindset, we help every developer, security team, and enterprise build software that is risk-free by design.
You will lead a team of product managers, set the quality and performance bar across engines, and partner with R&D, Research, Design, and GTM to deliver capabilities that meet enterprise expectations for accuracy, scale, and trust.
What you’ll do
Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for the engine portfolio, and make the investment trade-offs across engines that determine where Checkmarx competes and wins.
Build and lead a high-performing product management team, setting direction, developing talent, and holding a consistent standard across domains.
Establish detection quality and performance as accountable business outcomes, with clear targets and the evidence to demonstrate progress against them.
Partner with R&D leadership to align engineering capacity and delivery commitments to the roadmap.
Translate customer, market, and competitive insight into a differentiated strategy that drives adoption and revenue growth.
Align GTM, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success behind the engine narrative, and own its credibility in the market.
Engage enterprise customers and C-level stakeholders to validate direction, build long-term partnerships, and resolve escalations that matter to the business.
Represent the engine strategy internally and externally, including at executive reviews, customer briefings, industry events, and analyst engagements.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a SaaS environment.
3+ years of experience leading product teams in a fast-paced technology environment.
Proven success launching and scaling B2B SaaS or enterprise security products.
Deep understanding of product lifecycle management, Agile methodologies, and lean principles.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with data-driven decision-making.
Experience engaging with enterprise customers, C-level stakeholders, and technical users.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-growth, and security-conscious environment.
Strong point of view on AI/ML product development, with familiarity across the AI/ML lifecycle (data, model development, evaluation, deployment)
Background in cybersecurity, application security, or developer tooling strongly preferred
The ideal candidate location is the East Coast
What we have to offer
Medical, dental, vision, 401(K), and additional incentives
Culture of community and opportunity to work in a growing organization
Room for career growth and professional development
Training and educational opportunities
Checkmarx Inc. is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Technology Practice
jobs.text:
About Modern Executive Solutions
Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow.
The Role
The Associate Director leads core components of retained executive searches within our Technology Practice.
This is a research-led role including candidate first-round interviews. You are responsible for defining the target market, executing rigorous market mapping, building accurate and high-quality pipelines, and engaging candidates directly through structured first-stage interviews. You contribute to candidate assessment discussions and slate development.
Associate Directors typically manage ~5 concurrent retained searches.
Team Structure
Searches are typically staffed with a three-person team. Most often, this includes a Senior Partner, a Managing Director (or Senior Director), and an Associate Director. In some cases, the team may consist of a Partner, a Senior Director, and an Associate Director.
As the Associate Director, you lead research and market mapping and conduct first-round candidate interviews and early-stage candidate development. You work directly with senior leadership on search strategy, target identification, and candidate evaluation.
Because teams are small and accountability is clear, scope and responsibility are visible. Progression from Associate Director to Director is based on demonstrated capability and readiness rather than tenure, and can occur more quickly than in larger, more layered search firms where advancement is often tied to structure or time in seat.
Scope of Responsibility
Lead research strategy, including systematic market mapping and target company identification
Build and maintain high-quality candidate pipelines
Achieve 80%+ mapping accuracy through disciplined and creative sourcing methods
Conduct first-round candidate interviews
Contribute to structured candidate assessment and slate construction
Produce client-ready candidate summaries and search materials
Maintain disciplined search workflow and data integrity
Your work directly impacts market coverage, pipeline strength, and candidate quality.
Experience / At-Level Expectations
Demonstrated ability to manage ~5 concurrent retained searches with consistent quality and pace (approximately 12+ searches annually)
Proven strength in research strategy and systematic market mapping
Track record of building accurate target company lists and candidate pipelines, achieving 80%+ mapping accuracy
Experience conducting first-round candidate interviews and contributing to structured candidate assessment
Ability to independently draft client-ready materials with minimal edits
Strong discipline in maintaining accurate search workflow within an ATS
Experience supporting VP, SVP, or C-suite searches
Technology search experience is helpful but not required. We are open to outstanding researchers from retained executive search firms with a strong interest in building depth within technology leadership markets.
We will also selectively consider executive search researchers or executive recruiters from in-house executive recruiting teams supporting VP, SVP, or C-suite hiring within technology companies or large, complex enterprises (e.g., Fortune 500 organizations). This may include executive-level technical recruiters who have experience engaging senior technology leaders.
Candidates should demonstrate rigor in market mapping, structured candidate assessment, and executive-level engagement.
Why Modern?
• Purpose-Driven Work: Join a team that is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and gives back to the community by donating 10% of annual profits to support underserved youth and educational opportunities.
• Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful projects that positively impact clients’ organizations, communities, and the development of diverse leaders.
• Professional Growth: Gain exposure to various aspects of the business, with opportunities for mentorship, leadership development, and career advancement.
• Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with a 401(k) match.
• Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from a flexible remote work environment, paid parental leave, and an office setup stipend to support your work-from-home needs.
Our Values
• Be Bold: Think strategically, seeing implications and creative paths. Innovates commercially – seeks to understand client perspective to drive impact. Innovates internally - seeks to improve processes, procedures, and technology used within and across their teams.
• Be Excellent: Deliver client ready work, with attention to detail, raising the bar of expectations within team and with data integrity to include the use of all company tools and systems. Motivated by excellence to the benefit of clients and our firm.
• Be United: Be an inclusive ‘team player,’ willing to support, develop and ‘go the extra mile’ to deliver impact with others. Proactively develops trusting relationships both within and outside our firm.
• Be Authentic: Demonstrate awareness, coachability and a desire to grow with continuous improvement. Motivated by a personal purpose aligned with our firm’s mission and values. Is accountable for delivery of client ready work.
The pay range for this role is: 90,000 - 100,000 USD per year with a 10% annual target bonus (Remote)
Modern Executive Solutions is dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, veteran or military status or care-giver status. Please contact us at if you need assistance completing this application.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.
Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As a Director of Software Engineering for GenLogs, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling our core applications that tens of thousands of users rely on daily to fulfill critical supply chain operations.
This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning cloud/software platforms and solid understanding of machine learning and developing analytical based products. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.
You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.
WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning software engineering, product development, machine learning applications, and agentic development.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.
Set Technical Direction
Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the user facing applications and services
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.
Drive Product Delivery
Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.
Build Reliable, Scalable Systems
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.
Collaborate Across the Company
Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for user facing product lines
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

blocks.text: GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM

The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.

Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB

As a Director of Software Engineering for GenLogs, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling our core applications that tens of thousands of users rely on daily to fulfill critical supply chain operations.

This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning cloud/software platforms and solid understanding of machine learning and developing analytical based products. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.

You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.
The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.
Overview:
A plan is only as good as the team that can build it. At LegitScript, the Director of Engineering owns that team. You will lead through engineering managers, set the standard your squads build to, and make sure the software LegitScript promises actually ships. This is a senior technical leadership role: your judgment shapes architecture, estimates, and technical direction, but your leverage comes from the managers and technical leaders you develop, not the code you write yourself.
You will own the integrity of what engineering promises. Every commitment carries an engineering manager's signature on feasibility, approach, and cost, and that signature has to hold up in delivery. You will reduce the drag of maintenance work, make technical debt visible enough to compete for priority on its own merits, and build a reliability practice that keeps on-call sustainable. You will partner as a peer with product leadership, drawing a clean line between what gets built and how it gets built, so every trade-off is a real decision instead of a surprise.
What You'll Do:
Own delivery across your squads, including capacity planning, forecasting, and clear visibility into where every commitment stands.
Stand behind the engineering side of every co-signed bet: feasibility, approach, and cost.
Sequence technical work, surface delivery risk early, and turn a slipping commitment into a decision rather than a surprise.
Set and hold the standard for engineering quality, including design review, code review, testing, and documentation.
Own reliability, monitoring, and incident response for the services your squads run, and keep on-call sustainable.
Partner with staff engineers on architecture direction, and make sure squads build on the shared platform rather than around it.
Reduce operational toil through automation, replatforming, and retirement, and make technical debt visible enough to get funded.
Lead, coach, and grow engineering managers, owning hiring, performance, and career development.
Develop tech leads and senior engineers, building a strong technical bench in every squad.
Define and track engineering health metrics, including delivery predictability, cycle time, deployment frequency, and time to recovery.
Report progress, risk, and trade-offs to engineering leadership, product, and the executive team with clarity and a clear point of view.
What You'll Bring:
10+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineers, with demonstrable experience leading through other managers or senior technical leaders.
A track record of delivering complex B2B software, ideally in SaaS, fintech, regtech, compliance, trust and safety, or another domain where accuracy and defensibility matter as much as speed.
Experience owning delivery across multiple teams at once, including capacity planning, forecasting, and dependency management.
Credibility on estimation, with a track record of commitments that held and a clear view of how to fix a system that produces bad estimates.
Experience partnering with a product counterpart as a peer, with a clean boundary between product intent and technical execution.
Technical depth to evaluate architecture, API and integration design, and data modeling decisions, along with the judgment to know when to defer.
Experience consuming a shared platform or paved road rather than building parallel infrastructure per team.
Strong command of reliability practice, including observability, incident response, and sustainable on-call.
Experience hiring, growing, and retaining strong engineers and engineering managers.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a technical trade-off to an executive, a product partner, and an engineer in the same document.
A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred:
Experience in products that combine software automation with expert human review, including human-in-the-loop decision systems.
Domain experience in payments, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, supplements, financial crime, marketplaces, or advertising platforms.
Experience delivering complex, operations- and customer-facing applications on the Salesforce platform.
Experience in an organization moving to standardized, containerized deployment, delivered incrementally rather than through a single cutover.
Experience managing external consultancies with a deliberate plan to internalize ownership.
We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.
Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We cannot support international remote work.
**We do not accept unsolicited applications from third-party recruiters or agencies for this job posting. Any candidate submission without a prior agreement will be considered the property of our company, and we will not be responsible for any fees or obligations related to such submissions. We encourage interested candidates to apply directly through our official channels.**

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Data Management
jobs.text:
About Versapay
Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end- to-end cash flow clarity, ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms. By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.
About the Role
We are looking for a strategic, builder-minded Senior Director of Enterprise Data Management to own and execute Versapay’s enterprise data strategy at a pivotal moment in our evolution. This leader will drive the convergence of our transactional, operational, behavioral, relational and intent data layers into a unified operational backbone — the foundational unlock for AI- powered product features, semantic data models, externalized data products, and autonomous AR workflows.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role directly tied to our product and commercial roadmap, with a clear mandate and executive alignment behind it.
What You’ll Do
Data Strategy & Architecture
Define and drive Versapay’s enterprise data strategy, aligning the data roadmap to product, AI, and commercial objectives.
Lead the architectural convergence of our transactional, operational, and analytical data layers into a unified, bi-directional operational backbone.
Own a multi-year data maturity roadmap with clear milestones across architecture, semantics, governance, and accessibility.
Champion a business-first data modelling philosophy: canonical hierarchies, enterprise ontologies, and shared metric catalogues that allow humans and AI agents to interpret data consistently.
Data Governance & Quality
Operationalize data governance as a first-class concern — automated classification, RBAC enforcement, platform SLAs, and certified data objects.
Formalize the Enterprise Data Catalogue, replacing institutional knowledge with a searchable, self-service discovery layer.
Deploy and maintain an executive data health dashboard to provide ongoing visibility into the health and integrity of our data estate.
Enforce the data procurement gate, ensuring new tools and systems are reviewed and classified before entering the estate.
Build and own the Enterprise Data Asset Registry to enable secure, frictionless data sharing internally and with commercial partners.
AI Enablement & Agentic Readiness
Drive data infrastructure readiness to support Versapay’s AI roadmap — from ML pipelines and LLM serving layers
to agentic serving tiers.
Establish formal schema contracts and semantic modelling standards that guarantee deterministic outputs for safe,
scalable agent deployment.
Partner with Product and Engineering to enable agentic capabilities: reverse data flow, predictive model productization, and real-time data serving.
Govern data and AI exposure — ensuring sensitive data stays within approved platforms and all external data products meet strict quality, lineage, and privacy standards.
Data Accessibility & Commercialization
Evolve the function from ad hoc data requests to a design-first, product-oriented organization with a governed, discoverable asset registry.
Operationalize external data products for commercialization, delivering clear value to customers within consent
and compliance frameworks.
Partner with the commercial team on data product strategy — turning Versapay’s proprietary network data into defensible, recurring revenue.
Expand self-service data access for internal teams while protecting compute capacity and governance standards.
Team Leadership
Lead and grow the Data Platform Team, building a high-performing function with clear ownership across data strategy, engineering, consumption, AI compute; in tight partnership with the Embedded Analytics Team, Risk and Compliance.
Act as the cross-functional bridge between Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and Legal/Compliance- ensuring data serves every function from a shared, trusted foundation.
Build a culture of data discipline — standardizing how information is captured and governed so insight is consistent, discoverable, and trusted across the organization.
Represent the data function at the executive level, partnering closely with the CTO and contributing to the broader AI and product roadmap.
What You Bring
Required
• 10+ years of experience in data leadership, with at least 5+ years at the Director level owning enterprise data strategy, architecture, or governance.
• Demonstrated track record of modernizing and unifying complex, multi-source data environments at scale — ideally in a SaaS, fintech, payments context.
• Deep expertise in modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred), lakehouse architectures, ETL frameworks, and semantic/canonical modelling.
• Strong evidence of application of AI and ML infrastructure — including how data governance, observability, and semantic standards underpin safe, scalable AI deployment.
• Proven ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams and partner effectively across Product, Engineering, and Commercial functions.
• Experience governing data for commercial use: external data products, consent frameworks, lineage standards, and privacy compliance.
• Exceptional communication skills — able to translate complex data and architectural concepts for executive audiences and build alignment across functions.
• Experience with managing the cost of data warehouses and cost forecasting.
• Experience in hiring and managing talent across the entire data food chain – from BI and Analytics to Data Engineering to CI/CD of data platforms.
Preferred
• Experience with agentic AI architecture, MCP, or LLM serving layers and the data requirements that underpin them.
• Familiarity with AR/AP automation, payments, or working capital platforms and the data models they generate.
• Track record of commercializing data as a product — packaging data assets, building external APIs, or creating data-sharing programs with partners.
• Experience managing data maturity transformations with structured roadmaps, measurable milestones, and executive visibility.
• Hands-on experience with AWS-native data infrastructure (Glue, SageMaker, Bedrock) alongside Snowflake and modern BI tooling.
• Background in a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS environment.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Doit
We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
About the Role
The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.
What you will be doing
Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.
What you will need
Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.
Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.
Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.
Capable of building world-class engineering teams.
Still technically hands-on - able to review code, architecture, incidents and difficult engineering problems directly.
Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Portugal
We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain.
About The Role
Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.
The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.
This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.
Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.
You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:
Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.
Who You Are
Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like In The Role
The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.
Why Join Us
A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect In The Hiring Process
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
About the Role
We’re seeking a Executive Director of Data Engineering to lead the architecture, infrastructure, and engineering standards that power our global marketing intelligence capabilities. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Intelligence Officer, this leader will modernize our AI infrastructure, accelerate how we build and deliver, and set global data standards across every domain we touch — creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technologist and a strategic leader who can build best-in-class engineering practices at global scale while driving the move toward agile, automated, and AI-native data delivery.
What You’ll Do
AI Infrastructure & Engineering Modernization
Design and evolve scalable AI and data infrastructure that supports predictive, prescriptive, and generative use cases across the function.
Establish standards and tooling for accelerated delivery and faster coding — including AI-assisted development, reusable components, and automation that compresses time-to-value.
Evaluate and introduce new technologies that enable innovation across creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data domains.
Mature our MLOps and deployment practices so models and data products move from prototype to production reliably and repeatably.
Data Standards, Taxonomies & Governance
Develop comprehensive, future-proof data taxonomies and data standards that bring consistency and interoperability across domains and regions.
Set and govern global data standards — architecture, quality, lineage, documentation, and metadata — that scale across the network and agency partners.
Embed data governance, privacy, and security by design, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and responsible AI practices.
Create a single, trusted foundation for data that improves accuracy, accessibility, and reuse across teams.
Delivery Excellence & AI Integration
Drive continuous progress toward agile, automated, and effective data delivery, embedding DevOps/DataOps practices and CI/CD across engineering workflows.
Define and uphold best-in-class standards for AI integration, from data pipelines through model deployment and monitoring.
Build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization, raising the bar on technical excellence, velocity, and reliability.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security to lead the teams responsible for protecting the systems, products, services, and data that power the Roblox platform. This is an opportunity to define how security and privacy are engineered into one of the world’s largest and most ambitious platforms. You will work on problems that span product design, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, privacy, and emerging technology—helping protect the data and systems relied on by tens of millions of users and creators.
You will bring Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering together around a unified vision to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Roblox’s products, infrastructure, and data systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other business leaders to make security and privacy durable properties of how Roblox designs, builds, deploys, and operates.
Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will oversee a high-impact organization of security engineering leaders and senior individual contributors. You will operate as a peer to Infrastructure and Engineering leadership, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and well-executed engineering solutions.
You Will
Set the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering.
Lead and grow a high-performing organization of managers and senior technical leaders, while building a culture of accountability, inclusion, and technical excellence.
Establish security and privacy architecture principles for Roblox products, services, production platforms, cloud environments, and data systems.
Raise the security bar across the software development lifecycle through security reviews, threat modeling, secure design, testing, vulnerability management, and risk-based remediation.
Drive the design and adoption of hardened, secure platforms at Roblox scale, partnering with Infrastructure Engineering on foundational security controls.
Advance Privacy Engineering by embedding privacy-by-design practices and scalable technical controls into product and platform architecture, data flows, and operating processes.
Translate regulatory and company privacy commitments into clear engineering requirements, measurable controls, and durable solutions.
Own cross-functional priorities, metrics, executive reporting, and delivery for product security, platform security, privacy engineering, and related risk-reduction programs.
You Have
15+ years of experience in security engineering, privacy engineering, infrastructure security, or a related technical field, including 8+ years leading and developing engineering or security organizations.
Deep technical expertise in at least one security or engineering discipline, with the breadth and judgment to lead across product, platform, infrastructure, cloud, data, and privacy domains.
A track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable security outcomes across large-scale products, platforms, or distributed systems.
Experience embedding security and privacy into the software development lifecycle through architecture, standards, tooling, automation, and risk-based prioritization.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment across modern production environments, including cloud, hybrid, distributed, containerized, and data-intensive systems.
A people-centered, results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to build high-performing teams, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical risk and tradeoffs clearly.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$457,970—$525,510 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.
