jobs.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
jobs.text:
In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.
A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market.
Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents
Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building their companies
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the banking ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A leader with great product chops, commercial instinct to grow the business, and discipline to run it safely
A high bar for craft – leading a creative, customer-centered, data-driven and experimentation-oriented approach
Enthusiasm for building AI- and agent-powered products that drive spectacular customer experiences
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, risk, compliance, finance, and partners
10+ years' experience, ideally in banking, payments, platforms, or financial products
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Command of how business banking works: account opening and KYB, deposits and liquidity, payment rails (ACH, wire, check, international, FedNow, RTP)
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 financial products, ideally in fintech or another high-growth environment, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Sound judgment in a regulated, risk-sensitive environment: balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting
Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.
Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
jobs.text:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.
Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.
Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners

blocks.text: In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.

Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.

Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:

items: Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

blocks.text: Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

items: A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners
Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment
Sound judgment in a regulated environment: you balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
As a Director of Engineering, you’ll lead an established engineering organisation responsible for one of our key business areas, with the autonomy and accountability to make a significant impact on how engineering performs at Zopa. You’ll set direction, build high-performing teams and drive meaningful improvements across people, technology and ways of working. This isn’t a role focused on incremental change: we’re looking for someone who can identify where the biggest opportunities exist, create a clear strategy and turn it into measurable progress. You’ll have the scope to influence significant technical and architectural decisions, improve engineering effectiveness and shape how we build and operate technology.
Your impact will extend beyond the teams you directly lead. Our Directors are expected to raise the level of engineering across Zopa, working closely with Product, Commercial and Technology leaders to turn engineering improvements into better business outcomes. You’ll bring strong people leadership, technical credibility and a genuinely data-led approach to understanding what’s working and where we can improve, while helping us push further in areas such as AI-enabled engineering.
This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering leader to take real ownership, drive substantial change and clearly see the results of the decisions they make.
As a highly collaborative role, you’ll attend our Canary Wharf office 3 days per week

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
About Freedom
Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer to define and lead the technology strategy of Freedom Digital Bank France.
The CTO will be responsible for technology architecture, infrastructure, engineering, cybersecurity, data governance, IT operations and digital transformation. The role will work closely with the wider Freedom Holding Corp. technology organisation to develop a secure, resilient and scalable digital banking platform.
As a member of the founding executive team, the CTO will contribute to the bank’s regulatory authorisation, establishment and launch in France. The successful candidate will ensure that the technology environment meets applicable French and EU regulatory, cybersecurity, data-protection and operational-resilience requirements.
Key responsibilities:
Define and execute the technology strategy for Freedom Digital Bank France.
Design and maintain a secure, scalable and resilient technology architecture.
Lead infrastructure, cloud, engineering, integration and IT operations initiatives.
Ensure the availability, performance and security of digital banking platforms.
Establish IT governance, technology controls and architecture standards.
Oversee cybersecurity, information security and technology risk management programmes.
Ensure compliance with financial-sector technology requirements and operational resilience requirements.
Implement effective ICT incident detection, incident response, recovery and regulatory reporting processes.
Develop business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities.
Support the development and launch of digital banking products and customer journeys.
Partner with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Business teams.
Oversee technology outsourcing and relationships with cloud providers, vendors and strategic partners.
Manage technology budgets, resources and delivery priorities.
Build and develop high-performing technology teams.
Support the preparation of technology, cybersecurity and outsourcing documentation required for the regulatory authorisation process.
Drive automation, innovation and continuous improvement across the bank.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Pakistan
Pakistan is home to the third-largest concentration of technology team members at Moniepoint, and it's one of the fastest-growing markets we hire into, with real headroom for growth in seniority and scope. We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Pakistan.
About the role
Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.
The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.
We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.
That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.
There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.
As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:
Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.
Who you are
You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like
The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
The platform ready to support a new market.
A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.
Why Join Us
A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect in The Hiring Process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.
Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.
Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.
The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.
As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. Reporting to the CTO, this leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.
What you’ll do:
Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.
Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to the CTO and senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.
Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.
What we’re looking for:

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
jobs.text:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

jobs.title: Data Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
Director, Analytics & Marketing Intelligence – Automotive
Company: VML / WPP
Location: London, UK
Working Model: Hybrid
Reporting to: Chief Marketing Intelligence Officer
Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1
At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.
Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.
About the Opportunity
We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Analytics & Intelligence to lead analytics and marketing intelligence across a major European automotive account.
This is a senior, client-facing role sitting at the intersection of marketing analytics, consulting and commercial leadership.
This isn’t a traditional technical Data Director position. We’re looking for someone who understands how data, analytics and measurement can help senior marketing leaders make better decisions and who can turn complex information into a clear strategic and commercial point of view.
You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders across European markets, helping them understand marketing and customer performance, identify opportunities for growth and make more informed decisions through data and insight.
Your experience could span areas such as marketing effectiveness, marketing mix modelling (MMM), media measurement, CRM and customer analytics, digital and web analytics, and broader marketing intelligence. You don’t need to be the technical specialist in every discipline; what matters is your ability to understand how these areas connect and translate them into meaningful recommendations for clients.
Alongside leading the analytics relationship, you’ll play an important role in identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions and growing the partnership across Europe.
What You’ll Do
Lead Marketing Analytics & Intelligence
Lead the development and delivery of marketing analytics and intelligence across European markets.
Bring together data and insight from across media, CRM, digital, customer and market sources to create a holistic view of performance.
Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Help clients understand marketing effectiveness, customer behaviour and the drivers of business performance.
Use measurement approaches, including MMM and wider effectiveness methodologies, to help inform marketing investment and decision-making.
Identify emerging trends, opportunities and challenges and turn these into meaningful strategic recommendations.
Help shape new approaches and capabilities across analytics, measurement and marketing intelligence.
Be a Senior Strategic Partner to Clients
Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as an advisor rather than simply a delivery partner.
Understand the business challenge behind the data and determine how analytics and insight can help solve it.
Lead senior conversations around marketing performance, customer behaviour, effectiveness and growth.
Turn complicated analytical thinking into clear and compelling stories that clients can understand and act on.
Bring a strong point of view, challenge existing thinking where appropriate and introduce new ideas and approaches.
Balance individual market requirements with a broader European perspective.
Drive Commercial Growth
Develop a deep understanding of client priorities and identify opportunities where data, analytics and intelligence can add further value.
Shape new propositions, solutions and scopes of work around those opportunities.
Support and lead pitches, proposals and senior new-business conversations.
Work with wider VML and WPP capabilities to bring the right expertise together around client challenges.
Understand the commercial aspects of the relationship, including scoping, financial management and account profitability.
Help turn strong client relationships and great analytical thinking into sustainable commercial growth.
Connect Teams & Markets
Work closely with local market teams to build a joined-up European approach to analytics and marketing intelligence.
Bring together specialists across data, media, strategy, CRM, customer experience and technology to solve complex client challenges.
Establish consistent ways of working and share best practice across markets.
Connect local insights and intelligence to build a stronger regional perspective.
Provide leadership and direction to cross-functional teams working across different disciplines and markets.
What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who can bridge the gap between analytics and the business someone who understands the data but is equally comfortable explaining what it means, what the client should do next and where the next opportunity lies.
You’ll ideally bring:
Strong experience within marketing analytics, measurement, marketing effectiveness or marketing intelligence.
Significant experience working within the automotive sector, with a strong understanding of its customers, commercial challenges and marketing landscape.
Experience across areas such as MMM, media measurement, CRM/customer analytics, digital analytics or marketing effectiveness.
The ability to translate complex data and analysis into clear strategic recommendations and compelling client stories.
Strong senior stakeholder management and the confidence to advise, influence and challenge clients.
A consulting mindset, with the ability to start with a business challenge and determine the right analytical response.
Strong commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities, shaping propositions and growing client relationships.
Experience working across multiple markets, ideally within a European or global organisation.
Experience bringing together cross-functional teams and different areas of expertise to solve client problems.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
The ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving and complex client environment.
Additional European language skills would be an advantage.
What’s in it for you?
Alongside a generous annual leave allowance and pension, you’ll have access to a wide range of benefits, including:
Life Assurance
Permanent Health Insurance
BUPA
Flexible hybrid working
Enhanced family-friendly policies
Well-being Programme
Employee Assistance Support
Cycle to Work Scheme
Eye Care and Glasses Vouchers
Season Ticket Loans
WPP Discounts
You’ll also have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and support for your longer-term career development.
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
VML is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability.
We believe in creating a dynamic working environment that values diversity and inclusion and are committed to recruiting a diverse slate of candidates.
If you require reasonable adjustments or additional support during the application process, our People Team will be happy to assist.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Head of Developer Relations, SEA and OCE
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As the Head of Developer Relations you will own the strategy, execution, and outcomes for Roblox developer growth strategies of Southeast Asia (SEA). You will work directly with publishers, developers, emerging studios, and industry partners across SEA to drive adoption, accelerate development, and build long-term ecosystem relationships.
You will serve as a strategic partner to developers, represent Roblox at industry events, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Creator, and International teams to scale Roblox as a destination for high-quality, game development.
You Will:
Proactively set team goals, monitor progress and conversation trends with key partners.
Partner with data scientists, product, engineering and leaders across the company.
Become the voice of your partners, identifying and quantifying the critical action items that will impact our product growth in the region.
Communicate risk factors of the region and make difficult decisions.
Actively share reports to reflect the impact of your work with the company.
Requirements:
Residency in Singapore or willing to relocate.
10+ years of experience in technical project management.
Able to proactively communicate with all key stakeholders.
Experience with launching a technical product in international markets.
Experience with using Roblox Studio or another game development engine. (eg. Unity or Unreal)
A researcher with a unique skill set to quickly ramp up and understand your target audience needs.
Passionate, full of positive energy, and a role model to others.
Driven by teamwork, naturally encourages people to work together.
Able to lead by example, building a clear high-level strategy and holding yourself and others accountable to the long-term company vision.
Data and feedback driven, your decisions are inspired by the product usage, the users’ qualitative insights, and your expertise.
Communication focused with excellent verbal and written skills.
Self-Directed with the ability to establish your work and processes.
Advance Educational degree or equivalent practical experience
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta is the world’s first health provider-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.
Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.
This position is based in Hyderabad, India.
Who We Need
Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.
If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.
This Opportunity
We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.
The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.
These services form the backbone of Truveta’s engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with people-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.
What You’ll Do
Technical and Platform Leadership
Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
Lead the development and management of Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud-native services.
Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, and developer self-service capabilities.
Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
Provide hands-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.
Product and Delivery Leadership
Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.
POD and People Leadership
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team in India.
Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
Partner effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production-grade backend services.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security-focused backend services.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with open-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open-source solutions.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero-trust security models.
Experience defining service-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
We're hiring a VP of Engineering to take full ownership of one of our core engineering domains. You'll report to our CTO and own your domain outright, including strategy, architecture, delivery, and the team. This is a hands-on leadership role.
Responsibilities
Take full technical and delivery ownership of a core area of the business, which could span AI, trading, retail, or another part of the platform
Architect and build the core systems in your domain, from real-time generation and demand modelling through to high-volume consumption pipelines and the customer-facing app
Build and lead the engineering team in your domain, including hiring, structure, and standards
Set technical direction alongside the CTO and the wider leadership team
Ship alongside your team on the hardest problems

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.
You will own the Platform end-to-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.
The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.
This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.
We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade-offs between long-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.
Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Architecture
Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business-critical.
Balance long-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.
Reliability & Engineering Excellence
Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident-management practices.
Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
Lead post-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Core Platform Capabilities
Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross-company capabilities.
Product & Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.
You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.
Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
Make clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade-offs.
Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.
AI-First Engineering
Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.

jobs.title: Head of Product - B2C
jobs.text:
Renmoney Microfinance Bank is on a mission to empower individuals and businesses across Nigeria by building a comprehensive financial ecosystem. From lending and savings to insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle services, we are creating innovative solutions that drive financial inclusion and economic growth.
Your Mission
As Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will own the vision and strategic direction of Renmoney’s retail product ecosystem. This includes core lending and banking products, as well as adjacent services such as insurance, remittances, and lifestyle solutions. Given the seniority of the CPO position and its strategic impact on the business, the role requires relocation to Lagos, Nigeria for the on-site work in the headquarters of the company.
You will work closely with the executive team to:
Drive product innovation and profitability.
Enhance customer experience and adoption.
Ensure products are competitive, compliant, and scalable in Nigeria’s fast-evolving financial services landscape.
You will lead multidisciplinary teams across Product Management, Design, Data, and Technology — ensuring that what we build creates measurable value for customers, partners, and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision
Define and deliver Renmoney’s ecosystem product strategy, balancing growth, profitability, and risk.
Translate market opportunities into scalable product roadmaps across lending, banking services, insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle.
Stay ahead of regulatory requirements and competitive dynamics in Nigeria.
Product Development & Execution
Lead the design and rollout of customer-centric products tailored to Nigeria’s retail segments.
Champion research, data analytics, and customer feedback to shape product decisions.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital channels to improve efficiency and customer experience.
Establish robust product governance and compliance processes.
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Build and manage strategic partnerships with fintechs, telcos, insurers, remittance providers, and lifestyle platforms.
Develop cross-sell, bundled, and embedded finance opportunities that expand customer value.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms that balance growth and cost efficiency.
Leadership & Performance
Lead and grow a high-performing product team with a culture of accountability, innovation, and delivery.
Partner with Risk, Finance, and Collections to optimize pricing, yields, impairments, and capital allocation.
Track and report KPIs: adoption, profitability, NPS/CSAT, revenue contribution, and ecosystem expansion.

jobs.title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
jobs.text:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !
L'opportunité:
HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients.
Vos missions:
Construire et développer une équipe produit performante
Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France.
Définir et challenger la vision produit
Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.
Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.
Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.
Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale
Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.
Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.
Aligner produit et stratégie marketing
Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.
Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.
Votre profil:
Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement.
Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables.
Leadership : Au moins 3 ans de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires à différents niveaux de carrière — avec un vrai sens du coaching, une direction claire et l'envie de faire grandir les gens
Un(e) leader qui passe à l'action. Vous donnez le cap, vous emmenez votre équipe avec vous, et vous mettez la main à la pâte pour que ça se concrétise.
Orienté(e) client et rigoureux(se) dans l'analyse. À l'aise pour interroger vos propres données et challenger vos hypothèses. Capable d'aller dans le détail, de faire le lien avec la vision d'ensemble, et de restituer les insights avec clarté.
Orienté(e) business. Vous comprenez comment les décisions produit se répercutent sur les coûts et les revenus — et vous vous tenez responsable des résultats, pas seulement des réalisations.
Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes.
Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action.
Excellent(e) communicant(e). Vous écrivez et présentez avec clarté et conviction — que ce soit pour un narratif stratégique, une mise à jour pour le leadership ou un brief produit.
Organisé(e) et structuré(e), avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés.
Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.
Ce que nous t’offrons :
Un environnement dynamique et international, avec une culture d'entreprise forte
Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide garantie !
Une équipe française bienveillante, passionnée, proactive et dynamique
Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement
Nos avantages : de délicieuses réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, réduction sur le transport, un accès privilégié à Gymlib
Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :
Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !
Tes débuts chez HelloFresh :
A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO - AI Catalyst Discovery Venture
jobs.text:
The Venture
Discovering a better catalyst still runs on trial and error: form a hypothesis, synthesise a few candidates, test, repeat, for years, at a cost measured in millions. Most of the search space is never touched. It is one of the slowest, most expensive bottlenecks between the chemicals industry and a lower-carbon future.
We're building the company to change that. Spun out of A*STAR, our platform closes the loop between computation and the lab: machine learning proposes catalyst compositions worth making, simulation screens them, and an automated experimental workflow validates the winners, feeding every result back to sharpen the next cycle. It reaches candidates a traditional programme never would, in a fraction of the time and cost.
The beachhead is CO₂ to methanol and green chemicals, where industry pull is real and the economics work. Most catalyst work is improving a recipe that already exists, and the incumbent supplier usually keeps that business. The opportunity is a new process with no incumbent catalyst, and an unusual number of those are arriving between now and 2030. The core discovery IP is being licensed from A*STAR, with the inventor on board as an advisor. What the venture needs now is a founding technical leader to own the science and build the company around it.
The Role
You'll be the founding CTO. You'll own everything from the discovery campaign to a catalyst a customer can actually run in their process, taking a validated workflow and turning it into the engine of a real business. You'll work alongside a commercial co-founder (CEO), a dedicated ATUM venture team, and the inventor-advisor.
Together, we'll:
Direct the catalysis: which chemistries we pursue, how we design the discovery campaigns, how we read the results
Own the licensed workflow and the automated experimental loop end to end
Take candidates from prediction to a manufacturable, deployable catalyst, not a paper
Build defensible IP the company owns, including new catalyst compositions worth patenting
Sit across the table from chemical customers and turn their process problems into targets we can solve
Build the lab foundation and the science team behind it
This is not a job. It's a founding journey where you share the risk, the upside, and the impact.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
At Inventi, we build payment infrastructure technology for payment service providers. Our payments platform connects customers to SEPA, SWIFT, TARGET2, and other payment systems through a single API.
We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer to set our technology direction and shape what we build next.
Why this could be interesting for you
There's no fixed roadmap waiting for you here - you'd build it yourself. You'd shape both the technology and the team, staying hands-on, on infrastructure banks and PSPs actually depend on. And you'd get real room to experiment with AI along the way.
The role:
Own our technology strategy and make the big architectural decisions.
Drive AI adoption across engineering - make it part of how we build.
Set the bar for technical quality and engineering standards.
Own reliability, security, and technical risk across the platform.
Build a delivery process the whole company can rely on.
Drive company wide engineering culture and strive for quality, passion and learning.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
Igloo is expanding its product engine and establishing a dedicated Tech Solutions hub in Pune. We are looking for a hands-on Lead Solutions Architect & Site Lead to drive platform architecture, govern technical design, and manage our multidisciplinary engineering organization in India.
In this dual-impact role, you will balance deep technical ownership—reviewing architecture, guiding system design, and auditing code—with people leadership across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and Integration teams. You will ensure our high-throughput insurance and direct-to-consumer platform remains scalable, secure, and resilient.
Key Responsibilities:
Architecture & System Design
Architect, design, and govern high-availability, microservices-based platform solutions for global direct-to-consumer and partner-facing lines of business.
Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews; establish quality benchmarks, security controls, and robust release mechanisms.
Stay hands-on with system design and technical troubleshooting, guiding engineers through complex algorithmic and infrastructural challenges.
Team & Site Leadership
Lead overall strategy, capacity planning, and operating rhythm for the Pune technology hub.
Recruit, mentor, and scale multidisciplinary teams across backend, frontend, QA, DevOps/SRE, and platform integration.
Drive engineering culture, career pathing, succession planning, and retention initiatives across the India site.
Product Delivery & Operations
Partner with global product, architecture, and business teams (UAE, India, China) to align platform roadmap with technical execution.
Collaborate with DevOps/SRE and QA to optimize CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, observability, and incident response SLAs.
Leverage AI productivity tools responsibly for code synthesis, testing, documentation, and technical analysis.

jobs.title: B2B Tech Associate Director - Burson
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role:
As an Associate Director in our Technology practice, you will be working across some of our largest and most strategic enterprise/B2B clients. As well as an overall understanding of enterprise technology gleaned from your experience to date, the successful candidate will have experience working with brands in some or all of the following key sectors: datacentre, automotive, semiconductor/processor, and Internet of Things.
Alongside your relevant experience, you will be a dynamic and commercially astute thinker, creating strategic and innovative solutions to meet client challenges, yielding exceptional results. You will offer insightful and effective counsel to clients, manage expectations, proactively address issues, and ensure seamless execution of all client deliverables.
What you'll do:
Lead and grow senior client relationships, providing strategic counsel and ensuring communications programmes deliver against business objectives.
Develop and oversee integrated communications strategies and creative campaigns across multiple channels.
Partner closely with internal specialists and agency partners to deliver innovative, insight-led client solutions.
Drive account growth by identifying new opportunities, selling integrated programmes and supporting new business pitches and proposals.
Oversee project delivery, ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an exceptional standard.
Champion the use of data, intelligence and AI-powered solutions to enhance client outcomes and uncover new opportunities.
Lead, inspire and develop team members through coaching, mentoring, performance management and career development planning.
Act as a senior ambassador for the agency, contributing to thought leadership, industry visibility, agency culture and continued business growth.
Experience that contributes to success:
Proven experience leading senior client relationships and acting as a trusted strategic advisor to technology and innovation-focused brands.
Strong integrated communications background across earned, social, content, influencer and corporate communications.
Demonstrated ability to develop high-impact strategies, compelling narratives and multi-channel campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Experience operating within complex, multi-agency environments and collaborating effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.Commercially minded, with a track record of driving account growth, uncovering new opportunities and contributing to business development.
Strong understanding of data-driven communications, measurement frameworks, AI tools and intelligence-led planning.
Experienced people leader with a passion for coaching, mentoring and developing high-performing teams.
Excellent presentation, pitching and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
#LI-CY1
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
